Moreover, operating the LDM at 6.25 Hz with rich semantic and acoustic latent representation enables efficient training and sampling, requiring only 1 day of training on 4 GPUs and fast inference with an RTF of 0.08. Audio samples are available at https://regenvoice.github.io/demo/.

title: Residual Physics-Informed Neural Networks for High-Fidelity BLDC Motor Modeling
authors: Haitham El-Hussieny
abstract: Accurate dynamics modeling of Brushless DC (BLDC) motors is fundamental to high-performance robotic joint control. This paper presents a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) with a deep residual (ResNet) backbone that learns a continuous-time surrogate of the full six-state BLDC motor dynamics. Given simulation time, applied three-phase voltages, and excitation parameters as inputs, the network directly predicts all motor state variables -- rotor angle, angular velocity, three-phase currents, and winding temperature -- while simultaneously satisfying the governing electromechanical and thermal ODEs through a composite physics-data loss. A curriculum scheduling strategy gradually activates the physics penalty to prevent premature convergence. Training runs are completed in under two minutes on a standard CPU. Crucially, once trained, PINN inference achieves latencies of 0.1--22, mu s per query, up to 118x faster than conventional ODE solvers, making it suitable for real-time observer and control applications.

title: Super-Generalist: Towards Comprehensive and Accurate Medical Image Understanding via Generalist-Specialist Synergy
authors: Shaoteng Zhang, Weiwei Cao, Wanxing Chang, Yutong Xie, Kai Cao, Zaiyi Liu, Yu Shi, Tingbo Liang, Qi Zhang, Ling Zhang, Yong Xia, Jianpeng Zhang
abstract: Medical images require comprehensive and accurate interpretation to support the diagnosis of diverse clincial conditions. Recent vision-language generalist models offer broad task coverage and promising zero-shot capabilities, yet often lack fine-grained anatomical and lesion awareness for reliable diagnosis and spatial interpretability. In contrast, supervised specialist models achieve strong performance on specific tasks but typically lack generalization across diseases and anatomies. In this work, we present SuG, a Super-Generalist framework that unifies generalist vision-language learning with specialist objectives, enabling both broad generalization and specialist-level diagnostic capability. We perform specialist-enhanced vision-language alignment in SuG by incorporating spatial priors from multiple segmentation experts, including anatomy, class-specific lesion and class-agnostic lesion segmentors that captures lesions beyond anatomies annotated during training. To improve lesion grounding capability, we leverage lesion masks as spatial priors to calibrate text-conditioned visual attention, encouraging disease-related semantics to focus on clinically relevant regions. We evaluate SuG on extensive chest and abdominal CT benchmarks, including CT-RATE, Merlin, MedVL-CT69K, and several in-house tumor datasets. SuG achieves state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of disease diagnosis tasks and surpasses specialist models on several critical tumor diagnosis benchmarks. Furthermore, SuG demonstrates strong lesion grounding capability, including robust generalization to lesion types lacking class-specific supervision.

title: BeyondSight: Object Permanence for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
authors: Sandro Papais, Letian Wang, Mudit Jain, Behnaz Rezaei, Steven L. Waslander
abstract: Autonomous driving operates in partially observable environments where actors may become fully occluded by other vehicles or infrastructure. Most end-to-end driving systems implicitly couple actor existence to instantaneous observations, causing actor hypotheses to degrade or disappear during prolonged occlusion and removing potentially critical agents from downstream prediction and planning. We introduce BeyondSight, a permanence-aware end-to-end driving framework that decouples actor existence from observability by maintaining persistent actor hypotheses over time. BeyondSight propagates actor queries temporally and updates them with observation-conditioned evidence, enabling joint perception, prediction, and planning to reason about actors even when they are temporarily unobservable. To enable principled training and evaluation of persistence-aware models, we further introduce nuScenes-Permanence, an extension of nuScenes that provides supervision and observability-conditioned evaluation for unobservable actors. Experiments show that BeyondSight substantially improves reasoning under occlusion, increasing detection performance for unobservable actors from 0 to 0.249 mAP while reducing planning error from 0.61 to 0.54 L2avg. These results highlight object permanence as an important modeling principle for robust end-to-end autonomous driving.

title: Exploring the Potential of Program Flowcharts on Code Generation Using Multimodal LLMs
authors: Yuki Toi, Tao Xiao, Kazushi Tomoto, Masanari Kondo, Yasutaka Kamei
abstract: In recent years, Large Language Models (LLMs) have made significant strides, leading to the emergence of multimodal LLMs capable of processing diverse inputs such as images and audio. Previous research indicates that the supply of multimodal LLMs with combined textual and visual information improves the automatic code generation capabilities. In software development, diagrams such as flowcharts are widely employed to facilitate tasks like code comprehension. While existing studies investigated the impact of visual inputs on LLMs and the usage of software diagrams, the potential influence of providing flowcharts on multimodal LLM performance remains underexplored. In this study, we generated flowcharts from example solution code for AtCoder problems and provided these visual aids alongside problem statements to GPT-4o for code generation. Our findings demonstrate that integrating flowcharts with problem statements yields performance improvements of up to 10%. Furthermore, when employing abstracted flowcharts, we observed a trend indicating that increasing levels of flowchart detail correlate with enhanced performance. Additionally, we compared the effectiveness of flowchart provision to Few-Shot Learning approaches. The findings suggest that one-shot learning provides sustainable improvements, whereas two-shot learning results in only minor improvements. Our work highlights the importance of software diagrams in supporting multimodal LLM-driven code generation.

title: Weaving Light and Time: Unified Harmonic-Geometric Representation Learning for Dense RGB-Event Parsing
authors: Chenxu Peng, Chongtian zhou, Dicheng Liu, Bo-Wen Yin, Yimian Dai, Xialei Liu, Ming-Ming Cheng, Xiang Li
abstract: Fusing standard RGB frames with asynchronous event streams has emerged as a definitive paradigm for robust perception in degraded environments. Although unified backbones have recently gained traction in multi-modal vision, adapting them to the RGB-Event domain remains fundamentally challenging. Existing architectures either resort to decoupled dual encoders that double computational overhead, or adopt generic unified designs that fail to resolve implicit geometric parallax and cross-spectral aliasing under the extreme representational divide between dense intensity grids and sparse kinematic spikes. To transcend these bottlenecks, we present Evita, the first unified backbone specifically engineered for dedicated dense RGB-Event parsing. To achieve profound modal synergy, Evita explicitly embeds a suite of intrinsic co-learning modules directly into every encoder layer. Specifically, it features Geometric Parallax Rectification for adaptive spatial alignment, Harmonic Spectral Resonance for texture transfer exclusively in the complex frequency domain, and Transient Global Routing for event-driven asymmetric attention. To guarantee robust feature extraction against spatial misalignments and decouple representations from specific event encodings, we construct N-ImageNetV2 alongside a stochastic event representation mixing pretraining protocol, empowering the network to seamlessly accommodate arbitrary event formats in downstream tasks. Extensive evaluations across the DELIVER, DDD17, and DSEC benchmarks confirm that Evita establishes new state-of-the-art metrics while delivering a superior accuracy-latency trade-off for real-time multimodal perception.The code are publicly available at: https://github.com/chaineypung/Evita.

title: Taxonomy Maintenance In The Wild Over Evolving Scholarly Data: Reliability, Efficiency, and Cost-Effectiveness
authors: Daomin Ji, Hui Luo, Zhifeng Bao, Junhao Gan, Zi Huang
abstract: The rapid growth of scientific publications makes scholarly taxonomies quickly obsolete. We study taxonomy maintenance in the wild, a new problem that moves beyond static construction by continuously adapting taxonomies to evolving scholarly repositories, such as arXiv, for a given research topic. We propose GIST, a robust framework for maintaining evolving taxonomies. Unlike purely LLM-centric approaches, GIST grounds structure induction in expert-curated evidence by extracting partial hierarchies from the "Related Work" sections of papers. It integrates these partial taxonomies into a unified global taxonomy in a geometric box-embedding space, where box containment encodes the inductive bias of is-a relations. To connect semantics with geometric structure, GIST learns a bidirectional mapping between word embeddings and box embeddings. For efficient incremental updates, GIST uses novelty-aware coreset selection to update the model with representative historical signals and new evidence, avoiding costly full retraining. To handle high-velocity paper streams under user-specific token budgets, GIST further combines a hypothesized concept generator with a cost-effective evidence retrieval module. Experiments on real-world arXiv datasets show that GIST outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, improving Node F1 and Edge F1 by 11.0% and 13.1% over the strongest baseline while requiring only 9.6% of its runtime and 12.7% of its monetary cost.
comment: The paper has been accepted by SIGMOD 2027

title: MedRealMM: A Real-World Multimodal Benchmark for Chinese Online Medical Consultation
authors: Runhan Shi, Quan Zhou, Yuqian Xu, Shuai Yang, Xin Wu, Zitong Zhou, Hui Liu, Bin Cha, Zheming Wang, Liya Li, Wei Wei, Haoyuan Hu, Jun Xu
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in online medical consultation, yet existing benchmarks remain poorly aligned with real clinical practice. Many rely on synthetic conversations or patient simulators, omit patient-uploaded medical images, or evaluate open-ended clinical responses using multiple-choice or lexical-overlap metrics that poorly reflect clinical quality. We introduce \textbf{MedRealMM}, a large-scale benchmark for multimodal online medical consultation built from de-identified patient-doctor interactions collected from a nationwide Chinese internet hospital. MedRealMM uses a Multimodal Clinical Challenge Point (MCCP) extraction framework to identify clinically demanding moments in authentic consultation trajectories and converts each into a standardized next-response generation task while preserving the preceding text-image context. Each instance is paired with a case-specific rubric refined by physicians that rewards clinically desirable behaviors and penalizes unsafe, unsupported, or contradictory responses. The current release contains 5,620 real-world multimodal cases spanning 64 clinical departments. We evaluate 19 general-purpose and medical-specialized LLMs, including text-only and multimodal systems. Our results show that image information is critical for reliable clinical performance and that current frontier models remain below the online physician response. Although some frontier models satisfy as many or more positive clinical criteria than physicians, they trigger more negative criteria, indicating that safety-sensitive error avoidance remains a central bottleneck. MedRealMM offers a realistic and reproducible benchmark for evaluating multimodal medical reasoning in real-world online consultation. The dataset will be publicly available on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/jdh-algo/MedRealMM.

title: Feeling UISTful: An Interactive Portrait of Scholarly Authorship, Readership, and the In-Between
authors: Sophia Liu, Shm Garanganao Almeda, Max Kreminski, Bjoern Hartmann
abstract: We introduce UISTful, a system that turns reading activity into a collective portrait of a scholarly community. Readers explore a semantic globe of UIST papers and authors while the system records private reading traces that can be reviewed, reflected upon, curated, and published for others to replay. Inspired by the information flâneur, UISTful treats a reading trace as a camera through which readers frame and interpret what they read, casting reading as a creative and authorial process. Shared traces display the plurality of interpretations composed across the same scholarly landscape, while collective trace views reveal paths and concentrations of attention across the community, inviting UIST to see itself as an interactive system of papers, authors, readers, and their exchanges.

title: Beyond F5 and GVW: The Proper-Cover Algorithm for Fast Ideal Basis Computation
authors: Sheng-Ming Ma, Yi Liu, Zheng-Lin Jiao
abstract: Gröbner basis computation incurs heavy computational overhead, especially under lexicographic order. F5 and its GVW variant dominate efficient field-based Gröbner basis solving. The proper basis algorithm offers a parameterized ideal computation framework without leveraging modern signature-based optimizations. This work presents the Proper-Cover algorithm for zero-dimensional polynomial ideals by combining GVW's cover optimization over signature with the proper basis theory. We generalize signature, cover, POT ordering, reduction and S-pair concepts to parameterized coefficients, design a two-phase algorithm with compatible factor construction and hungry refinement, and rigorously prove termination and output correctness. Accordingly, we propose a new framework for the efficient computation of polynomial ideal bases. Benchmark results show that Proper-Cover surpasses F5 under all monomial orderings and delivers clear speedups over GVW for lexicographic (plex) order.

title: Evaluating Semantic and Quality-Aware Retrieval for Source Code Repositories
authors: Marek Horváth, Emília Pietriková
abstract: Keyword-based retrieval is limited for source-code repositories when queries are expressed in natural language or concern implementation intent and code quality rather than exact tokens. This study evaluates a prototype retrieval system that combines function-level fragmentation, text-and-code embeddings, ChromaDB vector storage, LLM-derived quality metadata, and four retrieval modes: semantic, quality-filtered, hybrid, and automatic routing. The concrete evaluation uses an educational C-code corpus. The full corpus contains 563 anonymized programmer identifiers and 8,951 C files; a reproducible 10% indexed sample contains 56 programmer identifiers, 847 files, and 3,839 fragments. Across 15 manually judged queries, semantic retrieval achieved nDCG@5 of 0.820, Success@5 of 0.800, and MRR of 0.644. The automatic router selected the expected mode for all 15 queries. In a small manual audit, LLM-derived quality scores were within one point of the manual assessment for 9 of 12 fragments. Within the reported query set, semantic retrieval was the strongest overall mode, while explicit quality metadata was most useful for explicitly quality-oriented queries.

title: Present but Rescaled: Chat-to-Agent Transfer of Additive Activation Steering
authors: Lucas Pinto
abstract: Additive activation steering (injecting a scaled residual-stream direction during generation) is calibrated almost entirely in single-turn chat, yet the models it targets are increasingly deployed as tool-using ReAct agents. We present the first systematic chat-to-agent transfer study of additive steering, coupling behavioral measurement with a representation read-out in a matched-information design: the same items rendered as plain chat or as a ReAct tool-use episode, with matched-norm random-direction controls and the transcript re-encoded every turn to exclude KV-cache contamination. Transfer is real but rescaled, and the right description is a dissociation: the injected direction reaches the late layers at near-full strength in every setting and model tested (install-site agent-over-chat ratios 0.83-1.16 across three families), while the behavioral coupling is reset per model and context. On Qwen2.5-7B a refusal bypass vector amplifies in the agent (T = 1.45, CI [1.20, 1.78], N = 300); across a powered uniform-protocol distribution the coupling spans amplification (Gemma-2-9B T = 2.00) to attenuation (Yi-1.5-9B T = 0.43, CI [0.29, 0.60]), with no universal constant and a single clean attenuator against a universal sign. Directional ablation of the same axis does not amplify (T = 0.93, CI including 1) while additive injection amplifies (T = 1.50), a 20.1-point gain difference (CI [13.4, 26.8]) that identifies an additive-specific mechanism. Two pre-registered instruments converge to localize the rescaling to the ReAct format scaffold, before any tool observation, rather than to the observation boundary where a dilution account would predict it. The safety implication is immediate and unpredictable: agentic deployment amplifies steering-based refusal bypass by up to 2.00x on some models while others attenuate, so a deployment cannot assume a given model is safe under additive steering.

title: KV-PRM: Efficient Process Reward Modeling via KV-Cache Transfer for Multi-Agent Test-Time Scaling
authors: Peng Kuang, Haibo Jin, Xiaoyu Han, Yanli Wang, Xiaopeng Yuan, Ye Yu, Kaidi Xu, Haohan Wang
abstract: Process Reward Models (PRMs) have been proven to be highly effective in guiding test-time scaling (TTS) methods, which significantly boost the capabilities of LLM-based multi-agent systems. However, existing PRMs are text-based: they re-encode the entire trajectory text from scratch. In long multi-agent rollouts, the scoring cost, growing quadratically with respect to sequence length L, creates a severe computational bottleneck, severely limiting PRMs' application in long-context scenarios. To resolve this, we introduce KV-PRM, a highly efficient process reward model that eliminates the heavy text re-encoding by directly reading the KV cache produced naturally during the LLM's generation phase. By processing a single "verify token" against the pre-existing KV cache, KV-PRM reduces the scoring cost from O(L^2) to O(L). We formally prove that the KV cache contains strictly greater information capacity than text, and is more efficient for downstream reward modeling. Empirically, across the MATH, GSM8K, and AIME benchmarks, KV-PRM matches or strictly outperforms text-PRMs under various TTS methods such as Beam Search, MCTS, and Weighted Voting, with up to a 5,000x reduction in scoring FLOPs, a 37x reduction in latency, and a 34x reduction in per-sequence memory footprint compared to text-based PRMs.

title: What Pixels Are Enough? SEAMS: Sufficiency Saliency via MSE-Preservation Soft-Masks
authors: Magdalena Trędowicz, Łukasz Struski, Arkadiusz Lewicki, Karolina Pachota, Andrzej Grudzień, Mateusz Jagła, Jacek Tabor
abstract: Saliency maps are most useful when they identify the image regions that are sufficient to preserve a model's behaviour. We introduce SEAMS, a sufficiency-based saliency method that directly optimises a soft mask using a preservation objective. Given a frozen differentiable model output, such as a class probability, CLS embedding, or token representation, SEAMS searches for a compact mask that preserves the selected output. The approach relies on a simple optimisation framework based on soft masks, a learnable budget, and a three-way image composite generated entirely from the query image. As a result, it requires no auxiliary distractor dataset, architecture-specific attribution mechanism, or differentiable top-k relaxation. Experiments with frozen ViT-S/16 and ConvNeXt models show that the same optimisation pipeline can generate object-level, class-conditioned, and token-level explanations by changing only the preserved target. The resulting masks are compact, interpretable, stable across random initialisations, and competitive on insertion and deletion benchmarks. Our results also indicate that different architectures often rely on different sufficient evidence while achieving similar preservation fidelity, highlighting the architecture-dependent nature of visual explanations.

title: Gårding's Theorem for Posynomials
authors: Nima Anari
abstract: We extend Gårding's theorem to homogeneous posynomials: if a finite positive sum of monomials with arbitrary nonnegative real exponents is zero-free on a product of right half-planes, then its degree-normalized root is concave. Consequently, zero-freeness in a sector of aperture $απ$ implies $α$-fractional log-concavity. This sharpens generic mixing and domain-sparsification guarantees for fixed-size matchings and nonsymmetric determinantal point processes. The result was developed in an AI-assisted interaction initiated and checked by the author; Codex also assisted with assembling and typesetting the manuscript.
translation: 我们将Gårding定理推广到齐次正项式（homogeneous posynomials）：如果具有任意非负实数指数的单项式的有限正和在右半平面的乘积上是无零点的，那么其次数归一化的根是凹的。因此，在孔径为 $απ$ 的扇形区域内的无零点性意味着 $α$-分数对数凹性（$α$-fractional log-concavity）。这提高了固定大小匹配和非对称行列式点过程（nonsymmetric determinantal point processes）的通用混合和域稀疏化保证。该结果是在作者发起并检查的AI辅助交互中开发的；Codex还协助了手稿的组装和排版。
tldr: 本文将Gårding定理推广至齐次正项式，证明了无零点性与凹性及分数对数凹性之间的关系，从而改进了匹配和非对称行列式点过程的理论保证，该研究得到了AI的辅助。
ai_comments:
1. 创新性：成功将经典的Gårding定理从齐次多项式推广到了具有任意非负实指数的齐次正项式（posynomials）上。
2. 重要性：该理论推广直接优化了固定大小匹配和非对称行列式点过程（DPP）的通用混合与域稀疏化保证，在理论计算机科学和概率论中具有重要应用。此外，这也是一个展示AI辅助（如Codex）进行高级数学定理推导与论文排版的生动案例。
3. 局限性：摘要未提及具体证明的复杂度，且对于实际计算中如何有效验证无零点性（zero-freeness）未做展开。
motivation: 旨在将通常适用于多项式的Gårding定理推广到更一般的齐次正项式（允许任意非负实数指数），从而为固定大小匹配和非对称行列式点过程等应用提供更强的通用混合和域稀疏化保证。
method: 通过数学证明将经典的Gårding定理拓展至齐次正项式。具体而言，证明了若具有任意非负实数指数的单项式的有限正和在右半平面乘积上无零点，则其次数归一化根具有凹性。该研究是在作者引导和检查的AI交互（使用Codex等工具）辅助下完成的。
results: 证明了齐次正项式在右半平面乘积上的无零点性蕴含着其次数归一化根的凹性；进一步地，在孔径为 $απ$ 的扇形区域内的无零点性可推导出 $α$-分数对数凹性。这一结论改善了固定大小匹配和非对称行列式点过程的混合与域稀疏化保证。
conclusion: 成功将Gårding定理推广至齐次正项式，不仅在数学理论上取得了突破（建立了无零点性与凹性/分数对数凹性之间的联系），还为相关计算问题（如匹配和非对称行列式点过程）提供了更强的理论保证，并展示了AI辅助数学研究的前景。

title: COAST: Context-Aware Differential Learning for Gene Expression Prediction in Spatial Transcriptomics
authors: Keunho Byeon, Sunhong Park, Jeewoo Lim, Jin Tae Kwak
abstract: Spatial transcriptomics enables profiling of spatial gene expression but is limited by high cost and low throughput, motivating prediction from H&E histopathology images. Existing context-aware methods mainly supervise absolute expression, while relative expression relationships between spots are rarely used explicitly. We propose COAST, a context-aware differential learning framework for spatial gene expression prediction. COAST conditions the local and global context features with type-specific modulation and aggregates the target and context spot tokens using a Transformer encoder to capture both fine-grained local patterns and slide-level structure. It is trained with a joint objective that combines absolute expression regression with signed differential regression between the target and context spots. Experiments on multiple spatial transcriptomics datasets show consistent improvements in correlation- and distribution-based metrics, demonstrating the effectiveness of context-aware differential learning for histology-based spatial gene expression prediction.
zh_title: COAST：空间转录组学中用于基因表达预测的上下文感知差异学习
translation: 空间转录组学能够对空间基因表达进行谱系分析，但受限于高成本和低通量，这激发了从H&E组织病理学图像中进行预测的研究。现有的上下文感知方法主要监督绝对表达，而斑点（spots）之间的相对表达关系很少被显式使用。我们提出了COAST，一个用于空间基因表达预测的上下文感知差异学习框架。COAST通过特定类型的调制来调节局部和全局上下文特征，并使用Transformer编码器聚合目标和上下文斑点token，以捕获细粒度的局部模式和切片级结构。它采用联合目标进行训练，该目标结合了绝对表达回归以及目标和上下文斑点之间的有符号差异回归。在多个空间转录组学数据集上的实验表明，在基于相关性和基于分布的指标上均取得了持续的改进，证明了上下文感知差异学习对于基于组织学的空间基因表达预测的有效性。
tldr: 提出COAST框架，通过结合绝对表达回归与目标-上下文斑点间的符号差异回归（差异学习），并利用Transformer融合局部和全局上下文，提升了基于病理图像的空间基因表达预测精度。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于引入了“差异学习”（differential learning），即显式地建模目标斑点与上下文斑点之间的相对表达差异，而不仅仅是预测绝对值。这种联合优化设计（绝对+相对差异）非常符合图像对比和相对定量分析的直觉，能有效缓解由于批次效应或染色差异导致的绝对数值漂移，对于组织病理学图像的基因表达预测具有重要意义。
motivation: 空间转录组学由于高成本和低通量，推动了从H&E组织病理学图像预测基因表达的研究。然而，现有的上下文感知方法主要监督绝对表达，很少显式利用斑点（spots）之间的相对表达关系。
method: 提出COAST框架。该框架通过特定类型调制来调节局部和全局上下文特征，并使用Transformer编码器聚合目标斑点和上下文斑点的token，以捕获细粒度的局部模式和切片级结构。在训练时，采用联合目标函数，将绝对表达回归与目标和上下文斑点之间的有符号差异回归结合起来。
results: 在多个空间转录组学数据集上的实验表明，COAST在基于相关性和基于分布的评估指标上均取得了持续的改进。
conclusion: 上下文感知的差异学习（COAST）能有效提升基于组织学图像的空间基因表达预测性能，证明了显式建模斑点间相对表达关系的有效性。

title: A Personalized Computational Framework for Assessing the Sufficiency of Partially Observed Data in Healthcare AI models
authors: Qingchu Jin, Felistas Mazhude, Jamie B. Rabb, Robert S. Kramer, Douglas B. Sawyer, Raimond L. Winslow
abstract: Achieving early and timely diagnosis and treatment for disease is a major challenge. Recent applications of machine learning (ML) algorithms trained on patient data have shown promise in many different settings for predicting the patient health state. A challenge often faced when applying these ML algorithms is that at any given time, not all clinical variables (features) needed as input to perform prediction tasks are available. We define the concept of full-feature-capacity (FFC) to refer to prediction performance when such algorithms make use of all features on which they were trained. We then introduce Feature Sufficiency Analysis (FSA) - an analysis for determining whether a subset of all clinical features needed by an AI model is sufficient to achieve FFC. FSA estimates the underlying distributions of missing variables conditioned on features that are available. FSA provides a patient-specific assessment of whether the existing set of measured features achieves FFC. If yes, then there is no need to acquire further inputs and a ML-based prediction. We provide two case studies: prediction of need for postoperative prolonged ventilation in patients recovering from heart surgery; 10-year mortality prediction in an outpatient cohort. We also demonstrate that FSA also provides a clinically interpretable feature-ranking methodology based on prediction sufficiency, identifies intrinsically hard-to-predict patient populations, and has the potential to perform cost-aware optimization for clinical data acquisition. FSA provides a generic computational approach for determining whether incomplete clinical information is sufficient to support trustworthy AI-assisted clinical decision-making, thereby facilitating the prospective deployment of healthcare AI systems across diverse clinical settings.

title: TSR-Ego: Temporally Guided Stereo Refinement Framework for Egocentric 3D Human Pose Estimation
authors: Md Mushfiqur Azam, John Quarles, Kevin Desai
abstract: Egocentric 3D human pose estimation from head-mounted stereo cameras is challenging due to fisheye distortion, severe self-occlusion, and frequent truncation of body joints outside the camera field of view. Recent stereo egocentric methods have improved performance through heatmap lifting, stereo correspondence, and transformer-based refinement, but they often rely heavily on frame-local evidence or use temporal information only as auxiliary pose-level context. This limits robustness when current-frame stereo cues are weak, occluded, or ambiguous. We propose TSR-Ego, a temporally guided stereo framework that couples short-term motion evidence with projection-guided feature sampling. The model first enriches dense stereo feature maps using a causal depthwise-separable temporal convolution, allowing past visual evidence to influence the feature space before deformable cross-attention. A single-stage causal stereo decoder then refines learned 3D joint queries through temporal self-attention, joint self-attention, and fisheye deformable stereo cross-attention, using the evolving pose estimate to generate 2D sampling references. Unlike methods that apply temporal reasoning mainly after pose prediction, TSR-Ego uses motion context to shape both the sampled stereo features and the joint representations while preserving online inference without future frames. Experiments on UnrealEgo2 and UnrealEgo-RW show state-of-the-art performance, with especially strong gains on real-world sequences.
zh_title: TSR-Ego：用于第一人称视角双目三维人体姿态估计的时序引导双目优化框架
translation: 基于头戴式双目相机的自我视角（第一人称视角）三维人体姿态估计面临着鱼眼畸变、严重的自我遮挡以及相机视场外身体关节频繁截断等挑战。最近的双目自我视角方法通过热力图提升、双目对应和基于Transformer的优化提高了性能，但它们通常严重依赖于单帧局部证据，或者仅将时序信息作为辅助的姿态级上下文。这限制了在当前帧双目线索微弱、被遮挡或模糊时的鲁棒性。我们提出了TSR-Ego，这是一个时序引导的双目框架，它将短期运动证据与投影引导的特征采样相结合。该模型首先使用因果深度可分离时序卷积来丰富稠密的双目特征图，从而允许过去的视觉证据在可变形交叉注意力之前影响特征空间。接着，单阶段因果双目解码器通过时序自注意力、关节自注意力以及鱼眼可变形双目交叉注意力，利用不断演变的姿态估计来生成2D采样参考，从而优化学习到的3D关节查询。与主要在姿态预测后应用时序推理的方法不同，TSR-Ego利用运动上下文来塑造采样的双目特征和关节表示，同时保留了无需未来帧的在线推理。在UnrealEgo2和UnrealEgo-RW上的实验表明，该方法达到了最先进的性能，特别是在真实世界序列上取得了显著的提升。
keywords: 第一人称3D人体姿态估计
tldr: 本文提出TSR-Ego框架，通过将时序运动线索融入特征采样与关节查询优化中，显著提升了第一人称视角双目3D人体姿态估计的鲁棒性，并在真实场景中取得了领先的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将时序上下文（temporal context）融入的阶段提前，不同于以往仅在姿态预测后进行时序平滑或作为辅助上下文的方法，TSR-Ego在特征采样和关节表示阶段就引入了时序线索。其因果（causal）设计保证了在线推理的实用性。不过，由于其依赖于前序帧的运动线索，在初始帧或运动极不规则、发生突变时，时序引导的效果可能会受到一定局限。
motivation: 现有的第一人称视角双目姿态估计方法主要依赖单帧局部信息，或者仅将时序信息作为辅助的姿态级上下文，这导致在当前帧双目视觉线索较弱、被遮挡或视场受限时，系统缺乏足够的鲁棒性。
method: 提出TSR-Ego框架：首先，利用因果深度可分离时序卷积丰富稠密双目特征图，将过去的视觉证据融入特征空间；其次，采用单阶段因果双目解码器，通过时序自注意力、关节自注意力以及鱼眼可变形双目交叉注意力，结合当前姿态估计生成的2D采样参考，对3D关节查询进行逐步优化。
results: 在UnrealEgo2和UnrealEgo-RW数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法达到了最先进（State-of-the-art）的性能，尤其是在真实世界的测试序列中表现出了极强的泛化能力和显著的性能提升。
conclusion: TSR-Ego通过将运动上下文融入到双目特征采样和关节表示中，克服了单帧双目线索不足的局限，并在不依赖未来帧的前提下实现了高效的在线推理，在虚拟和真实世界数据集上均达到了最先进的姿态估计性能。

title: Understanding Schedule-Free Methods in Nonconvex Optimization: Rate Guarantees and Escaping Saddles
authors: Jiseok Chae, Donghwan Kim
abstract: Schedule-Free methods have attracted growing interest for alleviating the burden of designing and tuning a learning rate scheduler, while matching and sometimes even outperforming optimizers with tuned schedulers. Despite their strong empirical results, their convergence theory in nonconvex optimization, where modern machine learning objectives typically arise, has remained largely unexplored. In this paper, we provide worst-case analyses of Schedule-Free gradient descent and Schedule-Free stochastic gradient descent, in their standard form and without auxiliary modifications or restrictive conditions, for smooth but possibly nonconvex objectives. Based on a Lyapunov analysis derived from the continuous-time limiting ordinary differential equation associated with these methods, we show that Schedule-Free gradient descent and Schedule-Free stochastic gradient descent achieve the optimal worst-case convergence rates attainable among first-order methods. We further formulate Schedule-Free gradient descent as a nonautonomous dynamical system and prove strict-saddle avoidance under an arbitrarily small one-time perturbation. These theoretical results provide a better understanding of the strong performance that Schedule-Free methods demonstrate.
zh_title: 理解非凸优化中的无调度（Schedule-Free）方法：收敛率保证与逃离鞍点
translation: 无调度（Schedule-Free）方法因能减轻设计和调整学习率调度器的负担，同时达到甚至有时超越配备调参调度器的优化器性能，而受到越来越多的关注。尽管它们取得了强大的实证结果，但它们在非凸优化（现代机器学习目标通常具有的特性）中的收敛理论在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本文中，我们针对平滑但可能非凸的目标函数，在标准形式且无辅助修改或限制条件的情况下，提供了无调度梯度下降和无调度随机梯度下降的最坏情况分析。基于从这些方法关联的连续时间极限常微分方程推导出的李雅普诺夫（Lyapunov）分析，我们证明了无调度梯度下降和无调度随机梯度下降达到了一阶方法所能达到的最优最坏情况收敛率。我们进一步将无调度梯度下降公式化为非自治动力系统，并证明了在任意小的单次扰动下其能避免严格鞍点。这些理论结果为无调度方法展现出的强劲性能提供了更好的理解。
tldr: 本文首次为标准Schedule-Free优化方法在非凸优化中提供了理论分析，证明了其具有最优收敛率，并能在微小扰动下逃离严格鞍点。
ai_comments: 该论文填补了Schedule-Free方法在非凸优化领域理论保障的空白。其创新之处在于，在不依赖任何辅助修改或苛刻限制条件的前提下，对标准形式的SF-GD和SF-SGD进行了最坏情况分析。通过引入连续时间极限常微分方程并构建Lyapunov函数，作者成功证明了其最优收敛率。此外，将SF-GD视为非自治系统来证明鞍点规避，为理解该类算法在复杂非凸景观中的行为提供了极具启发性的视角。
motivation: 尽管Schedule-Free方法在免除学习率调度器调参负担的同时取得了优异的实证效果，但它们在非凸优化（现代机器学习的主要场景）中的收敛理论在很大程度上仍未被探索。
method:
1. 对标准形式、无辅助修改且无限制条件的Schedule-Free梯度下降（SF-GD）和随机梯度下降（SF-SGD）进行最坏情况分析；
2. 结合与这些方法关联的连续时间极限常微分方程（ODE），推导并采用Lyapunov分析法；
3. 将SF-GD建模为非自治动力学系统，并分析其在微小一次性扰动下的鞍点规避行为。
results: 证明了SF-GD和SF-SGD在平滑非凸目标下均能达到一阶方法的最优最坏情况收敛率，并证明了SF-GD在任意小的单次扰动下能够避开严格鞍点。
conclusion: 本文的理论结果为Schedule-Free方法在实际应用中展现出的强大性能提供了坚实的理论支撑和更深入的理解。

title: Distributed Symmetry Breaking on Hyperbolic Random Graphs
authors: Yannic Maus, Janosch Ruff, Sonia Simons, George Skretas
abstract:
Real-world networks like the internet share patterns like a power law degree distribution and a high clustering coefficient. Many of these properties are captured by the generative model of hyperbolic random graphs (HRGs), which provides a theoretical framework for studying such networks. Motivated by the observation that several algorithms perform better on real-world networks than their worst-case guarantees suggest, we design and analyse distributed algorithms under the assumption that the input graph is an HRG. Indeed, prior work has shown that the classical symmetry-breaking problem of $Δ+1$ colouring, where $Δ$ is the maximum degree of the graph, can be solved in 2 rounds on HRGs [Maus and Ruff; SODA'26].
  In stark contrast to this 2-round algorithm for $Δ+1$ colouring, we prove that the related symmetry-breaking problems of maximal independent set (MIS) and maximal matching (MM) are substantially harder: we establish a lower bound of $Ω\left(\frac{\log\log n}{\log\log\log n}\right)$ for MIS and MM on HRGs. Our lower bound techniques rely on new structural insights that may be of independent interest: we show that HRGs contain $d$-ary trees with large height and degree which enables us to adapt and lift prior impossibility results for distributed algorithms to the setting of HRGs.
  We also show that these lower bounds are polynomial tight: we design algorithms tailored to HRGs that solve MIS and MM in $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\log^{5/3}\log n)$ rounds with high probability in the LOCAL model, improving over the general worst-case lower bound of $Ω\left(\min\left\{\log Δ, \sqrt{\log n}\right\}\right)$ rounds [Khoury and Schild; FOCS'25].
zh_title: 双曲随机图上的分布式对称性破缺
translation:
诸如互联网之类的现实世界网络具有幂律度分布和高聚类系数等共同模式。双曲随机图（HRG）生成模型捕获了其中的许多属性，并为研究此类网络提供了理论框架。受“几种算法在现实网络上的表现优于其最坏情况保证”这一观察的启发，我们在输入图为 HRG 的假设下设计并分析了分布式算法。事实上，先前的研究已经表明，经典的 $\Delta+1$ 着色对称性破缺问题（其中 $\Delta$ 是图的最大度）在 HRG 上可以在 2 轮内解决 [Maus 和 Ruff; SODA'26]。
与这种用于 $\Delta+1$ 着色的 2 轮算法形成鲜明对比的是，我们证明了最大独立集（MIS）和最大匹配（MM）等相关的对称性破缺问题要困难得多：我们为 HRG 上的 MIS 和 MM 确立了 $\Omega\left(\frac{\log\log n}{\log\log\log n}\right)$ 的下界。我们的下界技术依赖于可能具有独立研究价值的新结构见解：我们证明了 HRG 包含具有大高度和大度数的 $d$ 叉树，这使我们能够将先前关于分布式算法的不可能结果调整并推广到 HRG 的设置中。
我们还表明这些下界在多项式意义上是紧确的：我们设计了针对 HRG 定制的算法，在 LOCAL 模型中以高概率用 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\log^{5/3}\log n)$ 轮解决 MIS 和 MM，相比于通用的最坏情况 $\Omega\left(\min\left\{\log \Delta, \sqrt{\log n}\right\}\right)$ 轮下界有所改进 [Khoury 和 Schild; FOCS'25]。
tldr: 本文证明了在双曲随机图上解决最大独立集（MIS）和最大匹配（MM）的分布式下界为 $\Omega\left(\frac{\log\log n}{\log\log\log n}\right)$，并设计了在 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\log^{5/3}\log n)$ 轮内解决这些问题的多项式紧确算法。
ai_comments:
1. 创新性：本文将经典的分布式对称性破缺问题（MIS和MM）置于更符合现实网络拓扑特征的双曲随机图（HRGs）中进行研究，填补了理论与实际算法表现之间的鸿沟。
2. 理论贡献：通过证明HRG中存在高且宽的d叉树，成功将通用的分布式不可能结果迁移到HRG模型中，这一结构性发现具有独立的学术价值。
3. 局限性：虽然在LOCAL模型下取得了多项式紧确的轮数，但尚未探讨在带宽受限的CONGEST模型下的表现，且缺乏在真实网络数据集上的实验验证。
motivation: 现实世界网络中的分布式算法表现往往优于其理论最坏情况保证。双曲随机图（HRG）是模拟现实网络（如幂律度分布和高聚类系数）的重要理论框架。由于先前工作表明 $\Delta+1$ 着色在 HRG 上仅需 2 轮即可解决，本文旨在探索其他经典的分布式对称性破缺问题（如最大独立集 MIS 和最大匹配 MM）在 HRG 上的计算复杂度。
method:
1. 下界证明：提出新的结构性见解，证明双曲随机图（HRG）中包含具有大高度和大度数的 $d$ 叉树，从而能够将通用的分布式算法不可能结果（impossibility results）调整并应用到 HRG 场景。
2. 算法设计：针对 HRG 拓扑特征定制分布式算法，在 LOCAL 模型下以高概率解决 MIS 和 MM 问题。
results:
1. 证明了在 HRG 上求解 MIS 和 MM 的分布式轮数下界为 $\Omega\left(\frac{\log\log n}{\log\log\log n}\right)$。
2. 设计了可在 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\log^{5/3}\log n)$ 轮内（高概率）解决 MIS 和 MM 的 LOCAL 算法，实现了多项式紧确的复杂度，并超越了最坏情况下的通用下界。
conclusion: 在双曲随机图（HRG）上，最大独立集（MIS）和最大匹配（MM）问题比 $\Delta+1$ 着色问题（仅需2轮）要困难得多。本文确定了其 $\Omega\left(\frac{\log\log n}{\log\log\log n}\right)$ 的下界，并提供了多项式紧确的 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\log^{5/3}\log n)$ 轮算法，展示了真实网络结构对分布式算法效率的深远影响。

title: Attention to Detail: Evaluating Energy, Performance, and Accuracy Trade-offs Across vLLM Configurations
authors: Nada Zine, Tristan Coignion, Vincenzo Stoico, Clément Quinton, Romain Rouvoy, Patricia Lago
abstract:
Large Language Models are reshaping how software is developed and maintained. They are typically deployed in production using inference engines such as vLLM, which can efficiently serve pre-trained, highly configurable models. While prior work has focused on model architectures and hardware acceleration, the impact of inference engine configuration on energy consumption, performance, and output quality remains poorly understood.
  In this paper, we present a large-scale controlled study of three selected vLLM configuration options: attention kernel type, prefix caching, and chunked prefill. We evaluate all combinations of these configurations across 5 open-weight LLMs and 5 diverse inference tasks, totaling $9,000$ runs and $93,600$ measures. We analyze energy consumption, latency, and accuracy, and examine both main effects and interaction effects between configuration options and tasks.
  Our results show that the studied configuration options significantly impact energy and performance, mainly driven by attention type and prefix caching, while chunked prefill has a limited effect under the default vLLM serving configuration and evaluated workloads. These effects are highly model- and workload-dependent, and no configuration is universally optimal. We further show that model choice dominates global trade-offs, while configuration tuning provides local improvements along the Pareto frontier. Unexpectedly, inference options can also affect model accuracy.
zh_title: 关注细节：评估不同 vLLM 配置下的能耗、性能和准确性权衡
translation: 大语言模型（LLM）正在重塑软件的开发和维护方式。它们通常在生产环境中使用诸如 vLLM 之类的推理引擎进行部署，这些引擎可以高效地服务预训练且高度可配置的模型。虽然先前的研究主要侧重于模型架构和硬件加速，但推理引擎配置对能耗、性能和输出质量的影响仍不为人所知。在本文中，我们对三个选定的 vLLM 配置选项进行了大规模控制研究：注意力内核类型、前缀缓存和分块预填充。我们在 5 个开源 LLM 和 5 个不同的推理任务中评估了这些配置的所有组合，总共进行了 9,000 次运行和 93,600 次测量。我们分析了能耗、延迟和准确性，并检查了配置选项与任务之间的主效应和交互效应。我们的结果表明，所研究的配置选项显著影响了能耗和性能，这主要由注意力类型和前缀缓存驱动，而分块预填充在默认的 vLLM 服务配置和评估的工作负载下效果有限。这些影响高度依赖于模型和工作负载，没有哪种配置是普遍最优的。我们进一步表明，模型选择主导了全局权衡，而配置调整则沿着帕累托前沿提供了局部改进。出乎意料的是，推理选项也会影响模型的准确性。
tldr: 本文通过对 vLLM 推理引擎配置进行大规模实证研究，发现注意力内核和前缀缓存显著影响能耗与性能，且这些影响高度依赖于模型和任务；同时，推理配置还会意外地影响模型的输出准确性。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于，它并没有像传统研究那样仅关注模型架构或硬件加速，而是首次对主流推理引擎 vLLM 的具体配置（如注意力内核、前缀缓存等）进行了大规模的系统性实证研究。发现“推理配置会意外影响模型输出准确性”是一个非常有趣且值得警惕的结论。其局限性在于，实验主要在默认的 vLLM 服务配置和特定的 5 个模型及任务下进行，在更极端或定制化的生产环境下的泛化性还有待进一步探索。
motivation: 虽然先前关于大语言模型（LLM）的研究多集中在模型架构和硬件加速上，但推理引擎（如 vLLM）的具体配置对能耗、性能和输出质量的影响仍不为人所知，缺乏系统性的定量评估。
method: 开展了一项大规模控制变量研究，评估了三种 vLLM 配置选项（注意力内核类型、前缀缓存和分块预填充）的所有组合。实验涵盖了 5 个开源 LLM 和 5 个不同的推理任务，共进行了 9,000 次运行和 93,600 次测量，系统分析了能耗、延迟和准确性，并探讨了配置与任务之间的主效应和交互效应。
results: 研究表明，所评估的配置选项（尤其是注意力内核类型和前缀缓存）对能耗和性能有显著影响，而分块预填充在默认 vLLM 服务配置下的影响有限。这些影响高度依赖于具体的模型和工作负载。此外，模型选择主导了全局权衡，而配置微调可在帕累托前沿带来局部改进。令人意外的是，推理配置选项还会对模型的输出准确性产生影响。
conclusion: 没有哪一种推理引擎配置是普遍最优的。模型选择决定了全局的性能权衡，而对 vLLM 推理配置的精细调整则能在帕累托前沿上提供重要的局部性能与能耗优化。此外，配置的选择还可能出乎意料地影响模型的最终输出质量（准确性）。

title: SherAgent: Scaling Attack Investigation in the Wild via LLM-Empowered Iterative Query-Filter Backtracking
authors: Zhenyuan Li, Zhengkai Wang, Ling Jiang, Xiangmin Shen, Ruixiao Lin, Sen Nie, Shi Wu, Shouling Ji
abstract: Provenance-based attack investigation enables viable automation by standardizing data and query logic; however, it is critically hindered in practice by dependency explosions and fragmented causal chains in the wild. Towards designing a robust and automated investigation tool, we collaborated with the SOC of a major Internet corporation serving billions of users. By engaging in real-world incident response, we are able to evaluate and refine their existing LLM-based investigation workflows, which processes tens of thousands of raw alerts daily, leaving thousands for manual triage, to find out the root causes of investigation failures and major challenges in their existing tools. Motivated by these findings, we propose SherAgent, an LLM-empowered automated investigation system. Operating on an iterative ``query-filter'' backtracking paradigm over provenance graphs, SherAgent leverages the semantic reasoning capabilities of LLMs to process unstructured data, such as investigation context and threat intelligence. To overcome fragmented causal chains caused by missing events, the system dynamically calibrates query conditions to broaden the search scope. Concurrently, it performs precision result filtering and strategic nodes selection for subsequent exploration, thereby mitigating dependency explosions. Extensive evaluations in the wild demonstrate that SherAgent improves the end-to-end investigation success rate by 31.1% and 63.7% compared to both legacy enterprise baselines and SOTA approaches, respectively. Furthermore, it operates with remarkable efficiency, incurring under $0.10 in API costs and requiring less than 4 minutes per investigation. Finally, our user study confirms that SherAgent provides accurate and clear insights, significantly reducing the analytical overhead for security experts.
zh_title: SherAgent：通过大语言模型赋能的迭代式“查询-过滤”回溯在真实场景中扩展攻击调查
translation: 基于溯源的攻击调查通过标准化数据和查询逻辑实现了可行的自动化；然而，在实际应用中，它严重受到依赖爆炸和真实环境中因果链断裂的阻碍。为了设计一个强大且自动化的调查工具，我们与一家服务数十亿用户的大型互联网公司的安全运营中心（SOC）进行了合作。通过参与真实的事件响应，我们能够评估并改进他们现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的调查工作流（该工作流每天处理数万个原始警报，留下数千个进行手动分流），以找出调查失败的根本原因以及现有工具面临的主要挑战。受这些发现的启发，我们提出了SherAgent，一个由大语言模型赋能的自动化调查系统。SherAgent在溯源图上基于迭代的“查询-过滤”回溯范式运行，利用大语言模型的语义推理能力来处理非结构化数据，例如调查上下文和威胁情报。为了克服由缺失事件引起的因果链断裂，系统动态校准查询条件以扩大搜索范围。同时，它进行精准的结果过滤和策略性的节点选择以供后续探索，从而缓解依赖爆炸。在真实环境中的广泛评估表明，与传统企业基线和最先进（SOTA）方法相比，SherAgent将端到端调查成功率分别提高了31.1%和63.7%。此外，它运行效率极高，每次调查的API成本低于0.10美元，耗时不到4分钟。最后，我们的用户研究证实，SherAgent提供了准确且清晰的见解，显著减轻了安全专家的分析开销。
tldr: 本文提出了SherAgent，一个基于大语言模型的自动化攻击调查系统，通过在溯源图上进行迭代式“查询-过滤”回溯，有效解决了依赖爆炸和因果链断裂问题，在真实场景中大幅提升了调查成功率和效率。
ai_comments: 该工作紧密结合工业界实际痛点（与服务数十亿用户的互联网巨头SOC合作），针对溯源图分析中经典的“依赖爆炸”和“因果链断裂”问题，巧妙地结合了LLM的语义推理能力与结构化的“查询-过滤”回溯范式。其极低的API成本（<$0.10）和快速响应时间（<4分钟）展现了极强的实用落地价值。
motivation: 传统的基于溯源的攻击调查在实际应用中严重受到“依赖爆炸”和“因果链断裂”的阻碍。现有的基于大语言模型的调查工具在处理海量日常警报时仍存在较高的手动分流负担和调查失败率。
method: 提出SherAgent系统，它在溯源图上基于迭代的“查询-过滤”（query-filter）回溯范式运行。该系统利用LLM的语义推理能力处理非结构化数据（如调查上下文和威胁情报）；通过动态校准查询条件以扩大搜索范围，从而克服因缺失事件导致的因果链断裂；同时进行精准结果过滤和策略性节点选择，以缓解依赖爆炸。
results: 在真实环境中的广泛评估表明，与传统企业基线和最先进（SOTA）方法相比，SherAgent的端到端调查成功率分别提升了31.1%和63.7%。此外，它运行效率极高，单次调查的API成本低于0.10美元，耗时不足4分钟。用户研究也证实其能提供准确清晰的洞察，显著减轻了安全专家的分析开销。
conclusion: SherAgent是一个高效、低成本且准确的自动化攻击调查系统，能够有效应对真实网络安全场景中的依赖爆炸和因果链断裂难题，显著降低安全专家的分析负担。

title: Optimal finite element error estimates and Newton convergence for a quasilinear elliptic problem with mixed boundary conditions
authors: Mihai Bucataru
abstract: The article studies finite element approximations of a quasilinear elliptic heat-conduction problem with inhomogeneous mixed boundary conditions. The conductivity tensor is matrix-valued, anisotropic, possibly nonsymmetric, and dependent on both position and temperature, rendering the problem nonlinear, nonmonotone, and nonpotential. The nonlinear algebraic system arising from the Galerkin discretization is solved using Newton's method, with a posteriori guarantees provided by a computable Newton-Kantorovich criterion and a mesh-dependent stopping rule that ensures that the algebraic error is asymptotically negligible relative to the discretization error. Since the discrete solution need not be unique, we prove that every discrete solution satisfies the optimal convergence rates. The analysis combines mixed-boundary elliptic regularity with an Aubin-Nitsche duality argument adapted to the quasilinear setting. Numerical experiments in two and three dimensions confirm the predicted convergence rates and demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed criterion.
zh_title: 具有混合边界条件的拟线性椭圆问题的最优有限元误差估计与牛顿收敛性
translation: 本文研究了具有非齐次混合边界条件的拟线性椭圆热传导问题的有限元逼近。其导热系数张量是矩阵值的、各向异性的、可能非对称的，并且依赖于位置和温度，这使得该问题具有非线性、非单调和非势能的特点。由Galerkin离散化产生的非线性代数系统采用牛顿法进行求解，并通过可计算的牛顿-坎托罗维奇准则和依赖于网格的停止规则提供后验保证，以确保代数误差相对于离散误差在渐近意义上可以忽略不计。由于离散解不一定唯一，我们证明了每一个离散解都满足最优收敛阶。该分析将混合边界椭圆正则性与适用于拟线性设置的Aubin-Nitsche对偶论证相结合。在二维和三维空间中的数值实验证实了预测的收敛速度，并展示了所提准则的可行性。
tldr: 本文研究了具有非齐次混合边界条件的拟线性椭圆热传导问题的有限元逼近，证明了所有离散解均满足最优收敛阶，并利用牛顿-坎托罗维奇准则保证了牛顿法的收敛性。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新点在于解决了非单调、非势能且离散解不唯一的复杂拟线性椭圆问题。在混合边界条件下，成功证明了所有离散解的最优收敛阶，并将牛顿-坎托罗维奇后验准则与网格控制相结合，为实际计算提供了强有力的理论支撑。其局限性在于对复杂几何区域或极度各向异性介质的正则性要求在实际中是否容易满足，摘要中对此未做深入展开。
motivation: 针对具有非齐次混合边界条件、导热系数张量依赖于位置和温度的拟线性椭圆热传导问题（该问题具有非线性、非单调和非势能特性），由于其离散解可能不唯一，需要研究其有限元逼近的最优误差估计以及牛顿迭代求解的收敛性保证。
method: 采用Galerkin离散化建立非线性代数系统，并使用牛顿法进行求解。引入可计算的牛顿-坎托罗维奇（Newton-Kantorovich）准则和依赖于网格的停止规则来控制代数误差。在理论分析中，将混合边界椭圆正则性与适用于拟线性设置的Aubin-Nitsche对偶论证相结合。
results: 证明了即使在离散解不唯一的情况下，每一个离散解也都满足最优收敛阶。同时，二维和三维的数值实验证实了预测的收敛速度，并验证了所提准则的可行性。
conclusion: 结合混合边界椭圆正则性与改进的Aubin-Nitsche对偶方法，成功为一类复杂的非线性、非单调拟线性椭圆问题建立了最优有限元误差估计，并通过牛顿-坎托罗维奇准则及网格相关停止规则确保了牛顿法的渐近收敛性与计算可行性。

title: Malaika: Understanding Malware through Tri-Grounded Agentic Reasoning
authors: Xingzhi Qian, Xinran Zheng, Yiling He, Lorenzo Cavallaro
abstract: Recent LLM-based systems have shown promising capabilities for security-focused code analysis. Malware understanding, however, poses a distinct challenge: analysts must reconstruct high-level malicious behaviors under partial observability from sparse, dispersed evidence intertwined with benign functionality. While static analysis can expose security-relevant signals, the central challenge is not merely identifying suspicious code, but determining whether the evidence sufficiently supports an auditable behavior-level conclusion. We formulate malware understanding as a grounded reasoning problem and argue that reliable behavior reconstruction requires three complementary forms of grounding. Domain grounding constrains how behavior hypotheses are generated and evaluated, semantics grounding localizes and connects supporting program evidence, and knowledge grounding supports behavioral attribution through externally verifiable threat knowledge. To study this hypothesis, we present Malaika, a multi-agent framework that operationalizes the three grounding mechanisms through analyst-inspired reasoning, tool-mediated evidence localization, and retrieval-based behavioral attribution. We instantiate Malaika for Android malware analysis and evaluate it on malware-understanding tasks. Results show that Malaika improves analysis quality over prior LLM-based malware-analysis frameworks and demonstrate that reliability depends not only on model capability but also on the reasoning process. In particular, comparisons against malware-analysis systems and frontier agentic frameworks show that grounding-aware reasoning produces more precise and auditable conclusions. Ablation studies further support the grounding hypothesis. These findings suggest that grounding-aware reasoning provides a principled foundation for reliable malware understanding and, more broadly, for evidence-grounded software analysis.
zh_title: Malaika：通过三元接地智能体推理理解恶意软件
translation: 最近，基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统在以安全为核心的代码分析中展示了极具前景的能力。然而，恶意软件理解带来了一个独特的挑战：分析人员必须在部分可观测的情况下，从与良性功能交织在一起的稀疏、分散的证据中，重构出高层的恶意行为。虽然静态分析可以暴露与安全相关的信号，但核心挑战不仅仅是识别可疑代码，而是确定这些证据是否足以支持一个可审计的行为级结论。我们将恶意软件理解表述为一个接地推理问题，并认为可靠的行为重构需要三种互补的接地形式。领域接地约束了行为假设的生成和评估方式，语义接地定位并连接了支持性的程序证据，而知识接地则通过外部可验证的威胁知识支持行为归因。为了研究这一假设，我们提出了 Malaika，这是一个多智能体框架，它通过受分析师启发的推理、工具介导的证据定位以及基于检索的行为归因，将这三种接地机制付诸实践。我们针对 Android 恶意软件分析实例化了 Malaika，并在恶意软件理解任务上对其进行了评估。结果表明，相比于先前的基于 LLM 的恶意软件分析框架，Malaika 提高了分析质量，并证明了可靠性不仅取决于模型能力，还取决于推理过程。特别是，与恶意软件分析系统和前沿智能体框架的对比表明，接地感知推理能产生更精确、更具可审计性的结论。消融研究进一步支持了接地假设。这些发现表明，接地感知推理为可靠的恶意软件理解以及更广泛的基于证据的软件分析奠定了原则性的基础。
tldr: 本文提出了 Malaika，一个基于三元接地（领域、语义和知识接地）的多智能体框架，用于实现高精度、可审计的恶意软件行为理解与分析。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将恶意软件理解形式化为“三元接地推理”（Tri-Grounded Reasoning）问题，并构建了多智能体框架 Malaika。这种方法不仅关注 LLM 本身的能力，更强调推理过程中的证据链闭环（将领域、代码语义和外部知识相结合），对于提高恶意软件分析的可解释性和可审计性具有重要意义。其局限性在于目前仅在 Android 恶意软件上进行了实例化和评估，其在其他平台（如 Windows、Linux 二进制文件）上的泛化能力和扩展性仍有待进一步验证。
motivation: 恶意软件理解面临独特挑战，分析人员需要从稀疏、分散且与良性功能交织的证据中重构高层恶意行为。现有的安全分析不仅需要识别可疑代码，更需要确定证据是否足以支持可审计的行为级结论。
method: 提出了 Malaika，一个专为 Android 恶意软件分析设计的多智能体框架。它通过分析师启发式推理、工具介导的证据定位以及基于检索的行为归因，实现了三种接地（grounding）机制：领域接地（约束假设生成与评估）、语义接地（定位和连接程序证据）和知识接地（通过外部威胁知识支持行为归因）。
results: 在 Android 恶意软件理解任务上的评估表明，Malaika 的分析质量优于先前的基于 LLM 的恶意软件分析框架。与现有系统和前沿智能体框架相比，其接地感知推理能产生更精确、更具可审计性的结论。消融实验也证实了该接地假设的有效性。
conclusion: 接地感知推理（grounding-aware reasoning）为可靠的恶意软件理解以及更广泛的、基于证据的软件分析提供了原则性的基础。

title: Scoped Verification for Reliable Long-Horizon Agentic Context Evolution under Distribution Shift
authors: Dan C. Hsu, Luke Lu
abstract: Deployed LLM agents rely on agentic context, the model-external textual control content assembled by an operational harness. In this work, the mutable component of that context is a persistent system-level instruction that is updated from operational experience while the model, tools, and harness remain fixed. Over long evolution horizons, flat-text maintenance makes verification increasingly difficult as accumulated instructions grow and interact. We propose Graph-Regularized Agentic Context Evolution (GRACE), which maintains the persistent instruction component as a typed semantic graph and validates proposed updates within the local typed neighborhoods of modified nodes. Accepted graph updates are reconstructed as incremental edits to the textual instruction checkpoint used at deployment. We evaluate GRACE within a fixed telecom agent harness derived from $τ^2$-bench under a controlled distribution-shift protocol. Across five independent replications, GRACE improves strict reliability, measured by pass^3, from the Gemini 2.5 Flash zero-shot value of 0.091 to 0.673$\pm$0.136 at the final checkpoint. This exceeds a Gemini 3.1 Pro zero-shot reference of 0.242 on the same held-out set, while the flat-text HCE baseline finishes at 0.191$\pm$0.051. These results identify two requirements for reliable long-horizon context evolution, a structural substrate that makes verification local and a consolidation mechanism that keeps accumulated instruction content usable.
zh_title: 面向分布偏移下可靠长周期智能体上下文演化的范围验证
translation: 已部署的大语言模型（LLM）智能体依赖于智能体上下文，即由操作套件组装的模型外部文本控制内容。在这项工作中，该上下文的可变部分是一个持久的系统级指令，它根据操作经验进行更新，而模型、工具和套件保持不变。在长周期的演化过程中，扁平文本的维护使得验证变得越来越困难，因为累积的指令在不断增长和相互作用。我们提出了图正则化智能体上下文演化（GRACE），它将持久指令组件维护为一个有类型的语义图，并在被修改节点的局部有类型邻域内验证提议的更新。被接受的图更新会被重构为对部署中所使用的文本指令检查点的增量编辑。我们在一个基于 $τ^2$-bench 的固定电信智能体套件中，在受控的分布偏移协议下对 GRACE 进行了评估。在五次独立重复实验中，GRACE 将 Gemini 2.5 Flash 的严格可靠性（以 pass^3 衡量）从零样本时的 0.091 提升到了最终检查点时的 0.673±0.136。这超过了相同留出集上 Gemini 3.1 Pro 零样本参考值 0.242，而扁平文本 HCE 基线最终仅为 0.191±0.051。这些结果明确了可靠的长周期上下文演化所需的两个条件：一个使验证局部化的结构性基质，以及一个保持累积指令内容可用的整合机制。
tldr: 本文提出GRACE方法，将持久性系统指令表示为有类型的语义图以实现局部验证，显著提升了LLM智能体在分布偏移和长周期上下文演化下的可靠性。
ai_comments: 该论文针对LLM智能体长期运行中指令漂移和冲突这一现实且棘手的问题，创新性地引入了语义图结构（GRACE）进行局部验证，避免了全局文本维护的混乱。其实验设计严谨（多次独立重复、控制分布偏移），结果具有很强的说服力（以较小模型超越了更大模型的零样本表现）。局限性在于，图结构的定义和局部验证的机制可能对特定领域知识有一定依赖，其在更通用、开放领域的泛化能力仍待进一步验证。
motivation: 在部署的大语言模型（LLM）智能体中，持久的系统级指令会根据操作经验不断演化。然而，在长周期演化中，采用扁平文本（flat-text）形式维护指令会导致验证变得越来越困难，因为累积的指令不断增加且相互干扰。
method: 提出图正则化智能体上下文演化（GRACE）方法。它将持久指令组件维护为一个有类型的语义图，并在被修改节点的局部类型邻域内验证提议的更新，最后将接受的图更新重构为对部署时使用的文本指令检查点的增量编辑。
results: 在基于 $τ^2$-bench 的电信智能体测试中，GRACE 将 Gemini 2.5 Flash 的严格可靠性（用 pass^3 衡量）从零样本的 0.091 提升到最终检查点的 0.673±0.136。这不仅大幅超过了 Gemini 3.1 Pro 零样本基线的 0.242，也显著优于扁平文本 HCE 基线的 0.191±0.051。
conclusion: 实验结果表明，可靠的长周期上下文演化需要满足两个核心要求：一是使验证局部化的结构性基质，二是保持累积指令内容可用的整合机制。

title: Generative Communications: Overview, Technologies, and Trends
authors: Wenjun Zhang, Zhiyong Chen, Tong Wu, Guo Lu, Li Song, Feng Yang, Meixia Tao
abstract: The groundbreaking development of generative artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly boosting the ability to generate content such as images and videos, reshaping communication paradigms. This article introduces generative communications (GenCom), a novel paradigm for 6G networks in which large AI models (LAMs) drive semantic understanding, reasoning, and content generation, embedding these into the communication process. Unlike traditional systems that strictly pursue accurate bit transmission, GenCom enables transmitters to convey only minimal yet sufficient information, while receivers leverage shared generative priors and knowledge bases to synthesize the intended output. Communication is thus redefined as controlled generation rather than data reproduction. We formalize the concept of GenCom, clarify its AI-native and generation-driven properties, and present its core mechanisms. A two-layer GenCom architecture supported by key enabling technologies is proposed, and analysis of four representative application scenarios demonstrates that GenCom offers ultra-efficient transmission, semantic-level robustness, and new network functions. Finally, we outline future research directions, including foundational theory and real-time processing, highlighting a promising pathway toward 6G networks.
comment: accepted by IEEE Wireless Communications Magazine
zh_title: 生成式通信：概述、技术与趋势
translation: 生成式人工智能（AI）的突破性发展正在迅速提升图像和视频等内容的生成能力，重塑了通信范式。本文引入了生成式通信（GenCom），这是一种面向6G网络的全新范式，其中大AI模型（LAMs）驱动语义理解、推理和内容生成，并将这些能力嵌入到通信过程中。与严格追求精确比特传输的传统系统不同，GenCom允许发送端仅传输极少但足够的必要信息，而接收端则利用共享的生成先验和知识库来合成预期的输出。因此，通信被重新定义为受控生成，而非数据复现。我们形式化了GenCom的概念，阐明了其AI原生和生成驱动的属性，并介绍了其核心机制。提出了一种由关键使能技术支持的双层GenCom架构，对四个代表性应用场景的分析表明，GenCom能够提供超高效的传输、语义级的鲁棒性以及全新的网络功能。最后，我们概述了未来的研究方向，包括基础理论和实时处理，突出了通往6G网络的一条充满前景的路径。
tldr: 本文提出了一种面向6G的生成式通信（GenCom）新范式，通过大模型将通信重新定义为“受控生成”而非“数据复现”，实现了极低信息量传输与语义级鲁棒性。
ai_comments: 本文前瞻性地将生成式人工智能与6G通信相结合，提出了“生成式通信（GenCom）”这一颠覆性的新范式，将通信从“数据复现”转变为“受控生成”，具有很强的创新性和行业引领意义。其局限性可能在于大模型在实时通信中的计算开销以及生成内容的保真度与幻觉问题，这需要未来更深入的研究。
motivation: 传统的通信系统严格追求精确的比特传输，而生成式AI的爆发式发展正在重塑通信范式。为了在6G中实现超高效传输和语义级鲁棒性，需要引入大AI模型来驱动语义理解、推理和内容生成，并将这些能力嵌入通信过程中。
method: 形式化了GenCom的概念，明确了其AI原生和生成驱动的属性及核心机制；提出了一种由关键使能技术支持的双层GenCom架构，并分析了四个代表性的应用场景。
results: 通过对四个代表性应用场景的分析，证明了GenCom能够提供超高效的传输、语义级的鲁棒性以及全新的网络功能。
conclusion: 生成式通信（GenCom）将通信重新定义为受控生成而非数据复现，为6G网络的发展提供了一条充满前景的全新路径，未来的研究需要重点关注基础理论和实时处理。

title: HiHR: Hierarchical Hyperbolic Representation for Aerial-Ground Person Re-Identification
authors: Qiwei Yang, Pingping Zhang
abstract: Aerial-Ground Person Re-IDentification (AG-ReID) aims to retrieve the same person across heterogeneous aerial and ground camera platforms. Although great progress has been made, existing methods remain suboptimal due to the direct feature alignment across views, overlooking view-specific cues. To address this issue, we propose a novel Hierarchical Hyperbolic Representation (HiHR) framework for AG-ReID. More specifically, we first extract multi-granularity features based on pre-trained visual-text encoders. Then, we propose a Text-guided Multi-granularity Fusion (TMF) to fuse multi-granularity features and enhance the representation ability of identity features. Furthermore, we introduce the Hierarchical Hyperbolic Learning (HHL) to construct a hierarchical feature structure in a hyperbolic space. This hierarchy includes a coarse level that ensures identity separability and cross-view consistency, and a fine level that preserves view-specific discriminative cues. As a result, our proposed framework can effectively aggregate view-invariant and view-specific discriminative features for AG-ReID. Extensive experiments on four AG-ReID benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework. The source code is available at https://github.com/YangQiWei3/HiHR.
comment: Accepted by ECCV2026. More modifications may be performed
zh_title: HiHR：用于空地人员重识别的层次双曲表示
translation: 空地人员重识别（AG-ReID）旨在跨异构的空中和地面摄像头平台检索同一个人。尽管取得了巨大进展，但由于跨视角的直接特征对齐，现有方法仍然不是最优的，它们忽略了视角特有的线索。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个新颖的层次双曲表示（HiHR）框架用于AG-ReID。更具体地说，我们首先基于预训练的视觉-文本编码器提取多粒度特征。然后，我们提出了文本引导的多粒度融合（TMF）来融合多粒度特征并增强身份特征的表示能力。此外，我们引入了层次双曲学习（HHL）在双曲空间中构建层次特征结构。这个层次结构包括一个确保身份可分离性和跨视角一致性的粗粒度级别，以及一个保留视角特有判别性线索的细粒度级别。因此，我们提出的框架可以有效地聚合用于AG-ReID的视角不变和视角特有的判别性特征。在四个AG-ReID基准测试上的广泛实验证明了我们框架的有效性。源代码可在https://github.com/YangQiWei3/HiHR获取。
tldr: 针对空地人员重识别(AG-ReID)中现有方法忽略视角特有线索的问题，本文提出了一个名为HiHR的层次双曲表示框架，通过文本引导的多粒度融合和层次双曲学习，有效聚合了视角不变和视角特有的判别性特征，并在多个基准测试中取得了良好效果。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个层次双曲表示框架HiHR，特别是在双曲空间中构建层次特征结构来同时处理视角不变性和视角特有线索。结合文本引导的多粒度融合，这种方法在处理异构跨视角重识别问题上具有新颖性，有望提高模型对复杂场景的适应性和鲁棒性。
motivation: 现有空地人员重识别(AG-ReID)方法在跨视角直接特征对齐时，忽略了视角特有的线索，导致次优性能。
method: 提出层次双曲表示(HiHR)框架。首先，基于预训练的视觉-文本编码器提取多粒度特征。其次，提出文本引导的多粒度融合(TMF)模块来融合多粒度特征并增强身份特征表示能力。最后，引入层次双曲学习(HHL)在双曲空间中构建层次特征结构，包括确保身份可分离性和跨视角一致性的粗粒度级别，以及保留视角特有判别性线索的细粒度级别。
results: 在四个空地人员重识别基准测试上进行了广泛实验，结果表明所提出的框架是有效的。
conclusion: 所提出的HiHR框架能够有效聚合视角不变和视角特有的判别性特征，从而解决了空地人员重识别中的挑战，并在多个基准测试中表现出有效性。

title: Data-driven predictive control of nonlinear systems using weighted regularization
authors: Fritz A. Engeln, Sebastian Zieglmeier, Marta Zagórowska, Jan-Willem van Wingerden
abstract: Data-driven control methods, like Data-enabled Predictive Control (DeePC), are often formulated for linear systems, where the principle of superposition allows global system behavior to be inferred from locally collected data through Willems' fundamental lemma. This principle does not hold for nonlinear systems, whose dynamics may vary across operating regions. We propose a data-driven predictive control framework for nonlinear systems that incorporates data column preferences according to their proximity to the current operating point through a weighted norm regularization, thereby localizing the predictor without discarding any data. We show how the proposed weighting scheme induces operating point-dependent data prioritization and ensures a well-posed optimization problem. A numerical study on a nonlinear two-tank system demonstrates that the proposed method matches or outperforms hard data-selection schemes while retaining the full data matrix and its rank, thereby guaranteeing feasibility.
zh_title: 非线性系统基于加权正则化的数据驱动预测控制
translation: 数据驱动控制方法，如数据使能预测控制（DeePC），通常是为线性系统设计的，其中叠加原理允许通过Willems基本引理从局部收集的数据推断全局系统行为。这一原理不适用于非线性系统，因为其动力学特性可能因操作区域而异。我们提出了一种用于非线性系统的数据驱动预测控制框架，该框架通过加权范数正则化，根据数据列与当前操作点的接近程度来纳入数据列偏好，从而在不丢弃任何数据的情况下实现预测器的局部化。我们展示了所提出的加权方案如何诱导操作点依赖的数据优先级并确保优化问题具有良好适定性。对非线性双罐系统进行的数值研究表明，所提出的方法与硬数据选择方案相比，性能相当或更优，同时保留了完整的数据矩阵及其秩，从而保证了可行性。
tldr: 针对非线性系统，提出一种数据驱动预测控制框架，通过加权正则化优先处理与当前操作点接近的数据，无需丢弃数据即可实现局部化预测，并在数值研究中表现良好。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一种无需丢弃数据即可实现非线性系统数据驱动预测控制局部化的加权正则化方法。它巧妙地解决了非线性系统动态特性随操作区域变化的问题，同时保留了数据的完整性，避免了硬数据选择可能带来的信息损失和可行性问题。这种方法对于实际非线性过程的控制具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的数据驱动控制方法（如数据使能预测控制DeePC）主要针对线性系统，其叠加原理不适用于动态特性随操作区域变化的非线性系统。
method: 提出一种非线性系统的数据驱动预测控制框架，通过加权范数正则化，根据数据列与当前操作点的接近程度来优先选择数据，从而在不丢弃任何数据的情况下实现预测器的局部化。该加权方案能诱导操作点依赖的数据优先级，并确保优化问题具有良好适定性。
results: 在非线性双罐系统上的数值研究表明，所提出的方法与硬数据选择方案相比，性能相当或更优，同时保留了完整的数据矩阵及其秩，从而保证了可行性。
conclusion: 提出的基于加权正则化的数据驱动预测控制方法能有效解决非线性系统的数据驱动控制问题，通过局部化预测并保留完整数据矩阵，在性能和可行性方面均表现出色。

title: Causally Debiased Latent Action Model for Embodied Action Conditioned World Models
authors: Yufan Wei, Kun Zhou, Lingjun Mao, Zijun Zhang, Ziming Xu, Ziqiao Xi, Shuang Liang, Ruobing Han, Yuchen Yan, Xinyue Wang, Fan Feng, Biwei Huang
abstract: Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) aim to simulate future observations conditioned on embodied actions, offering a promising foundation for robot planning, policy evaluation, and data augmentation. However, learning controllable ACWMs requires large-scale action-labeled data, which remains costly to collect in the real world. Latent action models (LAMs) mitigate this bottleneck by inferring latent actions from unlabeled videos, but existing LAMs are typically trained with reconstruction-only objectives and therefore entangle action-relevant dynamics with action-irrelevant visual factors such as backgrounds and untouched objects. In this work, we identify this action-irrelevant bias as a key obstacle to controllable ACWMs and introduce evaluation metrics to measure latent-action bias, action following, and robustness. We propose CD-LAM, a causally debiased framework for LAM-based ACWMs. CD-LAM introduces three efficient fine-tuning objectives: embodiment-centric reconstruction, action-centric contrastive learning, and latent space calibration, which together encourage embodiment-focused, action-aware, and calibrated non-collapsed latent action representations. Experiments on 2B and 14B ACWM backbones show that CD-LAM substantially improves latent-action controllability, downstream robot-action following, visual fidelity, and adaptation efficiency, requiring only 6k fine-tuning steps and more than 12$\times$ fewer robot-action adaptation updates than the baseline.
zh_title: 用于具身动作条件世界模型的因果去偏潜动作模型
translation: 动作条件世界模型（ACWM）旨在模拟基于具身动作的未来观测，为机器人规划、策略评估和数据增强提供了有前景的基础。然而，学习可控的ACWM需要大规模的动作标注数据，这在现实世界中收集成本高昂。潜动作模型（LAM）通过从无标注视频中推断潜动作来缓解这一瓶颈，但现有的LAM通常采用仅重建的目标进行训练，因此将动作相关的动力学与动作无关的视觉因素（如背景和未接触的物体）纠缠在一起。在这项工作中，我们将这种动作无关的偏差确定为实现可控ACWM的关键障碍，并引入了评估指标来衡量潜动作偏差、动作遵循和鲁棒性。我们提出了CD-LAM，一个用于基于LAM的ACWM的因果去偏框架。CD-LAM引入了三个高效的微调目标：以具身为中心的重建、以动作为中心的对比学习和潜空间校准，这些目标共同促进了以具身为中心、具有动作感知能力且经过校准的非坍缩潜动作表示。在2B和14B ACWM骨干网络上的实验表明，CD-LAM显著提高了潜动作的可控性、下游机器人动作遵循能力、视觉保真度和适应效率，仅需6k步微调，且比基线减少了12倍以上的机器人动作适应更新。
tldr: 本文提出了CD-LAM，一种因果去偏的潜动作模型框架，通过三种高效微调目标显著提高了具身动作条件世界模型的控制力、动作遵循能力和数据适应效率。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于敏锐地指出了现有潜动作模型（LAM）在无监督训练中容易将动作动力学与背景等无关视觉信息相纠缠的痛点，并从因果去偏的角度提出了低成本、高效率的微调解决方案。其重要性在于极大地降低了具身世界模型对动作标注数据的依赖，提高了微调效率（减少12倍以上的更新）。局限性在于，虽然在2B和14B模型上表现优异，但在更复杂、动态背景的多模态真实场景中的泛化能力仍有待进一步验证。
motivation: 学习可控的动作条件世界模型（ACWM）需要大量高成本的动作标注数据。虽然潜动作模型（LAM）能从无标注视频中推断潜动作，但现有LAM由于仅采用重建目标训练，导致动作相关动力学与背景、未接触物体等动作无关的视觉因素相纠缠，产生了动作无关的偏差，阻碍了可控ACWM的构建。
method: 提出CD-LAM框架，引入了三种高效的微调目标：以具身为中心的重建、以动作为中心的对比学习以及潜空间校准。这些目标协同作用，以促进聚焦于具身、感知动作且校准的非坍缩潜动作表示。此外，还引入了评估潜动作偏差、动作遵循和鲁棒性的新指标。
results: 在2B和14B的ACWM骨干网络上的实验表明，CD-LAM显著提升了潜动作的可控性、下游机器人动作遵循能力、视觉保真度和适应效率。它仅需6k步微调，且机器人动作适应更新次数比基线减少了12倍以上。
conclusion: CD-LAM通过因果去偏有效克服了现有LAM中的动作无关偏差，为构建高效、可控的具身动作条件世界模型提供了一种极具前景且实用的解决方案。

title: Instrumentation and field tests to evaluate a rollover risk estimator for mobile machinery with mobile tools
authors: Lama Al Bassit, Bastien Laurent, Philippe Samuel Heritier, Romain Duval, Valérie Sulis, Roland Lenain
abstract: Agricultural machines that carry mobile tools or implements have an internal dynamic that makes them more prone to rollover risk than machines with fixed configurations. Previous research has led to the development of algorithms capable of predicting rollover risk in real time by estimating relevant metrics, primarily the LTR (Load Transfer Ratio), with a focus on vehicles with static configurations. This paper presents the adaptation of these algorithms for machines with mobile tools and describes the field tests, conducted on a self-propelled sprayer, to evaluate their effectiveness in predicting rollover. The tests also aimed to acquire the necessary data to build an accurate numerical model of the vehicle and produce high-quality simulated tests. This paper describes the chosen instrumentation, the test procedure, and the experimental design of these tests. These field tests include static tests and dynamic tests. Static tests determine vehicle parameters, while dynamic tests measure variables related to the machine displacement and wheel/ground forces in real time. The initial results demonstrate the algorithms' ability to capture variations in LTR, which express lateral and longitudinal rollover risk. The data collected through these tests will enable the vehicle displacements to be replayed by simulation, producing simulated rollover accidents and evaluating the effectiveness of the developed algorithms in accident prevention.
zh_title: 移动工具移动机械侧翻风险评估仪的仪器化与现场试验
translation: 农业机械携带移动工具或农具，其内部动态使其比固定配置的机械更容易发生侧翻风险。先前的研究已经开发出能够通过估计相关指标（主要是载荷转移比LTR）实时预测侧翻风险的算法，主要关注静态配置的车辆。本文介绍了这些算法在带有移动工具的机械上的适应性，并描述了在一台自走式喷雾机上进行的现场试验，以评估其预测侧翻的有效性。这些试验还旨在获取必要的数据，以建立车辆的精确数值模型并生成高质量的模拟试验。本文描述了所选的仪器、试验程序和这些试验的实验设计。这些现场试验包括静态试验和动态试验。静态试验确定车辆参数，而动态试验实时测量与机械位移和车轮/地面力相关的变量。初步结果表明，这些算法能够捕捉LTR的变化，这表达了横向和纵向的侧翻风险。通过这些试验收集的数据将使车辆位移能够通过模拟重现，从而产生模拟侧翻事故并评估所开发算法在事故预防中的有效性。
tldr: 本文针对带有移动工具的农业机械，改进了侧翻风险预测算法，并描述了在自走式喷雾机上进行的现场试验，以评估算法有效性并收集数据用于数值模型和事故模拟。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过将现有的侧翻预测算法应用于涉及移动工具的更复杂场景，解决了农业机械中的一个关键安全问题。在真实喷雾机上进行现场试验对于验证和数据收集具有重要价值，这将有助于创建稳健的数值模型和模拟。将载荷转移比（LTR）作为关键指标是合适的。这项工作为改进这类机械的事故预防奠定了基础。
motivation: 携带移动工具的农业机械比固定配置的机械更容易发生侧翻。先前的侧翻风险预测算法主要针对静态配置车辆，因此需要对这些算法进行调整和评估，以适用于带有移动工具的机械，并实时预测侧翻风险。
method: 本文将现有的侧翻风险预测算法（主要关注载荷转移比LTR）应用于带有移动工具的机械。通过在自走式喷雾机上进行静态和动态现场试验，评估算法预测侧翻的有效性，并收集数据以构建精确的车辆数值模型和进行模拟试验。文中还详细描述了所选的仪器、测试程序和实验设计。
results: 初步结果表明，所改进的算法能够捕捉LTR的变化，这些变化反映了横向和纵向的侧翻风险。通过这些试验收集的数据将用于通过模拟重现车辆位移，从而模拟侧翻事故并评估所开发算法在事故预防中的有效性。
conclusion: 初步的现场试验表明，针对带有移动工具的移动机械，改进后的算法能够有效捕捉侧翻风险指标（LTR）。收集到的数据对于未来基于模拟评估事故预防的有效性至关重要。

title: TactiDex: A Real-World Tactile-Guided Benchmark for Human-Like Dexterous Manipulation
authors: Suting Ni, Hanbing Zhang, Zhenyu Wei, Guo Chen, Chixuan Zhang, Ye Shi, Jingya Wang
abstract: Tactile feedback is fundamental to Hand-Object Interaction (HOI), governing contact formation, force regulation, and stable manipulation, making it essential for achieving true human-like dexterous manipulation. Yet, current human-to-robot dexterous transfer pipelines primarily rely on kinematic trajectories, resulting in motion imitation without physically grounded interaction. To address this, we introduce TactiDex, a real-world tactile-guided benchmark specifically designed to move dexterous manipulation beyond kinematic mimicry toward contact-level human-likeness. TactiDex provides a comprehensive dataset that elegantly aligns whole-hand tactile signals with multi-granularity kinematic and object states, coupled with standardized evaluation metrics. Building upon this data paradigm, we propose a tactile-driven transfer framework that effectively translates human demonstrations into physically plausible robotic execution. We introduce TactiSkill, a framework built upon a novel tri-component tactile reward that innovatively uses tactile signals as structured supervision. This reward unifies guidance, human-like alignment, and contact constraints into a single objective. Through comprehensive experiments on both single and bimanual tasks, we demonstrate that TactiSkill achieves superior performance in manipulation success and physical realism. This work lays a crucial foundation for advancing tactile-aware dexterous manipulation. Our project page at https://tactidex.github.io/.
zh_title: TactiDex：面向类人灵巧操作的真实世界触觉引导基准
translation: 触觉反馈是手-物交互（HOI）的基础，主导着接触形成、力量调节和稳定操作，这使得它对于实现真正的类人灵巧操作至关重要。然而，目前的人到机器人灵巧迁移管线主要依赖于运动学轨迹，导致了没有物理基础交互的动作模仿。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了TactiDex，这是一个真实世界的触觉引导基准，专门旨在推动灵巧操作超越运动学模仿，走向接触层面的类人类。TactiDex提供了一个全面的数据集，该数据集将整手触觉信号与多粒度运动学和物体状态优雅地对齐，并配备了标准化的评估指标。基于这种数据范式，我们提出了一个触觉驱动的迁移框架，该框架能够有效地将人类演示转化为物理上合理的机器人执行。我们引入了TactiSkill，这是一个基于新型三成分触觉奖励的框架，该框架创新地将触觉信号用作结构化监督。该奖励将引导、类人对齐和接触约束统一到一个单一的目标中。通过在单手和双手任务上的全面实验，我们证明了TactiSkill在操作成功率和物理真实性方面均取得了优异的性能。这项工作为推进触觉感知灵巧操作奠定了至关重要的基础。我们的项目主页位于 https://tactidex.github.io/。
tldr: 本文提出了TactiDex基准和TactiSkill框架，通过将整手触觉信号与运动学状态对齐，并使用创新的三成分触觉奖励进行监督，实现了物理上更真实、成功的类人灵巧操作。
ai_comments: 该论文成功将触觉反馈引入到人-机灵巧操作迁移中，弥补了传统仅依赖运动学轨迹的不足。其提出的TactiDex基准和TactiSkill框架，特别是三成分触觉奖励的设计，对于实现高保真度、物理真实的类人机械手操作具有重要的创新意义和实用价值。
motivation: 当前人到机器人的灵巧操作迁移主要依赖于运动学轨迹，导致只有动作模仿而缺乏基于物理的交互，无法实现真正的类人灵巧操作。
method: 1. 提出TactiDex基准，提供将整手触觉信号与多粒度运动学及物体状态对齐的全面数据集和标准化评估指标；2. 提出TactiSkill框架，利用一个包含引导、类人对齐和接触约束的三成分触觉奖励作为结构化监督，实现触觉驱动的迁移。
results: 在单手和双手任务上的全面实验表明，TactiSkill在操作成功率和物理真实性方面均取得了优异的表现。
conclusion: 本研究为推进触觉感知灵巧操作奠定了至关重要的基础，证明了引入触觉反馈对提升机器人操作物理真实性和成功率的关键作用。

title: GenVid2Robot: From Video Generation to Robot Manipulation via Rigid-Geometric Consistency
authors: Haohui Huang, Xi Yuan, Panpan Liao, Tao Teng, Chenguang Yang, Jing Guo, Yi Guo
abstract: Generated videos provide useful visual motion priors for robot manipulation, but their visual plausibility does not imply physical executability. A generated video usually lacks metric geometry, grasp grounding, robot kinematic feasibility, and execution-time feedback, which makes direct trajectory replay unreliable in real-world manipulation. This paper presents GenVid2Robot, a rigid-geometric consistency framework that converts generated video motion into executable real-robot manipulation trajectories. Given an initial RGB-D observation and a task instruction, GenVid2Robot samples task-relevant semantic anchors from the real first frame, tracks these anchors through generated video candidates, and verifies whether the resulting 2D motion can be explained by first-frame RGB-D anchors under a sparse relative $SE(3)$ model. In this way, generated videos are treated as uncertain visual motion hypotheses rather than direct robot demonstrations. Only geometrically consistent motion is transferred to the robot. The accepted relative motion is then applied to the real grasp-time TCP pose selected by mask-constrained grasping, producing a grasp-conditioned execution trajectory that is consistent with both the visual motion prior and the physical grasp configuration. To reduce execution mismatch caused by RGB-D noise, calibration residuals, and small contact-induced displacement, a bounded depth-compensation module corrects local depth-direction errors without assuming full online replanning. Real-robot experiments demonstrate that GenVid2Robot improves the reliability of generated-video-guided manipulation by grounding visual motion priors with sparse metric geometry, grasp constraints, robot feasibility checking, and bounded execution feedback.
zh_title: GenVid2Robot：通过刚性几何一致性从视频生成到机器人操控
translation: 生成的视频为机器人操控提供了有用的视觉运动先验，但其视觉上的合理性并不意味着物理上的可执行性。生成的视频通常缺乏度量几何、抓取基础、机器人运动学可行性以及执行期间的反馈，这使得直接轨迹重放在现实世界的操控中变得不可靠。本文提出了 GenVid2Robot，这是一个刚性几何一致性框架，可将生成的视频运动转换为可执行的真实机器人操控轨迹。给定初始 RGB-D 观测值和任务指令，GenVid2Robot 从真实的初始帧中采样任务相关的语义锚点，通过生成的视频候选序列追踪这些锚点，并验证产生的 2D 运动是否可以用初始帧 RGB-D 锚点在稀疏相对 SE(3) 模型下进行解释。通过这种方式，生成的视频被视为不确定的视觉运动假设，而不是直接的机器人演示。只有几何一致的运动才会被传递给机器人。被接受的相对运动随后应用于通过掩码约束抓取选择的真实抓取时间 TCP 位姿，从而生成既符合视觉运动先验又符合物理抓取配置的抓取条件执行轨迹。为了减少由 RGB-D 噪声、校准残差和接触引起的微小位移导致的执行不匹配，一个有界深度补偿模块在不假设完全在线重规划的情况下校正了局部深度方向误差。真实机器人实验表明，GenVid2Robot 通过将视觉运动先验与稀疏度量几何、抓取约束、机器人可行性检查和有界执行反馈相结合，提高了生成视频引导操控的可靠性。
tldr: 该框架通过引入刚性几何验证和深度补偿，将不可靠的生成视频运动转化为机器人可执行的物理轨迹。
ai_comments: 该研究巧妙地解决了生成式视频在机器人操控中的“视觉合理但不物理可行”这一核心痛点。通过引入刚性几何一致性约束，将不可靠的视频生成转化为可执行的机器人轨迹，为利用大规模视频生成模型赋能机器人操控开辟了新路径。
motivation: 尽管生成的视频提供了有价值的视觉运动先验，但其缺乏度量几何、抓取基础和运动学可行性，导致直接重放轨迹在真实机器人操作中不可靠。
method: 提出 GenVid2Robot 框架：1. 从初始 RGB-D 图像采样语义锚点并在视频中追踪；2. 使用稀疏相对 SE(3) 模型验证 2D 运动的几何一致性；3. 将选定的运动应用于掩码约束下的抓取 TCP 位姿；4. 引入有界深度补偿模块以校正执行过程中的局部误差。
results: 实验证明，GenVid2Robot 通过将视觉运动先验与稀疏度量几何、抓取约束和执行反馈相结合，显著提高了基于生成视频引导的机器人操控的可靠性。
conclusion: GenVid2Robot 通过将生成的视频视为不确定的视觉运动假设，并结合刚性几何约束和深度补偿，有效地将视觉先验转化为可靠的机器人操作指令。

title: YeTI: You Only Need Two Noisy Images for Real-World sRGB Noise Generation
authors: Jaekyun Ko, Byung Wan Lim, Soomin Lee, Dongjin Kim, Tae Hyun Kim
abstract: Real-world sRGB image denoising remains challenging due to the nonlinear characteristics of sensor noise and the difficulty of acquiring aligned clean-noisy image pairs. Supervised denoisers often overfit to limited paired datasets, while self-supervised methods still depend on sufficiently diverse noisy observations. These limitations motivate scalable noise synthesis methods that can model real-world noise without clean ground truth or camera metadata. We propose YeTI, a real-world sRGB noise generation framework that learns from only two noisy observations of the same scene. YeTI uses a Reconstruction Autoencoder to disentangle scene structure and noise characteristics, and models the latent noise distribution with a one-step Conditional Diffusion Transformer trained using consistency objectives. Given a single noisy input at inference time, YeTI generates realistic, signal-dependent noise while preserving the underlying scene content. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of YeTI across real-world benchmarks. We evaluate noise generation on SIDD and further assess generalization on SIDD+, MAI2021, and SID, covering smartphone and diverse consumer-camera sensors. Downstream denoising results on DND further show that denoisers trained with YeTI-synthesized images achieve strong real-world performance, highlighting the practical value of clean-image-free and metadata-free noise generation.
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Includes supplementary material
zh_title: YeTI：您只需要两张真实世界的 sRGB 噪声图像即可进行噪声生成
translation: 真实世界的 sRGB 图像去噪仍然具有挑战性，因为传感器噪声具有非线性特性，并且难以获取对齐的干净-噪声图像对。监督式去噪器通常会在有限的配对数据集上过拟合，而自监督方法仍然依赖于足够多样化的噪声观测。这些局限性促使人们需要可扩展的噪声合成方法，这些方法可以在没有干净参考图像或相机元数据的情况下模拟真实世界的噪声。我们提出了 YeTI，一个真实世界的 sRGB 噪声生成框架，它仅从两个相同场景的噪声观测中学习。YeTI 使用重建自编码器来解耦场景结构和噪声特征，并使用使用一致性目标训练的单步条件扩散 Transformer 来模拟潜在噪声分布。在推理时，给定单个噪声输入，YeTI 可以生成逼真的、与信号相关的噪声，同时保留底层的场景内容。广泛的实验证明了 YeTI 在真实世界基准测试中的有效性。我们在 SIDD 上评估噪声生成，并在 SIDD+、MAI2021 和 SID 上进一步评估泛化能力，涵盖了智能手机和各种消费级相机传感器。在 DND 上的下游去噪结果进一步表明，使用 YeTI 合成的图像训练的去噪器取得了强大的真实世界性能，凸显了无干净图像和无元数据噪声生成的实际价值。
tldr: YeTI 是一种新的噪声生成框架，仅需两张相同场景的噪声图像即可学习真实世界的 sRGB 噪声模型，无需干净的参考图像或相机元数据。它使用重建自编码器来分离场景结构和噪声特征，并结合条件扩散 Transformer 来模拟潜在噪声分布。YeTI 可以在推理时从单个噪声输入生成逼真的、与信号相关的噪声，并且在各种真实世界数据集上的实验证明了其有效性，下游去噪任务的结果也表明了其在实际应用中的价值。
ai_comments: YeTI 的主要创新在于仅需两张噪声图像即可实现真实世界 sRGB 噪声的生成，这大大降低了数据获取的门槛，解决了现有方法在数据依赖性上的痛点。其结合重建自编码器和条件扩散 Transformer 的方法在解耦场景结构和噪声特征方面表现出色。然而，需要注意的是，虽然 YeTI 减少了对干净图像和元数据的依赖，但其性能仍可能受限于输入噪声图像的数量和质量。未来的研究可以探索更少输入图像（例如单张）或更广泛噪声类型的生成。
motivation: 现有的真实世界 sRGB 图像去噪方法面临挑战，因为传感器噪声具有非线性特性，并且难以获取对齐的干净-噪声图像对。监督式去噪器容易在有限的数据集上过拟合，而自监督方法则需要足够多样的噪声观测。这些限制促使人们需要可扩展的噪声合成方法，这些方法可以在没有干净参考图像或相机元数据的情况下模拟真实世界的噪声。
method: YeTI 框架使用重建自编码器来分离场景结构和噪声特征。它利用一个单步条件扩散 Transformer 来模拟潜在噪声分布，并通过一致性目标进行训练。在推理时，给定单个噪声输入，YeTI 可以生成逼真的、与信号相关的噪声，同时保留底层场景内容。
results: YeTI 在真实世界数据集（如 SIDD）上进行了噪声生成评估，并在 SIDD+、MAI2021 和 SID 等数据集上进行了泛化能力评估，涵盖了智能手机和各种消费级相机传感器。使用 YeTI 合成的图像训练的去噪器在 DND 数据集上取得了强大的真实世界性能。
conclusion: YeTI 是一种有效的、无需干净图像和元数据的真实世界 sRGB 噪声生成方法，仅需两张噪声图像即可学习噪声模型，并且在下游去噪任务中表现出实际应用价值。

title: Cyclic Reformulation-Based Identification and Polytopic Uncertainty Modeling for Multirate Systems
authors: Hiroshi Okajima, Kakeru Ono
abstract: Modern control systems increasingly rely on heterogeneous sensors operating at different sampling rates, where intermittently missing outputs pose fundamental challenges for system identification. This paper proposes a non-iterative, control-oriented identification method for multirate systems based on cyclic reformulation. The method transforms multirate data into an expanded time-invariant representation and yields M parameter sets from a single input-output dataset, where M is the least common multiple of the sensor sampling periods. These parameter sets are used in two complementary ways: their centroid serves as a noise-reduced nominal model, while their convex hull gives a polytopic uncertainty model compatible with vertex-based LMI robust control design. Building on the noise-free structural recovery theorem of the authors' preceding work, which is restated here in the notation of the present paper, the present paper newly introduces the centroid and polytopic models derived from the M parameter sets; finite-noise behavior is treated as an empirical observation and is evaluated numerically. Numerical simulations support both models: an illustrative SISO example shows that the centroid attains higher validation FIT than the best individual vertex and substantially outperforms an interpolation-based baseline, while a MIMO multirate sensing example confirms, in line with the LTI counterpart, that the constructed polytope contains models whose validation FIT exceeds 95\% on average even at the highest tested noise level. The polytope is interpreted cautiously, with finite-noise behavior assessed through output-level validation statistics rather than realization-dependent matrix-coordinate distances. The proposed framework therefore links multirate system identification with robust-control-oriented uncertainty modeling without iterative EM-type optimization.
zh_title: 基于循环重构的多速率系统辨识与多胞形不确定性建模
translation: 现代控制系统日益依赖于在不同采样率下运行的异构传感器，其中间歇性缺失的输出对系统辨识提出了根本性挑战。本文提出了一种基于循环重构的非迭代、控制导向的多速率系统辨识方法。该方法将多速率数据转换为扩展的时不变表示，并从单个输入输出数据集中生成M个参数集，其中M是传感器采样周期的最小公倍数。这些参数集以两种互补的方式使用：它们的质心作为降噪的名义模型，而它们的凸包则提供与基于顶点的LMI鲁棒控制设计兼容的多胞形不确定性模型。在作者先前工作的无噪声结构恢复定理（在此以本文的符号重新阐述）的基础上，本文新引入了从M个参数集导出的质心和多胞形模型；有限噪声行为被视为经验观察并进行数值评估。数值模拟支持这两种模型：一个说明性的SISO示例表明，质心比最佳个体顶点具有更高的验证FIT，并且显著优于基于插值的基线；而一个MIMO多速率传感示例证实，与LTI对应物一致，所构建的多胞形包含的模型的验证FIT平均超过95%，即使在最高测试噪声水平下也是如此。对多胞形的解释是谨慎的，有限噪声行为通过输出级验证统计数据而不是依赖于实现矩阵坐标距离进行评估。因此，所提出的框架在没有迭代EM型优化的情况下，将多速率系统辨识与面向鲁棒控制的不确定性建模联系起来。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于循环重构的非迭代控制导向多速率系统辨识方法，通过将多速率数据转换为扩展时不变表示，生成M个参数集，并利用其质心作为降噪名义模型，凸包作为多胞形不确定性模型，从而将多速率系统辨识与鲁棒控制不确定性建模相结合。

results: 数值模拟支持这两种模型：SISO示例显示质心比最佳个体顶点具有更高的验证FIT，并显著优于基于插值的基线；MIMO多速率传感示例证实，所构建的多胞形包含的模型的验证FIT平均超过95%，即使在最高测试噪声水平下也是如此。

title: Toward Auditable AI Scientists: A Hypothesis Evolution Protocol for LLM Agents
authors: Izumi Takahara, Teruyasu Mizoguchi
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to play a central role in AI-driven scientific discovery. Equipped with broad knowledge, flexible reasoning, and tool use, they have the potential to autonomously explore and solve scientific problems by repeatedly proposing hypotheses, testing them, and revising their beliefs in the light of the evidence. In current agents, however, these hypotheses, tests, and belief updates are buried in unstructured logs, and no mechanism lets the agent or the human researcher audit that process. Here we propose the Hypothesis Evolution Protocol (HEP), an agent harness that provides hypothesis generation, evaluation, and evolution as explicit, auditable operations. On materials-science research tasks, a HEP-equipped agent operates the hypothesis--test--evidence--belief cycle that planning-style agents lack, generalizes across research questions, and exploits the protocol more fully as the base LLM becomes more capable. These results mark a step toward auditable AI scientists, whose scientific reasoning can be inspected, verified, and built upon.
zh_title: 迈向可审计的人工智能科学家：LLM智能体的假设演化协议
translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体被寄予厚望，将在人工智能驱动的科学发现中发挥核心作用。它们具备广泛的知识、灵活的推理能力和工具使用能力，有潜力通过反复提出假设、测试它们并根据证据修正其信念，自主探索和解决科学问题。然而，在当前的智能体中，这些假设、测试和信念更新被埋藏在非结构化日志中，并且没有机制让智能体或人类研究员审计该过程。本文提出了假设演化协议（HEP），这是一种智能体工具，它将假设生成、评估和演化作为明确的、可审计的操作提供。在材料科学研究任务中，配备HEP的智能体能够运行规划式智能体所缺乏的假设-测试-证据-信念循环，能够跨研究问题进行泛化，并且随着基础LLM能力的增强，能更充分地利用该协议。这些结果标志着向可审计的人工智能科学家迈出了一步，其科学推理可以被检查、验证和在此基础上进行构建。
tldr: 本文提出了假设演化协议（HEP），这是一种智能体工具，旨在使大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在科学发现中的假设生成、评估和演化过程变得显式且可审计，从而解决当前LLM智能体科学推理过程不透明的问题。

motivation: 当前的大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在科学发现中，其假设、测试和信念更新过程被埋藏在非结构化日志中，缺乏让智能体或人类研究员审计该过程的机制。
method: 本文提出了假设演化协议（HEP），这是一种智能体线束，它将假设生成、评估和演化作为明确的、可审计的操作提供。

title: Application of machine learning to monster level prediction in tabletop RPG game design
authors: Jolanta Śliwa, Jakub Adamczyk
abstract: Designing balanced adversaries is a central but labor-intensive task in tabletop role-playing game (TTRPG) development. In systems such as Pathfinder, each monster is described by many numerical attributes that jointly determine its power, summarized as an ordinal level. We investigate whether machine learning can support designers by predicting this level from a monster's attributes, framing the task as tabular ordinal regression. We introduce what is, to our knowledge, the first dataset built specifically for TTRPG monster-level prediction, derived from publicly available Pathfinder Second Edition data. Using it, we compare classical regression models with rounding schemes, dedicated tabular ordinal regression algorithms, and neural networks with ordinal-aware losses. To mirror real design workflows, we evaluate all models under chronological and expanding-window protocols with several complementary metrics. Results show that tree-based ensembles outperform linear models and neural approaches, achieving near-perfect ordinal ranking and high predictive accuracy. Explainable AI analyses, such as feature importance and error distributions, show that the model is aligned with human intuition and follows patterns grounded in game rules.
