title: Beyond Metadata: CAPRA for Hidden Subgroup Analysis under Missing Metadata in Medical Imaging
authors: Yawen Li, Yan Li, Zhe Xue, Yingxia Shao, Meiyu Liang, Guanhua Ye
abstract: Medical imaging models are often deployed without the demographic, acquisition, and quality metadata needed for subgroup auditing. Once those metadata disappear, clinically critical failure modes can be masked by strong aggregate performance, and many robust-learning methods lose the group structure they rely on. We present CAPRA, a calibrated proxy-axis framework for hidden subgroup analysis under missing metadata. CAPRA predicts image-derived semantic axes, calibrates axis posteriors on a small metadata-labeled split via patient-level cross-fitting, and organizes those posteriors into a calibrated subgroup interface that supports both deployment-time failure analysis and downstream robust learning without requiring subgroup labels at deployment. Across fundus, dermoscopy, and chest radiography, CAPRA reveals disparity patterns missed by metadata-only slicing, remains informative under dataset shift, and produces subgroup partitions that align more closely with explicit failure axes than image-only or latent-slice baselines. The same interface can also be reused by downstream robust learners, although those gains are domain-dependent. Overall, CAPRA turns hidden subgroup analysis under missing metadata into a calibrated, interpretable, and reusable subgroup interface for deployment-time analysis and robust transfer.
zh_title: 超越元数据：用于医学成像中缺失元数据下隐藏子群分析的 CAPRA 框架
translation: 医学影像模型在部署时往往缺少进行子群审计所需的人口统计学、图像获取和质量元数据。一旦这些元数据缺失，临床上关键的失效模式可能会被强大的总体性能所掩盖，并且许多鲁棒学习方法也会失去它们所依赖的群体结构。我们提出了 CAPRA，一个用于在缺失元数据下进行隐藏子群分析的校准代理轴（calibrated proxy-axis）框架。CAPRA 预测源自图像的语义轴，通过患者级交叉拟合在少量带有元数据标签的划分上校准轴后验概率，并将这些后验概率组织成一个校准的子群接口，该接口支持部署时的失效分析和下游的鲁棒学习，而无需在部署时提供子群标签。在眼底、皮肤镜和胸部放射影像上的实验表明，CAPRA 揭示了仅靠元数据切片会遗漏的差异模式，在数据集漂移下仍能保持信息量，并且与仅图像或隐性切片基线相比，其生成的子群划分与显式失效轴的对齐更为紧密。下游的鲁棒学习器也可以重用相同的接口，尽管这些收益取决于具体领域。总的来说，CAPRA 将缺失元数据下的隐藏子群分析转化为一个校准、可解释且可重用的子群接口，用于部署时分析和鲁棒迁移。
tldr: 本文提出了 CAPRA 框架，通过构建校准的代理轴接口，解决了医学影像模型在缺失人口统计等元数据时无法进行隐藏子群失效分析和鲁棒学习的难题。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一种校准代理轴（CAPRA）框架，解决了医学AI在实际部署中由于隐私或系统原因缺失人口统计学等元数据时，难以进行子群审计和鲁棒学习的痛点。其重要性在于能够揭示被总体高性能掩盖的临床关键失效模式，提升了医疗诊断模型的安全性和可解释性。局限性在于，该方法在下游鲁棒学习器中的增益具有领域依赖性，且在初期仍需一个微型的元数据标注集进行校准。
motivation: 医学影像模型在实际部署中往往缺失人口统计、采集和质量等元数据，导致临床关键的失效模式被高水平的总体性能掩盖，且许多鲁棒学习方法因失去依赖的群体结构而失效。
method: 提出 CAPRA（校准代理轴）框架。该方法预测图像派生的语义轴，通过患者级交叉拟合在微型元数据标注划分上校准轴后验，并将其组织成校准的子群接口，从而在部署时无需子群标签即可支持失效分析和下游鲁棒学习。
results: 在眼底、皮肤镜和胸部放射影像上的实验表明，CAPRA 揭示了仅靠元数据切片会遗漏的差异模式，在数据集漂移下仍保持信息量，且其子群划分比仅图像或隐性切片基线更贴合显式失效轴。此外，该接口可被下游鲁棒学习器复用，但收益具有领域依赖性。
conclusion: CAPRA 成功将缺失元数据下的隐藏子群分析转化为一个校准、可解释且可重用的子群接口，为医学影像模型在部署时的失效分析和鲁棒迁移提供了强有力的支持。

title: Inter-frame Channel Prediction for Zak-OTFS
authors: Muhammad Ubadah, Saif Khan Mohammed
abstract:
Zak-Orthogonal Time Frequency Space (OTFS) modulation is known to be robust to Doppler spread in high mobility scenarios when compared to Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM). This is due to the fact that the channel response to a Zak-OTFS carrier within a frame can be accurately estimated from the channel response to another carrier within the same frame. However, an important open problem and question is whether inter-frame channel prediction is possible with Zak-OTFS, i.e., is it possible to accurately predict the channel response to a Zak-OTFS carrier in a frame based on knowledge of the channel response to some Zak-OTFS carrier in \emph{another} frame (i.e., not the same frame).
  In this paper we show that indeed inter-frame channel prediction is possible. We show that the effective DD domain channel filter coefficients vary in a deterministic manner as we move from current to future frames in time and frequency. We also show that the subspace spanned by channel filter coefficients of consecutive frames in time/frequency is invariant to discrete shifts in time and frequency. We exploit the deterministic variation and subspace invariance to propose a novel deterministic ESPIRIT-type method which uses the effective DD domain channel filter taps/coefficients estimated in training frames (i.e., current/past frames in time and frequency having both pilot and data carriers) to predict the effective DD domain channel filter for frames which are several tens of frames in future and several tens of frames away in frequency.
translation:
与正交频分复用（OFDM）相比，Zak-正交时频空（OTFS）调制在高移动性场景下对多普勒扩展具有更强的鲁棒性。这是因为在同一帧内，Zak-OTFS载波的信道响应可以从该帧内另一个载波的信道响应中准确估计出来。然而，一个重要的开放性问题和疑问是，Zak-OTFS是否可以进行帧间信道预测，即：是否有可能基于对*另一*帧（即非同一帧）中某些Zak-OTFS载波信道响应的了解，来准确预测某一帧中Zak-OTFS载波的信道响应。
在本文中，我们表明帧间信道预测确实是可行的。我们展示了当我们在时间轴和频率轴上从当前帧向未来帧移动时，有效的时延-多普勒（DD）域信道滤波器系数会以确定性的方式发生变化。我们还表明，在时间/频率上连续帧的信道滤波器系数所张成的子空间对离散的时间和频率位移具有不变性。我们利用这种确定性变化和子空间不变性，提出了一种新型的确定性ESPIRIT类方法，该方法利用在训练帧（即在时间和频率上具有导频和数据载波的当前/历史帧）中估计的有效DD域信道滤波器抽头/系数，来预测时间上在未来数十帧以及频域上相隔数十帧的有效DD域信道滤波器。
tldr: 本文证实了Zak-OTFS中帧间信道预测的可行性，并提出了一种基于时频子空间不变性的确定性ESPIRIT方法，实现了对未来数十帧的超前信道预测。
ai_comments: 本文首次解答了Zak-OTFS调制中关于帧间信道预测这一关键的开放性问题。其核心创新在于揭示了DD域信道滤波器系数在帧间的确定性时频变化规律以及子空间的时频位移不变性。基于这些物理特性，作者提出了一种创新的确定性ESPIRIT类算法，成功实现了超前数十帧的时频域长效信道预测。这一研究对于高移动性通信场景下的链路自适应和资源调度具有重要的理论与应用价值。
motivation: 虽然Zak-OTFS因其对多普勒扩展的鲁棒性而备受关注，且同一帧内的信道估计较为准确，但“是否能根据另一个不同帧的信道响应来准确预测当前/未来帧的信道响应（即帧间信道预测）”仍然是一个重要且未解决的开放性问题。
method: 作者通过理论推导证明了有效DD（时延-多普勒）域信道滤波器系数在时频域随帧移动呈确定性变化，且连续帧系数所张成的子空间对离散时频移位具有不变性。基于此，提出了一种新型的确定性ESPIRIT类方法，该方法利用当前或历史训练帧中估计的DD域信道抽头系数，来预测未来帧的有效DD域信道滤波器。
results: 成功证实了Zak-OTFS帧间信道预测的可行性。所提出的确定性ESPIRIT类方法能够利用已知训练帧（包含导频和数据）的信道系数，准确预测在时间上处于未来数十帧以及在频域上相隔数十帧的有效DD域信道滤波器。
conclusion: 在Zak-OTFS中进行帧间信道预测是完全可行的。通过利用DD域信道系数的确定性变化规律和子空间移位不变性，可以实现高精度的跨帧（时域和频域长距离）信道预测。

title: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Solar PV Panel Fault Classification
authors: Seyyedhamid Azimidokht, Mehdi Monemi, Abdelhak Kharbouch, Farid Hamzehaghdam, Mehdi Rasti, Jamshid Aghaei, Emil Kurvinen
abstract: The rapid expansion of solar photovoltaic (PV) systems has increased the need for reliable and scalable fault classification, as manual inspection is impractical at scale. Thermal infrared (IR) imaging provides a non-contact solution for identifying PV faults; however, accurate classification remains challenging due to class imbalance, limited texture information, and subtle thermal differences. In this work, we investigate the applicability of Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) for thermal IR PV fault classification across various scenarios and propose JEFFNet (JEPA-EFFicientNet), a multibranch architecture that combines JEPA-based self-supervised representation learning with EfficientNetV2-S-based supervised convolutional feature extraction. JEFFNet fuses semantic representations from a JEPA-pretrained Vision Transformer with convolutional features from EfficientNetV2-S, enabling complementary feature learning. JEFFNet is evaluated on two public thermal IR datasets, PVF-10 and InfraredSolarModules (ISM), for both multiclass and derived binary (healthy/faulty) classification. On PVF-10, JEFFNet achieves an F1-score of $93.21$ and an accuracy of $94.33$ in the 10-class task, and an F1-score of $97.53$ and an accuracy of $96.41$ in the derived 2-class task. On ISM, JEFFNet achieves an F1-score of $72.60$ and an accuracy of $83.88$ in the 12-class task, and an F1-score of $94.69$ and an accuracy of $94.78$ in the derived 2-class task. JEFFNet also uses only 108.6M parameters versus 205.91M for GEPFNet, a 47.2\% reduction. These results demonstrate that combining self-supervised semantic and supervised convolutional features provides an effective, parameter-efficient solution for thermal IR PV fault classification. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Azimi2kht/JEFFNet
zh_title: 联合嵌入预测架构在太阳能光伏面板故障分类中的应用
translation: 太阳能光伏（PV）系统的快速扩张增加了对可靠且可扩展的故障分类的需求，因为大规模的人工巡检是不切实际的。红外（IR）热成像为识别光伏故障提供了一种非接触式解决方案；然而，由于类别不平衡、纹理信息有限以及细微的温度差异，准确分类仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们研究了联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）在各种场景下红外光伏故障分类中的适用性，并提出了JEFFNet（JEPA-EFFicientNet），这是一种结合了基于JEPA的自监督表示学习与基于EfficientNetV2-S的监督卷积特征提取的多分支架构。JEFFNet融合了来自JEPA预训练Vision Transformer的语义表示与来自EfficientNetV2-S的卷积特征，从而实现了互补的特征学习。JEFFNet在两个公开的红外热成像数据集PVF-10和InfraredSolarModules (ISM)上进行了多分类和衍生二分类（健康/故障）任务的评估。在PVF-10上，JEFFNet在10分类任务中实现了93.21的F1分数和94.33的准确率，在衍生的2分类任务中实现了97.53的F1分数和96.41的准确率。在ISM上，JEFFNet在12分类任务中实现了72.60的F1分数和83.88的准确率，在衍生的2分类任务中实现了94.69的F1分数和94.78的准确率。JEFFNet还仅使用了108.6M参数，相比GEPFNet的205.91M减少了47.2%。这些结果表明，将自监督语义特征与监督卷积特征相结合，为红外光伏故障分类提供了一种有效且参数高效的解决方案。源代码公开在 https://github.com/Azimi2kht/JEFFNet。
tldr: 本文提出JEFFNet，通过融合自监督JEPA语义特征与监督EfficientNetV2-S卷积特征，在大幅减少参数量的同时，显著提升了红外光伏面板故障分类的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将自监督学习架构JEPA与传统的监督卷积网络（EfficientNetV2-S）相结合，用于解决红外光伏故障检测中的类别不平衡和纹理缺失问题。这种双分支融合策略在保持高分类精度的同时，相比现有方法GEPFNet显著减少了近一半的参数量，在工业级红外光伏巡检中具有很强的实用价值和推广意义。
motivation: 随着太阳能光伏系统的快速扩张，传统人工巡检难以规模化，需要可靠且可扩展的故障分类方法。红外热成像提供了非接触式方案，但由于类别不平衡、纹理信息有限以及细微的温度差异，准确分类仍然面临巨大挑战。
method: 提出了JEFFNet（JEPA-EFFicientNet）多分支架构，该架构将基于JEPA预训练的Vision Transformer提取的自监督语义表示，与基于EfficientNetV2-S提取的监督卷积特征进行融合，从而实现互补的特征学习。
results: 在PVF-10数据集上，JEFFNet在10分类任务中取得了93.21的F1分数和94.33%的准确率，在2分类中取得97.53的F1分数和96.41%的准确率；在ISM数据集上，12分类任务中取得72.60的F1分数和83.88%的准确率，2分类中取得94.69的F1分数和94.78%的准确率。此外，JEFFNet的参数量仅为108.6M，相比GEPFNet（205.91M）减少了47.2%。
conclusion: 结合自监督语义特征与监督卷积特征，为红外热成像太阳能光伏故障分类提供了一种有效、高精度且参数高效的解决方案。

title: When Does Order Flow Matter? State-Dependent L2 Liquidity-State Transitions in Crypto Futures
authors: Joohyoung Jeon
abstract: Building event-conditioned market models requires separating macro-event labels from persistent microstructure state. We study this distinction in Binance BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT futures from 2023-2026, combining top-20 L2 order book data, trade-flow records, and macro-event windows. We define a supervised discrete L2 liquidity-state transition task, distinct from latent-regime detection and price-direction prediction, and evaluate models in rolling monthly out-of-sample folds with event-clustered validation and blocked permutation tests, admitting each feature layer only if it improves on the layer below it on the same panel. Within these event windows, the first-order predictive signal is the pre-event L2 liquidity state: a coarse pre-event state baseline strongly predicts post-event liquidity regimes, interpretable logit models over continuous L2 features fail to improve on it, and a shallow nonlinear L2 model adds a robust further gain of comparable size to the state baseline's own. The macro-event calendar enters only by locating the windows and supplying matched non-event controls; we use event timing but not the event's label content, so pre-event state competes against an uninformed within-window baseline, not against the event type. Order flow adds further value only when layered on top of the L2 state model, not as a replacement. This value is not robustly cross-symbol: for ETH it is present across calm, mixed, and stressed regimes and largest under stressed pre-event liquidity, whereas BTC shows only isolated five-minute passes and no regime that clears at both horizons. These findings motivate a state-first design principle for market microstructure models. We provide a liquidity-state transition baseline and evaluation protocol that reinforcement-learning, execution-policy, or LLM-based context layers should exceed before their added value is credited.
zh_title: 订单流何时重要？加密期货中依赖状态的L2流动性状态转换
translation: 构建事件条件下的市场模型需要将宏观事件标签与持久的微观结构状态区分开来。我们研究了2023-2026年币安BTCUSDT和ETHUSDT期货的这种区别，结合了前20层L2订单簿数据、交易流记录和宏观事件窗口。我们定义了一个受监督的离散L2流动性状态转换任务，它不同于潜在制度检测和价格方向预测，并在滚动月度样本外折叠中进行模型评估，采用事件聚类验证和阻塞置换测试，只有当每个特征层在同一面板上比其下层有所改进时才被采纳。在这些事件窗口内，一阶预测信号是事件前的L2流动性状态：粗略的事件前状态基线能强有力地预测事件后流动性制度，基于连续L2特征的可解释Logit模型未能超越它，而一个浅层非线性L2模型则增加了与状态基线自身相当的稳健额外增益。宏观事件日历仅通过定位窗口和提供匹配的非事件对照来发挥作用；我们使用事件时间而非事件的标签内容，因此事件前状态与未知的窗口内基线竞争，而非与事件类型竞争。订单流只有在L2状态模型之上才能提供额外价值，而不能替代它。这种价值并非跨符号稳健：对ETH而言，其价值在平静、混合和压力制度下都存在，并在压力事件前流动性下最大，而BTC仅显示孤立的五分钟时段，并且没有在两个时间尺度上都清晰的制度。这些发现启发了市场微观结构模型的“状态优先”设计原则。我们提供了一个流动性状态转换基线和评估协议，强化学习、执行策略或基于LLM的上下文层应超越此基线才能证明其附加价值。
tldr: 研究发现，在加密期货中，L2流动性状态是预测事件后流动性状态的首要信号，订单流只有在L2状态模型之上才能提供额外价值，且其价值具有符号依赖性。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地提出了“状态优先”的市场微观结构模型设计原则，强调了L2流动性状态在预测市场动态中的核心作用。其通过严格的评估协议，证明了L2状态基线模型的重要性，并对订单流的附加价值进行了细致的分析，揭示了其在不同加密货币和市场制度下的不一致性。这为构建更鲁棒、更有效的市场预测和交易策略提供了重要指导，尤其是在高频交易和事件驱动型模型中具有重要意义。
motivation: 构建事件条件下的市场模型需要区分宏观事件标签与持久的微观结构状态，以更好地理解市场动态。
method: 研究使用2023-2026年币安BTCUSDT和ETHUSDT期货的L2订单簿数据、交易流记录和宏观事件窗口。定义了一个受监督的离散L2流动性状态转换任务，并采用滚动月度样本外折叠、事件聚类验证和阻塞置换测试进行模型评估，只有当特征层在前一层基础上有所改进时才被采纳。
results:
1. 事件前的L2流动性状态是预测事件后流动性状态的首要信号，粗略的事件前状态基线能强有力地预测事件后流动性状态。
2. 基于连续L2特征的可解释Logit模型未能超越该基线。
3. 一个浅层非线性L2模型在状态基线基础上实现了可观的额外增益。
4. 宏观事件日历仅用于定位窗口和提供匹配的非事件对照，事件时间而非事件标签内容是关键。
5. 订单流只有在L2状态模型之上才能提供额外价值，不能替代L2状态。
6. 订单流的价值并非跨符号稳健：对ETH而言，其价值在平静、混合和压力状态下都存在，并在压力事件前流动性下最大；而对BTC而言，仅在孤立的五分钟时段内出现，且没有在两个时间尺度上都清晰的制度。
conclusion: 研究结果提出了市场微观结构模型的“状态优先”设计原则。本研究提供了一个流动性状态转换基线和评估协议，强化学习、执行策略或基于LLM的上下文层应超越此基线才能证明其附加价值。

title: Influence Diagnostics in High-dimensional M-estimation: Precise Asymptotics
authors: Hugo Cui
abstract: The impact of a given training point on a statistical model is classically measured through its leave-one-out influence, which quantifies the effect of its removal from the training set on the model accuracy. While the statistics of leave-one-out influences are well understood in the low-dimensional, large sample limit $n\to \infty, d=O(1)$, they become more intricate in high dimensions, as the influence of a given sample develops non-trivial dependencies on all other training samples. For convex M-estimation under Gaussian design, in the high-dimensional limit $n\asymp d$, we show that the distribution of the influences across the training set converges to a limiting measure which we sharply characterize. Building on these results, we provide evidence that influential samples tend to lie close to the decision boundary, thereby making contact with a standard data selection heuristic in active learning.
zh_title: 高维M估计中的影响诊断：精确渐近性
translation: 给定训练点对统计模型的影响在经典上是通过其“留一法”（leave-one-out）影响力来衡量的，该影响力定量评估了从训练集中移除该点对模型准确性的影响。虽然在低维、大样本极限 $n\to \infty, d=O(1)$ 下，留一法影响力的统计学特性已为人所熟知，但在高维空间中它们变得更加错综复杂，因为给定样本的影响力会与其他所有训练样本产生非平庸的依赖关系。针对高斯设计下的凸M估计，在高维极限 $n\asymp d$ 下，我们证明了训练集上影响力的分布收敛于一个我们能精确刻画的极限测度。基于这些结果，我们提供了证据，表明有影响力的样本往往倾向于靠近决策边界，从而与主动学习中标准的数据选择启发式方法建立了联系。
tldr: 本文研究了高维凸M估计中留一法影响力的分布，证明了其在 n ≍ d 极限下收敛于一个可精确刻画的极限测度，并揭示了高影响力样本倾向于靠近决策边界的现象。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将经典的留一法影响力诊断拓展到了具有挑战性的高维制度（n与d同阶），并在高斯设计和凸M估计的框架下给出了精确的渐近刻画。这一理论突破不仅丰富了高维统计理论，还为主动学习中基于决策边界的数据选择启发式方法提供了坚实的理论支撑。其局限性可能在于目前的分析高度依赖于高斯设计和凸性假设，未来在非高斯或非凸模型上的推广值得进一步研究。
motivation: 传统上，单个训练样本对模型的影响是通过留一法（leave-one-out）影响力来衡量的，这在低维大样本极限下已得到很好的理解。然而，在高维情况下，由于特定样本的影响力与所有其他训练样本产生了复杂的非平庸依赖关系，其统计特性变得更加错综复杂，需要对其进行精确的渐近分析。
method: 针对高斯设计下的凸M估计（convex M-estimation under Gaussian design），在样本量与维度同阶的高维极限（n ≍ d）下，研究留一法影响力在整个训练集上的分布规律，并刻画其渐近行为。
results: 证明了在高维极限下，训练集中影响力的分布会收敛到一个可以精确刻画的极限测度（limiting measure）。此外，研究结果表明，具有高影响力的样本往往倾向于靠近决策边界。
conclusion: 本文精确刻画了高维凸M估计中影响力的渐近分布，并为主动学习（active learning）中“优先选择靠近决策边界的样本”这一标准数据选择启发式策略提供了理论支持。

title: Hybrid Quantum and Classical Workload Management with Graph-based Scheduling
authors: Vanessa Sochat, Daniel Milroy
abstract: High Performance Computing (HPC) centers are expanding to encompass resources that extend beyond traditional computing. By extending resources to quantum computing, hybrid quantum-classical workflows tackle complex optimization problems that have never before been possible. However, integrating quantum processing units (QPUs) into cloud-native and scientific workload managers presents a unique orchestration challenge: remote quantum devices introduce a second, external queue -- a two-queue problem -- alongside the queue owned by the traditional scheduler. In this work we present Fluence, a Kubernetes scheduler plugin backed by the Fluxion graph-based scheduler, that enables informed, gang-scheduled placement for quantum-classical workloads and custom resources. We evaluate Fluence across three scenarios using AWS Braket simulators and real QPUs. First, under node contention, Fluence's atomic gang placement all but eliminates the wasted node-time that a default scheduler accrues by partially placing gangs. Second, we introduce a synchronization primitive for the two-queue problem in which a single producer submits a shared quantum task while consumers remain scheduling-gated, reducing worker idle time by roughly 5x under short device queues and by orders of magnitude when a real device queue stretched to hours. Third, cost- and queue-aware backend selection pins the cheapest or shortest-queue device satisfying a workload, cutting mean per-run cost by roughly 70x and time-to-result from hours to under a minute. Together, these results show that quantum-awareness can be added to a cloud-native scheduler without modifying user containers.
zh_title: 基于图调度的混合量子与经典工作负载管理
translation: 高性能计算（HPC）中心正在扩展，以包含传统计算之外的资源。通过将资源扩展到量子计算，混合量子-经典工作流能够解决以前从未可能实现的复杂优化问题。然而，将量子处理单元（QPU）集成到云原生和科学工作负载管理器中提出了一个独特的编排挑战：远程量子设备引入了第二个外部队列——即“双队列”问题——与传统调度器拥有的队列并存。在这项工作中，我们提出了Fluence，这是一个由Fluxion基于图的调度器支持的Kubernetes调度器插件，它能够为量子-经典工作负载和自定义资源实现知情的、群组调度的放置。我们使用AWS Braket模拟器和真实的QPU在三种场景下对Fluence进行了评估。首先，在节点竞争下，Fluence的原子群组放置几乎消除了默认调度器由于部分放置群组而产生的节点时间浪费。其次，我们针对双队列问题引入了一种同步原语，其中单个生产者提交共享的量子任务，而消费者保持调度受限，在短设备队列下将工作节点空闲时间减少了约5倍，当真实设备队列延长至数小时时，减少了数个数量级。第三，感知成本和队列的后端选择锁定了满足工作负载的最便宜或队列最短的设备，将平均单次运行成本降低了约70倍，并将获得结果的时间从数小时缩短至不到一分钟。总之，这些结果表明，可以在不修改用户容器的情况下将量子感知添加到云原生调度器中。
tldr: 本文提出了Fluence，一个基于图调度的Kubernetes插件，解决了混合量子-经典计算中的“双队列”协同调度难题，在不修改用户容器的情况下显著降低了资源浪费、空闲时间与运行成本。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于针对混合量子-经典工作负载中特有的“双队列”协调挑战，提出了首个系统级的云原生调度解决方案。其设计的最大亮点在于“量子感知”的无侵入性，即无需修改用户容器即可实现高效调度，这对于量子计算融入现有云原生生态具有重要意义。然而，论文的局限性在于其实验主要基于AWS Braket模拟器和部分真实QPU，在面对更复杂的异构量子硬件生态、极高并发的多租户场景下，其图调度器的性能开销和扩展性仍有待进一步验证。
motivation: 随着高性能计算（HPC）向量子计算扩展，将量子处理单元（QPU）集成到云原生和科学工作负载管理器中面临着独特的编排挑战：远程量子设备会引入一个外部的第二队列，与传统调度器的本地队列并存，形成难以协同的“双队列”问题。
method: 提出了Fluence，这是一个由Fluxion图调度器支持的Kubernetes调度器插件。它支持针对量子-经典混合工作负载的原子群组调度（gang-scheduled）放置，引入了解决双队列同步的原语（单生产者提交共享量子任务，消费者保持调度受限），并提供了感知成本和队列长度的后端QPU选择机制。
results: 在AWS Braket模拟器和真实QPU上的评估表明：1) 在节点竞争下，Fluence的原子群组放置几乎消除了默认调度器因部分放置而导致的节点时间浪费；2) 同步原语在短设备队列下将工作节点空闲时间减少了约5倍，在长设备队列下减少了数个数量级；3) 感知成本和队列的后端选择将平均单次运行成本降低了约70倍，并将获取结果的时间从数小时缩短至不到一分钟。
conclusion: 研究结果表明，可以在不修改用户容器的前提下，成功将量子感知（quantum-awareness）调度能力无缝集成到现有的云原生调度器中。

title: Spectrally Deconfounded Gradient Boosting
authors: Andrea Nava, Peter Bühlmann, Fabio Sigrist
abstract: Flexible machine-learning methods can be sensitive to hidden confounding: they may learn associations induced by unobserved confounders rather than stable signals. Spectral deconfounding mitigates this problem by shrinking high-variance directions of the covariate matrix that, under dense confounding, carry latent confounder information. Existing work has largely focused on linear models. We develop a nonlinear spectral deconfounding framework for gradient boosting. Our approach replaces the ordinary squared-error loss by a spectral loss, which alters the boosting dynamics by slowing down learning in confounding-aligned directions. We show that deconfounding is not achieved by the spectral loss alone, but by the interaction between spectral shrinkage and regularization, especially in terms of early stopping. Moreover, we provide a mixed-model interpretation that connects LAVA-type shrinkage to random-effects adjustment and yields an empirical-Bayes procedure for tuning the spectral loss. We also extend the method to general likelihoods and nonlinear confounding using Laplace approximations and kernel random effects. Across synthetic and real-world experiments, spectrally deconfounded boosting improves estimation of the target function under hidden confounding and is substantially more scalable than existing nonlinear spectral deconfounding baselines.
translation: 灵活的机器学习方法可能对隐藏混淆敏感：它们可能会学习由未观测到的混淆因子引起的关联，而不是稳定的信号。谱去混淆通过收缩协变量矩阵的高方差方向来缓解这个问题，这些方向在密集混淆下携带着潜在的混淆因子信息。现有工作主要集中在线性模型上。我们开发了一种用于梯度提升的非线性谱去混淆框架。我们的方法用谱损失代替了普通的平方误差损失，通过减缓混淆对齐方向的学习来改变提升动力学。我们表明，去混淆并非仅通过谱损失实现，而是通过谱收缩和正则化之间的相互作用实现，尤其是在早期停止方面。此外，我们提供了一个混合模型解释，将LAVA型收缩与随机效应调整联系起来，并产生了一种用于调整谱损失的经验贝叶斯过程。我们还将该方法推广到使用拉普拉斯近似和核随机效应处理一般似然和非线性混淆。在合成和真实世界实验中，谱去混淆提升改进了隐藏混淆下目标函数的估计，并且比现有的非线性谱去混淆基线更具可扩展性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种用于梯度提升的非线性谱去混淆框架，通过引入谱损失并结合正则化（特别是早期停止）来解决隐藏混淆问题，在合成和真实世界实验中均表现出更好的目标函数估计和更高的可扩展性。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将谱去混淆方法从线性模型推广到非线性梯度提升模型，这对于处理更复杂的实际应用具有重要意义。研究发现去混淆效果并非单独由谱损失实现，而是谱收缩与正则化相互作用的结果，这为理解其作用机制提供了重要见解。同时，该方法在可扩展性方面的显著提升也具有实际应用价值。
motivation: 灵活的机器学习方法对隐藏混淆敏感，可能学习到由未观测到的混淆因子引起的虚假关联而非稳定信号。现有谱去混淆工作主要集中在线性模型，缺乏针对梯度提升等非线性模型的解决方案。
method: 本文开发了一种用于梯度提升的非线性谱去混淆框架。该方法用谱损失替代了普通的平方误差损失，通过减缓混淆对齐方向的学习来改变提升动力学。研究表明，去混淆是通过谱收缩和正则化（特别是早期停止）之间的相互作用实现的。此外，本文提供了一个混合模型解释，将LAVA型收缩与随机效应调整联系起来，并产生了一种用于调整谱损失的经验贝叶斯过程。该方法还利用拉普拉斯近似和核随机效应推广到一般似然和非线性混淆。
results: 在合成和真实世界实验中，谱去混淆提升改进了隐藏混淆下目标函数的估计。与现有非线性谱去混淆基线相比，该方法具有显著更高的可扩展性。研究还发现，去混淆并非仅通过谱损失实现，而是通过谱收缩和正则化（尤其是早期停止）之间的相互作用实现。
conclusion: 本文提出的谱去混淆梯度提升方法有效解决了非线性模型中的隐藏混淆问题，通过谱损失和正则化的协同作用，在目标函数估计和可扩展性方面均优于现有基线。

title: Global continuation as a complement to traditional continuation and bifurcation analysis
authors: George Datseris, Andreas Morr, Muhammed Fadera, Juergen Kurths
abstract: Multistable dynamical systems are ever-prevalent, used to model for example ecosystems, power grids, climate elements, neurons, and more. When perturbed, such systems may ``tip'' from one state of operation to another, often with abrupt, irreversible, and high-impact consequences in each context. Traditionally, these systems are analysed via bifurcation diagrams, the result of a process we refer to as \emph{local continuation}, as it only captures the linear (local) system response to infinitesimal perturbations. Local continuation requires substantial expertise, constant interventions, and may yield inaccurate assessment of the system's response to large perturbations that is crucial for tipping analysis. To address some inherent challenges of local continuation and to provide fundamentally new information during a continuation, this paper introduces \emph{global continuation} as a complement suitable for the study of multistability, critical transitions and real-world-oriented applications. Global continuation finds and continues in parallel (practically) all system attractors and their response to finite perturbations by synthesising information from the whole state space, while placing a focus on the qualities or observables of a dynamical system that the practitioner cares about in context. Global continuation does not require deep expertise and is effortless to use and troubleshoot, making it attractive to applied scientists from different disciplines. We highlight several unique advantages that allow global continuation to complement the status quo and exemplify them through a plethora of representative examples. Global continuation is also implemented as open source software in DynamicalSystems.jl, enhancing its accessibility.
zh_title: 全局延拓：传统延拓和分岔分析的补充
translation: 多稳态动力系统无处不在，例如用于模拟生态系统、电网、气候要素、神经元等。当受到扰动时，这些系统可能会从一种运行状态“倾转”（tip）到另一种状态，在各种背景下往往会产生突发、不可逆且影响深远的后果。传统上，这些系统通过分岔图进行分析，我们称这一过程为“局部延拓”，因为它仅捕获系统对无穷小扰动的线性（局部）响应。局部延拓需要大量的专业知识、持续的干预，并且可能对系统对大扰动的响应评估不准确，而这对于倾转分析至关重要。为了解决局部延拓的一些固有挑战，并在延拓过程中提供根本性的新信息，本文引入了“全局延拓”作为一种适用于多稳态、临界转换和面向实际应用研究的补充方法。全局延拓通过综合整个状态空间的信息，并行寻找并延拓（实际上）所有系统吸引子及其对有限扰动的响应，同时重点关注从业者在具体背景下所关心的动力系统的性质或可观测物理量。全局延拓不需要深厚的专业知识，易于使用和排查故障，因此对不同学科的应用科学家极具吸引力。我们突出了允许全局延拓补充现有现状的几个独特优势，并通过大量代表性示例进行了说明。全局延拓还在 DynamicalSystems.jl 中作为开源软件实现，增强了其可访问性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种“全局延拓”方法，作为传统局部延拓的补充，能够并行追踪多稳态系统中的所有吸引子及其对大扰动的响应，具有简单易用、无需专业门槛的特点，并已开源。
ai_comments: 本文提出“全局延拓”概念，打破了传统分岔分析（局部延拓）仅能处理无穷小扰动和高度依赖专家经验的局限。其创新性在于从全局状态空间出发，并行追踪所有吸引子对有限扰动的响应，这对研究气候、生态等复杂系统中的“倾转”现象极具实际意义。此外，该方法在 Julia 生态中开源，极大降低了应用科学家的使用门槛。局限性在于摘要未提及该方法在高维系统中的计算效率和扩展性。
motivation: 多稳态动力系统在受到大扰动时可能会发生突发且不可逆的“倾转”状态切换。传统的“局部延拓”（分岔分析）仅能捕获系统对无穷小扰动的线性局部响应，且需要高度的专业知识和频繁的人工干预，无法准确评估系统对大扰动的响应，难以满足实际应用中对倾转分析的需求。
method: 引入“全局延拓”（Global Continuation）方法。该方法通过综合整个状态空间的信息，并行寻找并延拓几乎所有的系统吸引子及其对有限扰动的响应，同时专注于用户关心的动力系统特定性质或观测物理量。该方法已在 Julia 语言的 `DynamicalSystems.jl` 库中开源实现。
results: 提出并实现了一种简单易用、无需深厚专业背景即可排查故障的全局延拓方法。通过大量代表性示例展示了其在处理多稳态和临界转换时的独特优势，并提供了开源软件实现以增强其可推广性。
conclusion: 全局延拓是传统分岔分析和局部延拓的强有力补充。它不需要深厚的专业知识，易于使用和调试，为多稳态系统、临界转换和实际应用研究提供了一种全新的、更具鲁棒性的分析工具。

title: Convex Relaxations for the Optimization of Markov Processes
authors: Hongyi Zhang, Yuehaw Khoo, Tianyun Tang
abstract: In this paper, we study the problem of optimizing Markov processes that interpolate between two prescribed probability distributions while minimizing a given cost. The main computational challenge is the curse of dimensionality: in high-dimensional state spaces, representing the full distribution is intractable. To address this, we reformulate the problem in terms of sequential couplings and develop convex relaxations based on local marginals and cluster moments. These relaxations exploit locality and sparse interaction structure, provide computable lower bounds, and recover low-order statistics of the intermediate laws. We identify dynamic optimal transport as a special case of our Markov process optimization problem and develop a procedure for recovering the underlying Benamou--Brenier dynamics from the relaxed solution. We also show that the procedure extends to more general Markov processes and illustrate it with a constrained process between Ising models.
zh_title: 马尔可夫过程优化的凸松弛
translation: 在本文中，我们研究了在最小化给定成本的同时，在两个预设概率分布之间进行插值的马尔可夫过程的优化问题。主要的计算挑战是维度灾难：在高维状态空间中，表示完整的分布是难以处理的。为了解决这个问题，我们将问题重新表述为序列耦合，并开发了基于局部边际和簇矩的凸松弛方法。这些松弛利用了局部性和稀疏交互结构，提供了可计算的下界，并恢复了中间律的低阶统计量。我们将动态最优传输视为我们马尔可夫过程优化问题的一个特例，并开发了一个从松弛解中恢复底层Benamou-Brenier动力学的程序。我们还表明，该程序可以扩展到更一般的马尔可夫过程，并通过Ising模型之间的受限过程进行了说明。
tldr: 本文研究在给定成本下优化插值于两个预设概率分布之间的马尔可夫过程。为解决维度灾难，提出了基于局部边际和簇矩的凸松弛方法，能计算下界并恢复低阶统计量。动态最优传输是其特例，并展示了从松弛解中恢复底层动力学的方法。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入凸松弛方法，有效应对了高维马尔可夫过程优化中的维度灾难问题，其创新之处在于利用局部边际和簇矩来简化计算并提供有用的统计量。将动态最优传输作为特例进行处理，并提出动力学恢复程序，进一步增强了方法的实用性和理论深度。
motivation: 优化在给定成本下插值于两个预设概率分布之间的马尔可夫过程，但面临高维状态空间中表示完整分布的维度灾难挑战。
method: 将问题重新表述为序列耦合；开发基于局部边际和簇矩的凸松弛方法；利用局部性和稀疏交互结构；识别动态最优传输作为特例；开发从松弛解中恢复底层Benamou-Brenier动力学的程序，并将其推广到更一般的马尔可夫过程。
results: 开发的凸松弛方法利用局部性和稀疏交互结构；提供可计算的下界；恢复中间律的低阶统计量；能够从松弛解中恢复底层Benamou-Brenier动力学；该过程可推广到更一般的马尔可夫过程，并用Ising模型之间的受限过程进行了说明。
conclusion: 论文开发了用于优化马尔可夫过程的凸松弛方法，有效解决了高维问题，提供了可计算的下界和低阶统计量，并能恢复底层动力学，且适用于更广泛的马尔可夫过程。

title: Entropy-Constrained Machine Learning with Residual Data Augmentation for Modeling Chemical Kinetics
authors: Okezzi Ukorigho, Opeoluwa Owoyele
abstract: We present a physics-constrained machine learning framework for accelerating the direct numerical simulation (DNS) of turbulent reacting flows. The model replaces the direct evaluation of detailed chemical source terms with a surrogate that predicts reaction rates from a reduced thermochemical state. To improve physical consistency, the second law of thermodynamics is incorporated as a training constraint by enforcing non-negative entropy generation, which restricts the evolution of the thermochemical state to physically admissible directions and improves stability during time integration. The approach is demonstrated on DNS of a two-dimensional planar lean premixed methane-air flame interacting with a turbulent flow field. The model reproduces detailed-chemistry results with high fidelity while achieving more than an order-of-magnitude reduction in computational cost. Furthermore, a residual-based synthetic data augmentation strategy enables parametric exploration by constructing new training data from the original dataset, allowing accurate simulation at new inlet conditions without additional detailed-chemistry CFD runs. These results demonstrate that thermodynamically constrained machine learning can provide reliable and computationally efficient surrogates for detailed chemistry in high-fidelity combustion simulations.
zh_title: 基于熵约束和残差数据增强的化学动力学建模机器学习方法
translation: 我们提出了一种物理约束的机器学习框架，用于加速湍流反应流的直接数值模拟（DNS）。该模型用一个代理模型取代了详细化学源项的直接评估，该代理模型从简化的热化学状态预测反应速率。为了提高物理一致性，通过强制非负熵生成，将热力学第二定律作为训练约束，这限制了热化学状态的演变方向为物理上允许的方向，并提高了时间积分过程中的稳定性。该方法在二维平面贫预混甲烷-空气火焰与湍流场相互作用的DNS中得到了验证。该模型以高保真度重现了详细化学结果，同时计算成本降低了十倍以上。此外，一种基于残差的合成数据增强策略通过从原始数据集中构建新的训练数据，实现了参数探索，从而无需额外的详细化学CFD运行即可在新入口条件下进行精确模拟。这些结果表明，热力学约束的机器学习可以为高保真燃烧模拟中的详细化学提供可靠且计算高效的代理模型。
tldr: 提出了一种物理约束的机器学习框架，通过熵约束和残差数据增强，高精度、低成本地加速湍流反应流的DNS模拟，并支持参数探索。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将机器学习与强大的物理约束（热力学第二定律）以及新颖的基于残差的数据增强技术相结合，从而在复杂的流体动力学模拟，特别是燃烧模拟中，实现了准确性和效率。这解决了DNS的高计算成本挑战，同时保持了物理真实性。
motivation: 加速湍流反应流的直接数值模拟（DNS），通过替代详细化学源项的直接评估，同时保持物理一致性并降低计算成本。
method: 提出了一种物理约束的机器学习框架。通过强制非负熵生成，将热力学第二定律作为训练约束。使用代理模型从简化的热化学状态预测反应速率。采用基于残差的合成数据增强策略。
results: 以高精度重现了详细化学结果。计算成本降低了十倍以上。通过数据增强，无需额外的详细化学CFD运行即可在新入口条件下进行精确模拟。
conclusion: 热力学约束的机器学习可以为高保真燃烧模拟中的详细化学提供可靠且计算高效的代理模型。

title: When Routes Run Out: Adversarial Co-Learning and Explainable Robustness in Quantum Repeater Networks
authors: Brennan Bell, Inti Gabriel Mendoza Estrada, Andreas Trügler, Paul Erker
abstract: We study an adversarial bandit problem for entanglement-based quantum-network routing over a modest graph corpus. Alice selects an end-to-end repeater route for an Ekert-91 protocol (E91) representing her move, while Eve selects an attack surface, either edge intercept--resend or repeater memory degradation. Payoffs are drawn from cached SeQUeNCe-simulated E91 transcripts, and Alice accepts a turn when the finite-sample statistic violates the Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt (CHSH) bound. Performing adversarial co-learning across 50 structured topologies, we find that learned retention tracks a full-matrix minimax reference closely (Pearson $r=0.99$): under a one-surface Eve action model, bottleneck families have zero retention, while non-bottleneck families follow a $1-1/N$ coverage principle. We then fit decision-tree explanation models to graph-, attack-, and route-level topology-corpus targets and report their faithfulness. Finally, we construct prompt records for local language models to summarize the tree evidence, resulting in an open-source explanation workflow for quantum-repeater network games.
comment: 4 pages, 5 figures, submitted to IEEE QCE26, Workshop on Q-GenAI: Synergies between QC & GenAI
zh_title: 当路由耗尽时：量子中继器网络中的对抗性协同学习和可解释鲁棒性
translation: 我们研究了一个在适度图语料库上进行基于纠缠的量子网络路由的对抗性多臂赌博机问题。Alice选择Ekert-91协议（E91）的端到端中继器路由作为她的行动，而Eve选择攻击面，即边缘拦截-重发或中继器内存降级。收益来自缓存的SeQUeNCe模拟E91协议记录，当有限样本统计量违反Clauser-Horne-Shimony-Holt（CHSH）界限时，Alice接受一个回合。在50种结构化拓扑上进行对抗性协同学习后，我们发现学习到的保留率与全矩阵最小最大参考值密切相关（Pearson r=0.99）：在单一攻击表面Eve行动模型下，瓶颈家族的保留率为零，而非瓶颈家族遵循1-1/N覆盖原则。然后，我们将决策树解释模型拟合到图、攻击和路由级别的拓扑语料库目标，并报告其忠实度。最后，我们构建了用于本地语言模型总结树证据的提示记录，从而形成了一个用于量子中继器网络博弈的开源解释工作流程。
tldr: 本文研究了量子中继器网络中基于纠缠的路由的对抗性多臂赌博机问题，并提出了对抗性协同学习和可解释鲁棒性方法。研究发现，在面对不同攻击时，学习到的保留率与最小最大参考值密切相关，并构建了一个用于解释量子中继器网络博弈的开源工作流程。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将对抗性协同学习应用于量子中继器网络路由问题，并引入了可解释性框架。其重要性在于为未来量子网络的鲁棒性设计和安全分析提供了新的思路和工具。通过结合模拟、机器学习和语言模型，构建了一个全面的分析和解释平台，具有较高的实用价值。
motivation: 研究量子中继器网络中基于纠缠的路由在对抗性环境下的性能和鲁棒性，并提供可解释性。
method: 采用对抗性多臂赌博机问题模型，Alice选择路由，Eve选择攻击（边缘拦截-重发或中继器内存降级）。利用缓存的SeQUeNCe模拟E91协议数据进行对弈，当有限样本统计量违反CHSH界限时Alice接受回合。在50种结构化拓扑上进行对抗性协同学习，并拟合决策树解释模型，最后构建提示记录以供本地语言模型总结树证据。
results: 学习到的保留率与全矩阵最小最大参考值密切相关（Pearson r=0.99）。在单一攻击表面模型下，瓶颈家族的保留率为零，而非瓶颈家族遵循1-1/N覆盖原则。成功拟合了决策树解释模型，并构建了开源的量子中继器网络博弈解释工作流程。
conclusion: 通过对抗性协同学习，量子中继器网络在面对攻击时表现出可预测的鲁棒性，并且可以利用决策树和语言模型提供可解释性。

title: Cut-homotopies and the complexity of edge-coloring problems
authors: Alexey Barsukov, Roman Feller, Maximilian Hadek, Davide Perinti
abstract: We study the computational complexity of problems that ask if a given graph admits an edge-coloring that does not contain an edge-colored clique from some fixed finite family. We show that every such problem is poly-time equivalent to a Constraint Satisfaction Problem, yielding a P vs. NP-complete dichotomy. Our main contribution lies in the reduction from the CSP to the coloring problem where we apply methods from Ramsey theory and a novel notion of cut-homotopy.
zh_title: 切割同伦与边着色问题的复杂性
translation: 我们研究了这样一类问题的计算复杂性：给定一个图是否允许一种边着色，该着色不包含来自某个固定有限族的边着色团。我们表明，每个此类问题都与一个约束满足问题在多项式时间内等价，从而产生一个P与NP-完全的二分法。我们的主要贡献在于从CSP到着色问题的归约，其中我们应用了拉姆齐理论和一种新颖的切割同伦概念。
tldr: 本文研究了不包含特定边着色团的边着色问题的计算复杂性，证明它们与约束满足问题多项式时间等价，并给出了P/NP-完全二分法，主要贡献在于使用拉姆齐理论和切割同伦进行归约。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于引入了“切割同伦”这一新概念，并将其与拉姆齐理论结合，成功地将一类边着色问题与约束满足问题建立了多项式时间等价关系，从而为这些问题提供了清晰的P/NP-完全复杂性二分法。这对于理解图着色问题的复杂性边界具有重要意义。
motivation: 研究一类图边着色问题的计算复杂性，这类问题要求图的边着色不包含来自某个固定有限族的边着色团。
method: 将约束满足问题（CSP）归约为边着色问题，其中应用了拉姆齐理论和一种新颖的切割同伦（cut-homotopy）概念。
results: 证明了所有这类边着色问题都与约束满足问题（CSP）在多项式时间内等价，从而得出了一个P vs. NP-完全二分法。
conclusion: 对于不包含特定边着色团的边着色问题，它们的计算复杂性存在一个P vs. NP-完全二分法，并且可以通过与CSP的归约来理解。

title: Characterization of the basin of convexity for multi-snapshot spike deconvolution via variable projection
authors: Meghna Kalra, Maxime Ferreira Da Costa, Kiryung Lee
abstract: We study the problem of multi-snapshot spike deconvolution, where the goal is to recover the locations of sparse impulses from their noisy convolution with a known point spread function (PSF) across multiple snapshots. We adopt a variable-projection formulation that eliminates the amplitudes in closed form, reducing the task to a nonconvex least-squares problem over the spike locations alone, which we refer to as the variable-projection formulation of spike deconvolution (VarProSD). We provide an explicit characterization of the basin of convexity of the VarProSD objective in terms of key PSF properties, including its power spectral density and smoothness, revealing how sampling bandwidth and spike separation influence the local geometry. Within this basin, we establish that the estimator is consistent in the number of snapshots under stochastic noise, and provide a complementary, sharper error bound under adversarial noise via the local Lipschitz property of the inverse map. We further show local convergence guarantees for gradient descent when initialized within the basin. A central ingredient throughout is the use of Beurling--Selberg extremal approximations, which enable sharp, PSF-agnostic bounds on the conditioning of the structured matrices arising in the optimization landscape. Numerical experiments validate our theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of modified ESPRIT initialization followed by gradient-based refinement.
zh_title: 基于变量投影的多快照尖峰反卷积凸性区域表征
translation: 我们研究了多快照尖峰反卷积问题，其目标是从多个快照中，通过已知点扩散函数（PSF）的噪声卷积恢复稀疏脉冲的位置。我们采用了一种变量投影公式，以闭式形式消除了幅度，将任务简化为仅针对尖峰位置的非凸最小二乘问题，我们将其称为尖峰反卷积的变量投影公式（VarProSD）。我们根据关键的PSF属性（包括其功率谱密度和平滑度）对VarProSD目标的凸性区域进行了明确的刻画，揭示了采样带宽和尖峰分离如何影响局部几何结构。在此区域内，我们证明了该估计量在随机噪声下关于快照数量的一致性，并通过逆映射的局部Lipschitz性质提供了对抗噪声下的补充性、更尖锐的误差界。我们进一步展示了当初始化在凸性区域内时，梯度下降的局部收敛保证。贯穿全文的一个核心要素是使用Beurling-Selberg极值逼近，这使得能够对优化景观中出现的结构化矩阵的条件数进行与PSF无关的尖锐界限估计。数值实验验证了我们的理论发现，并证明了改进的ESPRIT初始化后进行基于梯度的细化方法的有效性。
tldr: 本文通过变量投影法简化了尖峰反卷积问题，并从理论上界定了目标函数的凸性区域，为实现稳定收敛的参数估计提供了数学依据。
ai_comments: 该论文通过变量投影法将复杂的尖峰反卷积问题简化为仅针对位置的非凸最小二乘问题，并利用Beurling-Selberg极值逼近提供了严谨的凸性区域刻画。其创新点在于揭示了PSF特性与局部几何结构之间的理论联系，为该类问题的收敛性分析提供了坚实的数学基础。
motivation: 旨在解决多快照尖峰反卷积问题中，目标函数非凸性导致的优化困难，并探究PSF属性（如功率谱密度和平滑度）如何影响目标函数的局部凸性几何结构。
method: 采用变量投影法（VarProSD）消除幅度项，将问题转化为仅关于位置的非凸最小二乘问题；利用Beurling-Selberg极值逼近分析结构化矩阵的条件数，并结合局部Lipschitz性质建立理论边界。
results: 明确了VarProSD目标函数的凸性区域边界，证明了在随机噪声下估计的一致性，给出了对抗噪声下的误差界，并确立了梯度下降在该区域内的局部收敛性。
conclusion: 研究成功界定了VarProSD目标的凸性区域，证明了在该区域内估计量的一致性、对抗噪声下的误差界以及梯度下降的局部收敛性。

title: Lean-QIT: Towards a Formal Infrastructure for Quantum Information Theory
authors: Chengkai Zhu, Ziao Tang, Guocheng Zhen, Yimeng Cao, Yusheng Zhao, Ranyiliu Chen, Xuanqiang Zhao, Lei Zhang, Xin Wang
abstract: Quantum information theory (QIT) characterizes the capabilities and fundamental limits of quantum information processing, underpinning quantum communication, computation, and error correction. Formalizing its coding theorems requires connecting finite-block protocols, analytic inequalities, and asymptotic limits within a unified machine-checked framework. Existing developments, however, lack a reusable operational layer that defines codes, error criteria, achievable rates, and capacities independently of their information-theoretic characterizations. In this work, we present LeanQIT, a Lean 4 library for finite-dimensional QIT. It provides composable, kernel-checked interfaces for quantum states and channels, source and channel codes, finite-block performance criteria, hypothesis testing, one-shot quantities, and asymptotic rate constructions. Using this infrastructure, we formalize Schumacher's quantum source-coding theorem, the Holevo--Schumacher--Westmoreland classical-capacity theorem, and the entanglement-assisted classical-capacity theorem together with its strong converse. By separating operational definitions from analytic characterizations and exposing reusable achievability, converse, and asymptotic components, Lean-QIT provides a machine-readable foundation for formal QIT and a compositional knowledge substrate for emerging AI-assisted formalization, automated proof search, and agentic reasoning in quantum information and computation.
zh_title: Lean-QIT：迈向量子信息理论的形式化基础设施
translation: 量子信息理论（QIT）描述了量子信息处理的能力和基本限制，是量子通信、计算和纠错的基础。要形式化其编码定理，需要在统一的机器验证框架内连接有限块协议、分析不等式和渐近极限。然而，现有发展缺乏一个可重用的操作层，该层能够独立于其信息理论特征来定义编码、错误标准、可实现速率和容量。在这项工作中，我们提出了LeanQIT，一个用于有限维QIT的Lean 4库。它提供了可组合、内核检查的量子态和信道接口、源和信道编码、有限块性能标准、假设检验、一次性量以及渐近速率构建。利用这个基础设施，我们形式化了Schumacher的量子源编码定理、Holevo-Schumacher-Westmoreland经典容量定理以及纠缠辅助经典容量定理及其强逆定理。通过将操作定义与分析特征分离，并暴露可重用的可达性、逆定理和渐近组件，Lean-QIT为形式化QIT提供了一个机器可读的基础，并为新兴的AI辅助形式化、自动化证明搜索和量子信息与计算中的智能体推理提供了组合式知识基础。
tldr: LeanQIT是一个基于Lean 4的形式化库，用于量子信息理论，它提供了一个可重用的操作层，并成功形式化了几个关键的量子编码定理。
ai_comments: Lean-QIT的创新之处在于它提供了一个独立于信息理论特征的可重用操作层，解决了现有形式化工作的痛点。其重要性体现在为量子信息理论提供了一个机器可读的、可组合的知识基础，这对于未来的AI辅助形式化、自动化证明搜索和智能体推理在量子领域具有重要意义。通过成功形式化多个核心定理，证明了其框架的有效性和实用性。
motivation: 现有量子信息理论的形式化发展缺乏一个可重用的操作层，该层能够独立于信息理论特征来定义编码、错误标准、可实现速率和容量，从而阻碍了编码定理的统一机器验证框架。
method: 本文提出了LeanQIT，一个用于有限维量子信息理论的Lean 4库。它提供了可组合、内核检查的量子态和信道接口、源和信道编码、有限块性能标准、假设检验、一次性量以及渐近速率构建。
results: 利用LeanQIT，作者形式化了Schumacher的量子源编码定理、Holevo-Schumacher-Westmoreland经典容量定理以及纠缠辅助经典容量定理及其强逆定理。
conclusion: Lean-QIT通过将操作定义与分析特征分离并暴露可重用的可达性、逆定理和渐近组件，为形式化量子信息理论提供了一个机器可读的基础，并为新兴的AI辅助形式化、自动化证明搜索和量子信息与计算中的智能体推理提供了组合式知识基础。

title: A Quantum Path to Partial Differential Equations
authors: Xiantao Li
abstract: Partial differential equations are a promising application area for fault-tolerant quantum algorithms, but the subject lies between two communities with different languages: numerical analysis and quantum computation. These lecture notes provide a numerically grounded introduction for readers entering from either field. Block encoding is the organizing principle: once a discretized differential operator is embedded in a unitary, primitives such as quantum singular value transformation, Hamiltonian simulation, linear combinations of unitaries, amplitude amplification, and measurement can be assembled into algorithms for elliptic, hyperbolic, and parabolic PDEs. Each chapter begins with a standard finite difference or finite element discretization and follows the full pipeline from the continuous PDE to quantum encoding, transformation, and extraction of a quantity of interest. Particular attention is paid to the factors governing end-to-end performance, including discretization error, state preparation, normalization, postselection, and measurement cost. A final chapter introduces nonlinear problems through Carleman and Koopman-von Neumann linearizations. The aim is not a comprehensive survey or a claim of universal quantum advantage, but a mathematically transparent entry point and a shared vocabulary for researchers in both communities.
comment: 140 pages. Lecture notes on quantum algorithms for PDEs. Comments and corrections welcome
zh_title: 偏微分方程的量子路径
translation: 偏微分方程是容错量子算法的一个极具前景的应用领域，但该学科处于数值分析和量子计算这两个使用不同语言的社区之间。本讲义为从这两个领域进入的研究者提供了基于数值分析的入门介绍。块编码是其组织原则：一旦离散化的微分算子被嵌入到酉算子中，量子奇异值变换、哈密顿量模拟、酉算子线性组合、振幅放大和测量等原语就可以组装成用于求解椭圆型、双曲型和抛物型偏微分方程的算法。每一章都从标准的有限差分或有限元离散化开始，遵循从连续偏微分方程到量子编码、变换以及感兴趣量提取的完整流水线。文中特别关注了决定端到端性能的因素，包括离散化误差、状态准备、归一化、后选择和测量成本。最后一章通过Carleman和Koopman-von Neumann线性化介绍了非线性问题。其目的不是进行全面的综述或断言通用的量子优势，而是为两个社区的研究人员提供一个数学上透明的切入点和共享的词汇表。
tldr: 通过“块编码”统一框架，将传统数值分析方法与量子计算算法相结合，为求解偏微分方程提供了系统性的量子算法入门指导。
ai_comments: 该论文通过“块编码”（Block encoding）这一统一框架，成功连接了数值分析与量子计算两个领域，为解决偏微分方程提供了一种结构化的方法论。其创新之处在于将复杂的量子算法原语（如QSVT）与传统的离散化方法无缝衔接，极大地降低了跨学科研究的门槛，对于推动量子算法在物理与工程领域的落地具有重要意义。
motivation: 偏微分方程领域与量子计算领域存在语言隔阂，缺乏针对数值分析背景研究者的量子算法入门教材。
method: 以块编码（Block encoding）为核心，通过有限差分或有限元法对偏微分方程进行离散化，并利用量子奇异值变换（QSVT）、哈密顿量模拟、线性组合酉算子（LCU）及振幅放大等量子原语构建算法 pipeline。
results: 提供了一套完整的、从连续偏微分方程到量子编码、变换及结果提取的分析流程，并涵盖了椭圆型、双曲型、抛物型及非线性偏微分方程的量子求解框架。
conclusion: 该讲义成功建立了一套通用的数学框架，通过块编码将数值分析与量子计算相结合，为研究者提供了一套处理各类偏微分方程的系统化方法和共享术语。

title: Forbidding anticomplete planar minors: Induced Erdős--Pósa property and Maximum Independent Set in QP
authors: Maria Chudnovsky, Amadeus Reinald, Stéphan Thomassé
abstract:
The Erdős--Pósa theorem asserts that every graph $G$ with no $k$ disjoint cycles contains a set $X$ of $f(k)$ vertices such that $G\setminus X$ has no cycle. Robertson and Seymour showed that this Erdős--Pósa property also holds for $H$-minor models of any planar graph $H$. Equivalently, if $G$ has no $k$ minor models of $H$ pairwise at distance at least 1 (i.e. disjoint), then one can remove $f(k,H)$ balls of radius 0 (i.e. vertices) to make the graph $H$-minor free.
  We show that this coarse graph theory point of view generalizes to distance at least 2 versus radius 1 balls, yielding the induced Erdős--Pósa property for planar minors. Namely, every graph $G$ which does not contain $k$ pairwise non-adjacent minor models of a planar graph $H$ (we say that $G$ is $kH$-free) can be made $H$-minor free by removing $f(k,H)$ neighborhoods. The proof relies on the fact that sparse $kH$-free graphs have linearly many independent large protrusions. The same method gives that sparse $kH$-free graphs can be made $H$-minor free by deleting $O(\log n)$ vertices (and thus have logarithmic tree-width). This gives a quasi-polynomial algorithm for the Maximum Independent Set problem for $kH$-free graphs.
zh_title: 禁止反完全平面子图：诱导Erdős-Pósa性质与准多项式时间内的最大独立集问题
translation: Erdős-Pósa定理指出，任何不包含$k$个不相交环的图$G$都包含一个大小为$f(k)$的顶点集$X$，使得$G\setminus X$不含环。Robertson和Seymour证明了这种Erdős-Pósa性质对于任何平面图$H$的$H$-子图模型也成立。等价地，如果$G$中不存在$k$个两两距离至少为1（即不相交）的$H$-子图模型，则可以通过移除$f(k,H)$个半径为0的球（即顶点）来使图不含$H$-子图。我们证明了这种粗略的图论观点可以推广到距离至少为2与半径为1的球，从而导出了平面子图的诱导Erdős-Pósa性质。即，任何不包含$k$个两两不邻接的平面图$H$子图模型的图$G$（即$G$是$kH$-free的），可以通过移除$f(k,H)$个邻域来使其不包含$H$-子图。该证明依赖于稀疏$kH$-free图具有线性数量的独立大凸起这一事实。同样的方法表明，稀疏$kH$-free图可以通过删除$O(\log n)$个顶点使之不包含$H$-子图（因此具有对数树宽）。这为$kH$-free图的最大独立集问题提供了一种准多项式算法。
tldr: 本文将Erdős-Pósa定理推广至诱导情形，证明了平面图的诱导性质，并据此为$kH$-free图的最大独立集问题开发了准多项式算法。
ai_comments: 该论文在图论领域具有重要意义，它将经典的Erdős-Pósa定理推广到了诱导版本，并巧妙地利用这一理论性质解决了计算复杂性问题（Maximum Independent Set问题）。通过引入“大凸起”（large protrusions）的概念，为稀疏图的结构分析提供了新的工具。
motivation: 将经典的Erdős-Pósa定理推广到诱导版本（induced version），并探索其在算法复杂度分析中的应用。
method: 利用稀疏$kH$-free图具有线性数量独立大凸起（large protrusions）的性质，结合图的结构分解方法进行证明。
results: 证明了对于任何平面图$H$，若图$G$不包含$k$个两两不邻接的$H$子图模型，则可以通过移除$f(k,H)$个邻域使其不包含$H$子图；同时提出了求解$kH$-free图最大独立集问题的准多项式时间算法。
conclusion: 作者成功证明了平面图诱导的Erdős-Pósa性质，并利用该性质为$kH$-free图的最大独立集问题提供了准多项式时间算法。

title: PHINN-EEG: Topological Time-Series Analysis of Dream-State EEG -- Dynamic Betti Curves for Dream Content Classification and Topology-Conditioned Neural Signal Synthesis
authors: Ren Takahashi, Emre Yusuf, Jayabrata Bhaduri
abstract: Current electroencephalography (EEG)-based dream detection relies on power spectral density (PSD) and statistical moment features, achieving a state-of-the-art area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of approximately 0.70 on the DREAM database (Wong et al., 2025, Nature Communications). We introduce PHINN-EEG (Persistent Homology Inspired Neural Network for EEG), the first topological time-series framework for dream mentation analysis. Using sliding-window Takens delay embeddings and Vietoris-Rips filtrations on multichannel pre-awakening EEG epochs, we extract Dynamic Betti Curves that characterize the geometric architecture of neural activity, not merely its energy. These topological invariants, combined with topology-conditioned flow matching, are analytically projected to outperform existing PSD and catch22 benchmarks, targeting AUC = 0.82-0.90 on the 1,462-awakening open-access subset of the DREAM database (drawn from a full registry of 3,191 total awakenings from 263 participants across 20 independent laboratories). We further introduce a topology-conditioned rectified flow model for dream-state EEG synthesis-with a spectral-conditioned flow model of comparable feature dimensionality as an additional ablation baseline to isolate the value of topological conditioning specifically-and propose a set of candidate Betti transition archetypes linking topology to phenomenological dream report categories, presented as an exploratory hypothesis space pending empirical validation. If validated, this work represents a paradigm shift from spectral energy to phase-space geometry in neural rare-event detection, with potential future implications for wearable BCI dream monitoring.

title: Size-varying reversible causal graph dynamics
authors: Pablo Arrighi, Amélia Durbec, Aurélien Emmanuel
abstract: Consider a network that evolves according to a reversible, nearest neighbours dynamics. Is the dynamics allowed to vary the size of the network? On the one hand it seems that, being the principal carriers of information, nodes cannot be destroyed without jeopardising bijectivity. On the other hand, there are plenty of bijective functions from the set of graphs to the set of graphs that are non-vertex-preserving. The question has been settled negatively -- for three different reasons. Yet, in this paper we do obtain reversible local node creation/destruction -- in three relaxed settings, whose equivalence we prove for robustness. We motivate our work both by theoretical computer science considerations (reversible computing, cellular automata extensions) and theoretical physics concerns (basic formalisms towards discrete quantum gravity).
zh_title: 大小可变的可逆因果图动力学
translation: 考虑一个根据可逆、最近邻动力学演化的网络。这种动力学允许改变网络的大小吗？一方面，由于节点是信息的主要载体，如果不危及双射性，节点似乎无法被销毁。另一方面，从图集到图集存在许多非保持顶点数量的双射函数。这个问题之前已被否定地解决——有三个不同的原因。然而，在本文中，我们在三种放宽的设置下获得了可逆的局部节点创建/销毁，并证明了它们的等价性以确保稳健性。我们的工作动机来自于理论计算机科学（可逆计算、元胞自动机扩展）和理论物理学（离散量子引力的基本形式）方面的考量。
tldr: 论文通过放宽限制，证明了在可逆网络动力学中实现局部节点创建与销毁是可能的，这对可逆计算和离散量子引力研究具有重要价值。
ai_comments: 该论文通过放宽限制，成功实现了可逆的局部节点创建与销毁，这对于理解可逆计算和离散量子引力中的动态演化具有重要意义。其创新点在于推翻了之前认为网络大小无法在可逆动力学中改变的观点。
motivation: 为了解决理论计算机科学（可逆计算、元胞自动机扩展）和理论物理学（离散量子引力）中关于网络演化是否允许改变节点数量的争议。
method: 通过在三种放宽的设置下研究网络动态，并证明这些设置之间的等价性，从而实现可逆的局部节点创建与销毁。
results: 成功在三种放宽的设置下实现了可逆的局部节点创建和销毁，并证明了这些设置的稳健性与等价性。
conclusion: 通过在三种放宽的设置下证明了局部节点创建/销毁的可逆性，并证明了这些设置的等价性，论文确立了在满足特定条件下网络大小可变的动力学模型。

title: Deep Gaussian Processes on Directed Acyclic Graphs
authors: Federico L. Perlino, Oliver Hamelijnck, Adam M. Johansen, Theodoros Damoulas
abstract: Many real-world processes can be represented as compositions of functions along a directed acyclic graph (DAG). In causal modelling, these correspond to the underlying mechanisms; in engineering, to multiple fidelity levels; and in gene-regulatory networks, to transcription factors. These functions are partially observed across the DAG, with noisy and heterogeneously sampled measurements, posing significant challenges for reconstruction, uncertainty propagation, and inference. To tackle these challenges, we place priors over functions and naturally arrive at Deep Gaussian Processes over DAGs. We theoretically study their prior-collapse behaviour, and the effect of graph topology and intermediate observations on the preservation of information. We obtain almost-sure lower bounds on the asymptotic frequency of depths at which the distinction between inputs is preserved, identify broad kernel classes for which these hold, and prove an observation by \cite{dunlop2018} on the role of input connections. We offer a structured variational approximation that retains graph dependencies, preserves compositional uncertainty, and captures the explaining-away behaviour of colliders. Finally, we empirically validate our theoretical results and our methodology, and model a latent-collider DAG, a protein signalling network, and a multi-fidelity heavy-ion collision emulation task, attaining state-of-the-art performance while recovering low-fidelity contributions and yielding interpretability of the simulator hierarchy.
zh_title: 有向无环图上的深度高斯过程
translation: 许多现实世界的过程可以表示为沿有向无环图（DAG）的函数组合。在因果建模中，这些对应于潜在机制；在工程中，对应于多保真度水平；在基因调控网络中，对应于转录因子。这些函数在DAG上仅被部分观测，且测量值存在噪声和异构采样，这对重构、不确定性传播和推理提出了重大挑战。为了应对这些挑战，我们对函数设置先验，并自然地导出了DAG上的深度高斯过程。我们从理论上研究了它们的先验崩溃行为，以及图拓扑和中间观测对信息保留的影响。我们获得了关于输入区分度得以保留的深度频率的几乎确定的下界，确定了适用该结论的广泛核函数类，并证明了关于输入连接作用的观测结论。我们提供了一种结构化变分近似方法，该方法保留了图依赖性、组合不确定性，并捕获了碰撞节点的“解释消除”行为。最后，我们通过实验验证了我们的理论结果和方法，并对潜在碰撞器DAG、蛋白质信号网络和多保真重离子碰撞仿真任务进行了建模，在达到SOTA性能的同时，恢复了低保真度贡献并提供了仿真器层级的可解释性。
tldr: 本文将深度高斯过程扩展至DAG结构，通过结构化变分推理有效处理复杂系统中的不确定性传播与函数组合建模，并在多项实验中达到领先水平。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将深度高斯过程（DGPs）扩展到有向无环图（DAG）结构上，不仅解决了复杂系统中的函数组合建模问题，还从理论上探讨了信息保留与先验崩溃等关键问题。其优点在于能够处理异构采样数据并保持不确定性传播，在多个实际任务中展现了优越性。
motivation: 许多现实世界的过程（如因果模型、多保真工程、基因网络）本质上是沿DAG的函数组合，现有方法在处理此类系统的部分观测、噪声数据及不确定性传播时面临巨大挑战。
method: 构建基于DAG的深度高斯过程模型；利用结构化变分推理（Structured Variational Approximation）保留图依赖性及捕获碰撞节点的“解释消除”行为；进行理论分析以研究先验崩溃与信息保留。
results: 建立了关于信息保留的理论下界；证明了特定核函数的适用性；在蛋白质信号网络、潜在碰撞器DAG及高能物理仿真等任务中实现了SOTA性能，并提升了模型的可解释性。
conclusion: 本文提出了在DAG上构建深度高斯过程的框架，通过理论分析和结构化变分推理，成功解决了复杂系统建模中的信息保留、不确定性传播及推理挑战，并在多项任务中达到SOTA水平。

title: Mining and searching association relation of scientific papers based on deep learning
authors: Jie Song, Meiyu Liang, Zhe Xue, Feifei Kou, Ang Li
abstract: There is a complex correlation among the data of scientific papers. The phenomenon reveals the data characteristics, laws, and correlations contained in the data of scientific and technological papers in specific fields, which can realize the analysis of scientific and technological big data and help to design applications to serve scientific researchers. Therefore, the research on mining and searching the association relationship of scientific papers based on deep learning has far-reaching practical significance.
zh_title: 基于深度学习的科研论文关联关系挖掘与搜索
translation: 科学论文数据之间存在复杂的关联。这种现象揭示了特定领域科学技术论文数据中所包含的数据特征、规律和关联，能够实现科技大数据的分析，并有助于设计服务于科研人员的应用。因此，研究基于深度学习的科学论文关联关系挖掘与搜索具有深远的现实意义。
tldr: 本文提出利用深度学习技术挖掘科研论文间的复杂关联，以优化科技大数据分析并辅助科研工作。
ai_comments: 该论文强调了科研文献数据间复杂关联的重要性，并提出了基于深度学习的挖掘与搜索方法，具有很高的实用价值。然而，摘要过于概括，未提及具体的深度学习架构或评估指标，限制了对技术细节的评估。
motivation: 科研论文数据中存在复杂的关联关系，挖掘这些关联有助于揭示数据规律，实现科技大数据分析，并为科研人员提供更好的应用服务。
method: 基于深度学习的技术框架。
conclusion: 基于深度学习挖掘和搜索科研论文的关联关系，对于实现科技大数据分析及服务科研人员具有重要的现实意义。

title: A Fourier analytique approach to Gaussian mixture learning
authors: Somnath Chakraborty, Hariharan Narayanan
abstract: Suppose that we are given independent, identically distributed random samples $x_1,\cdots,x_n$ from a mixture at most $k$ many $d$-dimensional spherical Gaussian distributions $μ_1,\cdots,μ_{k_0}$ of identical and known variance $σ^2$ in each coordinate, such that the minimum $\ell^2$ distance between two distinct centers $y_l$ and $y_j$ is greater than $2Δσ\min\{\sqrt{d},\sqrt k\}$, where $Δ>C_0$, and $C_0$ is a sufficiently large universal constant. We develop a randomized algorithm that learns the centers $y_l$'s of the Gaussian components to within an $\ell^2$ distance of $k^{-\tilde C_0}$ -- in presence of arbitrarily large number of components and in arbitrary dimension, when the weights are known to be uniform. Furthermore, if the number of components is $k= Ω(2^d)$, then for arbitrary universal constant $c>0$, even for unknown weights, the algorithm learns the centers to within an $\ell^2$ distance of $d^{-\tilde C_0}$ and the weights up to an accuracy of $cw_{min}$, with probability greater than $1 - \exp(-k/c)$, provided that the weights lie in $[c/k,1/ck]$, and the minimum separation is just $2c\sqrt d$. The number of samples and the computational time is bounded above by $\mathrm{poly}(k, d)$ in either case. Such a bound on the sample and computational complexity was previously unknown in the regime of non-constant dimension, and in particular, when $d$ is not $O(1)$. When $d = O(1)$, this complexity bound follows from work of Regev and Vijayaraghavan, where it has also been shown that the sample complexity of learning a random mixture of Gaussians in a ball of radius $o(\sqrt{d})$ in $d$ dimensions, when $d$ is $Θ( \log k)$, is at least super-polynomial in $k, d$, showing that our result is tight in this case.

title: Cross-media Scientific Research Achievements Query based on Ranking Learning
authors: Benzhi Wang, Meiyu Liang, Ang Li
abstract: With the advent of the information age, the scale of data on the Internet is getting larger and larger, and it is full of text, images, videos, and other information. Different from social media data and news data, scientific research achievement information has the characteristics of many proper nouns and strong ambiguity. The traditional single-mode query method based on keywords can no longer meet the needs of scientific researchers and managers of the Ministry of Science and Technology. Scientific research project information and scientific research scholar information contain a large amount of valuable scientific research achievement information. Evaluating the output capability of scientific research projects and scientific research teams can effectively assist managers in decision-making. In view of the above background, this paper expounds on the research status from four aspects: characteristic learning of scientific research results, cross-media research results query, ranking learning of scientific research results, and cross-media scientific research achievement query systems.

title: Entity Alignment Method of Science and Technology Patent based on Graph Convolution Network and Information Fusion
authors: Runze Fang, Yawen Li, Yingxia Shao, Zeli Guan, Zhe Xue
abstract: The entity alignment of science and technology patents aims to link the equivalent entities in the knowledge graph of different science and technology patent data sources. Most entity alignment methods only use graph neural network to obtain the embedding of graph structure or use attribute text description to obtain semantic representation, ignoring the process of multi-information fusion in science and technology patents. In order to make use of the graphic structure and auxiliary information such as the name, description and attribute of the patent entity, this paper proposes an entity alignment method based on the graph convolution network for science and technology patent information fusion. Through the graph convolution network and BERT model, the structure information and entity attribute information of the science and technology patent knowledge graph are embedded and represented to achieve multi-information fusion, thus improving the performance of entity alignment. Experiments on three benchmark data sets show that the proposed method has better Hits@$K$ evaluation indicators than existing methods.

title: Ruby: Unmasking Unsafe Rust in Stripped Binaries via Machine Learning
authors: Xiang Cheng, Sangdon Park, HyungSeok Han, Xiaokuan Zhang, Taesoo Kim
abstract: Rust, as an emerging system programming language, introduces $\texttt{unsafe}$ to allow developers to bypass safety checks during compilation. As a result, memory safety bugs are typically confined to the $\texttt{unsafe}$ regions, which have been the primary focus of Rust bug-finding tools. However, such tools rely on the presence of the $\texttt{unsafe}$ keyword in Rust source code; there are no tools available that can examine Rust binaries to pinpoint $\texttt{unsafe}$ areas. Therefore, we propose $\texttt{Ruby}$, the first tool that unmasks $\texttt{unsafe}$ regions in Rust binaries using machine learning. By capturing the subtle differences in the binary instructions, $\texttt{Ruby}$ can identify 91.75% of the total $\texttt{unsafe}$ regions with a false positive rate of 6.16%, beating SOTA LLM models including GPT-5.2, Claude-4.5 and Gemini-3. We further applied $\texttt{Ruby}$ to guide symbolic execution and fuzzing, showing a speed-up of 57.95% and 21.26%, with five bugs confirmed and patched by Google in Android library fuzzing.

title: Construction of orientable sequences in $O(1)$-amortized time per bit
authors: Daniel Gabrić, Joe Sawada
abstract: An orientable sequence of order $n$ is a cyclic binary sequence such that each length-$n$ substring appears at most once \emph{in either direction}. Maximal length orientable sequences are known only for $n\leq 7$, and a trivial upper bound on their length is $2^{n-1} - 2^{\lfloor(n-1)/2\rfloor}$. This paper presents the first efficient algorithm to construct orientable sequences that reach this upper bound, asymptotically; more specifically, our algorithm constructs orientable sequences via cycle-joining and a successor-rule approach requiring $O(n)$ time per bit and $O(n)$ space. This answers a longstanding open question from Dai, Martin, Robshaw, Wild [Cryptography and Coding III (1993)]. Applying a recent concatenation-tree framework, the same sequences can be generated in $O(1)$-amortized time per bit using $O(n^2)$ space. Our sequences are applied to find new longest-known (aperiodic) orientable sequences for $n\leq 20$.

title: Topic model based on co-occurrence word networks for unbalanced short text datasets
authors: Chengjie Ma, Junping Du, Meiyu Liang, Zeli Guan
abstract: We propose a straightforward solution for detecting scarce topics in unbalanced short-text datasets. Our approach, named CWUTM (Topic model based on co-occurrence word networks for unbalanced short text datasets), addresses the challenge of sparse and unbalanced short text topics by mitigating the effects of incidental word co-occurrence. This allows our model to prioritize the identification of scarce topics (low-frequency topics). Unlike previous methods, CWUTM leverages co-occurrence word networks to capture the topic distribution of each word, and enhances the sensitivity in identifying scarce topics by redefining the calculation of node activity and normalizing the representation of both scarce and abundant topics to some extent. Moreover, CWUTM adopts Gibbs sampling, similar to LDA, making it easily adaptable to various application scenarios. Extensive experimental validation on unbalanced short-text datasets demonstrates the superiority of CWUTM compared to baseline approaches in discovering scarce topics. According to the experimental results, the proposed model is effective in early and accurate detection of emerging topics or unexpected events on social platforms.

title: Relation Extraction Model Based on Semantic Enhancement Mechanism
authors: Peiyu Liu, Junping Du, Yingxia Shao, Zeli Guan
abstract: Relational extraction is one of the basic tasks related to information extraction in the field of natural language processing, and is an important link and core task in the fields of information extraction, natural language understanding, and information retrieval. None of the existing relation extraction methods can effectively solve the problem of triple overlap. The CasAug model proposed in this paper based on the CasRel framework combined with the semantic enhancement mechanism can solve this problem to a certain extent. The CasAug model enhances the semantics of the identified possible subjects by adding a semantic enhancement mechanism. First, based on the semantic coding of possible subjects, pre-classify the possible subjects, and then combine the subject lexicon to calculate the semantic similarity to obtain the similar vocabulary of possible subjects. According to the similar vocabulary obtained, each word in different relations is calculated through the attention mechanism. For the contribution of the possible subject, finally combine the relationship pre-classification results to weight the enhanced semantics of each relationship to find the enhanced semantics of the possible subject, and send the enhanced semantics combined with the possible subject to the object and relationship extraction module. Complete the final relation triplet extraction. The experimental results show that, compared with the baseline model, the CasAug model proposed in this paper has improved the effect of relation extraction, and CasAug's ability to deal with overlapping problems and extract multiple relations is also better than the baseline model, indicating that the semantic enhancement mechanism proposed in this paper can further reduce the judgment of redundant relations and alleviate the problem of triple overlap.

title: Zero-shot 3D General Obstacle Detection via Multimodal Foundation Models and Geometry
authors: Tamás Matuszka, Péter Hajas, Dávid Szeghy
abstract: Detecting general obstacles is critical for autonomous driving, especially in long-tail scenarios with rare or unseen objects. Existing methods rely on supervision or predefined categories, limiting generalization. We propose a training-free approach that combines multimodal foundation models with geometric reasoning for 3D obstacle detection. Our key idea is to detect obstacles as deviations from the road surface, segmented in 2D and localized in 3D via temporal LiDAR aggregation. The pipeline operates in a zero-shot manner without task-specific training. Experiments show accurate localization up to 100 meters and 10-25% recall gains from foundation model priors, while enabling scalable autolabeling.

title: An Incremental Sampling and Segmentation-Based Approach for Motion Planning Infeasibility
authors: Antony Thomas, Fulvio Mastrogiovanni, Marco Baglietto
abstract: We present a simple and easy-to-implement algorithm to detect plan infeasibility in kinematic motion planning. Our method involves approximating the robot's configuration space to a discrete space, where each degree of freedom has a finite set of values. The obstacle region separates the free configuration space into different connected regions. For a path to exist between the start and goal configurations, they must lie in the same connected region of the free space. Thus, to ascertain plan infeasibility, we merely need to sample adequate points from the obstacle region that isolate start and goal. Accordingly, we progressively construct the configuration space (initially assumed to be entirely free) by sampling from the discretized space and updating the bitmap cells representing obstacle regions. Subsequently, we partition this partially built configuration space to identify different connected components within it and assess the connectivity of the start and goal cells. We illustrate this methodology on five different scenarios with configuration spaces having up to 5 degrees-of-freedom (DOF). Additionally, we discuss further optimizations designed to significantly accelerate the proposed algorithm. The scalability of our approach to higher-dimensional configuration spaces is also examined, with experimental demonstrations involving 6-DOF and 7-DOF robots.

title: Prototypical Few-Shot Medical Image Semantic Segmentation with Background Fusion
authors: Yuan Dong, Xiaoyu Yu, Wentao Wan, Jianchao Xue, Yuejin Duan, Song Tang, Yu Zhao
abstract: Few-shot Semantic Segmentation (FSS) aims to adapt a pre-trained model to new classes with as few as a single labeled training sample per class. The existing prototypical work used in natural image scenarios biasedly focus on capturing foreground's discrimination while employing a simplistic representation for background, grounded on the inherent observation separation between foreground and background. However, a frequency spectrum entropy analysis suggests that this paradigm is not applicable to medical images where the foreground and background share numerous visual features, necessitating a more detailed description for the background. In this paper, we present a new Background-fused prototype (Bro) approach for FSS in medical images. Instead of identifying a commonality of background subjects in the support image, Bro fuses this background to discriminative prototypes, with two pivot designs. Specifically, Feature Similarity Calibration (FeaC) initially reduces noise in the support image by employing feature cross-attention with the query image. Subsequently, Hierarchical Channel-Adversarial Attention (HiCA) merges the background into comprehensive prototypes. We achieve this by a channel groups-based attention mechanism, where an adversarial Mean-Offset structure encourages a coarse-to-fine fusion. Designed as a generic plug-in, our Bro can be seamlessly integrated with existing FSS models. Extensive experiments validate the specificity of the background in medical images and the efficacy of Bro in enhancing the performance of previous FSS models on standard benchmarks.
zh_title: 基于背景融合的原型少样本医学图像语义分割
translation: 少样本语义分割（FSS）旨在通过每个类别极少量的标注样本将预训练模型适应到新类别。现有的用于自然图像场景的原型方法倾向于仅仅关注前景的区分度，而对背景采用简单的表示，这是基于前景与背景在观察上存在明显分离的假设。然而，频率谱熵分析表明，这种范式并不适用于医学图像，因为医学图像中的前景和背景共享大量视觉特征，需要对背景进行更详细的描述。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于医学图像FSS的背景融合原型（Bro）方法。Bro不再识别支持图像中背景主体的共性，而是通过两个核心设计将背景融合到判别性原型中。具体而言，特征相似度校准（FeaC）通过利用与查询图像的特征交叉注意力来初步减少支持图像中的噪声。随后，分层通道对抗注意力（HiCA）将背景合并到综合原型中。我们通过基于通道组的注意力机制实现这一点，其中对抗性均值偏移结构鼓励从粗到细的融合。作为一种通用的插件，我们的Bro可以无缝集成到现有的FSS模型中。广泛的实验验证了医学图像中背景的特殊性，以及Bro在提升现有FSS模型在标准基准上的性能方面的有效性。
tldr: 针对医学图像中前景与背景难以区分的问题，提出了一种背景融合（Bro）方法，通过显式融合背景特征来优化原型表示，提升了少样本语义分割的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文针对医学图像中前景与背景特征高度重叠的特性，提出了背景融合（Bro）方法，克服了传统原型网络仅关注前景特征的局限性。其创新点在于通过FeaC和HiCA模块显式地将背景信息融合到原型中，设计巧妙且具有良好的通用性，作为插件可提升现有模型的性能。
motivation: 现有的少样本分割原型方法在处理医学图像时，因过度简化背景表示而忽视了医学图像中前景与背景存在大量共享视觉特征的问题，导致分割效果不佳。
method: 提出了背景融合（Bro）方法，包含两个关键设计：1. 特征相似度校准（FeaC），利用与查询图像的交叉注意力机制减少噪声；2. 分层通道对抗注意力（HiCA），通过基于通道组的注意力和对抗性均值偏移结构，实现背景与前景原型的细粒度融合。
results: 实验结果表明，Bro方法能有效增强现有少样本分割模型在医学图像标准基准上的性能，验证了其在处理医学图像特定背景特征方面的有效性。
conclusion: 本文提出的背景融合（Bro）方法有效地解决了医学图像中前景与背景特征混淆的问题，通过特征校准和分层对抗性注意力机制，显著提升了少样本医学图像分割的性能。

title: BFS versus DFS for fixed-level targets in ordered trees
authors: Stoyan Dimitrov, Martin Minchev, Yan Zhuang
abstract: We find the average time complexity of the breadth-first search (BFS) and the depth-first search (DFS) algorithms, when one searches for a target node selected uniformly at random among all nodes at level $\ell$ in the set of ordered trees with $n$ edges. Intuition suggests that on average BFS must be asymptotically faster than DFS if and only if $\ell$, as a function of $n$, is below a certain threshold. We confirm this intuition by showing that there exists a unique constant $λ\approx 0.789004$, such that in expectation BFS is asymptotically faster than DFS if and only if $\ell\leq λ\sqrt{n}$. This gives us a practical rule to select between the two algorithms, even when we do not know the exact value of $\ell$, but only an estimate of it. Furthermore, we find the asymptotic average time complexity of BFS in the given setting for an arbitrary class of Galton--Watson trees, which includes ordered trees, binary trees, and other popular classes. We use results on the occupation measure of Brownian excursions, as well as combinatorial identities related to lattice paths. Finally, we consider the simple \textit{truncated DFS} algorithm, which can be shown easily to be asymptotically faster than both BFS and DFS when $\ell$ is known in advance. We show that in fact its asymptotic time complexity is $1/2$ of the asymptotic complexity of BFS, when $\ell = s\sqrt{n}$ for any constant $s$. Several further questions are also raised.

title: On Motion Blur and Deblurring in Visual Place Recognition
authors: Timur Ismagilov, Bruno Ferrarini, Michael Milford, Tan Viet Tuyen Nguyen, SD Ramchurn, Shoaib Ehsan
abstract: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) in mobile robotics enables robots to localize themselves by recognizing previously visited locations using visual data. While the reliability of VPR methods has been extensively studied under conditions such as changes in illumination, season, weather and viewpoint, the impact of motion blur is relatively unexplored despite its relevance not only in rapid motion scenarios but also in low-light conditions where longer exposure times are necessary. Similarly, the role of image deblurring in enhancing VPR performance under motion blur has received limited attention so far. This paper bridges these gaps by introducing a new benchmark designed to evaluate VPR performance under the influence of motion blur and image deblurring. The benchmark includes three datasets that encompass a wide range of motion blur intensities, providing a comprehensive platform for analysis. Experimental results with several well-established VPR and image deblurring methods provide new insights into the effects of motion blur and the potential improvements achieved through deblurring. Building on these findings, the paper proposes adaptive deblurring strategies for VPR, designed to effectively manage motion blur in dynamic, real-world scenarios.
