title: Algorithmic Expert Aggregation
authors: Wei Tang, Hanrui Zhang
abstract:
Forecast aggregation aims to combine information from multiple Bayesian experts' forecasts into an aggregate forecast. In much of this literature, however, the aggregate forecast is optimized for a particular loss or robustness criterion and need not itself be calibrated with respect to the outcome. We introduce and study expert aggregation, where the goal is instead to aggregate Bayesian experts into a new expert that continues to provide calibrated forecasts. In particular, we consider a setting where each input expert reports calibrated predictions, and the aggregator observes the prior distribution over states, and the input experts, but not the underlying Bayes probabilities of the states. We ask whether one can (i) construct a calibrated output expert that Blackwell refines a target expert and cannot be further Blackwell improved using the available information; and (ii) when a proper loss is specified, compute a nearly loss-optimal expert among all such refinements.
  We formulate calibrated experts as reduced-form information structures and measure refinement by Blackwell dominance of the induced prediction distributions. We characterize the constructible output experts through observable linear information: the input experts generate a linear system whose row space determines which calibrated output predictions are identifiable, and a new expert is constructible exactly when its predictions lie in the associated observable nonnegative cone. We establish a sharp algorithmic picture. When randomized output experts are allowed, both questions above admit efficient algorithms. In contrast, deterministic output experts are computationally intractable: deciding whether a deterministic calibrated refinement exists is $\mathsf{NP}$-hard, and deterministic proper-loss optimization admits no multiplicative PTAS unless $\mathsf{P}=\mathsf{NP}$.

title: SLORR: Simple and Efficient In-Training Low-Rank Regularization
authors: David González-Martínez, Shiwei Liu
abstract: Low-rank factorization is widely used to compress neural networks, but modern models are often not naturally amenable to aggressive factorization without significant accuracy loss. Existing training-time low-rank regularizers can improve compressibility, but they often require SVDs of large weight matrices, modify the model architecture (introducing additional trainable parameters), or rely on stateful cached quantities. To address these limitations, we introduce SLORR, a simple, stateless, and architecture-preserving framework for in-training low-rank regularization, instantiated with two main variants based on the Hoyer sparsity metric and the nuclear norm. SLORR directly regularizes the original weight matrices using GPU-friendly approximations for the forward and backward passes of the regularizers, for which we provide approximation guarantees. We first evaluate SLORR on ImageNet-1K across short-horizon continued training of ResNet-50, ViT-B/16, and ViT-L/16, and pretraining of ResNet-18, where SLORR induces compressibility while introducing less than 8% training overhead. We further evaluate SLORR-Hoyer in LLM pretraining at 135M and 560M scales: SLORR-trained compressed models preserve performance substantially better than unregularized models while adding less than 1% average training overhead.
zh_title: SLORR：简单高效的训练中低秩正则化
translation: 低秩分解被广泛用于压缩神经网络，但现代模型通常不适合在不显著损失精度的情况下进行激进的分解。现有的训练时低秩正则化器可以提高可压缩性，但它们通常需要对大型权重矩阵进行SVD、修改模型架构（引入额外的可训练参数）或依赖有状态的缓存量。为了解决这些局限性，我们引入了SLORR，一个简单、无状态、架构保持的训练中低秩正则化框架，它通过基于Hoyer稀疏度度量和核范数的两种主要变体实例化。SLORR使用GPU友好的近似方法直接正则化原始权重矩阵，用于正则化器前向和后向传播，我们为此提供了近似保证。我们首先在ImageNet-1K上评估了SLORR，包括ResNet-50、ViT-B/16和ViT-L/16的短周期持续训练以及ResNet-18的预训练，SLORR在引入不到8%的训练开销下诱导了可压缩性。我们进一步在1.35亿和5.6亿规模的LLM预训练中评估了SLORR-Hoyer：经过SLORR训练的压缩模型比未正则化模型更好地保持了性能，同时平均训练开销不到1%。
tldr: SLORR是一种简单、无状态、架构保持的训练中低秩正则化框架，它使用GPU友好的近似方法直接正则化原始权重矩阵，能够在引入低训练开销的同时显著提高模型的可压缩性，并在ImageNet和LLM预训练上表现出色。
ai_comments: SLORR的创新之处在于其简单性、无状态性和架构保持性，这解决了现有低秩正则化方法在实际应用中的主要痛点。通过GPU友好的近似和近似保证，SLORR在不牺牲效率的前提下实现了有效的正则化，对于大规模模型压缩具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的训练时低秩正则化方法通常需要对大型权重矩阵进行SVD、修改模型架构或依赖有状态的缓存量，这限制了它们的应用。为了解决这些局限性，本文提出了SLORR。
method: SLORR是一个简单、无状态、架构保持的训练中低秩正则化框架，它通过Hoyer稀疏度度量和核范数两种主要变体实现。SLORR直接使用GPU友好的近似方法对原始权重矩阵进行正则化，并提供了近似保证。
results: SLORR在ResNet-50, ViT-B/16, ViT-L/16的ImageNet-1K短周期继续训练和ResNet-18的预训练中，在引入不到8%的训练开销下提高了可压缩性。在1.35亿和5.6亿规模的LLM预训练中，SLORR-Hoyer训练的压缩模型比未正则化模型更好地保持了性能，平均训练开销不到1%。
conclusion: SLORR是一种有效且高效的训练中低秩正则化框架，它在保持低训练开销的同时显著提高了神经网络的可压缩性，并在多种模型和任务上展现出优越的性能保持能力。

title: DexVerse: A Modular Benchmark for Multi-Task, Multi-Embodiment Dexterous Manipulation
authors: Yunchao Yao, Zhuxiu Xu, Tianqi Zhang, Zixian Liu, Sikai Li, Zhenyu Wei, Feng Chen, Dihong Huang, Kechang Wan, Chenyang Ma, Shuqi Zhao, Shenghua Gao, Masayoshi Tomizuka, Yi Ma, Mingyu Ding
abstract: Building general-purpose dexterous manipulation policies requires benchmarks that go beyond isolated tasks to systematically evaluate policies across diverse interaction modes, sensory conditions, and robot embodiments. However, existing benchmarks remain limited in task and data diversity, embodiment coverage, or controllable visual variation, hindering studies of cross-task and cross-embodiment generalization. We present DexVerse, a large-scale and modular benchmark for dexterous manipulation. DexVerse includes 100 tasks spanning a broad range of manipulation skills, including object grasping and relocation, articulated-object interaction, functional tool use, bimanual coordination, non-prehensile control, contact-rich behaviors, multi-goal execution, and long-horizon multi-stage task completion. It supports 3 robot arms and 6 dexterous hands, and is extensible to new tasks, assets, and embodiments. To evaluate visuomotor generalization, DexVerse provides configurable visual variations in textures, background, lighting, and camera viewpoints. We further provide a VR-based teleoperation interface and 3,180 demonstrations with synchronized proprioceptive, RGB, depth, point-cloud, and state observations. We benchmark representative methods, including Diffusion Policy, DP3, OpenVLA, and $π_{0.5}$, across 19 tasks. Results reveal substantial challenges in task generalization and visuomotor robustness, establishing DexVerse as a promising testbed for general-purpose dexterous manipulation. Project page: https://ycyao216.github.io/DexVerse.site
zh_title: DexVerse：一个用于多任务、多实体灵巧操作的模块化基准
translation: 建立通用灵巧操作策略需要超越孤立任务的基准，以系统地评估跨多样交互模式、感知条件和机器人实体策略。然而，现有基准在任务和数据多样性、实体覆盖或可控视觉变化方面仍然有限，阻碍了跨任务和跨实体泛化的研究。我们提出了DexVerse，一个用于灵巧操作的大规模模块化基准。DexVerse包括100个任务，涵盖广泛的操作技能，包括物体抓取和重定位、关节物体交互、功能性工具使用、双臂协调、非抓取控制、接触丰富行为、多目标执行和长周期多阶段任务完成。它支持3种机器人手臂和6种灵巧手，并且可扩展到新任务、资产和实体。为了评估视觉运动泛化，DexVerse提供可配置的纹理、背景、照明和摄像机视角的视觉变化。我们还提供了一个基于VR的远程操作接口和3,180个带有同步本体感受、RGB、深度、点云和状态观测的演示。我们对代表性方法，包括Diffusion Policy、DP3、OpenVLA和$π_{0.5}$，在19个任务上进行了基准测试。结果揭示了任务泛化和视觉运动鲁棒性方面的巨大挑战，将DexVerse确立为通用灵巧操作的一个有前景的试验台。项目页面：https://ycyao216.github.io/DexVerse.site
tldr: DexVerse是一个大规模模块化基准，包含100个灵巧操作任务，支持多机器人和手部，提供可配置的视觉变化和3180个演示，旨在评估通用灵巧操作策略的泛化能力和视觉运动鲁棒性。
ai_comments: DexVerse的创新之处在于其前所未有的任务数量（100个），支持多机器人和多手部的“多实体”特性，以及可配置的视觉变化，这些都直接解决了现有基准的局限性。其提供的大量高质量演示数据和VR远程操作接口也极大地降低了研究门槛。该基准对于推动通用灵巧操作策略的发展具有重要意义，尤其是在评估跨任务和跨实体泛化能力以及视觉鲁棒性方面。
motivation: 现有基准在任务和数据多样性、实体覆盖或可控视觉变化方面存在局限性，阻碍了跨任务和跨实体泛化的研究。构建通用灵巧操作策略需要超越孤立任务的基准，以系统地评估跨多样交互模式、感知条件和机器人实体策略。
method: 提出DexVerse，一个大规模模块化灵巧操作基准。它包括100个涵盖广泛操作技能的任务（如抓取、重定位、关节物体交互、工具使用、双臂协调、非抓取控制、接触丰富行为、多目标执行和长周期多阶段任务）。它支持3种机器人手臂和6种灵巧手，并可扩展到新任务、资产和实体。为评估视觉运动泛化，DexVerse提供可配置的纹理、背景、照明和摄像机视角的视觉变化。还提供基于VR的远程操作接口和3180个包含同步本体感受、RGB、深度、点云和状态观测的演示。
results: 在19个任务上对代表性方法（包括Diffusion Policy, DP3, OpenVLA和$π_{0.5}$）进行了基准测试。结果揭示了任务泛化和视觉运动鲁棒性方面的巨大挑战。
conclusion: DexVerse被确立为通用灵巧操作的一个有前景的试验台，揭示了任务泛化和视觉运动鲁棒性方面的巨大挑战。

title: MulTTiPop: A Multitrack Transcription Dataset for Pop Music
authors: Nathan Pruyne, Benjamin Stoler, William Chen, Chien-yu Huang, Shinji Watanabe, Chris Donahue
abstract: We present MulTTiPop, a dataset of pop music segments and their associated multitrack MIDI recordings for the evaluation of automatic music transcription models. MulTTiPop contains 572 segments of popular music totaling 3.5 hours of audio, and contains songs from diverse genres and decades from the 1930s to 2000s. To collect this dataset, we perform metadata-based matching on song segments from the Lakh MIDI and TheoryTab datasets, manually identify an anchor beat between the audio and MIDI, then use beat tracking on the audio and warp the MIDI to match its tempo and timing. We evaluate state-of-the-art automatic music transcription models on MulTTiPop and find substantial room for improvement, with the best model achieving 38% Onset F1. More details and sound examples of MulTTiPop are available at https://gclef-cmu.org/multtipop.
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Associated web preview available at https://gclef-cmu.org/multtipop
zh_title: 多音轨流行音乐转录数据集：MulTTiPop
translation: 我们提出了 MulTTiPop，一个包含流行音乐片段及其相关多音轨 MIDI 录音的数据集，用于评估自动音乐转录模型。MulTTiPop 包含 572 个流行音乐片段，总计 3.5 小时的音频，涵盖了从 1930 年代到 2000 年代的各种流派和年代的歌曲。为了收集这个数据集，我们在 Lakh MIDI 和 TheoryTab 数据集中的歌曲片段上执行基于元数据的匹配，手动识别音频和 MIDI 之间的锚定节拍，然后对音频进行节拍跟踪，并将 MIDI 调整到匹配其速度和时序。我们在 MulTTiPop 上评估了最先进的自动音乐转录模型，发现有很大的改进空间，最好的模型达到了 38% 的 Onset F1。更多关于 MulTTiPop 的细节和声音示例可在 https://gclef-cmu.org/multtipop 获取。
tldr: MulTTiPop 是一个包含流行音乐片段及其多音轨 MIDI 录音的数据集，用于评估自动音乐转录模型。它包含 572 个片段，总计 3.5 小时，涵盖了从 1930 年代到 2000 年代的各种流派和年代的歌曲。通过对现有数据集进行匹配、手动识别锚定节拍、音频节拍跟踪以及 MIDI 速度和时序校准来收集。在 MulTTiPop 上评估最先进的自动音乐转录模型，结果表明仍有很大的改进空间，最佳模型的 Onset F1 仅为 38%。
ai_comments: MulTTiPop 数据集在流行音乐转录领域具有重要意义，因为它提供了高质量的多音轨 MIDI 数据，能够更精确地评估自动音乐转录模型。该数据集的多样性和覆盖范围（跨越多个年代和流派）使其成为一个宝贵的资源。然而，38% 的 Onset F1 表明当前模型在处理真实世界流行音乐数据时仍面临巨大挑战，这为未来的研究提供了明确的方向。
motivation: 创建 MulTTiPop 数据集是为了评估自动音乐转录模型，因为现有模型在该数据集上的表现表明存在很大的改进空间。
method: 通过基于元数据匹配 Lakh MIDI 和 TheoryTab 数据集中的歌曲片段，手动识别音频和 MIDI 之间的锚定节拍，然后对音频进行节拍跟踪，并将 MIDI 调整到匹配其速度和时序来收集数据集。
results: 在 MulTTiPop 数据集上评估最先进的自动音乐转录模型，结果显示改进空间巨大，最佳模型的 Onset F1 仅为 38%。
conclusion: MulTTiPop 数据集为评估自动音乐转录模型提供了一个新的资源，并且现有的最先进模型在该数据集上的表现表明，在提高转录准确性方面仍有显著的改进空间。

title: Enhancing In-context Panoramic Generation via Geometric-aware Pretraining
authors: Haoran Feng, Ruiyang Zhang, Longyi Zhang, Dizhe Zhang, Lu Qi
abstract: In this work, we present Canvas360, a two-stage framework for in-context panoramic generation that combines geometry-aware pretraining with downstream task-specific fine-tuning. To address the lack of large-scale, high-quality training data tailored to in-context panoramic tasks, we propose Canvas360Dataset, a collection of 1M high-quality paired panoramic samples for style transfer, inpainting, outpainting, and editing, enabling effective supervision across diverse in-context generation scenarios. On the modeling side, Canvas360 enhances text-to-panorama generation through parallel depth generation, velocity circular padding, and similarity loss regularization, enabling the model to learn geometry-aware representations, capture object distortion details, and improve geometric consistency and global coherence. Furthermore, empowered by strong panoramic priors, Canvas360 enables a unified in-context panoramic generation framework that supports diverse downstream tasks via token-level concatenation, surpassing prior methods in both task coverage and modeling flexibility. Extensive experiments show that Canvas360 improves panoramic image fidelity, achieving particularly strong performance on the panorama-specific FAED metric and competitive or leading results across the reported quantitative evaluations. More information can be found on our project page: https://zry000.github.io/Canvas360/
zh_title: 通过几何感知预训练增强上下文全景生成
translation: 本研究提出了Canvas360，一个用于上下文全景生成的两阶段框架，结合了几何感知预训练和下游任务的特定微调。为了解决缺乏针对上下文全景任务量身定制的大规模、高质量训练数据的问题，我们提出了Canvas360Dataset，一个包含1M个高质量配对全景样本的集合，用于风格迁移、修复、外绘和编辑，从而在各种上下文生成场景中实现有效的监督。在模型方面，Canvas360通过并行深度生成、速度环形填充和相似性损失正则化来增强文本到全景的生成，使模型能够学习几何感知表示、捕捉对象失真细节，并提高几何一致性和全局连贯性。此外，凭借强大的全景先验知识，Canvas360实现了一个统一的上下文全景生成框架，通过令牌级连接支持各种下游任务，在任务覆盖范围和模型灵活性方面均超越了先前的方法。大量的实验表明，Canvas360提高了全景图像的保真度，在特定于全景的FAED指标上取得了尤其强劲的性能，并在所报告的定量评估中取得了有竞争力的或领先的结果。更多信息可在我们的项目页面找到：https://zry000.github.io/Canvas360/
tldr: Canvas360是一个两阶段框架，通过几何感知预训练和下游任务微调来增强上下文全景生成。它提出了一个包含1M个全景样本的数据集，并结合了并行深度生成、速度环形填充和相似性损失正则化等技术，以提高几何感知表示、细节捕捉和全局一致性。该框架支持多种下游任务，并在各种评估中取得了领先的性能。
ai_comments: 该研究提出的Canvas360框架在上下文全景生成领域取得了显著进展。通过引入大规模数据集和几何感知预训练，有效解决了现有方法的局限性。该框架在处理多种下游任务时展现出的灵活性和优越性能，预示着其在全景内容创作和编辑领域的广阔应用前景。然而，对于计算资源的消耗和在不同设备上的部署效率仍有待进一步的评估。
motivation: 现有的上下文全景生成方法缺乏大规模、高质量的训练数据，并且在几何感知表示、细节捕捉和全局一致性方面存在不足。
method: 提出Canvas360，一个结合几何感知预训练和下游任务微调的两阶段框架。构建Canvas360Dataset，包含1M个全景样本。在模型方面，通过并行深度生成、速度环形填充和相似性损失正则化来增强文本到全景的生成，以学习几何感知表示、捕捉对象失真细节并提高几何一致性和全局连贯性。
results: Canvas360提高了全景图像的保真度，在特定于全景的FAED指标上表现尤为出色，并在报告的定量评估中取得了有竞争力的或领先的结果。
conclusion: Canvas360通过几何感知预训练和创新的模型组件，成功地增强了上下文全景生成能力，并为多种下游任务提供了一个统一且灵活的框架，在各项评估中均展现出优越性能。

title: OpenCoF: Learning to Reason Through Video Generation
authors: Xinyan Chen, Ziyu Guo, Renrui Zhang, Dongzhi Jiang, Hongsheng Li
abstract: Reasoning has become a core capability for large models, especially when reliable decisions require understanding logical consequences. Recent video generation models offer a reasoning path distinct from previous Chain-of-Thought (CoT): reasoning can unfold through temporally connected frames, known as Chain-of-Frame (CoF) reasoning. However, existing video generators are primarily trained on general video corpora, still lacking diverse supervision and dedicated designs for CoF reasoning. To address this gap, we introduce OpenCoF, a framework comprising the OpenCoF-17K dataset, a reasoning video dataset spanning 11 task families, and Wan-CoF, a fine-tuned video model for studying whether diverse temporal supervision improves CoF behavior. Across four video reasoning benchmarks, Wan-CoF achieves considerable gains over the Wan2.2-I2V-A14B baseline. Building on this, we empirically explore more advanced designs for CoF capabilities, i.e., equipping the model with visual and textual reasoning tokens. This mechanism respectively captures low-level visual cues and high-level semantic priors for spatial and temporal reasoning. Through performance comparisons and attention analysis, we examine how these tokens contribute across model depth, denoising steps, space, and time. Our results suggest that stronger video reasoning requires both broad temporal supervision and explicit mechanisms for organizing intermediate reasoning state. We open-source the dataset, model, and code to facilitate future research on reasoning-oriented video generation.
zh_title: 开放协同框架：通过视频生成学习推理
translation: 推理已成为大型模型的核心能力，尤其是在可靠决策需要理解逻辑后果时。最近的视频生成模型提供了一条与以往的思维链（CoT）不同的推理路径：推理可以通过时间上连接的帧展开，这被称为帧链（CoF）推理。然而，现有的视频生成器主要在通用视频语料库上进行训练，仍然缺乏多样化的监督和专门为CoF推理设计的机制。为了解决这个差距，我们引入了OpenCoF，一个包含OpenCoF-17K数据集（一个跨越11个任务家族的推理视频数据集）和Wan-CoF（一个用于研究多样化时间监督是否能改善CoF行为的微调视频模型）的框架。在四个视频推理基准测试中，Wan-CoF相对于Wan2.2-I2V-A14B基线模型取得了显著的提升。在此基础上，我们实证地探索了更先进的CoF能力设计，即为模型配备视觉和文本推理标记。该机制分别捕捉用于空间和时间推理的低级视觉线索和高级语义先验。通过性能比较和注意力分析，我们研究了这些标记如何在模型深度、去噪步数、空间和时间上做出贡献。我们的结果表明，更强的视频推理需要广泛的时间监督和用于组织中间推理状态的显式机制。我们开源了数据集、模型和代码，以促进面向推理的视频生成研究。
tldr: 该研究提出了OpenCoF框架，包括一个包含11个任务的17K视频数据集（OpenCoF-17K）和一个名为Wan-CoF的微调视频模型，旨在通过视频生成实现链式推理（Chain-of-Frame, CoF）。实验表明，Wan-CoF在视频推理基准测试中显著优于基线模型。此外，研究还探索了通过引入视觉和文本推理标记来增强模型CoF能力的设计，这些标记分别捕捉低级视觉线索和高级语义先验。结果表明，有效的视频推理需要广泛的时间监督和组织中间推理状态的显式机制。研究开源了数据集、模型和代码。
ai_comments: 这项研究在视频生成领域引入了新颖的“帧链”（CoF）推理概念，并提供了相应的框架（OpenCoF）和数据集（OpenCoF-17K），为解决视频理解和推理问题提供了重要资源。通过引入视觉和文本推理标记，该研究为模型提供了更强的推理能力，并对这些标记的作用进行了深入分析，为未来的研究提供了有价值的见解。然而，对于如何更有效地融合这些标记以及其在更广泛任务中的泛化能力仍有待进一步探索。
motivation: 现有的视频生成模型主要在通用视频语料库上进行训练，缺乏多样化的监督和专门为链式帧（Chain-of-Frame, CoF）推理设计的机制，而CoF推理是通过时间上连接的帧来展开的一种与以往的思维链（Chain-of-Thought, CoT）不同的推理方式。
method: 提出了OpenCoF框架，包括OpenCoF-17K数据集（包含11个任务家族的推理视频）和Wan-CoF微调视频模型。探索了通过引入视觉和文本推理标记来增强CoF能力的设计，这些标记分别捕捉低级视觉线索和高级语义先验，用于空间和时间推理。
results: Wan-CoF模型在四个视频推理基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升，优于Wan2.2-I2V-A14B基线模型。通过性能比较和注意力分析，研究发现视觉和文本推理标记能够有效地捕捉不同层次的推理线索，并且模型深度、去噪步数、空间和时间维度都对推理能力有影响。
conclusion: 更强的视频推理能力需要广泛的时间监督以及用于组织中间推理状态的显式机制。研究开源了数据集、模型和代码，以促进面向推理的视频生成研究。

title: Ideas Have Genomes: Benchmarking Scientific Lineage Reasoning and Lineage-Grounded Idea Generation
authors: Yifan Zhou, Qihao Yang, Yan Li, Donggang Li, Xiru Hu, Hokin Deng, Ziyang Gong, Xuanyi Zhou, Huacan Wang, Xiangchao Yan, Wanghan Xu, Wenlong Zhang, Shaofeng Zhang, Yue Zhou, Yifan Yang, Zhihang Zhong, Xue Yang
abstract: Scientific ideas rarely start from a blank page. They inherit mechanisms, repair known limitations, and recombine pieces of earlier work, much like biological genomes. Current benchmarks still say little about whether AI systems can follow this inheritance structure. We present IdeaGene-Bench (IG-Bench), a benchmark for scientific lineage reasoning and lineage-grounded idea generation. IG-Bench is organized around the IdeaGene framework: each paper or proposal is represented as a set of minimal, typed, evidence-grounded Idea Genome objects, and a GenomeDiff aligns these objects to record inheritance, mutation, loss, external import, and novel insertion under six operational evolutionary dynamics. The benchmark contains 1,961 golden lineage traces, 1,085 curated Idea Genome objects, and 920 pairwise GenomeDiff records across 10 scientific domains. It supports two evaluations. IG-Exam (42 task types, 1,029 instances) tests closed-form lineage reasoning across Idea Genome abstraction, inheritance tracing, evolutionary reasoning, and lineage verification. IG-Arena evaluates generation with a lineage-conditioned Population-Evolution Score(PES), asking whether a proposal can be inserted as a coherent descendant of a given lineage population: it should inherit the right Idea Genome objects, vary meaningfully from nearby work, and offer selection value for future research. Experiments on 14 LLM-based scientists expose a compositional bottleneck. The strongest system reaches only 27.3% exact accuracy on lineage reasoning, and structured lineage context reshuffles system rankings rather than helping every participant uniformly.
zh_title: 思想具有基因组：科学谱系推理和谱系基础的创意生成基准测试
translation: 科学思想很少是凭空产生的。它们继承机制，修复已知局限性，并重组早期工作的片段，这在很大程度上类似于生物基因组。目前的基准测试仍然很少说明人工智能系统是否能够遵循这种继承结构。我们提出了IdeaGene-Bench（IG-Bench），一个用于科学谱系推理和谱系基础的创意生成的基准。IG-Bench围绕IdeaGene框架组织：每篇论文或提案都表示为一组最小化的、有类型的、基于证据的思想基因组对象，而GenomeDiff则对这些对象进行对齐，以记录在六种操作性进化动力学下的继承、变异、丢失、外部引入和新插入。该基准包含1,961个黄金谱系追踪、1,085个精选的思想基因组对象和920个跨越10个科学领域的成对GenomeDiff记录。它支持两项评估。IG-Exam（42种任务类型，1,029个实例）测试跨越思想基因组抽象、继承追踪、进化推理和谱系验证的闭式谱系推理。IG-Arena使用基于谱系的群体进化评分（PES）来评估生成能力，询问一个提案是否可以作为给定谱系群体的一个连贯的后代被插入：它应该继承正确的思想基因组对象，与附近的工作有意义地区分，并为未来的研究提供选择价值。对14个基于LLM的科学家的实验暴露了一个组合瓶颈。最强的系统在谱系推理上的精确准确率仅达到27.3%，而结构化的谱系上下文重排了系统排名，而不是均匀地帮助每个参与者。
tldr: 该研究提出了一个名为IdeaGene-Bench（IG-Bench）的新基准，用于评估人工智能系统在理解和生成科学思想的演变过程方面的能力。该基准通过将科学论文表示为“思想基因组”对象，并跟踪它们之间的继承、变异和创新关系来工作。实验结果表明，现有的大型语言模型在科学思想的谱系推理方面存在瓶颈，准确率不高。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的框架来量化和评估AI在科学思想演变方面的能力，这对于理解和加速科学发现具有重要意义。然而，基准的有效性和通用性，以及模型在更广泛的科学领域和更复杂的推理任务上的表现仍需进一步探索。模型在谱系推理方面仅达到27.3%的准确率，表明在这一领域存在巨大的改进空间。
motivation: 当前的基准测试未能充分评估人工智能系统理解科学思想如何继承、演变和创新的能力，而这对于科学发展至关重要。
method: 提出了IdeaGene-Bench（IG-Bench）基准，该基准围绕IdeaGene框架构建。该框架将科学论文表示为一系列最小化的、有类型的、基于证据的思想基因组对象。GenomeDiff用于记录对象之间的继承、变异、丢失、外部引入和新插入。基准包含1,961个谱系追踪、1,085个思想基因组对象和920个GenomeDiff记录，涵盖10个科学领域。评估包括IG-Exam（测试闭式谱系推理）和IG-Arena（评估基于谱系的创意生成）。
results: 在对14个基于大型语言模型的系统进行的实验中，发现了一个“组合瓶颈”。在谱系推理方面，表现最好的系统准确率仅为27.3%。结构化的谱系上下文重排了系统排名，但并未对所有参与者都提供同等程度的帮助。
conclusion: 现有的大型语言模型在理解和生成科学思想的演变过程方面能力有限，尤其是在谱系推理方面存在显著的组合瓶颈。未来的研究需要改进模型在理解和利用科学思想的继承和演变机制方面的能力。

title: OPSD-V: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generators
authors: Hongyu Liu, Chun Wang, Feng Gao, Xuanhua He, Yue Ma, Ziyu Wan, Yong Zhang, Xiaoming Wei, Qifeng Chen
abstract: We propose OPSD-V, an on-policy self-distillation paradigm for post-training few-step autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models. Existing few-step AR video generators can produce long videos with low latency, but still suffer from error accumulation and weakened motion dynamics during long autoregressive rollout. OPSD-V reduces long-horizon degradation while preserving the original few-step inference path. The key idea is to introduce real long-video data as temporal context during training and use it to provide dense trajectory-level supervision. Specifically, the student follows the exact inference-time rollout, generating each chunk conditioned on its own previously generated KV cache. In parallel, the teacher is evaluated at the same student-visited denoising states, but uses a cleaner AR-consistent temporal cache in which older history can be replaced by real-video context. This provides dense denoising-level corrective targets under on-policy AR cache dynamics, without changing the sampler, number of denoising steps, or inference-time cache mechanism. We apply OPSD-V to representative few-step AR video models, including Self-Forcing and LongLive. Experiments show consistent improvements in visual quality, motion dynamics, and VBenchLong scores. A user study with 10 participants comparing 20 video pairs shows that OPSD-V is preferred over the base models in 66.0% of overall-preference judgments (82.5% excluding ties).
zh_title: OPSD-V：用于训练后少步自回归视频生成器的在线策略自蒸馏
translation: 我们提出OPSD-V，一种用于训练后少步自回归（AR）视频扩散模型的在线策略自蒸馏范式。现有的少步AR视频生成器可以低延迟地生成长视频，但在长AR展开过程中仍然存在误差累积和运动动力学减弱的问题。OPSD-V在保持原始的少步推理路径的同时，减少了长序列退化。关键思想是在训练期间引入真实的长视频数据作为时序上下文，并利用它提供密集的轨迹级别监督。具体来说，学生模型遵循与推理时相同的展开方式，生成每个块都以其自身先前生成的KV缓存为条件。同时，教师模型在相同的学生访问的去噪状态下进行评估，但使用更干净的、与AR一致的时序缓存，其中旧的历史可以被真实视频上下文替换。这在不改变采样器、去噪步数或推理时缓存机制的情况下，提供了在线策略AR缓存动态下的密集去噪级别纠正目标。我们将OPSD-V应用于代表性的少步AR视频模型，包括Self-Forcing和LongLive。实验表明，在视觉质量、运动动力学和VBenchLong分数方面得到了一致的改进。一项有10名参与者的用户研究比较了20个视频对，结果显示在整体偏好判断中，OPSD-V比基础模型更受欢迎，占66.0%（不包括平局则为82.5%）。
tldr: OPSD-V是一种用于改进少步自回归视频生成器的方法，通过引入真实长视频数据作为训练时的时序上下文，提供密集轨迹级别的监督，从而减少长视频生成中的误差累积和运动动力学减弱问题，同时保持原始的少步推理路径。实验表明，该方法在视觉质量、运动动力学和长视频基准测试中均有提升，并获得用户研究的偏好。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种名为OPSD-V的创新自蒸馏方法，有效解决了现有少步自回归视频生成器在长视频生成中的关键挑战。通过引入真实长视频数据作为监督信号，并设计精巧的教师-学生模型蒸馏机制，该方法在不牺牲推理效率的前提下，显著提升了视频的视觉质量和运动动态。尤其值得称赞的是，该方法能够直接应用于现有的先进模型，展示了其广泛的适用性和技术价值。未来的工作可以进一步探索其在不同类型视频生成任务中的潜力，以及更复杂的时序依赖建模。
motivation: 现有的少步自回归视频生成器在生成长视频时存在误差累积和运动动力学减弱的问题。
method: OPSD-V引入真实长视频数据作为训练时的时序上下文，并利用其提供密集的轨迹级别监督。学生模型遵循与推理时相同的自回归展开方式，并以其自身先前生成的KV缓存为条件。教师模型在学生模型访问的相同去噪状态下进行评估，但使用更干净的、与AR一致的时序缓存，其中可以将旧的历史替换为真实视频上下文。这在不改变采样器、去噪步数或推理时缓存机制的情况下，提供了在线策略AR缓存动态下的密集去噪级别纠正目标。
results: OPSD-V在视觉质量、运动动力学和VBenchLong分数方面得到一致改进。用户研究显示，在20个视频对的比较中，66.0%（不包括平局则为82.5%）的整体偏好判断中，OPSD-V优于基础模型。
conclusion: OPSD-V是一种有效的在线策略自蒸馏方法，能够显著提升少步自回归视频生成器在长视频生成任务中的性能，解决误差累积和运动动力学减弱的问题，并且无需修改推理过程。

title: UniClawBench: A Universal Benchmark for Proactive Agents on Real-World Tasks
authors: Zhekai Chen, Chengqi Duan, Kaiyue Sun, Bohao Li, Yuqing Wang, Manyuan Zhang, Xihui Liu
abstract: The rapid development of large language models and multimodal large language models has accelerated the emergence of proactive agents capable of operating everyday tools and assisting users in real-world environments. However, existing benchmarks struggle to evaluate such agents effectively, as they often rely on sandboxed environments and single-turn evaluation paradigms. Moreover, their scenario-based task taxonomies mix multiple model capabilities within the same task category, making it difficult to identify the root causes of agent failures. To address these limitations, we introduce UniClawBench, the first capability-driven benchmark designed to evaluate proactive agents in dynamic, real-world settings. UniClawBench is built around five foundational model capabilities: Skill Usage, Exploration, Long-Context Reasoning, Multimodal Understanding, and Cross-Platform Coordination. Based on these capabilities, we design 400 bilingual real-world tasks. Unlike previous benchmarks that rely on static, pre-recorded answers, our benchmark evaluates agents in live Docker containers using fine-grained, step-by-step completion checkpoints. Furthermore, we design a closed-loop evaluation strategy comprising an executor agent, a hidden supervisor agent, and a user agent to simulate realistic multi-turn human feedback without leaking grading criteria. To disentangle base model capabilities from framework-level design choices, we evaluate state-of-the-art models under multiple agent frameworks. Through comprehensive comparisons across both models and frameworks, we show how base model capabilities and agent framework designs jointly shape performance in real-world environments. To facilitate future research, we make our benchmark and code publicly available at https://github.com/HKU-MMLab/UniClawBench.
comment: Project Page: https://uniclawbench.github.io | GitHub Repo: https://github.com/HKU-MMLab/UniClawBench

title: Geometry and Gradient-based Partitioning for Panoramic Outdoor Reconstruction
authors: Weijian Chen, Weibo Yao, Yuhang Zhang, Xiaolin Tang, Guo Wang, Weijun Zhang, Xitong Gao, Yihao Chen, Hongde Qin, Lu Qi
abstract: Scaling 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to large outdoor scenes is costly in both data acquisition and computation. Adopting panoramic images with equirectangular projection (ERP) can reduce capture effort via their full $360^{\circ}$ field of view, yet the resulting omnipresent visibility invalidates existing partitioning strategies that rely on local camera frustums, causing block-wise optimization to degenerate into global training. Thus, we propose PanoLOG, a two-stage coarse-to-fine framework equipped with a Geometry and Gradient-based Partitioning Strategy tailored for large-scale panoramic 3DGS reconstruction. In the global coarse stage, PanoLOG leverages sky-sphere modeling and panoramic monocular depth supervision for reliable geometry, while in the refinement stage, G$^2$PS builds adaptive bounding volumes via parallax-driven uncertainty and assigns cameras via gradient-based importance scoring. Furthermore, we construct Pano360, the first benchmark on large-scale panoramic dataset for outdoor scene reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that G$^2$PS achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality while maintaining scalable, block-parallel training. Our models, training code, and dataset are publicly available.

title: ZipDepth: Bringing Lightweight Zero-Shot Monocular Depth Anywhere, on Any Device
authors: Fabio Tosi, Luca Bartolomei, Matteo Poggi, Stefano Mattoccia
abstract: Monocular depth estimation has seen remarkable progress through foundation models achieving robust zero-shot generalization, yet their computational demands place them far beyond the reach of embedded and mobile platforms. Lightweight alternatives exist, but have been developed almost exclusively within single-domain, self-supervised paradigms, failing silently under domain shift. We present ZipDepth, a compact monocular depth network that bridges this gap by combining an efficient reparameterizable encoder-decoder with large-scale knowledge distillation from a foundation model over a large multi-domain training set. Comprising just 6.1M parameters, ZipDepth runs at real-time rates from server GPUs to power-constrained devices, achieving the best trade-off between zero-shot accuracy and deployment efficiency among lightweight models across five benchmarks, taking a significant step towards the accuracy of foundation models with 50x more parameters.
comment: ECCV 2026. Code: https://github.com/fabiotosi92/ZipDepth - Project page: https://zipdepth.github.io/

title: LongE2V: Long-Horizon Event-based Video Reconstruction, Prediction, and Frame Interpolation with Video Diffusion Models
authors: Cheng-De Fan, Chun-Wei Tuan Mu, Chen-Wei Chang, Chin-Yang Lin, Kun-Ru Wu, Yu-Chee Tseng, Yu-Lun Liu
abstract: Recovering high-quality video from sparse event streams is a challenging task. Regression methods often blur textures, while existing generative models struggle with long-term stability. We propose LongE2V, a novel approach that leverages pre-trained video diffusion priors to jointly handle event-based video reconstruction, prediction, and frame interpolation. By fine-tuning a foundational video model, our approach achieves high data efficiency and superior perceptual quality. We introduce Autoregressive Unrolling and Adaptive Context Switching to mitigate temporal drift in extremely long sequences. We also propose Reencoding Alignment with Cross Residual Correction to ensure precise bidirectional consistency during frame interpolation. Furthermore, Event Voxel Density Augmentation ensures robustness across varying sensor resolutions. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that LongE2V outperforms state-of-the-art methods across all three tasks, exhibiting exceptional temporal coherence and zero-shot generalization. Project page: https://cdfan0627.github.io/LongE2V-page/

title: Wat3R: Underwater 3D Geometry Learning without Annotations
authors: Jiangwei Ren, Xingyu Jiang, Zijie Song, Wei Xu, Hongkai Lin, Dingkang Liang, Xiang Bai
abstract: Estimating 3D geometry in underwater environments presents unique challenges due to light attenuation, scattering, and the absence of large-scale, high-quality 3D annotations. Pioneering methods rely on massive dense annotations that are impractical in underwater settings. In this paper, we propose Wat3R, a cross-domain semi-supervised learning framework designed to adapt feed-forward 3D reconstruction models from air to underwater scenes. Uniquely, our method eliminates the need for any annotated underwater data following a teacher-student architecture, that learns robust geometry representations merely on abundant unlabeled real underwater video footage. We also design a cross-view consistency loss that leverages geometric cues from other views to compensate for the information degradation in the current view caused by water attenuation and scattering. Furthermore, considering the lack of comprehensive evaluation benchmarks, we construct Water3D, a diverse dataset covering various water bodies and underwater scenarios, designed for geometric task evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that Wat3R outperforms current state-of-the-art methods in underwater multi-view depth estimation and point cloud reconstruction. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/LSXI7/Wat3R .
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/LSXI7/Wat3R

title: Statistical inverse learning problems with random observations
authors: Abhishake Rastogi, Tapio Helin, Nicole Mücke
abstract: We provide an overview of recent progress in statistical inverse problems with random experimental design, covering both linear and nonlinear inverse problems. Different regularization schemes have been studied to produce robust and stable solutions. We discuss recent results in spectral regularization methods and regularization by projection, exploring both approaches within the context of Hilbert scales and presenting new insights particularly in regularization by projection. Additionally, we overview recent advancements in regularization using convex penalties. Convergence rates are analyzed in terms of the sample size in a probabilistic sense, yielding minimax rates in both expectation and probability. To achieve these results, the structure of reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces is leveraged to establish minimax rates in the statistical learning setting. We detail the assumptions underpinning these key elements of our proofs. Finally, we demonstrate the application of these concepts to nonlinear inverse problems in pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) models, where the task is to predict changes in drug concentrations in patients.

title: Mixing of Glauber Dynamics on High Overlap Gibbs Measures
authors: Afonso S. Bandeira, Ahmed El Alaoui, Almut Rödder
abstract: We show fast mixing of Glauber dynamics for certain quadratic Gibbs measures with large external fields. The main ingredient is an overlap condition that allows us to control correlation matrices uniformly over all pinnings, by controlling norms of small submatrices of the interaction matrix. Using stochastic localization, we then obtain a lower bound on the spectral gap and, consequently, polynomial-time mixing of Glauber dynamics. As a direct application, we consider the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model, whose interaction matrix is a scaled GOE matrix. For this model, we show that for any fixed finite inverse temperature $β$, there exists a strength of external field $θ$, not depending on the size of the system, for which Glauber dynamics mixes in polynomial time (with high probability on the draw of the interaction matrix).

title: The Regularization Parameter: Sparse Precision Matrix Estimation
authors: Aryan Eftekhari, Daniel Sergio Vega, Ernst-Jan Camiel Wit, Olaf Schenk
abstract: Sparse precision matrix estimation provides an interpretable and computationally efficient framework for modeling conditional dependencies in high-dimensional, low-sample-size data. A recurring challenge is appropriately selecting the regularization parameter that controls estimator sparsity and strikes a balance between underfitting and overfitting. We propose a closed-form, matrix-valued regularization parameter derived from the sampling distribution of the first-order optimality conditions of the $\ell_1$-regularized Gaussian maximum-likelihood estimator. By prescribing the probability that each nonzero entry of the estimator satisfies its optimality condition under resampling, we eliminate the need for cross-validation. The resulting regularization parameter is shown to attain asymptotic scaling properties that, under standard conditions, provide consistency and sparsistency of the estimator. On synthetic Gaussian and non-Gaussian datasets, as well as real-world gene microarray and neuroimaging applications, the proposed approach achieves estimation accuracy comparable to cross-validation, delivers superior support recovery, and reduces runtime by several orders of magnitude.

title: Distributionally Faithful Imputation via Positive Semi-Definite Kernel Density Estimation
authors: Andrea Basteri, Carlo Ciliberto, Alessandro Rudi
abstract: Missing values undermine statistical inference and machine learning pipelines, yet most imputation methods rely on heuristics or restrictive parametric assumptions that ignore the joint data distribution. We recast imputation under missing completely at random (MCAR) as density estimation from masked observations: estimate a distribution whose observed marginals exactly match those in the data. Leveraging positive semi definite (PSD) kernel densities we obtain a convex empirical risk problem with closed form marginals, solvable by a Newton interior point method. The resulting PSD Impute model yields both single and multiple imputations from the same fitted density, enjoys statistical consistency with fast adaptive excess risk beating the curse of dimensionality for very regular probabilities. Preliminary experiments on one synthetic and eleven real world datasets already indicate competitive distributional accuracy compared with popular imputation baselines, suggesting strong practical promise.
zh_title: 通过正半定核密度估计实现分布忠实的插补
translation: 缺失值会损害统计推断和机器学习流程，然而大多数插补方法依赖于启发式或限制性参数假设，忽略了联合数据分布。我们将完全随机缺失（MCAR）下的插补重新定义为从掩蔽观测中进行密度估计：估计一个其观测边际与数据中边际完全匹配的分布。利用正半定（PSD）核密度，我们获得了一个具有封闭形式边际的凸经验风险问题，可通过牛顿内点法求解。由此产生的PSD Impute模型能够从同一拟合密度生成单一和多重插补，具有统计一致性，并能实现快速自适应超额风险，对于非常规则的概率可以克服维度诅咒。对一个合成数据集和十一个真实世界数据集的初步实验已经表明，与流行的插补基线相比，该方法具有竞争力的分布准确性，预示着强大的实用前景。
tldr: 该研究将MCAR下的缺失值插补重构为基于PSD核密度的密度估计问题，通过凸优化求解，并实现了具有竞争性分布准确性的单一和多重插补。

motivation: 缺失值会损害统计推断和机器学习流程，而大多数现有插补方法依赖启发式或限制性参数假设，忽略了联合数据分布。
method: 将MCAR下的插补重新定义为从掩蔽观测中进行密度估计，目标是估计一个其观测边际与数据中边际完全匹配的分布。利用正半定（PSD）核密度，获得一个具有封闭形式边际的凸经验风险问题，并通过牛顿内点法求解。
results: PSD Impute模型能够从同一拟合密度生成单一和多重插补，具有统计一致性，并能实现快速自适应超额风险，克服了高维诅咒。初步实验在1个合成数据集和11个真实世界数据集上显示出与流行插补基线相比具有竞争力的分布准确性。

title: A Sparse and Truncated State Vector Simulator for Peaked Circuits
authors: Diogo R. Ferreira
abstract: In a class of quantum circuits known as peaked circuits, the goal is to predict the most probable bit string at the output of the circuit. Since these circuits are designed to have a sharp peak in their output distribution, in principle it should be possible to simulate them using a truncated state vector with a limited number of terms, or a fraction of the total probability mass. This approximate simulation can be carried out on a classical computer with a sparse representation that stores only the nonzero amplitudes of the state vector, in contrast to the dense representations that are common in most quantum simulators. For efficiency, all operations on the state vector should be vectorized to the furthest possible extent and, if available, hardware acceleration can also be used. This work describes how these requirements were met in an open-source implementation, and discusses its performance and limitations.
zh_title: 用于尖峰电路的稀疏截断态向量模拟器
translation: 在一类被称为尖峰电路的量子电路中，目标是预测电路输出中最可能出现的比特串。由于这些电路被设计为在输出分布中具有尖锐的峰值，原则上应该可以使用有限项的截断态向量或总概率质量的一部分来模拟它们。这种近似模拟可以在经典计算机上通过稀疏表示进行，该表示仅存储态向量的非零振幅，这与大多数量子模拟器中常见的密集表示形成对比。为了提高效率，态向量上的所有操作都应尽可能地向量化，并且如果可用，还可以使用硬件加速。这项工作描述了如何在开源实现中满足这些要求，并讨论了其性能和局限性。
tldr: 该研究开发了一种开源模拟器，用于在经典计算机上对尖峰量子电路进行稀疏截断态向量模拟，以高效预测最可能的输出比特串。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的方法来模拟特定类别的量子电路（尖峰电路），通过采用稀疏和截断的态向量表示，而非传统的密集表示。这有望显著提高这些特定电路的经典模拟效率，从而以更少的计算资源预测最可能的输出比特串。其开源性质进一步提升了实用性和潜在的广泛应用。它的重要性在于弥合了经典模拟能力与某些量子算法需求之间的差距。
motivation: 在尖峰量子电路中，目标是预测电路输出中最可能出现的比特串。由于这些电路的输出分布具有尖锐峰值，理论上可以通过有限项的截断态向量进行高效模拟，这与常见的密集表示方法不同。

title: Cascading Effects of the COVID-19 Pandemic on Barangays in the Philippines
authors: Naomi Ashley Amparo, John Frederick Muji, Paul James Montecillo, Jaymar Soriano, Vena Pearl Bongolan
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic disrupted socio-economic and healthcare systems in the Philippines, significantly affecting barangays. This study analyzes the cascading effects of the COVID-19 pandemic on key aspects of a barangay, namely mobility, accessibility of public services, economic and financial health, food security, educational engagement, and physical health. It focuses on data from 2,122 Filipino households collected during May to June 2021 as part of the World Bank COVID-19 Households Survey. A Bayesian network model was constructed to programmatically map the conditional dependencies among these variables, utilizing Python libraries. Survey responses were grouped into common variables based on shared characteristics and standardized through z-score normalization to serve as nodes in the Bayesian network. By extending the Bayesian network into an influence diagram, the results will help identify interventions to guide local government units (LGUs) and policymakers in crafting tailored recovery programs and strategies that address impacts on physical health, economic and financial health, food security, public service access, mobility, and educational engagement. These efforts ultimately aim to enhance barangay resilience and preparedness for future public health crises. The results indicate that interventions aimed at boosting food production, stabilizing market prices, and expanding income opportunities are the most effective in improving community outcomes. This highlights the vital role of targeted economic and food security measures in mitigating the socio-economic impacts of the pandemic and offers valuable insights for shaping future response and recovery efforts.
zh_title: 菲律宾COVID-19大流行对描笼涯的连锁效应
translation: COVID-19大流行扰乱了菲律宾的社会经济和医疗系统，对描笼涯产生了显著影响。本研究分析了COVID-19大流行对描笼涯关键方面，即流动性、公共服务可及性、经济和财务健康、粮食安全、教育参与和身体健康，的连锁效应。研究重点关注2021年5月至6月期间收集的2,122个菲律宾家庭的数据，这些数据是世界银行COVID-19家庭调查的一部分。构建了一个贝叶斯网络模型，利用Python库程序化地绘制了这些变量之间的条件依赖关系。调查回复根据共同特征分组为常见变量，并通过z-score标准化作为贝叶斯网络中的节点。通过将贝叶斯网络扩展为影响图，结果将有助于识别干预措施，以指导地方政府单位（LGUs）和政策制定者制定量身定制的恢复计划和战略，解决对身体健康、经济和财务健康、粮食安全、公共服务可及性、流动性和教育参与的影响。这些努力最终旨在增强描笼涯的韧性以及应对未来公共卫生危机的准备。结果表明，旨在促进粮食生产、稳定市场价格和扩大收入机会的干预措施在改善社区成果方面最为有效。这突显了有针对性的经济和粮食安全措施在减轻大流行社会经济影响方面的关键作用，并为制定未来的应对和恢复工作提供了宝贵的见解。
tldr: 本研究分析了COVID-19大流行对菲律宾描笼涯在流动性、公共服务、经济健康、粮食安全、教育和身体健康方面的连锁影响，使用贝叶斯网络模型识别出促进粮食生产、稳定市场价格和扩大收入机会的干预措施最为有效。

method: 该研究利用2021年5月至6月期间收集的2,122个菲律宾家庭的数据（来自世界银行COVID-19家庭调查）。构建了一个贝叶斯网络模型，并利用Python库程序化地绘制了这些变量之间的条件依赖关系。调查回复根据共同特征分组为常见变量，并通过z-score标准化作为贝叶斯网络中的节点。通过将贝叶斯网络扩展为影响图来识别干预措施。

conclusion: 本研究强调了有针对性的经济和粮食安全措施在减轻大流行社会经济影响方面的关键作用，并为制定未来的应对和恢复工作提供了宝贵的见解，最终目标是增强描笼涯的韧性和应对未来公共卫生危机的准备。

title: Towards Robust Semantic Video Transmission over Block Erasure Channels
authors: Nargis Fayaz, Homa Esfahanizadeh, Matin Mortaheb, Jinfeng Du, Harish Viswanathan
abstract: This paper investigates semantic-aware neural joint source-channel coding (JSCC) for robust video transmission over block erasure channels. We propose a neural video compression framework exploring both spatial-domain and feature-domain designs. In the spatial domain, video frames are partitioned into blocks, enabling localized erasure handling and fine-grained robustness control via uniform erasure and two-level, semantic-guided non-uniform erasure strategies. In the feature domain, latent features are partitioned, enabling missing features to be semantically recovered while maintaining overall spatial consistency. Comprehensive experiments quantify reconstruction quality under varying uniform and non-uniform erasure probabilities. Our results show that spatial-domain JSCC excels at handling random localized losses, whereas feature-domain JSCC provides superior robustness to distributed erasures and maintains fidelity under low-loss scenarios. The analysis highlights the trade-offs between spatial continuity and semantic redundancy, offering insights for designing robust, task-aware video communication systems.
comment: accepted and will be presented at IEEE VTC FALL 2026
zh_title: 面向块擦除信道的鲁棒语义视频传输
translation: 本文研究了用于在块擦除信道上进行鲁棒视频传输的语义感知神经联合源信道编码（JSCC）。我们提出了一种神经视频压缩框架，探索了空间域和特征域设计。在空间域中，视频帧被划分为块，通过均匀擦除和两级语义引导非均匀擦除策略，实现局部擦除处理和细粒度鲁棒性控制。在特征域中，潜在特征被划分，使缺失特征能够被语义恢复，同时保持整体空间一致性。全面的实验量化了在不同均匀和非均匀擦除概率下的重建质量。我们的结果表明，空间域JSCC擅长处理随机局部损失，而特征域JSCC对分布式擦除提供了卓越的鲁棒性，并在低损耗场景下保持高保真度。该分析强调了空间连续性和语义冗余之间的权衡，为设计鲁棒、任务感知的视频通信系统提供了见解。
tldr: 本文研究了一种用于在块擦除信道上进行鲁棒视频传输的语义感知神经联合源信道编码（JSCC）框架，该框架结合了空间域和特征域设计，以处理局部损失和分布式擦除。
ai_comments: 这项工作在语义视频传输领域具有创新性，通过结合空间域和特征域设计，为在不稳定的信道条件下提高视频传输的鲁棒性提供了新的思路。特别是对不同域处理不同类型损失的分析，为未来的任务感知型通信系统设计提供了宝贵的见解。
motivation: 在块擦除信道上实现鲁棒的语义视频传输。
method: 本文提出了一种神经视频压缩框架，结合了空间域和特征域设计。在空间域中，视频帧被分成块，通过均匀擦除和两级语义引导非均匀擦除策略实现局部擦除处理和细粒度鲁棒性控制。在特征域中，潜在特征被划分，使缺失特征能够被语义恢复，同时保持整体空间一致性。
results: 空间域JSCC擅长处理随机局部损失，而特征域JSCC对分布式擦除具有卓越的鲁棒性，并在低损耗场景下保持高保真度。
conclusion: 空间连续性和语义冗余之间存在权衡，这为设计鲁棒、任务感知的视频通信系统提供了见解。

title: Tree-based solution representations for quadratic bilinear systems and their consequences in model order reduction
authors: Martin Redmann
abstract: We investigate quadratic bilinear systems by developing novel tree-based representations of their solutions. The proposed framework decomposes the solution into a sequence of coupled bilinear subsystems whose components admit explicit expansions indexed by full binary trees. These representations yield sufficient conditions for the existence of global solutions and lead to new output bounds in terms of reachability Gramians. Motivated by these estimates, we introduce time-limited and infinite-horizon reachability and observability Gramians, establish sufficient conditions for their existence, and characterize them through nonlinear matrix equations. The associated Gramians are employed to identify dominant state-spaces and to derive exact reduced-order models obtained by removing Gramian kernels. Building on these results, we develop a balanced truncation method for quadratic bilinear systems and prove an error bound for the reduced-order approximation. The proposed framework provides a unified connection between tree-based solution representations, nonlinear Gramian theory, and balanced truncation for quadratic bilinear systems, closing several theoretical gaps in the analysis of Gramian-based model reduction for this class of systems.
zh_title: 二次双线性系统的基于树的解表示及其在模型降阶中的应用
translation: 我们通过开发其解的新型基于树的表示来研究二次双线性系统。所提出的框架将解分解为一系列耦合的双线性子系统，其分量通过完整二叉树进行显式展开。这些表示为全局解的存在性提供了充分条件，并根据可达性Gramian产生了新的输出界限。受这些估计的启发，我们引入了时间受限和无限视界可达性与可观测性Gramian，建立了它们存在性的充分条件，并通过非线性矩阵方程对其进行表征。相关的Gramian用于识别主导状态空间并通过移除Gramian核获得精确的降阶模型。在此基础上，我们开发了一种二次双线性系统的平衡截断方法，并证明了降阶近似的误差界限。所提出的框架在二次双线性系统的基于树的解表示、非线性Gramian理论和平衡截断之间提供了统一的连接，弥补了此类系统Gramian模型降阶分析中的几个理论空白。
tldr: 本文研究了二次双线性系统，开发了基于树的解表示，引入了新的可达性/可观测性Gramian，并基于此提出了一种平衡截断模型降阶方法，弥补了理论空白。

motivation: 该研究的动机是利用新的输出界限估计，引入时间受限和无限视界可达性及可观测性Gramian，并解决二次双线性系统Gramian模型降阶分析中的几个理论空白。
method: 本文通过开发其解的新型基于树的表示来研究二次双线性系统。该框架将解分解为一系列耦合的双线性子系统，其分量通过完整二叉树进行显式展开。在此基础上，引入了时间受限和无限视界可达性与可观测性Gramian，并通过非线性矩阵方程对其进行表征。这些Gramian用于识别主导状态空间并推导出精确的降阶模型。最后，开发了一种二次双线性系统的平衡截断方法。
results: 研究结果包括：基于树的解表示为全局解的存在性提供了充分条件，并产生了基于可达性Gramian的新输出界限。建立了时间受限和无限视界可达性与可观测性Gramian的存在性充分条件，并通过非线性矩阵方程对其进行了表征。利用相关Gramian识别了主导状态空间并导出了精确的降阶模型。为二次双线性系统开发了平衡截断方法，并证明了降阶近似的误差界限。
conclusion: 该论文的结论是，所提出的框架在二次双线性系统的基于树的解表示、非线性Gramian理论和平衡截断之间提供了统一的连接，弥补了此类系统基于Gramian的模型降阶分析中的几个理论空白。

title: Kime-Representation Formulations of Three Open Problems in the Foundations of Classical Mechanics: Uncertainty, Invariant Entropy, and Directional Degrees of Freedom
authors: Ivo D. Dinov
abstract: We give mathematically self-contained formulations, in the complex-time (kime) representation, of three open problems from the foundations of classical mechanics: (I) the extension of the classical entropic uncertainty principle to non-canonical variables and to multiple degrees of freedom; (II) the characterization of coordinate-invariant measures and entropies, i.e., the question of why continuous physical quantities must be paired for an invariant entropy to exist; and (III) the construction of a classical relativistic directional degree of freedom (a classical analogue of a spin-1/2 system). Throughout, the kime phase is interpreted {statistically as a latent circular random variable whose law Φmodels the intrinsic trial-to-trial variability of repeated, identically controlled experiments indexed by the kime magnitude. The mathematical bridge is an exact symplectic identification of the kime cone with the action-angle chart of a one-degree-of-freedom phase space, under which the kime measure is the Liouville measure and the phase law becomes the angular conditional of a Liouville density. Specifically, we (i) prove a sharp entropic uncertainty relation on the kime cylinder whose extremal family is von Mises x Gaussian, together with a sharp circular Fisher-information inequality saturated exactly by von Mises laws; (ii) prove an exact non-canonical uncertainty relation in which the correction term is the geometric mean of the Poisson bracket, clarifying the conjectured role of the expected bracket; (iii) prove aggregate multi-degree-of-freedom bounds via the Williamson normal form and Fischer's inequality, and isolate the per-degree-of-freedom refinement as a precise open problem of symplectic Schur-Horn type; (iv) prove that diffusion of the kime phase produces monotone entropy growth with the equipartitioned (Haar-uniform) phase law.
zh_title: 经典力学基础中的三个开放问题的Kime表示公式：不确定性、不变熵和方向自由度
translation: 我们以复时间（kime）表示法，对经典力学基础中的三个开放问题进行了数学上自洽的阐述：(I) 将经典熵不确定性原理扩展到非正则变量和多自由度；(II) 表征坐标不变的度量和熵，即为什么连续物理量必须成对才能存在不变熵的问题；以及 (III) 构建一个经典相对论方向自由度（经典自旋-1/2系统的模拟）。在整个过程中，kime相位被统计地解释为一个潜在的循环随机变量，其定律 Φ 模拟了由kime量级索引的重复、相同控制实验的内在逐次试验变异性。数学上的桥梁是将kime锥与单自由度相空间的动量-角度图精确地辛识别，在此之下，kime测度是刘维尔测度，相位定律成为刘维尔密度的角度条件。具体来说，我们 (i) 证明了kime圆柱上的一个尖锐熵不确定关系，其极值族是von Mises x Gaussian，同时证明了一个恰好由von Mises定律饱和的尖锐圆形费雪信息不等式；(ii) 证明了一个精确的非正则不确定关系，其中修正项是泊松括号的几何平均值，澄清了预期括号的推测作用；(iii) 通过威廉姆逊范式和费雪不等式证明了聚合多自由度界限，并将每个自由度的细化分离为一个精确的辛舒尔-霍恩型开放问题；(iv) 证明了kime相位的扩散会产生伴随均分（Haar均匀）相位定律的单调熵增长。
tldr: 本文在复时间（kime）表示中，对经典力学基础中的三个开放问题进行了数学上自洽的阐述和解决，这些问题涉及不确定性、不变熵和经典相对论方向自由度（经典的自旋-1/2系统模拟）。
