zh_title: PORTS：面向大语言模型工具选择的偏好优化检索器
translation: 将外部工具与大语言模型（LLMs）集成已成为完成复杂任务的一种有前途的范式。由于LLMs在有效管理大型工具集方面仍面临困难，研究人员已开始探索基于检索的方法来预选最相关的选项，以解决输入长度和延迟限制。然而，现有的检索器由于训练过程分离，往往与工具调用LLMs不匹配。本文提出了PORTS，一种用于训练工具选择检索器的创新优势比偏好优化方法。通过使用来自冻结LLM的困惑度启发偏好信号，我们的方法通过优化选择概率与下游性能之间的相关性，同时联合强制文档字符串之间的对比语义损失，微调检索器以找到有用的工具。PORTS的多功能性及其显著提高工具选择准确性的能力，通过在六个数据集、两个编码器模型和三个具有不同先验知识的LLM上的大量实验得到了证明。凭借低计算需求，我们的对齐过程促进了对新查询和工具的泛化，证明了其在具有不断发展的工具集的实际应用中的价值。
tldr: PORTS通过一种新的偏好优化方法对检索器进行微调，使其与LLM在工具选择任务上对齐，从而在保持低计算成本的同时提高了工具检索的准确性。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入偏好优化（Preference Optimization）来弥合检索器与下游大模型在工具调用任务中的偏差，这是一个非常巧妙且实用的思路。其创新之处在于利用冻结LLM的困惑度作为偏好信号，无需额外的人工标注，且计算成本较低，具有很好的落地潜力。
motivation: 现有的检索增强方法在处理大规模工具集时，检索器与下游工具调用LLM的训练过程分离，导致两者之间存在偏差，影响了工具选择的准确性。
method: 提出PORTS方法，利用冻结LLM的困惑度作为偏好信号，通过优化工具选择概率与下游性能之间的相关性，并结合文档字符串的对比语义损失，对检索器进行微调。
results: 在六个数据集、两种编码器模型和三种不同LLM上的实验表明，PORTS能显著提升工具选择的准确性，且计算开销低，对新查询和工具具有良好的泛化能力。
conclusion: PORTS通过基于偏好的优化策略，有效解决了工具检索器与下游LLM之间的对齐问题，显著提升了工具选择的准确性和泛化能力。

title: A Heisenberg Subdivision Scheme with Central Smoothness Loss
authors: Hassan Ugail, Alfonso Carriazo
abstract: We introduce an interpolatory subdivision scheme for control polygons that take values in the three-dimensional Heisenberg group, the simplest noncommutative model geometry. The scheme keeps existing points at every refinement step and inserts new ones by a coordinate rule whose central correction comes from the group law. The two horizontal coordinates are refined by the classical four-point scheme of Dyn, Gregory and Levin, while the central coordinate acquires a closed-form correction built from a signed area of neighbouring horizontal data. Our main finding concerns the regularity of the limit curve. The horizontal part is exactly the classical four-point limit and inherits its smoothness. The central part behaves very differently. We prove that it converges to a continuous limit that belongs to the Zygmund class, with a logarithmic modulus of continuity. Under an explicit and verifiable condition on the central forcing, this logarithmic bound is sharp, because the scaled first differences then grow linearly with the refinement level, and the limit fails to be continuously differentiable. The effect is confirmed numerically. The correction is harmless at any single refinement step, but its repeated injection at every scale is what impacts smoothness. The example serves as a caution for nonlinear and group-valued subdivision, where a geometrically natural correction can impact regularity.

title: BitFair: A 12nm Bit-Serial CNN Accelerator with Learnable Early Termination and Adaptive Bit Ordering for Ultra-Low-Power XR Vision
authors: Ang Li, Chang Gao
abstract: Extended Reality (XR) wearables require always-on perception within tight power envelopes of a few watts and motion-to-photon latency budgets below 20 ms, leaving only a few milliseconds for neural-network inference. Bit-serial computing is attractive for such energy-efficient neural network acceleration, but many existing architectures still process all bits even when ReLU sets the final output to zero. This paper presents BitFair, a software-hardware co-designed bit-serial CNN accelerator with learnable bit-level early termination and adaptive bit ordering, working under the ultra-low-power and strict latency requirements of XR applications. BitFair exploits dynamic bit-level sparsity by learning per-layer thresholds that trigger early termination when partial sums reliably predict that the final ReLU output will be zero. Furthermore, it searches for layer-wise bit orders that prioritize informative bits, maximizing early termination without sacrificing accuracy. A GlobalFoundries 12nm FinFET implementation with a core area of 0.34 mm^2, 104 KB on-chip memory, and voltage scaling from 0.55 to 0.70 V achieves sub-millisecond latency, up to 117.0 BTOPS/W, and 0.07 pJ/SOP. On IBM DVS128 Gesture and N-MNIST, BitFair achieves 96.5% and 97.7% accuracy, respectively, while improving effective energy efficiency by 4.0-22.1x and accuracy by up to 9.2% over prior fabricated XR vision accelerators.

title: Geometry-Aware Infrastructure-Anchored Denoiser for UWB Sensing and Work-Zone Reconstruction
authors: Weizhe Tang, Jiaxi Liu, Junwei you, Steven T.Parker, Pei Li, Sikai Chen, Meng Ran, Bin Ran
abstract: Accurate work-zone geometry perception is critical for intelligent transportation systems, and ultra-wideband sensing offers a low-cost approach for infrastructure-aided reconstruction. However, outdoor UWB ranging is often degraded by non-line-of-sight propagation, burst noise, and long-tail errors, which can distort downstream spatial reconstruction. We present GAIA, a geometry-aware, infrastructure-anchored learning framework that couples temporal range modeling with latent anchor-layout estimation and deterministic distance projection. GAIA preserves range denoising as the supervised task while orienting the learned distances toward boundary-consistent reconstruction. We evaluate GAIA on a real-world outdoor UWB dataset with synchronized UWB, GNSS, and IMU measurements, and further test robustness using a real-data-calibrated stress-test simulator. GAIA achieves the lowest overall range MSE and highest polygon IoU among evaluated filtering-based and learning-based baselines, reducing MSE by 18.4% and improving polygon IoU by 15.5% over PoseMLP. These results show that geometry-aware range denoising provides an effective path toward spatially coherent work-zone reconstruction.

title: iSTAR: an algebraic-collapse framework for variational reduction in quantum-inspired continuous Ising solvers
authors: Bowen Liu, Dongmei Xiao
abstract: Continuous Ising solvers embed a discrete optimization problem into a continuous dynamical system and recover the spin configuration by sign readout, but dense interaction evaluation gives an $O(N^2)$-per-step cost. We show that this cost is not intrinsic: during late-stage simulated bifurcation the trajectory collapses onto a lower-dimensional active subspace, and saturated coordinates can be eliminated exactly by a variational frozen-set identity whose couplings fold into an induced field on the unresolved subsystem. We prove large-parameter recovery for the external-field quartic model, the hard-box limit of ballistic confinement, and a robust-margin freezing criterion. The resulting algorithm, iSTAR (Ising Stable-set Tail-Aware Reduction), exploits this collapse by detecting stabilized coordinates and continuing only on the active tail. An online certified implementation on the G-set benchmark preserves the same-seed baseline in all runs and removes on average 64.4% of the dense interaction work.
zh_title: iSTAR：一种用于量子启发式连续Ising求解器变分约简的代数坍缩框架
translation: 连续Ising求解器将离散优化问题嵌入到连续动力系统中，并通过符号读出恢复自旋配置，但稠密交互评估导致每步存在O(N^2)的计算成本。我们证明了这种成本并非内在的：在模拟分叉的后期，轨迹会坍缩到低维活跃子空间，饱和坐标可以通过变分冻结恒等式精确消除，其耦合会折叠到未解析子系统的诱导场中。我们证明了针对外场四次模型、弹道约束的硬盒极限以及稳健裕度冻结准则的大参数恢复能力。由此产生的算法iSTAR（Ising稳定集尾部感知约简）通过检测稳定坐标并仅在活跃尾部继续计算来利用这种坍缩。在G-set基准测试上的在线认证实现表明，该算法在所有运行中均保持了相同的基准结果，并平均消除了64.4%的稠密交互工作量。
tldr: iSTAR框架通过识别并剔除演化过程中的稳定变量，在不牺牲精度的情况下，将连续Ising求解器的计算量平均降低了约64%。
ai_comments: 该论文通过揭示连续Ising求解器在后期演化中的低维结构特性，提出了一种代数坍缩框架。其创新点在于将复杂的动态系统简化为更小规模的子系统，在保证精度的同时显著降低了计算复杂度，为大规模组合优化问题提供了一种高效的启发式求解思路。
motivation: 连续Ising求解器在处理稠密交互时存在每步O(N^2)的高额计算成本，作者旨在探索这一成本是否具有内在不可避免性，并寻求降低计算开销的方法。
method: 提出iSTAR算法，利用变分冻结恒等式检测并消除稳定的坐标，将剩余的耦合折叠到未解析的子系统中，仅对活跃的尾部进行持续演化。
results: 在G-set基准测试中，iSTAR在保持与基准线相同结果的同时，平均减少了64.4%的稠密交互计算工作量。
conclusion: iSTAR框架成功利用了Ising求解器在演化后期的低维坍缩特性，通过变分冻结策略有效降低了计算开销，并在保持求解质量的前提下实现了显著的性能提升。

title: Quaternion-Averaging-Based Adaptive Complementary Filter for Pedestrian Dead Reckoning With a Foot-Mounted AHRS
authors: Shunsei Yamagishi, Lei Jing
abstract: Pedestrian Dead Reckoning (PDR) can be applied to indoor navigation systems. GPS suffers from signal degradation due to roofs and high-rise buildings, whereas PDR can estimate positions without being affected by such signal degradation. The accuracy of a foot-mounted AHRS(Attitude and Heading Reference System)-based PDR depends on the accuracy of the attitude estimation algorithm used in the AHRS. In this article, a Quaternion-Averaging-Based Adaptive Complementary Filter (QAACF) for PDR with a foot-mounted AHRS is proposed to improve estimation accuracy while reducing computational cost. QAACF fuses a quaternion derived from angular velocity with quaternions derived from acceleration and magnetic field measurements using Markley's quaternion averaging, which combines two quaternions more rigorously than linear interpolation. In addition, QAACF adaptively adjusts the weights of angular velocity, acceleration, and magnetic field measurements according to gait phases and the level of magnetic disturbances. Experimental results showed that the proposed QAACF achieves low Root Mean Square Errors (RMSEs) compared to existing attitude estimation filters while requiring lower computational cost than Kalman filters.

title: The Granularity Paradox: How Temporal Disaggregation Inflates In-Sample Fit and Compounds Out-of-Sample Error
authors: Hugo Moreira
abstract: This paper explores the "Granularity Paradox" in time-series forecasting, wherein finer temporal disaggregation (e.g., Monthly to Weekly/Daily) improves in-sample diagnostics and dataset size (N), but degrades out-of-sample accuracy due to recursive error compounding over longer horizons (H). Conversely, coarse aggregation (Annual) eliminates recursive error propagation but reduces data available to estimators. We formalize this trade-off and benchmark 10 models - spanning naïve, statistical, machine learning, and deep learning architectures - across six granularities using a 13-year public procurement dataset. The empirical results reveal a non-monotonic threshold structure: recursive autoregressive and seasonal models degrade substantially under high-frequency forecasting (e.g., Holt-Winters reaches a Test R-squared of -151 and TPFE of 425.85% at the Daily grain), while the LSTM traces a U-shaped error curve, worsening from Monthly (19.66%) through Bi-Weekly (35.94%) before overcoming the error propagation penalty at Daily (TPFE of 4.35%, R-squared of 0.66). Linear Regression remains stable across all granularities (16.3-17.0% TPFE), confirming that the paradox is driven by recursive feedback topology, not model complexity. The results demonstrate that standard pointwise metrics (RMSE, MAE) systematically mask cumulative error propagation, and that evaluating forecasts without goal-dependent cumulative metrics produces misleading assessments of model adequacy. We introduce a consensus-dissensus diagnostic comparing the directional behaviour of pointwise metrics against cumulative TPFE across granularities, enabling the identification of models whose standard diagnostics mask systematic error propagation.

title: Neuromorphic Silicon Neuron Controller for Adaptive Deep Brain Stimulation in Parkinson's Disease
authors: Md Abu Bakr Siddique, Jakub Orłowski, Yan Zhang, Hongyu An
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) affects millions worldwide and causes severe motor symptoms. Adaptive deep brain stimulation (aDBS) delivers physiologically informed stimulation that can track fluctuations in PD motor symptoms, enabling more intelligent DBS control. However, most existing aDBS approaches are primarily algorithm- and software-driven, with limited efforts toward circuit realization, particularly low-power and implantable integrated circuits. This paper presents the Silicon Leaky Integrate-and-Fire Deep Brain Stimulation (SiLIF-DBS) controller, a neuromorphic silicon neuron stimulator implemented with metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) technology. For system-level evaluation, a simplified computational model of the SiLIF-DBS controller is derived and embedded within a Parkinsonian cortico-basal ganglia framework for closed-loop validation. The system is driven by beta-band subthalamic nucleus local field potentials (STN-LFPs), with their average rectified value (Beta ARV) used as the control biomarker. Our SiLIF-DBS controller for aDBS suppresses pathological beta activity while consuming only 25% of the power required by open-loop stimulation and achieving a suppression efficiency of $5.85\%$/$μ$W. Overall, our SiLIF-DBS controller achieves strong beta suppression at substantially reduced power, delivering high suppression efficiency that demonstrates it is a viable foundation for low-power implantable aDBS.

title: Publishing Without Journals: An Open, Forkable Archive with Attributed Review
authors: Matthew Lorig
abstract: The journal is a seventeenth-century technology asked to do four modern jobs at once: disseminate results, certify their quality, allocate scholarly attention, and confer career credit. It does none of them well. Pre-publication peer review is slow, only weakly reliable, demonstrably biased toward established authors and institutions, and expensive, while the reviewing effort it consumes is spent largely on work that will never matter. We argue that these are not defects to be patched but consequences of bundling dissemination and certification into a single gated act, and we propose unbundling them. Under the proposal, authors deposit papers in an open archive; certification happens \emph{after} deposit, continuously, through attributed and up- or down-voted public commentary to which authors may reply; and papers are version-controlled objects that any qualified reader may \emph{fork}, so that the lineage of an idea -- and hence the credit for it -- is recorded automatically. None of the individual components is speculative: each already exists somewhere in the scholarly ecosystem. The contribution here is to argue that assembling them into a single venue that \emph{replaces} rather than supplements the journal is both feasible and preferable, and to confront the objections -- sparse participation, the chilling effect of real names, the loss of the certification signal, and the non-meritocratic distribution of attention -- that any honest version of the argument must answer.

title: Exogenous Dropout: A Simple, Strong Baseline for Corruption-Robust Time Series Forecasting with Covariates
authors: Hao Hu, Xue-shan Ai
abstract: Time series forecasters that use exogenous covariates are fragile in deployment: when those covariates are noised, temporally misaligned, or missing, strong exogenous-fusion and exogenous-adapted models can degrade far above the endogenous-only floor. We study whether such robustness requires specialized architectures, or whether it can be obtained through a simple training intervention. We propose exogenous dropout, a model-agnostic method that randomly zeros whole exogenous channels during training. Across electricity-price forecasting, reservoir hydrology, and meteorology, exogenous dropout substantially improves robustness under Gaussian noise, temporal misalignment, and fully missing channels, while preserving clean accuracy. Applied to a dual-correlation network, it yields the most robust model in our experiments, outperforming a deliberately strong bounded architectural foil, BoundEx, which combines a learnable gate, a fallback residual to the endogenous backbone, and per-channel exogenous FiLM modulation. Architecture-by-dropout ablations, gate-behavior diagnostics, and a representation-level bound show that explicit architectural boundedness is not necessary for this robustness: an unbounded model trained with exogenous dropout is more robust than the bounded model in every domain. We release a corruption-robustness benchmark and recommend exogenous dropout as a simple, strong baseline for future work on time series forecasting with covariates.
zh_title: 外源Dropout：一种用于含协变量的时间序列预测中提升鲁棒性的简单且强大的基准方法
translation: 使用外源协变量的时间序列预测模型在部署时非常脆弱：当这些协变量出现噪声、时间错位或缺失时，强大的外源融合和外源适配模型可能会退化到远低于仅使用内源数据的基准水平。我们研究了这种鲁棒性是否需要专门的架构，还是可以通过简单的训练干预来获得。我们提出了外源Dropout，这是一种与模型无关的方法，在训练期间随机将整个外源通道置零。在电力价格预测、水文和气象领域，外源Dropout在面对高斯噪声、时间错位和完全缺失通道的情况下显著提高了鲁棒性，同时保持了清洁数据的预测精度。应用于双相关网络时，它产生了实验中最鲁棒的模型，优于经过精心设计的强架构基准BoundEx（结合了可学习门控、残差回退和逐通道FiLM调制）。架构与Dropout的消融实验、门控行为诊断及表示层界限分析表明，显式的架构约束对于这种鲁棒性是不必要的：使用外源Dropout训练的无界模型在每个领域都比有界模型更鲁棒。我们发布了一个鲁棒性基准，并建议将外源Dropout作为未来含协变量时间序列预测工作的简单强基准。
tldr: 提出了一种名为“外源Dropout”的简单训练策略，通过在训练中随机丢弃外源特征，显著提升了时间序列模型在面对噪声和数据缺失时的鲁棒性，无需复杂架构设计。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种极简但极其有效的训练干预方法，挑战了“提升鲁棒性需要复杂架构设计”的传统观念。其核心贡献在于证明了通过简单的Dropout策略即可在多种现实场景中实现超越复杂架构的鲁棒性，为时间序列预测领域提供了一个强有力的基准。
motivation: 现有利用外源协变量的时间序列预测模型在面对噪声、时间错位或数据缺失时表现脆弱，性能甚至会低于仅使用内源数据的模型，且目前尚不清楚这种鲁棒性是否必须依赖复杂的架构设计。
method: 提出“外源Dropout（Exogenous Dropout）”方法，在训练过程中随机将整个外源协变量通道置零，使模型在面对噪声、时间错位或缺失数据时表现出更强的鲁棒性。
results: 在电力价格、水文和气象三个领域的实验表明，外源Dropout在保持原始数据预测精度的同时，显著提升了模型在各种干扰下的鲁棒性，且性能优于复杂的BoundEx架构。
conclusion: 显式的架构约束对于提升时间序列预测的鲁棒性并非必要；通过在训练期间随机丢弃外源特征通道，可以以极低的成本显著提升模型在噪声、错位及缺失数据下的鲁棒性。

title: Learning to Control LLM Agent Harnesses with Offline Reinforcement Learning
authors: Haiwen Yi, Xinyuan Song
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are usually improved by changing prompts, models, or hand-written workflows, while the execution harness around the model is treated as fixed infrastructure. We argue that this harness is itself a learnable control layer. We formalize harness operation as a finite-horizon Harness MDP, where a lightweight controller selects structural execution actions while the LLM executor remains frozen. The controller is trained from offline rollouts using advantage-weighted regression with only terminal task-rubric rewards. We also separate final task quality from a post-hoc Harness Maturity Score, which measures whether the harness follows reliable execution patterns rather than only whether the final answer is correct. This separation gives a finite-buffer view of harness learning: final-quality gains require high-return support in the offline buffer, while process behavior can shift whenever it aligns with advantage-weighted actions. Across six controlled domains and two public-benchmark adapters, the learned controller consistently improves verification behavior and selectively improves final task quality, with the largest gains on adapted tau-bench retail, adapted AgentBench DB-Bench, and coding with a calibrated structural verifier. Ablations against behavior cloning and Forced CHECK show that the gains are not explained by imitation or by simply adding checks. These results identify harness control as a learnable layer for frozen LLM agents, while showing that offline support limits when better process control becomes better final answers.

title: Empirical Minimal-Realisation Compression of Deep Neural Networks via Controllability-Observability Tests
authors: Anis Hamadouche, Amir Hussain
abstract: Deep neural networks often contain substantial hidden-state redundancy, but most compression methods operate directly on weights, neurons, or quantised representations without explicitly characterising the dynamical role of internal states. This paper proposes a controllability-observability framework for empirical state-order reduction of deep neural networks. By viewing a trained network as a depth-indexed nonlinear dynamical system, we construct data-driven reachability, observability, and balanced Gramians from hidden-state snapshots and output Jacobians. The resulting A/B/C tests estimate layer-wise reachable, observable, and jointly reachable--observable ranks. These ranks are then used not only as diagnostic measures of hidden-state redundancy, but also as actual compressed layer widths for realised reduced networks. Experiments on MNIST and CIFAR-10 compare the proposed balanced realisation against projection-based reduction, unstructured pruning, structured pruning, low-rank SVD, dynamic INT8 quantisation, and linear baselines. On MNIST, a four-layer SiLU DNN is reduced from state order 1024 to 277, giving 72.95% state compression and 73.48% parameter compression, while maintaining 95.45% accuracy compared with 96.60% for the full model. On CIFAR-10, a larger SiLU DNN is reduced from state order 4608 to 1339, giving 70.94% state compression and 83.09% parameter compression, while preserving accuracy from 54.45% to 54.44% and reducing CUDA inference latency by approximately 3X. The results show that balanced reachable-observable ranks provide a principled empirical minimal-realisation criterion for designing compact neural architectures with little or no loss in accuracy.

title: Prompt-to-Paper: Agentic AI System for Bioinformatics
authors: Ramsha Kamran, Maheera Amjad, Zartasha Mustansar, Arsalan Shaukat, Salma Sherbaz, Muhammad U.S. Khan
abstract: While recent advances in large language models have enabled end-to-end automated manuscript generation, existing systems suffer from three critical deficiencies: (i) generated claims are not deterministically grounded in verifiable literature, (ii) experimental results are frequently fabricated rather than executed, and (iii) there exists no standardized, multi-dimensional framework to assess whether AI-generated manuscripts meet the quality and rigor required for real-world publication. We present Prompt-to-Paper, a multi-agent framework that directly addresses this evaluation gap through three integrated innovations. First, a deterministic retrieval-augmented generation pipeline with section-aware relevance scoring and snowball citation expansion grounds every claim in a verifiable corpus of 60--100 papers. Second, an autonomous coding agent executes real computational biology experiments replacing synthetic outputs with genuine numerical results. Third, an eight-dimensional automated quality scorer, benchmarked with approximate reference statistics from published papers and augmented with explicit hallucination penalties, provides standardized, reproducible quality assessments. The quality-driven improvement loop uses a context-rich reviser that routes each iteration to one of three researcher actions and fires a deep research cycle every ten iterations to re-run experiments and re-manuscript from stronger outputs. We validate the system on five bioinformatics case studies; all five cases compiled submission-formatted PDFs with zero out-of-range citations. The improvement loop raises manuscript quality by an average of +17.96 points on a 0--100 scale (maximum +26.04. As partial external checks, a human reviewer scored the five manuscripts at an average of 7.0 out of 10. Complete manuscripts are produced at approximately 0.31 USD per paper.
zh_title: Prompt-to-Paper：用于生物信息学的代理AI系统
translation: 尽管大型语言模型的最新进展已经实现了端到端的自动化论文生成，但现有系统存在三个关键缺陷：(i) 生成的论点缺乏可验证文献的确定性支撑；(ii) 实验结果往往是编造的而非实际执行的；(iii) 缺乏标准化的、多维度的框架来评估AI生成的论文是否达到真实出版所需的质量和严谨性。我们提出了 Prompt-to-Paper，这是一个通过三项集成创新直接解决评估差距的多智能体框架。首先，一个具有分段相关性评分和雪球引用扩展的确定性检索增强生成流水线，将每个论点建立在60-100篇可验证论文的语料库上。其次，一个自主编程智能体执行真实的计算生物学实验，用真实的数值结果取代合成输出。第三，一个八维自动化质量评分器，通过已发表论文的参考统计数据进行基准测试，并增加了明确的幻觉惩罚，提供标准化、可重复的质量评估。质量驱动的改进循环使用一个富含上下文的修订器，将每次迭代路由到三个研究员操作之一，并在每十次迭代中触发一次深度研究循环，以重新运行实验并从更强的输出中重新撰写论文。我们在五个生物信息学案例研究中验证了该系统；所有五个案例都编译了符合提交格式的PDF，且引用零错误。改进循环使论文质量平均提高了17.96分（0-100分量表，最高提升26.04分）。作为部分外部检查，人工审稿人对这五篇论文的平均评分为7.0分（满分10分）。每篇论文的完整制作成本约为0.31美元。
tldr: Prompt-to-Paper 是一个多智能体系统，通过真实实验执行和严格的文献溯源，实现了高质量、低成本的生物信息学论文自动化生成。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入多智能体架构和确定性检索增强生成，有效解决了AI论文写作中的幻觉和不可验证性问题，尤其是将代码执行集成到写作流程中，大大提升了生物信息学领域AI生成论文的科学严谨性。
motivation: 现有的大语言模型自动生成论文系统存在三个主要缺陷：生成内容缺乏可验证的文献支撑、实验结果往往是编造的而非实际执行的、缺乏用于评估论文质量和严谨性的标准化框架。
method: 提出了 Prompt-to-Paper 多智能体框架，包含三个核心创新：1. 基于确定性检索增强生成（RAG）的文献引用系统；2. 能够自动执行计算生物学实验并生成真实数值结果的自主编程智能体；3. 包含8个维度的自动化质量评分与迭代改进循环系统。
results: 在五个生物信息学案例中，该系统成功生成了符合提交格式的PDF，引用准确率达100%。通过迭代改进，论文质量评分平均提升17.96分，人类评审平均得分7.0/10，且单篇生成成本仅约0.31美元。
conclusion: Prompt-to-Paper 系统通过多智能体协作、实验代码自动执行和多维度质量评估，实现了高质量、可验证的生物信息学论文自动生成。

title: Evaluating calibrated refusal and safe usefulness in dual-use biology settings
authors: Edwin H. Wintermute, Harmon Bhasin, Christina M. Agapakis, Dianzhuo Wang, Evan Seeyave, Arjun Banerjee, Daniel Fulop, Matthew C. Watson, Adam J. Meyer, Sandrine Boissel, Jens H. Kuhn, Rishi Jain, Noah D. Taylor, Helena Shomar, Patrick M. Boyle, Kenny Workman
abstract: As AI agents are incorporated into life science workflows, the capabilities that speed discovery might also enable misuse. We present BioSecBench-Refusal, a benchmark for risk identification and refusal behavior for biological research tasks. The benchmark pairs 61 Routine tasks, legitimate analyses adapted from the published literature, with 46 Red-Team tasks, fictional scenarios that resemble real research but conceal a biosecurity hazard. Across 16 model-harness configurations, refusal rates ranged from 7\% to 74\% on Routine tasks and 1\% to 62\% on Red-Team tasks, with many configurations refusing legitimate Routine work at comparable or higher rates than concealed hazards. Refusals were most often triggered by provider API filters applied prior to agentic reasoning. However, models given room to reason showed the potential to identify more real threats. We release BioSecBench-Refusal as a tool for model developers to calibrate capability and caution for agentic biotech R\&D.
zh_title: 评估双用途生物学环境下的校准拒绝与安全有用性
translation: 随着AI代理被纳入生命科学工作流，加速发现的能力也可能导致误用。我们提出了BioSecBench-Refusal，这是一个用于生物研究任务风险识别和拒绝行为的基准。该基准将61个常规任务（改编自已发表文献的合法分析）与46个红队任务（伪装成真实研究但隐藏生物安全风险的虚构场景）配对。在16种模型配置中，常规任务的拒绝率为7%至74%，红队任务的拒绝率为1%至62%，许多配置拒绝合法常规工作的比例与拒绝隐蔽危害的比例相当甚至更高。拒绝行为通常是由代理推理前应用的提供商API过滤器触发的。然而，给予模型推理空间的模型显示出识别更多真实威胁的潜力。我们发布BioSecBench-Refusal作为工具，供模型开发者校准代理生物技术研发中的能力与谨慎性。
tldr: 本文推出了BioSecBench-Refusal基准，发现当前AI模型在处理生物研究任务时，往往因外部过滤器干扰而无法准确区分常规科研与生物安全风险，导致过度拒绝或防御不足。
ai_comments: 该论文通过构建BioSecBench-Refusal基准，揭示了当前AI模型在生物安全领域面临的“过度拒绝”与“防御不足”的双重困境。其创新点在于将常规科研任务与隐蔽生物风险任务进行对比，强调了模型在拒绝策略上的校准需求，对AI在生命科学领域的安全落地具有重要参考价值。
motivation: 随着AI代理在生命科学工作流中的应用日益广泛，如何在提升科研发现速度的同时，防止其被用于生物安全误用，成为了一个亟待解决的问题。
method: 开发了BioSecBench-Refusal基准，包含61个常规科研任务和46个隐蔽生物安全风险任务，并在16种模型配置下测试了其拒绝率与推理表现。
results: 测试显示模型拒绝率波动极大（7%-74%），且许多配置对常规科研任务的拒绝率甚至高于对隐蔽危险任务的拒绝率；研究发现API过滤器往往是拒绝的主要触发因素，而给予模型推理空间能显著提升其识别真实威胁的能力。
conclusion: 目前的AI模型在生物研究任务中缺乏有效的拒绝校准，过度依赖外部API过滤器而非模型自身的推理能力，导致了有用性与安全性之间的失衡。

title: AdaStop: Cost-Aware Early Stopping for DNN Test Selection
authors: Bonan Shen, Wei-Jung Huang, Xin Liu, Jiazhou Gao, Tao Ning
abstract: Existing methods for testing deep neural networks (DNNs) primarily prioritize test inputs likely to reveal model faults under a fixed labeling budget. In practice, choosing that budget is difficult: too little testing misses failures, while too much incurs unnecessary labeling costs. This work studies the stopping problem in DNN testing. We formulate testing as a cost--benefit decision process in which labeling an input incurs cost $c$ and discovering a fault yields value $v$. Based on this formulation, we introduce \textit{AdaStop}, a framework that estimates the marginal fault discovery rate during testing and stops labeling when the estimated rate falls below the threshold $τ= c/v$. Experiments across multiple datasets, architectures, and selection strategies show that $65$--$84\%$ of faults can be discovered using only $9$--$31\%$ of the labeling budget.
zh_title: AdaStop：用于DNN测试选择的成本感知提前停止方法
translation: 现有的深度神经网络（DNN）测试方法主要是在固定标注预算下优先选择可能揭示模型缺陷的测试输入。在实践中，确定该预算非常困难：预算太少会遗漏缺陷，而预算太多则会产生不必要的标注成本。本文研究了DNN测试中的停止问题。我们将测试制定为一个成本-效益决策过程，其中标注一个输入会产生成本c，而发现一个缺陷会产生价值v。基于这一公式，我们引入了AdaStop，这是一个在测试期间估计边际故障发现率，并在估计比率低于阈值τ= c/v时停止标注的框架。跨多个数据集、架构和选择策略的实验表明，仅使用9%-31%的标注预算即可发现65%-84%的缺陷。
tldr: AdaStop通过动态估算边际故障发现率，在DNN测试达到最优成本效益点时自动停止，显著降低了测试成本。
ai_comments: 该研究巧妙地将DNN测试问题转化为成本-效益决策问题，引入了基于边际故障发现率的动态停止机制。其创新之处在于无需人工设定固定的标注预算，能够显著降低测试成本，在实际工程应用中具有很高的价值和通用性。
motivation: 现有的DNN测试方法往往依赖预设的固定标注预算，这在实际中难以设定，会导致测试不足或成本浪费。
method: 提出AdaStop框架，将测试过程建模为成本-效益决策过程，通过估算边际故障发现率，并在其低于设定阈值（成本/收益比）时自动停止测试。
results: 在多个数据集和模型架构上的实验表明，该方法仅需9%-31%的标注预算即可发现65%-84%的故障。
conclusion: AdaStop通过动态评估边际故障发现率，有效地解决了DNN测试中的成本与收益平衡问题，在显著节省标注预算的同时保持了高故障发现率。

title: Learnable Weighting of Intra-Attribute Distances for Categorical Data Clustering with Nominal and Ordinal Attributes
authors: Yiqun Zhang, Yiu-ming Cheung
abstract: The success of categorical data clustering generally much relies on the distance metric that measures the dissimilarity degree between two objects. However, most of the existing clustering methods treat the two categorical subtypes, i.e. nominal and ordinal attributes, in the same way when calculating the dissimilarity without considering the relative order information of the ordinal values. Moreover, there would exist interdependence among the nominal and ordinal attributes, which is worth exploring for indicating the dissimilarity. This paper will therefore study the intrinsic difference and connection of nominal and ordinal attribute values from a perspective akin to the graph. Accordingly, we propose a novel distance metric to measure the intra-attribute distances of nominal and ordinal attributes in a unified way, meanwhile preserving the order relationship among ordinal values. Subsequently, we propose a new clustering algorithm to make the learning of intra-attribute distance weights and partitions of data objects into a single learning paradigm rather than two separate steps, whereby circumventing a suboptimal solution. Experiments show the efficacy of the proposed algorithm in comparison with the existing counterparts.
zh_title: 用于标称和序数属性分类数据聚类的属性内距离可学习加权方法
translation: 分类数据聚类的成功在很大程度上依赖于衡量两个对象之间相异程度的距离度量。然而，大多数现有的聚类方法在计算相异度时，将标称和序数这两种分类子类型同等对待，而没有考虑序数属性值的相对顺序信息。此外，标称属性和序数属性之间可能存在相互依赖关系，这对于揭示相异度具有重要意义。因此，本文将从类似图的视角研究标称和序数属性值的内在差异和联系。据此，我们提出了一种新的距离度量方法，以统一的方式衡量标称和序数属性的属性内距离，同时保留序数属性值之间的顺序关系。随后，我们提出了一种新的聚类算法，将属性内距离权重的学习和数据对象的划分整合到一个单一的学习范式中，而不是两个单独的步骤，从而避免了次优解。实验结果表明，与现有同类方法相比，该算法具有显著的有效性。
tldr: 提出了一种统一的分类数据聚类算法，通过联合优化属性距离权重和聚类划分，有效处理标称与序数属性的差异及顺序信息。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将标称属性和序数属性的距离度量统一化，并引入了可学习的权重机制，通过将权重学习与聚类过程集成，有效避免了传统两步法产生的次优解问题，具有较强的实用价值。
motivation: 现有分类数据聚类方法未充分区分标称与序数属性的本质差异（特别是序数属性的顺序信息），且忽略了属性间的相互依赖性，导致距离度量不够准确，且传统的两步法易陷入次优解。
method: 提出了一种基于图视角的统一距离度量方法，用于衡量标称和序数属性的属性内距离，并设计了一种将属性内距离权重学习与数据对象聚类划分集成在单一范式中的新型聚类算法。
results: 实验结果表明，该算法在处理包含标称和序数属性的数据集时，聚类效果优于现有的对比方法。
conclusion: 提出了一种能够同时处理标称和序数属性的统一聚类框架，通过联合优化距离权重和聚类划分，显著提升了分类数据的聚类性能。

title: CanvasAgent: Enabling Complex Image Creation and Editing via Visual Tool Orchestration
authors: Hairui Zhu, Yiying Yang, Tengjin Weng, Ziyu Lu, Xiao Yao, Xiaoyang Ye, Lin Ma, Wenhao Jiang
abstract:
Complex image creation and editing often require more than a single generation or editing model. A user request may involve synthesizing images, localizing objects, segmenting regions, editing selected content, compositing intermediate assets, reading text, and enhancing the final result. Such tasks shift multimodal agents from perception-augmented reasoning to manipulation-centered visual creation, where tools must actively transform visual states rather than merely inspect them. However, existing multimodal tool-use agents are mostly optimized for perception, search, or domain-specific editing, and lack large-scale supervision for executable image-creation trajectories. In this paper, we introduce CanvasCraft, a large-scale multimodal tool-use dataset for complex image creation and editing, and \textbf{CanvasAgent}, a tool-augmented multimodal agent that learns to orchestrate heterogeneous visual tools through multi-turn interaction. CanvasCraft contains 140K fully annotated executable trajectories and 10K
  RL task specifications. CanvasAgent is first trained with SFT to learn executable reasoning-action trajectories, and is then optimized with GRPO using a hybrid reward that combines outcome- and process-level signals. During rollout, CanvasAgent inspects intermediate results, tracks visual assets, and adapts tool decisions to the evolving visual state. Experiments evaluate both final image quality and trajectory behavior, demonstrating the effectiveness of CanvasAgent and the proposed dataset for complex multi-tool image creation workflows.
zh_title: CanvasAgent：通过视觉工具编排实现复杂的图像创作与编辑
translation: 复杂的图像创作和编辑往往不仅仅需要单一的生成或编辑模型。用户的请求可能涉及合成图像、定位对象、分割区域、编辑选定内容、合成中间资产、读取文本以及增强最终结果。这些任务将多模态智能体从感知增强推理转向以操作为中心的视觉创作，其中工具必须主动改变视觉状态，而不仅仅是检查它们。然而，现有的多模态工具使用智能体大多针对感知、搜索或特定领域的编辑进行了优化，缺乏用于可执行图像创作轨迹的大规模监督。在本文中，我们介绍了CanvasCraft，一个用于复杂图像创作和编辑的大规模多模态工具使用数据集，以及CanvasAgent，一种工具增强的多模态智能体，它学习通过多轮交互来编排异构视觉工具。CanvasCraft包含140K完全标注的可执行轨迹和10K强化学习任务规范。CanvasAgent首先通过SFT训练以学习可执行的推理-动作轨迹，然后使用结合了结果级和过程级信号的混合奖励通过GRPO进行优化。在执行过程中，CanvasAgent检查中间结果，跟踪视觉资产，并根据不断变化的视觉状态调整工具决策。实验评估了最终图像质量和轨迹行为，证明了CanvasAgent和所提出的数据集对于复杂的多工具图像创作工作流的有效性。
tldr: CanvasAgent利用大规模数据集CanvasCraft和强化学习技术，学会了如何协同多种视觉工具来完成复杂的图像创作任务。
ai_comments: 该论文填补了多模态智能体在复杂图像编辑领域缺乏大规模可执行轨迹数据的空白。通过引入CanvasCraft数据集和基于GRPO的强化学习优化，CanvasAgent在处理需要多工具协同的复杂视觉任务上表现出了更强的鲁棒性和适应性，将智能体的能力从感知向主动的视觉操作转化。
motivation: 现有的多模态智能体主要侧重于感知、搜索或特定领域的编辑，缺乏处理复杂图像创作任务所需的工具编排能力及大规模可执行轨迹监督。
method: 构建了包含140K可执行轨迹和10K强化学习任务规范的CanvasCraft数据集；采用监督微调（SFT）进行初步训练，随后利用包含结果和过程导向信号的混合奖励函数，通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）进一步优化CanvasAgent。
results: 实验结果表明，CanvasAgent在复杂的多工具图像创作工作流中表现出色，能够有效提升最终图像质量并优化创作轨迹行为。
conclusion: CanvasAgent通过结合大规模高质量数据集与混合奖励优化策略，成功实现了复杂图像创作任务中的多工具编排，为多模态智能体在视觉创作领域的应用提供了有效范式。

title: Learning 4D Geometric Priors for Inference-Efficient World Action Models
authors: Jianjun Zhang, Jian Zhu, Taiyi Su, Chong Ma, Zitai Huang, Yi Xu, Hanli Wang
abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have shown strong potential for robotic manipulation by jointly modeling visual future dynamics and executable action sequences. However, existing video-action co-training methods primarily optimize appearance-oriented video latents, which may insufficiently capture the temporally evolving geometry required for precise manipulation. We propose MECo-WAM, a Multi-Expert Co-Training World Action Model that injects action-relevant 4D geometric priors into video-action representations while preserving the original lightweight inference graph. During training, MECo-WAM combines video and action experts with a lightweight 4D expert supervised by relational targets from a frozen VGGT encoder. Asymmetric expert visibility prevents non-causal shortcuts from auxiliary geometry to action generation. To transfer geometric knowledge into the deployed video-action pathway, we introduce decayed 4D read-mask attention, which provides restricted current-frame geometric guidance early in training and progressively removes this dependency. We further propose action-aware temporal geometric distillation, which aligns within-frame geometric relations and their temporal evolution while emphasizing visual regions most relevant to robot actions. At deployment, all auxiliary 4D components are removed. Experiments on LIBERO (98.2%), RoboTwin 2.0 (92.6%), and challenging real-world manipulation tasks show that MECo-WAM improves manipulation performance without increasing inference cost.

title: Breaking Structural Isolation: Scalable Graph Clustering via Community-Aware Sampling and Structural Entropy
authors: Jingyun Zhang, Hao Peng, Jianxin Li, Angsheng Li, Philip S. Yu
abstract: Unsupervised graph clustering is a fundamental technique for uncovering underlying semantic patterns in large-scale networks. Although Graph Contrastive Learning has demonstrated promising performance, existing methods often suffer from the "structural isolation" issue during mini-batch training, making it challenging to capture cohesive community structures that characterize the global topological distribution. To address these challenges, we propose SCISE, a Scalable unsupervised graph Clustering framework that preserves structural Integrity by synergizing community-aware sampling with constrained Structural Entropy. Specifically, we first introduce the Structural Entropy Community Constraint operator (SECC), which optimizes structural information within a constrained solution space to mitigate community fragmentation and enhance partition cohesion. Second, to prevent global information loss during batch training, we design a Community-Aware Sampling Expansion (CSampE) mechanism that incorporates the community context of target nodes into sampling batches, effectively breaking structural barriers and preserving topological integrity. Finally, we devise a Structural Contrastive Learning (StructCL) module that refines edge weights based on intra-batch structural similarity, guiding the encoder to learn representations in a higher-order structural space. Extensive experiments on six mainstream benchmark datasets demonstrate that SCISE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art algorithms, with ablation studies and robustness analyses further validating its effectiveness and reliability for real-world large-scale graphs.
comment: Accepted to the Proceedings of the VLDB Endowment (VLDB 2026). 18 pages, 15 figures, 15 tables

title: A Task-Driven Evaluation of UAV Detection and Tracking under Synthetic Fog
authors: Amir Pouladi, Vesal Ahsani, Haijun Li, Homayoun Najjaran, Afzal Suleman
abstract: Fog severely degrades the visibility of small unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in skydominant, long-range imagery, reducing the reliability of downstream detection and tracking. This paper presents a task-driven evaluation framework that links depth-aware synthetic fog generation, image restoration, object detection, and tracking within a unified pipeline. Given the practical difficulty of collecting and annotating foggy UAV scenes, synthetic fog is generated from real clear-weather outdoor images containing UAV targets using monocular depth estimation and the atmospheric scattering model. Representative restoration methods from classical, convolutional neural network (CNN)-based, and transformer-based families are first compared, after which the selected restoration model is integrated into the downstream perception pipeline. Detection is evaluated under both clean-only and fog-inclusive training regimes using multiple detector variants, while tracking-by-detection is assessed on clean, foggy, and restored video sequences. Beyond image-level restoration metrics, the study evaluates how fog and restoration affect detection robustness and tracking performance. The results show that fog substantially degrades both detection and tracking, primarily through increased missed detections. Fog-inclusive training provides the most consistent improvement in robustness, whereas test-time restoration is most beneficial when the detector has been trained only on clean imagery. These findings show that restoration quality does not necessarily translate into proportional gains in downstream perception and therefore should be evaluated jointly with detection and tracking performance.
zh_title: 基于任务驱动的合成雾环境下无人机检测与跟踪评估
translation: 雾霾严重降低了天空背景下远距离无人机（UAV）的可见度，从而降低了下游检测和跟踪任务的可靠性。本文提出了一个任务驱动的评估框架，将深度感知合成雾生成、图像恢复、目标检测和跟踪链接在一个统一的流水线中。鉴于收集和标注雾天无人机场景的实际困难，本文利用单目深度估计和大气散射模型，从包含无人机目标的真实晴天室外图像中生成合成雾。首先比较了来自经典、基于卷积神经网络（CNN）和基于Transformer系列的代表性恢复方法，随后将选定的恢复模型集成到下游感知流水线中。在仅包含清晰图像和包含雾的训练机制下，使用多种检测器变体评估检测性能，并在清晰、雾天和恢复后的视频序列上评估跟踪性能。除了图像级的恢复指标外，本研究还评估了雾和恢复过程对检测鲁棒性和跟踪性能的影响。结果表明，雾霾主要通过增加漏检率严重降低了检测和跟踪性能。包含雾的训练提供了最稳健的性能提升，而当检测器仅在清晰图像上训练时，测试时恢复最为有益。这些发现表明，恢复质量并不一定转化为下游感知性能的成比例提升，因此应与检测和跟踪性能进行联合评估。
tldr: 本文通过合成雾数据评估了去雾算法对无人机检测和跟踪的影响，发现去雾质量与感知性能并不直接挂钩，提出了任务驱动的联合评估策略。
ai_comments: 该研究的重要贡献在于强调了图像恢复指标（如PSNR等）与下游任务（目标检测与跟踪）性能之间的不一致性。这提醒研究人员在评估去雾算法时，不能仅关注视觉质量，必须将其置于实际任务流水线中进行联合评估。局限性在于研究依赖于合成雾，可能与真实复杂大气环境存在偏差。
motivation: 雾霾严重影响了天空背景下远距离无人机的可见度，导致检测与跟踪性能下降，且获取真实雾天无人机标注数据极其困难，因此需要建立一个科学的评估框架来量化雾对感知系统的影响及去雾方法的有效性。
method: 构建了一个统一的评估框架，通过单目深度估计和大气散射模型从清晰图像生成合成雾；对比了经典、CNN及Transformer类去雾方法；并在清洗/雾天训练集下，评估了不同去雾模型对目标检测与跟踪性能的影响。
results: 雾霾主要导致漏检率增加，从而严重影响跟踪稳定性；雾天包含训练（Fog-inclusive training）比测试时去雾能提供更稳健的性能提升；当检测器仅在清晰图像上训练时，测试时去雾效果最显著。
conclusion: 研究表明，去雾算法的质量并不直接等同于下游感知性能的提升。对于部署在真实任务中的系统，雾天训练（Fog-inclusive training）比单纯的测试时去雾更为稳健，且应采取联合评估策略。

title: KAT-Coder-V2.5 Technical Report
authors: Bo Huang, Fengxiang Li, Hao Xu, Haoyang Huang, Hongyi Fu, Jinhua Hao, Kun Yuan, Minglei Zhang, Pengcheng Xu, Shiyang Liu, Wenhao Zhuang, Yuze Shi, Zongxian Feng, Chao Wang, Cheng He, Chongling Rao, Deyu Cao, Fan Yang, Gang Xiong, Haochen Liu, Jiabao Li, Jian Liang, Jinghui Jia, Jingwen Chang, Jun Du, Junyu Shi, Min Li, Mingqi Wu, Qiang Gao, Shangpeng Yan, Shaotong Qi, Shu Xu, Shuo Zhou, Tiankuo Xu, Tong Zheng, Weilun Zhao, Xiancheng Meng, Xianda Sun, Xiaoyu Jiang, Xunhao Jia, Yao Xia, Yimeng Xu, Yinghan Cui, Yingpeng Chen, Yiwen Ning, Yong Wang, Yuxuan Sun, Zhongsheng Liu, Ming Sun, Cheng Luo, Chen Yang, Han Li, Kun Gai
abstract: We present KAT-Coder-V2.5, a coding-focused agentic model trained to act autonomously inside real, executable repositories rather than as a single-turn code generator. Its capability is bottlenecked less by model scale than by the scarcity of reproducible environments, verifiable rewards, and high-value trajectories, which we address with an end-to-end agentic post-training framework. AutoBuilder reconstructs multilingual repositories into sandboxed environments with fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass verification at scale, from which we regenerate self-contained task specifications, recover near-miss trajectories, and distill supervision through process-aware filtering, while KwaiClawEnv synthesizes large-scale tool-use trajectories from executable services and real task seeds. We further scale reinforcement learning with harness randomization, a reliability-hardened sandbox, an asymmetric actor--critic PPO with hindsight-augmented value estimation, and a harness-oriented reward framework, and unify SWE, Agent-Claw, and WebCoding experts via Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation. Across six software-engineering and agentic benchmarks, KAT-Coder-V2.5 delivers the best agentic tool-use result on PinchBench and ranks second only to the frontier Opus 4.8 on repository-level software engineering. Our service is available at https://streamlake.com/product/kat-coder.

title: ShadowProbe: Language-Extensible Detection of Hidden Algorithmic Complexity Vulnerabilities
authors: Yuanmin Xie, Xiangfan Wu, Wenhao Wu, Lingyun Ying, Puzhuo Liu, Haipeng Qu, Zhongyuan Chen, Min Zhou, Chengnian Sun
abstract:
Algorithmic Complexity Vulnerabilities (ACVs) arise when adversarial inputs trigger worst-case execution behavior, causing severe performance degradation or Denial-of-Service conditions. A key but underexplored source is shadow complexity: non-trivial computational costs hidden inside seemingly benign standard library APIs. Because these costs are invisible at call sites, attackers can exploit them to induce unexpected superlinear runtime behavior. Existing ACV detectors often rely on fuzzing, symbolic execution, or hybrid analysis, but they are usually language-specific, require substantial manual effort to construct harnesses, and depend on heavy runtime instrumentation.
  We present ShadowProbe, a scalable and language-extensible framework for discovering ACVs through lightweight static analysis, automated reconstruction of execution contexts, and Large Language Model (LLM) assisted test generation. ShadowProbe uses a structured multi-stage pipeline: it statically screens for candidate functions guided by shadow-complexity signals, reconstructs minimal executable contexts from project-level symbols, and synthesizes size-controlled inputs to probe worst-case behavior. It then validates candidates using execution-time measurements and robust statistical growth inference, separating true algorithmic blowups from runtime noise such as garbage collection and JIT compilation effects.
  We evaluate ShadowProbe on the WISE benchmark, where it consistently improves analysis efficiency over existing approaches. We further apply it to large-scale systems including CPython, the JDK, Zig, Rustc, and vLLM, uncovering many previously unknown ACVs, many of which have been confirmed and partially remediated by maintainers. These results show that ShadowProbe can identify hidden algorithmic risks across diverse real-world codebases.

title: Binocular Gaze Estimation with Single Camera and Single Light Source
authors: Tongbing Huang, Yang Fu, Yunfei Wang, Zhaocan Wang
abstract: According to commonly consented theories, the minimum hardware requirement for gaze tracker is one camera and two light sources to realize gaze estimation with free head movements. However, in some scenarios such as eye tracking on mobile devices, it is preferable to use less components, especially light sources. We propose a gaze estimation method with one camera and one light source. A "virtual light source" is introduced, which is geometrically placed symmetrically to the real light source with respect to the camera, and generates a "virtual glint" in the acquired image. We estimate the "virtual glint" by exploiting the relationship between the distance between two pupils and two glints in the captured image, and estimate the gaze with polynomial regression assuming two light sources are available. A new normalization factor for regression method is verified, which turns out to be practical for one-glint system. The performance is proved to be acceptable, while degradation is noticed compared to system with two actual light sources.

title: Is Your NPU Ready for LLMs? Dissecting the Hidden Efficiency Bottlenecks in Mobile LLM Inference
authors: Guanyu Cai, Ruiming Tian, Lang Yang, Zhouhong Ren, Jinliang Yuan, Lingkun Li, Jiliang Wang
abstract: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) on mobile devices enhances privacy and reduces latency, but is severely bottlenecked by hardware inefficiency. We present the first comprehensive, cross-layer measurement study of mobile LLM inference, uniquely spanning five mainstream frameworks (e.g., llama.cpp, GENIE) and three hardware backends (CPU, GPU, NPU). To enable this analysis, we develop PowerBench, a fine-grained profiling tool that provides the first backend-specific energy attribution, moving beyond traditional device-level measurements. Our study yields three critical insights: (1) Framework-induced performance gaps are substantially amplified on NPUs, reaching up to 10x using custom operators due to divergent offloading and quantization strategies. (2) We identify a distinct phase split where NPUs excel at compute-bound prefilling, while CPUs outperform all other backends in memory-bound decoding. This is driven by the NPU's preference for large, fixed-shape workloads, which conflicts with the small-kernel, dynamic nature of decoding. (3) Backend-specific profiling uncovers substantial scheduling headroom missed by prior work. Suboptimal thread configurations, uncoordinated NPU sleep latencies, and CPU polling intervals result in up to 40% energy waste. Leveraging these findings, we present an energy-oriented best-practice configuration for mobile LLM inference. We estimate that this configuration could reduce energy consumption by up to 54.8% on the NPU backend across three datasets.
zh_title: 您的NPU准备好运行LLM了吗？剖析移动端大模型推理中隐藏的效率瓶颈
translation: 在移动设备上部署大语言模型（LLM）可以增强隐私并降低延迟，但受到硬件效率低下的严重制约。我们提出了首个针对移动端LLM推理的全面跨层测量研究，涵盖了五种主流框架（如llama.cpp, GENIE）和三种硬件后端（CPU, GPU, NPU）。为了进行此分析，我们开发了PowerBench，这是一种细粒度分析工具，提供了首个后端特定的能量归因，超越了传统的设备级测量。我们的研究得出了三个关键见解：（1）框架导致的性能差距在NPU上被大幅放大，由于卸载和量化策略的差异，使用自定义算子时差距高达10倍。（2）我们识别出一个明显的阶段性差异，即NPU擅长计算密集型的预填充，而CPU在内存密集型的解码阶段优于所有其他后端。这是由NPU对大型、固定形状工作负载的偏好导致的，这与解码过程中小型核、动态性的本质相冲突。（3）后端特定的分析揭示了先前工作未发现的大量调度余量。线程配置不佳、NPU睡眠延迟未协调以及CPU轮询间隔导致了高达40%的能量浪费。利用这些发现，我们提出了一种面向能效的移动端LLM推理最佳实践配置。据估计，该配置在三个数据集上的NPU后端上可将能耗降低高达54.8%。
tldr: 通过开发PowerBench工具，本文揭示了移动端LLM推理中NPU在解码阶段的效率短板，并证明通过优化调度配置可显著提升能效。
ai_comments: 该论文填补了移动端大模型推理性能分析的空白，通过开发PowerBench工具实现了细粒度的后端能量归因。其核心创新在于揭示了NPU在处理动态解码任务时的固有局限性，并提出了基于负载特性的异构计算优化策略，对于移动端AI部署具有极高的工程参考价值。
motivation: 移动端部署大模型虽具隐私和延迟优势，但受限于硬件效率瓶颈，当前缺乏针对移动LLM推理的跨层、细粒度硬件性能测量与能效归因研究。
method: 开发了细粒度分析工具PowerBench，对五种主流框架和三种硬件后端（CPU, GPU, NPU）进行了跨层测量与能量归因研究，并对比了不同负载下的性能表现。
results: (1) 框架差异在NPU上被放大（高达10倍）；(2) NPU擅长计算密集型预填充，CPU擅长内存密集型解码；(3) 存在调度冗余，优化配置后能耗最高可降低54.8%。
conclusion: 研究表明，移动端LLM推理的效率瓶颈不仅源于硬件，更源于框架与硬件后端之间的调度不匹配。通过针对性的配置优化，可以显著降低功耗并提升推理效率。

title: Parameter-Free Encoders Remain Viable for RDB Foundation Models
authors: Linjie Xu, David Wipf
abstract: Given a relational database (RDB) storing heterogeneous tabular information, how can we predict missing (or future) values in some target column of interest? As the space of potential targets is vast across enterprise settings, it is preferable to avoid learning a new model from scratch each time there is a new prediction task. Frozen foundation models based on RDB-specific encoders provide a viable solution, but ideal design remains an open question. On the one hand, it has recently been argued that certain parameter-free subgraph encoders combined with single-table foundation models can achieve near SOTA performance, with no RDB-specific pre-training required. Meanwhile, other contemporary studies advocate for parameterized encoders pre-trained to exploit observable labels for learning task-specific representations. To address this ambiguity, we analyze RDB encoder properties specifically when labels are present as inputs, proving limitations on the potential efficacy of trainable encoder parameters. As empirical validation, we demonstrate that considerably simpler parameter-free encoders are still capable of strong performance across many relevant benchmarking tasks.
comment: ICML 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data
zh_title: 无参数编码器对于关系数据库基础模型依然可行
translation: 鉴于关系数据库（RDB）存储了异构的表格信息，我们如何预测目标列中缺失（或未来）的值？由于企业环境中潜在的目标空间非常广泛，每次出现新的预测任务时都避免从头学习新模型是更为理想的选择。基于RDB专用编码器的冻结基础模型提供了一种可行的解决方案，但其理想设计方案仍是一个开放性问题。一方面，最近有观点认为，某些无参数子图编码器与单表基础模型相结合，无需RDB专用预训练即可达到接近SOTA的性能。与此同时，其他当代研究则提倡使用经过预训练以利用可观测标签来学习任务特定表示的参数化编码器。为了解决这种模糊性，我们专门分析了当标签作为输入存在时RDB编码器的属性，证明了可训练编码器参数在潜在效能上的局限性。作为实证验证，我们证明了相当简单的无参数编码器在许多相关基准测试任务中仍然具备强大的性能。
tldr: 研究证明在关系数据库基础模型中，简单的无参数编码器不仅理论可行，在实际任务中也能达到与参数化编码器相当的强劲性能。
ai_comments: 该研究通过理论分析和实证验证，对当前关系数据库（RDB）基础模型中编码器设计的争议给出了有力回应。其创新点在于指出在存在标签信息时，参数化编码器的潜在局限性，并为更简单、高效的无参数编码器提供了强有力的支持，对简化工业界大规模数据库预测任务的部署具有重要参考价值。
motivation: 旨在解决当前RDB基础模型设计中的争议：即在面对多样的企业级预测任务时，究竟是应使用需要预训练的参数化编码器，还是更简单的无参数编码器。
method: 通过理论推导分析在存在标签作为输入时，RDB编码器参数对模型效能的限制；并通过多项基准测试任务进行实证验证，对比无参数编码器与参数化编码器的性能表现。
results: 理论分析证明了可训练参数在特定条件下的局限性，实证结果显示无参数编码器在多个基准测试中依然能够保持接近SOTA的强劲性能。
conclusion: 研究表明，在RDB基础模型中，无参数编码器不仅在理论上具有合理性，在实际任务中也表现出与参数化编码器相当的强劲性能，是构建此类模型时的一种可行且高效的选择。

title: InvWeaver: Deductive Feedback for Invariant Synthesis in Interacting-Loop Programs
authors: Guangyuan Wu, Weining Cao, Zehui Tan, Yuan Yao, Hengfeng Wei, Taolue Chen, Xiaoxing Ma
abstract: Loop invariant inference is a fundamental yet challenging problem in program verification. Recent LLM-aided guess-and-check techniques have shown strong performance on single-loop programs, but they often struggle with programs containing multiple interacting loops. This paper presents InvWeaver, a neuro-symbolic framework for synthesizing invariants for such programs. The key idea is to expose inter-loop dependencies and propagate proof obligations through a combination of loop-level abstraction, obligation-guided inference, and weakest-precondition-based refinement. We evaluate InvWeaver on a comprehensive benchmark suite, including a newly curated dataset derived from classic algorithms. Experimental results show that InvWeaver substantially outperforms existing invariant inference methods, solving 72 out of 82 multi-loop benchmark problems and maintaining strong performance on single-loop tasks.

title: Full-range Binary Classifier Calibration for Stable Model Updates in Production
authors: Konstantin Berlin
abstract: Detection models running in adversarial environments face a malicious distribution that drifts rapidly while the benign distribution stays comparatively stable, so teams retrain and redeploy constantly to stay ahead of new threats. Retraining tends to change the output prediction scores, which breaks downstream users of the model. For these security-oriented models we need consistent false-positive rate (FPR) across all output values, whereas standard probability-calibration methods target class probability rather than an FPR contract. We introduce a method built on top of existing calibration primitives that targets the whole FPR curve, giving scores a consistent FPR meaning across deployments. On one held-out split, the observed relative FPR error was at most 2.3% from 10% down to 0.1% FPR and 7.2% at 0.01% FPR. The shipped artifact remains under 200 KB in measurements across calibration sets from 1K to 10M benign samples.

title: Privilege and confidentiality in generative AI workflows
authors: Václav Janeček, Thomas Melham
abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) systems store and process client data in three distinct ways: in the model's parameters through training and memorisation, in the context window during a live session, and in knowledge databases for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Each mode creates different and often counter-intuitive risks to confidentiality and legal professional privilege, and each calls for specific governance responses. Drawing on the first English and American decisions to address privilege and generative AI, UK and Munir v Secretary of State for the Home Department and United States v Heppner, on the orthodox privilege authorities against which those decisions must be read, and on recent computer science research, we explain the three modes of data storage and processing in terms accessible to practitioners and analyse the legal consequences of each. We then situate the analysis within the regulatory framework governing solicitors in England and Wales and within the ordinary principles of professional negligence, arguing that the standard of effective information governance (and with it the benchmark against which negligence and misconduct will be measured) is changing. Although we write primarily for SRA-regulated practitioners, our data-governance analysis is framed to extend to any jurisdiction in which the protection of privilege or professional secrecy depends on demonstrable confidentiality. The ultimate aim of this article is to help legal services professionals understand salient data leakage risks in GenAI systems and thereby facilitate a more responsible deployment of GenAI on client data and other sensitive material.
zh_title: 生成式AI工作流中的特权与保密性
translation: 生成式AI系统通过三种不同的方式存储和处理客户数据：通过训练和记忆存储在模型参数中、在实时会话期间存储在上下文窗口中，以及存储在用于检索增强生成（RAG）的知识数据库中。每种模式对保密性和法律职业特权构成了不同且通常是反直觉的风险，每种模式都需要具体的治理响应。本文借鉴了英国和美国首批涉及特权与生成式AI的裁决（UK and Munir v Secretary of State for the Home Department案和United States v Heppner案），参考了这些裁决所依据的正统特权权威，并结合了最新的计算机科学研究，以从业者易于理解的方式解释了三种数据存储和处理模式，并分析了每种模式的法律后果。随后，我们将分析置于英格兰和威尔士律师的监管框架以及职业疏忽的一般原则内，论证有效信息治理的标准（以及衡量疏忽和不当行为的基准）正在发生变化。尽管本文主要针对受英国律师监管局（SRA）监管的从业者，但我们的数据治理分析旨在扩展到任何依赖可证明的保密性来保护特权或职业秘密的司法管辖区。本文的最终目的是帮助法律服务专业人士了解生成式AI系统中的显著数据泄露风险，从而促进在客户数据和其他敏感材料上更负责任地部署生成式AI。
tldr: 本文分析了生成式AI处理数据的三种模式对法律特权的影响，提醒法律从业者需更新信息治理标准，以应对AI带来的数据泄露风险。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将计算机科学中的数据存储模式（模型参数、上下文窗口、RAG数据库）与法律实践中的特权和保密性原则相结合。其重要性在于为法律从业者提供了针对生成式AI应用的具体治理框架，强调了在AI辅助工作流中维持职业保密性的新标准。局限性在于法律分析主要侧重于英格兰和威尔士的监管框架，尽管其数据治理分析具有普适性。
motivation: 生成式AI在处理法律数据时带来了复杂且反直觉的保密风险，法律从业者缺乏对这些技术风险及其法律后果的清晰理解，亟需建立符合职业道德和法律特权要求的AI部署准则。
method: 通过分析英美法律判例（如UK and Munir案和United States v Heppner案）、传统特权法理以及计算机科学中AI数据处理的三种模式（模型训练、上下文窗口、RAG），构建法律与技术交叉分析框架。
results: 明确了AI三种数据存储模式带来的不同法律风险，并指出法律从业者的信息治理标准正在演变，未达到该标准可能导致职业疏忽或不当行为。
conclusion: 生成式AI的使用正在改变法律行业对有效信息治理的定义，从业者必须理解AI不同数据处理模式下的保密风险，以避免违反职业特权和保密义务。

title: Decision Protocols in Multi-Agent Large Language Model Conversations
authors: Lars Benedikt Kaesberg
abstract: Improving the task performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential, yet scaling these models faces significant challenges such as diminishing returns and high costs. Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) offer a promising solution by distributing tasks among specialized agents to improve the overall task performance. This can reduce training costs at the expense of increased test time due to the discussion and decision-making process. The decision protocol is a critical component of MAS because it specifies how multiple agents collaborate to create a final solution. This thesis introduces the Multi-Agent LLM (MALLM) framework, which implements and evaluates various decision protocols, namely voting, consensus, and judge decision mechanisms, to simulate multi-agent discussions for conversational task solving. Unlike previous work that used a single decision protocol or tested them on limited datasets, this study systematically examines their impact on a diverse set of tasks, ranging from knowledge-based datasets (MMLU, MMLU-Pro, GPQA) and logic-based datasets (StrategyQA, MuSR, Math-lvl-5, SQuAD 2.0). The results indicate that consensus protocols excel in knowledge-intensive domains while voting and judge protocols are more effective for logic-based tasks. Increasing response diversity through independent solution generation improves decision quality, while changes in information access during the decision process have minimal impact.
zh_title: 多智能体大语言模型对话中的决策协议
translation: 提升大语言模型（LLM）的任务性能至关重要，但模型扩展面临收益递减和高昂成本等显著挑战。多智能体系统（MAS）通过将任务分配给专业智能体来提高整体性能，提供了一种有前景的解决方案。虽然这会因讨论和决策过程而增加测试时间，但可以通过降低训练成本来平衡。决策协议是MAS的核心组件，因为它规定了多个智能体如何协作以达成最终方案。本文介绍了多智能体大语言模型（MALLM）框架，该框架实现并评估了多种决策协议，即投票、共识和裁判决策机制，以模拟对话任务解决中的多智能体讨论。与以往仅使用单一决策协议或在有限数据集上进行测试的研究不同，本研究系统地考察了它们在多样化任务集上的影响，涵盖知识类数据集（MMLU, MMLU-Pro, GPQA）和逻辑类数据集（StrategyQA, MuSR, Math-lvl-5, SQuAD 2.0）。结果表明，共识协议在知识密集型领域表现优异，而投票和裁判协议在逻辑类任务中更有效。通过独立生成解决方案来增加响应多样性可提高决策质量，而决策过程中信息获取的变化影响微乎其微。
tldr: 该研究通过MALLM框架对比了投票、共识和裁判三种决策协议，发现不同协议在知识与逻辑任务中各有优势，且增加响应多样性可显著提升决策效果。
ai_comments: 该研究系统性地对比了不同决策协议在多智能体系统中的表现，弥补了现有研究仅关注单一协议的局限性，为构建更高效的多智能体对话系统提供了实证依据和设计指南。
motivation: 大模型单体扩展面临边际收益递减和高昂成本问题，多智能体系统通过任务分配可提升性能，但缺乏对不同决策协议在多样化任务中有效性的系统性研究。
method: 提出了MALLM（Multi-Agent LLM）框架，实现了投票（voting）、共识（consensus）和裁判（judge）三种决策协议，并在MMLU、StrategyQA等多个知识和逻辑类数据集上进行了系统性评估。
results: 研究发现共识协议在知识类任务中表现最佳，投票和裁判协议在逻辑类任务中更有效；提高独立解的多样性可提升最终决策质量，而决策过程中信息获取方式的改变影响有限。
conclusion: 不同决策协议在不同任务领域表现各异：共识协议更适合知识密集型任务，而投票和裁判协议在逻辑推理任务中表现更优。此外，增加响应多样性有助于提升决策质量。

title: PatchOptic for Shared-State LLM Workflows with Projected Views and Verified Structured Updates
authors: Zhaoyu Bai, Jiaqi Cai
abstract: Agentic workflows often operate over shared, structured state. Because LLM context windows are limited, each model invocation is typically shown only the state fragment needed for the current workflow step, a pattern commonly known as progressive disclosure. Modern systems construct such model-facing views using grep-like keyword search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), abstract-syntax-tree (AST) queries, and task-specific agent skills. These methods make the read side manageable, but they do not define when a locally proposed rewrite is valid after it is applied back to the full state. The missing piece is a contract between local updates and global validity. We introduce PatchOptic, an optic-inspired interface for shared-state LLM workflows. Optics are compositional bidirectional accessors that describe how views of structured data are read and updated. PatchOptic borrows this view/update intuition and realizes it through projected reads and verified structured patches. Each workflow step declares a projected read view, an authorized write region, and a patch-source region. Beyond runtime enforcement, the same declaration yields a path-level footprint that supports delegation, sub-workflow composition, and static certificates for reordering independent steps within the same phase. We evaluate this design with PatchBench, a benchmark with 46 cases across domains. The results show that projected reads reduce reported leakage and token cost while preserving accepted-output quality under the strong actor. Runtime verification blocks declared workflow-contract violations before commit, and patch-read enforcement rejects compromised patch artifacts that use hidden sources.

title: Ground3D-LMM: Fine-Grained 3D Point Grounding and Spatial Reasoning with LMM
authors: Amol Harsh, Zongyan Han, Jean Lahoud, Ye Liu, Rao Muhammad Anwer, Hisham Cholakkal, Salman Khan, Fahad Khan
abstract: Natural-language queries about 3D environments become actionable when responses are verifiable and metric. Verifiability requires explicit grounding to the referred 3D region, while metric answers report physical measurements in real-world units (e.g., size, thickness, clearance, and distance). Existing 3D large multimodal models (LMMs) approaches remain limited: conversational systems typically respond without explicit 3D grounding, while 3D grounding models are not designed for interactive, metric-aware dialogue. In this paper, we present Ground3D-LMM, a unified model that takes a point cloud and an optional RGB image as input and supports 3D spatial conversation with (i) point-grounded responses and (ii) metric numeric outputs at both object and part granularity, including multi-object queries. To evaluate this intersection of grounding and measurement, we define the 3D Grounded Measurement task, which requires predicting the referred 3D region and the corresponding metric quantities in real-world units. We introduce a large-scale dataset built on ScanNet and ScanNet++ datasets with dense object and part annotations and roughly 2.5M question-answer pairs spanning eight tasks, along with a manually verified test set. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets and tasks show that our proposed Ground3D-LMM model provides a strong baseline for grounded, metric-aware 3D conversational understanding. Our dataset and model are publicly available.

title: TypeGo: An OS Runtime for Embodied Agents
authors: Guojun Chen, Alex Schott, Lin Zhong
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can plan behavior for embodied agents from natural language, but treating the LLM as a request/response oracle on the critical path is fundamentally at odds with real-time control and concurrent goals. We argue for an operating-system-style runtime for embodied agents, and instantiate this idea in an early prototype, TypeGo. TypeGo structures LLM-based planning as asynchronous loops at multiple timescales that overlap with execution, and manages the agent's physical body like an OS manages hardware: the Skill Kernel arbitrates typed physical subsystems among concurrent per-task processes, a scheduler preempts them and resumes or replaces each by source, and speculative skill streaming hides LLM latency behind ongoing motion, while a fast first-action path yields visible feedback within a second. Users program behavior through natural language prescriptions that TypeGo dispatches to the LLM-based planners or compiles into low-latency interrupt handlers. Our prototype of Kalos, a Unitree Go2 quadruped, provides preliminary evidence for the design: in our current task suite, it cuts per-step delay by 50% over step-by-step planning and time-to-first-action by 73% over monolithic planning, while admitting concurrent tasks at low scheduling overhead.
zh_title: TypeGo：一种用于具身代理的操作系统运行时
translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）可以根据自然语言为具身代理规划行为，但将 LLM 视为关键路径上的请求/响应预言机与实时控制和并发目标是根本矛盾的。我们主张为具身代理提供一种操作系统风格的运行时，并实例化了这一构想的早期原型 TypeGo。TypeGo 将基于 LLM 的规划构建为与执行重叠的多时间尺度异步循环，并像操作系统管理硬件一样管理代理的物理实体：技能内核在并发任务进程间仲裁类型化的物理子系统，调度程序抢占并根据源代码恢复或替换它们，预测性技能流在持续运动中隐藏 LLM 延迟，而快速首动作路径在一秒内产生可见反馈。用户通过自然语言指令编程行为，TypeGo 将其分发给基于 LLM 的规划器或编译为低延迟中断处理程序。我们的 Kalos 原型（Unitree Go2 四足机器人）为该设计提供了初步证据：在当前的测试集中，它比逐步规划降低了 50% 的每步延迟，比单体规划缩短了 73% 的首动作时间，同时以低调度开销支持并发任务。
tldr: TypeGo 通过引入操作系统式的任务调度与实时处理机制，有效解决了 LLM 在机器人实时控制中的高延迟痛点，显著提升了响应速度与多任务并行能力。
ai_comments: TypeGo 创新性地将操作系统设计理念（如多任务调度、中断处理、资源仲裁）引入具身智能代理领域，解决了LLM推理延迟与实时控制需求之间的核心矛盾。其将LLM规划解耦为异步多时间尺度循环的设计极具前瞻性，为复杂环境下的机器人实时控制提供了有效的架构方案。
motivation: 大型语言模型作为请求/响应预言机在实时控制和并发任务执行中存在高延迟问题，无法满足具身代理对实时性的要求。
method: 构建了一个名为TypeGo的操作系统运行时，包含技能内核（Skill Kernel）进行物理资源仲裁、多时间尺度异步规划循环、任务调度器实现抢占与恢复、以及预测性技能流（speculative skill streaming）技术。
results: 在Unitree Go2四足机器人上进行的实验表明，TypeGo将每步延迟降低了50%，首动作响应时间缩短了73%，并支持低开销的并发任务执行。
conclusion: TypeGo 通过操作系统式的运行时管理，成功实现了具身代理的高效并发控制与低延迟响应，证明了在机器人领域引入OS架构的必要性。

title: Statistical Adversaries: Natural Backdoor-like Features in Vision Datasets
authors: Paul K. Mandal, Pavan Reddy, Tristan Malatynski
abstract: Model-specific adversarial attacks have been extensively studied. We study a different failure mode: naturally occurring statistical signals in vision data that can behave like backdoor-like triggers without being maliciously inserted. We call these signals statistical adversaries. We analyse Imagenet to find patterns that are strongly linked to certain labels. We then use statistical controls to remove random correlations from our candidate signals. Finally, we demonstrate that these signals directly and predictably alter model predictions. These statistical adversaries are more targeted than generic corruptions and transfer across different model architectures. This suggests that some vulnerabilities are driven by dataset structure and distribution rather than a single model's idiosyncrasies. We conclude that ordinary datasets can contain exploitable adversarial surfaces even in the absence of poisoning, and suggest that dataset audits should treat spurious structure not only as a source of bias or interpretability failure, but also as a latent attack surface for vision models.
zh_title: 统计对抗样本：视觉数据集中的天然后门特征
translation: 针对特定模型的对抗攻击已被广泛研究。我们研究了一种不同的失效模式：视觉数据中自然存在的统计信号，这些信号无需恶意插入即可表现出类似后门的触发器功能。我们称这些信号为“统计对抗样本”。我们分析了ImageNet以寻找与特定标签强相关的模式，随后利用统计控制方法剔除候选信号中的随机相关性。最后，我们证明这些信号能够直接且可预测地改变模型预测。这些统计对抗样本比一般的干扰更具针对性，且能在不同模型架构间迁移。这表明某些漏洞是由数据集结构和分布驱动的，而非单一模型的特异性所致。我们得出结论：普通数据集即使在没有投毒的情况下也包含可利用的对抗面，并建议数据集审计不仅应将伪结构视为偏差或可解释性失败的来源，还应将其视为视觉模型的潜在攻击面。
tldr: 研究发现视觉数据集中存在天然的“统计对抗样本”，无需恶意投毒即可导致模型产生可预测的预测偏差，这揭示了数据集结构本身即是模型的一种潜在攻击面。
ai_comments: 该研究揭示了视觉模型漏洞的一个根本性来源，即数据集本身固有的统计特征，而非仅仅是模型架构或恶意投毒的问题。这对于理解AI的安全性和鲁棒性具有重要意义，强调了数据集审计的必要性。
motivation: 研究人员旨在探讨视觉数据中是否存在类似于后门攻击的自然统计信号，即无需恶意插入即可导致模型预测失败的“统计对抗样本”。
method: 分析ImageNet数据集以识别与特定标签强相关的模式；利用统计控制方法剔除随机相关性；通过实验验证这些信号对不同模型架构预测结果的可预测影响。
results: 研究发现，视觉数据集中存在天然的统计对抗信号，这些信号能够跨模型架构转移，并以可预测的方式影响模型预测，证明了数据集结构本身就是一种潜在的攻击面。
conclusion: 数据集本身天然包含可被利用的“统计对抗样本”，即使在没有恶意投毒的情况下，这些伪相关性也会导致模型的预测偏差，需将其纳入模型安全审计的范畴。

title: Light-Omni: Reflex over Reasoning in Agentic Video Understanding with Long-Term Memory
authors: Chang Nie, Jiaju Wei, Junlan Feng, Chaoyou Fu, Caifeng Shan
abstract: Agentic video understanding equips models with long-term memory to autonomously process and respond to continuous, long-horizon multimodal streams. However, advanced video agents often rely on ``detective-style'' iterative reasoning for action control (e.g., $\mathtt{search}$) and evidence aggregation, incurring prohibitive costs and latency. We argue that such heavy reasoning primarily compensates for the lack of global context and semantic misalignment in retrieval. This paper introduces Light-Omni, a multimodal agent framework for reflexive and lightweight video understanding. It achieves this through dual contextual states that instantly build the required context in a single forward pass. First, we maintain a global state, a finite-sized multimodal script continuously consolidated from episodic memory, serving as the global context for Light-Omni. Through hierarchical merging, it preserves recent details while summarizing past events. Second, conditioned on this global context, we generate a parametric latent state that directly drives autonomous actions and produces retrieval embeddings, with minimal latency. Benefiting from this coupled design, Light-Omni achieves semantically aligned retrieval and reflexive responses while avoiding iterative reasoning. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of Light-Omni across multiple video benchmarks. Notably, it outperforms M3-Agent with an average 2.4% accuracy gain, a 12.1$\times$ speedup, and a 2.6$\times$ improvement in GPU memory efficiency. Furthermore, it serves as a memory system to enhance both the performance and efficiency of existing MLLMs. Project page: https://clare-nie.github.io/Light-Omni.
zh_title: Light-Omni：智能体视频理解中基于长时记忆的反射胜于推理机制
translation: 智能体视频理解通过赋予模型长时记忆，使其能够自主处理和响应连续、长时程的多模态流。然而，先进的视频智能体通常依赖“侦探式”迭代推理来进行动作控制（如搜索）和证据聚合，这导致了极高的成本和延迟。我们认为，这种繁重的推理主要是为了补偿全局上下文的缺失以及检索中的语义不对齐。本文介绍了 Light-Omni，一个用于反射式和轻量级视频理解的多模态智能体框架。它通过双重上下文状态在单次前向传播中即时构建所需的上下文。首先，我们维护一个全局状态，这是一个从情景记忆中不断整合的有限大小的多模态脚本，作为 Light-Omni 的全局上下文。通过分层合并，它在总结过去事件的同时保留了最近的细节。其次，以该全局上下文为条件，我们生成一个参数化潜状态，直接驱动自主动作并产生检索嵌入，延迟极低。受益于这种耦合设计，Light-Omni 实现了语义对齐的检索和反射式响应，同时避免了迭代推理。广泛的实验验证了 Light-Omni 在多个视频基准测试中的有效性。值得注意的是，它在准确率上比 M3-Agent 平均提升了 2.4%，速度提升了 12.1 倍，GPU 内存效率提高了 2.6 倍。此外，它还可以作为一种记忆系统，增强现有多模态大模型（MLLM）的性能和效率。项目主页：https://clare-nie.github.io/Light-Omni。
tldr: Light-Omni 提出了一种无需复杂迭代推理的轻量级视频智能体架构，通过双重上下文状态实现高效、实时的长视频理解。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于挑战了当前智能体依赖复杂迭代推理的范式，转而采用“反射式”机制。通过引入双重上下文状态（全局脚本和参数化潜状态），显著提升了处理长视频任务的实时性和效率。这种从计算密集型推理转向轻量级、实时响应的设计思路，为实时视频智能体的发展提供了重要参考。
motivation: 现有的视频智能体依赖“侦探式”迭代推理来处理长时视频，导致计算成本高、延迟大。作者认为这种重推理主要是为了弥补检索中全局上下文缺失和语义对齐不足的问题。
method: 提出 Light-Omni 框架，采用双重上下文状态：1. 全局状态（通过分层合并的有限多模态脚本，汇总历史信息）；2. 参数化潜状态（基于全局上下文，直接驱动动作和检索嵌入，实现单次前向传播响应）。
results: 在多项视频基准测试中表现优异，相比 M3-Agent，准确率提升 2.4%，速度提升 12.1 倍，GPU 显存效率提升 2.6 倍，并能作为增强其他多模态大模型（MLLM）的通用记忆系统。
conclusion: Light-Omni 通过双重上下文状态设计，成功实现了在无需复杂迭代推理的情况下进行高效、精确的视频理解，在性能、速度和资源消耗方面均优于现有方法。

title: $\mathbfλ$-VAE: Variance Equalization for Posterior Collapse
authors: Girum Demisse
abstract: Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) frequently suffer from posterior collapse, a failure mode in which the approximate posterior converges to the prior, rendering the latent code uninformative. Despite extensive research, a unified account of why collapse occurs has remained an open question. We identify and formalize two logically independent but coupled causes. \emph{Gradient imbalance} occurs when the decoder's reconstruction signal vanishes faster than the $\mathbb{KL}$ regularization pressure as the posterior widens. \emph{Information gap} occurs when the stochastic sampling step discards a substantial fraction of the encoder's computed representation, attenuating decoder sensitivity and making collapse inexpensive. Both causes share the same collapse trajectory, and we show that the information gap is algebraically equivalent to mismatch between the aggregate posterior and the prior, unifying two pathologies. Subsequently, we introduce $λ$-VAE, which resolves both causes through a single modification to the reparameterization step: the sampling noise is scaled by per-dimension exponent, while the $\mathbb{KL}$ penalty retains the original posterior variance. This asymmetry shifts the stable training attractor away from the degenerate collapsed state, driving all latent dimensions toward the same equilibrium -- a mechanism we term \emph{variance equalization}. A closed-form optimal exponent per dimension follows from a net information gain objective, with a single hyperparameter controlling the reconstruction-generation tradeoff. We validate on standard benchmarks (Binary MNIST, Binary Omniglot, CIFAR-10, CelebA-64), showing consistent reductions in collapsed dimensions, information capacity gains of up to $2.8\times$ nats, and reconstruction quality improvements of up to $+0.33$ BPD.

title: aiAuthZ: Off-Host, Identity-Bound Authorization for AI Agents
authors: Sai Varun Kodathala
abstract: AI agents issue tool calls on the basis of text they cannot verify, so any party who controls part of the context can forge the appearance of authority. I evaluate 15 contemporary language models against eight attack scenarios derived from a published corpus of real agent incidents and find that refusal varies from 100% down to 38% across fully evaluated models; the most expensive model refused only half of the attacks despite a twentyfold price spread. I present aiAuthZ, an authorization gateway that moves the safety decision off the agent's host. Before a tool call executes, the gateway verifies caller identity with a per-message HMAC-SHA256 signature bound to a single-use nonce and a timestamp window, and it evaluates a role-based and argument-level policy that the agent can neither read nor modify. Every decision joins a SHA-256 hash-chained audit log, and each accepted message yields an HMAC-authenticated QR receipt that achieves 94% mean verification across eight transmission channels, with zero forgeries accepted in 25 wrong-key trials. With the gateway in place, residual attack success falls to 0% for all 15 models at no more than 0.03 ms of added decision latency. On the AgentDojo banking suite, aiAuthZ blocks all seven attacker-directed tool calls the evaluated agents emit, at the cost of one legitimate first-time payment, while a spotlighting baseline allows two injections to succeed. Across nine in-scope case studies from the same incident corpus, aiAuthZ blocks nine of nine, against four of nine for a policy baseline without identity binding. The gateway does not prevent a model from being deceived; it prevents a deceived model from acting beyond the verified user's authority on every call routed through it. The implementation and all experiments are released at https://github.com/Sports-Vision-Inc/aiAuthZ.
zh_title: aiAuthZ：面向 AI 代理的离机、身份绑定式授权方案
translation: AI 代理基于无法验证的文本发布工具调用，因此任何控制部分上下文的人都可以伪造授权。我针对从已发布真实代理事件语料库中提取的八种攻击场景评估了 15 种当代语言模型，发现完全评估模型对攻击的拒绝率从 100% 到 38% 不等；尽管价格差异高达 20 倍，但最昂贵的模型也仅拒绝了一半的攻击。我提出了 aiAuthZ，这是一个将安全决策从代理主机移出的授权网关。在执行工具调用之前，网关会使用绑定到单次 nonce 和时间戳窗口的每消息 HMAC-SHA256 签名来验证调用者身份，并评估代理既不能读取也不能修改的基于角色和参数的策略。每个决策都会加入一个 SHA-256 哈希链审计日志，并且每个被接受的消息都会生成一个 HMAC 认证的 QR 收据，在八个传输通道中实现了 94% 的平均验证率，并在 25 次错误密钥试验中未接受任何伪造。在部署该网关后，所有 15 种模型的残留攻击成功率降至 0%，且决策延迟增加不超过 0.03 毫秒。在 AgentDojo 银行套件上，aiAuthZ 阻止了评估代理发出的所有七个攻击者引导的工具调用，代价是一次合法的首次支付，而对比基线允许两次注入成功。在来自同一事件语料库的九个范围内的案例研究中，aiAuthZ 阻止了 9 个中的 9 个，而没有身份绑定的策略基线仅阻止了 4 个。该网关不能防止模型被欺骗；它防止了被欺骗的模型在通过其路由的每次调用中执行超出已验证用户权限的操作。实现代码和所有实验已发布在 https://github.com/Sports-Vision-Inc/aiAuthZ。
tldr: aiAuthZ 通过引入外部授权网关，利用加密身份绑定和细粒度策略拦截 AI 代理的越权工具调用，在不显著增加延迟的情况下将攻击成功率降至零。
ai_comments: 该论文针对AI代理在工具调用中容易被诱导执行越权操作的安全痛点，提出了一种解耦的授权网关架构。其创新之处在于将授权决策从代理主机剥离，通过加密签名和不可篡改的策略强制执行鉴权，有效解决了模型层面的逻辑漏洞，在几乎不增加延迟的前提下大幅提升了系统的鲁棒性。
motivation: AI 代理容易受上下文操纵攻击导致越权工具调用，且现有模型在面对此类攻击时防御能力参差不齐，缺乏统一的外部鉴权机制。
method: 提出 aiAuthZ 授权网关，采用 HMAC-SHA256 签名绑定单次 nonce 和时间戳进行身份验证；在网关层执行代理无法修改的基于角色和参数的细粒度策略；所有决策记录在 SHA-256 哈希链审计日志中。
results: 在 15 种语言模型测试中，aiAuthZ 将残留攻击成功率降至 0%，决策延迟增加不超过 0.03 ms；在 AgentDojo 和多个案例研究中，均能有效拦截恶意工具调用。
conclusion: aiAuthZ 通过将授权决策从代理主机移至外部网关，利用身份绑定和细粒度策略，成功阻止了 AI 代理在被误导后的非法越权行为，为 AI 系统提供了有效的安全保障。

title: Rendering-Aware Bayesian 3D Gaussian Splatting with Native Uncertainty and Adaptive Complexity Control
authors: Gaoxiang Jia, Vikram Appia, Junzhou Huang, Xinlei Wang
abstract: 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) is a strong representation for real-time novel-view synthesis, but its standard training pipeline relies on point estimates and hand-tuned heuristics, providing no native uncertainty or principled complexity control. This is most limiting under sparse views or fixed acquisition budgets, where a model must identify weakly supported geometry and select informative views. We introduce a rendering-aware Bayesian 3DGS framework that tracks Gaussian geometry with a Normal-Inverse-Wishart posterior over means and covariances using renderer-derived surrogate summaries. An optional Dirichlet-process extension adds a probabilistic component-usage signal, and the training schedule makes the closed-form versus approximate inference boundary explicit. Re-rendering posterior geometry samples yields native predictive uncertainty for interval calibration and active view selection. In a fixed-budget 16-to-32 active-view task, native NIW acquisition improves PSNR by +0.453 dB and LPIPS by -0.0146 over a scoring-only 3-member standard-ensemble baseline, winning 29/39 scene-seed pairs and 10/13 scene means; it also improves over PPU-style (+0.355 dB) and NIW-proxy (+0.401 dB) acquisition. NIW native intervals reduce 95% coverage error by about 17x relative to a shared proxy (0.046 vs. 0.796) and are about 10x closer to nominal coverage than a 3-member deep ensemble (0.047 vs. 0.454) at roughly one-third the training cost. As a reconstruction compatibility check, paired NIW-vs-standard analysis over 39 scene-seed runs yields +0.030 dB PSNR with 1.6% additional training time. These results position Bayesian 3DGS as a practical probabilistic scene representation for decision-facing tasks such as active view selection.
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 24 tables including appendix. Preprint
zh_title: 具有原生不确定性和自适应复杂度控制的渲染感知贝叶斯3D高斯溅射
translation: 3D高斯溅射（3DGS）是一种用于实时新视角合成的强大表示方法，但其标准训练流程依赖于点估计和人工调整的启发式方法，无法提供原生的不确定性或原则性的复杂度控制。这在稀疏视图或固定采集预算下尤为受限，因为模型必须识别弱支撑几何并选择信息量大的视图。我们引入了一种渲染感知的贝叶斯3DGS框架，通过渲染器导出的代理摘要，利用均值和协方差的Normal-Inverse-Wishart后验来跟踪高斯几何。一个可选的Dirichlet过程扩展增加了一个概率性的组件使用信号，训练计划明确了闭式推理与近似推理的界限。对后验几何样本进行重新渲染，可产生用于区间校准和主动视图选择的原生预测不确定性。在固定的16到32个主动视图任务预算中，原生NIW采集在PSNR上比仅评分的3成员标准集成基线提高了+0.453 dB，LPIPS提高了-0.0146，并在39个场景种子对中赢得了29个，在13个场景均值中赢得了10个；它也优于PPU风格（+0.355 dB）和NIW代理（+0.401 dB）采集。NIW原生区间将95%覆盖误差相对于共享代理降低了约17倍（0.046 vs. 0.796），并且在约为三分之一训练成本的情况下，比3成员深度集成更接近标称覆盖（0.047 vs. 0.454）。作为重建兼容性检查，在39次场景种子运行中进行的NIW与标准配对分析显示，PSNR提升了+0.030 dB，训练时间仅增加1.6%。这些结果将贝叶斯3DGS定位为一种实用的概率场景表示，适用于主动视图选择等面向决策的任务。
tldr: 通过引入贝叶斯建模，为3D高斯溅射赋予了原生不确定性估计和复杂度控制能力，在稀疏视图和主动学习任务中实现了更高质量与更低成本的平衡。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入贝叶斯框架，成功解决了标准3DGS缺乏不确定性估计和复杂度控制的问题。其创新之处在于利用Normal-Inverse-Wishart分布对高斯参数进行建模，不仅提升了渲染质量，还显著降低了计算成本，在主动视觉选择等决策任务中表现出极高的应用价值。
motivation: 现有的3DGS训练依赖于点估计和人工启发式规则，缺乏原生不确定性估计和原则性的复杂度控制，导致在稀疏视角或固定预算场景下表现受限。
method: 引入渲染感知的贝叶斯3DGS框架，利用Normal-Inverse-Wishart（NIW）后验分布对高斯均值和协方差进行建模，并结合Dirichlet过程进行组件使用信号的概率建模，实现闭式与近似推理的结合。
results: 在固定预算的主动视图选择任务中，该方法在PSNR和LPIPS指标上均优于基线模型；在不确定性校准方面，其95%覆盖误差比传统代理方法降低了约17倍，且训练成本仅为深度集成方法的约三分之一。
conclusion: 该研究成功构建了渲染感知的贝叶斯3DGS框架，提供了原生的预测不确定性估计与自适应复杂度控制，在资源受限和主动学习任务中显著优于传统方法。

title: Multi-Teacher Contrastive Distillation for Edge-Efficient Pathology Foundation Models
authors: Tim Lenz, Maurice Heide, Marco Gustav, Nic G. Reitsam, Jakob Nikolas Kather
abstract: Computational pathology foundation models (PFMs) have advanced whole-slide image analysis. However, their size and inference cost hinder local deployment in pathology departments. We propose MuCoDi, a pretraining framework that distills frozen tile embeddings from multiple PFMs into compact edge-oriented encoders. Instead of regressing individual teacher features, MuCoDi trains lightweight MobileOne and RepViT students with a contrastive distillation objective adapted from MoCo v3, where cached Virchow2, UNI2, and H-Optimus-1 embeddings replace momentum-encoder keys. We pretrain students on 14.3M TCGA tiles from only 11.8K WSIs and evaluate frozen encoders on 23 clinically curated downstream classification tasks. RepViT-based MuCoEdge students retain near-teacher performance while reducing model size by orders of magnitude: MuCoEdge-R2.3 and MuCoEdge-R1.5 reach 71.0% external AUROC, within 0.8 percentage points of the best teacher (Virchow2, 71.8%), while MuCoEdge-R2.3 obtains the best external F1 and the second-best AUPRC (51.8% and 53.3%). MuCoEdge-R1.0 reaches 70.9% AUROC with only 6.4M parameters and 1.12 GFLOPs. On a Raspberry Pi 5, sub-million-parameter MobileOne students achieve up to 605-fold single-tile speedup over Virchow2 while retaining 66.5% to 66.9% external AUROC, demonstrating that PFM-quality pathology representations can be moved toward practical edge deployment. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/mucodi-6243.

title: Self-Review Reinforcement Learning (SRRL) with Cross-Episode Memory and Policy Distillation
authors: Muhammad Zain Amin, Kibele Sebnem Yildirim
abstract: Reinforcement Learning is commonly used to train large language models using environmental feedback. In applied settings, the environment usually provides sparse or delayed feedback. This makes it difficult for the model to pinpoint which actions in its reasoning led to success or failure. So, learning effectively from these signals is hard because the model must determine how each failure should inform meaningful behavioral corrections in subsequent iterations. We introduce a training framework, Self-Review Reinforcement Learning, that embeds an explicit self-review step into each RL episode.
