The ordinary backward reduction then lands the full Muon input on the owner, so Newton-Schulz runs locally with no optimizer-step matrix collective. Forward and backward still materialize and reshard parameters; the runtime challenge is to make that uneven layout efficient and correct. MatrixFSDP does so with MatrixShard metadata, a balance-aware owner planner, deterministic owner-segment P2P collectives, owner-buffer pinning, and owner-shard checkpoint resharding. The resulting update matches full-matrix Muon while preserving ZeRO-3-scale memory: on 64 A100s, MatrixFSDP reduces optimizer-step latency over stock FSDP2-Muon by 4.2x on one node and 54.6x on eight nodes, reaches up to 2.15x end-to-end speedup, and runs model sizes where ZeRO-1 owner placement exceeds an 80 GB GPU.

title: Hidden Amplifiers: Cross-Level Risk in Software Supply Chains
authors: Rakesh Podder, Rafael Fabian Gonzalez Arellano, Indrajit Ray
abstract: Modern software supply chains comprise hundreds of transitive dependencies, yet existing analysis tools operate at either the ecosystem level (dependency graphs) or the code level (static analysis within packages). This separation creates two failure modes. First, false-positive CVE alerts for unreachable code. Second, blind spots for structurally critical micro-dependencies. We introduce cross-level risk propagation, a framework that bridges code-level risk metrics with ecosystem-level dependency exposure through a unified risk formula. Preliminary evaluation on 50 packages across npm and PyPI reveals a class of hidden amplifiers -- micro-dependencies with fewer than 50 methods but over 50,000 dependents -- that carry outsized supply-chain risk invisible to all current Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tools. Without cross-level analysis, such packages can harbor exploitable code for years because no current tool considers both internal code structure and ecosystem position simultaneously. These results suggest that cross-level analysis opens a new design space for supply-chain security.
comment: In The 42nd International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution (ICSME 2026)

title: Auditing of Unlearning Algorithms
authors: Sahasrajit Sarmasarkar, Anastasia Koloskova, Sanmi Koyejo
abstract: Evaluating whether unlearning algorithms truly remove training data influence remains an open challenge. We propose a practical auditor that computes data-dependent lower bounds on the unlearning parameter $\varepsilon$ using membership inference attacks. Evaluating multiple unlearning algorithms, we find a sharp separation: algorithms with rigorous guarantees, such as model clipping and rewind-to-delete, achieve very small $\varepsilon$ bounds that do not falsify their unlearning guarantees, whereas empirical methods such as Hessian-based unlearning, interleaved ascent-descent, ascent on the forget set, and fine-tuning on the retain set exhibit large bounds, indicating poor unlearning. Our auditor provides a practical tool for empirically falsifying unlearning claims through a hypothesis-testing framework, and we validate it on CIFAR-100 and Shakespeare text.
translation: 评估遗忘算法是否真正消除了训练数据的影响仍然是一个未决挑战。我们提出了一种实用的审计工具，利用成员推理攻击计算遗忘参数 $\varepsilon$ 的数据依赖下界。通过评估多种遗忘算法，我们发现了一个明显的界限：具有严格保证的算法（如模型剪枝和回溯删除）获得了非常小的 $\varepsilon$ 界，没有证伪其遗忘保证；而经验方法（如基于 Hessian 的遗忘、交替上升下降、遗忘集梯度上升和保留集微调）表现出较大的界，表明遗忘效果较差。我们的审计工具通过假设检验框架为实证证伪遗忘声明提供了一个实用工具，并在 CIFAR-100 和 Shakespeare 文本数据集上进行了验证。
tldr: 本文开发了一种实用的审计工具，通过成员推理攻击量化评估机器遗忘算法的有效性，并发现理论保证方法优于经验方法。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种基于成员推理攻击的实用审计框架，能够量化评估机器遗忘算法的有效性。其重要性在于揭示了理论保证方法与经验方法在遗忘效果上的巨大鸿沟，为评估模型隐私保护能力提供了标准化的工具。局限性在于该方法主要依赖于成员推理攻击，对于某些复杂的遗忘场景可能存在局限。
motivation: 目前的机器遗忘算法难以验证其是否真正移除了训练数据的影响，缺乏有效的评估工具。
method: 提出了一种基于成员推理攻击（Membership Inference Attacks）的审计框架，利用假设检验来计算遗忘参数 $\varepsilon$ 的数据依赖下界，从而实证评估遗忘算法的有效性。
results: 实验表明，模型剪枝和回溯删除等有严格理论保证的方法能达到较小的 $\varepsilon$ 界；而基于 Hessian 的遗忘、交替上升下降、遗忘集梯度上升及保留集微调等经验方法则表现出较大的 $\varepsilon$ 界，说明其遗忘效果不佳。
conclusion: 该研究通过提出的审计工具证实，具有严格理论保证的遗忘算法在实际操作中表现更优，而基于启发式的经验方法往往无法真正消除训练数据的影响。

title: Uncovering Latent Depression Severity for Binary Depression Detection via Advantage-weighting Ranking
authors: Manning Gao, Tingyi Liu, Leheng Zhang, Haifeng Hu, Yuncheng Jiang, Sijie Mai
abstract: Automatic depression detection using audio-visual data faces significant challenges, particularly in disentangling overlapping feature distributions and establishing robust decision boundaries. To address this, we propose a fine-grained multimodal framework featuring a temporal encoder and a mutual transformer to facilitate deep cross-modal fusion. Our core contribution is the Binary Advantage-weighting Ranking Loss, which optimizes the latent space distribution through two complementary mechanisms: Advantage-weighted Separation, which mines hard pairs by computing a pairwise prediction difference matrix and dynamically weighting them based on their difficulty; and Advantage-weighted Compactness, which minimizes intra-class variance to force features to cluster around their respective class centers. Extensive experiments on D-vlog and LMVD demonstrate that our model reconstructs the latent ordinal structure by prioritizing hard pairs, thereby achieving state-of-the-art performance.
zh_title: 通过优势加权排序揭示用于二元抑郁症检测的潜在抑郁严重程度
translation: 使用音频-视觉数据进行自动抑郁症检测面临巨大挑战，特别是在解耦重叠的特征分布和建立鲁棒的决策边界方面。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个细粒度的多模态框架，其特点是包含时间编码器和互Transformer，以促进深度的跨模态融合。我们的核心贡献是二元优势加权排序损失，它通过两种互补机制优化潜在空间分布：优势加权分离，通过计算成对预测差异矩阵并根据难度动态加权来挖掘难样本；以及优势加权紧凑性，通过最小化类内方差迫使特征围绕各自的类中心聚类。在D-vlog和LMVD上的广泛实验表明，我们的模型通过优先处理难样本重建了潜在的序数结构，从而实现了最先进的性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的多模态框架和优势加权排序损失函数，通过优化潜在特征空间来提升音频-视觉抑郁症检测的准确性。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于引入了“二元优势加权排序损失”，通过挖掘难样本并优化潜在空间分布，解决了音频-视觉抑郁症检测中特征分布重叠和决策边界难以界定的问题，在多个数据集上表现优异。
motivation: 自动抑郁症检测中音频-视觉数据存在特征分布重叠和决策边界难以确定的挑战，需要更细粒度的特征建模方法。
method: 提出了一种多模态框架，包含时间编码器和互注意力Transformer进行特征融合，并引入“二元优势加权排序损失”，通过“优势加权分离”挖掘难样本，以及“优势加权紧凑性”减小类内方差。
results: 在D-vlog和LMVD数据集上的实验表明，该模型通过优先处理难样本成功重构了潜在序数结构，达到了最先进的性能水平。
conclusion: 通过引入优势加权排序损失来重构潜在序数结构，该模型有效提升了音频-视觉抑郁症检测的准确性，达到了最先进的性能。

title: K-ABENA: K-Adaptive Backpropagation with Error-based N-exclusion Algorithm : (Compensated Loss-Based Sample Exclusion with Unbiased Gradient Estimation)
authors: Jean-Francois Bonbhel
abstract: We present K-ABENA (K-Adaptive Backpropagation with Error-based N-exclusion Algorithm), a selective gradient computation framework that reduces per-iteration training cost by excluding a fraction of low-loss ("minor") observations from the backward pass. Its canonical form (v3) combines a defensive-mixture sampling design over the minor set with Horvitz-Thompson inverse-probability reweighting, yielding a design-unbiased Horvitz-Thompson gradient estimator (Lemma 2) and whose self-normalized practical variant carries a bias of order O(1/m) with an explicit constant (Lemma 3). We prove an O(1/sqrt(T)) non-convex convergence guarantee for SGD under the estimator, with an additive term that quantifies the residual bias (Theorem 1). We further prove that uncompensated loss-based selection - a family that includes OHEM, SBP, and the two earlier K-ABENA variants - admits no stationary point at any minimizer where its selection bias is bounded away from zero (Proposition 2), and we quantify this failure empirically: at 0.17% class imbalance, uncompensated variants reach test AUC 0.53-0.62 versus 0.9998 for full-batch SGD, while the compensated estimator attains 0.9991 at identical 28.4% compute savings. On real datasets (Breast Cancer, Digits, Wine, Diabetes) the compensated estimator is statistically indistinguishable from full-batch SGD (paired permutation tests, p >= 0.5; Section 7) while saving 28-54% of per-epoch gradient computation. A biased "regularized mode" (the earlier half-domain variant) is retained as an option with a proven exact bias decomposition (Lemma 5) and quantified contraindications: it collapses to 0.386 accuracy under 40% label noise (baseline: 0.832) and to 0.53 AUC under extreme imbalance. Every advantage and every limitation reported in this paper is either proved or measured; all experiments are CPU-scale (NumPy/scikit-learn) and their scope is stated explicitly.

title: From Textural Counterpoint to Feature Encoding: A Multi-Dimensional Machine Representation Study of Haydn's "The Lark" Integrating Electroacoustic Analysis
authors: Yakun Liu, Zhiyu Jin, Hai Luan, Dong Liu, Xiaonan Li
abstract: Chamber music, as a highly precise multi-part interactive system, contains a logic of "role assignment and dynamic interaction" that provides an extremely valuable blueprint for exploring human-computer collaborative composition paradigms. Addressing the lack of role perception capabilities in existing deep music generation models during polyphonic interactions, this paper conducts an interdisciplinary analysis of Haydn's String Quartet in D Major, The Lark (Op. 64, No. 5). We propose a novel research path: "Classical Morphology Qualitative Analysis-Electroacoustic Quantitative Measurement-Machine Representation Reconstruction." The study first utilizes auditory analysis to dissect the counterpoint morphology of the leading voice and the underlying groove in the first movement. Subsequently, it introduces spectrum and dynamic feature analysis tools from a Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) to translate subjective auditory perception into objective, measurable physical parameters. Building on this, the paper introduces a fundamentally new approach to low-level computer feature extraction: completely abandoning the traditional mechanical quantization grid, introducing Event-based Timestamps to record the duration of micro-timing, and transforming acoustic features into an independent "Role-Aware Encoding" as an aesthetic heuristic mechanism (a phenomenological anchor). This study not only completes the logical loop spanning classical analysis, electronic music mapping, and AI symbolic generation but also establishes a profound theoretical foundation-from the perspectives of interactive aesthetics and media philosophy-for constructing human-computer collaborative music systems imbued with "social attributes" and "otherness awareness."
zh_title: 从织体对位到特征编码：海顿《云雀》的多维机器表征与电声分析研究
translation: 室内乐作为一种高度精密的多声部交互系统，其蕴含的“角色分配与动态交互”逻辑，为探索人机协作作曲范式提供了极具价值的蓝图。针对现有深度音乐生成模型在多声部交互中缺乏角色感知能力的问题，本文对海顿《D大调弦乐四重奏》（作品64之5，即《云雀》）进行了跨学科分析。我们提出了一条全新的研究路径：“古典形态学定性分析-电声学定量测量-机器表征重构”。研究首先利用听觉分析剖析了第一乐章中主导声部与底层律动的对位形态；随后，引入数字音频工作站（DAW）的频谱与动态特征分析工具，将主观听觉感知转化为客观、可测量的物理参数。在此基础上，本文提出了一种全新的底层计算机特征提取方法：彻底摒弃传统的机械量化网格，引入基于事件的时间戳（Event-based Timestamps）记录微时序时长，并将声学特征转化为独立的“角色感知编码”，作为一种审美启发机制（现象学锚点）。本研究不仅完成了跨越古典分析、电子音乐映射与AI符号生成的逻辑闭环，还从交互美学与媒体哲学的视角，为构建具备“社会属性”与“他者意识”的人机协作音乐系统奠定了深厚的理论基础。
tldr: 本文提出了一种“角色感知编码”方法，通过电声分析和微时序建模，将古典室内乐的交互逻辑转化为AI可理解的特征，以提升音乐生成模型中的角色感知能力。
ai_comments: 该研究通过跨学科方法将古典音乐形态学、电声学分析与AI表征相结合，创新性地提出了“角色感知编码”，为解决音乐生成模型中缺乏交互逻辑和角色感知的难题提供了新思路，具有重要的理论与实践意义。
motivation: 针对现有深度音乐生成模型在多声部交互中缺乏角色感知能力的问题，探索如何将室内乐中复杂的“角色分配与动态交互”逻辑引入人机协作作曲。
method: 采用“古典形态学定性分析-电声学定量测量-机器表征重构”的研究路径，利用DAW工具将听觉感知转化为物理参数，并引入基于事件的时间戳和角色感知编码替代传统的量化网格。
results: 成功构建了从古典分析到电声映射再到AI符号生成的逻辑闭环，并提出了一种能够捕捉微时序和审美启发式信息的“角色感知编码”新方法。
conclusion: 本研究通过将古典音乐的交互逻辑转化为可计算的机器表征，为构建具有“社会属性”和“他者意识”的人机协作音乐系统奠定了理论基础。

title: More Convincing, Not More Correct: Self-Play Reward Hacking of Reference-Free LLM Judges
authors: Chenyu Zhou
abstract: Training a language model against its own reference-free judgments (the premise of self-rewarding, self-play, and LLM-as-a-judge pipelines) assumes a model's verdict on a shown answer tracks correctness. We show it fails structurally: conditioned on a candidate, a judge scores plausibility, not correctness, leaving false-positive basins a policy learns to exploit. We measure this with a hidden-anchor audit: a held-out, cross-source exact-match check the judge never sees. On GSM8K with Qwen3 policies, self-play drives the judge's pass rate from 0.72 to 0.94 while true accuracy stays at 0.20 (three seeds). This reward hacking is not white-box gaming: the errors transfer across judge families (Qwen, Llama, Gemma) and scales, a strict three-judge ensemble still accepts 55% of them, and no plausibility-scoring defense closes the basin. The decisive variable is whether the judge commits an answer of its own before using the candidate: committing first drops the false-positive rate from 0.719 to 0.012, blind solving lifts discrimination to 0.96, and used as the training reward the de-anchored channel keeps false positives at zero, preventing the basin rather than only detecting it. A falsifiable bound (the gap is at most 1 - accuracy) predicts which regimes are exposed. The full arc replicates without training under best-of-N selection in code and competition math, and with a Gemma policy.

title: Teaching LTL and ω-automata with Spot
authors: Alexandre Duret-Lutz
abstract: Spot is a mature, open-source C++/Python library and toolset for Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) and $ω$-automata manipulation. While Spot is routinely used as a research and verification back-end, its rich visualization capabilities and Python interface also make it an attractive platform for \emph{teaching} the connections between temporal logic formulas and the $ω$-automata that give them their semantics.
zh_title: 使用Spot教授线性时序逻辑和ω-自动机
translation: Spot是一个成熟的、开源的C++/Python库和工具集，用于线性时序逻辑（LTL）和ω-自动机的操作。虽然Spot通常被用作科研和验证的后端，但其丰富的可视化功能和Python接口也使其成为教学线性时序逻辑公式与其语义对应的ω-自动机之间联系的理想平台。
tldr: Spot是一款功能强大的LTL和ω-自动机处理工具，其Python接口和可视化能力使其成为教学相关理论的理想平台。
ai_comments: 该论文强调了Spot工具在科研之外的教学潜力，体现了将复杂形式化方法工具转化为教育资源的趋势。其局限在于未详细说明具体的教学案例或课程设计。
motivation: 作者旨在推广Spot工具在教育领域的应用，利用其成熟的库功能和可视化特性，帮助学生更好地理解时序逻辑与自动机之间的语义联系。
method: 利用Spot库提供的Python接口和丰富的可视化功能，将线性时序逻辑公式与ω-自动机进行直观的关联展示。
results: 证明了Spot作为一种成熟的开源工具，通过其Python接口和可视化能力，能够有效地支持形式化方法相关课程的教学。
conclusion: Spot不仅是一个强大的科研验证工具，也是教授线性时序逻辑与ω-自动机之间联系的理想教学平台。

title: GaussFusion: Towards Multimodal 3D Gaussian Pretraining
authors: Zhixuan You, Jihua Zhu, Yiding Sun, Zihao Guo, Haozhe Cheng, Dongxu Zhang, Lin Chen, Hainan Luo
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting provides an explicit representation that jointly models geometry and appearance, serving as a scalable foundation for 3D representation learning. Existing pre-training methods for Gaussian representations, such as masked Gaussian reconstruction, primarily capture local structures but offer limited semantic supervision. In this paper, we propose GaussFusion, a multimodal pre-training framework for 3D Gaussian representations. GaussFusion integrates image and text supervision into masked Gaussian modeling through cross-modal semantic alignment, enabling the Gaussian encoder to learn both visual and language-level semantic information during pre-training. To better adapt masked modeling to the non-uniform distribution of Gaussian primitives, we further propose Gaussian Salience-guided Multi-scale Hole Masking (GSHM). GSHM constructs spatially continuous masked regions based on Gaussian salience. By applying hole masks at multiple scales, GSHM encourages the encoder to capture both fine-grained local patterns and broader structural dependencies. Extensive experiments on downstream tasks demonstrate that GaussFusion improves the transferability of Gaussian representations. Notably, GaussFusion outperforms Gaussian-MAE on ModelNet40 and ScanObjectNN (PB-T50-RS) by 0.61\% and 3.85\%, respectively.
zh_title: GaussFusion：迈向多模态3D高斯预训练
translation: 3D高斯溅射（3D Gaussian Splatting）提供了一种联合建模几何与外观的显式表示，成为3D表示学习的可扩展基础。现有的高斯表示预训练方法（如掩码高斯重建）主要捕捉局部结构，但语义监督有限。在本文中，我们提出了GaussFusion，一种用于3D高斯表示的多模态预训练框架。GaussFusion通过跨模态语义对齐将图像和文本监督整合到掩码高斯建模中，使高斯编码器在预训练期间能够学习到视觉和语言层面的语义信息。为了使掩码建模更好地适应高斯基元的非均匀分布，我们进一步提出了高斯显著性引导的多尺度孔洞掩码（GSHM）。GSHM基于高斯显著性构建空间连续的掩码区域。通过在多个尺度上应用孔洞掩码，GSHM鼓励编码器同时捕捉细粒度的局部模式和更广泛的结构依赖。在下游任务上的大量实验表明，GaussFusion提高了高斯表示的迁移能力。值得注意的是，GaussFusion在ModelNet40和ScanObjectNN（PB-T50-RS）上的表现分别比Gaussian-MAE高出0.61%和3.85%。
tldr: GaussFusion通过引入多模态语义对齐和显著性引导的多尺度掩码，提升了3D高斯表示的预训练质量及下游任务迁移性能。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将多模态语义对齐引入到3D高斯表示预训练中，解决了现有方法语义监督不足的问题。通过引入GSHM机制，有效地处理了高斯基元的非均匀分布特性，具有较强的实际应用潜力和迁移能力。
motivation: 现有的3D高斯预训练方法主要聚焦于局部几何结构，缺乏足够的语义监督，限制了其在复杂任务中的表示能力。
method: 提出GaussFusion框架，通过跨模态语义对齐将图像和文本监督整合进掩码高斯建模；引入高斯显著性引导的多尺度孔洞掩码（GSHM），通过基于显著性的多尺度掩码策略提升局部与结构特征的提取能力。
results: 在ModelNet40和ScanObjectNN数据集上，GaussFusion的性能分别超越了Gaussian-MAE 0.61%和3.85%，证明了其优越的迁移能力。
conclusion: GaussFusion通过整合多模态监督与创新的掩码策略，显著提升了3D高斯表示的语义理解能力与下游任务的迁移性能。

title: Drift Happens: An Empirical Study of Neural Architecture Robustness to Temporal Distribution Shift
authors: Robin Holzinger, Riccardo Colletti
abstract:
Real-world data distributions evolve over time, inducing temporal distribution shift that can substantially degrade the reliability of deployed machine learning systems. However, the extent to which architectural choices and their associated inductive biases affect temporal robustness remains insufficiently understood.
  We present a systematic empirical comparison of temporal robustness across three heterogeneous, time-indexed domains encompassing image classification, multi-label text classification, and text regression tasks. Using a unified evaluation framework based on temporal drift matrices, we train models on cumulative historical data and evaluate their performance on both earlier and later time periods, thereby quantifying cross-temporal generalization. Our study spans model families ranging from simple multilayer perceptrons and convolutional networks to recurrent networks and pretrained Transformer-based encoders.
  Collectively, the results show that architectural inductive biases systematically shape temporal robustness: models whose inductive biases lead them to exploit localized, highly discriminative features attain the highest in-distribution accuracy, yet those features are often the ones that change most over time, so these models degrade fastest, while pretrained encoders that draw on coarser, more stable representations drift more gradually. These observations offer practical guidance for selecting architectures for real-world systems subject to temporal drift.
comment: 33 pages, 28 figures. Extended version of the QCDS 2026 proceedings paper; proceedings version to appear in Springer LNCS. Interactive website: https://drift-happens.org/

title: xDECAF: An Extensible Data Flow Diagram Analysis Framework for Information Security
authors: Benjamin Arp, Felix Schwickerath, Alexander Vogt, Tom Hüller, Nils Niehues, Nicolas Boltz
abstract: xDECAF is an extensible tool for architecture-based data flow analysis with a focus on information security. It combines an extended data flow diagram metamodel of labeled flows and nodes, a domain-specific constraint language with different flow operations, and a browser-based editor backed by an analysis engine. In this paper, we present the xDECAF tool library and a curated catalog of over 20 example models with documented constraints and expected violations, intended as a reusable dataset for the community. The tool has already been adopted by several research lines, providing concrete evidence of its utility. The tool, dataset, and a hosted online editor are publicly available.
comment: Accepted at ASE'26 Tools and Datasets

title: PolicyShiftGuard: Benchmarking and Improving Policy-Adaptive Image Guardrails
authors: Mingyang Song, Luxin Xu, Haoyu Sun, Minzhou Pan, Yu Cheng, Bo Li
abstract: Image guardrails are typically trained and evaluated under a fixed safety policy, implicitly treating safety as an intrinsic property of an image. Real deployments are different: the same image may be allowed in one product, restricted in another, and newly disallowed when a policy boundary changes. We study policy-adaptive image guardrailing, where a model must decide whether an image violates the currently supplied policy and generalize to held-out policy definitions. We introduce PolicyShiftBench, a comprehensive benchmark with 2,000 policy-discriminative instances over 265 images, where each image is paired with 7.55 policy-conditioned prompts on average to test whether models adapt to the active policy rather than relying on image-level safety priors. We then propose PolicyShiftGuard, a compact policy-conditioned guardrail trained with a two-stage training recipe that combines Randomized Policy SFT (RP-SFT) with Boundary-Pair Policy Adaptation (BP-Adapt). BP-Adapt trains matched prompts for the same image and risk category using standard label supervision and a pairwise comparison loss that separates blocking policies from passing policies. Experiments show that existing VLMs and specialized guardrails remain brittle under policy shifts, while PolicyShiftGuard substantially improves policy-sensitive performance. The 7B model achieves SOTA performance of 76.9 Avg. F1 and 72.1 Avg. PSS on PolicyShiftBench, transfers well to UnSafeBench and SafeEditBench, and improves the latency-performance trade-off with a concise output format. Ablations confirm that matched pass/block boundary pairs are essential for stable policy adaptation.
zh_title: PolicyShiftGuard：图像安全护栏策略适应性的基准测试与改进
translation: 图像护栏通常在固定的安全策略下进行训练和评估，隐含地将安全性视为图像的固有属性。然而，实际部署场景并非如此：同一张图像在某个产品中可能被允许，在另一个产品中可能被限制，且当策略边界发生变化时，可能被重新定义为禁止。我们研究了策略适应性图像护栏，要求模型判断图像是否违反当前提供的策略，并泛化到未见过的策略定义中。我们引入了 PolicyShiftBench，这是一个包含 265 张图像、2000 个策略判别实例的综合基准，每张图像平均匹配 7.55 个策略条件提示，以测试模型是否能适应当前策略，而非依赖图像级别的安全先验。随后，我们提出了 PolicyShiftGuard，这是一个紧凑的策略条件护栏模型，采用两阶段训练方案，结合了随机策略指令微调 (RP-SFT) 和边界对策略适应 (BP-Adapt)。BP-Adapt 使用标准标签监督和将拦截策略与通过策略区分开的成对比较损失，为同一图像和风险类别训练匹配的提示词。实验表明，现有的视觉语言模型和专用护栏在策略转移下仍然脆弱，而 PolicyShiftGuard 显著提高了策略敏感性能。7B 模型在 PolicyShiftBench 上达到了 76.9 平均 F1 和 72.1 平均 PSS 的 SOTA 性能，在 UnSafeBench 和 SafeEditBench 上表现良好，并以简洁的输出格式改善了延迟与性能的权衡。消融实验证实，匹配的通过/拦截边界对对于稳定的策略适应至关重要。
tldr: 针对图像安全护栏在不同策略下表现不一致的问题，本文提出了 PolicyShiftBench 基准和 PolicyShiftGuard 模型，通过策略条件训练显著提升了模型对动态安全策略的适应能力。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将图像安全评估从“静态属性”转向“动态策略适应”，针对实际工业场景中策略变动频繁的痛点，提出了有效的基准测试与训练方法。其局限性可能在于对极度复杂或模糊的策略描述的泛化能力仍需进一步验证。
motivation: 现有的图像安全护栏通常基于固定策略训练，无法适应现实中不同产品或策略变更带来的动态安全需求，导致模型在面对策略转移时表现脆弱。
method: 提出了 PolicyShiftBench 基准测试；开发了 PolicyShiftGuard 模型，采用两阶段训练策略：随机策略指令微调 (RP-SFT) 和边界对策略适应 (BP-Adapt)，利用成对比较损失来区分通过与拦截策略。
results: PolicyShiftGuard 在 PolicyShiftBench 上达到 76.9 的平均 F1 分数和 72.1 的平均 PSS，在 UnSafeBench 和 SafeEditBench 上表现良好，且具备更优的延迟与性能平衡。
conclusion: PolicyShiftGuard 通过引入策略条件训练，成功解决了现有视觉语言模型在应对多变安全策略时的脆弱性问题，在多个基准测试中达到了领先水平。

title: Progressive Reasoning with Primitive Correction for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning
authors: Ziyi Chen, Haoyan Shi, Sunhan Xu, Congyan Lang
abstract: Compositional Zero-Shot Learning (CZSL) aims to combine known attributes and objects as primitives for recognizing previously unseen attribute-object pairs. Prior works either predict attributes and objects independently, missing their strong contextual dependency, or use unidirectional conditional modeling (e.g., object-guided attribute prediction), which is prone to error propagation. We propose PRPC, a Progressive Reasoning framework with Primitive Correction, which explicitly models the bidirectional dependency between attributes and objects via step-wise inference. PRPC performs mutual correction of primitives to suppress prediction errors in earlier steps. Specifically, we formulate CZSL as structured, Q&A-style Chain-of-Thought reasoning process and constrain the MLLM to follow predefined semantic steps to generate intermediate decisions. To further enhance the reliability and logical consistency of intermediate reasoning, we introduce reinforcement learning post-training with a GRPO-based objective, providing step-level rewards aligned with the progressive inference procedure. Extensive experiments on three CZSL benchmarks demonstrate that PRPC achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating the effectiveness of progressive reasoning and bidirectional correction for robust compositional generalization.

title: Reproducible Validation of Voucher-Based L2 Interoperability: Diagnosing an ERC-4337 Compatibility Issue in an EIL SDK Implementation
authors: Cheng-En Lee, Yu-Chien Huang, Yun-Cheng Tsai
abstract:
Ethereum Layer-2 (L2) ecosystems improve scalability but also fragment users, liquidity, gas funding, and execution across rollups. Consequently, cross-rollup interoperability is not only a bridging problem but also a wallet, execution, and validation problem. Ethereum Interop Layer (EIL) proposes a voucher-based architecture in which users create voucher requests on an origin chain and redeem XLP-signed vouchers on a destination chain. When reproducing the evaluated SDK version in a controlled local environment, we observed a compatibility issue in the \texttt{UserOperation} path: paymaster-related data can differ after signing, preventing a stable comparison between the user-authorized representation and the representation later inspected by the local validation flow.
  This paper presents a reproducible two-L2 validation framework and a controlled compatibility mitigation for that issue. We build a deterministic local testbed over Arbitrum- and Optimism-style development chains, deploy the core paymaster and bridge-related components, implement mock bundlers and event-driven XLP providers, and introduce a sanitized paymaster-data handling path together with a compatible multichain account wrapper. Using this framework, we execute the core voucher lifecycle from request creation to destination-chain voucher redemption and asset release.
  The contribution is an empirical diagnosis of an implementation-level compatibility barrier, a bounded mitigation that restores controlled end-to-end execution, and an inspectable validation artifact for studying voucher-based interoperability. The work does not claim a new interoperability protocol, universal wallet compatibility, or production readiness; it identifies the remaining gaps toward standard-account validation, one-signature multichain authorization, and full dispute-settlement support.

title: Beyond the Syntax: Do Security Experts Trust LLMs for NIDS Rule Engineering?
authors: Lorenzo di Filippo, Enkeleda Bardhi, Andrea Agiollo, Alessandro Palma, Silvia Bonomi, Fernando Kuipers
abstract: As network threats evolve, manual NIDS rule engineering has become a critical operational bottleneck. While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for automating this process, their ability to produce production-ready rules remains unvalidated. This paper presents a human-centered investigation into LLM-based NIDS rule engineering, formalizing a grounded generation framework and evaluating it through a user study with 10 domain experts. Our evaluation reveals a syntax-semantics paradox: although LLMs generate syntactically correct rules, experts find them only partially deployable due to low specificity and logic hallucinations in 12% of cases. While the system received a favorable SUS score of 67, practitioners remain skeptical of its autonomous capabilities, viewing LLMs as support tools for drafting and verification rather than independent generators. Finally, our statistical analysis indicates that while large-scale models ($\geq 70B$) consistently produce syntactically valid rules, small models ($\leq 4B$) are largely ineffective for IDS rule generation.

title: PCBWorld: A Benchmark Environment for Engine-Grounded PCB Design Automation
authors: Hyungseok Song, Junseok Park, Won-Seok Choi, Seohui Bae, Han-Seul Jeong, Youngjoon Park, Soonyoung Lee
abstract: PCB routing is the task of connecting the nets of a board with copper traces under strict design rules, yet learning-based methods still lag behind rule-based routers. We introduce PCBWorld, an open-source engine-grounded PCB routing environment built on the KiCad EDA engine. As a human engineer does, agents in PCBWorld interactively route a board through the engine's native operations, using its Design Rule Check (DRC) feedback to keep the routing within the design rules. The environment supports both RL policies and tool-using LLM agents. Alongside the environment, PCBWorld-Bench provides three dataset families in KiCad's native board format (.kicad_pcb), covering two types of controllable synthetic instances and 679 real open-source boards. It scores any completed board with eight engine-checked evaluation metrics, regardless of the routing method. In our experiments, agents in PCBWorld consistently outperformed grid-action RL policies and open-loop LLM baselines, and an RL policy trained only on synthetic boards transferred zero-shot to real boards, approaching rule-based routers. These results position the engine-grounded, interactive approach of PCBWorld as a promising foundation for advancing the routing ability of both RL and LLM agents.

title: CMDR: Contextual Multimodal Document Retrieval
authors: Ryota Tanaka, Taku Hasegawa, Kyosuke Nishida
abstract: Multimodal document retrieval aims to retrieve relevant pages while preserving both textual and visual content from the original document. However, existing benchmarks primarily evaluate simple lexical or semantic matching, and most methods encode pages independently. Consequently, they overlook the contextual information in the document required to resolve queries that aggregate information across multiple pages. In this paper, we introduce CMDR and CMDR-Bench, a new multimodal document retrieval task and benchmark that require modeling document context. To address this challenge, we propose CMDR-Embed, a contextual multimodal embedding framework that explicitly incorporates document context by jointly encoding multiple pages and deriving page-level embeddings from a shared contextual representation. Furthermore, we introduce CMCL, a contextual multimodal contrastive learning objective that effectively trains CMDR-Embed by balancing contextual modeling with page-level discriminability. Experiments demonstrate that CMDR-Embed significantly outperforms non-contextual embeddings, highlighting the importance of context-aware multimodal embeddings for advancing document retrieval.
comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026; project page: https://cmdr-bench.github.io/
zh_title: CMDR：上下文感知多模态文档检索
translation: 多模态文档检索旨在检索相关页面，同时保留原始文档的文本和视觉内容。然而，现有的基准测试主要评估简单的词汇或语义匹配，且大多数方法独立编码页面。因此，它们忽略了解决跨多页聚合信息查询所需的文档上下文信息。在本文中，我们引入了CMDR和CMDR-Bench，这是一项新的多模态文档检索任务和基准，需要对文档上下文进行建模。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了CMDR-Embed，这是一个上下文多模态嵌入框架，通过联合编码多个页面并从共享的上下文表示中派生页面级嵌入，明确地整合了文档上下文。此外，我们引入了CMCL，一种上下文多模态对比学习目标，通过平衡上下文建模与页面级辨别能力，有效地训练了CMDR-Embed。实验证明，CMDR-Embed显著优于非上下文嵌入，突显了上下文感知多模态嵌入对于推进文档检索的重要性。
tldr: 提出了一种能够联合编码多页文档以捕捉上下文信息的检索框架，显著提升了多模态文档检索效果。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了“文档上下文”的概念，解决了传统方法独立编码单页导致的信息孤立问题。通过对比学习目标（CMCL）和联合编码框架（CMDR-Embed），有效地提升了多模态文档检索在复杂查询下的性能。该工作对于处理长篇文档检索具有重要的学术与实际意义。
motivation: 现有方法多独立编码单页，忽略了多页文档中的上下文关联，导致难以处理需要跨页聚合信息的复杂查询。
method: 提出了CMDR-Embed框架，通过联合编码多页内容并从共享上下文中派生页面级嵌入；同时设计了CMCL（上下文多模态对比学习）目标函数来平衡上下文建模与页面区分度。
results: 实验表明，CMDR-Embed在性能上显著优于非上下文感知的嵌入方法。
conclusion: CMDR框架通过引入上下文建模，有效解决了多页文档检索中跨页信息关联的难题，证明了上下文感知多模态嵌入在文档检索任务中的优越性。

title: LibFHE: A Numba-Based CUDA-Python Library for Non-RNS CKKS-BGV Fully Homomorphic Encryption on GPUs
authors: John Chiang
abstract: It has been a decade since the fourth-generation FHE framework, CKKS, was proposed; yet, there is still no indicator pointing toward a fifth-generation successor; and in recent years, numerous studies have explored GPU acceleration to improve the efficiency of homomorphic computations. In this paper, we propose LibFHE, a high-performance GPU-accelerated framework that features CUDA-Python bindings to achieve both high-level programmability and bare-metal GPU performance for homomorphic workloads. A large majority of state-of-the-art implementations adopt the RNS-CKKS variant. In contrast, this work deliberately revisits the original (non-RNS) CKKS-BGV framework, and develops a GPU-based implementation along with corresponding optimizations. Experimental results demonstrate that optimized CUDA-Python implementations can achieve performance comparable to highly optimized C++ FHE libraries, while significantly reducing implementation complexity and improving programmability.
zh_title: LibFHE：一个基于Numba的CUDA-Python库，用于GPU上的非RNS CKKS-BGV全同态加密
translation: CKKS作为第四代全同态加密（FHE）框架提出至今已有十年，目前尚未出现第五代继任者。近年来，许多研究探索了通过GPU加速来提升同态计算的效率。本文提出了LibFHE，这是一个高性能的GPU加速框架，通过CUDA-Python绑定实现了高水平的可编程性和裸机级的GPU性能。当前大多数先进的实现都采用了RNS-CKKS变体，而本研究特意重新审视了原始的（非RNS）CKKS-BGV框架，并开发了基于GPU的实现及相应的优化。实验结果表明，优化后的CUDA-Python实现能够达到与高度优化的C++ FHE库相当的性能，同时显著降低了实现复杂性并提升了可编程性。
tldr: LibFHE通过CUDA-Python实现了高性能的非RNS CKKS-BGV同态加密，兼顾了C++级的性能与Python的开发效率。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于通过Numba技术在Python中实现了高性能的CUDA加速，打破了FHE库通常必须使用底层C++编写的认知。其重要性在于降低了全同态加密研究的开发门槛，同时证明了非RNS架构在特定优化下仍具备极强的竞争力。局限性在于未讨论RNS与非RNS在极大规模计算下的具体性能权衡。
motivation: 当前全同态加密（FHE）实现大多依赖复杂的C++代码，且主流研究多关注RNS-CKKS变体。作者旨在通过GPU加速和Python绑定，在保持高性能的同时，降低开发复杂性并提升可编程性。
method: 开发了LibFHE框架，采用Numba技术实现CUDA-Python绑定，针对非RNS（non-RNS）的CKKS-BGV架构进行了专门的GPU底层优化。
results: 实验结果表明，LibFHE在性能上可与高度优化的C++ FHE库相媲美，同时显著降低了实现复杂度。
conclusion: LibFHE证明了使用CUDA-Python开发高性能同态加密库是可行的，能够提供与C++相当的性能，同时极大提升了代码的可编程性和易用性。

title: A robust and versatile parallel FFT-based mechanical solver for general non-periodic and periodic boundary conditions
authors: Yaovi Armand Amouzou-adoun, Lionel Gélébart, Cédric Flageul, Yushan Wang
abstract: General boundary conditions are implemented within a fast Fourier transform framework for linear and non-linear mechanical problems using small or finite transformation formulations. In the context of parallel computing (distributed memory), we present a framework that enables the combination of periodic and non-periodic (Dirichlet or Neumann) boundary conditions. Taking advantage of the link between non-periodic boundary conditions and the symmetries of the relevant components of the fluctuation displacement and stress fields, discrete trigonometric transforms are employed to adapt the classical Moulinec-Suquet fast Fourier transform approach. The present study employs an original displacement-based fixed-point algorithm in combination with a convergence acceleration method in order to solve boundary value problems. Finite difference approaches are used to build the discrete Green operators associated with a pre-conditioner (reference material), whose choice depends on the loading type and the small or finite transformation frameworks. The newly developed double tetrahedron scheme is employed to investigate non-periodic problems. Outcomes are compared to those of the classical hexahedral scheme. The robustness and computational efficiency of the presented parallel solver is demonstrated through numerical experiments of non-trivial loading scenarios (tension, bending, normal-mixed loading, torsion-bending), complex and densely discretized microstructures and diverse behavior laws (elasticity, isotropic plasticity, crystal plasticity), within small and finite transformation frameworks.

title: From Regression to Prior-Aware Inference: Solving the ILWE Family in Randomness Leakage Attacks against ML-DSA
authors: Peiheng Zhang, Yuejun Liu, Wei Cheng, Muye Li, Honglin Shao, Yongbin Zhou
abstract:
ML-DSA is a representative lattice-based signature scheme standardized by NIST. It relies on signing randomness and rejection sampling to ensure that released signatures are statistically independent of the secret key. Practical implementations, however, may leak partial information about this randomness, and such leakage can transform public signatures into ILWE-type problems, resulting in secret key disclosure risks.
  Such randomness leakage attack can be formulated as a two-stage key-recovery procedure, in which leaked partial information and public signatures are first transformed into an ILWE-family instance, and then a recovery solver is applied to recover the secret key. Existing work has mainly focused on the first stage by constructing such instances under different leakage models. By contrast, the role of solver in the subsequent instance-solving stage remains under-explored, and existing attacks often rely on ad-hoc model-specific solvers. To address this gap, we propose a unified framework to systematically evaluate different recovery solvers on leakage-derived ILWE-family instances. The framework covers three ILWE instances, including the ordinary ILWE, Fiat-Shamir ILWE (FS-ILWE) and Concealed ILWE (CILWE) under different scenarios.
  Within our framework, we explore three classes of solvers. Our experiments show that the solver has a significant impact on the secret-key recovery efficiency. In particular, on FS-ILWE, prior-aware discrete-inference reduces the number of informative relations by one to two orders of magnitude compared to the baselines: Compared with OLS, BP constitutes a reduction by a factor of 15.4x-64.9x in noise-free settings, and by a factor of 10.5x-73.9x in noisy settings. Overall, this work provides a systematic evaluation on different solvers in randomness leakage attacks, and presents new benchmarks for future analysis on ML-DSA.
zh_title: 从回归到先验感知推理：解决ML-DSA随机性泄露攻击中的ILWE家族问题
translation: ML-DSA是NIST标准化的一种具有代表性的基于格的签名方案。它依赖于签名随机性和拒绝采样来确保发布的签名与私钥在统计上是独立的。然而，实际实现可能会泄露关于这种随机性的部分信息，这种泄露可能将公开签名转化为ILWE（整数学习错误）类型的问题，从而导致私钥泄露风险。此类随机性泄露攻击可以表述为一个两阶段的密钥恢复过程，其中泄露的部分信息和公开签名首先被转化为ILWE家族实例，然后应用恢复求解器来恢复私钥。现有工作主要集中在第一阶段，即在不同泄露模型下构建此类实例。相比之下，后续实例求解阶段中求解器的作用仍未得到充分探索，且现有攻击通常依赖于特定的临时求解器。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了一个统一框架，用于系统地评估泄露衍生的ILWE家族实例上的不同恢复求解器。该框架涵盖了三种ILWE实例，包括不同场景下的普通ILWE、Fiat-Shamir ILWE (FS-ILWE) 和隐藏ILWE (CILWE)。在我们的框架内，我们探索了三类求解器。实验表明，求解器对密钥恢复效率有重大影响。特别是，在FS-ILWE上，先验感知离散推理将信息关系的数量比基线减少了1到2个数量级：与OLS相比，BP在无噪声设置下减少了15.4倍至64.9倍，在有噪声设置下减少了10.5倍至73.9倍。总的来说，这项工作为随机性泄露攻击中的不同求解器提供了系统评估，并为ML-DSA的未来分析提出了新的基准。
tldr: 本文系统评估了针对ML-DSA随机性泄露攻击的求解器，发现先验感知推理算法能显著提升攻击效率，将所需数据量降低一到两个数量级。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于从“求解器”的角度对ML-DSA的随机性泄露攻击进行了系统性评估，而非仅仅关注泄露模型本身。它提出的统一框架涵盖了多种ILWE变体，并验证了先验感知推理算法（如BP）在降低攻击复杂度方面的显著优势，为评估后量子密码算法的侧信道安全性提供了重要的基准和方法论。
motivation: 现有的针对ML-DSA随机性泄露攻击的研究多集中在泄露模型构建上，而对于后期的实例求解阶段缺乏系统性研究，且现有求解器多为特定模型下的临时方案，缺乏统一的评估标准。
method: 提出了一个统一的框架来系统评估针对ILWE家族实例的不同恢复求解器。该框架涵盖了普通ILWE、FS-ILWE和CILWE三种实例，并对比了包括普通最小二乘法（OLS）和置信传播（BP）在内的三类求解器。
results: 实验表明求解器显著影响密钥恢复效率。在FS-ILWE中，先验感知推理相比基准方法（如OLS）将所需信息关系数量减少了1至2个数量级，在无噪声和有噪声环境下分别实现了最高64.9倍和73.9倍的性能提升。
conclusion: 研究证明了求解器选择对ML-DSA随机性泄露攻击的效率至关重要。通过引入先验感知推理框架，显著减少了恢复密钥所需的样本量，证实了现有攻击方法在算法层面上仍有巨大的优化空间。

title: Energy-Efficient GPU DVFS for Fine-Tuning of SLMs on Resource-constrained Embedded Devices
authors: Jurn-Gyu Park, Sanzhar Zholdybayev, Aidar Amangeldi, Ademi Zhanuzakova
abstract: Dynamic Voltage Frequency Scaling (DVFS) on resource-constrained embedded GPU platforms is essential for energy-efficient small language model (SLM) fine-tuning, as privacy- and personalization-driven adaptation increasingly requires local execution and involves repeated forward-backward optimization over many mini-batches, making it substantially more time- and energy-intensive than single-pass inference. To this end, 1) we first characterize the fine-tuning behavior of representative encoder-only SLMs of BERT variants, and autoregressive decoder-only SLMs of Pythia variants on GLUE benchmarks. In addition to the characterizations, 2) we propose a simple yet effective ML-based model selection that selects energy-optimal GPU DVFS settings on resource-constrained embedded platforms. Our results on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin demonstrate average 13.11% energy savings (up to 26.73%) over MAXN Mode 0, which has no explicit power cap.

title: Is Domain Adaptation Always Helpful? A Frozen-Backbone Study of Cross-Domain Sentiment Transfer
authors: Phat Tran, Artin Lahni, Pranav Kulkarni, Yaolun Zhang
abstract: Sentiment analysis with frozen pre-trained language model (PLM) backbones has become a common paradigm, yet the practical benefit of explicit domain adaptation remains unclear, particularly when backbones encode varying degrees of target-domain knowledge. We present a preliminary case study evaluating a controlled family of frozen embedding backbones (Qwen3-Embedding 0.6B, 4B, 8B), alongside RoBERTa-base and FinBERT. We train a lightweight MLP adapter on consumer reviews using Domain-Adversarial Neural Networks (DANN), Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD), and Supervised Contrastive Learning (SCL), and evaluate transfer to movie reviews (SST-2) and a heavily restricted subset of financial news (Financial PhraseBank). Within this constrained sample, we observe two distinct transfer patterns. On SST-2, domain adaptation provides negligible gain regardless of scale. On the financial subset, explicit domain adaptation appears to recover substantial performance for small general-purpose backbones. Notably, we find that adversarial alignment (DANN) is associated with degraded performance for domain-specialized backbones like FinBERT, consistent with erosion of pre-existing domain-specific structure, whereas supervised contrastive loss appears to preserve it. These preliminary findings suggest that the efficacy of explicit domain adaptation is highly contingent on whether the frozen backbone already possesses target-domain coverage.

title: Mitigating Errors in LLM-Generated Web API Invocations via Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Constrained Decoding
authors: Daniel Maninger, Leon Chemnitz, Jannis Brugger, Tushar Lamba, Amir Molzam Sharifloo, Mira Mezini
abstract:
Integration of web APIs is a cornerstone of modern software systems, yet writing correct web API invocation code remains challenging due to complex and evolving API specifications. Although LLMs are increasingly used for code generation, previous work has empirically shown that their ability to generate correct web API integrations is limited. At the same time, mitigation techniques and their effectiveness for this setting remain insufficiently understood.
  In this paper, we propose and systematically evaluate retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and constrained decoding (CD) as two complementary approaches to improving LLM-generated web API invocation code. For RAG, we design a retriever that processes OpenAPI specifications and retrieves compact endpoint representations to inject into model prompts. For CD, we introduce an automatic translation from OpenAPI specifications to regex-based constraints enforced during generation.
  We evaluate both approaches on WAPIIBench's existing synthetic dataset and on a new real-world dataset derived from GitHub repositories. Our results show that RAG reduces hallucinations and improves correctness when generating full API invocations but reduces it when the endpoint is already provided as it encourages the generation of unnecessary parameters. In contrast, CD reliably prevents illegal URLs, HTTP methods, and arguments and substantially improves overall correctness for both starter codes.
comment: 54 pages, 11 figures; supersedes arXiv:2509.20172v6, which is a discarded journal extension of our work

title: FlexRC: A Flexible Multi-Point Model Order Reduction Method for Many-Port RC Networks
authors: Yuncheng Xu, Siyuan Yin, Lin Liu, Fan Yang, Xuan Zeng, Chengtao An, Yangfeng Su
abstract: Efficient model order reduction for many-port resistor-capacitor (RC) networks is essential in post-layout circuit simulation. Existing high-accuracy elimination-based methods have certain limitations, such as fixed frequency points, large reduced-order models, or high reduction cost. This paper proposes FlexRC, a flexible multi-point model order reduction method for many-port RC networks. FlexRC starts from the same elimination step as previous methods, and then constructs a nonorthogonal projection basis by a modified block rational Arnoldi process to generate a sparse banded reduced model. FlexRC features three adjustable components: user-specified frequency points, a tolerance-controlled port-reduction technique for the internal subsystem, and an optional sparsity-control strategy. We discuss passivity under port-reduction perturbations, analyze moment matching, and provide a conservative error estimate for port reduction. Numerical experiments on industrial RC examples and IBM power-grid examples demonstrate the effectiveness of FlexRC in terms of reduction time and transient simulation time.

title: Prior-First, Condition-Second: Scalable and Controllable Hand Motion Completion
authors: Mingyi Shi, Xuelin Chen, Taku Komura
abstract: Synthesizing hand motion that matches the full body motion and the semantic labels is a difficult task due to their high degrees of freedom and the lack of semantic labels. To cope with this issue, we propose a prior-first, condition-second framework for body-conditioned hand motion completion. Our framework first learns a generic body-hand kinematic prior from large-scale unstructured and unlabeled motion data, capturing the intrinsic coordination between global body dynamics and hand articulation. Semantic control is then introduced through lightweight adaptation on top of the frozen prior, avoiding the need to relearn kinematic structure for each control interface. Our framework centers on a streaming, autoregressive body-hand prior that generates coherent, kinematically consistent hand motion from body dynamics in real time, using structured kinematic modeling to maintain mechanical body-hand coupling. To enable practical controllability under limited supervision, we introduce semantically-layered adapters that inject conditioning signals at appropriate kinematic levels, supporting both self-supervised attribute control and weakly supervised text-driven control with only a few hours of labeled data. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that our framework improves kinematic plausibility, robustness, and controllability compared to end-to-end conditioned baselines, particularly in low-resource and cross-dataset settings. We further showcase real-time inference and an interactive authoring workflow, highlighting the applicability to production animation pipelines. Homepage: https://AIGAnimation.github.io/HandPrior/
zh_title: 先验优先，条件随后：可扩展且可控的手部动作补全
translation: 合成符合全身动作和语义标签的手部动作是一项艰巨的任务，原因在于其具有极高的自由度且缺乏语义标签。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种用于身体条件手部动作补全的“先验优先，条件随后”框架。我们的框架首先从大规模非结构化和未标注的运动数据中学习通用的身体-手部运动学先验，以捕捉全局身体动力学与手部关节之间的内在协调性。随后，通过在冻结的先验之上进行轻量级适配来引入语义控制，从而避免了为每个控制接口重新学习运动学结构。我们的框架以流式、自回归的身体-手部先验为核心，利用结构化运动学建模来维持机械性的身体-手部耦合，从而实时生成连贯、符合运动学规律的手部动作。为了在有限监督下实现实际的可控性，我们引入了语义分层适配器，在适当的运动学级别注入条件信号，仅需少量标注数据即可支持自监督属性控制和弱监督文本驱动控制。广泛的评估表明，与端到端的条件基准方法相比，我们的框架在运动学合理性、鲁棒性和可控性方面有所提升，特别是在低资源和跨数据集设置下。我们进一步展示了实时推理和交互式创作工作流，突出了其在生产动画流程中的适用性。
tldr: 一种通过预训练通用运动先验并结合轻量级语义适配器，实现低数据需求、实时且高可控性的手部动作补全框架。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了“先验优先，条件随后”的架构，通过解耦通用运动先验与特定语义控制，显著降低了对标注数据的依赖，并提高了模型的泛化能力与实时性，非常适合生产环境。
motivation: 现有的手部动作合成方法面临高自由度带来的复杂性，且严重缺乏带语义标注的训练数据，导致难以实现高质量、可控的手部动作补全。
method: 提出了一种“先验优先，条件随后”的框架。首先从大规模无标注数据中学习通用的身体-手部运动学先验；随后通过轻量级的语义分层适配器（Semantically-layered adapters）在冻结的先验基础上注入条件控制信号，实现自监督属性控制和弱监督文本驱动控制。模型采用流式自回归架构以支持实时推理。
results: 实验结果表明，该框架在运动学合理性、鲁棒性和可控性方面均优于端到端基准方法，特别是在低资源和跨数据集场景下表现出色，并支持实时推理和交互式工作流。
conclusion: 该框架成功实现了在低资源条件下生成高质量、可控且符合人体运动学规律的手部动作，证明了先验学习在复杂动作合成任务中的有效性。

title: A Lower Bound for Read-Once Parity Branching Programs
authors: Ben Lee Volk
abstract: We prove an $\tildeΩ(n^2)$ lower bound for read-once parity branching programs computing an explicit boolean function on $n$ variables. The previous best lower bound was $\tildeΩ(n^{1.5})$. Our lower bound is proved by reducing the problem to a lower bound in algebraic circuit complexity.
zh_title: 读取一次奇偶分支程序的下界
translation: 我们证明了计算 $n$ 个变量上显式布尔函数的读取一次奇偶分支程序的 $\tildeΩ(n^2)$ 下界。之前的最佳下界是 $\tildeΩ(n^{1.5})$。我们的下界是通过将该问题归约为代数电路复杂性中的下界来证明的。
keywords: 读取一次奇偶分支程序
tldr: 本文将读取一次奇偶分支程序的下界从 $\tildeΩ(n^{1.5})$ 提升至 $\tildeΩ(n^2)$，通过归约至代数电路复杂性证明。
ai_comments: 该研究在复杂性理论领域取得了重要进展，通过将布尔函数复杂度问题转化为代数电路复杂度问题，成功打破了长期存在的读取一次奇偶分支程序下界瓶颈，展现了不同计算模型之间深刻的联系。
motivation: 旨在提升对读取一次奇偶分支程序计算布尔函数复杂度的理论理解，并改进之前 $\tildeΩ(n^{1.5})$ 的最佳下界结果。
method: 通过将问题归约为代数电路复杂性中的下界问题来证明。
results: 证明了计算显式布尔函数的读取一次奇偶分支程序的下界为 $\tildeΩ(n^2)$。
conclusion: 研究证明了读取一次奇偶分支程序计算特定布尔函数的下界为 $\tildeΩ(n^2)$，改进了之前的最优结果。

title: Intercepting an Agile Target with Net-Carrying Drones using Competitive Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
authors: Timothée Gavin, Murat Bronz
abstract: This article presents a solution to intercept an agile drone by a team of agile drone carrying catching nets. We formulate the problem as a competitive Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) task. To address the problem of nonstationarity and catastrophic forgetting of agents overfitting to the current opponent strategy, we train the pursuers and the evader using Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO) with Prioritized Fictitious Self Play (PFSP). We train the agents in a high-fidelity simulator using low-level control commands, collective thrust and body rates (CTBR), to achieve agile flights for both the pursuers and the evader. We compare the performance of the trained policies in terms of catch rate, time to catch and crash rates, against heuristic baselines and show that our solution outperforms them. Ablation studies show that PFSP lead to more robust policies that can adapt to different opponent strategies, and that a low-level control commands are crucial for learning performing strategies in the pursuit-evasion task. Finally, a qualitative analysis of the learned behaviours highlights the emergence of cooperative tactics among the pursuers.
zh_title: 利用竞争性多智能体强化学习实现携带网无人机对敏捷目标的拦截
translation: 本文提出了一种利用携带网的敏捷无人机团队拦截敏捷目标的方法。我们将该问题表述为竞争性多智能体强化学习（MARL）任务。为了解决非平稳性以及智能体对当前对手策略过拟合导致的灾难性遗忘问题，我们使用带有优先级虚拟自我对弈（PFSP）的多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）来训练追捕者和逃逸者。我们在高保真模拟器中使用低级控制指令（集体推力和机身速率，CTBR）来训练智能体，以实现追捕者和逃逸者的敏捷飞行。我们将训练策略在捕获率、捕获时间和碰撞率方面的表现与启发式基准进行了比较，并表明我们的方案优于它们。消融研究表明，PFSP能带来更鲁棒的、能适应不同对手策略的策略，且低级控制指令对于学习追逃任务中的高性能策略至关重要。最后，对所学行为的定性分析突出了追捕者之间协作策略的涌现。
tldr: 本文提出了一种利用PFSP优化的MARL方法，通过低级控制指令训练无人机团队，实现了对敏捷目标的有效协作拦截，性能超越传统启发式方法。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将竞争性多智能体强化学习（MARL）应用于无人机捕获任务，并通过引入优先级虚拟自我对弈（PFSP）解决了非平稳性和灾难性遗忘问题。其不仅关注捕获成功率，还通过低级控制指令（CTBR）实现了更灵活的飞行控制，展现了多智能体协作策略的涌现，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。
motivation: 针对如何利用携带网的无人机团队有效拦截敏捷目标的问题，旨在解决多智能体训练中的非平稳性以及智能体对特定对手策略过拟合导致的灾难性遗忘问题。
method: 采用竞争性多智能体强化学习（MARL），结合多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）与优先级虚拟自我对弈（PFSP）算法，在仿真器中使用低级控制指令（CTBR）进行训练。
results: 实验结果表明，该方案在捕获率、捕获时间和碰撞率方面均优于启发式基准方法；消融实验证实了PFSP能提升策略鲁棒性，且CTBR控制对于学习高效策略至关重要。
conclusion: 该研究证明了利用基于PFSP的MAPPO算法和低级控制指令，能够有效训练无人机团队协作捕获敏捷目标，其性能优于启发式基准，且具有良好的鲁棒性和适应性。

title: Signed-Graph Recommendation as Structural Consistency Maximization
authors: Zifan Wang, Siyu Chen, Wenzhuo Song
abstract: While signed social recommendation has shown great potential by modeling both trust and distrust relations, its effectiveness is often hindered by structural noise and data sparsity. In this work, we first identify a fundamental inconsistency across the structural, propagation, and semantic layers of existing models, which leads to biased representations learned from sparse or noisy datasets. Furthermore, we observe that most existing methods treat the observed graph as fixed, failing to bridge the gap between noisy topologies and reliable social semantics. To address these issues, we propose a unified framework named SSC-Loop that treats signed social recommendation as the maximization of structural consistency. SSC-Loop includes three dedicated modules: ESA-DA for structural consistency, a P/N/O propagation mechanism for propagation consistency, and a contrastive learning objective for semantic consistency. Experiments on Epinions demonstrate that SSC-Loop achieves strong performance on explicit signed social rating prediction, while auxiliary results on Slashdot under a derived link-existence setting further suggest its ability to exploit signed social structures. Source code is available at https://github.com/Refrainwww/SSC-Loop.

title: SearchEyes: Towards Frontier Multimodal Deep Search Intelligence via Search World Simulation
authors: Zhengbo Jiao, Yiming Cheng, Yilei Jiang, Kaituo Feng, Rui Huang, Tianyi Jiang, Juanxi Tian, Jiapeng li, Qunzhong Wang, Tailai Chen, Qianshan Wei, Chuan Xiao, Shanyu Rong, Yangfu Li, Yanhan Zhou, Yunpu Ma, Yifan Zhang, Xiangyu Yue
abstract: Training multimodal search agents to perform multi-hop reasoning remains challenging due to a fundamental structural disconnect: existing pipelines construct training data, search environments, and reward signals independently, causing synthesized structural metadata to be discarded, environments to rely on irreproducible external engines, and RL rewards to remain sparse at the trajectory level. We present \textbf{SearchEyes}, which uses a typed knowledge graph as the backbone of a \emph{simulated search world} that unifies all three components. We propose \textbf{Perception-Knowledge Chains (PKC)} to sample constrained multi-hop paths over the visual-knowledge intersection of Wikidata5M, retaining hop-level entity metadata that simultaneously defines a self-contained search world and step-level reward anchors. We further propose \textbf{Hop-Anchored Policy Optimization (HaPO)}, which reuses these anchors for step-level credit assignment without a separately trained process reward model. Experiments on six multimodal knowledge-intensive benchmarks show that SearchEyes achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source multimodal search agents, with SearchEyes-27B improving over the strongest open-source baseline by 6.2 points on average.%

title: Integrating knowledge graphs and multilingual scholarly corpora for domain-adaptive LLMs in SSH
authors: Adam Faci, Alessio Miaschi, Anne Combe, Pascal Cuxac, Francesca Frontini, Nicolas Larrousse, Stéphane Pouyllau
abstract: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into scientific research workflows, particularly for bibliographic discovery and literature synthesis, raises significant methodological, epistemic and regulatory challenges for the Social Sciences and Humanities (SSH), especially with regard to disciplinary diversity, multilingual access to sources and the evaluation of results. This paper presents an on-going use case developed within the European project LLMs4EU and the ALT-EDIC infrastructure, aimed at adapting foundation models to SSH research practices and supporting tasks such as question answering, comparative document analysis and literature review. The evaluation framework follows the LLMs4EU protocol and encompasses both independent quantitative benchmarking (retrieval, summarisation, traceability and hallucination detection) and a qualitative assessment involving a panel of Digital Humanities experts. By embedding model adaptation within research infrastructures and a structured legal and ethical compliance framework, the use case explores how domain-sensitive and regulation-aware generative AI can support SSH scholarship while preserving reliability and epistemic responsibility.
comment: 8 pages, 4 tables, workshop LLMs4SSH of LREC 2026 conference
zh_title: 整合知识图谱与多语言学术语料库以实现人文社科领域的LLM自适应
translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在科学研究工作流（特别是文献发现和综述）中的整合，为人文社科（SSH）领域带来了重大的方法论、认识论和监管挑战，特别是在学科多样性、多语言资源获取以及结果评估方面。本文展示了欧洲项目LLMs4EU和ALT-EDIC基础设施内的一个正在进行的用例，旨在使基础模型适应SSH研究实践，并支持问答、比较文档分析和文献综述等任务。评估框架遵循LLMs4EU协议，涵盖了独立定量基准测试（检索、摘要、可追溯性和幻觉检测）以及涉及数字人文专家小组的定性评估。通过将模型适配嵌入研究基础设施以及结构化的法律和伦理合规框架，该用例探讨了领域敏感和监管意识强的生成式AI如何在保持可靠性和认识论责任的同时支持SSH学术研究。
tldr: 通过结合知识图谱与专业语料库，并嵌入伦理合规框架，本文探索了如何让大型语言模型更好地服务于人文社科研究。
ai_comments: 该研究通过将LLM与领域知识图谱及多语言语料库结合，为解决人文社科（SSH）领域的专业化需求提供了切实可行的路径。其创新点在于不仅关注技术性能，还强调了法律合规与学术诚信，为AI在学术研究中的负责任应用提供了参考范式。
motivation: 解决LLM在人文社科（SSH）领域应用时面临的学科多样性、多语言资源获取及结果评估等方法论与伦理挑战，旨在构建领域敏感且合规的生成式AI。
method: 采用LLMs4EU协议，通过整合领域知识图谱与多语言学术语料库对基础模型进行领域自适应，并结合定量基准测试（检索、摘要、可追溯性、幻觉检测）与数字人文专家的定性评估。
results: 初步建立了一个能够支持问答、比较文档分析和文献综述的领域适配框架，并通过定量与定性评估验证了其在学术研究中的潜力。
conclusion: 通过将领域模型适配与研究基础设施及伦理法律框架深度整合，可以有效提升LLM在人文社科研究中的可靠性与学术责任感。

title: Agentic AI for IPoDWDM Network Lifecycle Automation: An MCP-Enabled Architecture
authors: Chunmin Xia, Jakub Harbaczewski, Nikhil Dsilva, Julie Raulin, Dominic Schneider, Achim Autenrieth
abstract: We present a distributed, vendor-agnostic multi-MCP architecture for SDN-based automation and autonomous control of multi-vendor, multi-layer IPoDWDM networks. The framework enables E2E service lifecycle automation, closed-loop cross-layer control using GNPy model and optical telemetry, and is experimentally validated on a IPoDWDM testbed.
comment: Accepted for oral presentation at the European Conference on Optical Communication (ECOC 2026)
zh_title: 用于IPoDWDM网络生命周期自动化的智能代理AI：一种基于MCP的架构
translation: 我们提出了一种用于基于SDN的多厂商、多层IPoDWDM网络自动化和自主控制的分布式、与厂商无关的多MCP架构。该框架支持端到端服务生命周期自动化，利用GNPy模型和光遥测技术进行跨层闭环控制，并在IPoDWDM测试平台上进行了实验验证。
tldr: 提出了一种分布式多MCP架构，实现了多厂商IPoDWDM网络的端到端自动化与闭环控制。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个支持多厂商、多层IPoDWDM网络的分布式架构，并利用MCP（多域控制器）实现了端到端的自动化和跨层闭环控制，这对于提升光网络运维效率具有重要意义。局限性在于摘要未提及在超大规模或复杂网络环境下的可扩展性问题。
motivation: 旨在解决多厂商、多层IPoDWDM网络中复杂的端到端服务生命周期自动化和跨层控制难题。
method: 提出了一种基于SDN的分布式、与厂商无关的多MCP（多域控制器）架构，利用GNPy模型和光遥测技术实现闭环控制。
results: 通过IPoDWDM实验平台验证了该架构在实现端到端服务生命周期自动化和跨层闭环控制方面的有效性。
conclusion: 提出的多MCP架构能够有效实现IPoDWDM网络的自动化运维和跨层闭环控制，并通过实验验证了其可行性。

title: NegROI: Click-Centric Uncertainty-Guided Refinement with Scene-Conditioned Negative Prompts for Robust Interactive 3D Segmentation
authors: Shuheng Zhang, Feng Wu
abstract: Interactive 3D segmentation aims to extract object masks in point clouds with minimal user clicks. Despite recent progress, most existing approaches still struggle with (i) coarse voxel resolution that blurs fine boundaries under limited clicks and (ii) hard false positives caused by confusing background structures. These issues are exacerbated by density and scale shifts across datasets (e.g., dense RGB-D reconstructions vs. sparse LiDAR scans), where fixed refinement heuristics and purely click-driven decoding generalize poorly. To address them, we propose NegROI -- a novel transformer-based interactive framework that couples click-centric multi-resolution refinement with scene-conditioned negative prompts. Given a coarse voxel prediction, it refines only a local Region Of Interest (ROI) around the current click on a finer grid and fuses refined logits back to the coarse mask. To improve robustness and efficiency, we introduce uncertainty-driven selective refinement that prioritizes ambiguous regions. Meanwhile, we model hard background patterns via a set of scene-conditioned negative prompts obtained by cross-attention over scene tokens. We further stabilize these prompts with a diversity regularizer. Finally, we propose boundary-aware hard negative mining to supervise negative-prompt attention toward boundary-proximal, high-confidence false positives. Our experiments on common benchmark datasets (i.e., ScanNet, S3DIS, and KITTI) demonstrate improved click efficiency and reduced false positives, with stronger cross-dataset robustness than the state-of-the-art baselines.

title: Delay-Aware Active Triangulation with Uncertainty-Driven Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Counter-UAS
authors: Seungwook Lee, David Hyunchul Shim
abstract: Multi-agent active visual triangulation enables precise 3D localization of aerial targets by coordinating mobile observers with controllable cameras. However, existing methods assume instantaneous state feedback, ignoring cumulative latency from detection, communication, and decision propagation. We present a delay-aware, uncertainty-driven multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for target localization in Counter-UAS applications. Our contributions are: (1) a Dec-POMDP formulation with Age-of-Information (AoI) augmented observations enabling delay-aware coordination -- AoI improves triangulation validity by 10.6 percentage points; (2) a controlled comparison showing that perception-consistent rewards outperform privileged clean-state rewards (0.547 m vs.0.633 m RMSE, 27% fewer track losses) -- both policies are trained through identical observation noise but differ in what they are optimized for, producing a stability-robustness tradeoff; and (3) multi-source analytical covariance propagation incorporating pixel, pose, gimbal, and intrinsics uncertainties -- restricting to angular noise alone causes 2.8-fold RMSE degradation. Experiments with MAPPO in 4096 parallel environments achieve 0.547 +- 0.217 m RMSE with 78.1% triangulation validity, while MLP policies achieve near-zero validity (0.7%), confirming recurrent memory as essential for delay compensation.
zh_title: 面向反无人机系统的延迟感知主动三角测量：基于不确定性驱动的多智能体强化学习研究
translation: 多智能体主动视觉三角测量通过协调带有可控摄像头的移动观测器，实现了对空中目标的精确3D定位。然而，现有方法假设状态反馈是即时的，忽略了探测、通信和决策传播带来的累积延迟。我们提出了一种用于反无人机（C-UAS）目标定位的延迟感知、不确定性驱动的多智能体强化学习框架。我们的贡献包括：（1）一种具有信息新鲜度（AoI）增强观测的Dec-POMDP公式，实现了延迟感知协调——AoI将三角测量有效性提高了10.6个百分点；（2）对照实验表明，感知一致性奖励优于特权清洁状态奖励（RMSE为0.547米 vs 0.633米，跟踪丢失减少27%）——两种策略通过相同的观测噪声进行训练，但优化目标不同，产生了稳定性与鲁棒性的权衡；（3）结合像素、姿态、云台和内在参数不确定性的多源解析协方差传播——仅限制在角度噪声会导致RMSE恶化2.8倍。在4096个并行环境中使用MAPPO进行的实验达到了0.547 ± 0.217米的RMSE和78.1%的三角测量有效性，而MLP策略的有效性接近于零（0.7%），证实了循环记忆对于延迟补偿至关重要。
tldr: 通过引入信息新鲜度（AoI）和感知一致性奖励，该方法解决了多智能体在反无人机任务中因通信延迟导致的定位失效问题。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将信息新鲜度（AoI）与多智能体强化学习相结合，解决了无人机反制（C-UAS）场景中通信与计算延迟对目标定位的致命影响。研究揭示了感知一致性奖励比传统理想状态奖励更具鲁棒性，并强调了循环记忆网络在处理延迟补偿中的不可替代性。局限性在于未提及在极高动态或极端干扰环境下的长期表现。
motivation: 现有的多智能体视觉三角测量方法忽略了探测、通信和决策传播中的累积延迟，导致在真实的反无人机应用中定位精度下降甚至目标丢失。
method: 提出了一种基于Dec-POMDP框架的延迟感知多智能体强化学习方法，通过引入信息新鲜度（AoI）增强观测，结合感知一致性奖励函数，并使用包含多源不确定性传播的协方差模型进行训练。
results: 实验表明，该方法在4096个并行环境中实现了0.547米均方根误差（RMSE）和78.1%的定位有效性；相比之下，不具备循环记忆的MLP策略几乎失效（有效性仅0.7%）。
conclusion: 本研究证明了引入AoI观测和感知一致性奖励机制，能显著提升多智能体在存在延迟情况下的目标定位精度与稳定性，且循环神经网络对于处理此类时延任务至关重要。

title: Umm... With Transformers? Insights from Filled Pause Use across Four Slavic Parliaments
authors: Ivan Porupski, Branimir Dropuljić, Nikola Ljubešić
abstract: Filled pauses (FPs) are a universal feature of spontaneous speech, yet most studies rely on small, single-language corpora, limiting the generalisability of their findings. We analyse ~4,000 hours of parliamentary speech across four related Slavic languages (Croatian, Czech, Polish, Serbian). FP occurrence is obtained via transformer-based automatic detection, while FP rate is modelled using Generalised Estimating Equations (GEE) with Mundlak correction to distinguish within- from between- speaker effects. We replicate a negative association of age and speech rate with FP rate, but find that gender effects are language-specific and directionally opposite to most prior literature. Novel analyses of sentiment, political orientation, and power status reveal a consistent positive association between sentiment and FP rate, alongside parliament-specific modulation by orientation and power status, with opposition speakers tending toward lower FP rates than governing coalition speakers.
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at InterSpeech 2026. Code published: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20766877
zh_title: 嗯……用Transformer？关于四国斯拉夫议会中填充停顿使用的见解
translation: 填充停顿（FPs）是自发语言中的普遍现象，但大多数研究依赖于小型、单语言语料库，限制了其研究结果的普遍性。我们分析了四种相关斯拉夫语言（克罗地亚语、捷克语、波兰语、塞尔维亚语）中约4000小时的议会演讲。通过基于Transformer的自动检测获取FP出现频率，并使用带有Mundlak校正的广义估计方程（GEE）对FP率进行建模，以区分说话人内部和说话人之间的效应。我们复制了年龄和语速与FP率的负相关关系，但发现性别效应具有语言特异性，且方向与大多数先前文献相反。对情感、政治倾向和权力地位的创新性分析显示，情感与FP率之间存在持续的正相关关系，同时政治倾向和权力地位对FP率具有议会特异性的调节作用，反对派发言人倾向于比执政联盟发言人具有更低的FP率。
tldr: 研究在大规模斯拉夫议会语料中发现，填充停顿的使用受年龄、语速、情感及政治背景影响，且表现出显著的跨语言差异，挑战了部分既有的通用性结论。
ai_comments: 该研究通过大规模多语言语料库克服了传统小样本研究的局限性，特别是在利用Transformer进行自动检测方面具有创新性。其发现性别效应具有语言特异性，挑战了既有文献的普遍观点，为跨语言语用学研究提供了重要参考。
motivation: 现有的填充停顿研究多依赖于小规模、单语言语料库，导致研究结果的普遍性受限，因此需要在大规模多语言语境下重新审视这些特征。
method: 利用基于Transformer的模型自动检测约4000小时的议会演讲中的填充停顿，并采用带有Mundlak校正的广义估计方程（GEE）对填充停顿率进行建模，以区分说话人内部和说话人之间的效应。
results: 研究复制了年龄和语速与填充停顿率的负相关关系；发现性别效应具有语言特异性且与多数既有研究相反；揭示了情感与填充停顿率呈正相关；并观察到政治立场和权力地位对填充停顿率的调节作用具有议会特异性。
conclusion: 研究表明填充停顿的使用受到年龄、语速、情感及政治语境的复杂影响，且存在显著的跨语言差异，强调了在语用分析中考虑语言和文化特异性的重要性。

title: MemDefrag: Latent Memory Defragmentation for Large Language Models
authors: Ruiyi Yan, Zhuoyuan Mao, Yiwen Guo
abstract: Latent memory, which stores past knowledge fragments as per-layer hidden states, has emerged as a promising paradigm (e.g., MemoryLLM and M+) for long-term memory in large language models (LLMs). However, the paradigm suffers from significant performance degradation during memory updates, due to positional encoding misalignment and the absence of any tracing mechanism to distinguish target memory fragments from irrelevant ones. To discover such a tracing mechanism, we probe the layer-wise attention density over stored memory fragments, and find that a small set of middle transformer layers consistently concentrates the highest density on the target fragment - exposing an inherent tracing signal. In light of this, we propose MemDefrag, a training-free and model-agnostic framework that (1) uses a middle-layer tracing signal to conduct memory defragmentation (rank, reorder, and filter memories), and (2) applies an informativeness-guided proportional forgetting mechanism once capacity is exceeded. Experiments show that MemDefrag substantially outperforms MemoryLLM and M+ on knowledge retention (e.g., 43.0% vs. 17.4%/17.6% after 50 memory updates) and long-context benchmarks, and generalizes well across various LLMs and latent-memory variants.

title: Imagined Rollouts are Kinematic, Not Dynamic: A Diagnosis of Long-Horizon World-Model Failure
authors: Finn Rasmus Schäfer, Korbinian Moller, Yuan Gao, Christian Oefinger, Sebastian Schmidt, Johannes Betz
abstract: Long-horizon failure in world models is conventionally attributed to compounding error, a generic framing that does not distinguish what kind of error compounds. We propose a kinematic-vs-dynamic reframing: world models tend to imagine kinematically rather than dynamically. We operationalize this as the imagined Kinematic-Consistency Error, a per-step diagnostic that measures how far a rollout departs from a closed-form kinematic null, paired with a perturbation protocol that tests whether iKCE responds when physical conditions cross a regime boundary. We instantiate the diagnostic on a released DreamerV3 checkpoint trained on DMC walker-walk, where imagined iKCE runs roughly two orders of magnitude above that of matched real-physics rollouts. Across a friction sweep that crosses the gait-collapse boundary, the model's iKCE stays statistically flat even as the trained policy's reward collapses through the same range, providing the kinematic-not-dynamic signature. The diagnostic distinguishes kinematic from dynamic imagination at horizons longer than the embodiment's gait period.
comment: 9 Pages Workshop Paper accepted at RSS Robot World Model Workshop 2026
zh_title: 想象的展开是运动学的，而非动力学的：对长时程世界模型失效的诊断
translation: 世界模型在长时程预测中的失效通常被归因于复合误差，这是一种未能区分具体误差类型的笼统表述。我们提出了一个运动学与动力学的重构框架：世界模型倾向于进行运动学而非动力学的想象。我们将此操作化为“想象运动学一致性误差”（iKCE），这是一种逐步诊断指标，用于测量展开轨迹偏离封闭形式运动学零点的程度，并配合扰动协议来测试iKCE在物理条件跨越区域边界时的响应。我们在DreamerV3的DMC walker-walk检查点上应用了该诊断，发现想象的iKCE比匹配的真实物理展开高出约两个数量级。在跨越步态崩溃边界的摩擦力扫描中，尽管训练策略的奖励在同一范围内崩溃，模型的iKCE却保持统计学上的平稳，提供了“运动学而非动力学”的特征证据。该诊断能够在超过实体步态周期的时程上区分运动学想象与动力学想象。
tldr: 世界模型在长时程预测中失效是因为它们只学会了简单的几何运动（运动学），而无法理解和模拟真实的物理规律（动力学）。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入“运动学与动力学”的视角，为诊断世界模型在长时程预测中的失效提供了一个独特且具有可解释性的框架。其核心贡献在于证明了模型往往仅学习到了简单的几何运动规律，而忽略了复杂的物理动力学约束，这对于改进机器人学习和强化学习中的模型预测能力具有重要意义。
motivation: 传统观点将世界模型的长时程失效归因于“复合误差”，但这种说法过于笼统；研究者试图通过区分“运动学”与“动力学”误差，深入探究模型为何在长时程预测中表现不佳。
method: 提出了“运动学一致性误差”（iKCE）诊断指标，通过测量想象轨迹与封闭形式运动学零点的偏离程度，并结合摩擦力参数变化的扰动协议，来区分模型的想象是运动学驱动还是动力学驱动。
results: 在DreamerV3模型上的实验表明，其想象轨迹的iKCE远高于真实物理轨迹；在摩擦力变化导致步态崩溃的测试中，模型无法感知物理条件变化，呈现出明显的“运动学而非动力学”特征。
conclusion: 世界模型在长时程预测中失效的主要原因是其倾向于进行“运动学”而非“动力学”的想象，这种偏差导致模型无法准确捕捉物理环境的动态变化。

title: Decoupled Single-Mask Annotation Noise Detection via Cross-Sectional Patch Self-Consistency
authors: Yinheng Zhu, Xiaowei Xu
abstract: Vascular computed tomography datasets are commonly annotated only once per scan, yielding the pervasive yet under addressed problem of single mask annotation noise. Existing solutions either require costly multirater fusion or are coupled with network training, preventing explicit auditing of where and why labels fail. We introduce a decoupled framework for single-mask annotation noise detection that leverages cross-sectional patch self-consistency to produce interpretable and auditable noise evidence. Tubular anatomy exhibits strong cross-sectional recurrence: patches extracted orthogonally along vessel centrelines recur in appearance across locations and subjects. Thus, anatomically similar patches should have consistent masks, and disagreement signals unreliable annotation. Our method samples cross-sectional patches, retrieves intensity-equivalent neighbours via scalable vector search, and computes a patch-level noise score from statistical mask disagreement, yielding explicit image-mask evidence for every flagged region. Aggregating scores produces scan-level quality maps for dataset quality assessment or quality-weighted training. Experiments on the coronary CT dataset validate the detected noise for improving training robustness and reveal systematic annotation biases. Specifically, transverse and oblique vessels exhibit 5.1 times higher error rates than axis-aligned structures, with additional correlations to cross-sectional area and intensity. Code is available here.
zh_title: 基于跨截面补丁自我一致性的解耦单掩码标注噪声检测
translation: 血管计算机断层扫描（CT）数据集通常每个扫描仅标注一次，导致了普遍存在但尚未得到解决的单掩码标注噪声问题。现有的解决方案要么需要昂贵的多标注者融合，要么与网络训练耦合，无法对标签失败的位置和原因进行明确审计。我们引入了一种用于单掩码标注噪声检测的解耦框架，利用跨截面补丁自我一致性来产生可解释且可审计的噪声证据。管状解剖结构表现出很强的跨截面重复性：沿血管中心线正交提取的补丁在不同位置和受试者之间表现出外观上的重复。因此，解剖结构相似的补丁应该具有一致的掩码，不一致则信号表示标注不可靠。我们的方法采样跨截面补丁，通过可扩展向量搜索检索强度等效的邻居，并从统计掩码不一致性计算补丁级噪声评分，从而为每个标记区域提供明确的图像-掩码证据。聚合评分可产生扫描级质量图，用于数据集质量评估或质量加权训练。在冠状动脉CT数据集上的实验验证了所检测到的噪声在提高训练鲁棒性方面的作用，并揭示了系统性的标注偏差。具体而言，横向和斜向血管的错误率是轴向对齐结构的5.1倍，并与横截面积和强度存在额外相关性。代码已公开。
tldr: 提出一种无需多重标注即可检测血管CT影像中单掩码标注噪声的方法，通过分析解剖补丁的一致性提供可解释的噪声证据。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种解耦的框架，无需多重标注或与特定网络训练绑定，即可检测单掩码标注噪声。通过利用血管结构的跨截面自我一致性，该方法不仅能识别噪声，还能提供可解释的图像-掩码证据，这对于医疗影像数据的质量审计和偏差分析具有重要意义。
motivation: 血管CT数据集通常只有一个标注掩码，存在严重的单掩码标注噪声问题；现有解决方案要么成本高昂，要么与训练过程耦合，缺乏可解释性和审计能力。
method: 提出一种解耦框架：利用血管中心线正交提取跨截面补丁，通过可扩展向量搜索检索强度相近的邻居，并计算补丁级别的掩码不一致性评分，从而生成噪声证据和扫描级别的质量图。
results: 实验证明该方法能有效检测标注噪声并提升训练鲁棒性；揭示了系统性标注偏差，发现横向和斜向血管的错误率是轴向对齐结构的5.1倍。
conclusion: 该研究成功提出了一种基于跨截面补丁自我一致性的解耦噪声检测框架，不仅提升了模型训练的鲁棒性，还揭示了医学影像标注中存在的系统性偏差。

title: Multimodal Video-to-Music Recommendation via Semantic Retrieval and Temporal Reranking
authors: Seungheon Doh, Minhee Lee, Sangmoon Lee, Ben Sangbae Chon, Juhan Nam
abstract: We present VTMR, a two-stage framework for Video-To-Music Recommendation. In Stage~1, VTMR aligns comprehensive video and music signals in a joint audio-visual-text representation space and efficiently retrieves semantically compatible candidates using coarse global embeddings. In Stage~2, it reranks the retrieved candidates by attending to the temporal sequences of both video and music, thereby capturing fine-grained temporal correspondence. Evaluated on the video-to-music recommendation task, the multimodal retrieval stage improves R@10 from 14.2 to 15.9 and Median Rank from 75 to 58 over the strongest baseline; the temporal reranker further boosts R@10 to 18.3 and Median Rank to 46, demonstrating complementary gains from richer query encoding and temporal alignment. A human preference study confirms that VTMR is on par with a commercial baseline in overall preference, while outperforming a generative baseline in music quality.
comment: Accepted for publication at The Machine Learning for Audio workshop at ICML 2026

title: InfluMatch: Frontier-Quality KOL Search at 4B-Model Cost
authors: Krittanon Kaewtawee, Petmongkon Pornpichitsuwan, Natchaya Temyingyong, Nutnicha Laplamoon, Wachiravit Modecrua, Krittin Pachtrachai, Touchapon Kraisingkorn
abstract: Matching influencers (KOLs) to free-form, multi-part Thai marketing criteria is today served either by keyword search over structured profiles, which misses semantic fit, or by prompting frontier LLMs over every candidate, which is accurate but slow and expensive. We present InfluMatch, a low-cost three-stage cascade -- retrieval $\rightarrow$ rerank $\rightarrow$ reason -- built entirely from small open-weight models: dense retrieval returns 50 candidates, a 4B pointwise reranker scores each by the log-probability of a single Yes token and keeps 10, and a 4B reasoner grades the shortlist per criterion on a rubric with a Thai rationale. The cascade is designed for cost: reasoning over a filtered top-10 halves token spend versus reasoning over all 50 while scoring 14 points higher. End-to-end against human relevance labels on an 11-query set with all 50 candidates labeled, the full cascade reaches 94.1% P@5, versus a retrieval-only baseline near random; it matches the frontier model Kimi-K2.6 (91.8%) while emitting ${\sim}35\times$ fewer output tokens and serving a 50-KOL query in ${\sim}20$ s on one A100. Notably, the only fine-tuning that pays off is pairwise: a SimPO-tuned reranker matches the frontier baseline's best-pick accuracy (78.0 EM), whereas fine-tuning the reasoner on pointwise per-criterion labels improves offline scores yet degrades end-to-end ranking -- an inversion we trace to the design of the absolute labeling task -- leaving the untuned base model as the strongest deployed reasoner. The result is a deployable, explainable KOL search system at a small fraction of frontier serving cost.
zh_title: InfluMatch：以4B模型成本实现前沿水平的KOL搜索
translation: 将KOL与自由形式、多部分的泰语营销标准相匹配，目前的方法要么是对结构化配置文件进行关键词搜索（缺乏语义契合度），要么是对每个候选者提示前沿LLM（准确但缓慢且昂贵）。我们提出了InfluMatch，这是一个低成本的三阶段级联架构——检索$\rightarrow$重排$\rightarrow$推理——完全由小型开放权重模型构建：密集检索返回50个候选者，4B逐点重排器通过单个“Yes”令牌的对数概率对每个候选者评分并保留10个，4B推理器根据准则和泰语理由对候选名单进行评分。该级联架构专为成本设计：与对所有50个候选者进行推理相比，对过滤后的前10名进行推理减少了一半的令牌消耗，同时得分提高了14个点。在11个查询集（包含50个候选者标注）的人类相关性标签对比测试中，完整级联达到了94.1%的P@5，而仅检索基线接近随机；它匹配了前沿模型Kimi-K2.6（91.8%），同时输出令牌减少了约35倍，并在单个A100上以约20秒的速度处理50个KOL的查询。值得注意的是，唯一有效的微调是成对微调：SimPO微调的重排器匹配了前沿基线的最佳选择准确率（78.0 EM），而对推理器进行基于逐点准则标签的微调虽然提高了离线分数，却降低了端到端排名效果——这种倒置现象源于绝对标注任务的设计——这使得未微调的基础模型成为最强的部署推理器。其结果是一个可部署、可解释的KOL搜索系统，其服务成本仅为前沿模型的一小部分。
tldr: InfluMatch通过三阶段小模型级联架构（检索-重排-推理），在保持前沿大模型匹配性能的同时，将推理成本降低了35倍。
ai_comments: 该研究通过巧妙的级联架构（检索-重排-推理）解决了大规模语言模型在特定任务（KOL匹配）中成本过高的问题。其创新之处在于证明了利用小模型（4B）进行精细化分工可以达到甚至超过大模型的性能，同时显著降低了推理成本。特别是关于微调策略（Pairwise vs Pointwise）的洞察，为构建高效的检索系统提供了重要的工程实践参考。
motivation: 现有的KOL搜索方案要么因基于关键词匹配而缺乏语义理解，要么因依赖昂贵的顶级大模型（Frontier LLMs）进行全量扫描而导致成本过高、速度缓慢。
method: 采用“检索 $\rightarrow$ 重排 $\rightarrow$ 推理”的三阶段级联方法：首先通过密集检索获取50个候选者；接着使用4B参数的重排器基于“Yes”令牌的对数概率进行筛选；最后通过4B参数的推理器对前10名候选者进行基于标准的评分和解释。
results: InfluMatch在端到端评估中达到了94.1%的P@5，性能优于顶级模型Kimi-K2.6（91.8%），同时输出令牌数减少约35倍，且单次查询耗时约20秒。此外，研究发现成对微调（Pairwise）对重排器有效，而对推理器进行逐点微调反而会降低端到端排名效果。
conclusion: InfluMatch 通过三阶段小模型级联架构，在保持与顶级大模型相当的准确率的同时，大幅降低了计算成本和延迟，是处理垂直领域搜索任务的高效且可部署的解决方案。

title: MCP-Enabled Agentic AI for Autonomous IPoDWDM Network Lifecycle Automation
authors: Chunmin Xia, Jakub Harbaczewski, Nikhil Dsilva, Julie Raulin, Dominic Schneider, Achim Autenrieth
abstract: This demo presents an MCP-enabled agentic AI architecture for autonomous control of vendor-agnostic IPoDWDM networks. We demonstrate live end-to-end lifecycle multi-layer automation and closed-loop control using GNPy and telemetry, validated on a real testbed.
comment: Accepted for demo presentation at the European Conference on Optical Communication (ECOC 2026)
zh_title: 用于IPoDWDM网络全生命周期自主自动化的MCP赋能代理式AI
translation: 本演示介绍了一种用于IPoDWDM网络（IP over DWDM）自主控制的MCP赋能代理式AI架构。我们演示了利用GNPy和遥测技术实现端到端全生命周期多层自动化和闭环控制，并在真实的测试平台上进行了验证。
tldr: 提出了一种利用MCP驱动代理式AI实现IPoDWDM网络自动化控制的架构，并验证了其在多层自动化和闭环控制方面的有效性。
ai_comments: 该论文展示了MCP（Model Context Protocol）在网络自动化领域的应用，通过将代理式AI与底层网络控制技术结合，实现了跨厂商IPoDWDM网络的闭环自主管理，具有很高的实用价值和前瞻性。
motivation: 针对现有IPoDWDM网络缺乏跨厂商、自主化全生命周期管理的问题，旨在探索一种基于代理式AI的自动化控制方案。
method: 采用MCP赋能的代理式AI架构，结合GNPy工具和遥测技术（telemetry），在真实测试平台上进行端到端多层自动化与闭环控制验证。
results: 在真实测试平台上成功验证了该架构在IPoDWDM网络中实现端到端生命周期多层自动化和闭环控制的能力。
conclusion: MCP赋能的代理式AI架构能够有效实现IPoDWDM网络的全生命周期自主自动化与闭环控制。

title: Faithful or Findable? Evaluating LLM-Generated Metadata for RDF Dataset Search
authors: Riccardo Terrenzi, Serkan Ayvaz
abstract: Dataset search depends heavily on metadata, making LLM-generated metadata a consequential form of synthetic content in retrieval systems. We study six metadata-generation settings for RDF datasets, ranging from simple rewriting to profile-grounded and agentic graph-based generation, and evaluate them jointly for retrieval effectiveness and faithfulness. Unconstrained metadata rewriting delivers the strongest retrieval gains over the original metadata, but it is also the least faithful, showing that search improvements can be driven by unsupported semantic expansion. More grounded settings substantially improve faithfulness, and profile-grounded rewriting provides the most balanced trade-off between retrieval effectiveness and grounding. These findings position synthetic metadata as a system-level IR problem in which effectiveness, provenance, and trust must be evaluated together.
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, accepted at SynthIR @ SIGIR 2026

title: Propose and Attend: Training-free MLLM Grounding Confidence via Multi-Token Localized Attention
authors: Daniel Shalam, Emanuel Ben Baruch, Avi Ben Cohen, Tal Remez
abstract: Multimodal large language models can emit localized predictions, bounding boxes for objects and temporal windows for video and audio events, but they hallucinate these regions prolifically. The model's own token log-probabilities are nearly uninformative: they conflate grounding quality with input ambiguity, and coordinate tokens become near-deterministic once the model commits. We propose Multi-Token Localized Attention (MTLA): a training-free, post-hoc score that measures how strongly a prediction's tokens attend to the region they claim. Prior attention-based detectors, which sum attention over the entire input modality and read a single response token, are weaker special cases; we show that summing only within the claimed region and aggregating across all prediction tokens recovers a stronger grounding signal. The same recipe applies almost trivially to other modalities and tasks: object detection in images and temporal localization in video and audio. Across multiple MLLM families and three modalities, MTLA improves hallucination AUROC by +7 to +38 over the best prior training-free baseline. Used as a confidence score for re-ranking, it nearly doubles the zero-shot COCO detection AP of an open-source 8B generalist (from 20.4 to 37.0), narrowing the gap to supervised detectors without any task-specific training.
zh_title: 提出与关注：通过多令牌局部注意力实现无需训练的多模态大模型定位置信度评估
translation: 多模态大模型能够输出局部预测，例如物体的边界框以及视频和音频事件的时间窗口，但这些区域往往存在大量的幻觉。模型自身的令牌对数概率几乎没有信息量：它们将定位质量与输入模糊性混为一谈，且一旦模型做出决策，坐标令牌就会变得近乎确定。我们提出了多令牌局部注意力（MTLA）：一种无需训练的事后评分方法，用于衡量预测令牌对其所声明区域的关注程度。先前的基于注意力的检测器将整个输入模态的注意力相加并读取单个响应令牌，这是较弱的特殊情况；我们证明，仅在声明区域内求和并跨所有预测令牌进行聚合，可以获得更强的定位信号。同样的方案几乎可以轻松应用于其他模态和任务：图像中的目标检测以及视频和音频中的时间定位。在多个 MLLM 系列和三种模态中，MTLA 将幻觉检测的 AUROC 比现有的最佳无需训练基准提升了 7 到 38 个点。作为重排序的置信度分数，它使开源 8B 通用模型的零样本 COCO 检测 AP 几乎翻了一番（从 20.4 提升至 37.0），在没有任何特定任务训练的情况下缩小了与有监督检测器的差距。
tldr: 提出一种无需训练的 MTLA 方法，通过分析模型内部的注意力权重来评估多模态定位任务的置信度，大幅降低了模型幻觉并提升了定位准确性。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一种无需训练、事后可用的置信度评分方法（MTLA），巧妙地利用了多模态大模型内部的注意力机制来解决幻觉问题。其重要性在于无需额外训练即可显著提升模型在定位任务上的表现，且具有跨模态的通用性。局限性在于其表现仍依赖于模型本身的基础注意力质量。
motivation: 多模态大模型在生成定位预测（如边界框、时间窗口）时存在严重的幻觉问题，且传统的基于令牌对数概率的方法无法有效区分定位质量与输入模糊性。
method: 提出多令牌局部注意力（MTLA），这是一种无需训练的事后评分方法，通过将预测令牌在所声明区域内的注意力值进行求和与聚合，从而量化预测的置信度。
results: 在多个模型系列和三种模态上，MTLA 将幻觉检测的 AUROC 提升了 7 到 38 个点；在 COCO 目标检测任务中，将 8B 通用模型的零样本 AP 从 20.4 提升至 37.0，接近有监督检测器的水平。
conclusion: MTLA 是一种高效的、无需训练的置信度评估框架，通过多令牌局部注意力机制，显著降低了多模态大模型的定位幻觉，并在多种任务和模态中展现了超越现有基准的性能。

title: Learning Sparsest Linear Causal DAGs with Latent Confounders via Higher-Order Cumulants
authors: Ming Cai, Hisayuki Hara
abstract:
Recovering the exact directed acyclic graph (DAG) in linear non-Gaussian acyclic models with latent confounders (LvLiNGAM) remains a challenging problem. Although LvLiNGAM is identifiable only up to an observational equivalence class, each equivalence class is characterized by a unique sparsest DAG. Recovering the sparsest DAG from finite samples, however, remains difficult. Although existing methods are asymptotically consistent, they do not provide an explicit finite-sample procedure for recovering the unique sparsest DAG, nor do they handle models with an arbitrary number of latent confounders.
