title: Efficient and Robust Lock-Free Multi-Word Compare-and-Swap via Contention-Aware Helping
authors: Motoki Unno, Kento Sugiura, Yoshiharu Ishikawa
abstract: Efficient concurrent access to shared memory remains a central focus for researchers seeking to enhance data structure performance. Lock-based synchronization often limits scalability and introduces liveness issues such as deadlocks. In contrast, implementing non-blocking structures with single-word compare-and-swap (CAS) instructions increases algorithmic complexity because of unavoidable intermediate states. Multi-word compare-and-swap (MCAS) operations offer a practical primitive for atomically updating multiple discrete memory locations, thereby addressing these challenges. However, under high contention, helping mechanisms designed to guarantee lock-freedom may cause excessive cache invalidations and significant performance degradation. Furthermore, existing approaches are vulnerable to the ABA problem. Current lock-free MCAS algorithms may duplicate the execution of the same operation, leading to inconsistent states in certain edge cases. To address these challenges, this paper introduces a new lock-free MCAS algorithm that achieves both efficiency and consistency. First, we propose a contention-aware helping mechanism that dynamically regulates the number of concurrent helpers through exponential backoff and embedded entry counters. These counters also enable a fast garbage-collection path, significantly reducing memory management overhead. Second, we introduce a version embedding approach to suppress the ABA problem during MCAS operations. Although version embedding requires several bits per target memory region to store version information, embedded versions allow helpers to avoid duplicated MCAS executions. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves up to three times the throughput of the state-of-the-art lock-free MCAS algorithm. Moreover, the results indicate that version embedding is sufficient to prevent the ABA problem in practical scenarios.
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEICE for possible publication
zh_title: 通过争用感知帮助实现高效且鲁棒的无锁多字比较与交换
translation: 高效并发访问共享内存仍然是研究人员寻求提升数据结构性能的核心焦点。基于锁的同步机制常常限制可扩展性并引入死锁等活性问题。相比之下，使用单字比较与交换（CAS）指令实现非阻塞结构由于不可避免的中间状态而增加了算法复杂性。多字比较与交换（MCAS）操作提供了一种实用的原语，用于原子性地更新多个离散内存位置，从而解决了这些挑战。然而，在高争用条件下，旨在保证无锁的帮助机制可能导致过度的缓存失效和显著的性能下降。此外，现有方法容易受到ABA问题的影响。当前的无锁MCAS算法可能会重复执行相同的操作，导致在某些边缘情况下状态不一致。为了解决这些挑战，本文介绍了一种新的无锁MCAS算法，该算法同时实现了效率和一致性。首先，我们提出了一种争用感知帮助机制，通过指数退避和嵌入式入口计数器动态调节并发帮助者的数量。这些计数器还支持快速垃圾回收路径，显著减少内存管理开销。其次，我们引入了一种版本嵌入方法，以在MCAS操作期间抑制ABA问题。尽管版本嵌入需要每个目标内存区域的几个比特来存储版本信息，但嵌入式版本允许帮助者避免重复的MCAS执行。实验结果表明，所提出的方法实现了比现有最先进的无锁MCAS算法高达三倍的吞吐量。此外，结果表明版本嵌入足以在实际场景中预防ABA问题。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的无锁多字比较与交换（MCAS）算法，旨在解决现有并发访问共享内存方法中的效率和一致性问题。该算法引入了争用感知帮助机制和版本嵌入方法，显著提高了在高争用下的吞吐量（最高三倍）并有效预防了ABA问题。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过提出一种创新的无锁MCAS算法，解决了并发数据结构中的关键挑战。动态争用感知帮助机制是提高高争用下效率的关键创新，而版本嵌入为ABA问题提供了鲁棒的解决方案。高达三倍的显著性能提升凸显了其在高性能计算中的实际重要性。
motivation: 现有基于锁的同步机制限制了可扩展性并引入了死锁等活性问题。单字比较与交换（CAS）在实现非阻塞结构时增加了算法复杂性。多字比较与交换（MCAS）在解决原子更新多个离散内存位置的挑战时，在高争用下，其帮助机制可能导致过度的缓存失效和显著的性能下降。此外，现有方法容易受到ABA问题的影响，并可能导致操作重复执行和状态不一致。
method: 本文提出了一种新的无锁MCAS算法，旨在实现效率和一致性。主要方法包括：1. 提出了一种争用感知帮助机制，通过指数退避和嵌入式入口计数器动态调节并发帮助者的数量。这些计数器还支持快速垃圾回收路径，显著减少内存管理开销。2. 引入了一种版本嵌入方法，在MCAS操作期间抑制ABA问题。通过在每个目标内存区域存储版本信息，帮助者可以避免重复的MCAS执行。
results: 实验结果表明，所提出的方法实现了比现有最先进的无锁MCAS算法高达三倍的吞吐量。此外，结果表明版本嵌入足以在实际场景中预防ABA问题。
conclusion: 本文提出的新的无锁MCAS算法，通过其争用感知帮助机制和版本嵌入方法，有效解决了并发内存访问中的效率和一致性挑战，显著优于现有解决方案。

title: BlueMagpie-TTS: A Token-Efficient Tokenizer, Language Model, and TTS for Taiwanese-Accent Code-Switching Speech
authors: Ho Lam Chung, Bo-Xuan Zheng, Cheng-Chieh Huang, Cheng-Han Chang, Jung-Ching Chen, Lok-Lam Ieong, Ting-Lin Hsiao, Yu-Cheng Lee, Yi-Hsin Chung, Yu-Kai Guo, Hung-yi Lee
abstract: Off-the-shelf TTS systems are poorly adapted to Taiwanese Mandarin. Their accent defaults to other Mandarin variants, their tokenizers over-segment common Taiwanese text, and their pronunciation degrades at code-switching boundaries where Chinese and English alternate within one utterance. These problems share one root: the text side lacks adaptation to the Taiwanese context. We address the text side from the bottom up. PangolinTokenizer, a byte-level BPE tokenizer trained on Taiwan-context data, reaches the lowest token rate (0.485 tokens/character) with the smallest vocabulary among nine tokenizers. Barbet, a billion-parameter Traditional-Chinese language model trained on PangolinTokenizer, serves as the text-semantic frontend and ranks first among comparable public models on a 14-task evaluation. BlueMagpie-TTS attaches Barbet to the pretrained acoustic stack of VoxCPM2 through a learned bridge, keeping the acoustic stack fixed. On a 1000-sentence Taiwan-localized test set, it lowers CER from 11.45% to 4.81% and WER from 14.83% to 5.36%, relative reductions of 58.0% and 63.9%. In a blind listening study on 500 of these sentences with ten listeners, 65.6% of majority votes prefer BlueMagpie-TTS.
zh_title: 蓝鹊-TTS：一种用于台湾口音语码转换语音的令牌高效分词器、语言模型和TTS
translation: 现有的TTS系统对台湾普通话的适应性很差。它们的口音默认为其他普通话变体，它们的分词器过度分割常见的台湾文本，并且在中文和英文在同一句中交替出现的语码转换边界处，它们的S发音质量下降。这些问题有一个共同的根源：文本端缺乏对台湾语境的适应。我们从底层解决文本端的问题。PangolinTokenizer是一种在台湾语境数据上训练的字节级BPE分词器，在九种分词器中以最小的词汇量达到了最低的令牌率（0.485 tokens/字符）。Barbet是一个十亿参数的繁体中文语言模型，在PangolinTokenizer上训练，作为文本语义前端，在14项任务评估中在可比较的公共模型中排名第一。BlueMagpie-TTS通过一个学习到的桥接器将Barbet连接到VoxCPM2的预训练声学堆栈，保持声学堆栈固定。在1000句台湾本地化测试集上，它将CER从11.45%降低到4.81%，WER从14.83%降低到5.36%，相对降低了58.0%和63.9%。在对其中500句进行十位听众的盲听研究中，65.6%的多数票偏爱BlueMagpie-TTS。
tldr: BlueMagpie-TTS 是一种针对台湾口音语码转换语音的TTS系统，通过定制的分词器和语言模型解决了现有系统在台湾普通话适应性、分词准确性和语码转换边界发音问题，显著提高了性能。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于从文本端自下而上地解决了针对特定语言变体（台湾普通话）和语码转换场景的TTS系统适应性问题。通过定制化分词器和语言模型，它有效地提升了TTS系统在处理复杂语言现象时的性能。这种方法为其他特定方言或多语言混合场景下的TTS开发提供了有价值的参考。
motivation: 现有的TTS系统在台湾普通话方面表现不佳，其口音不符，分词器对常见台湾文本过度分段，并且在中文和英文交替的语码转换边界处发音质量下降。这些问题根源于文本端缺乏对台湾语境的适应。
method:
研究从文本端着手，开发了以下组件：
1. PangolinTokenizer：一个基于台湾语境数据训练的字节级BPE分词器，实现了最低的令牌率（0.485 tokens/character）和最小的词汇量。
2. Barbet：一个基于PangolinTokenizer训练的十亿参数繁体中文语言模型，作为文本语义前端，在14项任务评估中表现最佳。
3. BlueMagpie-TTS：通过一个学习到的桥接器将Barbet连接到VoxCPM2的预训练声学堆栈，同时保持声学堆栈固定。
results:
1. PangolinTokenizer 在九种分词器中实现了最低的令牌率 (0.485 tokens/character) 和最小的词汇量。
2. Barbet 在14项任务评估中，在可比较的公共模型中排名第一。
3. 在1000句台湾本地化测试集上，BlueMagpie-TTS 将字符错误率 (CER) 从 11.45% 降至 4.81% (相对降低 58.0%)，并将单词错误率 (WER) 从 14.83% 降至 5.36% (相对降低 63.9%)。
4. 在对500句进行盲听研究中，65.6% 的多数票更倾向于 BlueMagpie-TTS。
conclusion: BlueMagpie-TTS通过其专门的PangolinTokenizer和Barbet语言模型，显著提高了对台湾口音语码转换语音的TTS性能，解决了现有系统在适应性、分词和发音方面的问题。

title: ThorArena: Benchmarking Humanoid Physical Interaction with Human Motion-Force Demonstrations
authors: Chenhao Yu, Hongwu Wang, Weitao Zhang, Youhao Hu, Jiachen Zhang, Gangyang Li, Alois Knoll, Shaqi Luo
abstract:
Humanoid robots are increasingly expected to perform contact-rich tasks that require not only accurate whole-body motion but also robust physical interaction with surrounding objects and humans. Although recent advances in humanoid motion imitation and whole-body control have achieved remarkable tracking performance, existing datasets and benchmarks primarily focus on kinematic motion while largely overlooking synchronized interaction forces. As a result, current evaluations fail to capture how external interaction forces affect tracking accuracy, stability, and control robustness.
  In this paper, we present ThorArena, a benchmark for evaluating force-aware humanoid interaction based on human demonstrations with synchronized motion and force measurements. We collect a real-world interaction dataset that simultaneously captures whole-body human motion and forces exerted by both hands across six representative physical interaction tasks. Based on these demonstrations, we propose force-aware evaluation metrics that jointly assess whole-body tracking accuracy, robustness under different force levels, control effort, and episode survival through the Force-Aware Tracking Score (FATS) and complementary diagnostic metrics. We further establish a unified benchmark protocol that replays recorded interaction forces in simulation and provides a standardized evaluation interface for different humanoid control policies.
  Experiments on representative whole-body control policies demonstrate that force-aware evaluation reveals substantial performance differences that remain largely hidden under conventional no-force evaluation. ThorArena provides a practical and reproducible framework for studying force-aware humanoid interaction and offers a new benchmark for evaluating contact-rich humanoid behaviors.
zh_title: ThorArena：基于人体运动-力演示的类人机器人物理交互基准测试
translation:
类人机器人越来越被期望执行接触丰富的任务，这不仅需要精确的全身运动，还需要与周围物体和人类进行鲁棒的物理交互。尽管类人机器人运动模仿和全身控制的最新进展取得了卓越的跟踪性能，但现有数据集和基准主要关注运动学运动，而很大程度上忽略了同步的交互力。因此，当前的评估未能捕捉外部交互力如何影响跟踪精度、稳定性以及控制鲁棒性。
在本文中，我们提出了ThorArena，一个用于评估基于人类演示（同步运动和力测量）的力感知类人机器人交互的基准。我们收集了一个真实世界的交互数据集，该数据集同时捕捉了六个代表性物理交互任务中人体全身运动和双手施加的力。基于这些演示，我们提出了力感知评估指标，通过力感知跟踪分数（FATS）和补充诊断指标，联合评估全身跟踪精度、不同力水平下的鲁棒性、控制努力和任务生存率。我们进一步建立了一个统一的基准协议，该协议在仿真中重放记录的交互力，并为不同的类人机器人控制策略提供标准化的评估接口。
对代表性全身控制策略的实验表明，力感知评估揭示了在传统无力评估下大部分隐藏的实质性性能差异。ThorArena为研究力感知类人机器人交互提供了一个实用且可复现的框架，并为评估接触丰富的类人机器人行为提供了一个新的基准。
tldr: ThorArena是一个用于评估类人机器人物理交互的基准平台，它通过收集同步的人体运动和力测量数据，并提出力感知评估指标和协议，揭示了传统无力评估下隐藏的性能差异。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地提出了ThorArena基准，解决了现有类人机器人评估中长期存在的对交互力关注不足的问题。通过引入同步的运动和力测量数据集以及力感知评估指标，它提供了一个更全面、更真实的评价框架，对于推动类人机器人在复杂、接触丰富任务中的发展具有重要意义。其标准化协议也为不同控制策略的比较提供了便利。
motivation: 现有类人机器人运动模仿和全身控制的进步主要关注运动学，而忽略了同步的交互力，导致当前评估无法捕捉外部交互力如何影响跟踪精度、稳定性和控制鲁棒性。类人机器人越来越需要执行接触丰富的任务，这不仅需要精确的全身运动，还需要与周围物体和人类进行鲁棒的物理交互。
method: 本文提出了ThorArena，一个基于人类演示（同步运动和力测量）来评估力感知类人机器人交互的基准。作者收集了一个真实世界的交互数据集，同步捕捉了六个代表性物理交互任务中人体全身运动和双手施加的力。基于这些演示，提出了力感知评估指标，通过力感知跟踪分数（FATS）和补充诊断指标，联合评估全身跟踪精度、不同力水平下的鲁棒性、控制努力和任务生存率。此外，还建立了一个统一的基准协议，在仿真中重放记录的交互力，并为不同的类人机器人控制策略提供标准化的评估接口。
results: 使用代表性的全身控制策略进行的实验表明，力感知评估揭示了在传统无力评估下大部分隐藏的实质性性能差异。
conclusion: ThorArena为研究力感知类人机器人交互提供了一个实用且可复现的框架，并为评估接触丰富的类人机器人行为提供了一个新的基准。

title: Nested Episodic State Topology (NEST): A Graph-Theoretic Architecture of Cognitive States
authors: Ishant
abstract: We present NEST (Nested Episodic State Topology), a foundational graph-theoretic representational ontology for modeling cognition as structured state formation and transformation rather than as a finished empirical model. Concepts, episodes, percepts, and task contexts are represented as typed, weighted graphs whose nodes may carry internal subgraph payloads; edges are typed under six relation classes -- causal, containment, temporal, associative, evidential, and spatial. Durable belief graphs are separated from capacity-limited working-memory graphs that may host transient non-belief content. WM-belief grounding, conflict catalogs, and belief-update operators specify how transient structure is tested against stored knowledge and how belief is revised. A reusable operator toolkit -- activation, graph-property functionals, working-memory transitions, awareness and trajectory functionals, and belief update -- organizes the formal core. Derived diagnostics such as fragmentation, involvement, signed evaluation, coherence, and active conflict define familiar phenomena in the same ontology; self-related processing is modeled through designated self-image subgraphs within belief. Subsequent sections instantiate this core without new primitives: phenomena signatures, a task-instantiation schema for action selection and failure modes, and compatibility mappings that embed ACT-R, Soar, Sigma, the Common Model of Cognition, Global Workspace Theory, semantic networks, Theory-Theory, and chunking as constrained regions of one language. Mappings constitute the culminating technical section; discussion addresses scope, limitations, and open research directions. The contribution is intentionally foundational: a transparent representational substrate for later empirical, computational, and domain-specific work.
zh_title: 嵌套情景状态拓扑 (NEST)：一种认知状态的图论架构
translation: 我们提出了NEST（嵌套情景状态拓扑），这是一种基础的图论表示本体，用于将认知建模为结构化的状态形成和转换，而非一个已完成的经验模型。概念、情景、感知和任务上下文被表示为类型化、加权的图，其节点可能带有内部子图负载；边在六种关系类别下进行类型化——因果、包含、时间、关联、证据和空间。持久的信念图与容量有限的工作记忆图分离，后者可能承载瞬态非信念内容。工作记忆-信念基础、冲突目录和信念更新操作符指定了瞬态结构如何与存储知识进行检验以及信念如何被修订。一个可重用的操作符工具包——激活、图属性泛函、工作记忆转换、意识和轨迹泛函以及信念更新——组织了形式核心。派生的诊断指标，如碎片化、涉入、有符号评估、连贯性和主动冲突，在同一本体论中定义了熟悉的现象；自我相关处理通过信念中指定的自我形象子图进行建模。后续章节无需新原语即可实例化此核心：现象签名、用于动作选择和失败模式的任务实例化模式，以及兼容性映射，这些映射将ACT-R、Soar、Sigma、通用认知模型、全局工作空间理论、语义网络、理论-理论和组块化嵌入为一种语言的受限区域。映射构成了最终的技术部分；讨论涉及范围、局限性和开放的研究方向。这项贡献是故意奠基性的：为后续的经验、计算和领域特定工作提供一个透明的表示基底。
tldr: NEST是一种基础的图论表示本体，用于将认知建模为结构化的状态形成和转换，而不是一个现成的经验模型。它将概念、事件、感知和任务上下文表示为带类型、加权的图，并定义了工作记忆与信念的交互、操作工具包以及与现有认知架构的兼容性映射。
ai_comments: NEST的创新之处在于它提供了一个统一的、图论基础的认知状态表示框架，能够将概念、情景等复杂的认知元素建模为结构化的图。其重要性体现在它不仅提供了一种新的建模方法，还能通过兼容性映射将现有主流认知架构整合进同一语言体系，展现了强大的理论统一潜力。这种奠基性的工作为未来的认知科学研究提供了透明且可扩展的基底。
motivation: 该论文旨在提出一种基础的图论表示本体，用于将认知建模为结构化的状态形成和转换，而非一个已完成的经验模型。
method: 论文提出了NEST（嵌套情景状态拓扑），这是一种图论表示本体。它将概念、情景、感知和任务上下文表示为带有内部子图负载的类型化、加权图，其边按照六种关系类别（因果、包含、时间、关联、证据、空间）进行类型化。持久的信念图与容量有限的工作记忆图分离，后者可承载瞬态非信念内容。通过工作记忆-信念基础、冲突目录和信念更新操作符来指定瞬态结构如何与存储知识进行检验以及信念如何被修订。一个可重用的操作符工具包（激活、图属性泛函、工作记忆转换、意识和轨迹泛函以及信念更新）组织了形式核心。
results: NEST定义了诸如碎片化、涉入、有符号评估、连贯性和主动冲突等诊断指标，并在同一本体论中定义了熟悉的现象。自我相关处理通过信念中指定的自我形象子图进行建模。该架构无需新原语即可实例化核心，包括现象签名、用于动作选择和失败模式的任务实例化模式，以及兼容性映射，这些映射将ACT-R、Soar、Sigma、通用认知模型、全局工作空间理论、语义网络、理论-理论和组块化嵌入为一种语言的受限区域。
conclusion: 该论文的贡献是奠基性的：提供了一个透明的表示基底，以支持后续的经验、计算和领域特定工作。

title: Determinantal point process sampling for bioacoustic active learning
authors: Hugo Magaldi, Gabriel Dubus
abstract: Eco-acoustic monitoring generates vast volumes of audio data, making active learning a promising approach for reducing annotation effort while efficiently training reliable biodiversity classifiers. This report presents CARE-DPP, a batch active-learning acquisition method submitted to BioDCASE Active Learning for Bioacoustics 2026 challenge. The method combines class-balanced predictive uncertainty with embedding-space novelty, while a determinantal point process (DPP) objective selects a high-quality and non-redundant acquisition batch. The uncertainty-novelty balance is annealed over the annotation budget: early cycles emphasize geometric coverage, whereas later cycles increasingly exploit classifier uncertainty. To mitigate unreliable early scores, the DPP candidate pool mixes top-quality candidates with a decreasing proportion of random exploration. An adaptive acquisition schedule uses smaller batches early and larger batches later. Evaluated over five repeats on the BirdSet HSN, POW and UHH subsets and on ATBFL, CARE-DPP obtains a mean development AULC of 0.50 for macro mAP, compared with 0.46 for the official CoreSet baseline. Ablations identify DPP batch diversification and the adaptive acquisition schedule as the largest contributors.
comment: BioDCASE Challenge 2026 - Task 4 Active learning. Ranked 2/14
zh_title: 生物声学主动学习的行列式点过程采样
translation: 生态声学监测产生了大量的音频数据，使得主动学习成为一种有前景的方法，可以减少标注工作量，同时高效训练可靠的生物多样性分类器。本报告介绍了CARE-DPP，一种提交给BioDCASE 2026生物声学主动学习挑战赛的批处理主动学习采集方法。该方法将类别平衡的预测不确定性与嵌入空间新颖性相结合，同时行列式点过程（DPP）目标选择高质量且非冗余的采集批次。不确定性-新颖性平衡在标注预算内进行退火：早期周期强调几何覆盖，而后期周期则越来越多地利用分类器不确定性。为了减轻早期分数不可靠的问题，DPP候选池将高质量候选与递减比例的随机探索混合。自适应采集调度在早期使用较小的批次，后期使用较大的批次。在BirdSet HSN、POW和UHH子集以及ATBFL上进行五次重复评估，CARE-DPP的宏观mAP平均开发AULC为0.50，而官方CoreSet基线为0.46。消融实验表明，DPP批次多样化和自适应采集调度是最大的贡献者。
tldr: CARE-DPP是一种用于生物声学主动学习的批处理采集方法，它结合了类别平衡的预测不确定性和嵌入空间新颖性，并通过行列式点过程选择高质量、非冗余的批次，在多个数据集上表现优于基线。
ai_comments: 这篇论文提出了一种新颖的主动学习方法CARE-DPP，其创新点在于结合了不确定性、新颖性以及行列式点过程（DPP）进行批次多样化选择。尤其值得关注的是，它引入了不确定性-新颖性平衡的退火策略和自适应批次调度，有效解决了主动学习中早期分数不确定和批次选择效率的问题。在生态声学监测这种数据量巨大的领域，该方法对于减少人工标注成本具有重要意义。
motivation: 生态声学监测产生大量音频数据，需要减少标注工作量并高效训练可靠的生物多样性分类器。
method: 提出CARE-DPP方法，结合类别平衡的预测不确定性与嵌入空间新颖性。使用行列式点过程 (DPP) 目标选择高质量、非冗余的采集批次。不确定性-新颖性平衡会随着标注预算而调整（早期强调几何覆盖，后期利用分类器不确定性）。为减轻早期分数不可靠性，DPP候选池混合了高质量候选和递减比例的随机探索。采用自适应采集策略，早期使用小批次，后期使用大批次。
results: 在BirdSet HSN、POW、UHH子集和ATBFL上，CARE-DPP的宏观mAP平均开发AULC为0.50，而官方CoreSet基线为0.46。消融实验表明DPP批次多样化和自适应采集策略是最大贡献者。
conclusion: CARE-DPP通过结合不确定性、新颖性、DPP批次多样化和自适应采集策略，显著提高了生物声学主动学习的效率和性能。

title: Reward-Density Heuristic for Dynamic Multi-Vehicle Routing: Performance and Computational Efficiency
authors: Manish Kolachalam, Rani Malhotra
abstract: The Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) and its variants represent some of the most practically consequential optimization challenges in modern logistics and urban mobility. In this study, we address a dynamic, online variant combining elements of the VRP and the Orienteering Problem (OP), in which a fleet of vehicles must maximise cumulative reward collected within a fixed time horizon while continuously replanning as new tasks arrive. We propose and evaluate a reward-density heuristic for dynamic multi-vehicle assignment, referred to as the Efficiency heuristic. We evaluate this formulation across two application domains: autonomous drone task allocation and urban taxi dispatch, across multiple fleet sizes and task scales. The proposed method is compared with four classical construction heuristics and three metaheuristic algorithms (Adaptive Large Neighbourhood Search, Genetic Algorithm, and Simulated Annealing), all evaluated under identical conditions. Across all tested configurations, the Efficiency heuristic matches the solution quality of the best metaheuristic algorithms while requiring two to three orders of magnitude less planning time, establishing Pareto dominance over all competing methods on the reward-versus-compute frontier. These findings suggest a practical design principle for real-time allocation and dispatch systems: in dynamic, time-constrained routing environments, carefully designed greedy heuristics can match the output of sophisticated search procedures at a fraction of the computational cost, making them preferable for online deployment.
zh_title: 动态多车辆路径规划的奖励密度启发式算法：性能与计算效率
translation: 车辆路径问题（VRP）及其变体是现代物流和城市交通中一些最具实际影响的优化挑战。在本研究中，我们解决了一个结合了VRP和定向问题（OP）元素的动态、在线变体，其中车队必须在固定时间范围内最大化累积奖励，并随着新任务的到来持续重新规划。我们提出并评估了一种用于动态多车辆分配的奖励密度启发式算法，称为效率启发式算法（Efficiency heuristic）。我们在自主无人机任务分配和城市出租车调度这两个应用领域，以及不同的车队规模和任务规模下评估了这种方法。所提出的方法与四种经典构建启发式算法和三种元启发式算法（自适应大邻域搜索、遗传算法和模拟退火）在相同条件下进行了比较。在所有测试配置中，效率启发式算法的解决方案质量与最佳元启发式算法相匹配，但所需的规划时间减少了两个到三个数量级，在奖励与计算的帕累托前沿上对所有竞争方法建立了帕累托优势。这些发现为实时分配和调度系统提供了一个实用的设计原则：在动态、时间受限的路径规划环境中，精心设计的贪婪启发式算法可以在计算成本极低的情况下达到复杂搜索过程的输出水平，使其成为在线部署的首选。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种奖励密度启发式算法（Efficiency heuristic），用于解决动态多车辆路径规划问题。该算法在保持与最佳元启发式算法相当的解决方案质量的同时，将计算时间缩短了两个到三个数量级，非常适合实时在线部署。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种简单而高效的奖励密度启发式算法，并在多种实际应用场景中验证了其卓越的性能。其核心贡献在于证明了在特定动态、时间受限的优化问题中，精心设计的贪婪启发式算法可以在计算效率上远超复杂的元启发式算法，同时保持解决方案的质量。这对于需要实时决策的物流和交通系统具有重要的实际指导意义。
motivation: 解决现代物流和城市交通中动态、在线的多车辆路径规划问题，该问题结合了VRP和OP元素，目标是在固定时间范围内最大化累积奖励，并随着新任务的到来持续重新规划。
method: 提出并评估了一种奖励密度启发式算法，称为Efficiency heuristic，用于动态多车辆分配。该方法在自主无人机任务分配和城市出租车调度两个应用领域进行评估，并与四种经典构建启发式算法和三种元启发式算法（自适应大邻域搜索、遗传算法和模拟退火）在相同条件下进行比较。
results: 在所有测试配置中，Efficiency heuristic的解决方案质量与最佳元启发式算法相匹配，但所需的规划时间减少了两个到三个数量级，在奖励与计算的帕累托前沿上对所有竞争方法建立了帕累托优势。
conclusion: 在动态、时间受限的路径规划环境中，精心设计的贪婪启发式算法可以在计算成本极低的情况下达到复杂搜索过程的输出水平，使其成为在线部署的首选。

title: SWE-Review: Closing the Loop on Issue Resolution with Agentic Code Review
authors: Ruoyu Wang, Jierun Chen, Shaowei Wang, Chaofan Tao, Sidi Yang, Yuxin Jiang, Kim-Hui Yap, Lifeng Shang, Xiaohui Li, Haoli Bai
abstract: Coding agents increasingly generate pull requests (PRs) for real-world software issues, yet one-shot PR generation remains open-loop: the PR is proposed without systematic review, diagnosis, or revision. We introduce \textbf{SWE-Review}, a framework for closing this loop with agentic code review. Given an issue and an AI-generated PR, a reviewer agent explores the repository, decides whether the PR should be accepted, and provides structured feedback for revision. We evaluate this setting with our proposed \textbf{SWE-Review-Bench} to measure both review correctness and downstream revision usefulness. We further curate \textbf{SWE-Review-Traj} dataset to study broader applications of agentic review and fill the data-scarcity gap for open reviewer training. Experiments show that agentic review continuously improves PRs through a generate-review-revise loop, outperforms single-turn fixed-context review in both decision accuracy and resolve rate after revision, transfers beyond review to improve issue-resolution models, and enables effective and efficient test-time scaling. These results position agentic code review as a practical mechanism for moving AI coding agents from one-shot PR generation toward closed-loop issue resolution.
zh_title: SWE-Review：通过代理代码审查闭环解决问题
translation: 编码代理越来越多地为实际软件问题生成拉取请求（PR），但单次PR生成仍然是开放循环的：PR在没有系统审查、诊断或修改的情况下被提出。我们引入了\textbf{SWE-Review}，一个用于通过代理代码审查来闭合此循环的框架。给定一个问题和一个AI生成的PR，审查代理会探索代码库，决定PR是否应该被接受，并提供结构化反馈进行修改。我们通过提出的\textbf{SWE-Review-Bench}来评估此设置，以衡量审查的正确性和下游修改的有用性。我们进一步整理了\textbf{SWE-Review-Traj}数据集，以研究代理审查的更广泛应用，并弥补开放审查器训练的数据稀缺问题。实验表明，代理审查通过生成-审查-修改循环持续改进PR，在决策准确性和修改后的解决率方面优于单次固定上下文审查，能够迁移到审查之外以改进问题解决模型，并实现了有效且高效的测试时间扩展。这些结果表明，代理代码审查是使AI编码代理从单次PR生成转向闭环问题解决的实用机制。
tldr: SWE-Review引入了一个代理代码审查框架，通过生成-审查-修改循环，系统地审查和改进AI生成的代码拉取请求，从而实现闭环问题解决。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入代理代码审查机制，解决了AI编码代理在生成拉取请求时缺乏系统性审查和修改的开放循环问题，这是一个重要的创新点。其提出的SWE-Review框架和相关数据集为实现更智能、更可靠的自动化软件开发流程提供了实用路径，具有较高的应用价值和潜在影响。
motivation: 现有的AI编码代理生成拉取请求（PR）是单次开放循环的，缺乏系统性的审查、诊断和修改，导致无法有效解决实际软件问题。
method: 引入SWE-Review框架，包含一个审查代理。给定一个问题和一个AI生成的PR，审查代理会探索代码库，决定是否接受PR，并提供结构化反馈进行修改。同时提出了SWE-Review-Bench用于衡量审查正确性和修改有用性，并创建了SWE-Review-Traj数据集用于更广泛的应用研究和训练。
results: 实验表明，代理审查通过生成-审查-修改循环持续改进PR；在决策准确性和修改后的解决率方面优于单次固定上下文审查；可以迁移以改进问题解决模型；并实现了有效且高效的测试时间扩展。
conclusion: 代理代码审查是使AI编码代理从单次PR生成转向闭环问题解决的实用机制。

title: A Dual-CRDT Architecture for Decentralized Trust Governance and Evolution
authors: Amos Brocco
abstract: While CRDTs provide decentralized replication and eventual consistency, Byzantine-resilient deployments require mechanisms for deciding which updates should be trusted and therefore contribute to the reconstructed state. In practice, the trust relationships underlying these decisions may evolve over time as participants join or leave, identities change, and governance rules are revised. However, the information used to make trust decisions is typically managed outside the replicated state itself. This paper introduces a dual-CRDT architecture composed of a \emph{Trust CRDT} and a \emph{Data CRDT}. The Trust CRDT stores and evolves governance information, while the Data CRDT is reconstructed according to the trust configuration derived from the Trust CRDT. Governance therefore becomes replicated state rather than an externally managed artifact. Building upon deterministic reconstruction and Byzantine trust filtering, the proposed model allows trust relationships and governance rules to evolve through ordinary CRDT updates. The resulting architecture provides a recursive governance model in which governance rules determine their own future evolution while simultaneously governing application data. The approach is implemented as a prototype on top of Melda and melda-sec and should be viewed as an initial exploration of decentralized trust governance and evolution for Byzantine-resilient CRDT systems.
zh_title: 去中心化信任治理与演进的双CRDT架构
translation:
虽然CRDT提供了去中心化复制和最终一致性，但拜占庭容错部署需要机制来决定哪些更新应该被信任并因此有助于重建状态。在实践中，支撑这些决策的信任关系可能会随着参与者的加入或离开、身份的改变以及治理规则的修订而随时间演变。然而，用于做出信任决策的信息通常在复制状态本身之外进行管理。本文引入了一种双CRDT架构，由一个
信任CRDT和一个
数据CRDT组成。信任CRDT存储和演进治理信息，而数据CRDT则根据从信任CRDT派生的信任配置进行重建。因此，治理成为复制状态，而不是外部管理的工件。基于确定性重建和拜占庭信任过滤，所提出的模型允许信任关系和治理规则通过普通的CRDT更新进行演变。由此产生的架构提供了一个递归治理模型，其中治理规则决定了它们自身的未来演变，同时管理应用程序数据。该方法作为Melda和melda-sec之上的原型实现，应被视为去中心化信任治理和拜占庭容错CRDT系统演进的初步探索。
tldr: 本文提出了一种双CRDT架构，包括一个信任CRDT和一个数据CRDT，用于在拜占庭容错的CRDT系统中实现去中心化的信任治理和演进。信任CRDT管理不断演变的治理规则，而数据CRDT则根据这些规则重建状态，从而使治理成为复制状态并允许信任关系通过CRDT更新进行演变。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于通过双CRDT架构将治理信息本身整合到复制状态中，使信任规则能够动态且递归地演变。这解决了去中心化系统中一个关键挑战，通过将信任演变直接集成到CRDT框架中，增强了拜占庭容错CRDT系统的鲁棒性和适应性。论文也指出这是“初步探索”，表明未来有进一步发展和验证的空间。
motivation: 现有的拜占庭容错CRDT部署通常将信任决策和演变中的信任关系在复制状态之外进行管理，导致治理信息的外部化和管理复杂性。
method: 本文引入了一种双CRDT架构，由一个信任CRDT和一个数据CRDT组成。信任CRDT负责存储和演进治理信息，而数据CRDT则根据信任CRDT派生的信任配置进行状态重建。该模型基于确定性重建和拜占庭信任过滤，允许信任关系和治理规则通过常规CRDT更新进行演变。该方法已在Melda和melda-sec之上实现了一个原型。
results: 该架构提供了一个递归治理模型，其中治理规则可以决定自身的未来演变，同时管理应用程序数据。
conclusion: 本文提出了一种双CRDT架构，作为去中心化信任治理和拜占庭容错CRDT系统演进的初步探索，实现了一个递归治理模型，将治理规则纳入复制状态并允许其动态演变。

title: Shifting is Optimal under Gap-ETH: A Lower Bound Framework for Geometric Approximation Schemes
authors: Manuel Cáceres, Sándor Kisfaludi-Bak, Saeed Odak
abstract:
The shifting technique of Hochbaum and Maass [J.ACM'85] produces PTASes with the fastest known running times $n^{O(1/\varepsilon^{d-1})}$ for several $d$-dimensional geometric problems. However, it is only known, due to Marx [FOCS'07], that these algorithms are indeed optimal for dimension $d=2$.
  We show that these running times are optimal under Gap-ETH for every constant dimension. More precisely, we develop a framework that enables us to prove the conditional optimality of the shifting algorithms for several problems on unit ball graphs, such as maximum independent set, maximum induced forest, and others, as well as for the problem of piercing unit balls.
  Our framework is built using the cube wiring theorem of De Berg et al. [SICOMP'20] and the reduction steps of Marx and Sidiropoulos [SoCG'14] to create a convenient maximization version of geometric CSP that can be used as a basis for reductions.
zh_title: 在Gap-ETH下，Shifting算法是最优的：一个几何近似方案的下界框架
translation:
Hochbaum和Maass的Shifting技术[J.ACM'85]为几个d维几何问题产生了具有已知最快运行时间$n^{O(1/\varepsilon^{d-1})}$的PTASes。然而，仅由Marx[FOCS'07]证明这些算法对于维度d=2确实是最优的。
我们证明了在Gap-ETH假设下，这些运行时间对于每个常数维度都是最优的。更准确地说，我们开发了一个框架，使我们能够证明Shifting算法对于单位球图上的几个问题（如最大独立集、最大导出森林等）以及刺穿单位球问题的条件最优性。
我们的框架是利用De Berg等人[SICOMP'20]的立方体布线定理和Marx和Sidiropoulos[SoCG'14]的归约步骤构建的，以创建一个方便的几何CSP最大化版本，可以作为归约的基础。
tldr: 本文证明了Hochbaum和Maass的Shifting技术在Gap-ETH假设下，对于任意常数维度d，其运行时间$n^{O(1/\varepsilon^{d-1})}$是几何问题的最优解。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将Shifting技术的最优性证明从二维扩展到任意常数维度，这在理论上具有重要意义。通过构建一个通用的下界框架，为几何近似算法的设计和分析提供了新的工具和视角。
motivation: Hochbaum和Maass的Shifting技术为d维几何问题提供了运行时间最快的PTASes，但其最优性此前仅被Marx证明适用于d=2维。本文的动机是证明这些算法在Gap-ETH假设下对于所有常数维度都是最优的。
method: 本文开发了一个框架，利用De Berg等人提出的立方体布线定理和Marx与Sidiropoulos的归约步骤，创建了一个方便的几何CSP最大化版本，作为归约的基础来证明Shifting算法的条件最优性。
results: 本文证明了在Gap-ETH假设下，Shifting算法的运行时间对于每个常数维度都是最优的。具体而言，它证明了单位球图上多个问题（如最大独立集、最大导出森林等）以及刺穿单位球问题的Shifting算法的条件最优性。
conclusion: 在Gap-ETH假设下，Shifting技术为许多d维几何问题提供了最优的近似方案，其运行时间$n^{O(1/\varepsilon^{d-1})}$被证明是不可改进的。

title: Packet Routing for the Quantum Internet
authors: Robert Malaney
abstract: We present a new design for quantum packet routing within the emerging Quantum Internet, highlighting how a little-used feature of Internet Protocol Version 6 (IPv6), namely Extension Headers, can lead to a significant amount of quantumness within the IP layer. Taking a minimalist approach to alterations of established standards, we outline the changes required in order for quantum teleportation, quantum routing, and superpositions of these processes to be enabled. Relative to other proposals for routing within the Quantum Internet, the architecture we propose enables a wider range of outcomes allowed by quantum mechanics. We do not claim any optimally in our design, but rather a pathway to invoke new quantum routing outcomes via small additions to the current IPv6.
zh_title: 量子互联网的分组路由
translation: 我们提出了一种量子互联网中量子分组路由的新设计，强调了互联网协议版本6 (IPv6) 中一个鲜为人知的功能——扩展头，如何能在IP层中引入显著的量子特性。采取对既有标准进行极小改动的路径，我们概述了启用量子隐形传态、量子路由以及这些过程的叠加态所需的变化。相对于其他量子互联网路由提案，我们提出的架构能够实现量子力学所允许的更广泛的结果。我们并未声称该设计达到最优，而是提供了一条通过对当前IPv6进行少量添加来触发新量子路由结果的途径。
tldr: 通过在现有IPv6协议中添加扩展头，实现了一种兼容现有互联网基础设施的量子分组路由架构。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于巧妙地利用了现有IPv6协议中的“扩展头”（Extension Headers）机制，以最小化改动的方式引入了量子路由能力，为现有的互联网基础设施向量子互联网演进提供了一条切实可行的过渡路径。其局限在于作者明确表示未追求设计的最优性，仅是提出了一种概念性架构。
motivation: 为了解决量子互联网中缺乏高效、兼容现有网络架构的量子分组路由机制的问题，探索如何利用现有的IPv6基础设施来承载量子信息传输。
method: 采用极简主义方法，通过利用IPv6的扩展头（Extension Headers）功能，在不对现有标准进行大规模改动的前提下，定义支持量子隐形传态、量子路由及两者叠加态的协议扩展机制。
results: 提出了一种新的量子分组路由架构，该架构能够支持量子隐形传态和量子路由，且相比其他提案，能够实现更广泛的量子力学允许的路由结果。
conclusion: 通过在IPv6协议中增加少量扩展头，可以有效地实现量子隐形传态和量子路由功能，为构建量子互联网提供了一种兼容性好且灵活的架构方案。

title: HAPS as a Hypercell: Enabling Coverage and Capacity Carrier Shutdown in Cellular Networks
authors: Matteo Bernabè, David López-Pérez, Nicola Piovesan
abstract: Energy consumption remains a dominant operational challenge for current and future cellular systems, especially in dense urban deployments. This paper investigates a novel role for non terrestrial network (NTN) high-altitude platform station (HAPS) as an enabler of energy-efficient operation rather than only coverage extension. We define the HAPS-Hypercell as a wide-area non-terrestrial layer that can assume the coverage role of multiple terrestrial macro-cells, enabling, for the first time, the shutdown of both capacity and coverage macro-cells. We develop a comprehensive third generation partnership project (3GPP)-compliant system model, along with two HAPS-Hypercell pairing architectures that capture the interplay among multiple layers, realistic channel conditions, and distributed carrier shutdown (CS) mechanisms. Our results show that the HAPS-Hypercell can effectively reduce overall network power consumption. We then identify key limitations of a straightforward HAPS integration, laying the groundwork for future optimization and providing key insights for next-generation CS operations.
zh_title: HAPS作为超蜂窝：在蜂窝网络中实现覆盖和容量载波关断
translation: 能耗仍然是当前和未来蜂窝系统，尤其是在密集城市部署中，主要的运营挑战。本文研究了非地面网络（NTN）高空平台站（HAPS）作为一种实现能源效率运营的新颖角色，而不仅仅是覆盖扩展。我们将HAPS-Hypercell定义为一种广域非地面层，可以承担多个地面宏蜂窝的覆盖角色，首次实现了容量和覆盖宏蜂窝的关断。我们开发了一个全面的符合第三代合作伙伴计划（3GPP）标准的系统模型，以及两种HAPS-Hypercell配对架构，捕捉了多层、实际信道条件和分布式载波关断（CS）机制之间的相互作用。我们的结果表明，HAPS-Hypercell可以有效降低整体网络功耗。然后，我们识别了HAPS直接集成的关键局限性，为未来的优化奠定了基础，并为下一代CS操作提供了关键见解。
tldr: 本文研究了HAPS作为超蜂窝在蜂窝网络中实现覆盖和容量载波关断，以提高能源效率。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的HAPS应用方式，即将其作为“超蜂窝”来主动管理地面蜂窝网络的能耗，而不仅仅是作为覆盖扩展。这种方法通过实现容量和覆盖宏蜂窝的关断，直接解决了蜂窝系统能耗高的核心问题，具有重要的实际意义和潜在的节能效益。
motivation: 蜂窝系统，尤其是在密集城市部署中，能耗仍然是当前和未来主要的运营挑战。
method: 本文将HAPS-Hypercell定义为一种广域非地面层，可以承担多个地面宏蜂窝的覆盖角色，首次实现了容量和覆盖宏蜂窝的关断。开发了一个全面的符合3GPP标准的系统模型，以及两种HAPS-Hypercell配对架构，捕捉了多层、实际信道条件和分布式载波关断（CS）机制之间的相互作用。
results: HAPS-Hypercell可以有效降低整体网络功耗。同时，识别了HAPS直接集成的主要局限性。
conclusion: HAPS-Hypercell的提出为未来的优化奠定了基础，并为下一代载波关断操作提供了关键见解。

title: Prompt Coach: An Empirical Evaluation of an Agentic Tutor for Learning Prompt Engineering in Software Development
authors: Rohit Mehra, Kapil Singi, Vikrant Kaulgud, Vibhu Saujanya Sharma, Swapnajeet Gon Choudhury, Swati Sharma, Adam P. Burden, Majd Sakr
abstract: Prompt engineering has emerged as a critical yet undertaught skill for software developers, one that traditional learning approaches are ill-equipped to support given its evolving, interactive, and context-dependent nature. In this paper, we introduce Prompt Coach (PC), an agentic tutor that helps developers learn how to craft high-quality code-generation prompts through Socratic guidance embedded in-flow within their IDE. PC evaluates prompt quality across multiple dimensions and surfaces targeted questions to guide self-correction, grounded in the developer's codebase and the behavior of the target LLM. We present an early empirical study with 15 professional developers combining quantitative prompt quality scoring with qualitative perception measures. Participants showed statistically significant improvements after a single 60-minute session, with the largest gains across dimensions commonly overlooked by developers. They also reported strong trust, high adoption readiness, and unanimous agreement that PC improved their prompt-writing skills.
comment: 7 pages. To be published in the proceedings of 41st International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE '26), October 12-16, 2026, Munich, Germany (Industry Showcase Track)
zh_title: 提示教练：对一种用于软件开发中学习提示工程的代理导师的实证评估
translation: 提示工程已成为软件开发者的关键但未被充分教授的技能，鉴于其不断发展的、交互式的和依赖上下文的性质，传统的学习方法难以支持。在本文中，我们介绍了 Prompt Coach (PC)，一个代理导师，通过嵌入在 IDE 中的苏格拉底式指导，帮助开发者学习如何制作高质量的代码生成提示。PC 在多个维度上评估提示质量，并根据开发者的代码库和目标 LLM 的行为提出有针对性的问题，以指导自我纠正。我们提出了一项包含 15 名专业开发者的早期实证研究，结合了定量的提示质量评分和定性的感知测量。参与者在单次 60 分钟的会话后表现出统计学上的显著改进，其中最大的提高出现在开发者通常忽略的维度上。他们还报告了高度的信任感、高的采纳准备度，并一致认为 PC 提高了他们的提示写作技能。
tldr: Prompt Coach (PC) 是一个集成在 IDE 中的代理导师，通过苏格拉底式指导帮助软件开发者学习提示工程。在一项有 15 名专业开发者的研究中，PC 在 60 分钟的会话后显著提高了开发者的提示质量，尤其是在他们常被忽略的方面。参与者对 PC 表现出高度信任和采纳意愿。
ai_comments: 这项研究首次提出了 Prompt Coach，一个在软件开发中学习提示工程的代理导师。该研究通过实证评估证明了其有效性，并强调了其在提升开发者技能和用户满意度方面的潜力。
motivation: 提示工程对软件开发至关重要但教授不足，而传统的学习方法难以应对其不断发展、交互和依赖上下文的特性。
method: 介绍 Prompt Coach (PC)，一个代理导师，通过嵌入在 IDE 中的苏格拉底式指导来帮助开发者学习提示工程。PC 在多个维度上评估提示质量，并根据开发者的代码库和目标 LLM 的行为提出有针对性的问题，以指导自我纠正。
results: 一项包含 15 名专业开发者的早期实证研究表明，参与者在单次 60 分钟的会话后，提示质量有了统计学上的显著提高，尤其是在开发者常忽略的维度上。参与者还报告了高度的信任感、高的采纳准备度，并一致认为 PC 提高了他们的提示写作技能。
conclusion: Prompt Coach (PC) 在提高软件开发者的提示工程技能方面显示出巨大潜力，即使在短时间内的使用也能带来显著的改进，并获得了用户的积极反馈。

title: Designing Computerized Gait Analysis for Pediatric Care: Clinician Perspectives on Sensing, Workflow, and Care Environments
authors: Elizabeth Hong, Andrea Green, Ge Wang, Yiwen Dong
abstract: Computerized gait analysis (CGA) serves as an essential diagnostic tool for evaluating neuromuscular, musculoskeletal, and neurological disorders in children, from cerebral palsy to muscular dystrophy. By enabling objective and comprehensive gait analysis, CGA supports timely clinical interventions that can significantly improve pediatric mobility outcomes and quality of life. Yet pediatric gait analysis introduces unique design considerations often underexplored in existing CGA research, as children's ongoing development shapes assessment requirements. To understand how CGA technologies can be designed for pediatric care, we conducted a qualitative study with 12 pediatric clinicians and one system designer who routinely work with CGA. Participants identified child-specific challenges including managing heightened sensory sensitivities to wearable devices, accommodating body proportions in sensor placement and calibration, and maintaining patient engagement during data collection. Clinicians also articulated needs for workflow adaptations and expressed interest in extending gait analysis beyond controlled laboratory settings into naturalistic environments such as playgrounds and schools, where children's authentic movement patterns emerge. Drawing from these clinician perspectives, we present design recommendations for pediatric-centered CGA that address sensing modalities suitable for sensory-sensitive children and approaches for capturing gait data across diverse care environments. Our findings contribute to the broader challenge of adapting clinical technologies to meet the distinct needs of pediatric populations.
zh_title: 儿科护理中的计算机步态分析设计：临床医生对传感、工作流程及护理环境的视角分析
translation: 计算机步态分析（CGA）是评估儿童神经肌肉、骨骼和神经系统疾病（从脑瘫到肌营养不良）的重要诊断工具。通过实现客观、全面的步态分析，CGA支持及时的临床干预，从而显著改善儿科患者的活动能力和生活质量。然而，儿科步态分析引入了现有CGA研究中常被忽视的独特设计考量，因为儿童的持续发育过程决定了评估需求。为了了解如何为儿科护理设计CGA技术，我们对12名儿科临床医生和1名系统设计师进行了定性研究，他们均有常规使用CGA的经验。参与者指出了针对儿童的特殊挑战，包括管理对穿戴设备的感官敏感性、适应传感器放置和校准中的身体比例，以及在数据采集过程中保持患者的配合度。临床医生还提出了工作流程调整的需求，并表达了将步态分析从受控实验室环境扩展到操场和学校等自然环境的兴趣，因为儿童真实的运动模式会在这些地方显现。基于这些临床视角，我们为以儿童为中心的CGA提出了设计建议，涵盖了适合感官敏感儿童的传感方式以及在不同护理环境中采集步态数据的方法。我们的研究结果为使临床技术适应儿科人群独特需求的更广泛挑战做出了贡献。
tldr: 研究揭示了儿科步态分析中传感设备与儿童生理/感官不匹配的问题，建议设计更具适应性的系统以支持真实环境下的步态评估。
ai_comments: 该研究通过定性访谈深入挖掘了儿科临床环境下的独特痛点，对于改善医疗技术的人性化设计具有重要意义。其局限在于样本量较小（13人），且主要基于临床医生的视角，未来研究可考虑纳入患儿及家属的反馈。
motivation: 现有的CGA研究往往忽视了儿童生长发育带来的特殊设计需求，导致现有技术在儿科临床应用中存在局限性，需探索更符合儿科特点的CGA设计方案。
method: 定性研究方法，通过对12名儿科临床医生和1名系统设计师进行深度访谈，分析其在常规使用CGA过程中的经验与需求。
results: 识别了儿童感官敏感度、身体比例校准、患者配合度等挑战；明确了工作流程改进的需求；并提出了支持自然环境（如操场、学校）数据采集的设计建议。
conclusion: 研究强调了儿科计算机步态分析（CGA）需兼顾儿童生理发育特性、感官敏感性以及临床工作流程，提出应向自然环境下的数据采集拓展，以实现更精准的临床诊断。

title: Collaborative Multi-Agent Testing for Emergent Failure Discovery in Autonomous Driving Systems
authors: Ruizhen Gu, Konstantinos Koufos, Donghwan Shin, Vahid Garousi, Mehrdad Dianati
abstract: Autonomous Driving Systems (ADS) can fail because of faults within individual modules as well as from interactions across perception, planning, and control. Yet existing ADS testing research often treats key testing functions, such as perturbation generation, behavioural assessment, and test case selection and exploration, as loosely coupled steps rather than coordinated roles for discovering such failures. We present CREAD, a collaborative multi-agent testing framework for testing ADS that organises perturbation generation, behavioural validation, and search coordination through a shared blackboard and an orchestrator. In the current work-in-progress instantiation, the framework focuses on perception-oriented perturbation generation, while remaining extensible to other ADS modules, including planning and control. It currently comprises a Perception Fuzzer Agent, a Metamorphic Validator Agent, and an Orchestrator Agent. Respectively, they generate perturbations, assess behavioural consistency across related scenario pairs, and coordinate further exploration. Experiments in HighwayEnv simulator show that the collaborative configuration improves failure discovery in the highway environment and remains competitive in the roundabout setting. Across the two environments, it yields about 2.1x as many failures per 100 scenarios as the single-agent baseline on average, while gains over a non-collaborative two-agent baseline vary across environments. These results suggest that collaborative multi-agent testing is a promising research direction for emergent ADS behaviour discovery.
zh_title: 自动驾驶系统中突发故障发现的协作式多智能体测试
translation: 自动驾驶系统 (ADS) 可能因单个模块内的故障以及感知、规划和控制之间的交互而失效。然而，现有的ADS测试研究通常将关键测试功能（例如扰动生成、行为评估以及测试用例选择和探索）视为松散耦合的步骤，而非发现此类故障的协调角色。我们提出了CREAD，一个用于测试ADS的协作式多智能体测试框架，它通过共享黑板和协调器组织扰动生成、行为验证和搜索协调。在当前的工作进展实例化中，该框架侧重于面向感知的扰动生成，同时可扩展到其他ADS模块，包括规划和控制。它目前由一个感知模糊器代理、一个变形验证器代理和一个协调器代理组成。它们分别负责生成扰动、评估相关场景对的行为一致性以及协调进一步探索。在HighwayEnv模拟器中的实验表明，协作配置改善了高速公路环境中的故障发现，并在环岛设置中保持竞争力。在两种环境中，它平均每100个场景发现的故障数量是单智能体基线的约2.1倍，而与非协作双智能体基线相比，收益因环境而异。这些结果表明，协作式多智能体测试是发现自动驾驶系统突发行为的一个有前途的研究方向。
tldr: 提出CREAD，一个协作式多智能体测试框架，通过感知模糊器、变形验证器和协调器代理，协同生成扰动、评估行为一致性并协调探索，显著提高了自动驾驶系统突发故障的发现率。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入协作式多智能体框架CREAD，创新性地解决了自动驾驶系统测试中各功能模块之间协同不足的问题。其核心在于将扰动生成、行为验证和探索协调整合为一个统一的协作过程，有效提升了突发故障的发现能力。特别是在感知层面，通过智能体的协同工作，能够更有效地探测到复杂交互导致的潜在失效。该方法的通用性和可扩展性也值得关注，未来有望应用于规划和控制等其他ADS模块的测试。
motivation: 自动驾驶系统 (ADS) 可能因模块内部故障或感知、规划和控制之间的交互而失效。现有的ADS测试研究通常将扰动生成、行为评估和测试用例选择与探索等关键测试功能视为松散耦合的步骤，而非发现此类故障的协调角色。
method: 提出了CREAD，一个协作式多智能体测试框架，通过共享黑板和协调器组织扰动生成、行为验证和搜索协调。当前实例化主要关注面向感知的扰动生成，但可扩展到其他ADS模块。它包含感知模糊器代理、变形验证器代理和协调器代理，分别负责生成扰动、评估相关场景对的行为一致性以及协调进一步探索。
results: 在HighwayEnv模拟器中的实验表明，协作配置改善了高速公路环境中的故障发现，并在环岛设置中保持竞争力。在两种环境中，它平均每100个场景发现的故障数量是单智能体基线的约2.1倍。与非协作双智能体基线相比，收益因环境而异。
conclusion: 这些结果表明，协作式多智能体测试是发现自动驾驶系统突发行为的一个有前途的研究方向。

title: Scalable Perturbation Learning for Online Self-Supervised Echo State Networks
authors: Taiki Yamada, Kantaro Fujiwara
abstract:
Intelligent systems should not only solve tasks but also adapt under real-world constraints. Autonomous adaptation via self-supervised learning, sequential adaptation via online learning, and memory-efficient implementation via perturbation-based learning are important requirements for such systems. However, these requirements are generally in tension for high-dimensional systems, because perturbation-based learning suffers from variance that grows with the dimension of the perturbed variables.
  In this study, we focus on echo state networks (ESNs), where this tension naturally arises in large reservoirs. We propose a perturbation-based learning rule for online self-supervised learning in ESNs. The proposed rule is derived from an orthogonal decomposition of the self-supervised learning cost, which separates an input-dependent component from a redundant component determined by the fixed ESN parameters. By perturbing only the input-dependent component, the effective perturbation dimension is reduced from the reservoir dimension to the input dimension.
  Thus, the proposed method preserves self-supervised adaptation, online learning, and scalar-feedback perturbation learning, while avoiding reservoir-size-dependent variance growth. This suggests a design principle for scalable and hardware-compatible learning: online learning should be restricted to the dynamically necessary low-dimensional component of the objective.
zh_title: 面向在线自监督回声状态网络的可扩展扰动学习
translation: 智能系统不仅应能解决任务，还需在现实约束下进行适应。通过自监督学习实现自主适应、通过在线学习实现序列适应，以及通过基于扰动的学习实现内存高效的实现，是此类系统的重要需求。然而，这些需求在高维系统中通常存在冲突，因为基于扰动的学习所带来的方差会随着扰动变量维度的增加而增长。在本研究中，我们聚焦于回声状态网络（ESN），其中这种张力在大型储层中自然产生。我们提出了一种用于ESN在线自监督学习的基于扰动的学习规则。所提规则源于自监督学习代价函数的正交分解，该分解将与输入相关的分量与由固定ESN参数决定的冗余分量分离开来。通过仅对输入相关分量进行扰动，有效扰动维度从储层维度降低到了输入维度。因此，该方法在保留自监督适应性、在线学习能力和标量反馈扰动学习的同时，避免了方差随储层规模增长的问题。这为可扩展且兼容硬件的学习提供了一种设计原则：在线学习应限制在目标函数中动态必要的低维分量上。
tldr: 通过将学习扰动降维至输入空间，本文提出了一种适用于大规模回声状态网络的稳定在线自监督学习方法。
ai_comments: 该研究巧妙地解决了高维储层计算中扰动学习的方差爆炸问题。通过引入正交分解，将学习目标降维至输入空间，为大规模硬件部署提供了极具价值的理论指导。这种将在线学习限制在动态必要维度的设计思想，在神经形态工程领域具有重要的启发意义。
motivation: 现有智能系统在实现自监督、在线学习及内存高效的扰动学习时，在高维系统中面临冲突，即扰动学习的方差会随变量维度增加而急剧增长。
method: 提出了一种基于自监督学习代价函数正交分解的扰动学习规则。通过将代价函数拆分为输入相关分量和由固定参数决定的冗余分量，仅对输入相关分量进行扰动，从而将有效扰动维度从储层维度降低至输入维度。
results: 提出的方法成功在回声状态网络（ESN）中实现了自监督在线学习，同时避免了方差随储层规模增大而增长的问题，实现了可扩展且兼容硬件的在线学习。
conclusion: 通过将扰动限制在输入相关分量，该方法实现了在大规模ESN中高效、稳定的在线自监督学习，证明了学习任务的动态降维是实现可扩展硬件实现的关键。

title: Efficient Pareto-Front Generation for Electric Machines using IGA and Second Order Derivatives
authors: Theodor Komann, Michael Wiesheu, Stefan Ulbrich, Sebastian Schöps, Peter Gangl
abstract: The multiobjective optimization of electric machines always involves a trade-off caused by various competing objectives such as performance and cost. A suitable design is usually determined by comparing variants from the Pareto front, which has been generated by a large number of simulation runs. This paper addresses the efficient generation of the Pareto front using a continuation method based on a homotopy method that exploits second-order derivative information to achieve superlinear convergence, enabling the fast generation of new Pareto-optimal points within only a few iterations. A key contribution is the derivation of formulas to compute the Hessian with respect to geometry parameters and shape, thus enabling direct modifications of the motor geometry in the context of Isogeometric Analysis. We apply our method to nonlinear 2D magnetostatic simulations of a permanent magnet synchronous motor and demonstrate its effectiveness by optimizing the cost, mean torque and torque ripple of the motor. Compared to a first-order optimization method, this approach reduces the number of iterations and function evaluations needed, making the pareto optimization fast and efficient.
zh_title: 电动机械的高效帕累托前沿生成
translation: 电动机械的多目标优化总是涉及由性能和成本等各种相互竞争的目标引起的权衡。通过比较帕累托前沿的变体，通常可以确定一个合适的设计，而帕累托前沿是通过大量的模拟运行生成的。本文提出了一种利用基于同伦法的连续性方法的高效帕累托前沿生成方法，该方法利用二阶导数信息来实现超线性收敛，从而能够在仅几次迭代中快速生成新的帕累托最优点。一个关键的贡献是推导出了计算几何参数和形状的Hessian的公式，从而能够在等几何分析（IGA）的背景下直接修改电机几何。我们将我们的方法应用于永磁同步电机的非线性二维磁静力学模拟，并通过优化电机的成本、平均扭矩和扭矩波动，证明了其有效性。与一阶优化方法相比，该方法减少了所需的迭代次数和函数评估次数，使得帕累托优化快速而高效。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于等几何分析（IGA）和二阶导数信息（Hessian）的连续性方法，用于高效生成电动机械设计中的帕累托前沿。该方法通过利用几何参数和形状的Hessian信息，实现了超线性收敛，能在少量迭代中快速生成新的帕累托最优点，并直接修改电机几何。在永磁同步电机设计优化中，该方法在成本、平均扭矩和扭矩波动等目标上，相比一阶优化方法，显著减少了迭代次数和函数评估次数，实现了快速高效的帕累托优化。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖且高效的帕累托前沿生成方法，通过结合等几何分析和二阶导数信息，显著提高了电动机械多目标优化的效率。该方法在理论推导和实际应用（永磁同步电机优化）上都展现了其优越性，尤其是在减少迭代次数和函数评估方面，为电动机械设计领域的优化问题提供了一个有价值的解决方案。未来可以进一步探索该方法在更复杂电机模型或更多优化目标下的适用性。
motivation: 电动机械的多目标优化需要在性能和成本等相互竞争的目标之间进行权衡，而帕累托前沿是确定合适设计的关键，但传统方法需要大量模拟运行来生成帕累托前沿。
method: 提出了一种基于同伦法的连续性方法，该方法利用二阶导数信息（Hessian）来实现超线性收敛，从而能够快速生成新的帕累托最优点。该方法导出了计算几何参数和形状的Hessian的公式，从而能够在等几何分析（IGA）的背景下直接修改电机几何。
results: 将该方法应用于永磁同步电机的非线性二维磁静力学模拟，并通过优化电机的成本、平均扭矩和扭矩波动，证明了其有效性。与一阶优化方法相比，该方法减少了所需的迭代次数和函数评估次数。
conclusion: 该研究提出了一种利用二阶导数信息的高效帕累托前沿生成方法，该方法能够快速生成电动机械设计中的帕累托最优解，并能直接修改电机几何，相比传统方法具有显著的效率提升。

title: From Blueprint to Reality: Modeling and Applying Putnam's Social Capital Theory with LLM-based Multi-agent Simulations
authors: Shiyi Ling, Zhi Zheng, Hui Zheng, Wenjun Xue, Feng Ye, Tong Xu
abstract: Putnam's Social Capital Theory is a foundational framework for collective action and community prosperity. However, traditional empirical methods face practical limits on control and replication. Meanwhile, LLM-based social simulations are typically behavior-driven and lack theory-aligned environments for modeling Putnam's core propositions. To address these gaps, we introduce SocaSim, an LLM-based multi-agent simulation framework to study Putnam's Social Capital Theory from theoretical blueprint to simulated reality. Specifically, we build an environment integrating social network evolution, trust dynamics, and norm propagation, where agents engage in repeated collective-action experiments, and then apply the three dimensions to analyze adaptation challenges in smart elderly care. Our simulations reproduce Putnam's macro-level patterns and exhibit strong human-agent alignment at the group level. Unlike traditional methods, SocaSim traces micro-level causal pathways of social network, trust, and norms via round-by-round simulations and counterfactual interventions, enabling process-level interpretability. Taken together, these capabilities establish a research paradigm that leverages LLM agents to bridge social science and computer science.
zh_title: 从蓝图到现实：利用基于LLM的多智能体仿真对普特南社会资本理论进行建模与应用
translation: 普特南的社会资本理论是集体行动和社区繁荣的基础框架。然而，传统的实证方法在控制和复现方面面临现实限制。与此同时，基于大语言模型（LLM）的社会模拟通常是行为驱动的，缺乏用于建模普特南核心命题的理论对齐环境。为了弥补这些差距，我们引入了SocaSim，这是一个基于LLM的多智能体仿真框架，用于从理论蓝图到模拟现实研究普特南的社会资本理论。具体而言，我们构建了一个整合社交网络演化、信任动态和规范传播的环境，智能体在其中参与重复的集体行动实验，然后应用这三个维度来分析智慧养老中的适应性挑战。我们的模拟重现了普特南的宏观模式，并在群体层面表现出强大的人机对齐。与传统方法不同，SocaSim通过逐轮模拟和反事实干预追踪社交网络、信任和规范的微观因果路径，实现了过程级的可解释性。总之，这些能力建立了一个利用LLM智能体架起社会科学与计算机科学桥梁的研究范式。
tldr: 通过SocaSim框架，利用大语言模型多智能体仿真复现了普特南的社会资本理论，实现了社会学理论的过程级建模与因果分析。
ai_comments: 该研究通过大语言模型（LLM）多智能体仿真成功架起了社会科学理论与计算模拟之间的桥梁。其创新点在于不仅实现了理论的可计算化，还通过反事实干预提供了过程层面的可解释性，克服了传统经验方法在控制和复现上的局限。该方法为社会科学的量化研究提供了一个强有力的新范式。
motivation: 传统经验方法在研究普特南社会资本理论时存在控制和复现的局限，而现有的LLM社会模拟多侧重于行为驱动，缺乏理论对齐的环境来建模社会资本的核心命题。
method: 构建名为SocaSim的LLM多智能体仿真框架，集成了社交网络演化、信任动态和规范传播机制；通过反复的集体行动实验，并结合反事实干预进行过程分析。
results: 仿真结果成功复现了普特南的宏观模式，在群体层面表现出高度的人机对齐，并揭示了社交网络、信任和规范的微观因果路径。
conclusion: SocaSim证明了LLM驱动的多智能体仿真能够有效复现社会科学理论中的宏观模式，并能深入洞察微观机制，为跨学科研究提供了重要的方法论工具。

title: MSA-DCNN: A Data-Efficient Multi-Scale Deformable CNN for Medical Image Classification
authors: Hamza Hussaini, Shahana Bano, Eyad Elyan, Carlos Francisco Moreno-García
abstract: Existing deep learning methods perform well in medical image classification but struggle with multi-scale morphology and limited annotations due to fixed sampling and data-hungry training. Existing approaches address these challenges in isolation: DCN-based models provide adaptive sampling but lack explicit multi-scale attention fusion and label-efficient regularisation; multi-scale architectures typically rely on static fusion; and semi-supervised methods target label scarcity without jointly modelling adaptive cross-scale representations. We propose MSA-DCNN, a scale-consistent deformable attention learning framework that introduces adaptive multi-scale sampling, within-scale saliency refinement, learned cross-scale fusion, and auxiliary self-distillation within a unified optimisation scheme, with potential to generalise to structurally heterogeneous anatomy. We evaluate on three public benchmarks and an external hold-out set for leukaemia. MSA-DCNN demonstrates competitive and often better performance against ViT baselines, CNN baselines, and a MICCAI semi-supervised baseline under distribution shift and label scarcity in accuracy, F1, and AUC (binary), while using fewer parameters. Ablations confirm complementary component contributions, supporting MSA-DCNN as a practical foundation for data-efficient medical image classification.
zh_title: MSA-DCNN：一种数据高效的多尺度可变形卷积神经网络用于医学图像分类
translation: 现有的深度学习方法在医学图像分类中表现良好，但由于固定的采样和数据饥渴的训练，在多尺度形态和有限标注方面存在困难。现有方法各自为政地解决了这些挑战：基于DCN的模型提供自适应采样，但缺乏明确的多尺度注意融合和标签高效正则化；多尺度架构通常依赖于静态融合；半监督方法针对标签稀缺问题，但没有联合建模自适应的跨尺度表示。我们提出了MSA-DCNN，一个尺度一致的可变形注意学习框架，它在一个统一的优化方案中引入了自适应多尺度采样、尺度内显著性细化、学习到的跨尺度融合以及辅助自蒸馏，有潜力推广到结构异质性解剖。我们在三个公开基准和一个外部留出集上对白血病进行了评估。在准确率、F1和AUC（二元）方面，MSA-DCNN在分布偏移和标签稀缺的情况下，与ViT基线、CNN基线和MICCAI半监督基线相比，表现出有竞争力甚至更好的性能，同时使用的参数更少。消融研究证实了各组成部分的互补贡献，支持MSA-DCNN作为数据高效医学图像分类的实用基础。
keywords: 多尺度可变形卷积神经网络
tldr: MSA-DCNN通过结合多尺度特征、可变形卷积和自监督学习，解决了医学图像分类中数据稀疏和多尺度形态的问题，在多个基准测试中表现优于现有方法。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的MSA-DCNN框架，有效地解决了医学图像分类中的关键挑战，如数据效率低下和多尺度形态问题。通过整合自适应采样、跨尺度融合和自蒸馏等技术，该模型在多个基准上取得了优越的性能，并展现了良好的泛化能力。然而，未来可以进一步探索其在更广泛的医学图像任务和不同模态上的应用潜力。
motivation: 现有的深度学习方法在医学图像分类中存在多尺度形态和有限标注的挑战，现有方法各自为政，未能有效解决这些问题。
method: 提出了一种名为MSA-DCNN的框架，该框架引入了自适应多尺度采样、尺度内显著性细化、学习到的跨尺度融合以及辅助自蒸馏，并将其统一在单一优化方案中。
results: MSA-DCNN在三个公开基准和一个外部留出数据集上进行了评估，与ViT基线、CNN基线和MICCAI半监督基线相比，在准确率、F1和AUC方面表现出竞争力甚至更优的性能，同时参数量更少。
conclusion: MSA-DCNN是一个实用的、数据高效的医学图像分类基础模型。

title: A Decomposition-Based Framework for Joint Optimization and Spatial Packaging of Interconnected Systems with Physical Interactions
authors: Julien Bückmann, Jorn van Kampen, Theo Hofman
abstract: This paper presents an approach and application of optimization of spatial packaging of interconnected systems with physical interactions (SPI2) in three-dimensional component placement problems. To enable its application for an automotive use case, SPI2 must support both initial design generation, including component alignment, and robust system-level coordination, requiring improved solution reliability and tractable computational cost. To address these requirements, the proposed methodology improves convergence rate and solution quality by enhancing numerical robustness in gradient-based optimization while reducing computational load. Existing SPI2 approaches are extended through the addition of alignment capabilities, enabling the representation of port-to-port alignments between components. Furthermore, the applicability of SPI2 is expanded by treating component placement locations as design variables, allowing for penalty-based coordination to ensure design feasibility and enabling integration within system-level optimization. The approach is validated using a multi-objective optimization framework based on Nondominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II), applied to a combined powertrain optimization and battery chassis integration problem. This demonstrates the effectiveness of the SPI2 in a system-level design context. The results show a twofold application of SPI2 in an automotive use case: first, as a tool for initial design generation, and second, as part of a system-level design coordinator that outperforms a discretized exhaustive search while requiring lower computational cost.
zh_title: 一种基于分解的具有物理交互的互联系统联合优化与空间布局框架
translation: 本文提出了一种用于三维组件布局问题中具有物理交互的互联系统空间布局（SPI2）的优化方法及应用。为了满足汽车用例的需求，SPI2必须支持包括组件对齐在内的初始设计生成，以及稳健的系统级协调，这要求提高求解可靠性并保持可控的计算成本。为了满足这些要求，所提方法通过增强基于梯度优化中的数值鲁棒性并降低计算负载，提高了收敛速度和求解质量。现有的SPI2方法通过增加对齐功能得到了扩展，实现了组件间端口到端口对齐的表示。此外，通过将组件放置位置视为设计变量，扩展了SPI2的适用性，从而允许基于惩罚的协调以确保设计可行性，并实现系统级优化的集成。该方法使用基于非支配排序遗传算法II（NSGA-II）的多目标优化框架进行了验证，并应用于动力总成优化和电池底盘集成问题。这证明了SPI2在系统级设计背景下的有效性。结果表明，SPI2在汽车用例中具有双重应用：首先作为初始设计生成的工具，其次作为系统级设计协调器的一部分，其性能优于离散化穷举搜索，且计算成本更低。
tldr: 提出了一种改进的SPI2空间布局框架，通过优化算法和对齐策略，高效解决了汽车动力系统等复杂工程中的组件布局与系统协同问题。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入基于梯度的优化增强和对齐能力，显著提升了复杂物理交互系统空间布局的效率。其创新之处在于将组件位置作为设计变量，并与多目标优化算法（NSGA-II）结合，在处理汽车动力总成和电池集成等实际工程问题时展现了优于穷举搜索的性能，具有很高的工程应用价值。
motivation: 为了解决现有SPI2方法在处理复杂物理交互系统空间布局时，难以满足初始设计生成、组件对齐以及系统级优化中高可靠性和低计算成本的需求。
method: 提出了一种基于分解的SPI2框架，引入了组件对齐功能，将组件位置作为设计变量，增强了梯度优化中的数值鲁棒性，并结合NSGA-II多目标优化算法进行验证。
results: 在汽车动力总成和电池底盘集成问题中，该方法不仅成功生成了初始设计，且作为系统级协调器时，在求解质量和计算成本上均优于离散化穷举搜索。
conclusion: 研究证明了SPI2框架在汽车系统级设计中作为初始设计生成工具和协调器的有效性，在提高求解质量的同时降低了计算开销。

title: Generalisation of Baker's Forcing Method to Arbitrary Prime and NP-hardness of Several $p$-adic Optimisations
authors: Tomoki Mihara
abstract: G.\ D.\ Baker formulated a forcing method to interpret integer optimisation problem into $2$-adic linear regression, and proved the NP-hardness of $2$-adic linear regression. We generalise the forcing method to a wider class of $p$-adic optimisation for the case where $p$ is not necessarily $2$, and prove the NP-hardness of $p$-adic linear regression, the NP-hardness of $2$-adic dynamic neural network by S.\ Albeverio, A.\ Khrennikov, and B.\ Tirrozi, and the NP-hardness of a partial generalisation of the $p$-adic optimisation problem associated to van der Put neural network by G.\ L.\ R.\ N'guessan.

title: Flow Matching-Based Speech Source Separation with Best-of-N Biometric Sampling
authors: Anastasia Zorkina, Alexandr Anikin, Nikita Khmelev, Anastasiya Korenevskaya, Sergey Novoselov, Vladimir Volokhov, Maxim Korenevsky, Yuriy Matveev
abstract: Single-channel speech separation remains challenging for real-world deployment due to source permutation ambiguity, sampling variability of generative models, and the difficulty of processing long recordings with chunk-wise inference. We address these issues with a conditional flow-matching-based method that produces an ordered two-source output conditioned on the mixture. A frozen speaker encoder defines the source order during training and is reused at inference for biometric best-of-$N$ candidate selection and chunk-level channel alignment. We evaluate separation quality on Libri2Mix benchmark using SI-SDR, PESQ, and ESTOI, and measure downstream impact using cpWER for automatic speech recognition and EER for speaker verification. The results show that the proposed Transformer U-Net variant is competitive with strong baselines in objective separation metrics and achieves the lowest downstream automatic speech recognition and speaker verification error rates in all evaluated settings.
comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Machine Learning for Audio
zh_title: 基于流匹配和最佳N生物特征采样的语音源分离
translation: 单通道语音分离在实际部署中仍然具有挑战性，因为存在源排列模糊、生成模型的采样变异性以及处理长录音的分块推理困难。我们通过一种基于条件流匹配的方法解决了这些问题，该方法生成一个以混合信号为条件的有序双源输出。一个冻结的说话人编码器在训练期间定义源顺序，并在推理时用于生物特征的N个最佳候选选择和分块级通道对齐。我们在Libri2Mix基准上使用SI-SDR、PESQ和ESTOI评估分离质量，并使用cpWER测量自动语音识别的下游影响，以及使用EER测量说话人验证的影响。结果表明，所提出的Transformer U-Net变体在客观分离指标上与强大的基线方法具有竞争力，并在所有评估的设置中实现了最低的下游自动语音识别和说话人验证错误率。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于流匹配的单通道语音分离方法，解决了源排列模糊、采样变异性和长音频处理难题，并通过生物特征采样实现了最佳的下游任务性能。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的流匹配方法来解决单通道语音分离中的核心挑战，特别是源排列模糊和采样变异性。通过结合生物特征采样和冻结的说话人编码器，该方法在下游任务中取得了最先进的性能，这表明其在实际应用中的巨大潜力。然而，对于更复杂的场景（例如，多于两个声源或高度重叠的语音），其性能仍有待进一步验证。
motivation: 单通道语音分离在实际应用中面临源排列模糊、生成模型采样变异性以及长音频分块推理的挑战。
method: 提出了一种条件流匹配方法，生成有序的双源输出，并使用冻结的说话人编码器在训练和推理阶段确定源顺序、进行最佳N生物特征候选选择和分块通道对齐。模型变体为Transformer U-Net。
results: 在Libri2Mix基准测试中，该方法在客观分离指标上与现有方法相当，并在所有评估的设置下实现了最低的下游自动语音识别（cpWER）和说话人验证（EER）错误率。
conclusion: 所提出的基于流匹配和生物特征采样的语音源分离方法在客观指标和下游任务性能上均优于现有方法，有效解决了单通道语音分离的挑战。

title: Hybrid electrolyzer systems: Smart strategy or economic fallacy?
authors: Marie Arnold, Jonathan Brandt, Geert Tjarks, Richard Hanke-Rauschenbach
abstract: Hybrid electrolyzer systems combining alkaline water electrolysis and proton exchange membrane water electrolysis have been investigated in the literature motivated by the expectation that their contrary techno-economic characteristics compensate for the individual technical and economic restrictions of each technology, thereby improving the profitability of green hydrogen production. To reassess the economic potential of hybrid electrolyzer systems beyond these technology-specific assumptions, we independently vary two key characteristics, electrolyzer efficiency and investment cost, in a large-scale sensitivity analysis. For each generated parameter configuration, we performed a techno-economic optimization of a green hydrogen supply chain, including two electrolyzers. The resulting system design, cost objective, and dispatch behavior are subsequently analyzed. Consequently, hybrid electrolyzer systems are identified as optimal if they provide a cost benefit over single electrolyzer systems. The analysis reveals that hybrid electrolyzer systems represent the optimal solution in at most 5.0% of the investigated cases. Furthermore, the maximum cost benefit is 0.057 EUR/kgH2, which corresponds to only about 1% of the total green hydrogen production cost. Additional analyses considering variations in energy purchase prices, storage fees, availability of renewable energy, and baseline electrolyzer efficiency yield negligible changes to these results. Hence, considering that hybrid electrolyzer systems offer marginal cost benefits and prove economically optimal in very few cases, they seem more likely to represent an economic fallacy than a smart strategy.

title: Agents That Teach: Towards Designing Incidental Learning Back into AI-Assisted Software Development
authors: Rohit Mehra, Samdyuti Suri, Prithviraj K Tagadinamani, Kapil Singi, Vikrant Kaulgud, Adam P. Burden
abstract: AI coding agents are rapidly reshaping how software is built, with developers increasingly delegating substantial coding tasks to autonomous agents in pursuit of higher productivity. While these gains are real, they come at the cost of incidental learning. Developers historically acquired informal knowledge through effortful problem-solving, and this has long shaped how software engineering expertise develops. However, with over-reliance on agentic coding, unpracticed skills could atrophy silently over time. As this learning pathway is short-circuited, developers risk silently accruing Knowledge Debt, a developer-level analogue of Technical Debt, where changes the agent executes that the developer cannot fully understand accrue over time. In this paper, we argue that incidental learning will not re-emerge on its own and must be consciously designed back into developer-agent interactions, and propose six design principles to guide such systems. We then present "SHIELD", a multi-agent system grounded in the notion of "agents that teach", that operationalizes these principles by leveraging the AI coding agent's own reasoning to surface contextual, out-of-band learning moments without disrupting developer flow. Through this work, we envision a path toward learning-aware development environments where productivity and learning are complementary, not competing.
comment: 5 pages. To be published in the proceedings of 41st International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE '26), October 12-16, 2026, Munich, Germany (New Ideas and Emerging Results Track)

title: Modeling Normal Is All You Need: Joint Latent Clustering for Anomaly Detection in Multimodal Cyber-Physical Systems
authors: Alexander Apartsin, Yehudit Aperstein
abstract: Faults on a cyber-physical system (CPS) are too rare and unrepresentative to characterise, or even to select a model on, so detection must instead model normal behaviour; the standard point-adjusted evaluation, however, rewards detectors that never do. CPS normal behaviour is the union of many imbalanced, curved, thin-fringed operating regimes rather than a single blob; we state this structure as ten assumptions (A1-A10), abbreviated Massive, Implicit, Imbalanced Multimodality (MIIM). We model the normal law with a jointly learned latent representation plus explicit Gaussian-mixture mode clustering, scored in the latent rather than by a global density or a reconstruction residual, and evaluate under a deliberately fair protocol: raw point-wise metrics with no point adjustment, a trivial-detector difficulty split, prevalence-matched F1, and train-normal-only calibration. On three real CPS datasets (WADI, HAI, SKAB), the detector wins both the combined column and the difficult correlation/dynamics-fault column on all three, reaching difficult-subset AUROC 0.831 on HAI, 0.726 on WADI, and 0.610 on SKAB. The margin is largest on the two multimodal datasets the MIIM assumptions target and slimmest on the near-unimodal one, tracking multimodality as the thesis predicts, and it holds against three deep detectors (USAD, TranAD, GDN) re-computed with the same raw metrics, all of which collapse on the difficult subset. The methodological contributions are the MIIM assumption set, the difficulty-stratified fair protocol, and a latent-only score that drops reconstruction because a flexible decoder rebuilds the hard faults faithfully.
zh_title: 建模“正常”即所需：针对多模态网络物理系统异常检测的联合潜在聚类方法
translation: 网络物理系统（CPS）上的故障太过罕见且不具代表性，难以进行表征，甚至难以进行模型选择，因此检测必须转而对正常行为进行建模；然而，标准的点调整评估方法奖励了那些从未真正进行检测的模型。CPS的正常行为是许多不平衡、弯曲、边缘稀疏的操作状态的集合，而非单一的整体；我们将这种结构表述为十个假设（A1-A10），简称为大规模、隐含、不平衡多模态（MIIM）。我们通过联合学习的潜在表示加上显式高斯混合模式聚类来模拟正常规律，并在潜在空间中进行评分，而不是通过全局密度或重构残差来评分。此外，我们采用了一套刻意公平的协议进行评估：原始逐点指标（无点调整）、平凡检测器难度分割、流行度匹配的F1分数以及仅训练正常数据的校准。在三个真实的CPS数据集（WADI、HAI、SKAB）上，该检测器在所有三个数据集的综合指标和困难相关性/动态故障列中均获胜，在HAI、WADI和SKAB上的困难子集AUROC分别达到0.831、0.726和0.610。该方法在MIIM假设所针对的两个多模态数据集上的优势最大，而在近单模态数据集上的优势最窄，这正如论文预测的那样追踪了多模态特性。该方法在与使用相同原始指标重新计算的三种深度检测器（USAD、TranAD、GDN）对比中表现稳健，而后者在困难子集上均表现不佳。本文的方法论贡献在于MIIM假设集、难度分层公平评估协议，以及一种仅基于潜在空间的评分方法，该方法放弃了重构，因为灵活的解码器会忠实地重建困难故障。
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对CPS多模态特性的联合潜在聚类异常检测方法，并在严苛的公平评估协议下验证了其优于现有重构型检测器的性能。
ai_comments: 该论文对异常检测评估范式提出了重要的批判性见解，特别是指出“点调整”指标的局限性，并强调了CPS中正常行为的多模态复杂性。通过提出MIIM假设和难度分层评估协议，该研究为异常检测研究设定了更严谨的基准。其创新点在于放弃了常规的重构误差，转而在潜在空间中进行联合聚类评分，这在处理复杂多模态数据时表现出极强的鲁棒性。
motivation: 由于CPS中的故障样本稀少且难以表征，传统异常检测方法往往难以建模正常的复杂操作模式（即多模态特性），且现有的评价指标（如点调整）存在误导性，导致检测器性能被高估。
method: 提出MIIM（大规模、隐含、不平衡多模态）假设；采用联合学习的潜在表示与显式高斯混合模型聚类相结合的方法；在潜在空间进行异常评分，而非依赖重构残差或全局密度；并实施了基于难度分层、无点调整的公平评估协议。
results: 在WADI、HAI和SKAB三个真实CPS数据集上，该方法在整体及高难度故障检测指标上均优于USAD、TranAD和GDN等主流深度模型，特别是在多模态数据集上优势明显。
conclusion: 研究证明了针对MIIM特性建模的联合潜在聚类方法在多模态CPS异常检测中优于现有的重构型深度模型，尤其是在处理高难度相关性和动态故障时效果显著。

title: Repeated Contention Scheduling: A Novel Resource Allocation Algorithm Toward 6G Vehicular Networks
authors: Alexey Rolich, Marco Tricco, Simone Paroli, Mert Yildiz, Andrea Baiocchi
abstract: Efficient decentralized resource allocation remains a fundamental challenge in NR-V2X sidelink communications, where conventional Semi-Persistent Scheduling (SPS) and Dynamic Scheduling (DS) suffer from persistent collisions and limited adaptability under dynamic and dense conditions. This paper proposes Repeated Contention Scheduling (RCS), a novel resource allocation algorithm based on multi-round, feedback-driven contention that eliminates long-term reservations and enables fully distributed operation. Simulations demonstrate that RCS outperforms SPS and DS in terms of success probability, collision and loss reduction, and timeliness metrics such as Packet Inter-Reception Delay and Age of Information, particularly under high load. The practical feasibility of the approach is validated through an SDR-based experimental testbed, which confirms robust operation under realistic hardware impairments and closely matches theoretical and simulation results. These findings establish RCS as a viable and scalable solution for resource allocation in 5G NR sidelink and a promising candidate for future 6G vehicular communication systems.

zh_title: 重复竞争调度：一种面向6G车联网的新型资源分配算法
translation: 高效的去中心化资源分配仍然是NR-V2X侧链路通信中的根本挑战，其中传统的半持久调度（SPS）和动态调度（DS）在动态和密集条件下遭受持续的冲突且适应性有限。本文提出了重复竞争调度（RCS），这是一种基于多轮、反馈驱动竞争的新型资源分配算法，它消除了长期预留并实现了完全分布式操作。仿真表明，RCS在成功概率、冲突和损耗减少以及诸如分组接收间隔延迟和信息时效性等及时性指标方面优于SPS和DS，特别是在高负载下。通过基于SDR的实验测试平台验证了该方法的实际可行性，证实了其在现实硬件损伤下的鲁棒操作，并与理论和仿真结果高度吻合。这些发现确立了RCS作为5G NR侧链路资源分配的一种可行且可扩展的解决方案，也是未来6G车联网通信系统的一个有前途的候选方案。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为RCS的分布式资源分配算法，通过多轮竞争机制有效解决了车联网通信中的资源冲突问题，在性能和实际部署上均优于现有的SPS和DS方案。
ai_comments: 该论文提出的RCS算法通过反馈驱动的多轮竞争机制，解决了传统SPS和DS在密集动态场景下的资源碰撞问题，具备分布式特性，且通过SDR实验验证了其工程可行性，是迈向6G车联网的重要技术探索。
motivation: 现有NR-V2X侧链路通信中的半持久调度（SPS）和动态调度（DS）在动态且密集的网络环境中存在持续冲突，且适应性较差，难以满足高效去中心化资源分配的需求。
method: 提出了一种基于多轮反馈驱动竞争的资源分配算法（Repeated Contention Scheduling, RCS），该算法摒弃了长期预留机制，实现了完全分布式操作。
results: 仿真结果表明，RCS在成功概率、冲突与丢包减少以及分组接收间隔延迟（PIR）和信息时效性（AoI）指标上均优于SPS和DS；基于SDR的实验平台验证了其在实际硬件损伤下的鲁棒性。
conclusion: RCS算法在提高资源分配成功率、减少冲突与丢包以及优化数据时效性方面表现优异，是5G NR侧链路及未来6G车联网资源分配的一种可行且可扩展的解决方案。

title: PVCap: Towards Accurate 3D Dense Captioning via PseudoCap and VoxelCapNet
authors: Xiaopei Wu, Chenshu Hou, Liang Peng, Dan Xu, Binbin Lin, Xiaoshui Huang, Yuenan Hou, Yu Li, Wenxiao Wang, Haifeng Liu, Deng Cai, Wanli Ouyang
abstract: 3D dense captioning, an emerging vision-language task, aims to generate descriptive sentences for each object in the 3D scene. Despite the impressive results achieved by previous methods, they suffer from two limitations. First, current research often employs global rigid transformations, such as rotation, to augment scenes without changing their spatial layouts. However, diverse spatial layouts are crucial for training a 3D dense captioning model to describe spatial relations between objects. Second, previous works mainly focus on the design of the caption generation pipeline while utilizing a simple network architecture for other components, i.e., backbone and detection head, which is crucial for extracting rich semantic information for captioning. In this paper, we propose PVCap to alleviate the aforementioned problems. Our PVCap consists of PseudoCap and VoxelCapNet. Specifically, PseudoCap employs a random mixing technique on instances within the dataset, generating numerous pseudo frames with diverse spatial layouts at the instance level. By utilizing a teacher-student framework, PseudoCap obtains pseudo caption labels for these pseudo frames. This data augmentation approach significantly increases the number of training samples and enhances the model's ability to describe the environment effectively. Regarding VoxelCapNet, we introduce a robust caption network that utilizes voxel features and adapts the caption head to the voxel-based network architecture. Our VoxelCapNet can serve as a competitive baseline for future research on 3D dense captioning. Extensive experiments are conducted on two prevalent benchmarks, i.e., ScanRefer and Nr3D. Notably, our method surpasses current state-of-the-art by 11.41% and 13.99% in CIDEr@0.5IoU, respectively. Codes will be made publicly available.
zh_title: PVCap：通过PseudoCap和VoxelCapNet实现精确的3D密集描述
translation: 3D密集描述是一项新兴的视觉语言任务，旨在为3D场景中的每个对象生成描述性句子。尽管现有方法取得了令人瞩目的成果，但它们仍存在两个局限性。首先，当前研究通常采用全局刚性变换（如旋转）来增强场景，而不改变其空间布局。然而，多样的空间布局对于训练3D密集描述模型以描述对象间的空间关系至关重要。其次，以往的研究主要关注描述生成流水线的流程设计，而对其他组件（即骨干网络和检测头）采用简单的网络架构，这对提取用于描述的丰富语义信息至关重要。在本文中，我们提出了PVCap来缓解上述问题。我们的PVCap由PseudoCap和VoxelCapNet组成。具体而言，PseudoCap在数据集内的实例上采用随机混合技术，生成了大量具有多样化空间布局的实例级伪帧。通过利用师生框架，PseudoCap为这些伪帧获取了伪描述标签。这种数据增强方法显著增加了训练样本的数量，并增强了模型有效描述环境的能力。关于VoxelCapNet，我们引入了一个鲁棒的描述网络，它利用体素特征并将描述头适配到基于体素的网络架构中。我们的VoxelCapNet可以作为未来3D密集描述研究的有力基准。我们在两个主流基准测试（ScanRefer和Nr3D）上进行了广泛的实验。值得注意的是，我们的方法在CIDEr@0.5IoU指标上分别超越了当前最先进水平11.41%和13.99%。代码将公开提供。
tldr: PVCap通过创新的伪场景数据增强和体素化架构，显著提升了3D场景中物体描述的准确性，并在主流数据集上刷新了性能纪录。
ai_comments: 该论文通过创新的数据增强策略（PseudoCap）和针对性的架构优化（VoxelCapNet）解决了3D密集描述任务中空间布局多样性不足和特征提取能力弱的问题。其显著的性能提升证明了该方法的有效性，为3D场景理解提供了强有力的基准。
motivation: 现有3D密集描述模型存在两个局限：一是仅依赖全局旋转增强导致空间布局单一，难以学习对象间的空间关系；二是骨干网络与检测头设计过于简单，难以提取丰富的语义特征。
method: 提出PVCap框架，包含两个核心模块：1. PseudoCap：通过实例级随机混合生成具有多样化空间布局的伪场景，并利用师生框架获取伪标注；2. VoxelCapNet：一种基于体素的特征提取网络，专门适配并优化了描述生成头。
results: 在ScanRefer和Nr3D基准测试中，CIDEr@0.5IoU指标分别提升了11.41%和13.99%，超越了当前的SOTA方法。
conclusion: PVCap通过PseudoCap增强数据多样性，并利用VoxelCapNet优化体素特征提取与描述生成，在ScanRefer和Nr3D数据集上实现了显著的性能提升，达到了新的SOTA水平。

title: EcoVision: AI-Powered Drone Imaging for Salt Marsh Vegetation Monitoring and Dominance Mapping
authors: Innocent Onyenonachi, Peter J. Lawerance, Nadia Kanwal
abstract: High-resolution RGB imagery acquired from low-altitude UAV surveys was processed through a modular pipeline incorporating transformer-based semantic segmentation, connected-component vegetation extraction, fine-grained species classification using a ConvNeXt architecture, and grid-based dominance scoring at 2x2m resolution. The framework targeted two ecologically significant halophytic grasses, Spartina maritima and Puccinellia maritima, and was trained using a curated and manually annotated UAV imagery, along with biodiversity imagery sourced from publicly accessible datasets. In order to identify these plants from the imagery, our segmentation yielded reliable species masks (mean IoU = 0.56; pixel-level accuracy = 0.96), while object-level classification achieved very good discrimination (F1 = 0.99). Dominance estimates closely matched quadrat-based field surveys, with mean absolute differences below 8%, preserving fine-scale spatial structure under realistic survey conditions. The developed system, named EcoVision, establishes a practical foundation for scalable, high-resolution salt marsh monitoring, demonstrating how AI-driven workflows can translate pixel-level predictions into ecologically interpretable metrics.
zh_title: EcoVision：用于盐沼植被监测与优势度制图的AI驱动无人机影像分析技术
translation: 通过低空无人机调查获取的高分辨率RGB影像，被输入到一个模块化管道中进行处理，该管道结合了基于Transformer的语义分割、连通分量植被提取、使用ConvNeXt架构的细粒度物种分类以及2x2米分辨率的网格化优势度评分。该框架针对两种具有生态意义的盐生草本植物（Spartina maritima和Puccinellia maritima），并使用精选的、手动标注的无人机影像以及来自公开数据集的生物多样性影像进行训练。为了从影像中识别这些植物，我们的分割产生了可靠的物种掩膜（平均IoU = 0.56；像素级准确率 = 0.96），而对象级分类实现了非常好的区分度（F1 = 0.99）。优势度估算与基于样方的实地调查结果高度吻合，平均绝对差异低于8%，在现实调查条件下保留了精细的空间结构。该开发系统被命名为EcoVision，为可扩展、高分辨率的盐沼监测奠定了实用基础，展示了AI驱动的工作流如何将像素级预测转化为具有生态可解释性的指标。
tldr: EcoVision利用无人机影像和深度学习技术，实现了盐沼植被的高精度自动分类与优势度制图，为生态监测提供了一种可扩展的新方案。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于成功将深度学习（Transformer和ConvNeXt）与无人机遥感结合，解决了盐沼植被细粒度监测的难题。其局限性可能在于模型对不同地理区域的泛化能力尚需进一步验证，且mean IoU（0.56）仍有提升空间。总体而言，该方法为生态环境监测提供了一个可扩展且高效的AI工作流。
motivation: 现有的盐沼植被监测手段难以在细粒度尺度上实现高效、大范围的自动化制图，亟需一种能够将无人机高分辨率影像转化为生态指标的AI工作流。
method: 构建了一个模块化处理流程：利用基于Transformer的语义分割提取植被，使用ConvNeXt架构进行细粒度物种分类，并结合2x2米网格进行优势度评分。
results: 语义分割平均交并比（mIoU）达到0.56，像素级准确率为0.96，物种分类F1值高达0.99；优势度估算与实地样方调查差异小于8%。
conclusion: EcoVision框架通过AI驱动的图像处理流程，实现了盐沼植被的高精度监测与优势度制图，为大规模生态监测提供了实用且可靠的工具。

title: DDB: Source-Level Interactive Debugging for Distributed Applications
authors: Yibo Yan, Junzhou He, Seo Jin Park
abstract:
Interactive debugging is an effective tool for understanding program behavior at the source level, allowing developers to pause execution, navigate the call stack, and inspect runtime state. However, interactive debuggers are designed for single-process execution, and interactive debugging has been widely considered impractical for distributed systems. Call stacks stop at process boundaries, debugging state fails to survive infrastructure dynamics, and, most critically, debugger-induced execution pauses trigger catastrophic timeout cascades that destroy the intended debug flow. Consequently, developers are forced to abandon live hypothesis testing in favor of unwieldy and iterative log-and-redeploy cycles.
  We present DDB, a source-level interactive debugger that extends interactive debugging capabilities to distributed applications. We show that each of these challenges admits a targeted solution. To bridge disjoint processes, Distributed Backtrace (DBT) embeds compact causality metadata in every RPC and reconstructs a unified call stack across RPC boundaries. To manage the lifecycle of a distributed session, an intent-preserving control plane automatically coordinates and propagates breakpoints across dynamic process sets. To make pausing safe, Pause-Erased Time (PET) virtualizes each process's clock, decoupling logical time from physical pauses and preventing timeout cascades. DDB integrates with an RPC framework in 20-60 lines of code. Evaluated on gRPC, ServiceWeaver, Nu, and Quicksand across up to 122 processes, DDB achieves 30ms median cross-RPC backtrace latency, sub-5 ms time jump under repeated execution pauses, and adds 1-5% throughput overhead, comparable to attaching a single-process debugger. In a controlled user study, DDB achieves a 100% fault localization success rate (compared to 38.5% for baseline tools) with a median localization time of ~8 minutes.
zh_title: DDB：面向分布式应用的源码级交互式调试器
translation:
交互式调试是理解程序行为的有效工具，允许开发者暂停执行、导航调用栈并检查运行时状态。然而，现有的交互式调试器是为单进程执行而设计的，在分布式系统中通常被认为是不切实际的。因为调用栈在进程边界处停止，调试状态难以在基础设施动态变化中保持，最关键的是，调试器引起的执行暂停会触发灾难性的超时级联，从而破坏预期的调试流程。因此，开发者被迫放弃实时假设测试，转而采用笨拙且迭代的“记录-部署”循环。

我们提出了 DDB，这是一种将交互式调试能力扩展到分布式应用的源码级交互式调试器。我们证明了上述挑战均有针对性的解决方案：为了弥合脱节的进程，分布式回溯（DBT）在每个RPC中嵌入紧凑的因果元数据，并跨RPC边界重构统一的调用栈；为了管理分布式会话的生命周期，意图感知控制平面会自动协调并在动态进程集中传播断点；为了使暂停操作安全，暂停擦除时间（PET）虚拟化了每个进程的时钟，将逻辑时间与物理暂停解耦，从而防止超时级联。DDB仅需20-60行代码即可与RPC框架集成。在gRPC、ServiceWeaver、Nu和Quicksand上进行的评估显示（最多达122个进程），DDB实现了30ms的中位跨RPC回溯延迟，在重复执行暂停下时间跳跃低于5ms，并增加了1-5%的吞吐量开销，与附加单进程调试器相当。在受控用户研究中，DDB实现了100%的故障定位成功率（基准工具为38.5%），中位定位时间约为8分钟。
tldr: DDB通过解决分布式系统中的调用栈追踪、断点协调和时间同步问题，让分布式应用也能像单机程序一样进行高效的交互式调试。
ai_comments: 该研究通过创新的分布式回溯、意图感知控制平面和时间虚拟化技术，成功克服了分布式系统调试中“暂停导致超时”和“状态碎片化”的核心难题。其轻量级的集成方式（仅需几十行代码）和极低的性能开销，使其在实际工程中具有很高的应用价值。
motivation: 传统的交互式调试器仅针对单进程设计，在分布式系统中由于调用栈断裂、基础设施动态变化以及调试暂停导致的超时级联，使得实时交互调试变得不可行，开发者被迫依赖低效的日志分析。
method: 1. Distributed Backtrace (DBT)：通过在RPC中嵌入因果元数据重建跨进程调用栈；2. 意图感知控制平面：协调和传播断点至动态进程集；3. Pause-Erased Time (PET)：虚拟化逻辑时钟，防止因调试暂停引发的超时级联。
results: 在多框架测试中，DDB实现了约30ms的跨RPC回溯延迟，低于5ms的时间跳跃，仅有1-5%的吞吐量开销；用户研究显示其故障定位成功率达到100%，定位时间中位数仅为8分钟。
conclusion: DDB 证明了在分布式系统中实现源级交互式调试不仅是可行的，而且能够显著提高故障定位的效率和准确性，为分布式开发工具链提供了重要补充。

title: RoME: Robust Mixture of Low-Rank Experts against Multiple Adversarial Perturbations
authors: Woo Jae Kim, Kyle Min, Suhyeon Ha, Joonsung Jeon, Sung-eui Yoon
abstract: Multi-perturbation adversarial training (MAT) aims to achieve robustness against multiple $\ell_p$ perturbations but suffers from robustness trade-offs between different threats. To address this, we employ a mixture of experts (MoE) to route different threats through distinct model pathways. However, naive application of MoE encounters two critical challenges: experts tend to overlook threat-specific features and redundantly capture features shared across threats, and gating networks suffer from threat-agnostic routing where they learn nearly identical routing patterns across threats, thus preventing the construction of threat-specific model pathways. To this end, we propose Robust Mixture of Low-Rank Experts (RoME), where each expert is a low-rank additive update to the shared backbone, allowing it to capture threat-common features while experts focus on threat-specific information. To address threat-agnostic routing, RoME introduces (i) dual-scale gating that exploits threat-discriminative signals from local and global level features, and (ii) threat-guided gating diversification that enforces diverse expert utilization across threats. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RoME outperforms existing state-of-the-art MAT in union robustness and natural accuracy and improves robustness against unseen threats. Codes are available at https://github.com/wkim97/RoME.
zh_title: RoME：针对多种对抗扰动的鲁棒低秩专家混合模型
translation: 多扰动对抗训练（MAT）旨在实现对多种 $\ell_p$ 扰动的鲁棒性，但往往面临不同威胁之间的鲁棒性权衡。为了解决这一问题，我们采用混合专家（MoE）模型，通过不同的模型路径处理不同的威胁。然而，朴素的 MoE 应用面临两个关键挑战：专家倾向于忽略威胁特有的特征，冗余地捕获跨威胁的共享特征；门控网络遭受威胁不可知的路由影响，即在不同威胁下学习到几乎相同的路由模式，从而无法构建威胁特定的模型路径。为此，我们提出了鲁棒低秩专家混合模型（RoME），其中每个专家都是对共享骨干网络的低秩加法更新，使其能够捕获威胁共性特征，同时让专家专注于威胁特定信息。为了解决威胁不可知的路由问题，RoME 引入了：(i) 双尺度门控，利用来自局部和全局特征的威胁判别信号；(ii) 威胁引导的门控多样化，强制不同威胁使用不同的专家。广泛的实验表明，RoME 在联合鲁棒性和自然准确率方面优于现有的最先进 MAT 方法，并提高了对未知威胁的鲁棒性。代码已在 https://github.com/wkim97/RoME 公开。
tldr: RoME 通过低秩专家和改进的门控机制，解决了多扰动对抗训练中专家功能重叠和路由失效的问题，实现了更好的鲁棒性权衡。
ai_comments: 该论文巧妙地结合了低秩适应（LoRA）思想与混合专家（MoE）架构，针对多扰动对抗训练中的核心痛点——专家同质化和路由机制失效——提出了有效的解决方案，具有很强的实用价值和创新性。
motivation: 现有的多扰动对抗训练（MAT）在应对多种威胁时存在鲁棒性权衡，且直接应用混合专家（MoE）会导致专家功能重叠和门控机制无法区分不同威胁的问题。
method: 提出 RoME 框架：1. 使用低秩加法更新作为专家，以捕获威胁特定信息并共享骨干特征；2. 引入双尺度门控机制，利用局部和全局特征进行威胁判别；3. 实施威胁引导的门控多样化策略，强制不同威胁使用不同的专家路径。
results: 在多项实验中，RoME 在联合鲁棒性和自然准确率上均优于现有的最先进 MAT 方法，并提升了对未知威胁的鲁棒性。
conclusion: RoME 通过引入低秩专家和威胁引导的门控机制，有效解决了多扰动对抗训练中的鲁棒性权衡问题，在提升联合鲁棒性的同时保持了良好的自然准确率。

title: x-Prediction Is All You Need:Training-Free Accelerated Generation via Endpoint Decodability
authors: Xin Peng, Ang Gao
abstract: Diffusion and flow matching models generate high-quality samples, but their ODE samplers often need tens to hundreds of neural function evaluations (NFEs). This remains a practical challenge for released checkpoints, since many accelerators require additional design choices and training cost through retraining, distillation, or trajectory redesign. We investigate a different route based on $x$-prediction. During sampling, standard affine probability paths already expose $x_0$ information: an intermediate state and its path velocity determine a principled estimate of the clean sample. We formalize this property as \textbf{endpoint decodability} and show that the decoder is the minimum-MSE estimator $\mathbb{E}[x_0\mid x_t]$ under the usual $\ell_2$ objective. This yields \textbf{Truncated Jump Sampling} (TJS): stop the ODE at an early-exit time $t^*$ and return the decoded $x_0$. TJS requires no retraining, distillation, or architecture change. Across SDXL, SD3.5M, Z-Image-Turbo, and three class-conditional benchmarks, it reduces NFEs by 20--70\% with near-matched quality. The analysis also shows why endpoint prediction can work without straightening the trajectory, providing inference acceleration without trajectory redesign.

title: LLM-Guided Measurement Credibility Correction for Trustworthy Industrial Process Inference
authors: Youcheng Zong, Runda Jia, Dakuo He
abstract: Industrial prediction and soft sensing depend on credible input measurements. In field deployment, a predictor may receive biased, delayed, stale, or derived measurements that still look plausible. Prediction can then fail before the forecasting backbone becomes the main limitation, because the input window no longer represents the real process. Sensor reconstruction, data reconciliation, and fault-tolerant soft sensing reduce this risk, but they often rely on numerical correlation, alarms, fault labels, or explicit process equations. These assumptions are not always available. A correlated variable can also be an unsafe reference when variables share instruments, derived formulas, soft-sensing chains, or control actions. The key issue is to decide before prediction which external measurements can credibly support the current measurement. To address this issue, this article proposes LLM-Guided Measurement Credibility Correction (MCC). MCC converts measurement meanings in process documents into measurement semantics usable by numerical models. It builds independent process references from semantically qualified external measurements and corrects local measurement conflicts before prediction. The predictor therefore receives a more credible input window. Across multiple complex industrial forecasting and soft-sensing tasks, +MCC achieves average relative MAE reductions of 30.7% on real-test protocols and 80.3% on controlled-corruption protocols. It adds only 0.5--2.0k online parameters, with the slowest +MCC inference time at 0.089 ms/step. These results show that measurement semantics can turn process documents into lightweight pre-inference credibility correction and improve prediction accuracy.

title: WebRetriever: A Large-Scale Comprehensive Benchmark for Efficient Web Agent Evaluation
authors: Wei Dong, Tianyu Fu, Zhe Yu, Hanning Wang, Anyang Su, Zhizhou Fang, Yuyang Chen, Shuo Wang, Minghui Wu, Ping Jiang, Zhen Lei, Chenxu Zhao
abstract: As web agents increasingly demonstrate capabilities in automated task execution, the development of robust evaluation frameworks for assessing their navigation and task completion performance has emerged as a critical research priority. However, existing benchmarks exhibit fundamental limitations. First, they suffer from insufficient scale and limited domain diversity, constraining comprehensive evaluation of cross-domain generalization. Second, prevailing LLM-as-Judge evaluation methodologies inadequately capture fine-grained interaction semantics, particularly regarding precise query formulation and filtering operations. Third, current benchmarks predominantly emphasize navigation success metrics while neglecting critical requirements for real-world deployment scenarios. To address these limitations, we introduce WebRetriever, a large-scale benchmark encompassing 800 websites and 1,550 tasks across diverse domains, including consumer, professional, and enterprise sectors, with comprehensive coverage of user intent patterns. We propose NavEval (Navigation Evaluation), a novel LLM-as-Judge framework that leverages rich interaction context beyond visual screenshots, achieving state-of-the-art alignment with human judgment across multiple evaluation datasets.
