The method then propagates intent without retraining, using embedding-space soft assignment, abstention, and alignment-scaled updates before reprojection. On a 5K-document LitCovid corpus, our method achieves global alignment comparable to per-item LLM steering while reducing LLM calls by over three orders of magnitude. An image case study shows that the same prototype-based mechanism extends to multimodal embeddings. These results suggest that group-level representations can make semantic steering more practical for larger embedding collections.
comment: Accepted as a short paper at IEEE VIS 2026. 5 pages, 2 figures
zh_title: 可扩展的嵌入投影语义引导
translation: 低维投影支持高维数据嵌入的交互式可视化分析，但其结构通常与分析师定义的语义关系不符。最近的LLM增强语义引导方法通过将分析师意图从用户定义的种子示例组中外部化来解决这一差距，但它们通过逐项LLM推理传播意图，导致LLM调用和成本随集合大小线性增长。我们提出了一种可扩展的语义引导方法，将语义计算从单个项目转移到用户定义的分组。一次LLM调用即可为所有分组生成结构化配置文件，这些配置文件被嵌入并与种子质心结合形成混合语义原型。然后，该方法在不重新训练的情况下，使用嵌入空间软分配、弃权和对齐缩放更新，在重新投影之前传播意图。在包含5K份文档的LitCovid语料库上，我们的方法实现了与逐项LLM引导相当的全局对齐，同时将LLM调用次数减少了三个数量级以上。一个图像案例研究表明，相同的基于原型机制可以扩展到多模态嵌入。这些结果表明，组级表示可以使语义引导对于更大的嵌入集合更具实用性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种可扩展的语义引导方法，通过将大型语言模型（LLM）的语义计算从单个项目转移到用户定义的分组，显著减少了LLM调用次数，同时保持了与逐项LLM引导相当的全局对齐。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了组级表示来解决语义引导方法的可扩展性问题，通过将LLM计算从逐项转移到组级，显著降低了计算成本和LLM调用次数。这对于处理大规模嵌入集合具有重要意义，使其在实际应用中更具可行性。该方法通过生成混合语义原型，有效地聚合了组内语义信息，并实现了高效的意图传播。其局限性可能在于组级配置文件生成的质量对整体性能的影响，以及在非常细粒度的语义引导场景下，组级表示是否能完全替代逐项推理的精确性。
motivation: 低维投影在可视化分析高维数据嵌入时，其结构往往与分析师定义的语义关系不一致。现有的LLM增强语义引导方法通过逐项LLM推理传播意图，导致LLM调用次数和成本随数据量线性增长，缺乏可扩展性。
method: 本文提出了一种可扩展的语义引导方法，将语义计算从单个项目转移到用户定义的分组。通过一次LLM调用为所有分组生成结构化配置文件，这些配置文件被嵌入并与种子质心结合，形成混合语义原型。然后，该方法在不重新训练的情况下，利用嵌入空间的软分配、弃权和对齐缩放更新，在重新投影之前传播意图。
results: 在包含5K份文档的LitCovid语料库上，该方法实现了与逐项LLM引导相当的全局对齐，同时将LLM调用次数减少了三个数量级以上。一个图像案例研究表明，相同的基于原型机制可以扩展到多模态嵌入。
conclusion: 这些结果表明，组级表示可以使语义引导对于更大的嵌入集合更具实用性。

title: TRACER: Early Failure Detection for Task-Oriented Dialogue
authors: Erfan Nourbakhsh, Rocky Slavin, Ke Yang, Anthony Rios
abstract: Task-oriented dialogue systems often fail before the final breakdown is obvious, but most evaluation only measures failure after the conversation has already gone wrong. We present TRACER, a method for early failure detection in task-oriented dialogue. TRACER predicts from a partial dialogue whether the full conversation will eventually fail by combining simple trajectory signals from belief-state changes with text representations of the evolving dialogue state. We evaluate the method in both oracle and generated belief-state settings, and test how well it works when only 25%, 50%, 75%, or 100% of the dialogue is visible. Across these settings, TRACER detects useful failure signals well before the end of the conversation and outperforms heuristic, classical, and single-stream baselines. These results suggest that early failure detection can provide a practical warning signal for dialogue systems before the interaction fully breaks down.
zh_title: TRACER：面向任务对话的早期故障检测
translation: 面向任务的对话系统通常在最终故障明显之前就已出现问题，但大多数评估只在对话已经出错后才测量故障。我们提出了TRACER，一种用于面向任务对话早期故障检测的方法。TRACER通过将信念状态变化的简单轨迹信号与不断演变的对话状态的文本表示相结合，从部分对话中预测完整的对话最终是否会失败。我们在预言机和生成信念状态设置下评估了该方法，并测试了当对话仅有25%、50%、75%或100%可见时它的工作效果。在这些设置中，TRACER在对话结束前很好地检测到有用的故障信号，并优于启发式、经典和单流基线方法。这些结果表明，早期故障检测可以在交互完全崩溃之前为对话系统提供实用的预警信号。
tldr: TRACER是一种用于面向任务对话系统早期故障检测的方法，它结合了信念状态变化和对话状态的文本表示来预测对话是否会失败，并在各种设置下优于基线方法。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的早期故障检测方法TRACER，解决了面向任务对话系统评估中普遍存在的滞后性问题。其结合多模态信号（信念状态变化和文本表示）进行预测的思路具有新颖性，且在多种实验设置下表现出色，证明了其在实际应用中的潜力。该研究对于提升对话系统的鲁棒性和用户体验具有重要意义。
motivation: 面向任务的对话系统经常在最终故障变得明显之前就出现问题，但大多数评估只在对话已经出错后才测量故障。因此，需要一种方法来提前检测故障。
method: TRACER通过结合来自信念状态变化的简单轨迹信号与不断演变的对话状态的文本表示，从部分对话中预测完整的对话最终是否会失败。
results: 在预言机和生成信念状态设置下，以及在对话可见度为25%、50%、75%或100%的情况下，TRACER都能在对话结束前很好地检测到有用的故障信号，并优于启发式、经典和单流基线方法。
conclusion: 早期故障检测可以为对话系统在交互完全崩溃之前提供实用的预警信号。

title: Fast Asymptotically Optimal Kinodynamic Planning via Vectorization
authors: Yitian Gao, Andrew Lu, Zachary Kingston
abstract: Sampling-based motion planners have been shown to be effective for systems with complex kinodynamic constraints and high dimensionality. However, these algorithms struggle to achieve real-time performance, leading to recent efforts to parallelize planning. While GPU-accelerated planners have achieved significant speedups, existing approaches require specialized CUDA programming that limits accessibility and portability. We present Parallel Asymptotically Optimal Kinodynamic RRT (PAKR), a massively parallel kinodynamic planner leveraging JAX and the XLA compiler to achieve GPU acceleration through standard Python tooling. By combining our parallel planner with the AO-x meta-algorithm, we achieve asymptotic optimality through fast iterative replanning. We provide a theoretical analysis of probabilistic completeness, analyze the effects of batch size and branching factor on convergence, and demonstrate scalability to complex dynamics using the MuJoCo-XLA simulator. Experiments show competitive runtimes with state-of-the-art GPU planners and superior solution quality.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Accepted to IROS 2026
zh_title: 通过向量化实现快速渐近最优动力学规划
translation: 基于采样的运动规划器已被证明对具有复杂动力学约束和高维度的系统有效。然而，这些算法难以实现实时性能，导致近期出现了并行化规划的努力。虽然GPU加速的规划器已经实现了显著的加速，但现有方法需要专门的CUDA编程，限制了可访问性和可移植性。我们提出了并行渐近最优动力学RRT（PAKR），这是一种利用JAX和XLA编译器通过标准Python工具实现GPU加速的大规模并行动力学规划器。通过将我们的并行规划器与AO-x元算法相结合，我们通过快速迭代重规划实现了渐近最优性。我们提供了概率完备性的理论分析，分析了批处理大小和分支因子对收敛的影响，并展示了使用MuJoCo-XLA模拟器对复杂动力学的可扩展性。实验表明，该方法与最先进的GPU规划器相比具有竞争力的运行时间，并且解的质量更优。
tldr: 通过JAX和XLA在Python中实现GPU加速的并行运动规划，无需复杂CUDA编程即可达到实时、渐近最优的性能。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于利用JAX和XLA编译器实现了无需CUDA底层编程的GPU加速运动规划器，显著降低了开发门槛并提高了可移植性。此外，结合AO-x元算法实现了渐近最优性，在复杂动力学系统中的表现优异，具有极高的实际应用价值。
motivation: 现有的基于采样的运动规划算法在处理复杂动力学和高维系统时难以满足实时性需求，而现有的GPU加速方案通常依赖复杂的CUDA编程，导致开发困难且缺乏可移植性。
method: 提出Parallel Asymptotically Optimal Kinodynamic RRT (PAKR)算法，利用JAX和XLA编译器进行向量化并行计算，并结合AO-x元算法实现渐近最优性，同时使用MuJoCo-XLA模拟器进行验证。
results: 实验结果表明，PAKR在运行速度上与最先进的GPU规划器相当，且在解的质量上表现更优，同时证明了其在复杂动力学任务中的可扩展性。
conclusion: PAKR通过JAX和XLA实现了高性能的并行运动规划，在保持渐近最优性的同时，提供了比传统CUDA实现更强的可移植性和开发效率，在复杂动力学任务中表现出优于现有方法的性能。

title: BanglaMemeEvidence: A Multimodal Benchmark Dataset for Explanatory Evidence Detection in Bengali Memes
authors: Fatema Tuj Johora Faria, Mukaffi Bin Moin, Md. Mahfuzur Rahman, Pronay Debnath, Asif Iftekher Fahim, Faisal Muhammad Shah
abstract: Memes have become influential communication tools on social media, combining viral visuals with concise messaging to convey impactful ideas. While substantial research has examined the affective dimensions of memes, key challenges such as detecting harmful content, identifying cyberbullying, and performing accurate sentiment analysis remain critical, largely due to the need for deeper contextual understanding. In this paper, we introduce MemeEvidenceDetect, a hybrid task aimed at analyzing a meme and its contextual information to identify specific sentences that explain or elucidate its meaning and humor. To support this task, we present BanglaMemeEvidence, a curated dataset of 2,917 Bengali memes, emphasizing its significance as a resource for the Bangla language. Each meme is annotated with natural language explanations, including Meme OCR, Meme Context, and Evidence Sentences, alongside relevance scores that reflect the relationship between a meme and its corresponding annotations. To address the gap in dynamically inferring a meme's context, we propose BengaliMemeEvidenceNet, a hybrid multimodal framework that integrates textual and visual features for comprehensive meme representation. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of BengaliMemeEvidenceNet, achieving an F1 score of 0.74. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to focus on evidence detection in Bengali memes, marking a notable step forward in the analysis of memes in low-resource languages.
comment: Accepted at 6th International Conference on Innovations in Computational Intelligence and Computer Vision (ICICV 2026)
zh_title: BanglaMemeEvidence：一个用于孟加拉语模因解释性证据检测的多模态基准数据集
translation: 模因已成为社交媒体上具有影响力的交流工具，通过结合病毒式传播的视觉效果与简洁的信息来传达有影响力的思想。尽管已有大量研究考察了模因的情感维度，但由于需要更深层次的语境理解，检测有害内容、识别网络欺凌和进行准确的情感分析等关键挑战仍然存在。在本文中，我们引入了MemeEvidenceDetect，这是一项旨在分析模因及其语境信息以识别解释其含义和幽默感的特定句子的混合任务。为了支持这项任务，我们提出了BanglaMemeEvidence，这是一个包含2,917个孟加拉语模因的精选数据集，强调了其作为孟加拉语资源的重要性。每个模因都标注了自然语言解释，包括模因OCR、模因语境和证据句子，以及反映模因与其相应注释之间关系的相关性得分。为了解决动态推断模因语境的差距，我们提出了BengaliMemeEvidenceNet，这是一个整合了文本和视觉特征以进行全面模因表示的混合多模态框架。我们的实验证明了BengaliMemeEvidenceNet的有效性，实现了0.74的F1分数。据我们所知，这是第一项专注于孟加拉语模因证据检测的研究，标志着在低资源语言模因分析方面迈出了重要的一步。
tldr: 本文发布了首个孟加拉语模因证据检测数据集BanglaMemeEvidence，并提出了BengaliMemeEvidenceNet模型，实现了对模因语境和解释性文本的自动化分析。
ai_comments: 该论文填补了低资源语言（孟加拉语）在多模态模因分析领域的空白。其创新点在于将解释性证据检测引入模因分析，不仅关注情感，更关注语义理解。局限性在于数据集规模相对较小，且模型性能仍有提升空间。
motivation: 模因在社交媒体中具有影响力，但目前的分析多集中于情感维度，缺乏对深层语境和含义的解释，且孟加拉语作为低资源语言，缺乏相关的模因分析基准和研究。
method: 提出了MemeEvidenceDetect混合任务；构建了包含2,917个孟加拉语模因的BanglaMemeEvidence数据集；设计了BengaliMemeEvidenceNet混合多模态框架，通过整合文本和视觉特征进行模因表示。
results: 实验结果表明，BengaliMemeEvidenceNet模型在证据检测任务上达到了0.74的F1分数，验证了该模型在理解孟加拉语模因语境方面的有效性。
conclusion: 本文成功提出了针对孟加拉语模因的解释性证据检测任务，并通过构建高质量数据集和多模态模型证明了该任务的可行性，为低资源语言的模因分析提供了重要基准。

title: Energy-Aware System-Level Evaluation of Post-Quantum TLS on Embedded User Equipment over a Disaggregated 5G Network
authors: Sanzida Hoque, Abdullah Aydeger
abstract: The transition to quantum-resistant security is a critical priority for the next generation of mobile networks, particularly within the disaggregated architecture of 5G. This paper presents an energy-aware system-level evaluation of Post- Quantum Cryptography (PQC) integrated into the Transport Layer Security (TLS) handshake on embedded User Equipment (UE). Using Raspberry Pi 5s as representative embedded processing platforms, we evaluate the performance of NIST-standardized combinations of classical and post-quantum signature and key exchange mechanisms (KEM), incorporating direct on-device power measurements to estimate per-handshake energy consumption. Results experimentally validate a strong coupling between latency and energy consumption, indicating that execution time is the dominant contributor to energy cost. Hash-based signature schemes incur up to 4x higher latency and 2x energy compared to lattice-based alternatives, while the impact of KEMs is comparatively smaller. The analysis further reveals that overall system performance is primarily constrained by cryptographic computation and concurrency-induced contention rather than network transport effects. These findings provide practical guidance for PQC deployment in mobile environments and demonstrate that lattice-based signatures offer a more favorable balance between security, efficiency, and scalability for 5G systems.
zh_title: 嵌入式用户设备在分离式5G网络上的后量子TLS的能源感知系统级评估
translation: 向抗量子安全过渡是下一代移动网络的一个关键优先事项，特别是在5G的网络架构中。本文提出了在嵌入式用户设备（UE）上传输层安全（TLS）握手中集成的后量子密码学（PQC）的能源感知系统级评估。我们使用树莓派5作为代表性的嵌入式处理平台，评估了经典和后量子签名及密钥交换机制（KEM）的NIST标准化组合的性能，并结合了直接的设备功耗测量来估算每次握手的能耗。结果通过实验验证了延迟和能耗之间存在很强的耦合关系，表明执行时间是能耗的主要贡献因素。基于哈希的签名方案的延迟和能耗分别是基于格的替代方案的4倍和2倍，而密钥交换机制（KEMs）的影响相对较小。分析进一步揭示，整体系统性能主要受密码计算和并发引起的争用限制，而非网络传输效应。这些发现为在移动环境中部署PQC提供了实际指导，并证明了基于格的签名在安全、效率和可扩展性方面为5G系统提供了更有利的平衡。
tldr: 该研究评估了在5G网络上使用树莓派5进行TLS握手时，后量子密码学（PQC）的能耗。结果表明，延迟与能耗密切相关，基于哈希的签名方案比基于格的方案能耗更高。计算能力和并发争用是主要的系统瓶颈，而非网络传输。基于格的签名在5G系统中提供了更好的安全、效率和可扩展性平衡。
ai_comments: 该研究对后量子密码学（PQC）在5G移动网络中的实际应用进行了重要的系统级能耗评估。通过在嵌入式设备上进行直接功耗测量，该研究提供了宝贵的实证数据，揭示了PQC对能耗和性能的影响。研究强调了延迟和计算瓶颈的重要性，并为PQC方案的选择提供了具体的指导。然而，该研究仅限于特定的硬件平台（树莓派5）和网络配置，未来的研究可以扩展到更多样化的设备和网络环境，以提供更全面的见解。
motivation: 随着向抗量子安全过渡到下一代移动网络，特别是在5G的网络架构中，有必要评估后量子密码学（PQC）在TLS握手中的实际影响，特别是在嵌入式用户设备（UE）上的能耗。
method: 使用树莓派5作为嵌入式处理平台，评估了NIST标准化的经典和后量子签名及密钥交换机制（KEM）组合的性能。通过直接的设备功耗测量来估算每次握手的能耗。
results: 实验结果验证了延迟和能耗之间存在很强的耦合关系，表明执行时间是能耗的主要贡献因素。基于哈希的签名方案的延迟和能耗分别是基于格的替代方案的4倍和2倍。密钥交换机制（KEMs）的影响相对较小。系统性能主要受密码计算和并发引起的争用限制，而非网络传输效应。
conclusion: 基于格的签名在安全、效率和可扩展性方面为5G系统提供了更有利的平衡，为在移动环境中部署PQC提供了实际指导。

title: Knowing When to Stop: Predicting Execution-Consistency Convergence in Text-to-SQL
authors: Yaron Anavi, Mor Aisenberg, Nadav Nesher, Elena Khabibullina, Isabella Cattinelli
abstract: Repeated LLM calls are the standard way to estimate how trustworthy a Text-to-SQL result is: run the pipeline multiple times, judge each SQL execution, and use the consistency of the verdicts as a confidence signal. The open question is when to stop, when the consistency has converged. We formulate this as a convergence-prediction problem and train a family of lightweight 1-D models that observe the running consistency trajectory and decide, at each step, whether further runs are unlikely to shift it materially, and we benchmark them against a principled Beta-Bernoulli stopping rule and a learned run-count baseline. On the BIRD benchmark and two production customer datasets, our method adapts its stopping point to each user question, halting sooner when consistency converges early and continuing longer when it converges late. We further show that the weak serial correlation between runs lets us permute their order as a training augmentation, controlled by a tunable shuffling weight. Performance stays consistent across the three datasets, and to mimic an imperfect production judge we inject noise into the correct/incorrect verdicts obtained by comparing the generated and ground-truth SQL results, showing that the method still predicts convergence reliably.
zh_title: 知晓何时停止：预测Text-to-SQL中的执行一致性收敛
translation: 重复调用LLM是评估Text-to-SQL结果可信度的标准方法：通过多次运行流水线，判断每次SQL执行情况，并将判决的一致性作为置信度信号。一个尚未解决的问题是何时停止，即一致性在何时收敛。我们将此问题表述为收敛预测问题，并训练了一系列轻量级一维模型，通过观察运行的一致性轨迹，在每一步决定是否继续运行，并将其与基于原则的Beta-Bernoulli停止规则及基于学习的运行计数基线进行了基准测试。在BIRD基准测试和两个生产客户数据集上，我们的方法能够根据每个用户的问题自适应调整停止点，在一致性早期收敛时提前停止，并在收敛较晚时持续更长时间。我们进一步证明，运行之间的弱序列相关性允许我们通过可调的重排权重将它们的顺序作为训练增强进行排列。在三个数据集上表现一致，并且为了模拟不完美的生产判断，我们通过比较生成SQL和真实SQL结果得到的正确/错误判决中注入噪声，表明该方法仍然能够可靠地预测收敛。
tldr: 通过训练轻量级模型监控Text-to-SQL的重复运行轨迹，自动判断何时达到一致性收敛，从而在节省算力的同时保证预测结果的可靠性。
ai_comments: 该研究针对Text-to-SQL任务中重复采样导致计算资源浪费的问题，提出了一种预测执行一致性收敛的轻量级模型。其创新点在于将“何时停止”转化为一个收敛预测问题，并利用运行轨迹进行动态决策，在保证可靠性的前提下有效降低了推理成本。局限性在于该方法依赖于对执行结果的准确评估。
motivation: 在Text-to-SQL任务中，重复调用LLM以评估结果可信度是标准做法，但如何确定何时停止重复调用以节省资源是一个未解决的问题。
method: 将一致性收敛建模为预测问题，训练了一系列轻量级一维模型来观察运行一致性轨迹，并据此决定何时停止。此外，利用运行序列的弱自相关性进行训练增强（重排），并对执行结果注入噪声以模拟真实生产环境的评估不确定性。
results: 在BIRD基准测试及两个生产数据集上，该方法能够根据具体问题自适应调整停止点，在收敛早时提前停止，收敛晚时延长运行，且在引入评估噪声的情况下仍能保持可靠的收敛预测性能。
conclusion: 该研究证明了利用轻量级模型预测一致性收敛是可行的，能够根据不同问题的难度自适应调整运行次数，从而在Text-to-SQL任务中实现效率与可靠性的平衡。

title: The Insertion List-Decoding Capacity and an Improved Bound on the Deletion List-Decoding Capacity
authors: Roni Con, Dean Doron, João Ribeiro
zh_title: 插入列表译码容量及删除列表译码容量的改进界限
translation: 非正式地说，给定对抗性错误模型下的列表译码容量，是指在列表大小为码长多项式的情况下，可以进行列表译码的最大码率。插入和删除下的列表译码容量是抗同步错误编码中一个基本但理解尚浅的方面。例如，当处理超过 1/2 的插入比例时，已知的最佳下界仅能说明容量为正。除此之外，我们也只有宽松的界限，且下界大多源于对均匀随机码的分析。我们对二进制码在插入和删除下的列表译码极限有了新的理解。我们证明了 δ-比例插入下的列表译码容量精确为 (1+δ)(1-h(δ/(1+δ)))（对于所有 δ∈[0,1]），这可以通过根据对称 2 状态马尔可夫链采样的码以高概率实现。有趣的是，我们补充说明了这种方法在删除列表译码中并不能优于均匀随机编码。我们还给出了 δ-比例删除下列表译码容量的改进上界，特别表明当 δ→0 时，其表现为 1-h(δ)。这与删除概率趋于零时二进制删除信道的容量渐近行为一致。
tldr: 本文确定了插入信道的精确列表译码容量，并改进了删除信道的列表译码上界。
ai_comments: 本文在同步错误纠错领域取得了重要进展，特别是在插入纠错方面给出了精确的容量公式，并改进了删除纠错的容量上界。创新点在于通过马尔可夫链构造码字，而非传统的随机码。局限性在于删除信道的容量下界仍未完全解决，且该方法在删除模型中未优于随机码。
motivation: 同步错误（插入和删除）下的列表译码容量长期以来研究不足，现有的下界往往非常宽松，特别是在高错误率区间，缺乏精确的容量界定。
method: 通过构造基于对称2状态马尔可夫链的编码方案来分析插入信道的列表译码容量；同时通过数学分析改进了删除信道列表译码的上界。
results: 证明了插入信道列表译码的精确容量为 (1+δ)(1-h(δ/(1+δ)))，并给出了删除信道列表译码的改进上界，在删除率趋于0时表现为 1-h(δ)。
conclusion: 本文确定了插入信道列表译码的精确容量，并改进了删除信道列表译码的上界，为理解同步错误下的列表译码极限提供了关键理论支撑。

title: InSpace: Structure-Aware 3D Indoor Scene Generation from a Single 360° Image
authors: Gwanhyeong Koo, Hyunsu Kim, Youngji Kim, Taejae Lee, Siwoo Lim, Sunjae Yoon, Suyong Yeon, Chang D. Yoo
abstract: Recent advances in single image-to-3D generation have enabled high-quality asset synthesis, yet extending these capabilities to indoor scene generation remains challenging. Existing methods focus on asset-level generation while neglecting the structural layout, which is essential for downstream applications and serves as the spatial anchor for grounding assets. However, a single image with a limited field of view lacks the spatial coverage to recover a coherent global layout. To this end, we use a 360° image represented in equirectangular projection (ERP) and propose InSpace, a structure-aware framework for 3D indoor scene generation. InSpace comprises three stages: (1) estimating partial scene geometry as spatial priors, (2) generating coarse scene structure with view-selective cross-attention, and (3) producing detailed layout and asset geometry with textures through a global-local hybrid attention, using flow matching. We also propose ERP-FRONT, a paired ERP-Image-to-3D indoor scene dataset based on 3D-FRONT. Experiments show that InSpace generates complete 3D indoor scenes with structural layout, along with separate textured assets from a single ERP image, achieving strong performance across 3D and 2D metrics. Project Page: https://kookie12.github.io/InSpace-Project-Page/
zh_title: InSpace：基于单张360°全景图像的结构感知3D室内场景生成
translation: 近期在单图转3D生成方面的进展使得高质量资产合成成为可能，然而将这些能力扩展到室内场景生成仍然具有挑战性。现有方法侧重于资产层面的生成，却忽略了对下游应用至关重要且作为资产定位空间锚点的结构布局。然而，视角有限的单张图像缺乏恢复连贯全局布局所需的空间覆盖范围。为此，我们使用等距柱状投影（ERP）表示的360°图像，并提出了 InSpace，一个用于3D室内场景生成的结构感知框架。InSpace 包含三个阶段：（1）估计部分场景几何作为空间先验；（2）利用视图选择交叉注意力生成粗略场景结构；（3）通过全局-局部混合注意力机制，利用流匹配生成详细的布局和带纹理的资产几何。我们还提出了 ERP-FRONT，这是一个基于 3D-FRONT 的配对 ERP 图像转3D室内场景数据集。实验表明，InSpace 能够从单张 ERP 图像生成具有结构布局的完整3D室内场景，以及独立的纹理资产，并在3D和2D指标上取得了优异的表现。
tldr: InSpace 利用360°全景图克服了普通视角图像缺乏全局信息的限制，通过三阶段框架实现了高质量的3D室内场景布局与资产生成。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地利用360°全景图像（ERP）解决室内场景生成中缺乏全局布局信息的难题，并引入了专门针对该任务的ERP-FRONT数据集，填补了该领域的空白。其分阶段的处理框架有效地平衡了全局结构与局部细节，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 现有的单图3D生成方法多关注单个资产，忽略了室内场景的结构布局，且普通视角图像缺乏全局空间覆盖能力，无法恢复连贯的室内空间布局。
method: 提出 InSpace 框架，包含三个阶段：(1) 估计部分场景几何作为空间先验；(2) 利用视图选择交叉注意力生成粗略场景结构；(3) 通过全局-局部混合注意力机制及流匹配技术，生成详细的布局及带纹理的资产几何结构。同时构建了 ERP-FRONT 数据集。
results: InSpace 能够从单张 ERP 图像生成包含结构布局和独立纹理资产的完整3D室内场景，在3D和2D指标上均表现出卓越性能。
conclusion: InSpace 成功实现了从单张360°全景图像生成具备结构布局和独立纹理资产的完整3D室内场景，证明了利用全景图像作为空间锚点在场景生成任务中的优越性。

title: Evaluating 5G-connected IoT for Power Line Temperature Prediction: Real-World Latency and Cost Trade-offs Between MEC and Cloud
authors: Aakash Sharma, Sigmund Akselsen, Anders Andersen, Lars Ailo Bongo, Arne Munch-Ellingsen
abstract: One of the key promises of Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) is its low latency. Current large-scale IoT deployments rely on cloud for their reliability, low cost, and ease of use. For outdoor IoT deployments, 5G cellular networks offer significantly enhanced bandwidth and dramatically reduced latency compared to previous generations, enabling real-time data processing and control. Therefore, leveraging 5G connectivity is crucial for outdoor IoT applications requiring responsiveness and complex data handling. Combining MEC with 5G has the potential to provide the ease of cloud computing alongside low latency. We investigate the latency performance on a 5G cellular network with an experimental MEC setup. In our proof-of-concept, we demonstrate the benefits of using an edge-based compute server for real-time power transmission line analytics. We compare our solution with state-of-the-art multi-region cloud deployments and discuss the advantages of mobile edge computing (MEC). Our real-world evaluation demonstrates a low latency of 44.62 ms for MEC compared to cloud regions; however, the gap is narrowing. While such low latencies can benefit real-world deployments, they remain insufficient to meet the stringent requirements of smart power grid operations (~8 ms).
zh_title: 评估用于输电线温度预测的5G连接物联网：MEC与云之间的真实延迟和成本权衡
translation: 移动边缘计算（MEC）的核心承诺之一是其低延迟。当前的规模化物联网部署依赖于云的可靠性、低成本和易用性。对于户外物联网部署，5G蜂窝网络与前几代相比提供了显著增强的带宽和大幅降低的延迟，从而实现实时数据处理和控制。因此，利用5G连接对于需要响应能力和复杂数据处理的户外物联网应用至关重要。将MEC与5G相结合，有可能在提供云计算便利性的同时实现低延迟。我们在实验性MEC设置下研究了5G蜂窝网络上的延迟性能。在我们的概念验证中，我们展示了使用基于边缘的计算服务器进行实时输电线分析的优势。我们将我们的解决方案与最先进的多区域云部署进行了对比，并讨论了移动边缘计算（MEC）的优势。我们的真实评估表明，与云区域相比，MEC实现了44.62毫秒的低延迟；然而，这一差距正在缩小。虽然这种低延迟可以使实际部署受益，但它们仍然不足以满足智能电网运行的严苛要求（约8毫秒）。
tldr: 本文评估了5G-MEC在输电线预测中的真实延迟，虽测得44.62 ms的低延迟（优于云端），但仍无法满足智能电网约8 ms的严苛要求。
ai_comments: 本研究通过真实的5G-MEC实验环境，对输电线温度预测这一具体场景进行了延迟和成本权衡评估，具有很强的实用价值。其重要性在于揭示了虽然MEC能显著降低延迟（至44.62 ms），但与智能电网极其苛刻的实时控制需求（~8 ms）相比仍有较大差距，这为未来5G边缘计算在重工业和电力领域的优化方向提供了清晰的现实依据。局限性在于摘要中未详细说明成本权衡的具体量化数据。
motivation: 户外物联网应用（如智能电网）需要实时数据处理和高响应能力。虽然5G和移动边缘计算（MEC）的结合有望提供低延迟和云计算的便利性，但需要通过真实世界的评估来探究MEC与传统云部署在延迟和成本方面的实际权衡。
method: 在5G蜂窝网络上搭建了一个实验性MEC系统，并实现了一个用于实时输电线分析的概念验证方案。通过将该边缘计算方案与最先进的多区域云部署进行对比，来评估其在真实世界中的延迟性能。
results: 实测评估显示，MEC实现了44.62 ms的低延迟，表现优于多区域云部署，但MEC与云之间的延迟差距正在缩小。
conclusion: 虽然5G与MEC的结合能提供低至44.62 ms的延迟，有利于实际物联网部署，但这一延迟水平仍无法满足智能电网运行约8 ms的严苛实时性要求。

title: Finite Observations, Infinite Behaviour: bicategorical semantics for stateful monoidal processes
authors: Cole Comfort, Giovanni de Felice
abstract: Time-dependent processes are often described by machines with an internal state which is updated as time evolves. An external observer cannot see this state and learns about a process only through finite observations of its inputs and outputs, each of which imposes a constraint on the trajectories the process can exhibit. We introduce a semantic construction in which two stateful processes have the same behaviour when they have the same constraints, as determined by finite observations, independent of their internal state. The construction is defined over any preorder-enriched monoidal category with a compatible notion of discarding, which we call a discard bicategory, capturing partial, non-deterministic, probabilistic, and quantum processes. The resulting category of behaviours provides a functorial semantics for free feedback categories in the sense of Katis, Sabadini, and Walters. For non-deterministic systems, we prove a categorified compactness theorem: every compatible family of finite observations between compact Hausdorff spaces extends uniquely and functorially to an infinite closed relation. Restricted to affine relations over finite fields, the compactness theorem recovers Willems' notion of behaviour for linear time-invariant systems.

title: Full Glyph Images Beat Token Embeddings: A Controlled Study for Transformers
authors: Shuyang Xiang, Hao Guan
abstract: Modern language models generally represent text as sequences of discrete token embeddings, an assumption deeply rooted in current practice but rarely questioned. We challenge this representation, especially for Chinese, by replacing index-based token embeddings entirely with a single rasterized image of the character sequence, processed by a vision encoder composed of a shared ResNet and a shallow Vision Transformer. To isolate the role of input representation, we construct a dual-branch controlled framework in which both a Vision-based model and an index-based baseline share an identical decoder backbone, training objective, optimizer, and data curriculum. Any performance difference is therefore attributable to the input modality only. Across all tested decoder backbones, the Vision-based model consistently outperforms the baseline, reaching a peak accuracy of 0.429 versus 0.355 for the index-based baseline,that is, a 21% relative improvement, while converging in about half the number of training epochs. The advantage emerges especially within the first five epochs (under 21% of total data) and persists under moderate character corruption: the corrupted Vision model matches the clean index-based baseline. Ablation studies reveal that the advantage requires both spatially coherent input and a ViT encoder with 2D positional encodings. A cross-script comparison on English shows the advantage does not transfer directly to alphabetic writing systems, suggesting that the uniform visual density and radical structure of Chinese characters are enabling conditions. These findings suggest that transformers are more modality-agnostic than commonly assumed, and that discrete tokenization is not a fundamental requirement for Chinese language modeling.
zh_title: 全字符图像优于Token嵌入：Transformer的受控研究
translation: 现代语言模型通常将文本表示为离散的Token嵌入序列，这一假设在当前实践中根深蒂固，但很少受到质疑。我们挑战了这种表示方法，特别是在中文场景下，通过将基于索引的Token嵌入完全替换为字符序列的单一栅格图像，并使用由共享ResNet和浅层Vision Transformer组成的视觉编码器进行处理。为了隔离输入表示的作用，我们构建了一个双分支受控框架，其中视觉模型和基于索引的基线模型共享相同的解码器主干、训练目标、优化器和数据课程。因此，任何性能差异仅归因于输入模态。在所有测试的解码器主干中，基于视觉的模型始终优于基线模型，最高准确率达到0.429，而基于索引的基线模型为0.355，即相对提升了21%，且训练轮数缩短了一半。这种优势在最初的五个周期（少于总数据的21%）内尤为明显，并且在中度字符损坏下仍然持续：受损的视觉模型表现与干净的基于索引的基线模型相当。消融研究表明，这种优势需要空间连贯的输入和具有2D位置编码的ViT编码器。对英语的跨脚本比较表明，这种优势不能直接转移到字母书写系统，这表明中文的统一视觉密度和偏旁部首结构是实现这一优势的条件。这些发现表明，Transformer比通常假设的更具模态无关性，离散标记化并不是中文语言建模的基本要求。
tldr: 该研究证明对于中文语言模型，直接使用字符图像作为输入比传统的离散Token嵌入更高效、更准确，且收敛速度更快。
ai_comments: 该研究挑战了语言模型必须依赖离散Token嵌入的传统假设，特别针对中文提出了全字符图像输入方案。其创新在于通过受控实验证明了对于中文这类具有特定视觉结构的语言，视觉表征优于Token表征。这为多模态模型设计和中文NLP提供了一个全新的视角，虽然该方法在英语等字母语言上效果有限，但揭示了Transformer在处理不同输入模态时的灵活性。
motivation: 现代语言模型默认使用离散Token嵌入，作者质疑这种做法在处理中文时的有效性，并试图探讨直接使用字符序列的图像表征是否能带来更好的性能。
method: 构建了一个双分支受控框架，将基于视觉的编码器（ResNet+轻量级ViT）与基于索引的基线模型进行对比，两者共享相同的解码器、目标函数和训练数据，通过对比两者的性能差异来评估输入模态的影响。
results: 视觉模型在所有测试中均优于基线模型，准确率从0.355提升至0.429（提升21%），训练收敛速度快约50%，且在字符损坏情况下仍具有较强的鲁棒性；该优势在英语等字母语言中未观察到。
conclusion: 对于中文语言模型而言，全字符图像输入优于传统的离散Token嵌入，证明了Transformer并不完全依赖于离散化处理，且视觉输入能显著提升训练效率和鲁棒性。

title: "AI Slop is DDoSing Open Source": Understanding the Impact of AI-Generated Contributions on Open Source Sustainability
authors: Sadia Afroz, Courtney Miller, Tyler Menezes, Edward Gilmour, Anita Sarma, Zixuan Feng
abstract: Open source software (OSS) communities are facing increasing pressure from Generative AI (GenAI) tools. We call it AI-DDoS: a denial-of-service effect in which plausible but low-quality AI-generated contributions overwhelm OSS community capacity. Using a phenomenon-based mixed-methods approach, we first analyze practitioner accounts from Reddit, OSS mentor mailing lists, and blogs to identify six recurring themes and derive hypotheses. We then evaluate these hypotheses using Bayesian Structural Time Series analysis across 294 repositories with over 2 million pull requests and issues. Our results show that while PR volume increased in 2025, merge rates declined, with one-time contributors experiencing an 18.18% drop in PR merge rates relative to the counterfactual. Finally, we identify 11 remediation strategies through practitioners' interviews and validate them with a survey of 229 OSS practitioners, grouping them into preservative, adaptive, and transformative orientations. Our findings show that AI-DDoS is not only a contribution-volume problem but a sustainability trap: communities often default to low-effort defensive strategies that protect short-term review capacity while making openness difficult to sustain.
zh_title: “AI垃圾内容正在对开源进行DDoS攻击”：理解AI生成内容对开源可持续性的影响
translation: 开源软件（OSS）社区正面临来自生成式AI（GenAI）工具的日益增长的压力。我们将其称为AI-DDoS：这是一种拒绝服务效应，即看似合理但低质量的AI生成贡献淹没了OSS社区的承载能力。通过现象学混合研究方法，我们首先分析了来自Reddit、OSS导师邮件列表和博客的从业者叙述，以确定六个反复出现的主题并推导出假设。然后，我们使用贝叶斯结构时间序列分析，对涵盖超过200万个拉取请求和问题的294个存储库评估了这些假设。我们的结果显示，虽然2025年PR数量有所增加，但合并率却有所下降，一次性贡献者的PR合并率相对于反事实模型下降了18.18%。最后，我们通过从业者访谈确定了11种补救策略，并通过对229名OSS从业者的调查进行了验证，将其分为防御性、适应性和转型性三个导向。我们的研究结果表明，AI-DDoS不仅是一个贡献量的问题，更是一个可持续性陷阱：社区往往默认采取低努力的防御策略，这些策略虽然保护了短期的审查能力，却使开放性难以维持。
tldr: AI生成的低质量开源贡献正导致“AI-DDoS”效应，即维护者被海量请求淹没，导致合并率下降，并迫使社区陷入损害长期开放性的防御陷阱。
ai_comments: 该研究通过实证分析揭示了生成式AI对开源生态的深层负面影响，即“AI-DDoS”效应。其创新之处在于将开源维护者的工作量饱和问题定义为一种类似DDoS攻击的社会技术现象，并不仅停留在现象描述，还通过贝叶斯时间序列分析提供了量化证据，最后提出了分类的缓解策略，对理解AI时代开源可持续性具有重要参考价值。
motivation: 旨在探讨生成式AI工具产生的看似合理但低质量的贡献（AI-DDoS）如何压垮开源社区的维护能力，并评估这种现象对开源项目可持续性的影响。
method: 采用现象学混合研究方法：首先通过Reddit、邮件列表和博客分析提炼出六个主题；其次利用贝叶斯结构时间序列分析（BSTS）对294个仓库的200多万个PR和Issue进行实证评估；最后通过访谈和229名从业者的问卷调查验证了11种缓解策略。
results: 研究发现，2025年PR数量激增但合并率下降；一次性贡献者的PR合并率较反事实模型下降了18.18%。此外，社区倾向于采用短期防御策略，这反而加剧了长期开放性维持的难度。
conclusion: AI-DDoS不仅仅是贡献数量的增长，更是一个可持续性陷阱。社区若仅采取低效的防御策略，虽然能在短期内维持评审能力，但长期来看会损害开源项目的开放性和生态健康。

title: Directional Curvature from Armijo Backtracking: A Low-Cost Sharpness Probe and a Calibration-Free Learning-Rate Safeguard for Adam
authors: Ashmitha R, Jörg Frochte
abstract: The local sharpness of the loss, the top Hessian eigenvalue $λ_1$, determines the largest stable gradient step, but measuring it normally requires Lanczos or Hessian-vector iterations. We observe that a single Armijo backtracking line search already carries this information at the cost of a few forward passes: the accepted step $α$ brackets the \emph{directional} curvature $q = g^\top H g/\|g\|^2$ within the multiplicative band set by the backtracking factor. Across CIFAR-10, Fashion-MNIST and Imagenette, $\logα$ tracks $\logλ_1$ at Pearson $-0.91$ to $-0.95$, giving a low-cost online Edge-of-Stability reading. Used once at initialisation, this measurement yields a learning-rate cap (a safeguard, not a faster optimiser) that makes Adam robust to a too-large initial learning rate across more than three orders of magnitude ($10^{-3}$ to $3.0$), at about one percent overhead, and it is a no-op when the chosen rate is already safe. One probe is enough: periodic in-training probing adds no robust benefit. The raw-gradient probe exposes the mechanism but needs a safety factor calibrated to the architecture by a one-minute divergence sweep. Probing along Adam's own update direction removes this calibration: a single fixed safety factor $κ= 2$ avoids divergence on all nine architectures we test and across the full learning-rate grids of all four benchmarks, and the recipe transfers to AdamW unchanged.
zh_title: 基于 Armijo 回溯的定向曲率：一种低成本的锐度探测器及 Adam 的免校准学习率保护机制
translation: 损失函数的局部锐度，即 Hessian 矩阵的最大特征值 λ1，决定了最大的稳定梯度步长，但通常需要通过 Lanczos 或 Hessian-向量乘积迭代来测量。我们观察到，单次 Armijo 回溯线搜索仅需几次前向传播即可携带此信息：接受的步长 α 将定向曲率 q = gᵀHg/||g||² 限制在回溯因子设定的乘法带内。在 CIFAR-10、Fashion-MNIST 和 Imagenette 上的实验表明，log α 与 log λ1 的 Pearson 相关系数在 -0.91 到 -0.95 之间，从而提供了一种低成本的在线“稳定边缘”（Edge-of-Stability）读数。在初始化时使用一次该测量，即可获得一个学习率上限（作为一种保护机制，而非加速优化器），使 Adam 在超过三个数量级（10⁻³ 到 3.0）的过大初始学习率下仍保持鲁棒，且开销仅约 1%，当选择的学习率已足够安全时，该机制不产生任何影响。一次探测足矣：训练期间的周期性探测并无额外鲁棒性收益。原始梯度探测揭示了其机制，但需要通过一分钟的发散扫描来针对架构校准安全因子。沿着 Adam 的更新方向进行探测消除了这种校准需求：一个固定的安全因子 κ = 2 即可在测试的所有九种架构以及四个基准测试的所有学习率网格上避免发散，且该配方可直接应用于 AdamW。
tldr: 本文提出了一种利用 Armijo 回溯线搜索来低成本获取局部曲率信息的方法，并将其转化为一种通用的 Adam 学习率保护机制，显著提升了训练稳定性。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于巧妙地利用了训练过程中已有的 Armijo 回溯线搜索操作，实现了对损失函数局部曲率的低成本估计，从而为 Adam 优化器提供了一个免调参的稳定保护机制。这种方法极大地降低了计算开销，并显著增强了 Adam 对大初始学习率的鲁棒性，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 测量损失函数的局部锐度（即 Hessian 矩阵最大特征值）通常计算成本高昂，而该值对于确定稳定的梯度下降步长至关重要，因此需要一种低成本的探测方法。
method: 通过单次 Armijo 回溯线搜索获取步长 α，将其作为局部曲率（Hessian 最大特征值）的代理，并利用此信息为 Adam 设定一个自动的学习率上限，从而防止因学习率过大导致的训练发散。
results: 实验表明，log α 与 log λ1 存在极强的负相关性（Pearson 相关系数 -0.91 至 -0.95）。使用该机制后，Adam 在学习率跨越三个数量级的情况下仍能保持稳定，且仅增加约 1% 的计算开销，无需针对特定架构进行校准。
conclusion: 通过 Armijo 回溯线搜索得到的步长可以作为局部曲率的有效代理，基于此设计的学习率保护机制能够以极低的开销显著提升 Adam 优化器的稳定性，且无需针对不同架构进行繁琐的超参数校准。

title: Separating Representation from Reconstruction Enables Scalable Text Encoders
authors: Megi Dervishi, Mathurin Videau, Yann LeCun
abstract: While decoders have rapidly scaled, encoders have remained largely unchanged since BERT. We revisit this disparity by frozen backbone evaluation via probing. Under this lens, the representations of BERT encoders become increasingly $\textit{unexploitable}$ by frozen probes, despite improved perplexity. The misalignment originates in BERT's flat design, which couples representation learning to the token reconstruction loss. We propose $\textbf{CrossBERT}$, a two-part architecture that separates the learning of high-quality encoded representations from the rigid grounding of token reconstruction. This design further enables high masking ratios ($\ge 50\%$) and gradient collection over all tokens via a $\textit{Complementary Masking Strategy}$, respectively increasing throughput by $1.5$ to $2\times$ and sample efficiency by $2\times$. Overall, CrossBERT demonstrates monotonic scaling and superior performance on MTEB(eng, v2) and frozen GLUE benchmarks.
zh_title: 将表示与重建分离可实现可扩展的文本编码器
translation: 尽管解码器的规模已迅速扩大，但编码器自BERT以来基本保持不变。我们通过冻结主干的探测评估重新审视了这种差异。在这种视角下，尽管困惑度有所提高，但BERT编码器的表示却越来越难以被冻结的探测器所利用。这种错位源于BERT的扁平化设计，它将表示学习与令牌重建损失耦合在一起。我们提出了CrossBERT，这是一种两部分架构，将高质量编码表示的学习与令牌重建的严格基础分离开来。这种设计进一步实现了高掩码率（≥50%）以及通过互补掩码策略对所有令牌进行梯度收集，分别将吞吐量提高了1.5到2倍，样本效率提高了2倍。总的来说，CrossBERT在MTEB(eng, v2)和冻结GLUE基准测试中展示了单调的缩放和卓越的性能。
tldr: CrossBERT通过解耦表示学习与重建任务，并采用互补掩码策略，大幅提升了文本编码器的扩展性、训练吞吐量和样本效率。
ai_comments: 该论文针对BERT类编码器在扩展性上的瓶颈提出了深刻见解，通过解耦表示学习与重建任务，为大规模编码器训练提供了新的范式。其创新点在于通过跨架构设计和互补掩码策略，解决了表示质量随模型规模增加而下降的问题，在效率和性能上均有显著提升。
motivation: BERT类编码器的表示能力随模型规模增加而退化，且其扁平化设计将表示学习与令牌重建损失强耦合，限制了扩展性。
method: 提出CrossBERT双部分架构，将表示学习与令牌重建任务解耦；采用互补掩码策略（Complementary Masking Strategy），支持高掩码率（≥50%）并对所有令牌进行梯度收集。
results: CrossBERT实现了单调的性能扩展，训练吞吐量提升1.5至2倍，样本效率提升2倍，并在MTEB和冻结GLUE基准测试中表现卓越。
conclusion: CrossBERT通过架构解耦和更高效的掩码策略，成功克服了传统BERT架构的扩展瓶颈，实现了单调的性能提升和更高的训练效率。

title: Explainable AI for Screening Abuse-Related Trauma in Bangladeshi Children: A Training-Free Multimodal Framework Evaluated on Noise-Aware Synthetic Data
authors: Salma Hoque Talukdar Koli, Fahima Haque Talukder Jely
abstract: Bangladesh has an estimated 1.17 mental-health professionals per 100,000 population and only six child psychiatrists nationwide. No Bengali-language, culturally adapted tool exists for early screening of abuse-related psychological trauma in children. We present ShishuRaksha AI, a decision-support (not diagnostic) framework that fuses four screening modalities: validated questionnaires (SDQ, CPSS), Bengali narrative text, House-Tree-Person (HTP) drawing features, and facial affect. The fusion is training-free and clinically weighted, uses cross-modal attention, and includes a single-modality override rule. Every risk score is explained through clinically weighted, perturbation-based additive attribution and rendered as a bilingual (Bangla/English) report with referral routing to national child-protection services (OCC, DSS, NMHH) under the Children Act 2013. No clinical dataset of abused children can be collected ethically at this stage, so we introduce a noise-aware synthetic benchmark (500 cases, 116 positive [23.2%], four deliberate noise layers, literature-grounded HTP priors) and evaluate tree-ensemble surrogates of the fusion design (facial channel excluded) under 5-fold stratified cross-validation. The fused model reaches an AUC of 0.874 [0.834-0.908], against 0.756 [0.705-0.803] for an SDQ-only baseline, with ablation, operating-point, subgroup, and calibration analyses. We state all limitations openly, including synthetic-only data, no held-out set, text-feature circularity, and an urban-rural subgroup gap. This work is a feasibility study and a design contribution toward ethically deployable child-protection screening in low-resource settings.
zh_title: 面向孟加拉国儿童虐待创伤筛查的可解释人工智能：一种基于噪声感知合成数据评估的无训练多模态框架
translation: 孟加拉国每10万人中仅有约1.17名心理健康专业人员，全国仅有6名儿童精神科医生。目前尚无针对儿童虐待相关心理创伤早期筛查的、经文化适应的孟加拉语工具。我们提出了ShishuRaksha AI，这是一个决策支持（而非诊断）框架，融合了四种筛查模态：验证问卷（SDQ, CPSS）、孟加拉语叙述文本、房-树-人（HTP）绘画特征以及面部情感。该融合过程无需训练且基于临床加权，利用了交叉模态注意力机制，并包含单模态覆盖规则。每个风险评分均通过临床加权、基于扰动的加性归因进行解释，并生成双语（孟加拉语/英语）报告，根据《2013年儿童法案》将其转介至国家儿童保护服务机构（OCC, DSS, NMHH）。鉴于目前无法合乎道德地收集受虐儿童的临床数据集，我们引入了一个噪声感知合成基准（500个案例，116个阳性 [23.2%]，包含四层有意加入的噪声，以及基于文献的HTP先验），并在5折分层交叉验证下评估了融合设计的树集成代理模型（排除了面部通道）。融合模型达到了0.874 [0.834-0.908] 的AUC，而仅使用SDQ的基线模型为0.756 [0.705-0.803]，并进行了消融、工作点、子组和校准分析。我们公开说明了所有局限性，包括仅使用合成数据、缺乏留出集、文本特征循环性以及城乡子组差距。本工作是一项可行性研究，也是为资源受限环境下可合乎道德部署的儿童保护筛查所做出的设计贡献。
tldr: 提出ShishuRaksha AI框架，通过融合多模态数据为孟加拉国儿童提供可解释的虐待创伤筛查支持，并在合成数据上证明了其优于传统问卷的筛查潜力。
ai_comments: 该研究通过创新的无训练（training-free）多模态融合框架解决了孟加拉国儿童虐待筛查资源匮乏的问题。其最大的亮点在于利用合成数据进行可行性验证，并引入了临床可解释性机制，为资源受限地区的医疗AI落地提供了重要的设计范式。然而，由于完全依赖合成数据，其实际临床表现仍需进一步验证。
motivation: 孟加拉国严重缺乏心理健康专家，且目前尚无针对当地儿童虐待心理创伤的文化适应性筛查工具，亟需一种可行、可解释的决策支持方案。
method: 提出ShishuRaksha AI框架，融合问卷、孟加拉语叙述文本、HTP绘画特征及面部情感四种模态；采用无训练（training-free）、临床加权及交叉模态注意力机制；通过扰动归因技术提供可解释性；使用带有噪声的合成数据进行基准测试与评估。
results: 该模型在合成数据集上表现优异，AUC达到0.874，显著高于仅使用问卷（SDQ）的基线模型（0.756）。
conclusion: ShishuRaksha AI 为资源受限地区的儿童虐待筛查提供了一个可行且可解释的初步框架，虽然目前仅限于合成数据验证，但证明了多模态融合在提升筛查准确性方面的潜力。

title: Candidate-Constrained Retrieval-Augmented Generation for LongEval-RAG: System Design and Empirical Analysis
authors: Yingdong Yang, Haijian Wu
abstract: We present a candidate-constrained retrieval-augmented generation system for LongEval-RAG, where each query is associated with an organizer-provided candidate set and all retrieved evidence and final citations must remain within that set. The system combines deterministic provenance tracking with passage-based retrieval, deterministic query expansion, pseudo-relevance feedback (PRF), reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), lightweight evidence reranking, citation-aware evidence aggregation, and optional MiniLM sentence reranking. We evaluate ten pipeline variants using a primary organizer evaluation and a supplementary self-generated diagnostic protocol. The primary evaluation shows that the strongest balanced variant is rule-minilm: a rule-based chunking pipeline with query expansion, PRF, RRF, reranking, citation prior, and late MiniLM sentence selection. This variant obtains the highest BERTScore, retrieval precision, nugget coverage, and average grade among our submissions. The result suggests that the main gain does not come from more complex semantic or topic-shift chunking, but from pairing stable rule-based evidence units with sentence-level neural selection before generation. The supplementary LLM-judge evaluation remains useful for early diagnosis and additional analysis, but it emphasizes different systems than the primary gold-answer and nugget-based evaluation, highlighting the need for multi-metric RAG evaluation.
zh_title: 面向LongEval-RAG的候选集约束检索增强生成：系统设计与实证分析
translation: 我们提出了一种面向LongEval-RAG的候选集约束检索增强生成系统，其中每个查询都关联一个由组织者提供的候选集，所有检索到的证据和最终引用必须保留在该集合内。该系统结合了确定性溯源追踪与基于段落的检索、确定性查询扩展、伪相关反馈（PRF）、倒数排名融合（RRF）、轻量级证据重排序、引用感知证据聚合以及可选的MiniLM句子重排序。我们通过主要的组织者评估和补充的自生成诊断协议评估了十种管道变体。主要评估表明，最强的平衡变体是rule-minilm：一种包含查询扩展、PRF、RRF、重排序、引用先验和后期MiniLM句子选择的基于规则的分块管道。该变体在我们的提交中获得了最高的BERTScore、检索精度、信息点覆盖率和平均评分。结果表明，主要的收益并非来自更复杂的语义或主题转移分块，而是来自在生成前将稳定的规则驱动证据单元与句子级神经选择配对。补充的LLM-judge评估在早期诊断和额外分析中仍然有用，但它强调的系统与主要基于金标准答案和信息点的评估不同，凸显了多指标RAG评估的必要性。
tldr: 通过限制检索范围至特定候选集，研究发现规则驱动的分块与句子级神经选择的组合是提升长文档RAG效果的最佳方案。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地引入了候选集约束机制，有效解决了长文档RAG场景下的溯源与引用准确性问题。其核心洞察在于，对于特定任务，规则驱动的稳定证据单元结合句子级神经重排序，往往比复杂的语义分块更能带来性能提升。该研究强调了多指标评估在RAG系统开发中的重要性。
motivation: 为了应对LongEval-RAG任务中要求所有检索证据和引用必须严格位于组织者提供的候选集内的挑战。
method: 构建了一个结合确定性溯源追踪、基于段落的检索、确定性查询扩展、伪相关反馈（PRF）、倒数排名融合（RRF）、轻量级证据重排序、引用感知证据聚合以及MiniLM句子重排序的系统，并测试了十种管道变体。
results: 名为“rule-minilm”的变体表现最优，在BERTScore、检索精度、信息点覆盖率和平均评分上均达到最高，证明了规则驱动证据单位与句子级神经选择结合的有效性。
conclusion: 在候选集约束的RAG场景中，基于规则的分块配合句子级神经选择是实现最优性能的关键，且多指标评估对于全面诊断RAG系统至关重要。

title: Finite Reliability Representations: Noise-Calibrated Belief-Space Covers for Reliable Decision-Making
authors: Hyung-Jin Yoon, Hunmin Kim
abstract: Physical sensing and actuation noise floors should inform how much belief resolution a decision-making system can reliably use. We introduce Finite Reliability Representations (FRR), a framework for covering belief spaces by reliability cells: regions within which the optimal action-value function Q*(b,u) varies by at most a tolerance epsilon, uniformly over actions. The framework is formulated on beliefs rather than states and uses a cover rather than an equivalence quotient, because approximate decision-closeness is not transitive in general. A central technical point is that noisy Bayesian updates should not be treated as globally contractive on arbitrary beliefs. We therefore separate three objects: the fixed-observation filter map, the predictive observation law, and the controlled belief-transition kernel. For nonlinear continuous-state systems, FRR is obtained under a reachable-set Lipschitz modulus for the belief-transition kernel. For finite-state POMDPs, the same construction becomes exact on the belief simplex: prediction is linear, Bayesian correction is a normalized positive linear map, sensor noise enters through observation-distribution distinguishability, and actuation uncertainty enters through an action-execution channel. Under the corresponding action-value Lipschitz condition, an FRR cover supports a cell-constant policy whose suboptimality is bounded by 2 epsilon/(1 - gamma). We also introduce reliability entropy, the logarithm of the minimal number of reliability cells, as a measure of certified decision-relevant belief complexity. The framework distinguishes representation sufficiency from fundamental performance floors imposed by sensing, process, and actuation noise. It applies to finite POMDPs, linear-Gaussian filters, locally linearized nonlinear filters, and particle-filter implementations through analytic or empirical certification of reliability cells.
comment: 25 pages. Introduces Finite Reliability Representations for noise-calibrated belief-space covers and policy sufficiency

title: When Does Small Data Work? Accuracy and Efficiency Trade-offs Between Tabular Foundation Models and Conventional Methods for Crowd-State Classification at Hajj and Umrah
authors: AlJawharh S. AlOtaibi, Mohamed Eltahir, Jude AlSubaie
abstract: Learning from few labeled examples is a central challenge in tabular machine learning, and it becomes the binding constraint in domains where labeling is costly, such as crowd monitoring during Hajj and Umrah. Tabular foundation models, which predict from only a handful of examples without task-specific training, were recently introduced to address this very-few-label regime. In this study we test them on crowd-state classification to assess how much they help when labels are scarce, and we compare them against standard machine learning methods to characterize the accuracy and efficiency trade-offs between the two approaches. Using three real datasets we evaluate different machine learning models, in untuned and tuned forms, against three foundation models. Results show that no single family is best everywhere. The right choice depends on the label budget. When labels are very few, foundation models lead. As labels grow, tuned conventional models catch up and significantly surpass the foundation models on the more structural geometry target. Efficiency separates them further where tuned machine learning models incur a large tuning cost that foundation models avoid, although foundation models reprocess their context at every prediction. We summarize these results as a practical map of which approach to prefer under a given label budget and computational budget.
zh_title: 小数据何时奏效？朝觐期间人群状态分类任务中表格基础模型与传统方法的准确性及效率权衡
translation: 从少量标记示例中学习是表格机器学习中的一个核心挑战，在标记成本高昂的领域（如朝觐期间的人群监控）中，这成为了限制性因素。表格基础模型被引入以解决这种极少标签的情况，它无需特定任务训练即可从少量示例中进行预测。在本研究中，我们在人群状态分类任务上测试了这些模型，以评估它们在标签稀缺时的帮助程度，并对比了它们与标准机器学习方法的准确性和效率权衡。通过使用三个真实数据集，我们评估了不同机器学习模型（包括调优和未调优版本）与三种基础模型的性能。结果表明，没有单一的模型系列在所有情况下都是最好的。正确的选择取决于标签预算。当标签非常少时，基础模型处于领先地位。随着标签数量的增加，调优后的传统模型会赶上，并在更具结构几何特征的目标上显著超过基础模型。效率进一步区分了它们：调优后的机器学习模型会产生巨大的调优成本，而基础模型则避免了这一点，尽管基础模型在每次预测时都需要重新处理其上下文。我们将这些结果总结为一张实用图谱，以指导在给定的标签预算和计算预算下应优先选择哪种方法。
tldr: 在标签极少时表格基础模型更优，但随着标签增加，调优后的传统机器学习方法在准确性上会反超。
ai_comments: 该研究为在标签稀缺环境下选择合适的表格数据处理模型提供了实用的决策指南，特别是在大规模人群监控等对标注成本敏感的领域具有重要应用价值。其核心创新在于对基础模型与传统模型在不同标签预算下的性能权衡进行了量化对比。
motivation: 在标签获取成本高昂的领域（如朝觐期间的人群监控），如何利用少量标注数据进行高效分类是一个核心挑战，研究旨在评估表格基础模型在这一场景下的有效性及与传统方法的权衡。
method: 在三个真实数据集上，对比了三种表格基础模型与多种常规机器学习方法（包含调优与未调优版本），并评估了它们在不同标签预算下的准确率和计算效率。
results: 实验表明，标签数量决定了最优选择：标签极少时基础模型领先；标签增加时，调优后的传统模型表现更好，尤其是在结构化几何目标上。效率方面，基础模型避免了调优成本，但每次预测均需重处理上下文。
conclusion: 没有单一模型在所有场景下均最优。基础模型在极少标签下表现优异，而传统模型在标签充足时在准确性和结构化任务上更具优势，且需权衡训练调优成本与推理效率。

title: SAGE: Synchronized Action-Gaze Recognition and Anticipation for Human Behavior Understanding
authors: Chenyi Kuang, Nakul Agarwal
abstract: Human object interaction (HOI), gaze pattern, and their anticipation are intricately linked, providing valuable insights into cognitive processes, intentions, and behavior. However, most existing models handle gaze and actions separately, missing both their interdependence and the advantages of a unified solution. This paper presents a novel unified framework, SAGE (Synchronized Action-GazE), which integrates simultaneous recognition and anticipation of both HOI and human gaze into a single unified end-to-end trainable model. Our approach leverages a transformer-based architecture and incorporates gaze data into spatiotemporal attention mechanisms to simultaneously predict current and future human actions and gaze behavior. We explore this bidirectional relationship between gaze and actions under different scenarios, whether requiring a close-up, detailed view (egocentric) or a wider, more contextual view (exocentric), making our framework versatile for various applications. Additionally, due to lack of datasets for comprehensive analysis of both HOI and gaze in exocentric videos, we establish a new benchmark Exo-Cook to facilitate further research in this domain. Experiments on three benchmark datasets: VidHOI, EGTEA Gaze+, and Exo-Cook show that jointly modeling gaze and actions across current and future frames achieves consistently strong results, often surpassing specialized state-of-the-art models tailored to individual tasks. By unifying actions and attention in a comprehensive way, our work lays the groundwork for more intuitive human-machine interaction.
zh_title: SAGE：用于人类行为理解的同步动作-注视识别与预测系统
translation: 人-物交互（HOI）、注视模式及其预测是紧密相连的，为理解认知过程、意图和行为提供了宝贵的见解。然而，大多数现有模型将注视和动作分开处理，错过了它们的相互依赖性以及统一解决方案的优势。本文提出了一个新颖的统一框架SAGE（同步动作-注视），它将HOI和人类注视的同步识别与预测集成到一个单一的端到端可训练模型中。我们的方法利用基于Transformer的架构，并将注视数据纳入时空注意力机制，以同时预测当前和未来的人类动作及注视行为。我们探讨了注视与动作在不同场景下的双向关系，无论是需要特写细节（第一视角）还是更广泛的上下文（第三视角），使得我们的框架适用于各种应用。此外，由于缺乏用于全面分析外向视频中HOI和注视的数据集，我们建立了一个新的基准Exo-Cook以促进该领域的进一步研究。在VidHOI、EGTEA Gaze+和Exo-Cook三个基准数据集上的实验表明，联合建模当前和未来帧的注视与动作始终能获得强劲的结果，通常超过了针对单一任务的专门最先进模型。通过以综合方式统一动作和注意力，我们的工作为更直观的人机交互奠定了基础。
tldr: SAGE是一个统一的Transformer模型，通过同时建模动作与注视的关联关系，实现了对人类当前行为的识别及未来行为的准确预测。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一个统一的端到端框架，将人类动作（HOI）与注视行为（Gaze）建模为互补的关联任务，而非孤立处理。这种方法不仅提升了预测性能，还通过引入Exo-Cook数据集填补了外向视角（exocentric）下行为与注视联合分析的空白，具有很强的应用潜力。
motivation: 现有模型通常将注视模式与动作识别分开处理，忽略了两者之间深层的相互依存关系，限制了对人类认知过程和行为意图的全面理解。
method: 提出SAGE框架，采用基于Transformer的架构，将注视数据融入时空注意力机制，实现对人-物交互（HOI）和注视行为的同步识别与预测；同时构建了Exo-Cook基准数据集。
results: 在VidHOI、EGTEA Gaze+和Exo-Cook三个数据集上的实验表明，SAGE在当前及未来动作与注视的预测任务中表现优异，性能优于针对单一任务的现有最先进模型。
conclusion: SAGE框架成功证明了将动作识别与注视预测联合建模能显著提升对人类行为理解的准确性与前瞻性，为构建更直观的人机交互系统奠定了基础。

title: Patient-Conditioned Dual Hypergraph Reasoning for Auditable Traditional Chinese Medicine Prescription Support
authors: Weizhi Nie, Shaojin Bai, Weijie Wang, Yuting Su
abstract: Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) prescription support requires patient-specific reasoning from clinical narratives to syndromes, treatment principles, herbs, and doses. Direct language-model generation can produce fluent prescriptions, but its decisions are difficult to audit against explicit clinical evidence. Static TCM knowledge resources provide useful priors, but they cannot determine which diagnostic and prescription relations should be emphasized for an individual patient. We propose a patient-conditioned dual hypergraph framework for auditable TCM prescription support. The first hypergraph organizes symptom, tongue, pulse, and other clinical evidence around syndrome and treatment-principle reasoning. The second hypergraph organizes syndrome, treatment, disease-context, herb, retrieval, and dose-prior evidence for prescription construction. Unlike static knowledge graphs or fixed hypergraphs, both hypergraphs are dynamically weighted by the patient representation. This design enables individualized activation of diagnostic and prescription paths, supporting personalized syndrome differentiation and herb-dose recommendation while preserving case-level auditability. Experiments on TCM-SD show that dynamic weighting in the first hypergraph improves MacBERT syndrome differentiation to 0.8297 accuracy and 0.3288 macro-F1. On TCM-BEST4SDT, the second hypergraph achieves the best mean Herb-F1 of 0.3111 across three seeds, and the full connected pipeline reaches 0.3074 Herb-F1, close to the oracle setting. A 50-case real-world CAP audit further suggests practical review potential, while highlighting the need for prospective dose-safety validation.

title: A Unified Algebraic Framework for Classification Performance Evaluation
authors: Ronaldo C. Prati
abstract: We propose a unified algebraic framework for classification performance evaluation that encompasses binary, multiclass, multilabel, ordinal, hierarchical, cost-sensitive, and soft-label settings within a single formalism. The foundation is a representation of actual and predicted labels as binary indicator matrices, combined with three aggregation operators -- global, column-wise, and row-wise -- that correspond exactly to micro, macro/weighted, and exemplar averaging. Any binary performance measure expressed in terms of true/positive/negative counts extends automatically to all settings by substituting these operators, generating multiclass and multilabel versions without measure-specific derivations. The framework further accommodates soft classifier outputs via argmax or thresholding, soft ground truth via triangular norms, ordinal classification via membership functions or cumulative encodings, and cost-sensitive evaluation via a cost matrix that subsumes MAE and MSE as special cases. We establish several theoretical results: micro-averaging equals denominator-weighted macro-averaging; the product $t$-norm is the unique one preserving the confusion-matrix partition; skew-invariant measures are characterised as functions of recall and specificity; and micro-precision, micro-recall, and micro-$F_1$ are all equal to accuracy in multiclass settings. Empirical illustrations on synthetic and real data confirm the theoretical findings.

title: CrossHallu: Do Hallucination Signals Generalize Across Languages and Domains in Large Language Model's Internals?
authors: Aisha Alansari, Malak Alkhorasani, Hamzah Luqman
abstract: Recent hallucination detection techniques in large language models (LLMs) focus on directly extracting features from a model's internal representations and training a classifier on these features to detect hallucinations, demonstrating promising results. Notwithstanding this advancement, most internal-state hallucination detection techniques have been explored predominantly in English, raising the question of whether such internal signals generalize across different languages and domains. To address this gap, we present CrossHallu, the first study to evaluate the cross-lingual and cross-domain generalization of hallucination detection using internal representations from six LLMs on the generative question-answering task. We conduct a systematic Arabic <-> English evaluation using TruthfulQA, an Arabic translated version of TruthfulQA, and HalluScore. This evaluation encompasses monolingual training and testing, cross-lingual transfer, cross-domain transfer, and combined cross-lingual and cross-domain transfer. The results reveal that internal-state hallucination signals in LLMs transfer across languages and domains for most models, with cross-lingual performance highly dependent on both class separability and language alignment in the feature space, whereas cross-domain transfer within Arabic varies depending on the training and testing datasets used for the hallucination detector. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/aishaalansari57/CrossHal.
zh_title: CrossHallu：幻觉信号在大语言模型的内部表示中是否具有跨语言和跨领域的通用性？
translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）中近期的幻觉检测技术主要集中在直接从模型的内部表示中提取特征，并以此训练分类器来检测幻觉，取得了显著成果。尽管有此进展，但大多数内部状态幻觉检测技术主要是在英语中进行的，这引发了一个问题：这些内部信号是否在不同语言和领域之间具有通用性？为了填补这一空白，我们提出了CrossHallu，这是首个利用六种LLM的内部表示，在生成式问答任务中评估幻觉检测的跨语言和跨领域泛化能力的研究。我们使用TruthfulQA、TruthfulQA的阿拉伯语翻译版以及HalluScore进行了系统的阿拉伯语<->英语评估。该评估涵盖了单语训练与测试、跨语言迁移、跨领域迁移以及跨语言与跨领域的组合迁移。结果表明，大多数模型的内部状态幻觉信号可以在语言和领域之间迁移，其中跨语言性能高度依赖于特征空间中的类可分性和语言对齐，而阿拉伯语内部的跨领域迁移则取决于用于幻觉检测器的训练和测试数据集。代码已开源。
tldr: 研究表明大语言模型的内部幻觉检测信号通常可以跨语言和领域迁移，但其效果取决于特征空间的语言对齐和类可分性。
ai_comments: 该研究填补了内部状态幻觉检测在跨语言和跨领域通用性方面的空白。其创新点在于系统地评估了LLM内部表示的可迁移性，为开发更具通用性的幻觉检测器提供了重要见解，特别是揭示了特征空间中的类可分性和语言对齐对迁移性能的关键影响。
motivation: 现有的幻觉检测技术多集中在英语领域，尚不清楚这些基于内部状态的信号是否能够推广到其他语言和领域。因此，作者旨在评估这些信号在跨语言和跨领域场景下的泛化能力。
method: 提出了CrossHallu框架，利用六种大语言模型的内部表示，在生成式问答任务上进行了系统的跨语言（阿拉伯语<->英语）和跨领域评估。通过训练分类器并测试其在单语、跨语言、跨领域以及混合场景下的表现，分析了幻觉信号的通用性。
results: 大部分模型的内部幻觉信号能够跨语言和领域迁移。跨语言性能高度依赖于特征空间中的类可分性和语言对齐程度；而阿拉伯语内部的跨领域迁移效果则取决于训练和测试数据集的选择。
conclusion: 研究表明，大语言模型内部的幻觉信号具有一定的跨语言和跨领域通用性，但其迁移效果受特征空间中语言对齐程度和类可分性的显著影响。

title: Paired Uterine Whole-Slide Images and Pathology Reports for Multimodal Computational Pathology
authors: Han Li, Jingsong Liu, Ayako Ura, Junlin Hou, Zhengyang Xu, Azar Kazemi, Oskar Thaeter, Christian Grashei, Fabian Gülhan, Reza Nasirigerdeh, Xun Ma, Rui Yan, Hao Chen, S. Kevin Zhou, Nassir Navab, Carolin Mogler, Peter Schüffler
abstract: Uterine diseases represent an important category of gynecologic pathology and require accurate histopathological assessment for diagnosis and treatment planning. Whole-slide images (WSI) have enabled the digital transformation of pathology workflows and provided new opportunities for artificial intelligence (AI) in computational pathology. In particular, multimodal models that jointly analyze histopathology images and pathology reports have shown promising potential for automated pathology report generation and AI-assisted diagnosis. However, the development of such systems remains limited by the scarcity of datasets that pair whole-slide images with clinically meaningful pathology reports. Instead, existing pathology datasets focus on patch- or slide-level annotations of a single endpoint (e.g., disease class), which do not fully capture the rich information in full clinical diagnostic workflow reports. Here, we introduce TUM-Uteria, a uterine pathology dataset comprising WSIs paired with diagnostic pathology reports at both the case and slide levels, collected from a tertiary medical center. The dataset contains 216 clinical cases, comprising 455 slide-level WSI-report pairs. The dataset underwent a structured multi-stage validation procedure involving board-certified pathologists to ensure reliable annotations. TUM-Uteria supports research in computational pathology, including whole-slide image analysis, multimodal learning, and automated pathology report generation.
zh_title: 用于多模态计算病理学的配对子宫全切片图像与病理报告数据集
translation: 子宫疾病是妇科病理学的重要组成部分，需要准确的组织病理学评估来进行诊断和治疗规划。全切片图像（WSI）实现了病理工作流程的数字化转型，并为计算病理学中的人工智能（AI）提供了新的机会。特别是，联合分析组织病理学图像和病理报告的多模态模型在自动化病理报告生成和人工智能辅助诊断方面显示出巨大的潜力。然而，此类系统的开发受到缺乏配对全切片图像与临床意义病理报告的数据集的限制。现有的病理数据集主要关注单一终点（如疾病类别）的切片级或补丁级标注，无法完全捕捉完整临床诊断工作流报告中的丰富信息。在此，我们介绍了 TUM-Uteria，这是一个子宫病理数据集，包含从三级医疗中心收集的病例和切片级别的 WSI 与诊断病理报告配对。该数据集包含 216 个临床病例，涵盖 455 个切片级 WSI-报告配对。该数据集经过了由委员会认证的病理学家参与的多阶段结构化验证程序，以确保标注的可靠性。TUM-Uteria 支持计算病理学研究，包括全切片图像分析、多模态学习和自动化病理报告生成。
tldr: 本文发布了 TUM-Uteria 数据集，包含 455 对经过专家验证的子宫全切片图像与病理报告，旨在推动多模态病理 AI 模型的研究。
ai_comments: 该论文填补了计算病理学领域中高质量多模态（图像+报告）数据集的空白。其创新点在于提供了病例和切片两个层级的配对数据，并经过了病理学专家的结构化验证，为多模态学习和自动化报告生成提供了宝贵资源，克服了以往仅关注单一终点标注的局限性。
motivation: 现有的计算病理学研究多依赖于单一的标注任务，缺乏能够捕捉完整临床诊断工作流的、包含全切片图像与临床报告的多模态配对数据集，限制了多模态人工智能模型的发展。
method: 构建了名为 TUM-Uteria 的数据集，包含 216 个临床病例和 455 个切片级 WSI-报告配对，并由委员会认证的病理学家进行了多阶段结构化验证。
results: 成功发布了 TUM-Uteria 数据集，该数据集支持全切片图像分析、多模态学习以及自动化病理报告生成等多种研究任务。
conclusion: TUM-Uteria 数据集为子宫病理学领域的多模态计算研究提供了重要的基础数据，有助于推动自动化诊断和报告生成技术的发展。

title: Efficient Discovery of Conditional Dependencies with Desbordante
authors: Ivan Kozhukov, Dmitry Fedoseev, Maksim Emelyanov, Artem Smola, Pyotr Senichenkov, Pavel Anosov, George Chernishev
abstract:
Conditional functional dependencies (CFDs) are functional dependencies with a restricted scope: they specify the context in which a dependency holds and are useful for data-quality tasks, specifying complex integrity constraints, and extracting valuable insights from data.
  We study the CFD discovery problem, which is computationally demanding. We build on the state-of-the-art CFDFinder algorithm and introduce a set of algorithmic and engineering improvements, including a parallelization strategy, to produce ParCFDFinder. Our implementation is integrated into Desbordante - a high-performance open-source data profiler written in C++ that exposes a Python interface, enabling CFD discovery to be invoked from any Python program.
  Experimental results show that our enhancements speed up the algorithm by up to $318\times$ ($118\times$ on average) and reduce memory usage by up to $23\times$ ($14\times$ on average) compared with the existing Java-based implementation of Metanome. Integrating ParCFDFinder into Desbordante makes it possible, for the first time, to conveniently discover CFDs on datasets with hundreds of thousands of rows on a commodity machine within a reasonable time.

title: Data Structures for Private Token Transfers in TEE-Based Networks
authors: Blake Regalia, Benjamin Adams
abstract: Trusted execution environment (TEE) based confidential smart contract networks promise privacy but remain vulnerable to storage access pattern attacks that can link senders and recipients in token transfers. When contracts update recipient balances during transfers, the unique storage keys accessed reveal transaction relationships even when data is encrypted. This paper introduces two novel data structures to address this vulnerability: the Delayed Write Buffer (DWB) and the Bitwise-Trie of Bucketed Entries (BTBE). The DWB delays recipient balance updates by buffering pending transfers and randomly settling entries, breaking the direct correlation between transfer execution and recipient storage access. The BTBE further enhances privacy by grouping addresses into constant-sized buckets, preventing flooding attacks and creating anonymity sets for balance queries. Additionally, we present a private notification system enabling real-time, privacy-preserving push notifications for confidential contracts. Our domain-specific approach leverages the unique characteristics of token transfers -- asymmetric balance updates and tolerance for delayed settlement -- to achieve practical performance with probabilistic anonymity guarantees.

title: The "I Don't Know" Filter: Enhancing Agentic Reliability in Function Calling
authors: Stefan Broecker, Mason del Rosario, Boris Selitser, Thomas Strohmer
abstract: The language models that underpin agents have seen a rapid rise in performance on function calling benchmarks. However, the metrics used in the training and evaluation of these models often encourage models to make positive claims even when the answer is uncertain, leading to hallucinations. Such hallucinations can be disastrous when language models are trusted to use function calls to make decisions in high stakes applications. To that end, we propose an agent evaluation metric that takes into account the negative outcomes associated with incorrect function calls. Further, to catch hallucinations before they can cause harm, we propose a lightweight trainable filter that can quantify a language model's uncertainty and remove potentially harmful function calls. By training that filter to detect and suppress uncertain function calls without modifying the underlying model, we demonstrate a practical path toward agents that know when to say "I don't know," a property we argue is essential to production reliability.

title: TileLens: Efficiently Using Large-Granularity Memory Systems with Transparent Two-Dimensional Memory Layout
authors: Jae Hyung Ju, Euijun Chung, Hritvik Taneja, Anish Saxena, Shinnung Jeong, Hyesoon Kim, Moinuddin K. Qureshi
abstract:
Large Language Model (LLM) inference is bottlenecked by the capacity and bandwidth of GPU High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM). Recent proposals, such as High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) and RoMe, offer higher capacity or bandwidth than HBM, but require a minimum access granularity of kilobytes. We show that these Large-Granularity Memory Systems (LGMS) can degrade the performance of tiled matrix-multiplication, which is the dominant operation in LLM inference, by up to an order of magnitude. The root cause of the slowdown is read amplification, where memory requests fetch far more data than the tile actually needs. This waste stems from a fundamental mismatch between the two-dimensional nature of compute tiles and the one-dimensional memory layout, leading to each request spilling well beyond the tile boundaries.
  To mitigate read amplification, we propose to use tile-major layout for LGMS. Rather than storing data as a one-dimensional strip, tile-major layout reshapes each contiguous memory block into a two-dimensional rectangle, aligning memory granularity with tile boundaries. To ease the adoption of tile-major layout on GPUs, we propose TileLens, lightweight software and hardware extensions that collectively cover major classes of GPU kernels. TileLens-SW extends GPU DSLs so that DSL-based kernels can adopt tile-major in global memory by changing only the layout descriptor. TileLens-HW extends the Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) for transparent tile-major support in TMA-based kernels without code changes. We evaluate TileLens on a cycle-level simulator using matrix-multiplication kernels from Qwen-3 30B and Llama-3.1 70B. Combining a tile-major layout with an adaptive hardware prefetcher, TileLens achieves near-HBM performance on HBF-augmented GPUs with a 5us HBF NAND read latency, reducing the geomean slowdown from 1.61-6.49x with conventional layouts to within 1% of an HBM-only baseline.

title: OmniOpt: Taxonomy, Geometry, and Benchmarking of Modern Optimizers
authors: Siyuan Li, Jiabao Pan, Yumou Liu, Zhuoli Ouyang, Xin Jin, Xinglong Xu, Jingxuan Wei, Shengye Pang, Jintao Che, Xuanhe Zhou, Conghui He, Cheng Tan
abstract: Optimizer selection for large-scale model training has become a system-level design decision constrained jointly by compute, memory, tuning budget, and task diversity, yet the landscape of over one hundred methods remains fragmented. We therefore present OmniOpt, a unified survey and benchmark cookbook of optimizers for the research community. OmniOpt rests on four coupled components. First, we treat every optimizer update as a structured transformation through a five-stage meta-pipeline, and show that most methods engage only one or two of these stages. Second, we use norm-constrained linear minimization oracles (LMOs) to unify different optimizers. Third, these two views ground a dual-dimension taxonomy, one dimension assigning each method to a mechanism family and the other recording the measurable training objectives it aims to improve. Fourth, and at the core of this paper, we instantiate the full taxonomy in a unified cross-domain benchmark spanning representative optimizers, model scales, and training regimes from language model pretraining to image classification, systematically analyzing each method family across multiple effect objectives and laying out their trade-offs. OmniOpt thus supplies the research community with an operational coordinate system for selecting optimizers under explicit mechanism and objective assumptions, and charts a direction for the future development of the optimizer community.

title: Reward-Gated On-Policy Distillation
authors: Mohammad Sadegh Akhondzadeh, Vijay Lingam, Atula Tejaswi, Chanakya Ekbote, Sujay Sanghavi, Aleksandar Bojchevski
abstract: On-policy distillation is a powerful way to transfer reasoning ability from a strong teacher to a smaller student: the student samples trajectories from its own policy, and the teacher provides dense token-level supervision on the states the student actually visits. However, this supervision is not always reliable: a teacher can assign high likelihood to plausible but incorrect solutions, or low likelihood to correct student solutions that follow different reasoning paths. Unconditionally distilling the teacher can therefore reinforce bad modes or erase useful student behavior. To address these limitations, we introduce RG-OPD: Reward-Gated On-Policy Distillation that uses verifier feedback to decide when teacher logits should be trusted. RG-OPD bridges sparse verifier rewards and dense teacher logits, preserving token-level supervision while filtering misleading teacher signals. Across reasoning and coding benchmarks, RG-OPD produces stronger distilled students, outperforming both vanilla reverse-KL distillation and the recent TSD-KD baseline. At 1K generation length, RG-OPD improves over reverse-KL by 2.9 points and over TSD-KD by 4.9 points; in the long-generation setting, it improves over the untuned student by 8.2 points. Our code is available at https://github.com/UoC-tail/RG-OPD.

title: An Exploratory Study of Malicious Link Posting on Social Media Applications
authors: Muhammad Hassan, Mahnoor Jameel, Masooda Bashir
abstract: Social network platforms are now widely used as a mode of communication globally due to their popularity and their ease of use. Among the various content-sharing capabilities made available via these applications, link-sharing is a common activity among social media users. While this feature provides a desired functionality for the platform users, link sharing enables attackers to exploit vulnerabilities and compromise users' devices. Attackers can exploit this content-sharing feature by posting malicious/harmful URLs or deceptive posts and messages which are intended to hide a dangerous link. However, it is not clear how the most common social media applications monitor and/or filter when their users share malicious URLs or links through their platforms. To investigate this security vulnerability, we designed an exploratory study to examine the top five android social media applications' performance when it comes to malicious link sharing. The aim was to determine if the selected applications had any filtering or defenses against malicious URL sharing. Our results show that most of the selected social media applications did not have an effective defense against the posting and spreading of malicious URLs. While our results are exploratory, we believe our study demonstrates the presence of a vital security vulnerability that malicious attackers or unaware users can use to spread harmful links. In addition, our findings can be used to improve our understanding of link-based attacks as well as the design of security measures that usability into account.

title: SOGRAND decoding of LDPC codes
authors: Ken R. Duffy, Jiewei Feng, Lukas Rapp, Muriel Médard
abstract: Long forward error correction codes are typically constructed by concatenating shorter component codes that are then decoded through iterative Soft-Input Soft-Output (SISO) of their components. The recently introduced Soft Output Guessing Random Additive Noise Decoding (SOGRAND) has been shown to enable accurate SISO component decoding for a broad range of component codes. Here we establish that by specializing its SISO computation to Single Parity Check codes, SOGRAND offers an alternative existing Check Node (CN) update for decoding Low Density Parity Check codes. Simulation results demonstrate similar or better decoding performance than Gallager's sum-product algorithm and norm-min-sum, while offering two distinct low complexity, hardware friendly CN update algorithms.

title: Claim2Source at CheckThat! 2026: Improving Multilingual Scientific Claim-Source Retrieval with Verification-based Re-Ranking
authors: Tobias Schreieder, Harsh Khandelwal, Yu-Ling Zhong, Michael Färber
abstract: Multilingual scientific claim-source retrieval aims to identify the scientific publication supporting a claim shared on social media. This task is challenging because claims often differ from source publications in terms of language, wording, and level of detail, which weakens the connection between claims and their underlying evidence. In this paper, we present our approach for the CheckThat! 2026 Lab Task 1: Source Retrieval for Scientific Web Claims. We propose a multi-stage retrieval framework for multilingual scientific claim-source retrieval that combines structured claim and source representations with progressive candidate refinement. To address multilingual retrieval challenges, the framework employs bilingual claim representations, metadata-enhanced source representations, and language-specific adaptation of dense retrieval models. Building on this setup, a first-stage retriever generates an initial pool of candidate sources, after which similarity-based re-ranking improves the ranking of highly relevant sources and verification-based re-ranking identifies the candidate source that best supports the claim using verification signals. Our approach achieves an average MRR@5 score of 0.7628 across English, German, and French claims, ranking first on the CheckThat! 2026 leaderboard.
comment: Accepted at the CheckThat! Lab at CLEF 2026

title: Additional properties of parity based bit-counting complexity classes and hierarchies
authors: Tayfun Pay
abstract: We study some properties of the parity based bit-counting complexity classes ${\bf B_{|0| \oplus}P}$ and ${\bf B_{|1| \oplus}P}$. We first show that both of these complexity classes are closed under complement and prove that ${\bf B_{|1|\oplus}P}\subseteq {\bf B_{|0|\oplus}P}$. We then prove that ${\bf US}\subseteq {\bf P}^{{\bf B_{|1|\oplus}P}}$ and ${\bf US}\subseteq {\bf P}^{{\bf B_{|0|\oplus}P}}$. We then study the characteristic functions of the parity based bit-counting complexity classes, where the characteristic function of ${\bf B_{|1| \oplus}P}$ outputs the Prouhet-Thue-Morse sequence. We then prove that a finite contiguous block of these sequences yield the parity of the starting number and then prove that ${\bf \oplus P}\subseteq {\bf P}^{{\bf B_{|0|\oplus}P}}$ and ${\bf \oplus P}\subseteq {\bf P}^{{\bf B_{|1|\oplus}P}}$. We then use the parity based bit-counting complexity classes to define various hierarchies and show that they all contain ${\bf PH}$ and are contained in ${\bf CH}$.

title: Securing Deep Learning Hardware: A Survey of Side-Channel Vulnerabilities and Countermeasures
authors: Zahra Mohammadi, Mona Hashemi, Siamak Mohammadi
abstract: As deep learning models are increasingly deployed in critical sectors such as healthcare, finance, and security, ensuring their protection against emerging threats has become crucial. Among these threats, side-channel attacks (SCAs) represent a particular challenge since they can extract sensitive information such as model architectures, parameters, and even user inputs without requiring direct access to the model. By leveraging the physical and micro-architectural properties of the hardware, attackers can compromise systems. This survey begins by classifying leakage sources and attacker objectives, then analyzes representative studies that demonstrate practical side-channel exploits against deep-learning hardware. It also reviews existing defenses aimed at mitigating these vulnerabilities and concludes by outlining key open research challenges and potential future directions.

title: What is Left for Us? Second Scholarship Against the Degradation of Research by AI
authors: Claudio Novelli, Luciano Floridi
abstract: We argue that generative AI can degrade research by eroding the very practices through which scholarly judgement is formed and academic trust is built. As constitutive conditions for the production and validation of knowledge, these practices cannot be reduced to the final outputs of research, which is what AI so effectively simulate. Accordingly, when researchers delegate central tasks of inquiry to systems like Large Language Models, they may stop enacting these practices and, with them, lose access to the formation they provide. An individual research output generated by AI may even appear improved but the researcher behind it fails to develop. Against this risk, merely keeping humans in the loop as prompters or quality checkers of AI outputs is insufficient to preserve research as a site of intellectual formation. What is needed instead is a renewed commitment to research as a lived practice in which judgement is formed gradually, often through frictions, and participation in a scholarly community. We defend it because it rests on four sources and warrants of research that cannot be automated: tacit knowledge, personal commitment, socialisation, and deep reading. This practice enacts what we call second scholarship, by which we understand the reappropriation of scholarly craft, chosen out of a critical experience of what generative AI can and cannot do. What cannot and should not be delegated becomes what research communities must value and answer for. This is what is left for us.

title: PreSIST: Vision-Language-Informed Object Persistence Prediction in Open-World Scenes
authors: Amanda Adkins, Tarunvidyut Ravisankar, Joydeep Biswas
abstract: Robots deployed over long periods must reason about environments that change over time. Existing long-term perception systems often address object change reactively, updating their maps only after revisiting a scene and observing that an object has moved. Instead, robots should reason proactively about how long objects are likely to persist using the context in which they appear. For example, a car at a traffic light and a car in a parking spot share the same semantic class, but their contexts imply different persistence durations. We propose PreSIST (Predictive Scene-conditioned Instance Survival over Time), a method for predicting whether an observed object will remain in its last seen pose at arbitrary future times. PreSIST estimates instance-level persistence priors from object properties and scene context, then integrates these priors with a probabilistic persistence filter as observations become available. Its key insight is that the reasoning capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) can relate scene context to likely object use and human activity, enabling persistence prediction before long-term observations are available. We develop two interchangeable variants: PreSIST-Lang, which estimates persistence priors using a VLM, and PreSIST-Vis, a novel vision-only model trained using PreSIST-Lang pseudo-labels for efficient deployment. Experiments on a new dataset of in-the-wild object persistence annotations show that PreSIST-Lang and PreSIST-Vis outperform baselines on open-world persistence prediction.

title: Telescope: Improving Zero Shot Detection of LLM Generated Content By Measuring Token Repetition Probability
authors: Christopher Nassif, Josh F. Cooper
abstract: Distinguishing Large Language Model (LLM) generated text from human writing is a critical and difficult challenge. While LLMs are trained to write like humans, we hypothesize that this training leaves an indelible mark. LLMs develop a particularly strong aversion to token repetition very early in training. This bias persists as a ''Vestigial Heuristic'' (a developmental artifact) that is activated in LLM-generated text, separating LLM from human writing. To probe this phenomenon, we introduce Telescope Perplexity, a metric that evaluates the token repetition of the model, $P(s_i | s_{1:i})$ . Our empirical investigation reveals that the Telescope Perplexity signature emerges early in pre-training, and Telescope Perplexity empirically enables highly effective zero-shot LLM detection. We show state-of-the-art or competitive performance across diverse datasets (including modern evaluation sets we introduce), reference models, and perturbation schemes with greater efficiency than other methods.

title: SiamJEPA: On the Role of Siamese Student Encoders in JEPA
authors: Makoto Yamada
abstract: Recently, Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have attracted significant attention in the computer vision and machine learning communities as a promising framework for self-supervised representation learning. Unlike masked autoencoders that reconstruct pixels, JEPA models learn representations by predicting latent embeddings of masked regions. Existing JEPA-based methods, such as I-JEPA and V-JEPA, typically employ a single encoder in the student network. In contrast, using Siamese encoders for student network is more naturally aligned with brain-inspired representation learning frameworks, yet their role in JEPA models remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we investigate the effect of Siamese student encoders in JEPA-based representation learning. To this end, we propose SiamJEPA, masked Siamese student encoders equipped with an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher network. SiamJEPA can also be viewed as a JEPA formulation of the brain-inspired representation learning model PhiNet. Through extensive experiments on ImageNet linear probing, we demonstrate that Siamese encoders act as an effective regularizer for the JEPA objective, improving representation separability and accelerating learning during the early stages of training. Furthermore, SiamJEPA consistently outperforms comparable single-encoder JEPA variants under limited training budgets and achieves higher linear probing accuracy than Masked Autoencoders (MAE) which requires longer training. Our findings reveal that Siamese student encoders are not merely an architectural choice but constitute an important inductive bias for predictive representation learning. These results provide new insights into the design of JEPA-based models and suggest that incorporating Siamese student architectures offers a simple yet effective approach for improving self-supervised representation learning.

title: Kaizen: Metamorphic Fuzzing and Differential Testing for LLM-Translated HPC Applications
authors: Oscar Ludwig, Ninad Anklesaria, Zheming Jin, Swaroop Pophale, Kausar Moshood, Christian J. DeVore, Brandon Gill, Cassius Villareal, Keita Teranishi, Manish Motwani
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to port scientific codes across heterogeneous high-performance computing (HPC) programming models, such as translating CUDA to OpenMP, OpenACC, Kokkos or SYCL. However, current evaluations use compilation success, token-level similarity, or developer-written tests from static benchmarks, which cannot reliably ensure behavioral correctness. We present Kaizen, a metamorphic fuzzing and differential testing framework for evaluating the correctness of LLM-translated HPC code. Kaizen uses metamorphic fuzzing via source-code mutation to generate semantically equivalent programs, grammar-based input fuzzing to explore behavioral diversity, and differential testing to expose semantic divergences between original and translated applications that compile and pass developer-written tests yet produce incorrect scientific results. We evaluate Kaizen on CUDA-to-OpenMP translation of 16 scientific applications from seven domains using three fine-tuned LLMs at kernel-level and full-program granularity. Our evaluation reveals that (1) compilation success is a poor proxy for correctness; (2) LLM-translated programs exhibit systematic compile-time error patterns, with nine categories for kernel-level translation and 27 for full-program translation; (3) semantic errors that survive compilation are often input-dependent and require differential testing to expose; and (4) full-program translation is substantially harder than kernel-level translation. These findings highlight the need for correctness-oriented evaluation of LLM-assisted HPC code translations.
comment: Manuscript under-review at the ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology (TOSEM) journal

title: Speaker-Disentangled Chunk-Wise Regression for Syllabic Tokenization
authors: Ryota Komatsu, Kota Kawakita, Takuma Okamoto, Takahiro Shinozaki
abstract: Unsupervised syllabic tokenization aims to learn discrete syllabic tokens that capture latent linguistic content-related structure from raw speech. Recent syllabic tokenization methods employ teacher-student distillation of the pretrained HuBERT to organize latent speech frame representations into syllabic segments. However, when trained with an utterance-level cross-entropy objective, the model predicts speaker identity rather than linguistic content, thereby compromising the purity of syllabic tokens.
