translation: 本文提出了一种基于耐力面概念的新型疲劳连续损伤框架，并使用能量释放率作为驱动力。损伤演化由热力学驱动力与耐力面的距离决定。与经典的失效面不同，该方法允许损伤在恒定幅值载荷下经过多次循环累积。因此，耐力面直接决定了材料的物理耐力极限。为了获得网格客观的结果，该公式通过微形态梯度增强进行了正则化。各向异性损伤演化和微裂纹闭合-开启效应的引入，将该框架扩展到了多轴疲劳和依赖于加载路径的退化。所选的原型损伤演化满足三个要求：合理的物理性、计算鲁棒性和标定灵活性。该模型成功地标定了普通混凝土的单调响应和低合金钢的高周疲劳行为。数值算例涵盖了L型混凝土试件的单调失效、循环载荷下的应力-寿命行为以及轴-扭复合疲劳。这些案例展示了所提出的公式如何应用于从标准拟脆性断裂基准到经典疲劳表征及复杂多轴损伤演化的实际场景。算例表明，该公式能够捕捉多次循环中的渐进退化并再现典型的应力-寿命行为。各向异性退化的影响在近失效阶段的多轴加载条件下尤为重要。总体而言，该方法为模拟高周疲劳驱动的损伤提供了一个热力学一致、梯度增强且计算鲁棒的框架。
tldr: 提出了一种基于耐力面的新型疲劳损伤框架，通过梯度增强实现网格无关性，并成功模拟了拟脆性材料在多轴及循环载荷下的渐进性失效。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将耐力面概念引入疲劳损伤建模，并结合微形态梯度增强技术，有效解决了网格依赖性问题，同时能够处理复杂的各向异性疲劳损伤和多轴加载情况。其局限性在于未提及对超高周疲劳或极端环境下的适应性。
motivation: 为了建立一个能够模拟拟脆性材料在恒定幅值循环荷载下长期累积损伤的力学框架，并解决传统失效面无法准确描述物理耐力极限的问题。
method: 基于耐力面概念和能量释放率的连续损伤力学框架，采用微形态梯度增强进行正则化，并引入各向异性损伤演化及微裂纹闭合-开启效应。
results: 成功模拟了混凝土的单调响应及低合金钢的高周疲劳行为，在L型混凝土试件、应力-寿命行为及轴-扭复合疲劳等算例中表现出良好的预测能力。
conclusion: 该研究提出了一种基于耐力面概念的连续损伤框架，能够有效模拟拟脆性材料在循环荷载下的渐进损伤和疲劳行为，在处理多轴加载和路径依赖性方面表现出良好的鲁棒性和物理合理性。

title: Performance evaluation of scheduling tasks in many-core systems utilizing processes and threads
authors: Mejgan Dedaj, Argyro Gailla, Theofanis Ioannou, Stamatia Kastrinaki, Hermione Kimpouropoulou, Dimitrios Kontodimos, Kleopatra Kontogianni, Sotirios Kontogiannis, Michail Panagiotidis Kannas, Anastasia Papouda, Anna Maria Sidiropoulou, George Tavridis
abstract: This study assesses the scalability of process-based and thread-based schedulers for many-core shared-memory systems using a memory-intensive row-wise quick-sort workload on large three-dimensional tensors. The process-based evaluation considers bounded prolific, bounded collective, and three pipe-based producer-consumer schedulers: one-to-one, one-to-many, and many-to-many. These pipe schedulers dynamically stream task identifiers to worker processes, exchanging increased inter-process communication overhead for enhanced runtime load balancing and flexible chunk-based task dispatching. The thread-based evaluation examines static, dynamic, guided, chunk-based, chunk-stealing, adaptive chunk, and AIMD adaptive scheduling strategies. The AIMD scheduler employs an additive-increase multiplicative-decrease policy inspired by TCP congestion control, utilizing an exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) of CPU utilization to regulate a contention window that limits the number of concurrently active chunks. The adaptive chunk scheduler further modifies chunk size based on observed per-thread execution speed. Experimental results on a 24-core x86-64 platform indicate that thread schedulers deliver the highest overall performance, with dynamic and guided scheduling yielding the most favorable practical outcomes. Among process schedulers, pipe-based designs demonstrate the strongest scalability, with one-to-one pipes excelling for smaller workloads and many-to-many pipes preferred for larger workloads. In summary, lightweight thread scheduling is optimal for shared-memory row sorting, while AIMD/adaptive scheduling and pipe-based process scheduling remain valuable for contention-aware execution, explicit inter-process coordination, and distributed-style heterogeneous workload management.
zh_title: 多核系统中利用进程和线程执行任务的调度性能评估
translation: 本研究使用内存密集型逐行快速排序工作负载和大型三维张量，评估了多核共享内存系统中基于进程和基于线程的调度器的可扩展性。基于进程的评估考虑了有界多产、有界集体和三种基于管道的生产者-消费者调度器：一对一、一对多和多对多。这些管道调度器动态地将任务标识符流式传输到工作进程，通过增加的进程间通信开销来换取增强的运行时负载平衡和灵活的基于块的任务分派。基于线程的评估考察了静态、动态、引导式、基于块、块窃取、自适应块和AIMD自适应调度策略。AIMD调度器采用受TCP拥塞控制启发的加性增加乘性减少策略，利用CPU利用率的指数加权移动平均（EWMA）来调节限制并发活动块数量的拥塞窗口。自适应块调度器根据观察到的每个线程执行速度进一步修改块大小。在24核x86-64平台上的实验结果表明，线程调度器实现了最高的整体性能，其中动态和引导式调度产生了最有利的实际结果。在进程调度器中，基于管道的设计显示出最强的可扩展性，其中一对一管道适用于较小的工作负载，而多对多管道适用于较大的工作负载。总之，轻量级线程调度对于共享内存行排序是最优的，而AIMD/自适应调度和基于管道的进程调度对于争用感知执行、显式进程间协调和分布式风格的异构工作负载管理仍然具有价值。
tldr: 在多核共享内存系统中，线程调度在内存密集型排序任务中表现优于进程调度。动态和引导式调度策略效果最佳。管道式进程调度在扩展性方面表现良好，适用于不同规模的工作负载。
ai_comments: 该研究在多核系统上对进程和线程调度进行了全面的性能评估，特别关注了内存密集型任务。实验结果清晰地表明了线程调度的优越性，并对不同调度策略进行了细致的比较。AIMD和自适应调度策略的引入增加了研究的新颖性，借鉴了网络领域的成熟理论。然而，研究仅限于x86-64平台和特定的排序工作负载，未来可以探索更广泛的硬件架构和应用场景。
motivation: 评估多核共享内存系统中基于进程和线程的调度器在内存密集型排序任务中的可扩展性。
method: 评估了三种进程调度器（有界多产、有界集体、三种管道式生产者-消费者调度器：一对一、一对多、多对多）和七种线程调度器（静态、动态、引导式、基于块、块窃取、自适应块、AIMD自适应）。
results: 线程调度器实现了最高的整体性能，其中动态和引导式调度最为有效。管道式进程调度器扩展性最强，一对一管道适用于较小的工作负载，多对多管道适用于较大的工作负载。
conclusion: 对于共享内存的行排序任务，轻量级线程调度是最佳选择。AIMD/自适应调度和管道式进程调度在争用感知执行、显式进程间协调和分布式异构工作负载管理方面仍然具有价值。

title: KinEMbed: Decoding Kinematics from Electromyography via Cross-Modal Contrastive Learning
authors: Sofia Gilardini, Chenfei Ma, Kianoush Nazarpour
abstract: Decoding hand kinematics from surface electromyography (EMG) is a core challenge in wearable biosignal processing with clinical relevance for prosthetic control and motor rehabilitation. Most representation learning approaches for EMG focus on discrete gesture classification, and few focus on continuous regression. We present KinEMbed, a cross-modal contrastive learning framework for hand kinematics regression that jointly trains dual encoders -- one for windowed EMG features and one for kinematic (joint angle) targets. The resulting embeddings inherit the geometric structure of the kinematic space without requiring kinematic signals at inference time. Evaluating on the NinaPro DB8 dataset that includes both able-bodied users and subjects with limb difference (N=11), KinEMbed outperforms PCA, PLS, autoencoder and contrastive (CEBRA) baselines on held-out sessions, with largest gains on the most challenging thumb degrees of articulation. We position this work as a first step toward contrastive representation learning for regression of hand kinematics from structured wearable biosignals.

zh_title: 肌电图运动学解码：通过跨模态对比学习
translation: 从表面肌电图（EMG）解码手部运动学是可穿戴生物信号处理中的一个核心挑战，在假肢控制和运动康复方面具有临床意义。大多数用于EMG的表征学习方法都侧重于离散手势分类，很少关注连续回归。我们提出了KinEMbed，一个用于手部运动学回归的跨模态对比学习框架，它联合训练了两个编码器——一个用于窗式EMG特征，一个用于运动学（关节角度）目标。由此产生的嵌入继承了运动学空间的几何结构，而无需在推理时使用运动学信号。在包含正常使用者和肢体差异使用者（N=11）的NinaPro DB8数据集上进行评估，KinEMbed在预测的运动学信息方面优于PCA、PLS、自动编码器和对比（CEBRA）基线方法，在最具挑战性的拇指运动学自由度方面增益最大。我们将这项工作定位为使用对比表征学习从结构化可穿戴生物信号回归手部运动学的第一步。
tldr: 本研究提出了一种名为KinEMbed的跨模态对比学习框架，用于从表面肌电图（EMG）解码手部运动学信息，实现了连续运动回归，并在NinaPro DB8数据集上取得了优于现有基线方法的性能，尤其在处理拇指运动学方面效果显著。
ai_comments: 该研究巧妙地将对比学习应用于肌电图信号的运动学回归任务，解决了现有方法在连续回归方面的不足。模型能够在推理时摆脱对运动学信号的依赖，这对于实际应用具有重要意义。研究在包含肢体差异使用者的多样化数据集上进行了验证，增加了结果的说服力。未来的工作可以进一步探索该方法在不同类型生物信号和更复杂运动任务上的应用潜力。
motivation: 现有的肌电图表征学习方法多侧重于离散手势分类，而较少关注连续运动回归，这限制了其在假肢控制和运动康复等领域的应用。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探索使用对比学习进行肌电图到手部运动学的连续回归。
method: 提出了一种名为KinEMbed的跨模态对比学习框架，该框架联合训练了处理窗式肌电图特征的编码器和处理运动学（关节角度）目标的编码器。通过对比学习，使得肌电图特征的嵌入能够保留运动学空间的几何结构，从而在推理时无需运动学信号。
results: 在NinaPro DB8数据集（包含正常使用者和肢体差异使用者）上进行评估，KinEMbed在预测的运动学信息方面优于PCA、PLS、自动编码器和CEBRA等基线方法，特别是在最具挑战性的拇指运动学回归任务上表现突出。
conclusion: KinEMbed是迈向使用对比表征学习从结构化可穿戴生物信号回归手部运动学的第一步，为肌电图信号在假肢控制和运动康复等领域的应用提供了新的可能性。

title: Dynamic Airspace Management for UAVs in Evolving Urban Environments: Collaborative Coordination and Human Safety
authors: Lin Sun, Yuhang Wang, Fan Meng Hong, Haopeng Chen, Yan Jiao, Yongming Xu
abstract: The low-altitude economy is an emerging industry with significant development potential, in which the safety of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) operations is a critical challenge. Particularly within complex urban topographies and human-populated environments, UAV airspace management must prioritize collision avoidance and human safety. We propose Pharos, a collaborative multi-UAV airspace management system. Pharos lies between the distributed local perception paradigm and the centralized fine-grained control paradigm. Pharos coordinates the safe parallel execution of UAVs in shared airspace while innovatively accounting for the impact of human fear. Pharos is implemented using the MAPPO algorithm due to its faster convergence and higher rewards than other typical MARL algorithms (HAPPO and HATRPO). To evaluate Pharos, we developed a 3D simulation system using real urban data. Visualization results demonstrate its effective airspace coordination capability. Regarding performance verification, Pharos reduced human fear by 52.72% compared to the benchmark Ipopt. Moreover, we designed spatial entropy as a system evaluation metric to quantify space utilization, which improved performance by 70.82% and 2.03% compared to the benchmarks Ipopt and A-star, respectively. The source code is available at an anonymized repository: https://github.com/pharos-anonymized/source-code.git.
zh_title: 城市演化环境下的无人机动态空域管理：协同协调与人身安全
translation: 低空经济是一个具有巨大发展潜力的的新兴产业，其中无人机运行的安全性是一个关键挑战。特别是在复杂的城市地形和人口居住环境中，无人机空域管理必须优先考虑避碰和人身安全。我们提出了Pharos，一个协同的多无人机空域管理系统。Pharos介于分布式局部感知范式和集中式细粒度控制范式之间。Pharos协调了无人机在共享空域中安全并行运行，并创新性地考虑了人类恐惧感的影响。Pharos采用了MAPPO算法实现，因为与其他典型的MARL算法（HAPPO和HATRPO）相比，它具有更快的收敛速度和更高的回报。为了评估Pharos，我们使用真实城市数据开发了一个3D仿真系统。可视化结果证明了其有效的空域协调能力。在性能验证方面，与基准Ipopt相比，Pharos将人类恐惧感降低了52.72%。此外，我们设计了空间熵作为系统评估指标来量化空间利用率，与基准Ipopt和A-star相比，其性能分别提高了70.82%和2.03%。源代码可在匿名存储库中找到：https://github.com/pharos-anonymized/source-code.git。
tldr: Pharos是一个协同多无人机空域管理系统，它在分布式感知和集中式控制之间取得平衡，通过MAPPO算法协调无人机安全运行，并考虑人类恐惧因素，在仿真中展示了有效的空域协调能力、降低了人类恐惧感，并提高了空间利用率。
ai_comments: 该研究关注无人机在城市环境中运行的安全问题，并提出了创新的解决方案Pharos系统。系统在协调无人机运行的同时，考虑了人类恐惧感这一独特因素，并取得了显著的成果。MAPPO算法的选择和空间熵作为评估指标的设计也体现了研究的深度。然而，实际部署中可能还需要考虑更多现实因素，如通信延迟、传感器噪声以及更复杂的动态环境变化。
motivation: 城市环境中无人机运行的安全是低空经济发展中的关键挑战，尤其是在复杂地形和人口密集区域，需要优先考虑避碰和人身安全。
method: 提出Pharos系统，一个介于分布式感知和集中式控制之间的协同多无人机空域管理系统。使用MAPPO算法进行协调，并设计了空间熵作为评估指标。
results: Pharos系统将人类恐惧感降低了52.72%，空间熵（空间利用率）比Ipopt和A-star分别提高了70.82%和2.03%。
conclusion: Pharos系统能够有效地协调无人机在共享空域中的安全运行，并能有效降低人类的恐惧感，提高空间利用率，为城市环境下的无人机空域管理提供了解决方案。

title: Probably Correct Optimal Stable Matching under Two-Sided Uncertainty
authors: Andreas Athanasopoulos, Anne-Marie George, Christos Dimitrakakis
abstract: We study a sequential learning problem for stable matchings in two-sided markets where preferences on both sides are initially unknown. We focus on a centralized setting where an algorithm matches agents at each time step and receives noisy rewards that reflect the preferences of the matched agents, following a semi-bandit feedback structure. We adopt a pure exploration perspective, aiming to efficiently identify the optimal stable matching with high probability. Our work extends prior results by handling \emph{two-sided uncertainty} and by exploiting \emph{partial preference} information. A central ingredient is the notion of \textbf{pervasive stable matching}, which enables the identification of optimal stable matchings under partial preferences. We propose elimination-based algorithms whose stopping criteria exploit the structure of the learned partial preferences, and provide a refined sample-complexity analysis. Beyond pure exploration, we extend our approach to regret minimization and establish regret bounds with respect to the \emph{optimal} stable matching that avoid dependence on the minimum reward gap $Δ_{\min}$.
zh_title: 双边不确定性下的概率最优稳定匹配
translation:
我们研究的是双边市场中稳定匹配的顺序学习问题，其中双方的偏好最初是未知的。我们关注一个中心化的设置，其中算法在每个时间步进行匹配，并接收反映匹配代理偏好的噪声奖励，遵循半强盗反馈结构。我们采用纯探索的视角，旨在以高概率有效地识别最优稳定匹配。我们的工作通过处理

双边不确定性

和利用

部分偏好

信息扩展了先前的结果。一个核心内容是

普遍稳定匹配

的概念，它使得在部分偏好下识别最优稳定匹配成为可能。我们提出了基于消除的算法，其停止标准利用了学习到的部分偏好信息的结构，并提供了精细的样本复杂度分析。除了纯探索，我们将我们的方法扩展到遗憾最小化，并建立了与

最优

稳定匹配相关的遗憾界限，该界限避免了对最小奖励差距 $Δ_{\min}$ 的依赖。
tldr: 该研究解决了双边市场中稳定匹配的顺序学习问题，其中双方偏好未知。算法在每一步匹配代理并接收有噪声的奖励，反馈结构为半强盗。研究目标是高概率地识别最优稳定匹配，解决了双边不确定性和利用部分偏好信息的问题。引入了“普遍稳定匹配”概念，并提出基于消除的算法，分析了样本复杂度，并建立了与最优稳定匹配相关的遗憾界限。
ai_comments: 该研究在稳定匹配领域取得了重要的理论进展，特别是在处理双边不确定性和利用部分偏好信息方面。引入“普遍稳定匹配”概念是该工作的亮点。提出的基于消除的算法及其样本复杂度分析为实际应用提供了理论基础。遗憾界限的分析也具有理论意义，避免了对最小奖励差距的依赖，这是一个值得关注的改进。
motivation: 在双边市场中，双方的偏好通常是未知的，这使得找到最优的稳定匹配成为一个挑战。该研究旨在解决这种双边不确定性问题，并利用部分偏好信息来提高匹配效率。
method: 该研究采用纯探索方法，通过算法在每一步匹配代理并接收有噪声的奖励（遵循半强盗反馈结构），以期高概率地识别最优稳定匹配。核心是“普遍稳定匹配”概念，并提出了基于消除的算法，利用学习到的部分偏好信息的结构来确定停止标准，并进行了样本复杂度分析。
results: 研究提出了基于消除的算法，并进行了样本复杂度分析。此外，还将方法扩展到遗憾最小化，并建立了与最优稳定匹配相关的遗憾界限，该界限不依赖于最小奖励差距 $Δ_{\min}$。
conclusion: 该研究通过引入“普遍稳定匹配”概念，并提出基于消除的算法，有效解决了双边市场中双边不确定性下的稳定匹配问题，并在纯探索和遗憾最小化方面取得了理论进展。

title: Handover-Optimal User Association Policy for LEO Satellite-based 5G NTN
authors: Pradnya Taksande, Jainesh Mehta, Prasanna Chaporkar
abstract: The integration of Non Terrestrial Networks into 5G and beyond cellular systems has introduced a significant paradigm shift, enabling ubiquitous connectivity and extending services to previously unconnected and underserved remote regions. In particular, Low Earth Orbit satellites, operating close to the Earth surface, can provide communication latency comparable to that of terrestrial networks. However, due to their high mobility, LEO satellites trigger frequent handovers, which degrade users quality of experience and increase signaling overhead. In this work, our objective is to minimize the number of handovers in a LEO satellite system while preventing satellite overloading. We formulate the problem within a game theoretic framework and apply the Spatial Adaptive Play algorithm to obtain a handover efficient and load balanced solution. Additionally, we propose a low complexity heuristic algorithm to achieve similar objectives with reduced computational overhead.
zh_title: LEO卫星5G NTN中切换最优的用户关联策略
translation: 非地面网络（NTN）与5G及未来蜂窝系统的集成引入了显著的范式转变，实现了无处不在的连接，并将服务扩展到以前未连接和未充分服务的偏远地区。特别是，低地球轨道（LEO）卫星运行在靠近地球表面的位置，可以提供与地面网络相当的通信延迟。然而，由于其高移动性，LEO卫星会触发频繁的切换，这会降低用户的体验质量并增加信令开销。在这项工作中，我们的目标是在防止卫星过载的同时，最小化LEO卫星系统中的切换次数。我们将问题在一个博弈论框架内进行建模，并应用空间自适应博弈算法（Spatial Adaptive Play）来获得一个切换高效且负载均衡的解决方案。此外，我们提出了一种低复杂度的启发式算法，以较低的计算开销实现类似的目标。
tldr: 本文旨在最小化LEO卫星系统中因其高移动性引起的频繁切换，同时防止卫星过载，通过博弈论框架和空间自适应博弈算法实现切换高效和负载均衡的解决方案，并提出低复杂度启发式算法。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将博弈论框架应用于LEO卫星网络的用户关联和切换优化问题，以平衡切换频率和负载均衡。提出的低复杂度启发式算法对于实际部署具有重要意义，因为它能在保证性能的同时降低计算复杂度。
motivation: 低地球轨道（LEO）卫星由于其高移动性，会触发频繁的切换，这会降低用户的体验质量并增加信令开销。本文旨在最小化LEO卫星系统中的切换次数，同时防止卫星过载。
method: 本文将问题在一个博弈论框架内进行建模，并应用空间自适应博弈算法（Spatial Adaptive Play）来获得一个切换高效且负载均衡的解决方案。此外，还提出了一种低复杂度的启发式算法，以较低的计算开销实现类似的目标。
results: 本文通过博弈论框架和空间自适应博弈算法获得了切换高效且负载均衡的解决方案。提出的低复杂度启发式算法能够以较低的计算开销实现类似的目标。
conclusion: 通过博弈论框架和启发式算法，本文成功地在LEO卫星系统中实现了切换次数的最小化，同时确保了卫星的负载均衡，从而有效解决了因高移动性导致的频繁切换问题。

title: Arbitrary high order splitting methods for linear Schr{ö}dinger equations with non-trivial compatibility conditions
authors: Joackim Bernier, Ramona Häberli, Gilles Vilmart
abstract: Splitting methods are a natural choice for the numerical time integration of partial differential equations, and arbitrary high order splitting schemes exist for Schr{ö}dinger equations with periodic boundary conditions. However, in the presence of non-periodic boundary conditions, we show that they suffer in general from an order reduction, even for smooth initial conditions. The reason for such order reduction phenomena are so-called compatibility conditions, which are not preserved by classical splitting schemes. In this paper, we introduce a family of modified splitting methods for one-dimensional linear Schr{ö}dinger equations with homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions, which achieve an arbitrary high order, and do not suffer from any order reduction. This is illustrated with a fourth order splitting scheme considering initial conditions with various regularity properties.
zh_title: 线性薛定谔方程非平凡相容性条件的任意高阶分裂方法
translation: 分裂方法是偏微分方程数值时间积分的自然选择，对于具有周期性边界条件的薛定谔方程，存在任意高阶分裂方案。然而，在存在非周期性边界条件的情况下，我们发现它们通常会遭受阶数降低，即使对于光滑的初始条件也是如此。这种阶数降低现象的原因是所谓的相容性条件，这些条件没有被经典分裂方案所保留。在本文中，我们针对具有齐次狄利克雷边界条件的一维线性薛定谔方程引入了一族改进的分裂方法，这些方法可以实现任意高阶，并且不会出现任何阶数降低。这一点通过一个四阶分裂方案，考虑具有各种正则性属性的初始条件进行了说明。
tldr: 针对具有非周期边界条件的线性薛定谔方程，传统分裂方法存在阶数降低问题，本文提出了一种改进的分裂方法，可以达到任意高阶且无阶数降低。
ai_comments: 这篇论文解决了分裂方法在处理非周期边界条件下的薛定谔方程时的一个关键限制——阶数降低问题。通过引入改进的分裂方法，它提高了数值模拟的精度和效率，对于需要高精度求解薛定谔方程的物理和工程领域具有重要意义。创新点在于对经典分裂方案的修改以保留相容性条件。
motivation: 传统的分裂方法在处理具有非周期边界条件的线性薛定谔方程时，即使初始条件平滑，也会出现阶数降低的问题，原因是经典分裂方案未能保留相容性条件。
method: 引入了一族针对一维线性薛定谔方程且具有齐次狄利克雷边界条件的改进分裂方法。通过一个四阶分裂方案，考虑具有不同正则性属性的初始条件进行说明。
results: 提出的改进分裂方法能够实现任意高阶，并且不会出现任何阶数降低。
conclusion: 针对非周期边界条件下的线性薛定谔方程，本文提出的改进分裂方法成功解决了传统方法存在的阶数降低问题，实现了任意高阶精度。

title: Athena-WBC: Capability-Aligned Policy Experts for Long-Tail Humanoid Whole-Body Control
authors: Yuan Jiang, Ningyuan Zhang, Xicun Yang, Shidi Li, Yuzhi Jiang, Zhiyi Rong, Shuaikang Ma, Chuanzheng Li, Jie Chen
abstract: Large-scale humanoid motion-tracking controllers are commonly improved by reallocating training effort: difficult motions are sampled more often, isolated into smaller subsets, or assigned to specialized experts. We show that this view is incomplete. In strong whole-body-control baselines, a residual set of feasible training clips remains unsolved even under targeted training, especially for high-dynamic transitions and balance-critical motions. These failures arise not only from insufficient exposure, but from a mismatch between the motion demands and the effective capability induced by the default training recipe. We propose Athena-WBC, a compact teacher-student pipeline with capability-aligned policy experts for long-tail humanoid whole-body control. Dynamic experts use a tracking-focused, constraint-aware objective that removes conservative effort and temporal-control penalties while preserving physical feasibility constraints; balance experts use a gravity curriculum to improve early-training survivability. The resulting privileged teachers are motion-routed for DAgger distillation and then compressed into a single controller with deployable observations followed by RL fine-tuning. Experiments on a full-size humanoid show improved recovery of training-set long-tail motions and better held-out tracking than a strong SONIC-recipe baseline, using only a small number of experts.
zh_title: Athena-WBC：面向长尾人形机器人全身控制的能力对齐策略专家系统
translation: 大规模人形运动跟踪控制器通常通过重新分配训练工作量来改进：更频繁地采样困难动作、将其隔离成较小的子集或分配给专门的专家。我们认为这种观点是不完整的。在强大的全身控制基线中，即使在有针对性的训练下，仍有一部分可行的训练片段无法解决，特别是在高动态转换和平衡关键动作方面。这些失败不仅是因为暴露不足，还因为运动需求与默认训练方案所诱导的有效能力之间存在不匹配。我们提出了 Athena-WBC，这是一个用于长尾人形机器人全身控制的、具有能力对齐策略专家的紧凑型教师-学生流水线。动态专家使用一种专注于跟踪、具有约束意识的目标，在保持物理可行性约束的同时去除了保守的努力和时间控制惩罚；平衡专家使用重力课程来提高训练初期的生存能力。由此产生的特权教师被路由进行 DAgger 蒸馏，然后压缩成一个具有可部署观察结果的单一控制器，随后进行强化学习微调。在全尺寸人形机器人上的实验表明，与强大的 SONIC 配方基线相比，使用少量专家即可改进对训练集长尾动作的恢复和更好的保留跟踪性能。
tldr: Athena-WBC 通过将复杂的机器人动作分解为专门的“能力对齐专家”，有效解决了人形机器人在高动态和平衡动作中的长尾控制难题。
ai_comments: 该研究通过将长尾运动拆解为特定能力的专家模型，解决了传统统一训练策略在复杂动作（如高动态转换和平衡关键动作）上的局限性，提供了一种更细粒度且有效的训练范式。其创新点在于从“能力对齐”的角度而非单纯的“数据重采样”角度优化控制器。
motivation: 现有的通用控制器在处理高动态转换和平衡关键动作等长尾运动时表现不佳，仅仅通过增加训练样本或简单重采样不足以解决问题，根本原因是运动需求与训练策略诱导的有效能力之间存在失配。
method: 提出 Athena-WBC 框架，包含两个核心组件：针对动态动作的“动态专家”（使用无保守惩罚的跟踪目标）和针对平衡动作的“平衡专家”（使用重力课程学习）。通过 privileged teachers 进行 DAgger 蒸馏，最后压缩为单一控制器并进行强化学习微调。
results: 在全尺寸人形机器人实验中，Athena-WBC 在训练集长尾动作的恢复能力和未见动作的跟踪性能上，均超越了强基线方法（SONIC），且仅需少量的专家模型。
conclusion: Athena-WBC 通过能力对齐的专家模型 pipeline，显著提升了人形机器人在长尾动作中的跟踪性能和鲁棒性，优于现有的强基线方法。

title: Semantic Homogenization in Italian Popular Music: A Diachronic Analysis
authors: Lorenzo Canale, Stefano Scotta, Alberto Messina
abstract: In recent years, studies have revealed a decline in semantic variety across popular music lyrics, particularly in English-language songs on streaming platforms like Spotify. This research examines whether a similar trend can be observed in a different linguistic and cultural context: the lyrics of all finalist songs from the 75 editions of the Sanremo Music Festival, Italy's most renowned music competition. What sets this work apart is the development of a flexible and efficient methodology for tracking changes in semantic similarity over time, which can be applied to different datasets to study similar phenomena. Drawing on a combination of full-text, segment-based, topic-based, and word-level analyses, the approach leverages both embedding techniques and large language models. When applied to the Sanremo corpus, this framework reveals a gradual move toward increasing semantic uniformity, echoing the global patterns identified in previous studies. These findings underscore the value of natural language processing tools in uncovering long-term shifts in musical language and cultural expression.
zh_title: 意大利流行音乐中的语义同质化：一项历时分析
translation: 近年来，研究表明流行音乐歌词的语义多样性有所下降，尤其是在Spotify等流媒体平台上的英文歌曲。本研究旨在检验在不同的语言和文化背景下，即意大利最著名的音乐比赛——圣雷莫音乐节75届所有决赛歌曲的歌词中，是否也能观察到类似的趋势。这项工作的独特之处在于开发了一种灵活高效的方法，用于追踪语义相似性随时间的变化，该方法可以应用于不同的数据集以研究类似的现象。该方法结合了全文、分段、主题和词汇层面的分析，并利用了嵌入技术和大型语言模型。当应用于圣雷莫语料库时，该框架揭示了语义统一性逐渐增加的趋势，这与先前研究中发现的全球模式相呼应。这些发现强调了自然语言处理工具在揭示音乐语言和文化表达长期变化方面的价值。
tldr: 本研究分析了意大利圣雷莫音乐节歌曲歌词的语义多样性，发现随着时间的推移，语义统一性逐渐增加，这与全球流行音乐的趋势一致，并提出了一种灵活的语义相似性追踪方法。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于其提出的灵活高效的语义相似性追踪方法，该方法结合了多种分析层面和先进的NLP技术（嵌入技术和大型语言模型），使其具有普适性，可应用于不同语言和文化背景下的流行音乐分析。研究结果验证了语义同质化并非仅限于英文流行音乐的普遍趋势，为理解全球文化表达的长期演变提供了新的视角。
motivation: 此前研究发现流行音乐歌词的语义多样性下降，尤其是在英文歌曲中。本研究旨在探讨在不同的语言和文化背景（意大利流行音乐）中是否存在类似的趋势。
method: 开发了一种灵活高效的方法来追踪语义相似性随时间的变化，该方法结合了全文本、分段、主题和词汇层面的分析，并利用了嵌入技术和大型语言模型。该方法适用于不同数据集以研究类似现象。
results: 将该框架应用于圣雷莫音乐节歌曲语料库后，发现语义统一性逐渐增加，这与之前研究中发现的全球模式相呼应。
conclusion: 研究结果强调了自然语言处理工具在揭示音乐语言和文化表达长期变化方面的价值。

title: Psychological features of dispute content and public acceptance of AI in legal adjudication: evidence for systematic variation beyond individual differences
authors: Masahiro Fujita, Eiichiro Watamura
abstract: Public acceptance of artificial intelligence (AI) in legal decision-making has been primarily explained through individual differences in personality traits and general technology attitudes. However, contextual features of legal disputes themselves may systematically influence preferences for AI versus human adjudicators. Across two studies with Japanese participants (N = 1,384 and N = 596), we examined whether psychological characteristics of dispute content shape acceptability judgments for algorithmic adjudication. Study 1 employed exploratory factor analysis on acceptability ratings across 46 legal dispute vignettes, revealing a two-dimensional structure distinguishing interpersonal-relational disputes (where human adjudicators were strongly preferred) from institutional-procedural disputes (where AI acceptance was comparatively higher). Study 2 replicated this structure in an independent sample and demonstrated that experimentally manipulated contextual features - emotional involvement and prototypicality - systematically modulated acceptability judgments, with effects varying by dispositional trust, AI-specific attitudes, and gender. AI-specific expectations emerged as the strongest predictor (eta2 = 0.252), and a three-way interaction among emotional involvement, gender, and prototypicality indicated that contextual effects are moderated by individual characteristics. These findings suggest that the psychological features of dispute content constitute an overlooked dimension in AI acceptance research, extending beyond technology acceptance models to fundamental questions about how individuals construe social problems and allocate adjudicative authority.
comment: 24 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables, journal accepted paper
zh_title: 法律裁决中争议内容的心理特征与公众对人工智能的接受度：个体差异之外的系统性变异证据
translation: 公众对人工智能（AI）在法律决策中接受度的解释，主要集中在人格特质和一般技术态度的个体差异上。然而，法律争议本身的情境特征可能会系统性地影响人们对AI与人类法官的偏好。通过两项针对日本参与者（N=1,384和N=596）的研究，我们考察了争议内容的心理特征如何塑造对算法裁决的接受度判断。研究1对46个法律争议情境的接受度评分进行了探索性因子分析，揭示了一个二维结构，区分了人际关系型争议（强烈倾向于人类法官）和制度程序型争议（AI接受度相对较高）。研究2在一个独立样本中复制了这一结构，并证明了实验操纵的情境特征——情感卷入度和典型性——系统性地调节了接受度判断，且其影响因气质信任、AI特定态度和性别而异。AI特定预期是预测因素中最强的（eta2 = 0.252），而情感卷入度、性别和典型性之间的三向交互作用表明，情境效应受到个体特征的调节。这些发现表明，争议内容的心理特征构成了AI接受度研究中一个被忽视的维度，这不仅扩展了技术接受模型，也触及了人们如何构建社会问题及分配裁决权等根本性问题。
tldr: 公众对AI司法的接受度不仅取决于个人偏好，还取决于争议本身的性质：人们更倾向于让人类处理人际纠纷，而对程序性争议使用AI的接受度更高。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将研究视角从单纯的“个体差异”转向“争议内容本身的心理特征”，揭示了公众对AI司法的接受度不仅取决于个人偏好，还高度依赖于争议性质（人际关系型 vs. 制度程序型）。这为理解AI在社会敏感领域的应用提供了更深入的认知框架，同时也指出了AI接受度研究中长期被忽视的情境因素。
motivation: 既往研究过度依赖于个体的性格特征和技术态度来解释AI接受度，忽略了法律争议本身的内容特征（情境因素）对公众判断的系统性影响。
method: 通过两项针对日本参与者（N=1,384和N=596）的研究。研究1使用探索性因子分析对46个法律争议场景进行分类；研究2通过操纵争议的情感卷入度和典型性，考察其对AI接受度的影响，并评估个体特征的调节作用。
results: 研究发现，人际关系型争议更倾向于人类法官，而制度程序型争议的AI接受度相对较高。情感卷入度和典型性是调节AI接受度的关键情境变量，且受个体AI预期、性别和信任度的调节。其中，AI预期是决定接受度的最强预测因子。
conclusion: 公众对AI司法的接受度受争议内容心理特征（如人际冲突程度、情感卷入度）的系统性影响，且这种情境影响与个体特征（如AI预期、性别）存在复杂的交互作用。未来研究应将争议内容的心理维度纳入AI接受度模型。

title: Representing and Detecting Label Ambiguity in IMU-Based Exercise Evaluation
authors: Andreas Spilz, Heiko Oppel, Michael Munz
abstract: Home-based physiotherapy is performed without supervision, which leads to incorrect execution and motivates systems that assess movement automatically from inertial measurement units (IMUs). Such systems assign each repetition to a category, yet a relevant share of repetitions falls near a class boundary, where even trained raters disagree. Classifiers trained with one-hot labels collapse these borderline repetitions onto a single class and discard this ambiguity. We address this with a method that automatically generates a label distribution per repetition without a large rater pool. We train a network to reproduce the full distribution with a Kullback-Leibler objective, the ambiguity approach, and compare it against a one-hot cross-entropy baseline on four IMU exercise datasets. From the network output we further determine whether a repetition is ambiguous and which classes are relevant to it. The ambiguity approach matched or exceeded the baseline classification on all four datasets, and detected ambiguity and the relevant classes more reliably. Representing the label distribution in the training target therefore adds information about ambiguity at no cost to classification.
zh_title: 基于IMU的运动评估中标签模棱两可的表示与检测
translation: 居家物理治疗通常在无人监督的情况下进行，这导致动作执行不规范，也促使了从惯性测量单元（IMU）自动评估运动的系统的发展。此类系统将每次重复动作归为一个类别，然而很大一部分重复动作落在类别边界附近，连训练有素的评估员都难以达成共识。使用独热标签训练的分类器将这些边界重复动作强制归为单一类别，从而丢弃了这种不确定性。我们提出了一种无需大量评估员即可自动为每个重复动作生成标签分布的方法。我们训练一个网络，利用Kullback-Leibler目标函数来重现完整分布（即“模棱两可方法”），并将其与四个IMU运动数据集上的独热交叉熵基准进行了比较。我们还利用网络输出进一步确定重复动作是否模棱两可，以及哪些类别与之相关。结果显示，“模棱两可方法”在所有四个数据集上的表现均达到或超过了基准分类，并更可靠地检测出了模棱两可性及相关类别。因此，在训练目标中表示标签分布，在不增加分类成本的情况下，增加了关于模棱两可性的信息。
tldr: 通过引入标签分布学习替代传统的独热编码，该方法有效解决了IMU运动评估中难以界定的“模棱两可”动作问题，提升了分类准确性并能自动识别不确定性样本。
ai_comments: 该研究巧妙地通过引入标签分布（Label Distribution）而非传统的独热编码（One-Hot Encoding），解决了运动评估中常见的模棱两可问题。其创新之处在于无需大量标注者即可生成分布，且在不增加额外成本的前提下提升了分类性能并实现了模棱两可样本的自动检测，具有很高的临床应用价值。
motivation: 居家物理治疗中缺乏监督导致动作执行不规范，而现有的基于IMU的自动评估系统通常使用独热标签，无法处理处于类别边界、专家也难以判定归属的“模棱两可”重复动作。
method: 提出了一种自动生成每个重复动作标签分布的方法，通过Kullback-Leibler散度作为目标函数训练网络，并利用网络输出判断动作的模棱两可性及其相关类别。
results: 该方法在四个IMU运动数据集上均达到或超过了传统的独热交叉熵基准表现，并能更可靠地检测出模棱两可的样本及其相关类别。
conclusion: 通过引入标签分布学习，该方法不仅提升了运动分类的准确性，还能够有效识别模棱两可的运动样本并确定其相关类别，为无监督的居家康复评估提供了一种更稳健的解决方案。

title: SynSFX: Multi-Model Sound Effects Synthesis Dataset for Deepfake Detection and Evaluation
authors: Linxi Li, Yuncong Yu, Qianwei Guo, Liwei Jin, Yechen Wang, Carsten Maple
abstract: While audio deepfake detection has advanced significantly, representative detectors show limited generalization to synthetic sound effects. Existing environmental audio datasets such as EnvSDD provide important initial resources, but remain limited in scale and generation provenance for studying isolated sound-effect deepfakes. To support this direction, we present SynSFX, a large-scale corpus of 43374 clips (26452 synthetic, 16922 real) spanning 7 popular text-to-audio models.
zh_title: SynSFX：用于深度伪造检测与评估的多模型音效合成数据集
translation: 尽管音频深度伪造检测技术已取得显著进展，但现有的检测器在合成音效方面的泛化能力仍然有限。现有的环境音频数据集（如EnvSDD）虽然提供了重要的初始资源，但在研究孤立音效深度伪造方面的规模和生成来源上仍显不足。为了支持这一研究方向，我们提出了SynSFX，这是一个包含43374个音频片段（26452个合成，16922个真实）的大规模语料库，涵盖了7种主流的文本转音频模型。
tldr: SynSFX是一个包含约4.3万个音频片段的大规模数据集，旨在解决现有深度伪造检测器在音效合成方面的泛化能力不足问题。
ai_comments: 该论文通过构建大规模音效数据集SynSFX，填补了当前音频深度伪造检测领域在音效合成检测方面的空白，对于提升检测模型的泛化能力具有重要的研究价值。
motivation: 现有的音频深度伪造检测器在音效合成方面的泛化能力不足，且缺乏专门针对孤立音效深伪研究的大规模、多来源数据集。
method: 构建了一个包含43374个音频片段（26452个合成，16922个真实）的大规模数据集，涵盖了7种主流的文本转音频（Text-to-Audio）模型。
results: 成功发布了SynSFX数据集，为音效深度伪造的检测与评估提供了关键的数据支撑。
conclusion: SynSFX数据集为研究和评估针对音效的深度伪造检测提供了大规模、多模型来源的基础资源，有助于推动音频伪造检测技术的发展。

title: Pretraining Curricula Enable Selective Fine-tuning
authors: Sebastian A. Bruijns, Jirko Rubruck, Mia H. Whitefield, Kai J. Sandbrink, Fazl Barez, Christopher Summerfield
abstract: Transformers follow implicit curricula whereby some tasks are learned before others. However, how explicit pretraining curricula influence learning, generalization, and the selectivity of fine-tuning is unclear. This is important for AI safety, where fine-tuning is used to selectively suppress misaligned behaviors. Here, we compare curricula that pretrain tasks in a balanced (sampled uniformly) or an imbalanced (one task early, the other late) fashion. We show that imbalanced learning of two conflicting copy tasks promotes in-context learning and improves the selectivity of refusal fine-tuning. Ablations and activation patching show that this occurs because imbalanced pretraining encourages tasks to be disentangled in separable neural circuits, whereas balanced training routes both tasks through a common pathway. We extend these findings to a synthetic language learning task involving rule-consistent and rule-violating data, where imbalanced curricula similarly lead to more localized, less entangled rule representations, resulting in more robust rule-following behavior. Together, these results suggest that imbalanced pretraining curricula may be an important tool for promoting disentangled representations, with direct consequences for the precision and reliability of safety fine-tuning.
zh_title: 预训练课程助力选择性微调
translation: Transformer模型遵循某种隐式课程，即某些任务会在其他任务之前被习得。然而，显式预训练课程如何影响学习、泛化以及微调的选择性尚不清楚。这对AI安全至关重要，因为微调常被用于选择性地抑制未对齐的行为。在此，我们比较了平衡（均匀采样）和非平衡（一任务在前，另一任务在后）的预训练任务课程。我们展示了对两个冲突复制任务进行非平衡学习，能够促进上下文学习并提高拒绝微调的选择性。消融实验和激活修补表明，这是因为非平衡预训练鼓励任务在可分离的神经回路中解耦，而平衡训练则通过共同路径处理两个任务。我们将这些发现扩展到涉及规则一致和规则违规数据的合成语言学习任务中，发现非平衡课程同样会导致更局部、更少纠缠的规则表示，从而产生更稳健的规则遵循行为。总之，这些结果表明非平衡预训练课程可能是促进表征解耦的重要工具，对安全微调的精确性和可靠性具有直接影响。
tldr: 研究表明，在预训练阶段采用非平衡的任务学习顺序，能使模型内部形成更清晰的任务解耦，从而让后续的安全性微调更加精准、有效。
ai_comments: 该研究揭示了预训练阶段的“课程设计”（Curriculum Design）对模型内部表示解耦及后续微调精度的深远影响。其创新点在于将预训练策略与AI安全性（尤其是拒绝行为的精确性）直接关联，为理解大模型如何学习及如何通过控制数据顺序来优化模型行为提供了新的视角。 limitations：目前主要基于合成任务和受控实验，在大规模真实语言模型上的适用性及扩展性有待进一步验证。
motivation: Transformer模型遵循隐式学习课程，但显式预训练课程如何影响模型学习、泛化及微调的选择性尚不明确；特别是在AI安全领域，研究如何通过预训练策略提升选择性抑制不良行为的能力具有重要意义。
method: 通过对比平衡（均匀采样）与非平衡（任务分先后）的预训练策略，利用消融实验和激活修补（Activation Patching）技术分析模型内部电路结构，并在合成语言任务上验证了规则学习的解耦效果。
results: 非平衡预训练促使模型将冲突任务分配到可分离的神经网络回路中，相比平衡训练中任务共享路径的模式，非平衡策略显著提升了后续安全性微调的选择性和规则遵循的稳健性。
conclusion: 预训练阶段采用非平衡课程（Imbalanced Curricula）能够促进模型内部任务表征的解耦，从而显著提高后续安全性微调（如拒绝特定行为）的精确度和稳健性。

title: CARL: Constraint-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Planning with LLMs
authors: Qiuyi Qi, Jinjian Zhang, Mutian Bao, Tian Liang, Guocong Li, Dongnan Liu, Wei Zhou, Jie Liu, Ming Kong, Linjian Mo, Feng Zhang, Qiang Zhu
abstract: Despite their strong reasoning capabilities and extensive world knowledge, Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently generate plans that violate task constraints, undermining their reliability in real-world applications. This deficiency arises from a lack of systematic mechanisms to incorporate constraint information during the generation process. While existing approaches attempt to mitigate this by relying on external tools or task decomposition, they fail to enhance the model's intrinsic constraint awareness. To address this, we propose Constraint-Aware Reinforcement Learning (CARL), a novel RL framework designed to strengthen LLMs' intrinsic focus on constraints. CARL introduces a constraint-aware reward by comparing the model's output distributions under constrained and unconstrained inputs, encouraging constraint focus and penalizing neglect. Compatible with various RL frameworks and requiring no external solvers or top models, CARL enables scalable, end-to-end constraint-aware planning. Extensive experiments on BlocksWorld, TravelPlanner, and T-Eval demonstrate that CARL significantly outperforms standard Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) baselines and state-of-the-art reasoning models, exhibiting a markedly increased focus on constraints.

title: Subcube Stifling
authors: Arjan Cornelissen, Nikhil S. Mande, Nithish Raja
abstract: We introduce the subcube stifling number, a new combinatorial measure of total Boolean functions. This measure is the largest integer $k$ such that, for every set $S$ of at most $k$ input variables and every assignment $b \in \{0,1\}^S$, there is a fixing of the variables outside $S$ under which the resulting function on the free variables $S$ is the point indicator $\mathbb{I}[x_S=b]$. Equivalently, for every small set of coordinates, the function can isolate any prescribed point of the corresponding Boolean cube by suitably fixing all remaining coordinates. This measure is inspired by the stifling number of Chattopadhyay et al.~(ITCS'23); whereas their measure asks for restrictions realizing every constant function, ours asks for restrictions realizing every point indicator. Our results are as follows. 1) We show that the subcube stifling number gives rise to an approximate-degree composition theorem. In particular, if a Boolean function $f$ has approximate degree $O(\sqrt{μ(f)})$, then for every Boolean function $g$, approximate degree composes tightly. This motivates the study of the subcube stifling number, and in particular the search for functions whose approximate degree is $O(\sqrt{μ(f)})$. 2) We show that a random Boolean function on $n$ input bits has subcube stifling number $Θ(\log(n))$ with high probability. 3) We show that indicators of linear codes over $\mathbb{F}_2$ whose minimum distance and dual distance are both linear have high subcube stifling number. 4) We prove that the functions arising from this linear-code construction do not have approximate degree $O(\sqrt{μ(f)})$; in fact, they have approximate degree $Ω(μ(f))$. The main question left open is whether there exists a Boolean function $f$ with approximate degree $Θ(\sqrt{μ(f)})$. A positive answer would yield new instances of tight approximate-degree composition.

title: SleepBand: Single-Source Domain Generalization for Sleep Staging via Physiologically Structured Spectral Modeling
authors: Zhi Lu, Yang Hu, Yan Chen
abstract: Generalizing sleep staging models to unseen datasets is challenging, and typical domain generalization (DG) methods often rely on multiple source domains or domain labels that are rarely available in practice. We tackle the stricter and more practical setting of single-source domain generalization: training on a single labeled source dataset, without domain labels or access to target data. We present SleepBand, a physiology-guided framework that embeds oscillatory priors via a learnable Morlet filter bank and a structured integration-and-recalibration pipeline. This anchors representations to domain-invariant sleep rhythms (e.g., slow waves, spindles), reducing reliance on dataset-specific artefacts. On five public datasets, SleepBand achieves state-of-the-art SDG performance and remains competitive under leave-one-domain-out (multi-source) DG. Analyses show that the learned filters align with canonical neurophysiology and that robustness stems from focusing on narrowband, physiologically meaningful cues. Our results suggest that principled, physiology-aware inductive biases are a promising path for robust single-domain sleep staging. Code is available at https://github.com/lzcn/sleep-band
zh_title: SleepBand：基于生理结构化谱建模的睡眠分期单源域泛化方法
translation: 将睡眠分期模型推广到未见的数据集具有挑战性，且典型的域泛化（DG）方法通常依赖于在实践中很少使用的多个源域或领域标签。我们解决了单源域泛化的更严格且更实用的设置：在没有领域标签或无法访问目标数据的情况下，仅在单个标记的源数据集上进行训练。我们提出了SleepBand，这是一个生理学指导的框架，它通过可学习的Morlet滤波器组和结构化的整合与重校准流水线嵌入振荡先验。这使得表示锚定在领域无关的睡眠节律（例如慢波、纺锤波）上，减少了对特定数据集伪影的依赖。在五个公共数据集上，SleepBand实现了最先进的单源域泛化性能，并在留一域（多源）域泛化下保持竞争力。分析表明，学习到的滤波器与典型的神经生理学一致，鲁棒性源于对窄带、具有生理意义线索的关注。我们的结果表明，有原则的、生理感知归纳偏置是实现稳健的单域睡眠分期的有希望的路径。代码可在 https://github.com/lzcn/sleep-band 获取。
tldr: SleepBand通过引入生理学先验知识，使睡眠分期模型在仅使用单源数据的情况下，能有效提取领域无关的生理节律，从而实现优异的跨数据集泛化性能。
ai_comments: 该研究通过将生理学先验知识（如睡眠波形特征）嵌入到模型架构中，有效地解决了睡眠分期在跨数据集泛化时的难题。其创新点在于不依赖多源域数据或领域标签，仅利用单源数据即可实现稳健的泛化，这在实际医疗应用中具有极高的实用价值。
motivation: 现有的睡眠分期模型在面对未见数据集时泛化能力较差，且典型的域泛化方法通常依赖于难以获取的多源数据或领域标签，因此需要一种在无领域标签的单源设置下实现泛化的方法。
method: 提出SleepBand框架，利用可学习的Morlet滤波器组嵌入振荡先验，并通过结构化的整合与重校准流水线，将特征锚定在领域无关的睡眠节律（如慢波、纺锤波）上。
results: 在五个公开数据集上达到了单源域泛化的最优性能，在留一域验证的多源域泛化设置下也保持了极强的竞争力，且学到的滤波器与经典神经生理学特征高度吻合。
conclusion: 基于生理学先验的归纳偏置是实现稳健的单源域泛化睡眠分期的有效途径，能够显著提升模型在未见数据集上的表现。

title: Terastate-per-second QUBO Brute-Force on a Single GPU: A Matrix Prefix-Suffix Decomposition
authors: Aleksandr Maltsev, Mikhail Remnev, Alexey Kapranov, Ekaterina Krivtsova
abstract: This paper presents a parallel QUBO exhaustive search algorithm for dense matrices, based on a prefix-suffix decomposition and Gray code ordering. The algorithm achieves O(1) per-state complexity: for the QUBO objective function computation only one arithmetic operation per state is performed. An adjustable energy components cache size enables placement in the fastest available memory tier. This reduces memory bandwidth requirements to a negligible level and transforms the problem from memory-bound to compute-bound. Our CUDA-based implementation achieves a state-of-the-art evaluation rate of $7.5\times10^{12}$ states per second on a single GPU, setting a new performance benchmark for the full-space-search subclass of exact solvers.

title: Framework for Grouping Local Process Models
authors: Viki Peeva, Wil M. P. van der Aalst
abstract: Local Process Models (LPMs) are an underexplored concept in process mining. LPMs describe patterns in event data considering sequence, choice, concurrency, and loop. In recent years, process mining has proved successful in the analysis and improvement of operational processes. More often than not, surprising findings are found when one does not consider the full process, making LPMs and their discovery highly valuable. However, similar to other pattern mining approaches, LPM discovery algorithms face the problems of model explosion and model repetition, i.e., the algorithms may create hundreds if not thousands of LPMs, and subsets of them are close in structure or behavior. Practically, no analyst would be able to comb through thousands of LPMs leading to using a sample of LPMs that are easily accessible. The current sentiment is that the top-scoring LPMs form the optimal sample to be presented. However, different applications should demand a different optimal sample. With this work, we show that if the goal of the mined LPMs is to understand a process, using the top-scoring LPMs as an optimal sample is a poor choice because of high repetition. We propose a framework for grouping LPMs and creating an optimal sample by taking one representative LPM for each group. We measure similarity between models via established process model similarity measures or by comparing the context in which an LPM appears. The context is formed using data attributes available in the underlying event logs. We demonstrate the usefulness of grouping on multiple event logs by comparing repetition and coverage between samples comprised of the top-scoring models and the representatives of discovered groups.

title: No Distributed Quantum Advantage for 3-Coloring Rooted Trees and 2-Coloring Even Cycles
authors: Pierre Fraigniaud, Frédéric Magniez, Isabella Ziccardi
abstract:
Significant effort has been devoted over the past decade to understanding whether quantum resources can provide advantages in distributed computing, and in particular whether they can help overcome locality constraints in networks, typically in Linial's LOCAL model. Recently, Coiteux-Roy~et~al.~(STOC 2024) showed that quantum resources do not help for 3-coloring \textit{unrooted} trees: in particular, their lower bound holds in the stronger \textit{non-signaling} model, which formalizes the principle of physical causality in distributed computing. The case of \textit{rooted} trees, however, was left open by their work.
  For rooted trees, the deterministic Cole-Vishkin algorithm 3-colors $n$-node trees in $O(\log^\star n)$ rounds, matching Linial's classical $Ω(\log^\star n)$ lower bound (FOCS 1987). In this paper, we show that any algorithm in quantum-LOCAL (without pre-shared entanglement) that properly 3-colors $n$-node rooted trees with probability at least ${1-O(1/\log n)}$ must perform $Ω(\log^\star n)$ rounds. That is, quantum resources provide no advantage for 3-coloring rooted trees. To get this result, we show a lower bound of $Ω(\log^\star Δ)$ for 3-coloring any $Δ$-ary tree with success probability at least $1-1/Δ$. The proof uses a \textit{color lifting} technique that bears similarity to Linial's original argument.
  We also show, as a separate result, that 2-coloring even-length $n$-node cycles with probability $1-O(1/n)$ requires $n/2-1$ rounds in the quantum-LOCAL model, even with pre-shared entangled states. This improves the previously known $\lceil (n-2)/4 \rceil$ lower bound of Gavoille, Kosowski, and Markiewicz (DISC 2009) by a factor of two, and shows that quantum algorithms cannot save even a single round over classical deterministic algorithms for 2-coloring even-length cycles.

title: PAGE: Towards Practical Human-level Gaze Target Estimation
authors: Zhoutong Ye, Chengwen Zhang, Zhaibin Cui, Mingze Sun, Jiaqi Liu, Xiangwu Li, Qingyang Wan, Chang Liu, Xutong Wang, Huan-ang Gao, Yu Mei, Chun Yu, Yuanchun Shi
abstract: Gaze target estimation, the task of predicting where a person is looking in a scene, is crucial to understanding human attention and intent. It is a challenging task that combines high-level understanding of global scene semantics and precise spatial reasoning using human appearance (e.g. pose, eye orientation). As a result, human-level performance remains elusive for existing models, limiting their practical application. To this end, we propose PaGE (Practical Gaze Estimator), a gaze estimation model that explicitly models the complex interaction between scene and head features. Using a PaGE model with a large ViT-H+ backbone as the teacher, we further distill student models with lighter backbones on a much larger and more diverse unlabeled dataset. The architectural improvements and novel training recipe allow PaGE to achieve state-of-the-art performance on several gaze estimation tasks, outperforming humans in 7 out of 9 metrics while reducing the human-AI gap by at least 60% in the remaining 2. The distilled student models retain most of the teacher's performance while being lightweight enough for practical deployment on robots and consumer devices. The code and model checkpoints are available at our project page.
zh_title: PaGE：迈向实用的类人注视目标估计
translation: 注视目标估计，即预测人在场景中看向何处，对于理解人类注意力和意图至关重要。这是一个极具挑战性的任务，需要结合对全局场景语义的高层理解以及利用人体外观（如姿态、眼睛方向）进行精确的空间推理。因此，现有模型难以达到人类水平，限制了其实际应用。为此，我们提出了PaGE（实用注视估计器），该模型明确建模了场景特征与头部特征之间的复杂交互。我们使用带有大型ViT-H+主干网络的PaGE模型作为教师模型，在更大且更多样化的无标注数据集上对轻量级主干网络进行学生模型蒸馏。架构的改进和新颖的训练配方使PaGE在多项注视估计任务上达到了最先进的性能，在9项指标中的7项超过了人类，并在其余2项中将人机差距缩小了至少60%。蒸馏后的学生模型保留了教师模型的大部分性能，同时足够轻量，可用于机器人和消费设备的实际部署。代码和模型检查点可在我们的项目页面获取。
tldr: PaGE通过架构优化和知识蒸馏，实现了超越人类水平的注视目标估计，并兼顾了轻量化部署需求。
ai_comments: 该论文通过知识蒸馏技术成功平衡了高精度与轻量化，不仅在性能上超越了人类水平，还显著提升了模型在实际机器人和消费级设备上的部署可行性，具有很高的实用价值。
motivation: 现有注视目标估计模型难以达到人类水平，且缺乏在实际设备上部署的实用性，无法满足对人类注意力和意图理解的需求。
method: 提出了PaGE模型，通过显式建模场景与头部特征的交互，并利用ViT-H+作为教师模型，对轻量级学生模型在海量无标注数据集上进行知识蒸馏。
results: PaGE在多项任务中达到SOTA水平，在9项指标中的7项超越人类，其余2项差距缩小至少60%，且蒸馏后的学生模型具备轻量化部署优势。
conclusion: PaGE通过架构优化和蒸馏策略，实现了超越人类的注视目标估计性能，并为实际应用提供了轻量化的高效模型。

title: Active Learning on Adversarially Corrupted Graphs
authors: Marco Bressan, Nicolò Cesa-Bianchi, Tommaso d`Orsi, Emmanuel Esposito, Silvio Lattanzi
abstract: Motivated by real-world scenarios where malicious entities tamper with existing networks, we define a model where an adversary seeks to hide a set of \emph{corrupted vertices} inside a graph $G^*$. To this end, the adversary can add edges between the corrupted vertices, as well as edges between the corrupted vertices and $G^*$, and its power is then measured by the size of the \emph{neighborhood} of the corrupted vertices in $G^*$. Our goal is to design an active learning algorithm that efficiently finds the subset of corrupted vertices using a small number of label queries. We devise an efficient algorithm that approximately recovers the corrupted vertices with a query complexity that depends polynomially on both the power of the adversary and the \emph{vertex expansion} of $G^*$, a fundamental measure of graph connectivity. At the heart of this result is a polynomial-time algorithm, obtained by carefully adapting sum-of-squares algorithms for approximating minimum expansion, that finds a set with small vertex expansion subject to cardinality constraints. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first time that the vertex expansion is shown to play a key role in determining the query complexity of active learning algorithms robust to structural adversarial attacks.

title: EventCoT: Event-centric Video Chain-of-thought for Reasoning Temporal Localization
authors: Youngkil Song, Yoonjae Baek, Dongwon Kim, Inho Kim, Dongkeun Kim, Suha Kwak
abstract: Reasoning temporal localization (RTL) requires a model to generate an answer that itself contains the time interval supporting it, so high-level reasoning and precise temporal grounding must be produced jointly in a single response. To tackle this challenging task, we propose the first event-centric video chain-of-thought framework, dubbed EventCoT. EventCoT first performs event-centric tokenization of the input video to convert it into compact event tokens, enabling efficient identification of question-relevant events. It then reasons within the identified events to generate the answer, grounding the time interval via embedding matching that aligns placeholder tokens with visual embeddings. EventCoT achieves state-of-the-art results on ActivityNet-RTL for reasoning temporal localization while using substantially fewer visual tokens than previous work. To verify its general performance, we further evaluate EventCoT on the grounded video question answering benchmark ReXTime, where it attains strong zero-shot results.
comment: 25 pages, 11 figures, 16 tables. Co-corresponding authors: Dongkeun Kim and Suha Kwak

title: Enhancing the Forecasting Capability of Multi-Model Blending Algorithms for Extreme Precipitation via Joint Use of Station and Gridded Observations
authors: Yu Wang, Yong Cao, Kan Dai, Yue Shen, Xiaoqing Zeng, Ruixia Zhao
abstract: Accurate extreme precipitation forecasting is critical for disaster mitigation but remains challenging for numerical weather prediction (NWP) models due to systemic intensity underestimation and spatial displacement. Traditional precipitation multi-model blending algorithms perform pixel-by-pixel blending on the forecast field based on weights, which may lead to the expansion of precipitation areas and the smoothing of extreme values. This study proposes an U-Net based two-stage framework: probability classification followed by value reconstruction, to blend forecasts from six major NWP models. A novel station-grid joint supervision mechanism is introduced by integrating observations from 2411 national meteorological stations in China into the loss function, simultaneously constraining spatial structures and peak intensities. Evaluations using independent samples from the 2025 flood season demonstrate that our model significantly outperforms both individual NWPs and current operational products. For rainstorms (>=50 mm), the Threat Score (TS) improved by 38.4% compared to the best NWP. Notably, for extreme events (>=100 mm) driven by extratropical cyclones and the subtropical high, the model successfully elevated the TS to above 0.1, transforming forecasts from having negligible reference value into those with certain operational utility. Furthermore, the model exhibits data-driven spatial correction capabilities, effectively realigning systematic rainbelt displacements with actual precipitation centers. The inclusion of station observations specifically enhanced the TS for rainstorms by 10.4% and effectively balanced the Bias. These results highlight the efficacy of multi-source joint supervision in enhancing the capture of extreme precipitation events.
zh_title: 通过联合使用站点和格点观测增强多模式融合算法对极端降水的预报能力
translation: 准确的极端降水预报对于防灾减灾至关重要，但由于数值天气预报（NWP）模型存在系统性的强度低估和空间位移，这仍然是一个挑战。传统的降水多模式融合算法基于权重对预报场进行逐像素融合，这可能导致降水区域的扩张和极端值的平滑。本研究提出了一种基于U-Net的两阶段框架：概率分类后进行数值重构，以融合六种主要NWP模型的预报。通过将中国2411个国家气象站的观测数据集成到损失函数中，引入了一种新颖的站点-格点联合监督机制，同时约束了空间结构和峰值强度。使用2025年汛期独立样本的评估表明，该模型显著优于单一NWP和现有的业务产品。对于暴雨（>=50 mm），威胁评分（TS）较最优NWP提高了38.4%。值得注意的是，对于由温带气旋和副热带高压驱动的极端事件（>=100 mm），该模型成功地将TS提高到0.1以上，使预报从几乎没有参考价值转变为具有一定的业务实用价值。此外，该模型表现出数据驱动的空间校正能力，有效地将系统性的雨带位移与实际降水中心重新对齐。站点观测的加入使暴雨的TS提高了10.4%，并有效地平衡了偏差。这些结果突显了多源联合监督在增强极端降水事件捕捉能力方面的有效性。
tldr: 研究提出了一种基于U-Net的两阶段融合框架，通过站点与格点联合监督，显著提升了极端降水预报的精度和业务参考价值。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入站点与格点联合监督机制，巧妙解决了传统多模式融合方法中存在的“平滑效应”和“极端降水强度低估”问题。将U-Net框架应用于降水融合并结合气象站点数据，不仅提升了预测精度，还为极端天气预报提供了具有实际业务价值的工具，具有很高的应用前景。
motivation: 数值天气预报（NWP）模型在预测极端降水时常存在强度低估和空间偏移问题，且传统的像素级融合算法容易导致降水区域扩张和极端值平滑。
method: 提出一种基于U-Net的两阶段框架（概率分类与数值重构），并引入站点-格点联合监督机制，将2411个国家气象站的观测数据集成至损失函数中，同时约束空间结构和峰值强度。
results: 在2025年汛期测试中，该模型表现显著优于单一NWP和现有业务产品。暴雨（>=50 mm）的威胁评分（TS）比最优NWP提升了38.4%；对于极端事件（>=100 mm），TS提升至0.1以上，具备了业务参考价值。此外，模型有效修正了雨带位移，站点观测的加入使暴雨TS进一步提升了10.4%。
conclusion: 通过联合使用站点和格点观测数据的两阶段U-Net框架，能够显著提高极端降水事件的预报能力，有效修正系统性偏差并提升极端值的捕捉精度。

title: Adaptive Diversity-Uncertainty Active Learning with Redundancy Control for Bioacoustic Event Classification
authors: Gabriel Dubus, Hugo Magaldi, Anatole Gros-Martial
abstract: Active learning is a promising framework for reducing annotation costs in large-scale bioacoustic monitoring, where expert labeling is expensive and data distributions are highly heterogeneous across environments. However, existing sample selection strategies often rely on static criteria that do not adapt to the evolving reliability of model predictions during training. This limitation can lead to suboptimal exploration-exploitation trade-offs and redundant sample selection. We propose an active learning strategy for multilabel bioacoustic event classification that jointly models predictive uncertainty, embedding-space diversity, and intra-batch redundancy. The method introduces an adaptive weighting scheme that progressively shifts from diversity-driven exploration in high-uncertainty regimes toward uncertainty-driven exploitation as the model becomes more confident, reflecting the increasing reliability of the classifier. To further improve annotation efficiency, a greedy Maximum Marginal Relevance (MMR) procedure is used to enforce diversity among selected samples within each acquisition batch. We evaluate the proposed approach within the BioDCASE 2026 Task 4 active learning framework on terrestrial (BirdSet) and marine (ATBFL) benchmarks using pretrained audio embeddings and a fixed annotation budget. Experimental results show consistent improvements in learning efficiency and competitive in terms of macro mean Average Precision (mAP) and Area Under the Learning Curve (AULC) across heterogeneous acoustic domains. The gains are particularly pronounced on structured terrestrial soundscapes, while performance remains competitive under noisier marine conditions. These findings demonstrate that adaptive acquisition strategies combining uncertainty estimation, embedding-space diversity, and redundancy-aware batch construction provide an effective and robust solution for [...].

title: PRISM: Personalized Robotic Dataset Generation via Image-based Scene and Motion Synthesis
authors: Dogyu Ko, Haneul Kim, Chanyoung Yeo, Dowoon Lee, Taeho Park, Hyoseok Hwang
abstract: Recent advances in large-scale pretrained vision-language-action models have improved robot policy learning, but directly deploying such policies in user-specific environments remains challenging due to limited generalization, which inevitably requires collecting a dataset tailored to the target environment. Teleoperation yields well-aligned data but is costly and difficult to scale, whereas simulation scales easily but struggles to resemble the target environment and generate task-specific trajectories. To meet both simultaneously, we propose PRISM, an end-to-end pipeline that generates personalized robotic datasets from a single image and a natural-language instruction. PRISM constructs digital cousin scenes that are semantically and geometrically aligned with the user environment yet diverse at the instance level, and synthesizes executable demonstrations without human teleoperation. Extensive experiments show that policies trained on PRISM-generated datasets outperform those trained on baseline-generated datasets on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, achieve up to 100\% success rate on three real-world manipulation tasks, and maintain stronger performance when evaluated in environments that differ from those seen during training.

title: Towards Fully Dynamic Omnitrees: Moment-Conserving Anisotropic Compression With Wavelets
authors: Theresa Pollinger, Masado Ishii, Jens Domke
abstract: Recently, omnitrees were introduced as a flexible space partitioning tree that improves upon the benefits of both octrees and k-d trees: Omnitrees' efficient encoding of anisotropic refinements holds particular interest for applications with anisotropic features and high dimensionality. These include, but are not limited to, computer graphics, databases, machine learning, and physics simulations. The present paper defines new operations on the omnitree encoding that extend its capabilities from the existing refinement to also include coarsening and therefore fully adaptive compression. It demonstrates natural integration of omnitrees with wavelets, which conserves moments of the stored function by design. For omnitrees, the wavelet coefficients can be interpreted as local refinement priorities, which can be used to guide the adaptation process. We derive algorithms for coarsening and downsplit that are guided by wavelet coefficients, and show their application to a large dataset of 3D shapes, as well as the continuous-valued density field of a cloud. The comparison to OpenVDB, a widely-used data structure for sparse volumetric data in computer graphics, enables a demonstration of the practical benefits of omnitrees even for moderately anisotropic three-dimensional data. Compared to OpenVDB, objects can be stored using up to 28x less space, and asymptotically show savings that exceed theoretical expectations. Using lossy compression, the cloud dataset can be compressed by $\approx5\times$ compared to OpenVDB, with negligible loss of visual quality. This demonstrates the potential of omnitrees for efficient storage and processing, and motivates further research into their applications in various domains.

title: WinTA-GIL: Windowed Trajectory Alignment for GNSS-IMU-LiDAR Heading Refinement in Intermittent Signal Environments
authors: Kaixin Feng, Zhichao Wen, Zhaohong Liao, Xin Xia, You Li
abstract: Although multi-source fusion positioning systems have achieved significant progress, accurate and reliable heading estimation remains a critical challenge due to the lack of gravitational constraints and the inherent weak observability of heading in complex environments. Most existing methodologies are specifically tailored for the startup phase, relying on a singular initial alignment to establish the heading reference. Consequently, these approaches lack the adaptability required to refine heading estimates dynamically, which renders the system highly vulnerable to accumulated drift and observation noise during prolonged navigation or immediately following GNSS signal outages. To address these limitations, this paper proposes WinTA-GIL, a novel heading refinement framework that integrates information from Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS), Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU), and Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) through a temporal window-based optimization strategy. Unlike conventional alignment methods restricted to the startup phase, WinTA-GIL leverages high-precision local trajectories from LiDAR-Inertial Odometry (LIO) to register against filtered GNSS observations. This approach transforms heading estimation into a repeatable, trajectory-based consistency optimization problem. In particular, an adaptive re-estimation mechanism based on state discrimination is incorporated to trigger heading corrections whenever necessary, thereby effectively suppressing the inertial drift accumulated during challenging conditions. Extensive experiments on both open-source and self-collected datasets demonstrate that WinTA-GIL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in both estimation accuracy and system robustness.

title: On the Complexity of Entrywise Power Matrix Factorization
authors: Nicolas Gillis, Subhayan Saha, Stefano Sicilia, Arnaud Vandaele
abstract: Given a nonnegative matrix $X$, a factorization rank $r$ and a real parameter $p$, entrywise power matrix factorization (EPMF) looks for a low-rank matrix $X_r$ such that $X = |X_r|^{\circ p}$ (exact case) or $X \approx |X_r|^{\circ p}$ (approximate case), where $(\cdot)^{\circ p}$ denotes the component-wise exponent. EPMF includes the modulus model ($p=1$) and component-wise square factorization ($p=2$) as special cases, the latter being closely related to the square root rank. We analyze the computational complexity of the exact decision problem and the Frobenius-norm approximation problem, and establish a complete complexity landscape. In the exact case, we show that EPMF is equivalent to the combinatorial problem of flipping the signs of the entries of a given matrix $X$ to obtain a rank-$r$ matrix, which we refer to as the signing problem. We first show that the signing problem, and hence exact EPMF, is strongly NP-hard, improving a weak NP-hardness result for the square-root-rank of Fawzi et al. (Math. Prog., 2015). We then show that the signing problem can be solved in polynomial-time when $r$ is fixed. Moreover, when the rank $r$ is part of the input, we show that for generic matrices the algorithm is fixed-parameter tractable (FPT) in the parameter $r$; in fact, the running time is linear in the input size $X$. In the approximate case using the Frobenius norm as an error measure, we show that EPMF is NP-hard, already when $r=2$, the smallest nontrivial case.

title: Unsupervised Detection of Underground Tunnels in Ground-Penetrating Radar Using Depth-Restricted Reconstruction Scoring
authors: Muhammad Junaid, Shoab A. Khan, Nisar Ahmed
abstract: Clandestine tunneling beneath oil and gas pipelines enables fuel theft, smuggling, and sabotage, yet conventional monitoring detects damage only after a pipeline has been compromised. Ground-penetrating radar (GPR) can image such tunnels non-invasively, but manual radargram interpretation does not scale to continuous corridor surveillance, and supervised detectors require tunnel examples that are scarce in practice. We present a fully unsupervised detection pipeline trained exclusively on normal subsurface radargrams collected at a purpose-built field site containing three buried tunnels at 1.5-3 m depth. A denoising convolutional autoencoder learns the structure of anomaly-free ground; at inference, tunnels are flagged by reconstruction error. Our central contribution is a depth-restricted top-k anomaly score, which pools the highest reconstruction errors only within the depth band where tunnels can physically occur. This physically motivated rule raises AUC from 0.986 to 0.994 and cuts missed detections from 74 to 17 of 634 tunnel windows, relative to whole-image scoring, without any retraining or labels. We further show that the optimal top-k fraction interacts with the depth restriction - 1% pooling is best on full images, 5% once scoring is depth-restricted - and that spatial voting across overlapping survey windows helps weak per-image detectors but offers no benefit once the scoring rule is strong. The final system attains AUC 0.994, F1 0.975, recall 0.973, and precision 0.976 on 1,600 field test windows spanning 55 survey lines, at a 1.6% false-alarm rate, using no tunnel labels for training, scoring, or threshold calibration.

title: Strong ILP Formulations for the p-Regions Problem
authors: Daniel Faber, Jan-Henrik Haunert, Petra Mutzel
abstract: Regionalization is a fundamental task in spatial analysis that seeks to partition a larger area - such as a country - into smaller regions that are homogeneous with respect to a given attribute. A popular model for regionalization is the p-regions problem, in which regions are formed by grouping the areas of an input planar subdivision. Given the subdivision's adjacency graph G and pairwise dissimilarities between vertices, the goal is to partition G into a fixed number p of connected subgraphs, such as to minimize the sum of dissimilarities over all vertex pairs in the same subgraph. The problem is NP-hard and even small instances are difficult to solve to provable optimality. In this paper, we present the new ILP model ER-S for the p-regions problem, exploiting a connection between the p-regions objective and the k-partitioning problem. Furthermore, we strengthen the known ILP model Tree with a new type of subtour elimination inequality specific to the p-regions problem. Combining ER-S and the strengthened version of Tree yields the model ER-S-Tree, which dominates the state-of-the-art models in polyhedral strength. This theoretical advantage is reflected in its superior performance in our experimental evaluation. In particular, the new models ER-S and ER-S-Tree enable the solution of problem instances for major European countries that were previously intractable.

title: HunyuanOCR-1.5: Making Lightweight OCR VLMs Faster and Better
authors: Gengluo Li, Xingyu Wan, Shangpin Peng, Weinong Wang, Hao Feng, Yongkun Du, Binghong Wu, Zheng Ruan, Zhiqiong Lu, Liang Wu, Pengyuan Lyu, Huawen Shen, Zibin Lin, Shijing Hu, Jieneng Yang, Hongbing Wen, Guanghua Yu, Hong Liu, Bochao Wang, Can Ma, Han Hu, Chengquan Zhang, Yu Zhou
abstract: We present HunyuanOCR-1.5, a lightweight end-to-end OCR-specialized vision-language model. HunyuanOCR unifies document parsing, text spotting, information extraction, text-image translation, and multi-image document understanding within a single end-to-end VLM. Building upon the lightweight architecture of HunyuanOCR-1.0, HunyuanOCR-1.5 does not redesign the backbone, but systematically improves both efficiency and capability. For efficiency, we adapt DFlash to OCR decoding, significantly reducing the latency of long structured outputs such as dense documents, tables, and formulas while preserving output distribution. Powered by DFlash, HunyuanOCR-1.5 achieves a 6.37x Transformer inference speedup and a 2.14x speedup under vLLM, delivering the fastest inference among lightweight OCR VLMs. For capability, we propose Agentic Data Flow, an agent-driven data construction system that transforms model weaknesses into executable data requirements and autonomously performs material search, quality verification, and pipeline development. It substantially improves long-tail capabilities in ancient-script OCR, fine-grained chart and table parsing, multi-image text-centric QA, low-resource multilingual parsing, and document hallucination evaluation. HunyuanOCR-1.5 ranks among the top-tier end-to-end OCR solutions on OmniDocBench v1.6 while achieving new performance milestones across these long-tail tasks. Combined with an upgraded pretraining and post-training recipe, HunyuanOCR-1.5 further extends its capability in high-resolution, long-context, and multi-task scenarios. Experiments demonstrate faster inference, broader OCR capability coverage, and the deployment advantages of a lightweight end-to-end model. We will release the model weights and training code to support future research and real-world OCR applications.

title: Ossetic-COT: Designing a morphologically annotated corpus and morphological analyzer for Ossetic
authors: Anna Shatskikh, Alexey Sorokin
abstract: In this work we present the first morphologically annotated corpus for Iron Ossetic that conforms to the Universal Dependencies schema. The corpus includes 5454 manually annotated sentences from the Iron Ossetic Corpus of Oral Texts, containing 74032 tokens. We use this corpus to train a BERT-based morphological analyzer. The analyzer achieves tag accuracy of 95.60%.

title: Symmetry all the way down
authors: Ignacio Amores-Sesar, Christian Cachin, Simon Holmgaard Kamp, Juan Villacis
abstract:
Asymmetric trust generalizes classical symmetric quorum systems by allowing each process to specify its own failure assumptions. While this flexibility enables tolerance of strictly more failure scenarios, it is not known if, in these cases, it is actually possible to solve distributed tasks, and if so, which.
  We answer this question using the depth hierarchy for asymmetric trust (Amores-Sesar et al., OPODIS~'25), which characterizes how much a process must rely on others to solve a task. We prove that asymmetric trust does not increase the solvability of tasks requiring depth two or more, such as reliable broadcast or consensus. Specifically, for any Byzantine asymmetric quorum system, every failure scenario that permits solving a task requiring depth at least two can also be tolerated by a suitably constructed Byzantine symmetric quorum system. We show this via a compiler that transforms asymmetric quorum systems into symmetric ones.
  The additional failure patterns tolerated exclusively by asymmetric trust correspond to scenarios in which only simpler tasks requiring depth one or less (such as consistent broadcast) can be solved. We further prove that this result is tight in the depth hierarchy, meaning that there exist no compilers that produce symmetric quorum systems that are valid also in failure scenarios where correct processes have depths one or less.
  Our results clarify the precise power of asymmetric trust. While it strictly enlarges the set of tolerable failure patterns, it does not provide additional strength for solving tasks requiring depth two or higher.

title: ProCon: Projection-Consistency Memory for Training-Free Anomaly Detection
authors: Joongwon Chae, Lihui Luo, Yang Liu, Dongmei Yu, Peiwu Qin, Runming Wang, Ilmoon Chae
abstract: Memory-based anomaly detection is attractive because it localizes defects from normal images without training a decoder or synthesizing pseudo anomalies. However, most memory methods still use the memory bank as a nearest-neighbor lookup table: a test patch is treated as normal if it has one nearby normal anchor. This hard retrieval view is vulnerable to false-normal matches and does not test whether the patch is consistently supported by a local normal neighborhood. We propose ProCon, a training-free framework that turns memory retrieval into decoder-free reconstruction. ProCon softly projects each test patch onto nearby normal memory vectors and uses the projection residual as anomaly evidence. To stabilize this residual, it constructs seed-perturbed layer-wise memories, aggregates bank residuals by a median, and fuses depth-specific residual maps by layer consensus. ProCon requires no decoder training, backbone fine-tuning, learned fusion weights, or pseudo-anomaly supervision. Across MVTec-AD, VisA, and Real-IAD under the single-category evaluation protocol, ProCon achieves strong image- and pixel-level performance under seven standard metrics, including image AUROC scores of 99.8%, 99.2%, and 93.2%, respectively. Ablations show that the gains come from replacing hard retrieval with soft normal projection and stabilizing the residuals through memory and depth consensus. The code is available at https://github.com/jw-chae/Procon

title: An Equivalence result for sketched Anderson Acceleration and sketched GMRES
authors: Alberto Bucci, Fabio Durastante
abstract: In this paper we present an equivalence result between a randomized version of Anderson Acceleration and of randomized GMRES for linear problems. Namely, we extend the classical result of Walker and Ni (2011) to the case in which the least-squares problem in Anderson Acceleration is solved in a sketched space defined by a random projection. This equivalence suggests potential avenues for further research in the design and analysis of randomized acceleration methods.

title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Antisemitic Incident Classification
authors: Karina Halevy, Julia Mendelsohn, Chan Young Park, Yulia Tsvetkov, Maarten Sap
abstract: Addressing hate and violence in society requires timely detection of hateful events from public reporting, but automated identification of hateful events remains underexplored. We introduce the task of hateful event detection and investigate the ability of AI systems, specifically large language models (LLMs), to discover and classify reports of antisemitic events with fine-grained labels. We evaluate OpenAI's GPT-4o and Meta's Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct on multiple expert-annotated datasets containing antisemitic event descriptions from news articles, civil society reports, and official records. We show that LLMs, particularly GPT-4o, have potential for this task, but substantial improvement is needed. Providing clear term definitions and in-context examples in prompts can improve performance: definitions are most helpful for rhetoric-oriented events (e.g. classical antisemitic tropes), while examples help label action-oriented events (e.g. physical assault). A case study of college newspapers demonstrates that LLMs can help surface relevant real-world events, supporting early monitoring and intervention. Overall, our findings highlight both opportunities and critical gaps in AI's ability to recognize complex harms and underscore the need for collaborative efforts among AI developers, policymakers, and civil society to design models, implement robust evaluation, and develop policy frameworks for defining and combating hate efficiently and effectively.
