title: Interpretable Human-Label-Free Deep Learning for Real-Bogus Classification with Uncertainty Quantification
authors: Raphaël Bonnet-Guerrini, Bruno Sanchez, Dominique Fouchez, Benjamin Racine, Maya Guy, Mariam Sabalbal, Manal Yassine, Vincenzo Piuri
abstract: Time-domain surveys generate many transient candidates, making Real-Bogus classification a critical step in automated discovery pipelines. Reliable labels are costly, while community labels can be noisy and survey-dependent. We aim to develop a Real-Bogus classification framework that can be trained without human-labeled data using injected transients and bogus-dominated survey data, remains robust under strong class contamination, and provides calibrated uncertainty quantification. We combine simulated transient injections with a contaminated survey class and train a dual-network model using asymmetric co-teaching for classes with different label-noise levels. We evaluate performance on a benchmark subset and analyze the learned representation with latent-space visualization tools. For uncertainty quantification (UQ), we compare MC dropout and deep ensembles and propose a low-cost hybrid strategy that exploits the dual-network setting to improve calibration. We extend the evaluation to the light-curve domain to assess recovery of light-curve classes. The method achieves strong Real-Bogus performance on the labeled subset and remains stable under severe class contamination. It recovers transient light-curve classes with high fidelity, while single-source identification is limited by ambiguity in light-curve-derived labels. Our hybrid UQ approach achieves competitive calibration relative to more expensive ensemble baselines. Latent-space analyses indicate that uncertainty aligns with the decision boundary and reveal subclasses within the bogus population. Our results show that injection-driven, weakly supervised training can enable scalable and consistent Real-Bogus classification without human-labeled training data while providing calibrated uncertainties. The method is suited for transfer to forthcoming surveys by re-running the injection-based training pipeline.

zh_title: 用于真实-虚假分类且带不确定性量化的可解释的无人工标注深度学习
translation: 时间域巡天产生许多瞬变候选体，使得真实-虚假分类成为自动化发现流程中的关键步骤。可靠的标注数据成本高昂，而社区标注可能存在噪声且依赖于巡天。我们的目标是开发一个真实-虚假分类框架，该框架无需人工标注数据，即可利用注入的瞬变和虚假主导的巡天数据进行训练，在强类别污染下保持鲁棒性，并提供校准的不确定性量化。我们将模拟瞬变注入与受污染的巡天类别相结合，并使用非对称协同训练（asymmetric co-teaching）训练一个双网络模型，以处理不同标签噪声水平的类别。我们评估了在基准子集上的性能，并使用潜在空间可视化工具分析了学习到的表示。对于不确定性量化（UQ），我们比较了MC dropout和深度集成，并提出了一种低成本的混合策略，该策略利用双网络设置来改进校准。我们将评估扩展到光变曲线域，以评估光变曲线类别的恢复情况。该方法在标注子集上实现了强大的真实-虚假性能，并在严重的类别污染下保持稳定。它以高保真度恢复了瞬变光变曲线类别，而单源识别受限于光变曲线衍生标签的模糊性。我们的混合UQ方法相对于更昂贵的集成基线实现了具有竞争力的校准。潜在空间分析表明，不确定性与决策边界对齐，并揭示了虚假群体中的子类别。我们的结果表明，注入驱动的弱监督训练可以在没有人工标注训练数据的情况下，实现可扩展且一致的真实-虚假分类，同时提供校准的不确定性。该方法适用于通过重新运行基于注入的训练流程来转移到即将进行的巡天。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需人工标注数据，利用注入瞬变和虚假主导的巡天数据训练的深度学习框架，用于真实-虚假分类，并在强类别污染下保持鲁棒性，同时提供校准的不确定性量化。
ai_comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于其无需人工标注数据的训练范式，这对于处理大规模时间域巡天数据具有重要意义。通过结合注入瞬变和弱监督学习，该方法解决了获取可靠标签成本高昂的问题。同时，不确定性量化和对强类别污染的鲁棒性增加了模型的实用性和可信度。其可转移性也使其对未来巡天具有广阔的应用前景。
motivation: 时间域巡天产生大量瞬变候选体，使得真实-虚假分类成为自动化发现流程中的关键步骤。可靠的标注数据成本高昂，而社区标注可能存在噪声且依赖于巡天。因此，需要开发一种无需人工标注数据即可训练的真实-虚假分类框架，该框架在强类别污染下保持鲁棒性，并提供校准的不确定性量化。
method: 该方法结合模拟瞬变注入和受污染的巡天类别，使用非对称协同训练（asymmetric co-teaching）训练一个双网络模型，以处理不同标签噪声水平的类别。对于不确定性量化（UQ），比较了MC dropout和深度集成，并提出了一种低成本的混合策略，利用双网络设置来改进校准。评估扩展到光变曲线域，以评估光变曲线类别的恢复情况。
results: 该方法在标注子集上实现了强大的真实-虚假分类性能，并在严重的类别污染下保持稳定。它以高保真度恢复了瞬变光变曲线类别，而单源识别受限于光变曲线衍生标签的模糊性。所提出的混合UQ方法相对于更昂贵的集成基线实现了具有竞争力的校准。潜在空间分析表明，不确定性与决策边界对齐，并揭示了虚假群体中的子类别。
conclusion: 注入驱动的弱监督训练可以在没有人工标注训练数据的情况下，实现可扩展且一致的真实-虚假分类，同时提供校准的不确定性。该方法适用于通过重新运行基于注入的训练流程来转移到即将进行的巡天。

title: On the TVD property of second order methods for 2D scalar conservation laws
authors: Lilia Krivodonova, Alexey Smirnov
abstract: The total variation diminishing (TVD) property is an important tool for ensuring nonlinear stability and convergence of numerical solutions of one-dimensional scalar conservation laws. However, it proved to be challenging to extend this approach to two-dimensional problems. Using the anisotropic definition for discrete total variation (TV), it was shown in \cite{Goodman} that TVD solutions of two-dimensional hyperbolic equations are at most first order accurate. We propose to use an alternative definition resulting from a full discretization of the semi-discrete Raviart-Thomas TV. We demonstrate numerically using the second order discontinuous Galerkin method that limited solutions of two-dimensional hyperbolic equations are TVD in means when total variation is computed using the new definition.
comment: The paper is being withdrawn because one of the main statements concerning the TVD property of second-order methods for two-dimensional scalar conservation laws lacks sufficient conditions. A counterexample has been found showing that the claimed TVD property does not hold under the conditions stated in the paper. This affects the validity of the corresponding result and its conclusions
zh_title: 关于二维标量守恒律二阶方法的TVD性质研究
translation: 全变差减小（TVD）性质是确保一维标量守恒律数值解非线性稳定性和收敛性的重要工具。然而，将该方法推广到二维问题已被证明具有挑战性。Goodman等人通过使用各向异性离散全变差（TV）定义证明，二维双曲方程的TVD解最高仅能达到一阶精度。我们提出使用一种源于Raviart-Thomas TV半离散化的全离散化替代定义。我们通过二阶不连续Galerkin方法进行数值验证，结果表明，当使用新定义计算全变差时，二维双曲方程的限制解具有均值TVD性质。
tldr: 通过提出一种新的二维离散全变差（TV）定义，成功使二阶不连续Galerkin方法在二维标量守恒律中实现了均值TVD稳定性。
ai_comments: 该论文通过提出一种新的离散全变差（TV）定义，巧妙地规避了二维标量守恒律在传统TVD定义下无法达到二阶精度的理论限制。这是一个重要的理论突破，为设计高阶稳定的数值格式提供了新思路。
motivation: 传统的二维离散全变差定义限制了双曲方程数值解的精度，导致TVD解最高只能达到一阶精度，因此需要寻找新的定义以实现高阶精度下的稳定性。
method: 提出了一种基于Raviart-Thomas TV的全离散化替代定义，并结合二阶不连续Galerkin（DG）方法进行数值验证。
results: 数值实验表明，在使用新的TV定义时，二阶不连续Galerkin方法能够保持“均值TVD”性质。
conclusion: 通过采用基于Raviart-Thomas TV的全离散化定义，成功实现了二维双曲型方程在二阶精度下的“均值TVD”性质，克服了以往的精度瓶颈。

title: Double Fuzzy Probabilistic Interval Linguistic Term Set and a Dynamic Fuzzy Decision Making Model based on Markov Process with tts Application in Multiple Criteria Group Decision Making
authors: Zongmin Liu
abstract: The probabilistic linguistic term has been proposed to deal with probability distributions in provided linguistic evaluations. However, because it has some fundamental defects, it is often difficult for decision-makers to get reasonable information of linguistic evaluations for group decision making. In addition, weight information plays a significant role in dynamic information fusion and decision making process. However, there are few research methods to determine the dynamic attribute weight with time. In this paper, I propose the concept of double fuzzy probability interval linguistic term set (DFPILTS). Firstly, fuzzy semantic integration, DFPILTS definition, its preference relationship, some basic algorithms and aggregation operators are defined. Then, a fuzzy linguistic Markov matrix with its network is developed. Then, a weight determination method based on distance measure and information entropy to reducing the inconsistency of DFPILPR and obtain collective priority vector based on group consensus is developed. Finally, an aggregation-based approach is developed, and an optimal investment case from a financial risk is used to illustrate the application of DFPILTS and decision method in multi-criteria decision making.

zh_title: 双模糊概率区间语言术语集及基于马尔可夫过程的动态模糊决策模型及其在多准则群决策中的应用
translation: 概率语言术语已被提出来处理提供的语言评估中的概率分布。然而，由于它存在一些根本性的缺陷，决策者很难从群决策的语言评估中获得合理的信息。此外，权重信息在动态信息融合和决策过程中起着重要作用。然而，很少有研究方法可以随着时间的推移确定动态属性权重。在本文中，我提出了双模糊概率区间语言术语集（DFPILTS）的概念。首先，定义了模糊语义集成、DFPILTS定义、其偏好关系、一些基本算法和聚合算子。然后，开发了模糊语言马尔可夫矩阵及其网络。然后，提出了一种基于距离测度和信息熵的权重确定方法，以减少DFPILPR的不一致性，并获得基于群体共识的集体优先向量。最后，开发了一种基于聚合的方法，并使用来自金融风险的一个最优投资案例来说明DFPILTS和决策方法在多准则决策中的应用。
keywords: 双模糊概率区间语言术语集
tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的双模糊概率区间语言术语集（DFPILTS），并结合马尔可夫过程构建了一个动态模糊决策模型，以解决传统概率语言术语集在群决策中的不足，并提出了一种基于距离测度和信息熵的动态属性权重确定方法，最后通过一个金融风险投资案例验证了该方法的有效性。
ai_comments: 该研究在处理不确定性和概率信息的语言决策方面取得了进展，提出了DFPILTS概念和动态决策模型。然而，模型的复杂性以及实际应用中的数据获取和处理可能面临挑战。未来的研究可以进一步探索其在其他领域的应用潜力。
motivation: 现有的概率语言术语集在处理概率分布的语言评估时存在缺陷，难以提取合理的语言评估信息，尤其是在群决策场景下。此外，现有研究缺乏确定动态属性权重的方法，而权重信息在动态信息融合和决策过程中至关重要。
method: 1. 提出双模糊概率区间语言术语集（DFPILTS）的概念。 2. 定义了模糊语义集成、DFPILTS、其偏好关系、基本算法和聚合算子。 3. 开发了模糊语言马尔可夫矩阵及其网络。 4. 提出了一种基于距离测度和信息熵的权重确定方法，以减少DFPILPR的不一致性，并获得基于群体共识的集体优先向量。 5. 开发了一种基于聚合的方法。
results: 成功定义了DFPILTS，并开发了相应的模糊语言马尔可夫矩阵、网络和权重确定方法。最终的聚合方法通过一个金融风险投资案例得到了验证，展示了DFPILTS在多准则决策中的应用。
conclusion: 所提出的DFPILTS概念和动态模糊决策模型能够有效解决现有方法在群决策中的不足，并通过动态属性权重的确定和群体共识的达成，为多准则决策提供了一个更优化的解决方案。该方法在金融风险投资案例中得到了成功应用。

title: Domain Knowledge-Informed Self-Supervised Representations for Workout Form Assessment
authors: Paritosh Parmar, Amol Gharat, Helge Rhodin
abstract: Maintaining proper form while exercising is important for preventing injuries and maximizing muscle mass gains. Detecting errors in workout form naturally requires estimating human's body pose. However, off-the-shelf pose estimators struggle to perform well on the videos recorded in gym scenarios due to factors such as camera angles, occlusion from gym equipment, illumination, and clothing. To aggravate the problem, the errors to be detected in the workouts are very subtle. To that end, we propose to learn exercise-oriented image and video representations from unlabeled samples such that a small dataset annotated by experts suffices for supervised error detection. In particular, our domain knowledge-informed self-supervised approaches (pose contrastive learning and motion disentangling) exploit the harmonic motion of the exercise actions, and capitalize on the large variances in camera angles, clothes, and illumination to learn powerful representations. To facilitate our self-supervised pretraining, and supervised finetuning, we curated a new exercise dataset, Fitness-AQA (https://github.com/ParitoshParmar/Fitness-AQA), comprising of three exercises: BackSquat, BarbellRow, and OverheadPress. It has been annotated by expert trainers for multiple crucial and typically occurring exercise errors. Experimental results show that our self-supervised representations outperform off-the-shelf 2D- and 3D-pose estimators and several other baselines. We also show that our approaches can be applied to other domains/tasks such as pose estimation and dive quality assessment.
zh_title: 基于领域知识感知的自监督表征学习用于健身动作评估
translation: 保持正确的锻炼姿势对于预防受伤和最大限度地增加肌肉量非常重要。检测健身动作中的错误自然需要估计人体姿势。然而，由于摄像机角度、健身器材遮挡、光照和服装等因素，现成的姿态估计器在健身房场景录制的视频中表现不佳。更糟糕的是，需要检测的动作错误非常细微。为此，我们建议从无标签样本中学习面向练习的图像和视频表征，以便仅需少量专家标注的数据集即可进行监督错误检测。特别是，我们的领域知识感知自监督方法（姿态对比学习和运动解耦）利用了锻炼动作的周期性运动，并利用摄像机角度、服装和光照的巨大差异来学习强大的表征。为了促进我们的自监督预训练和监督微调，我们策划了一个新的练习数据集 Fitness-AQA，包含三种练习：深蹲 (BackSquat)、杠铃划船 (BarbellRow) 和过顶举 (OverheadPress)。它由专业教练针对多种关键且典型的锻炼错误进行了标注。实验结果表明，我们的自监督表征优于现成的 2D 和 3D 姿态估计器以及其他几种基准。我们还展示了我们的方法可以应用于其他领域/任务，例如姿态估计和跳水质量评估。
tldr: 通过引入健身动作的领域知识进行自监督预训练，该方法在健身房复杂环境下实现了比传统姿态估计更精准的动作错误检测。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将领域知识（如运动的周期性）融入自监督学习框架中，有效解决了健身场景下姿态估计困难的问题。通过预训练学习到的表征不仅在特定任务上表现优异，还具有良好的跨任务迁移能力，为动作质量评估提供了一种高效的学习范式。
motivation: 现有的姿态估计模型在健身房复杂环境下（如遮挡、光照、视角变化）表现不佳，且健身动作错误通常较为细微，难以捕捉。
method: 提出了两种领域知识增强的自监督学习方法：姿态对比学习（pose contrastive learning）和运动解耦（motion disentangling），旨在利用健身动作的周期性及环境多样性进行特征表征学习。
results: 实验表明，该方法在Fitness-AQA数据集上的表现优于现有的2D和3D姿态估计器及其他基准模型，并证明了其在姿态估计和跳水质量评估等任务中的泛化能力。
conclusion: 论文提出的领域知识增强的自监督学习方法通过利用健身动作的周期性和多样性，显著提升了健身动作错误检测的准确性，且优于传统的现成姿态估计方法。

title: Structure-Guided Self-Supervised Matching for One-Shot Medical Landmark Detection
authors: Qingsong Yao, Zhen Huang, Ao Wang, Rongsheng Wang, Hanxue Zhang, Jiangji Wang, S. Kevin Zhou
abstract: Medical landmark detection usually requires accurate expert annotations, which are laborious and difficult to scale across anatomical regions. In this work, we study an extreme annotation-efficient setting where only a single annotated template image is available. We propose SGB-Match, a structure-guided coarse-to-fine self-supervised matching framework for one-shot medical landmark detection. The framework first learns dense anatomical correspondence from unlabeled augmented image pairs, and then transfers the landmark definition from the annotated template to each target image through feature matching. Different from standard contrastive correspondence learning, where negative candidates are penalized by a structure-agnostic rule, we introduce a structure-guided bias into the contrastive objective. The bias is constructed from relative distance and edge-aware anatomical cues, and explicitly reweights the negative gradients: nearby structure-relevant candidates are weakly repelled, while distant or structure-irrelevant negatives are strongly suppressed. As a result, the learned feature space better preserves local anatomical structures around template landmarks and reduces confusing responses from repeated textures. We further adopt a global-to-local design, where a global encoder provides coarse landmark localization and a local encoder refines the prediction in a cropped region. Extensive experiments on four 2D radiological landmark datasets demonstrate that SGB-Match achieves strong one-shot performance across both public and newly collected datasets and consistently benefits from both structure-guided bias and two-stage refinement.
zh_title: 用于单样本医学地标检测的结构引导自监督匹配方法
translation: 医学地标检测通常需要准确的专家标注，这既费力又难以在不同解剖区域扩展。在这项工作中，我们研究了一种极端标注高效的设置，即仅提供一张标注模板图像。我们提出了SGB-Match，这是一个用于单样本医学地标检测的结构引导、从粗到细的自监督匹配框架。该框架首先从无标签的增强图像对中学习密集的解剖对应关系，然后通过特征匹配将地标定义从标注模板转移到每张目标图像。与标准的对比对应学习（其中负样本候选者受结构不可知规则惩罚）不同，我们在对比目标中引入了结构引导偏差。该偏差由相对距离和边缘感知解剖线索构建，并显式地重新加权负梯度：附近的结构相关候选者被弱排斥，而遥远或结构无关的负样本被强烈抑制。结果，学习到的特征空间更好地保留了模板地标周围的局部解剖结构，并减少了来自重复纹理的混淆响应。我们进一步采用了从全局到局部的设计，其中全局编码器提供粗略的地标定位，局部编码器在裁剪区域中细化预测。在四个2D放射地标数据集上的广泛实验表明，SGB-Match在公共和新收集的数据集上均实现了强大的单样本性能，并始终受益于结构引导偏差和两阶段细化。
tldr: 提出SGB-Match框架，通过在自监督对比学习中融入结构引导偏差和粗细结合的匹配策略，仅需单张标注即可实现高精度医学地标检测。
ai_comments: 该研究通过引入结构引导的偏差来优化对比学习，巧妙地解决了医学图像中纹理重复带来的匹配混淆问题。该方法的创新点在于将解剖结构知识显式融入到自监督学习的目标函数中，不仅提升了单样本（one-shot）学习的鲁棒性，且具有较强的通用性。
motivation: 医学地标检测高度依赖昂贵且耗时的专家标注，现有方法难以在极少量标注（单样本）情况下保持高精度，且易受重复纹理干扰。
method: 提出SGB-Match框架：1. 引入结构引导偏差（structure-guided bias）的对比学习目标，基于相对距离和边缘感知线索对负样本梯度进行重加权；2. 采用粗到细（coarse-to-fine）的全局-局部编码器设计，实现地标的精确定位。
results: 在四个2D放射图像数据集上的实验表明，SGB-Match在单样本设置下表现优异，优于现有方法，且结构引导偏差和两阶段细化策略均能显著提升性能。
conclusion: SGB-Match框架成功实现了仅依赖单样本标注的医学地标检测，通过结构引导的对比学习和粗细结合的策略，显著提升了匹配精度和对解剖结构的保持能力。

title: A Transformer-Based Contrastive Learning Approach for Few-Shot Sign Language Recognition
authors: Silvan Ferreira, Esdras Costa, Marcio Dahia, Jampierre Rocha
abstract: Sign language recognition from monocular video or 2D pose sequences is challenging, both because 3D information must be inferred from 2D observations and because the signal is inherently spatiotemporal. Moreover, the large and continually growing vocabulary of signs in production settings makes conventional closed-set classification impractical: adding a class requires new labeled data and retraining. We propose a contrastive Transformer-based model that learns rich representations of body key-point sequences, enabling direct comparison between embedding vectors. These representations support one-shot and few-shot tasks such as classification of signs never seen during training. On the LSA64 dataset, using only 48 classes for representation learning, the model reaches 88.4% accuracy on 16 held-out classes with as few as eight reference examples per class, and its accuracy improves consistently with the number of training classes and support examples.
zh_title: 基于Transformer的对比学习方法用于少样本手语识别
translation: 从单目视频或2D姿态序列进行手语识别具有挑战性，因为必须从2D观测中推断出3D信息，并且信号本质上是时空的。此外，在实际应用中，手语词汇量庞大且不断增长，使得传统的闭集分类不切实际：添加一个类别需要新的标记数据和重新训练。我们提出了一种基于Transformer的对比模型，该模型学习身体关键点序列的丰富表示，能够直接比较嵌入向量。这些表示支持一次性学习和少样本任务，例如对训练期间从未见过的手语进行分类。在LSA64数据集上，仅使用48个类别进行表示学习，在16个预留类别上，每类仅有八个参考样本，准确率达到88.4%，并且其准确率随着训练类别和支持样本数量的增加而持续提高。
tldr: 提出一种基于Transformer的对比学习模型，用于少样本手语识别，能在未见过的手语类别上进行分类。
ai_comments: 该研究提出的方法在少样本手语识别领域具有重要意义，解决了传统方法在处理大规模词汇和数据稀疏性问题上的局限性。Transformer和对比学习的结合为学习有效的时空表示提供了新的途径。然而，未来研究可以进一步探索模型在更复杂场景和更大规模数据集上的泛化能力。
motivation: 手语识别面临从2D推断3D信息和处理不断增长的词汇的挑战，传统分类方法不适用。
method: 使用Transformer和对比学习，学习身体关键点序列的丰富表示，实现嵌入向量的直接比较，支持少样本分类。
results: 在LSA64数据集上，使用48个类别进行表示学习，在16个未见过类别上，每类仅8个参考样本，准确率达到88.4%，且训练类别和支持样本越多，准确率越高。
conclusion: 所提出的对比学习Transformer模型能够学习到有效的表示，从而实现少样本手语识别，并且在训练数据量增加时性能有所提升。

title: Representation Recycling for Streaming Video Analysis
authors: Can Ufuk Ertenli, Ramazan Gokberk Cinbis, Emre Akbas
abstract: We present StreamDEQ, a method that aims to infer frame-wise representations on videos with minimal per-frame computation. Conventional deep networks perform feature extraction from scratch at each frame in the absence of ad-hoc solutions. We instead aim to build streaming recognition models that can natively exploit temporal smoothness between consecutive video frames. We observe that the recently emerging implicit layer models provide a convenient foundation to construct such models, as they define representations as the fixed points of shallow networks, which need to be estimated using iterative methods. Our main insight is to distribute the inference iterations over the temporal axis by using the most recent representation as a starting point at each frame. This scheme effectively recycles the recent inference computations and greatly reduces the required processing time. Through extensive experimental analysis, we show that StreamDEQ is able to recover near-optimal representations within a few frames and maintain an up-to-date representation throughout the video duration. Our experiments on video semantic segmentation, video object detection, and human pose estimation in videos show that StreamDEQ achieves on-par accuracy with the baseline while providing 2-4x higher throughput.
comment: v3: ECCV2022 paper. This version: extended version accepted to be published at Neurocomputing
zh_title: 视频流分析的表示回收
translation: 我们提出了StreamDEQ，这是一种旨在以最小的每帧计算量推断视频帧级表示的方法。在缺乏专门解决方案的情况下，传统深度网络在每帧都从头开始进行特征提取。我们转而旨在构建能够原生利用连续视频帧之间时间平滑性的流识别模型。我们观察到，最近出现的隐式层模型为构建此类模型提供了便利的基础，因为它们将表示定义为浅层网络的固定点，需要使用迭代方法进行估计。我们的主要见解是通过将推理迭代分布在时间轴上，将最近的表示作为每帧的起点。这种方案有效地回收了最近的推理计算，并大大减少了所需的处理时间。通过广泛的实验分析，我们表明StreamDEQ能够在几帧内恢复接近最优的表示，并在整个视频持续时间内保持最新的表示。我们在视频语义分割、视频目标检测和视频中人体姿态估计方面的实验表明，StreamDEQ在提供2-4倍更高吞吐量的同时，实现了与基线相当的准确性。
tldr: StreamDEQ通过回收先前帧的表示作为起点，利用隐式层模型在视频流分析中实现显著的计算效率提升，同时保持准确性。
ai_comments: StreamDEQ的创新之处在于其表示回收机制，它巧妙地将隐式层模型的迭代特性与视频的时间平滑性结合起来，显著减少了每帧的计算量。这对于实时视频分析系统具有重要意义，因为它在不牺牲准确性的前提下，提供了更高的处理速度。该方法为未来高效的流媒体视频处理模型提供了一个新的思路。
motivation: 传统深度网络在视频流分析中对每帧进行从头开始的特征提取，缺乏利用连续帧之间时间平滑性的能力，导致计算量大。
method: 提出StreamDEQ，利用隐式层模型将表示定义为浅层网络的固定点。核心思想是在时间轴上分配推理迭代，使用最近的表示作为每帧的起点，从而有效回收计算。
results: StreamDEQ能在几帧内恢复接近最优的表示，并在整个视频持续时间内保持最新的表示。在视频语义分割、视频目标检测和视频中人体姿态估计任务上，StreamDEQ在保持与基线相当的准确性的同时，吞吐量提高了2-4倍。
conclusion: StreamDEQ通过表示回收显著提高了视频流分析的计算效率，同时保持了高准确性。

title: On homomorphism related parameters of oriented triangle-free planar graphs
authors: Soura Sena Das, Soumen Nandi, Sagnik Sen
abstract: The first major contribution of this work is proving that the oriented relative clique number of oriented triangle-free planar graphs is $10$, which completely answers and closes an open problem posed by Sopena (Discrete Mathematics 2016) in the most recent survey on oriented colorings. The second major contribution of the paper is to prove that if all oriented triangle-free planar graphs admit a homomorphism to a particular oriented graph $\overrightarrow{T}$, then its underlying graph $T$ must have minimum degree at least $10$. This result implies that, for the family of oriented triangle-free planar graphs, the lower bounds of the parameters oriented chromatic number, pushable chromatic number, $2$-dipath $L(p,1)$-labeling span, and oriented $L(p,1)$-labeling span are at least $11$, $6$, $p+8$, and $2p+8$, respectively, where $p \geq 1$. That is, we are able to obtain improved lower bounds of a number of other parameters restricted to the family of oriented triangle-free planar graphs using our second major contribution.
zh_title: 关于无三角形平面图有向同态相关参数的研究
translation: 本文的第一个主要贡献是证明了无三角形平面图的有向相对团数为10，这完整地回答并解决了Sopena（Discrete Mathematics 2016）在最近的一篇关于有向染色的综述中提出的一个公开问题。本文的第二个主要贡献是证明了如果所有无三角形平面图都允许同态到一个特定的有向图 $\overrightarrow{T}$，那么它的底层图 $T$ 必须具有至少为10的最小度。这一结果意味着，对于无三角形平面图族，有向色数、可推色数、$2$-dipath $L(p,1)$-标号跨度和有向 $L(p,1)$-标号跨度参数的下界至少分别为 $11$、$6$、$p+8$ 和 $2p+8$（其中 $p \geq 1$）。也就是说，通过我们的第二个主要贡献，我们能够获得限制在无三角形平面图族上的其他多个参数的改进下界。
tldr: 本文解决了无三角形平面图有向相对团数为10的公开问题，并为该类图的多项有向染色参数设定了更精确的下界。
ai_comments: 这项研究通过解决Sopena提出的公开问题，在有向图染色领域取得了重要进展。其创新之处在于通过对无三角形平面图的结构分析，精确界定了有向相对团数，并为一系列其他有向图参数提供了更严谨的下界，展示了该类图结构的复杂性。
motivation: 旨在解决Sopena (2016) 在有向染色综述中提出的关于无三角形平面图有向相对团数的公开问题，并改进该类图族相关参数的下界。
method: 通过理论证明方法，分析无三角形平面图的结构性质，并利用同态到特定有向图的约束条件推导相关参数的下界。
results: 证明了无三角形平面图的有向相对团数为10；证明了若该类图同态到某有向图，则其底层图最小度至少为10；推导出了有向色数、可推色数及相关L(p,1)-标号跨度的改进下界。
conclusion: 本文确定了无三角形平面图的有向相对团数为10，并证明了其对应的同态目标图必须具备至少10的最小度，从而推导出一系列有向图参数的改进下界。

title: Fitted Occupancy-Ratio Evaluation without Bellman Completeness
authors: Lars van der Laan, Nathan Kallus
abstract: Occupancy ratios correct distribution shift in offline reinforcement learning and are central to off-policy evaluation. Existing primal-dual and minimax methods typically estimate these ratios by enforcing occupancy-balance moments over a critic class. We propose fitted occupancy-ratio evaluation (FORE), a fitted fixed-point method that characterizes the discounted occupancy ratio through an adjoint Bellman recursion. At each iteration, FORE solves a single-level density-ratio objective on one-step-transition data, thereby projecting the adjoint Bellman image onto a log-ratio class in Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence. Unlike analyses of fitted Q-evaluation, which typically require value-function realizability together with Bellman completeness or projected-operator stability, our central approximation condition is just realizability of the discounted occupancy ratio itself. Under this condition, the population KL-projected recursion contracts in relative entropy toward the true ratio by virtue of the adjoint Bellman operator being a KL-contraction. For the empirical recursion, we establish finite-sample regret bounds that yield convergence in KL up to log-ratio approximation error and a statistical error governed by the complexity of the ratio hypothesis class. The fitted ratio supports direct value estimation by reward reweighting, occupancy-weighted fitted Q-evaluation, and doubly robust estimation that combines the fitted ratio with a fitted Q-function. Together, these results identify discounted occupancy-ratio realizability as a sufficient condition for offline policy evaluation without any completeness assumptions.
zh_title: 无贝尔曼完备性的拟合占用率评估
translation: 占用率纠正了离线强化学习中的分布偏移，并且是离策略评估的核心。现有的原始对偶和极小极大方法通常通过在评论家类别上强制执行占用平衡矩来估计这些比率。我们提出了拟合占用率评估（FORE），这是一种拟合不动点方法，它通过伴随贝尔曼递归来表征折扣占用率。在每次迭代中，FORE通过单步转移数据解决单级密度比目标，从而将伴随贝尔曼图像投影到库尔巴克-莱布勒（KL）散度中的对数比类别上。与拟合Q评估的分析不同，后者通常需要价值函数可实现性以及贝尔曼完备性或投影算子稳定性，我们的核心近似条件仅仅是折扣占用率本身的可实现性。在此条件下，群体KL投影递归在相对熵中收敛到真实比率，因为伴随贝尔曼算子是KL收缩。对于经验递归，我们建立了有限样本遗憾界限，这使得KL收敛达到对数比近似误差和由比率假设类的复杂性决定的统计误差。拟合比率支持通过奖励重加权进行直接价值估计、占用加权拟合Q评估以及结合拟合比率和拟合Q函数的双重鲁棒估计。这些结果共同表明，折扣占用率可实现性是离线策略评估的充分条件，无需任何完备性假设。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为拟合占用率评估（FORE）的新方法，用于在离线强化学习中估计折扣占用率，它通过利用伴随贝尔曼递归和单级密度比目标来解决分布偏移问题，并且仅需要折扣占用率的可实现性条件，无需贝尔曼完备性假设。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了FORE方法，它通过利用伴随贝尔曼递归和放宽了对贝尔曼完备性的要求，仅需折扣占用率的可实现性，为离线策略评估提供了一个更实际和宽松的理论基础。这对于处理现实世界中数据分布偏移的离线强化学习问题具有重要意义，因为它减少了现有方法的假设强度。
motivation: 在离线强化学习中，占用率用于纠正分布偏移，并且是离策略评估的核心。现有原始对偶和极小极大方法通常通过在评论家类别上强制执行占用平衡矩来估计这些比率，但这些方法可能需要严格的假设，例如贝尔曼完备性。
method: 本文提出了一种名为拟合占用率评估（FORE）的拟合不动点方法。该方法通过伴随贝尔曼递归来表征折扣占用率。在每次迭代中，FORE通过单步转移数据解决单级密度比目标，从而将伴随贝尔曼图像投影到库尔巴克-莱布勒（KL）散度中的对数比类别上。
results: 在折扣占用率可实现性的条件下，群体KL投影递归在相对熵中收敛到真实比率，因为伴随贝尔曼算子是KL收缩。对于经验递归，本文建立了有限样本遗憾界限，这使得KL收敛达到对数比近似误差和由比率假设类的复杂性决定的统计误差。拟合比率支持通过奖励重加权进行直接价值估计、占用加权拟合Q评估以及结合拟合比率和拟合Q函数的双重鲁棒估计。
conclusion: 这些结果共同表明，折扣占用率可实现性是离线策略评估的充分条件，无需任何完备性假设。

title: MetaMax: Improved Open-Set Deep Neural Networks via Weibull Calibration
authors: Zongyao Lyu, Nolan B. Gutierrez, William J. Beksi
abstract: Open-set recognition refers to the problem in which classes that were not seen during training appear at inference time. This requires the ability to identify instances of novel classes while maintaining discriminative capability for closed-set classification. OpenMax was the first deep neural network-based approach to address open-set recognition by calibrating the predictive scores of a standard closed-set classification network. In this paper we present MetaMax, a more effective post-processing technique that improves upon contemporary methods by directly modeling class activation vectors. MetaMax removes the need for computing class mean activation vectors (MAVs) and distances between a query image and a class MAV as required in OpenMax. Experimental results show that MetaMax outperforms OpenMax and is comparable in performance to other state-of-the-art approaches.

zh_title: MetaMax：通过威布尔校准改进开放集深度神经网络
translation: 开放集识别是指在推理时出现训练期间未见的类别的问题。这需要能够识别新颖类别的实例，同时保持对封闭集分类的判别能力。OpenMax是第一个基于深度神经网络的方法，通过校准标准封闭集分类网络的预测分数来解决开放集识别问题。在本文中，我们提出了MetaMax，一种更有效的后处理技术，通过直接建模类激活向量来改进现有方法。MetaMax消除了OpenMax中计算类平均激活向量（MAVs）以及查询图像与类MAV之间距离的需求。实验结果表明，MetaMax优于OpenMax，并且性能与其他的最先进方法相当。
tldr: MetaMax是一种新的后处理技术，通过直接建模类激活向量来改进开放集识别，优于OpenMax且与现有最佳方法相当。
ai_comments: MetaMax的创新之处在于其直接建模类激活向量的方法，从而简化了开放集识别的后处理过程，避免了OpenMax中对MAVs的依赖。这代表了开放集识别领域的一项重要进展，提供了一种更高效且与现有最佳方法性能相当的解决方案。
motivation: 解决开放集识别问题，即在推理时识别训练中未见的类别，同时保持对封闭集分类的判别能力。
method: 本文提出了MetaMax，一种更有效的后处理技术，通过直接建模类激活向量来改进现有方法。它消除了OpenMax中计算类平均激活向量（MAVs）以及查询图像与类MAV之间距离的需求。标题中提及通过威布尔校准。
results: 实验结果表明，MetaMax优于OpenMax，并且性能与其他的最先进方法相当。
conclusion: MetaMax通过直接建模类激活向量，提供了一种更有效的开放集识别后处理技术，在性能上超越了OpenMax并达到了与最先进方法相当的水平。

title: Restricted Bernoulli Matrix Factorization: Balancing the trade-off between prediction accuracy and coverage in classification based collaborative filtering
authors: Ángel González-Prieto, Abraham Gutiérrez, Fernando Ortega, Raúl Lara-Cabrera
abstract: Reliability measures associated with the prediction of the machine learning models are critical to strengthening user confidence in artificial intelligence. Therefore, those models that provide not only predictions, but also reliability, enjoy greater popularity. In the field of recommender systems, reliability is crucial, since users tend to prefer those recommendations that are sure to interest them, that is, high predictions with high reliabilities. In this paper, we propose Restricted Bernoulli Matrix Factorization (ResBeMF), a new algorithm aimed at enhancing the performance of classification-based collaborative filtering. This model is based on a collection of restricted matrix factorizations that jointly generate, for each user-item pair, a full probability distribution over the possible rating scores. To prove its effectiveness, the proposed model has been compared to other existing solutions in the literature in terms of prediction quality (Mean Absolute Error and accuracy scores), prediction quantity (coverage score) and recommendation quality (Mean Average Precision score). The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model provides a good balance in terms of the quality measures used compared to other recommendation models.

title: Proportionally Representative Clustering
authors: Haris Aziz, Barton E. Lee, Sean Morota Chu, Jeremy Vollen
abstract: In recent years, there has been a surge in effort to formalize notions of fairness in machine learning. We focus on centroid clustering--one of the fundamental tasks in unsupervised machine learning. We propose a new axiom ``proportionally representative fairness'' (PRF) that is designed for clustering problems where the selection of centroids reflects the distribution of data points and how tightly they are clustered together. Our fairness concept is not satisfied by existing fair clustering algorithms. We design efficient algorithms to achieve PRF both for unconstrained and discrete clustering problems. Our algorithm for the unconstrained setting is also the first known polynomial-time approximation algorithm for the well-studied Proportional Fairness (PF) axiom. Our algorithm for the discrete setting also matches the best known approximation factor for PF.

title: A Bayesian Approach for the Network Reconstruction of Interdependent Critical Infrastructure Systems from Cascading Failures
authors: MirSaleh Bahavarnia, Hiba Baroud, Yu Wang, Jin-Zhu Yu
abstract: Analyzing the behavior of complex interdependent networks requires complete information about the network topology and the interdependent links across networks. For many applications such as critical infrastructure systems, understanding network interdependencies is crucial to anticipate cascading failures and plan for disruptions. However, data on the topology of individual networks are often publicly unavailable due to privacy and security concerns. Additionally, interdependent links are often only revealed in the aftermath of a disruption as a result of cascading failures. We propose a scalable nonparametric Bayesian approach to reconstruct the topology of interdependent infrastructure networks from observations of cascading failures. Metropolis-Hastings algorithm coupled with the infrastructure-dependent proposal are employed to increase the efficiency of sampling possible graphs. Results of reconstructing a synthetic system of interdependent infrastructure networks demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms existing methods in both accuracy and computational time. We further apply this approach to reconstruct the topology of one synthetic and two real-world systems of interdependent infrastructure networks, including gas-power-water networks in Shelby County, TN, USA, and an interdependent system of power-water networks in Italy, to demonstrate the general applicability of the approach.

zh_title: 一种基于贝叶斯方法的级联失效下相互依赖关键基础设施网络重构研究
translation: 分析复杂相互依赖网络的行为需要关于网络拓扑和跨网络依赖链路的完整信息。对于关键基础设施系统等许多应用而言，了解网络相互依赖性对于预测级联失效和规划中断应对至关重要。然而，由于隐私和安全原因，个体网络的拓扑数据往往无法公开。此外，相互依赖的链路通常仅在中断后的级联失效结果中显现。我们提出了一种可扩展的非参数贝叶斯方法，根据级联失效的观测结果重构相互依赖的基础设施网络拓扑。采用Metropolis-Hastings算法结合基础设施依赖的提案分布，以提高采样可能图的效率。对相互依赖基础设施网络合成系统的重构结果表明，该方法在准确性和计算时间上均优于现有方法。我们进一步将此方法应用于重构一个合成系统和两个现实世界相互依赖基础设施网络系统（包括美国田纳西州谢尔比县的天然气-电力-供水网络，以及意大利的电力-供水相互依赖系统），以证明该方法的通用性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种利用级联失效数据重构关键基础设施网络拓扑的贝叶斯方法，有效解决了因数据隐私导致的网络结构不可见问题。
ai_comments: 该研究解决了基础设施网络拓扑数据缺失及隐私保护的难题，通过级联失效数据反向推演网络结构。其创新之处在于利用非参数贝叶斯方法与高效的采样算法，在准确性和计算效率上均有显著提升，具有重要的工程应用价值。
motivation: 关键基础设施网络的拓扑结构和依赖关系往往因隐私和安全原因不公开，且相互依赖性通常仅在级联失效发生后才能被观测到，因此需要一种能从失效数据中重构网络的方法。
method: 提出一种可扩展的非参数贝叶斯方法，结合Metropolis-Hastings算法及基础设施依赖的提案分布，从级联失效观测数据中重构网络拓扑。
results: 在合成系统上的测试表明，该方法在准确性和计算效率上均优于现有方法；通过对美国谢尔比县及意大利的真实基础设施网络应用，验证了该方法的普适性。
conclusion: 该方法能够有效地从级联失效数据中重构相互依赖的基础设施网络拓扑，证明了其在处理现实世界复杂系统中的普适性和优越性。

title: AppAgent: Multimodal Agents as Smartphone Users
authors: Chi Zhang, Zhao Yang, Jiaxuan Liu, Yanda Li, Yucheng Han, Xin Chen, Zebiao Huang, Bin Fu, Gang Yu
abstract: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have led to the creation of intelligent agents capable of performing complex tasks. This paper introduces a novel LLM-based multimodal agent framework designed to operate smartphone applications. Our framework enables the agent to operate smartphone applications through a simplified action space, mimicking human-like interactions such as tapping and swiping. This novel approach bypasses the need for system back-end access, thereby broadening its applicability across diverse apps. Central to our agent's functionality is its innovative learning method. The agent learns to navigate and use new apps either through autonomous exploration or by observing human demonstrations. This process generates a knowledge base that the agent refers to for executing complex tasks across different applications. To demonstrate the practicality of our agent, we conducted extensive testing over 50 tasks in 10 different applications, including social media, email, maps, shopping, and sophisticated image editing tools. The results affirm our agent's proficiency in handling a diverse array of high-level tasks.

zh_title: AppAgent：作为智能手机用户的多模态智能体
translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展催生了能够执行复杂任务的智能智能体。本文介绍了一种基于LLM的新型多模态智能体框架，旨在操作智能手机应用程序。我们的框架使智能体能够通过简化的动作空间（模拟人类的点击和滑动）来操作手机应用。这种新颖的方法绕过了对系统后端访问的需求，从而扩大了其在不同应用中的适用性。该智能体功能的核心在于其创新的学习方法。智能体通过自主探索或观察人类演示来学习导航和使用新应用程序。这个过程生成了一个知识库，智能体参考该知识库在不同应用程序中执行复杂任务。为了证明我们智能体的实用性，我们在10个不同的应用程序中进行了50多项任务的广泛测试，包括社交媒体、电子邮件、地图、购物和复杂的图像编辑工具。结果证实了我们的智能体在处理各种高级任务方面的熟练程度。
tldr: AppAgent是一个不需要后端权限的智能手机操作助手，通过模仿人类行为和学习应用操作，能够高效完成各类手机应用任务。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于通过模仿人类操作（点击、滑动）而非依赖后端API来控制手机应用，这极大地提高了通用性。其学习机制（自主探索与模仿学习）使其具有良好的扩展性。局限性在于未提及在极度复杂或动态环境下的鲁棒性表现。
motivation: 旨在解决当前智能体难以跨应用执行复杂任务的问题，并克服需要访问系统后端权限的局限性，实现像人类一样操作手机应用。
method: 构建了一个基于大语言模型的多模态智能体框架，通过简化操作空间（点击、滑动）模拟人类交互；利用自主探索和人类演示学习应用操作，并建立知识库以执行复杂任务。
results: 在涵盖社交媒体、邮件、地图、购物及图像编辑等10个应用上的50多项任务测试中，该智能体表现出了卓越的复杂任务处理能力。
conclusion: AppAgent证明了多模态大模型能够通过观察和自主探索，有效地模拟人类操作手机应用，为实现通用手机智能体提供了可行的路径。

title: Unveiling the Unborn: Advancing Fetal Health Classification through Machine Learning
authors: Sujith K Mandala
abstract: Fetal health classification is a critical task in obstetrics, enabling early identification and management of potential health problems. However, it remains challenging due to data complexity and limited labeled samples. This research paper presents a novel machine-learning approach for fetal health classification, leveraging a LightGBM classifier trained on a comprehensive dataset. The proposed model achieves an impressive accuracy of 98.31% on a test set. Our findings demonstrate the potential of machine learning in enhancing fetal health classification, offering a more objective and accurate assessment. Notably, our approach combines various features, such as fetal heart rate, uterine contractions, and maternal blood pressure, to provide a comprehensive evaluation. This methodology holds promise for improving early detection and treatment of fetal health issues, ensuring better outcomes for both mothers and babies. Beyond the high accuracy achieved, the novelty of our approach lies in its comprehensive feature selection and assessment methodology. By incorporating multiple data points, our model offers a more holistic and reliable evaluation compared to traditional methods. This research has significant implications in the field of obstetrics, paving the way for advancements in early detection and intervention of fetal health concerns. Future work involves validating the model on a larger dataset and developing a clinical application. Ultimately, we anticipate that our research will revolutionize the assessment and management of fetal health, contributing to improved healthcare outcomes for expectant mothers and their babies.
zh_title: 揭示未出生者：通过机器学习推进胎儿健康分类研究
translation: 胎儿健康分类是产科领域的一项关键任务，有助于早期发现和管理潜在的健康问题。然而，由于数据复杂性和标注样本有限，该任务仍具挑战性。本研究提出了一种用于胎儿健康分类的创新机器学习方法，利用在综合数据集上训练的LightGBM分类器。所提出的模型在测试集上达到了98.31%的优异准确率。我们的研究结果证明了机器学习在增强胎儿健康分类方面的潜力，提供了更客观、准确的评估。值得注意的是，我们的方法结合了多种特征，如胎心率、宫缩和母体血压，以提供全面评估。该方法有望改善胎儿健康问题的早期发现和治疗，确保母亲和婴儿获得更好的预后。除了实现高准确率外，我们方法的创新之处在于其全面的特征选择和评估方法。通过结合多个数据点，与传统方法相比，我们的模型提供了更全面、更可靠的评估。这项研究在产科领域具有重要意义，为胎儿健康问题的早期检测和干预进展铺平了道路。未来的工作包括在更大的数据集上验证模型并开发临床应用。最终，我们预计我们的研究将彻底改变胎儿健康的评估和管理，为准妈妈及其婴儿带来更好的医疗成果。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于LightGBM的机器学习方法，通过综合多项生理指标，以98.31%的准确率实现了高效的胎儿健康分类。
ai_comments: 该论文通过集成多种临床特征（如胎心率、宫缩等）利用LightGBM模型实现了极高的分类精度，展现了机器学习在产科辅助诊断中的巨大潜力。其创新点在于综合特征选择方法，提供了比传统手段更全面、客观的评估。局限性在于目前仍需在更大规模数据集上进行临床验证。
motivation: 针对胎儿健康分类任务中存在的数据复杂性和标注样本有限的挑战，旨在提升评估的客观性与准确性，以实现更早期的检测与干预。
method: 采用LightGBM分类器，通过整合胎心率、宫缩和母体血压等多种临床特征进行多维度建模与评估。
results: 该模型在测试集上达到了98.31%的准确率，证明了其在胎儿健康评估方面的卓越性能。
conclusion: 该研究证明了基于LightGBM的机器学习模型能够显著提高胎儿健康分类的准确性，为临床早期干预提供了可靠的辅助评估工具。

title: DIRA-SS:Dynamic Domain Incremental Regularised Adaptation -- Self-Supervised
authors: Abanoub Ghobrial, Kerstin Eder
abstract: Autonomous systems (AS) often rely on Deep Neural Network (DNN) classifiers to operate in complex and dynamically changing environments. However, during operation, these classifiers may encounter domains that differ from those seen during development, causing performance degradation under distribution shift. Removing systems from operation for labelled data collection and retraining is often impractical, particularly when adaptation must occur quickly and at scale. This paper introduces DIRA-SS, a self-supervised extension of Dynamic Incremental Regularised Adaptation (DIRA) that enables online domain adaptation using only a small number of unlabelled target-domain samples. DIRA-SS augments an existing classifier with an auxiliary retraining branch and adapts the shared feature representation through a rotation-prediction task, while elastic weight consolidation regularises important source-domain parameters to reduce destructive updates. This allows the model to benefit from transfer learning without requiring classification labels during operation. We evaluate DIRA-SS on CIFAR-10C, CIFAR-100C, and ImageNet-C using ResNet architectures under severe common corruptions. The results show that DIRA-SS substantially improves performance over the non-adapted source model, achieves accuracy close to the supervised DIRA method, and outperforms existing unsupervised test-time adaptation baselines on ImageNet-C when using only 100 target-domain samples.

zh_title: DIRA-SS：动态领域增量正则化适应——自监督学习版
translation: 自主系统（AS）通常依赖深度神经网络（DNN）分类器在复杂和动态变化的环境中运行。然而，在运行过程中，这些分类器可能会遇到与开发阶段所见不同的领域，从而导致分布偏移下的性能下降。将系统从运行中移除以进行标签数据收集和重训练通常是不切实际的，特别是在必须快速且大规模进行适应的情况下。本文介绍了 DIRA-SS，这是动态增量正则化适应（DIRA）的一种自监督扩展，它仅使用少量无标签目标域样本即可实现在线领域适应。DIRA-SS 通过辅助重训练分支增强现有分类器，并通过旋转预测任务适应共享特征表示，同时利用弹性权重固化来正则化重要的源域参数，以减少破坏性更新。这使得模型能够在运行期间受益于迁移学习，而无需分类标签。我们在严重常见损坏下的 ResNet 架构上，使用 CIFAR-10C、CIFAR-100C 和 ImageNet-C 对 DIRA-SS 进行了评估。结果表明，DIRA-SS 显著提高了相对于未适应源模型的性能，达到了接近监督式 DIRA 方法的准确度，并且在仅使用 100 个目标域样本时，在 ImageNet-C 上优于现有的无监督测试时适应基准。
tldr: DIRA-SS 是一种无需标签的在线领域适应技术，通过自监督旋转任务和正则化，使模型在极少量样本下即可适应动态环境中的分布偏移。
ai_comments: DIRA-SS 的创新之处在于将自监督学习（旋转预测任务）与正则化技术（弹性权重固化）相结合，实现了在无需标注数据情况下的高效在线领域适应。它成功解决了自主系统在动态环境中面临的性能衰退问题，且在数据样本量极少的情况下表现优异。局限性在于主要针对特定图像分类任务进行验证，在更复杂或非视觉任务中的泛化能力有待进一步研究。
motivation: 自主系统在运行中常遇到分布偏移导致的性能下降，而传统的收集标签数据进行重新训练的方法在实际应用中既不切实际也不高效。
method: DIRA-SS 引入了一个辅助重训练分支，通过自监督的旋转预测任务来适应共享特征表示，并利用弹性权重固化（EWC）来正则化重要的源域参数，从而防止灾难性遗忘。
results: 在 CIFAR-10C、CIFAR-100C 和 ImageNet-C 等数据集上，DIRA-SS 相比未适应的源模型有显著提升，性能接近监督式 DIRA，并在仅使用 100 个无标签样本时超过了现有的无监督测试时适应基准。
conclusion: DIRA-SS 是一种高效的自监督在线领域适应方法，能够通过极少量的无标签数据显著提升模型在动态环境下的鲁棒性，且性能表现接近监督式学习方法。

title: Learning to Visually Connect Actions and their Effects
authors: Paritosh Parmar, Eric Peh, Basura Fernando
abstract: We introduce the novel concept of visually Connecting Actions and Their Effects (CATE) in video understanding. CATE can have applications in areas like task planning and learning from demonstration. We identify and explore two different aspects of the concept of CATE: Action Selection (AS) and Effect-Affinity Assessment (EAA), where video understanding models connect actions and effects at semantic and fine-grained levels, respectively. We design various baseline models for AS and EAA. Despite the intuitive nature of the task, we observe that models struggle, and humans outperform them by a large margin. Our experiments show that in solving AS and EAA, models learn intuitive properties like object tracking and pose encoding without explicit supervision. We demonstrate that CATE can be an effective self-supervised task for learning video representations from unlabeled videos. The study aims to showcase the fundamental nature and versatility of CATE, with the hope of inspiring advanced formulations and models.

zh_title: 学习在视觉上连接动作及其效果
translation: 我们在视频理解中引入了“连接动作及其效果”（CATE）这一新概念。CATE在任务规划和从示范中学习等领域具有应用前景。我们识别并探索了CATE概念的两个不同方面：动作选择（AS）和效果亲和力评估（EAA），视频理解模型分别在语义层面和细粒度层面连接动作与效果。我们为AS和EAA设计了各种基线模型。尽管该任务在直觉上很直观，但我们观察到模型表现挣扎，人类的表现远超模型。我们的实验表明，在解决AS和EAA问题时，模型无需显式监督就能学习到物体跟踪和姿态编码等直观属性。我们证明了CATE可以成为一种有效的自监督任务，用于从无标注视频中学习视频表征。本研究旨在展示CATE的基础性和多功能性，希望能激发更先进的模型构思。
tldr: 本文引入了CATE概念来连接视频中的动作与效果，并证明了通过解决动作选择与效果评估任务，模型可以在无需显式监督的情况下学习到高质量的视频表征。
ai_comments: 该研究提出了一个新颖的视觉任务框架，通过连接动作及其效果来促进视频理解。创新点在于将任务细分为语义层面的动作选择（AS）和细粒度层面的效果亲和力评估（EAA）。该研究不仅揭示了当前模型在这些任务上的局限性，还证明了CATE作为一种有效的自监督学习任务，能够让模型在无需显式标注的情况下学习到物体跟踪和姿态编码等关键特征，对于视频表征学习具有重要意义。
motivation: 当前视频理解领域缺乏对动作及其产生效果之间逻辑关联的显式建模，该研究旨在通过引入CATE概念，提升模型在任务规划和从示范中学习等领域的表现。
method: 作者定义了两个子任务：动作选择（AS，语义层面）和效果亲和力评估（EAA，细粒度层面），并设计了多种基线模型来执行这些任务，同时验证了其作为自监督学习任务在未标注视频中的表现。
results: 实验表明，尽管人类在这些任务上表现远超机器，但模型通过解决AS和EAA任务，能够自发学习到物体跟踪和姿态编码等 intuitive 属性，且CATE可作为一种有效的自监督预训练任务。
conclusion: CATE是一个基础且多功能的视频理解任务。实验证明，即使在没有显式监督的情况下，通过解决AS和EAA任务，模型也能学习到强大的视频特征，这为未来的视频表征学习研究提供了新的自监督学习范式。

title: Graph Unitary Message Passing
authors: Haiquan Qiu, Quanming Yao
abstract: Unitarity is a useful principle for stabilizing deep neural networks, but in graph neural networks (GNNs) instability is induced not only by learnable parameters but also by the graph propagation operator. Motivated by this distinction, we propose Graph Unitary Message Passing (GUMP), a message-passing framework that uses a unitary propagation operator on a transformed graph to avoid graph-induced exponential decay under repeated propagation. GUMP combines (i) a graph transformation that maps an input graph to an Eulerian line-graph construction admitting unitary adjacency matrices, and (ii) a practical unitary projection procedure based on Newton-Schulz iteration. Theoretical analysis clarifies that, under standard analysis assumptions, unitary propagation keeps the graph-propagation term depth-stable, while vanilla normalized propagation exhibits exponential decay in its non-trivial spectral components. Across synthetic long-range tasks, TUDataset benchmarks, and LRGB datasets, GUMP improves over vanilla message passing and achieves competitive or superior performance against strong baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/ucker/gump_code.
translation: 酉性是稳定深度神经网络的一个有用原则，但在图神经网络（GNN）中，不稳定性不仅由可学习参数引起，还由图传播算子引起。基于这一区别，我们提出了图酉消息传递（GUMP），这是一种在变换图上使用酉传播算子的消息传递框架，旨在避免重复传播下由图引起的指数衰减。GUMP 结合了（i）一种将输入图映射为允许酉邻接矩阵的欧拉线图的图变换，以及（ii）一种基于 Newton-Schulz 迭代的实用酉投影程序。理论分析阐明，在标准假设下，酉传播使图传播项保持深度稳定，而普通的归一化传播在非平凡谱分量中表现出指数衰减。在合成长距离任务、TUDataset 基准和 LRGB 数据集中，GUMP 优于普通的图消息传递，并取得了与强基线相当或更好的性能。代码已在 https://github.com/ucker/gump_code 提供。
tldr: GUMP 框架通过确保图传播算子的酉性质，解决了深度图神经网络中的信号衰减问题，显著提升了模型在长距离任务中的表现。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将酉矩阵约束引入到图神经网络的传播算子中，解决了深度GNN中常见的图诱导指数衰减问题。其方法结合了图变换（线图）与高效的投影算法，具有很强的理论支撑，在长距离依赖任务中表现出色。
motivation: 深度图神经网络的不稳定性不仅源于可学习参数，还受到图传播算子的影响。现有的消息传递机制在重复传播过程中会导致图诱导的指数衰减，限制了深度模型的性能。
method: 提出了图酉消息传递（GUMP）框架，包含两个核心步骤：1. 通过图变换将原始图映射为允许酉邻接矩阵的欧拉线图；2. 采用基于 Newton-Schulz 迭代的实用酉投影程序来保持传播过程的稳定性。
results: 理论分析证明 GUMP 能保持传播项的深度稳定性。实验结果表明，GUMP 在合成长距离任务、TUDataset 和 LRGB 数据集上均优于普通的图消息传递方法，并达到了与强基线模型相当或更优的性能。
conclusion: GUMP 通过确保传播算子的酉性质，有效解决了深度图神经网络中的信号衰减问题，实现了更稳定的深度模型训练，并在多项基准测试中展现了优越性能。

title: CausalChaos! Dataset for Comprehensive Causal Action Question Answering Over Longer Causal Chains Grounded in Dynamic Visual Scenes
authors: Paritosh Parmar, Eric Peh, Ruirui Chen, Ting En Lam, Yuhan Chen, Elston Tan, Basura Fernando
abstract: Causal video question answering (QA) has garnered increasing interest, yet existing datasets often lack depth in causal reasoning. To address this gap, we capitalize on the unique properties of cartoons and construct CausalChaos!, a novel, challenging causal Why-QA dataset built upon the iconic "Tom and Jerry" cartoon series. Cartoons use the principles of animation that allow animators to create expressive, unambiguous causal relationships between events to form a coherent storyline. Utilizing these properties, along with thought-provoking questions and multi-level answers (answer and detailed causal explanation), our questions involve causal chains that interconnect multiple dynamic interactions between characters and visual scenes. These factors demand models to solve more challenging, yet well-defined causal relationships. We also introduce hard incorrect answer mining, including a causally confusing version that is even more challenging. While models perform well, there is much room for improvement, especially, on open-ended answers. We identify more advanced/explicit causal relationship modeling & joint modeling of vision and language as the immediate areas for future efforts to focus upon. Along with the other complementary datasets, our new challenging dataset will pave the way for these developments in the field. Project Page: https://github.com/LUNAProject22/CausalChaos
zh_title: CausalChaos!：用于在动态视觉场景中进行更长因果链全面因果动作问答的数据集
translation: 因果视频问答（QA）引起了越来越多的关注，但现有的数据集往往缺乏因果推理的深度。为了填补这一空白，我们利用卡通的独特属性，基于标志性的“汤姆猫与杰瑞鼠”系列构建了一个新颖且具有挑战性的因果 Why-QA 数据集：CausalChaos!。卡通利用动画原理，使动画师能够创建事件之间明确且富有表现力的因果关系，从而形成连贯的故事情节。利用这些属性，加上发人深省的问题和多层级答案（答案和详细的因果解释），我们的问题涉及连接角色与视觉场景之间多个动态交互的因果链。这些因素要求模型解决更具挑战性且定义明确的因果关系。我们还引入了困难的错误答案挖掘，包括一个更具挑战性的因果混淆版本。虽然模型表现良好，但仍有很大的改进空间，特别是在开放式回答方面。我们确定了更先进/明确的因果关系建模以及视觉和语言的联合建模作为未来工作的重点领域。连同其他互补数据集，我们的新挑战性数据集将为该领域的这些发展铺平道路。项目主页：https://github.com/LUNAProject22/CausalChaos
tldr: CausalChaos! 是一个基于动画构建的视频问答数据集，通过复杂的长链因果问题和难负样本，旨在提升模型在动态视觉场景下的深度因果推理能力。
ai_comments: 该数据集的创新之处在于利用卡通（汤姆猫与杰瑞鼠）中清晰且富有表现力的因果关系来构建更具挑战性的因果推理任务。通过引入多层级的因果解释和难负样本挖掘，该研究为视频因果问答模型的发展提供了新的评估基准和挑战。其局限在于目前模型在开放式回答方面表现仍有待提升。
motivation: 现有视频因果问答数据集缺乏深度因果推理能力，无法有效评估模型在处理长链、动态视觉场景下的复杂因果关系。
method: 利用“汤姆猫与杰瑞鼠”动画构建数据集，设计涉及多动态交互的长链因果问题，并引入难负样本挖掘（包括因果混淆版本）来评估模型的因果推理能力。
results: 实验表明，虽然模型在现有任务上表现尚可，但在处理开放式回答时仍有巨大提升空间，且在处理复杂的长链因果关系时面临显著挑战。
conclusion: CausalChaos! 数据集通过复杂的长链因果视频问答任务，揭示了当前多模态模型在深度因果推理方面的不足，为未来探索更高级的因果建模和视觉语言联合建模指明了方向。

title: Hierarchical Bayesian Crowdsourcing with Item Difficulty
authors: Seong Woo Han, Ozan Adıgüzel, Bob Carpenter
abstract: In applied statistics and machine learning, the gold standards used for training are often biased and almost always noisy. Dawid and Skene's justifiably popular crowdsourcing model adjusts for rater sensitivity and specificity, but fails to capture distributional properties of rating data gathered for training, which in turn biases training. In this study, we introduce a general purpose measurement-error model with which we can infer consensus categories by adding item-level effects for difficulty, discriminativeness, and guessability. We further show how to constrain the bimodal posterior of these models to avoid adversarial raters. We validate our model's goodness of fit with posterior predictive checks, the Bayesian analogue of $χ^2$ tests, and assess its predictive accuracy using leave-one-out cross-validation. We illustrate our new model with two well-studied data sets, binary rating data for caries in dental X-rays and implication in natural language.

title: On Regularization via Early Stopping for Least Squares Regression
authors: Rishi Sonthalia, Jackie Lok, Elizaveta Rebrova
abstract: A fundamental problem in machine learning is understanding the effect of early stopping on the parameters obtained and the generalization capabilities of the model. Even for linear models, the effect is not fully understood for arbitrary learning rates and data. In this paper, we analyze the dynamics of discrete full batch gradient descent for linear regression. With minimal distributional assumptions, we characterize the trajectory of the parameters and the expected excess risk. Using this characterization, we show that when training with any learning rate schedule and finite time horizon, the early stopped solution is equivalent to the minimum norm solution for a generalized ridge regression problem. We also prove that early stopping is beneficial for generic data with arbitrary spectrum and for a wide variety of learning rate schedules. We provide an estimate for the optimal stopping time and empirically demonstrate the accuracy of our estimate.

title: An Algorithm for the Assignment Game Beyond Additive Valuations
authors: Eric Balkanski, Christopher En, Yuri Faenza
abstract: The assignment game, introduced by Shapley and Shubik (1971), is a classic model for two-sided matching markets between buyers and sellers. In the original assignment game, it is assumed that payments lead to transferable utility and that buyers have unit-demand valuations for items. Two important and mostly independent lines of work have studied more general settings with imperfectly transferable utility and gross substitutes valuations. Multiple efficient algorithms have been proposed for computing a competitive equilibrium, the standard solution concept in assignment games, in these two settings. Our main result is an efficient algorithm for computing competitive equilibria in a setting with both imperfectly transferable utility and gross substitutes valuations. Our algorithm combines augmenting tree techniques from maximum matching and algorithms for matroid intersection. We also show that, in two mild generalizations of our model, computing a competitive equilibrium is NP-hard.
comment: 41 pages, 3 figures. Appeared in the proceedings of EC'24

title: FDLoRA: Personalized Federated Learning of Large Language Model via Dual LoRA Tuning
authors: Yao Lu, Jiaxing QI, Zhongzhi Luan, Shaohan Huang, Carol Fung, Hailong Yang, Depei Qian
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as important components across various fields, yet their training requires substantial computation resources and abundant labeled data. It poses a challenge to robustly training LLMs for individual users (clients). To tackle this challenge, the intuitive idea is to introduce federated learning (FL), which can collaboratively train models on distributed private data. However, existing methods suffer from the challenges of data heterogeneity, system heterogeneity, and model size, resulting in suboptimal performance and high costs. In this work, we proposed a variant of personalized federated learning (PFL) framework, namely FDLoRA, which allows the client to be a single device or a cluster and adopts low-rank adaptation (LoRA) tuning. FDLoRA sets dual LoRA modules on each client to capture personalized and global knowledge, respectively, and only the global LoRA module uploads parameters to the central server to aggregate cross-client knowledge. Finally, an adaptive fusion approach is employed to combine the parameters of the dual LoRAs. This enables FDLoRA to make effective use of private data distributed across different clients, thereby improving performance on the client without incurring high communication and computing costs. We conducted extensive experiments in two practice scenarios. The results demonstrate that FDLoRA outperforms six baselines in terms of performance, stability, robustness, computation cost, and communication cost.

title: Metric Differential Privacy at the User-Level Via the Earth Mover's Distance
authors: Jacob Imola, Amrita Roy Chowdhury, Kamalika Chaudhuri
abstract:
Metric differential privacy (DP) provides heterogeneous privacy guarantees based on a distance between the pair of inputs. It is a widely popular notion of privacy since it captures the natural privacy semantics for many applications (such as, for location data) and results in better utility than standard DP. However, prior work in metric DP has primarily focused on the item-level setting where every user only reports a single data item. A more realistic setting is that of user-level DP where each user contributes multiple items and privacy is then desired at the granularity of the user's entire contribution. In this paper, we initiate the study of one natural definition of metric DP at the user-level. Specifically, we use the earth-mover's distance ($d_\textsf{EM}$) as our metric to obtain a notion of privacy as it captures both the magnitude and spatial aspects of changes in a user's data.
  We make three main technical contributions. First, we design two novel mechanisms under $d_\textsf{EM}$-DP to answer linear queries and item-wise queries. Specifically, our analysis for the latter involves a generalization of the privacy amplification by shuffling result which may be of independent interest. Second, we provide a black-box reduction from the general unbounded to bounded $d_\textsf{EM}$-DP (size of the dataset is fixed and public) with a novel sampling based mechanism. Third, we show that our proposed mechanisms can provably provide improved utility over user-level DP, for certain types of linear queries and frequency estimation.
comment: 46 pages, 2 tables. Appeared in ACM CCS 2024
zh_title: 通过Earth Mover's Distance实现用户级度量差分隐私
translation: 度量差分隐私（DP）基于输入对之间的距离提供差异化的隐私保证。由于它能够捕捉许多应用（例如位置数据）的自然隐私语义，并比标准DP产生更好的效用，因此是一种广受欢迎的隐私概念。然而，以往的度量DP工作主要集中在单项级别，即每个用户仅报告单个数据项。更现实的场景是用户级DP，其中每个用户贡献多个数据项，并希望在用户整个贡献的粒度上实现隐私保护。在本文中，我们发起了一项关于用户级度量DP自然定义的研究。具体而言，我们使用Earth Mover's Distance (d_EM) 作为我们的度量来获得一种隐私概念，因为它捕捉了用户数据变化的幅度和空间方面。我们做出了三项主要的技术贡献。首先，我们设计了两种在d_EM-DP下的新型机制来回答线性查询和逐项查询。具体而言，我们对后者的分析涉及混洗隐私放大结果的推广，这可能具有独立的价值。其次，我们提供了一种从通用无界到有界d_EM-DP（数据集大小固定且公开）的黑盒归约，并采用了一种基于采样的新型机制。第三，我们证明了我们提出的机制在特定类型的线性查询和频率估计方面，可以证明比用户级DP提供更好的效用。
tldr: 本文将度量差分隐私扩展至用户级，利用Earth Mover's Distance实现了更优的隐私保护与数据效用平衡。
ai_comments: 该研究将度量差分隐私从传统的单项级别扩展到用户级别，填补了这一领域的研究空白。利用Earth Mover's Distance作为度量标准是一个创新点，能够更好地捕捉用户贡献数据中的幅度和空间变化，为处理复杂用户数据提供了更具实用性的隐私保护框架。
motivation: 现有的度量差分隐私主要集中在单项级别，无法满足现实中用户贡献多个数据项且需要用户级隐私保护的需求。
method: 1. 引入Earth Mover's Distance (d_EM) 作为用户级度量隐私的距离度量；2. 设计了针对线性查询和逐项查询的两种新型机制，并推广了混洗（shuffling）隐私放大结果；3. 提出了从无界到有界d_EM-DP的黑盒归约方法，并结合了基于采样的机制。
results: 所提出的机制在处理特定类型的线性查询和频率估计时，相比传统用户级差分隐私在效用上表现出显著提升。
conclusion: 研究成功定义了用户级别的度量差分隐私，并证明了基于Earth Mover's Distance的机制在特定查询任务中比传统用户级差分隐私具有更好的效用。

title: A Simulation Framework for Electromagnetic Signal Injection Attacks on Image Sensors
authors: Youqian Zhang, MK Michael Cheung, Chunxi Yang, Xinwei Zhai, Zitong Shen, Xinyu Ji, Eugene Yujun Fu, Sze Yiu Chau, Xiapu Luo
abstract: Image sensors are fundamental to many intelligent systems, allowing visual perception and AI-driven decision-making. However, their integrity can be compromised by electromagnetic signal injection attacks (ESIA), which manipulate captured images without modifying sensor hardware or software. Despite the growing threat, system-level understanding of the attacks, as well as the development of defenses, remains limited, in part because collecting adversarial data is often complex and requires specialized attack setups. To address this challenge, we model ESIA and develop a simulation framework for generating synthetic adversarial images. Our analysis shows that these synthetic images are statistically indistinguishable from those produced by real attacks. The proposed framework enables faster vulnerability evaluation of computer vision (CV) algorithms, without the need for dedicated attack hardware. We also present a pilot study showing that the robustness of the algorithms can be improved by adversarial training, demonstrating a practical and scalable path toward mitigating ESIA threats.

title: MambaCapsule: Towards Transparent Cardiac Disease Diagnosis with Electrocardiography Using Mamba Capsule Network
authors: Yinlong Xu, Zitai Kong, Yixuan Wu, Yue Wang, Xiaoqiang Liu, Yingzhou Lu, Jian Wu, Hongxia Xu
abstract: Cardiac arrhythmia, a condition characterized by irregular heartbeats, often serves as an early indication of various heart ailments. With the advent of deep learning, numerous innovative models have been introduced for diagnosing arrhythmias using Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals. However, recent studies solely focus on the performance of models, neglecting the interpretation of their results. This leads to a considerable lack of transparency, posing a significant risk in the actual diagnostic process. To solve this problem, this paper introduces MambaCapsule, a deep neural networks for ECG arrhythmias classification, which increases the explainability of the model while enhancing the accuracy.Our model utilizes Mamba for feature extraction and Capsule networks for prediction, providing not only a confidence score but also signal features. Akin to the processing mechanism of human brain, the model learns signal features and their relationship between them by reconstructing ECG signals in the predicted selection. The model evaluation was conducted on MIT-BIH and PTB dataset, following the AAMI standard. MambaCapsule has achieved a total accuracy of 99.54% and 99.59% on the test sets respectively. These results demonstrate the promising performance of under the standard test protocol.

title: Merchants of Vulnerabilities: How Bug Bounty Programs Benefit Software Vendors
authors: Esther Gal-Or, Muhammad Zia Hydari, Rahul Telang
abstract: We study how bug bounty programs (BBPs) shape software vendors' security and release choices. We develop a game-theoretic model in which a vendor chooses release timing and severity-contingent bounties, anticipating effort by ethical and malicious hackers in a winner-take-all discovery race. The model highlights two linked mechanisms: an incentive channel that shifts first discovery of severe vulnerabilities away from malicious exploitation and toward ethical reporting, and a governance channel in which coordinated disclosure changes how vulnerability information is managed during remediation. We derive closed-form optimal bounties and characterize a feasibility region sustaining positive bounties and interior success probabilities. Within it, a BBP strictly increases the vendor's expected profit by reallocating first-discovery probability on severe vulnerabilities from malicious to ethical hackers and by converting part of severe-loss exposure into bounded, pay-for-results expenditures. For private programs, we solve for the optimal invited set of ethical hackers and show it is strictly smaller than the expected number of malicious attackers. Higher bounties raise ethical hackers' effort and first-discovery probabilities but also increase program cost, and interact with reputational (non-monetary) incentives. Finally, BBP adoption conditionally reduces the marginal value of additional pre-release delay, implying earlier release relative to the no-BBP benchmark. Managerially, BBPs should be viewed as a post-release governance layer complementing strong internal assurance rather than a substitute for it. Policymakers can support responsible use by encouraging timely remediation, transparent post-patch disclosure, and reporting standards that reduce information asymmetry and triage frictions. (Abstract edited to fit the arXiv length limit.)

zh_title: 漏洞商人：漏洞赏金计划如何使软件厂商受益
translation: 我们研究了漏洞赏金计划（BBP）如何塑造软件厂商的安全和发布选择。我们开发了一个博弈论模型，其中厂商在预期伦理黑客和恶意黑客进行“胜者全得”的发现竞赛的情况下，选择发布时间和基于严重程度的赏金。该模型突出了两个相互关联的机制：一个是将严重漏洞的首发发现从恶意利用转向伦理报告的激励渠道；另一个是协调披露改变漏洞信息在修复过程中管理方式的治理渠道。我们推导出了封闭形式的最优赏金，并表征了维持正赏金和内部成功概率的可行区域。在该区域内，BBP通过将严重漏洞的首发概率从恶意黑客重新分配给伦理黑客，并将部分严重损失风险转化为有限的、按结果付费的支出，从而严格增加了厂商的预期利润。对于私有项目，我们求解了伦理黑客的最优邀请集，并证明其严格小于预期恶意攻击者的数量。更高的赏金会提高伦理黑客的努力程度和首发概率，但也会增加计划成本，并与声誉（非货币）激励相互作用。最后，BBP的采用有条件地降低了额外预发布延迟的边际价值，意味着相对于无BBP基准，产品发布时间更早。在管理上，BBP应被视为补充强大的内部保证的发布后治理层，而不是替代品。政策制定者可以通过鼓励及时修复、透明的补丁后披露以及减少信息不对称和分类摩擦的报告标准来支持其负责任的使用。
tldr: 漏洞赏金计划通过经济激励将漏洞发现权从恶意黑客转移给伦理黑客，从而帮助厂商降低风险、增加利润并优化软件发布节奏。
ai_comments: 该论文通过博弈论视角深入剖析了漏洞赏金计划（BBP）的经济学机制，创新点在于同时考虑了激励机制（防范恶意利用）与治理机制（协调披露）。其重要性在于为厂商提供了关于赏金定价及私有项目规模的量化指导，明确了BBP在软件开发生命周期中的定位。局限性在于模型基于理论假设，未讨论黑客行为的复杂动态或特定行业差异。
motivation: 研究漏洞赏金计划（BBP）如何影响软件厂商的安全决策和产品发布时机，揭示其在减少恶意利用和优化漏洞修复治理方面的经济价值。
method: 构建了一个博弈论模型，模拟软件厂商在发布时间与赏金定价上的决策，并分析了伦理黑客与恶意攻击者在“胜者全得”机制下的竞争行为。
results: 研究表明，BBP能通过将严重漏洞的发现概率从恶意黑客转移到伦理黑客，从而提高厂商利润；BBP还能促使厂商更早发布产品，并为私有项目提供了最优邀请人数的理论解。
conclusion: BBP是软件厂商提升安全性和利润的有效工具，它通过将恶意利用转化为受控的付费报告，优化了漏洞修复过程。厂商应将其作为内部安全审查的补充，而非替代品。

title: AnyDesign: Versatile Area Fashion Editing via Mask-Free Diffusion
authors: Yunfang Niu, Dong Yi, Lingxiang Wu, Jie Peng, Jinqiao Wang
abstract: Fashion image editing aims to modify a person's appearance based on a given instruction. Existing methods require auxiliary tools like segmenters and keypoint extractors, lacking a flexible and unified framework. Moreover, these methods are limited in the variety of clothing types they can handle, as most datasets focus on people in clean backgrounds and only include generic garments such as tops, pants, and dresses. These limitations restrict their applicability in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we first extend an existing dataset for human generation to include a wider range of apparel and more complex backgrounds. This extended dataset features people wearing diverse items such as tops, pants, dresses, skirts, headwear, scarves, shoes, socks, and bags. Additionally, we propose AnyDesign, a diffusion-based method that enables mask-free editing on versatile areas. Users can simply input a human image along with a corresponding prompt in either text or image format. Our approach incorporates Fashion DiT, equipped with a Fashion-Guidance Attention (FGA) module designed to fuse explicit apparel types and CLIP-encoded apparel features. Both Qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that our method delivers high-quality fashion editing and outperforms contemporary text-guided fashion editing methods.
zh_title: AnyDesign：基于无掩码扩散的多区域通用时尚编辑
translation: 时尚图像编辑旨在根据给定的指令修改人物的外观。现有方法需要分割器和关键点提取器等辅助工具，缺乏灵活且统一的框架。此外，这些方法在能够处理的服装类型多样性方面受到限制，因为大多数数据集都专注于干净背景下的人物，且仅包含上衣、裤子和连衣裙等通用服装。这些限制制约了它们在现实场景中的适用性。在本文中，我们首先扩展了一个现有的用于人体生成的数据集，以包含更广泛的服饰和更复杂的背景。这个扩展后的数据集包含穿着各种物品（如上衣、裤子、连衣裙、半身裙、头饰、围巾、鞋子、袜子和包包）的人物。此外，我们提出了 AnyDesign，这是一种基于扩散的方法，能够在多个区域进行无掩码编辑。用户只需输入一张人物图像以及相应的文本或图像格式的提示词。我们的方法结合了 Fashion DiT，并配备了时尚引导注意力（FGA）模块，旨在融合显式的服装类型和 CLIP 编码的服装特征。定性和定量实验均表明，我们的方法能够提供高质量的时尚编辑，并优于当下的文本引导时尚编辑方法。
tldr: 本文提出了AnyDesign，一种无需掩码即可进行多区域时尚编辑的扩散模型方法，并扩展了一个包含更丰富服装品类和复杂背景的数据集。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于摆脱了传统时尚图像编辑对分割掩码（Mask）或关键点提取器等辅助工具的依赖，实现了无掩码（Mask-Free）的灵活编辑。同时，通过扩展数据集引入了头饰、鞋袜、包包等更丰富的配饰品类，极大地拓宽了时尚编辑的应用边界。然而，在无掩码情况下如何精准保持非修改区域（如面部特征、背景细节）的完全一致性，可能仍是一个值得进一步探讨的挑战。
motivation: 现有的时尚图像编辑方法通常依赖分割器、关键点提取器等辅助工具，缺乏灵活统一的框架。此外，现有数据集多局限于干净背景及上衣、裤子、连衣裙等基础款式，限制了其在多样化现实场景中的应用。
method:
1. **数据集扩展**：扩展了现有的人体生成数据集，增加了更丰富的服装品类（如半身裙、头饰、围巾、鞋袜、包包等）以及更复杂的背景。
2. **AnyDesign框架**：一种基于扩散模型的无掩码多区域编辑方法，支持文本或图像格式的提示词。
3. **Fashion DiT与FGA模块**：核心网络采用Fashion DiT，并配备了时尚引导注意力（Fashion-Guidance Attention, FGA）模块，用于融合显式的服装类型与CLIP编码的服装特征。
results: 定性和定量实验结果均表明，AnyDesign能够提供高质量的时尚编辑效果，其性能优于当前的文本引导时尚编辑方法。
conclusion: AnyDesign通过无掩码扩散机制和FGA模块，克服了传统方法依赖辅助工具及服装品类受限的缺陷，实现了高质量、多区域且灵活的时尚图像编辑。

title: Training Verifiably Robust Agents Using Set-Based Reinforcement Learning
authors: Manuel Wendl, Lukas Koller, Tobias Ladner, Matthias Althoff
abstract: Reinforcement learning policies parametrized by deep neural networks have achieved strong performance for continuous control, yet even small input perturbations may lead to unpredictable behavior. This sensitivity limits their use in safety-critical domains, where robustness guarantees are required. Our work addresses this gap between state-of-the-art adversarial training methods and formal verification to train verifiably robust agents. Previous works train networks with individual adversarial perturbations, making them only robust against the specific adversarial attacks used. In contrast, our approach propagates entire perturbed input sets, enclosing all possible adversarial attacks within a single network pass. We leverage this to explicitly penalize the size of the output set (minimizing closed-loop uncertainty) and thereby make the actor robust against all possible attacks. This is realized by the use of set-based policy gradients, where each output within the set has a different gradient, thereby balancing the accuracy and robustness of the network. Doing so, we achieve formal verifiability across different verification frameworks for up to 9 times larger input perturbations compared to standard reinforcement learning and improve certified worst-case performance.
zh_title: 基于集合强化学习训练可验证鲁棒的智能体
translation: 采用深度神经网络参数化的强化学习策略在连续控制方面取得了强大的性能，但即使是微小的输入扰动也可能导致不可预测的行为。这种敏感性限制了它们在需要鲁棒性保证的安全关键领域的应用。我们的工作弥合了最先进的对抗训练方法与形式化验证之间的差距，以训练出可验证鲁棒的智能体。以前的工作使用单个对抗扰动来训练网络，这使得它们仅对所使用的特定对抗攻击具有鲁棒性。相比之下，我们的方法传播整个受扰动的输入集，在单次网络前向传播中包容所有可能的对抗攻击。我们利用这一点来显式惩罚输出集的大小（最小化闭环不确定性），从而使行动者对所有可能的攻击都具有鲁棒性。这是通过使用基于集合的策略梯度来实现的，其中集合内的每个输出都有不同的梯度，从而平衡了网络的准确性和鲁棒性。通过这种方式，与标准强化学习相比，我们在不同的验证框架下实现了针对高达9倍大输入扰动的形式化可验证性，并提高了经认证的最坏情况性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于集合的强化学习方法，通过传播整个受扰动输入集并最小化输出集大小，训练出可验证鲁棒的智能体。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将“集合传播”引入强化学习的训练流程中，避免了传统对抗训练只能针对特定攻击的局限性。通过最小化输出集合大小，直接在优化目标中考虑了最坏情况的鲁棒性。其高达9倍的扰动容忍度提升非常显著，对于自动驾驶、机器人等安全关键领域的强化学习落地具有重要意义。局限性可能在于集合传播和集合梯度的计算开销较大，在超高维状态空间下的可扩展性有待进一步验证。
motivation: 深度强化学习策略对微小的输入扰动非常敏感，限制了其在需要鲁棒性保证的安全关键领域的应用；现有的对抗训练方法仅针对特定攻击具有鲁棒性，无法提供形式化验证保证。
method: 提出一种基于集合的强化学习方法。该方法在单次网络前向传播中传播整个受扰动的输入集合（包容所有可能的对抗攻击），并显式地惩罚输出集合的大小以最小化闭环不确定性。通过使用集合值策略梯度（每个集合内的输出具有不同的梯度）来平衡网络的准确性与鲁棒性。
results: 在不同的验证框架下，与标准强化学习相比，该方法实现了对高达9倍大输入扰动的形式化可验证性，并提高了经认证的最坏情况性能。
conclusion: 通过结合集合传播和集合值策略梯度，该方法成功弥合了对抗训练与形式化验证之间的差距，能够有效训练出在连续控制中具有高鲁棒性和形式化验证保证的智能体。

title: DrugAgent: Reliable Multi-Agent Integration of Conflicting Biomedical Evidence for Drug-Target Interaction Assessment
authors: Yoshitaka Inoue, Tianci Song, Xinling Wang, Rui Kuang, Tianfan Fu, Augustin Luna
abstract:
Workflows in drug-target interaction (DTI) assessment require integrating heterogeneous data from predictive models, curated resources, and observations from experimental literature. This evidence can be incomplete or conflicting. DrugAgent is a large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent system focused on DTI evidence integration that integrates outputs from machine learning, knowledge graph, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) agents. DrugAgent converts agent outputs into interpretable representations, then summarizes conflict across the evidence.
  We evaluated DrugAgent on kinase screening data of 900 pairs spanning 178 kinases and 42 inhibitors, and an androgen receptor antagonist screening benchmark. On the kinase dataset, LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation indicated outputs were faithful to input evidence in 98.8% of cases. Biological plausibility of returned summarization was high (scores 3-4 out of 5) across ground-truth classes: 79% of Weak activity labels cases (81% for Moderate/77% Strong); Strong cases received higher scores than Weak/Moderate. Label stability showed 98% agreement across runs. Results on the antagonist benchmark were consistent with the kinase dataset.
  Retrieved literature provided the greatest benefit when direct drug-target evidence was available, highlighting the importance of evidence availability for RAG-based integration. DrugAgent provides heterogeneous evidence-grounded DTI assessment, complementing standalone DTI prediction. We provide strategies to model agreement, conflict, and uncertainty in biomedical evidence integration. Code: https://github.com/sciluna/DrugAgent.
zh_title: DrugAgent：用于药物-靶点相互作用评估的冲突生物医学证据的可靠多智能体整合
translation: 药物-靶点相互作用（DTI）评估的工作流需要整合来自预测模型、人工策画资源以及实验文献观察结果的异构数据。这些证据可能是完整性不足或相互冲突的。DrugAgent 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统，专注于 DTI 证据整合，它整合了机器学习、知识图谱和检索增强生成（RAG）智能体的输出。DrugAgent 将智能体的输出转换为可解释的表示，然后总结这些证据之间的冲突。我们在包含 178 个激酶和 42 个抑制剂、跨越 900 个配对的激酶筛选数据，以及一个雄激素受体拮抗剂筛选基准上对 DrugAgent 进行了评估。在激酶数据集上，大模型作为裁判（LLM-as-a-Judge）的评估表明，在 98.8% 的案例中，输出均忠实于输入证据。返回的总结在不同的基准真实类别中表现出较高的生物学合理性（5分中获得3-4分）：弱活性标签案例中为 79%（中等活性为 81%，强活性为 77%）；强活性案例获得的评分高于弱/中等活性。标签稳定性在多次运行中表现出 98% 的一致性。拮抗剂基准上的结果与激酶数据集一致。检索到的文献在有直接药物-靶点证据可用时提供了最大的益处，突出了证据可用性对于基于 RAG 的整合的重要性。DrugAgent 提供了基于异构证据的 DTI 评估，是对独立 DTI 预测的补充。我们提供了在生物医学证据整合中对一致性、冲突和不确定性进行建模的策略。代码：https://github.com/sciluna/DrugAgent。
tldr: DrugAgent 是一个基于大模型的多智能体系统，通过整合机器学习、知识图谱和 RAG 智能体，实现了高忠实度、高稳定性的冲突生物医学证据整合与药物-靶点相互作用评估。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种基于大语言模型的多智能体协同框架（DrugAgent），通过融合机器学习、知识图谱和RAG等多种技术，有效解决了药物-靶点相互作用（DTI）评估中异构数据冲突与不完整的问题。其高保真度（98.8%）和高稳定性（98%）证明了该方法的实用价值。局限性在于，该系统对直接证据的依赖性较强，在缺乏直接文献支持时，RAG带来的增益会受到限制。
motivation: 药物-靶点相互作用（DTI）评估需要整合来自预测模型、人工策画资源和实验文献等多种异构数据，但这些数据往往是不完整或相互冲突的，缺乏可靠的整合方法。
method: 提出了 DrugAgent，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统。该系统集成了机器学习、知识图谱和检索增强生成（RAG）智能体的输出，将这些输出转化为可解释的表示，并对证据之间的冲突进行总结。
results: 在激酶筛选数据集上，LLM裁判评估显示 98.8% 的输出忠实于输入证据，生物学合理性评分较高，多次运行的标签一致性达 98%。在拮抗剂基准上的结果与此一致。此外，检索文献在有直接药物-靶点证据时能提供最大益处。
conclusion: DrugAgent 能够提供基于异构证据的 DTI 评估，是对独立 DTI 预测方法的有力补充。研究还为生物医学证据整合中的一致性、冲突和不确定性建模提供了可行策略。

title: GQL and SQL/PGQ: Theoretical Models and Expressive Power
authors: Amélie Gheerbrant, Leonid Libkin, Liat Peterfreund, Alexandra Rogova
abstract:
SQL/PGQ and GQL are very recent international standards for querying property graphs: SQL/PGQ specifies how to query relational representations of property graphs in SQL, while GQL is a standalone language for graph databases. The rapid industrial development of these standards left the academic community trailing in its wake. While digests of the languages have appeared, we do not yet have concise foundational models like relational algebra and calculus for relational databases that enable the formal study of languages, including their expressiveness and limitations. At the same time, work on the next versions of the standards has already begun, to address the perceived limitations of their first versions.
  Motivated by this, we initiate a formal study of SQL/PGQ and GQL, concentrating on their concise formal model and expressiveness. For the former, we define simple core languages -- Core GQL and Core PGQ -- that capture the essence of the new standards, are amenable to theoretical analysis, and fully clarify the difference between PGQ's bottom up evaluation versus GQL's linear, or pipelined approach. Equipped with these models, we both confirm the necessity to extend the language to fill in the expressiveness gaps and identify the source of these deficiencies. We complement our theoretical analysis with an experimental study, demonstrating that existing workarounds in full GQL and PGQ are impractical which further underscores the necessity to correct deficiencies in the language design.
zh_title: GQL 与 SQL/PGQ：理论模型与表达能力
translation:
SQL/PGQ 和 GQL 是用于查询属性图的最新国际标准：SQL/PGQ 规定了如何在 SQL 中查询关系图表示，而 GQL 是一个独立的图数据库语言。这些标准的快速工业发展使得学术界望尘莫及。虽然这些语言的摘要已经出现，但我们还没有像关系数据库的关系代数和演算那样简洁的基础模型，以支持对语言（包括它们的表达能力和局限性）的正式研究。同时，新标准的后续版本工作已经开始，以解决其第一版本中存在的局限性。

出于这个动机，我们对 SQL/PGQ 和 GQL 进行了形式化研究，重点关注它们的简洁形式化模型和表达能力。对于前者，我们定义了简单的核心语言——Core GQL 和 Core PGQ——它们捕捉了新标准的精髓，便于理论分析，并完全阐明了 PGQ 的自底向上评估与 GQL 的线性或流水线方法之间的区别。借助这些模型，我们既证实了扩展该语言以填补表达能力差距的必要性，也确定了这些缺陷的根源。我们用实验研究来补充我们的理论分析，证明了在完整的 GQL 和 PGQ 中现有的变通方法是不切实际的，这进一步强调了纠正语言设计缺陷的必要性。
tldr: 该论文提出了 GQL 和 SQL/PGQ 的形式化模型，分析了它们的表达能力，并指出了现有标准的局限性，为未来的语言设计提供了理论基础和实验证据。
ai_comments: 该研究为 GQL 和 SQL/PGQ 这两种新兴的图查询标准提供了重要的理论基础。通过构建简洁的形式化模型，作者不仅清晰地阐述了两种语言的核心差异，还为评估它们的表达能力提供了严谨的框架。研究结果有力地证明了现有标准存在的局限性，并为未来的语言改进指明了方向。实验部分的补充也增加了研究的说服力，强调了理论分析在实际应用中的重要性。然而，该研究主要集中在理论层面，实际语言的实现和性能优化方面的考虑可能需要进一步探索。
motivation: GQL 和 SQL/PGQ 是用于查询属性图的最新国际标准，但学术界缺乏像关系代数和关系演算那样用于形式化研究的简洁基础模型，这阻碍了对其表达能力和局限性的深入理解。同时，新标准的后续版本已在开发中，需要解决现有版本存在的不足。
method: 论文定义了 GQL 和 PGQ 的核心语言（Core GQL 和 Core PGQ）作为形式化模型，以捕捉新标准的精髓并便于理论分析。通过这些模型，研究人员分析了两种语言在评估方式上的差异，并探讨了它们的表达能力。此外，还进行了实验研究，以验证现有 GQL 和 PGQ 中的变通方法在实践中的不可行性。
results: 研究人员定义了 Core GQL 和 Core PGQ 核心语言，阐明了 PGQ 的自底向上评估与 GQL 的线性或流水线方法之间的区别。研究证实了扩展语言以弥补表达能力差距的必要性，并找出了这些不足的根源。实验研究表明，现有的 GQL 和 PGQ 变通方法不切实际。
conclusion: GQL 和 SQL/PGQ 的形式化模型对于理解和改进这些标准至关重要。研究证实了现有标准在表达能力上存在不足，并强调了在语言设计中解决这些缺陷的必要性。实验结果进一步支持了对语言进行修订的论点。

title: AMT-APC: Automatic Piano Cover by Fine-Tuning an Automatic Music Transcription Model
authors: Kazuma Komiya, Yoshihisa Fukuhara
abstract: There have been several studies on automatically generating piano covers, and recent advancements in deep learning have enabled the creation of more sophisticated covers. However, existing automatic piano cover models still have room for improvement in terms of expressiveness and fidelity to the original. To address these issues, we propose a learning algorithm called AMT-APC, which leverages the capabilities of automatic music transcription models. By utilizing the strengths of well-established automatic music transcription models, we aim to improve the accuracy of piano cover generation. Our experiments demonstrate that the AMT-APC model reproduces original tracks more accurately than any existing models.
zh_title: AMT-APC：通过微调自动音乐转谱模型实现自动钢琴翻奏
translation: 关于自动生成钢琴翻奏已经有了若干研究，深度学习的最新进展使得创建更复杂的翻奏成为可能。然而，现有的自动钢琴翻奏模型在表现力和对原曲的还原度方面仍有提升空间。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种名为 AMT-APC 的学习算法，该算法利用了自动音乐转谱模型的能力。通过利用成熟的自动音乐转谱模型的优势，我们的目标是提高钢琴翻奏生成的准确性。我们的实验表明，AMT-APC 模型比任何现有模型都能更准确地重现原曲。
tldr: 本文提出 AMT-APC 算法，通过微调自动音乐转谱模型，显著提高了自动钢琴翻奏的还原度与准确性。
ai_comments:
创新性：该研究巧妙地将成熟的自动音乐转谱（AMT）模型引入到自动钢琴翻奏（APC）任务中，通过微调来迁移其强大的音频特征提取和转谱能力，这一思路具有很强的实用性。
重要性：提升了钢琴翻奏在表现力和原曲还原度上的表现，对自动音乐生成、音乐改编及娱乐互动等领域具有推动作用。
局限性：摘要中未详细说明具体的微调机制、所使用的网络架构以及实验所用的数据集，且未提及是否进行了主观听感评估。
motivation: 现有的自动钢琴翻奏（APC）模型在表现力以及对原曲的还原度（忠实度）方面仍有提升空间。
method: 提出了一种名为 AMT-APC 的学习算法，该算法利用并微调了成熟的自动音乐转谱（AMT）模型，以此来提升钢琴翻奏生成的准确性。
results: 实验结果表明，AMT-APC 模型在重现原曲的准确性上超越了所有现有的自动钢琴翻奏模型。
conclusion: 通过结合并微调成熟的自动音乐转谱（AMT）模型，AMT-APC 能够比现有模型更准确地重现原曲，有效提升了自动钢琴翻奏的生成质量。

title: VLMGuard: Bootstrapping Malicious Prompt Detectors from Unlabeled Vision-Language Prompts in the Wild
authors: Junlin Fang, Wenyu Chen, Reshmi Ghosh, Robert Sim, Ahmed Salem, Vitor R. Carvalho, Emily Lawton, Sharon Li, Jack W. Stokes, Sean Du
abstract: Vision-language Models (VLMs) are essential for contextual understanding of both visual and textual information. However, their vulnerability to adversarially manipulated inputs presents significant risks, leading to compromised outputs and raising concerns about the reliability in VLM-integrated applications. Detecting these malicious prompts is thus crucial for maintaining trust in VLM generations. A major challenge in developing a safeguarding prompt classifier is the lack of a large amount of labeled benign and malicious data. To address the issue, we introduce VLMGuard, a novel learning framework that leverages the unlabeled user prompts in the wild for malicious prompt detection. These unlabeled prompts, which naturally arise when VLMs are deployed in the open world, consist of both benign and malicious information. To harness the unlabeled data, we present an automated maliciousness estimation score for distinguishing between benign and malicious samples within this unlabeled mixture, thereby enabling the training of a binary prompt classifier on top. Notably, our framework does not require extra human annotations and is robust to realistic prompt variations, offering strong flexibility and practicality for real-world applications. Extensive experiments show that VLMGuard achieves superior detection results, improving AUROC by 5.39% on average over the state-of-the-art method. Disclaimer: This paper may contain offensive examples; reader discretion is advised. Code is available at: https://github.com/radiolab-ntu/vlmguard.
comment: Accepted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (07/2026)
zh_title: VLMGuard：从野外未标记的视觉语言提示中自举恶意提示检测器
translation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）对于视觉和文本信息的上下文理解至关重要。然而，它们容易受到对抗性操纵输入的影响，这带来了巨大的风险，导致输出受损，并引发对VLM集成应用可靠性的担忧。因此，检测这些恶意提示对于维护VLM生成的可信度至关重要。开发一个安全提示分类器的主要挑战是缺乏大量的标记良性和恶意数据。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了VLMGuard，一个新颖的学习框架，它利用野外未标记的用户提示进行恶意提示检测。当VLM部署在开放世界中时，这些自然产生的未标记提示包含良性和恶意信息。为了利用这些未标记数据，我们提出了一个自动恶意性估计分数，用于区分此未标记混合物中的良性和恶意样本，从而在此基础上训练一个二元提示分类器。值得注意的是，我们的框架不需要额外的人工标注，并且对现实的提示变化具有鲁棒性，为实际应用提供了强大的灵活性和实用性。广泛的实验表明，VLMGuard取得了卓越的检测结果，平均AUROC比现有最先进方法提高了5.39%。免责声明：本文可能包含冒犯性示例；读者请自行判断。代码可在：https://github.com/radiolab-ntu/vlmguard 获取。
tldr: VLMGuard利用野外未标记的视觉语言提示数据，通过自动恶意性估计分数训练恶意提示检测器，无需人工标注，并显著提升检测性能。
ai_comments: VLMGuard的创新之处在于其无需人工标注即可从野外未标记数据中自举恶意提示检测器的能力，这极大地解决了VLM安全领域数据稀缺的痛点。其自动化恶意性估计机制和对现实提示变化的鲁棒性，使其在实际部署中具有很高的实用价值和灵活性。
motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）容易受到对抗性操纵输入的攻击，导致输出受损，并引发对其可靠性的担忧。检测这些恶意提示至关重要，但主要挑战是缺乏大量的标记良性和恶意数据。
method: 本文引入了VLMGuard框架，该框架利用野外未标记的用户提示进行恶意提示检测。它提出一个自动恶意性估计分数来区分未标记混合数据中的良性和恶意样本，从而在此基础上训练一个二元提示分类器。该框架不需要额外的人工标注。
results: 广泛的实验表明，VLMGuard取得了卓越的检测结果，平均AUROC比现有最先进方法提高了5.39%。
conclusion: VLMGuard是一个无需额外人工标注且对真实提示变化具有鲁棒性的框架，为实际应用提供了强大的灵活性和实用性，并能显著提高恶意提示检测的性能。

title: Mitigating Covariate Shift in Imitation Learning for Autonomous Vehicles Using Latent Space Generative World Models
authors: Alexander Popov, Alperen Degirmenci, David Wehr, Shashank Hegde, Ryan Oldja, Alexey Kamenev, Bertrand Douillard, David Nistér, Urs Muller, Ruchi Bhargava, Stan Birchfield, Nikolai Smolyanskiy
abstract: We propose the use of latent space generative world models to address the covariate shift problem in autonomous driving. A world model is a neural network capable of predicting an agent's next state given past states and actions. By leveraging a world model during training, the driving policy effectively mitigates covariate shift without requiring an excessive amount of training data. During end-to-end training, our policy learns how to recover from errors by aligning with states observed in human demonstrations, so that at runtime it can recover from perturbations outside the training distribution. Additionally, we introduce a novel transformer-based perception encoder that employs multi-view cross-attention and a learned scene query. We present qualitative and quantitative results, demonstrating significant improvements upon prior state of the art in closed-loop testing in the CARLA simulator, as well as showing the ability to handle perturbations in both CARLA and NVIDIA's DRIVE Sim.
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, original September 2024, accepted at ICRA 2025 Workshop "Robots in the Wild", for associated video file, see https://youtu.be/7m3bXzlVQvU
zh_title: 利用潜空间生成式世界模型缓解自动驾驶模仿学习中的协变量偏移
translation: 我们提出使用潜空间生成式世界模型来解决自动驾驶中的协变量偏移问题。世界模型是一种能够根据过去的状态和动作预测智能体下一个状态的神经网络。通过在训练过程中利用世界模型，驾驶策略在不需要过多训练数据的情况下，能够有效缓解协变量偏移。在端到端训练期间，我们的策略通过与人类演示中观察到的状态进行对齐，学习如何从错误中恢复，从而使其在运行时能够从训练分布之外的扰动中恢复。此外，我们引入了一种新型的基于Transformer的感知编码器，该编码器采用多视角交叉注意力机制和学习到的场景查询。我们展示了定性和定量的结果，证明了在CARLA模拟器的闭环测试中，该方法相比于以往的最先进技术有了显著的提升，并且展示了在CARLA和英伟达的DRIVE Sim中处理扰动的能力。
tldr: 本文通过引入潜空间生成式世界模型和新型Transformer感知编码器，有效缓解了自动驾驶模仿学习中的协变量偏移问题，显著提升了系统在模拟环境中的抗扰动与恢复能力。
ai_comments: 该论文巧妙地将潜空间生成式世界模型引入到自动驾驶的模仿学习中，通过在训练中预测未来状态并与人类演示对齐，有效且低成本地解决了协变量偏移这一经典难题。引入基于多视角交叉注意力的Transformer感知编码器进一步提升了系统的感知能力。然而，其局限性在于实验主要在虚拟模拟器（CARLA和NVIDIA DRIVE Sim）中进行，实际物理世界中的泛化与安全性能仍有待验证。
motivation: 旨在解决自动驾驶模仿学习中常见的协变量偏移（covariate shift）问题，避免系统在面对训练分布之外的微扰时无法恢复，同时减少对海量训练数据的依赖。
method: 提出使用潜空间生成式世界模型（用于预测给定过去状态和动作的下一个状态），在端到端训练中让驾驶策略通过与人类演示中观察到的状态对齐来学习如何从错误中恢复。此外，引入了一种新型的、基于Transformer的感知编码器，该编码器采用了多视角交叉注意力（multi-view cross-attention）和学习到的场景查询（learned scene query）。
results: 在CARLA模拟器的闭环测试中，该方法相比于以往的前沿技术（SOTA）取得了显著的定性和定量提升，并且在CARLA和NVIDIA的DRIVE Sim中均展示出了出色的抗扰动和恢复能力。
conclusion: 通过利用潜空间生成式世界模型，驾驶策略可以在不需要海量训练数据的情况下有效缓解协变量偏移，使自动驾驶系统在运行时能够成功从训练分布之外的扰动中恢复。

title: "So Am I Dr. Frankenstein? Or Were You a Monster the Whole Time?": Mitigating Software Project Failure With Loss-Aversion-Aware Development Methodologies
authors: Junade Ali
abstract: Case studies have shown that software disasters snowball from technical issues to catastrophes through humans covering up problems rather than addressing them and empirical research has found the psychological safety of software engineers to discuss and address problems to be foundational to improving project success. However, the failure to do so can be attributed to psychological factors like loss aversion. We conduct a large-scale study of the experiences of 600 software engineers in the UK and USA on project success experiences. Empirical evaluation finds that approaches like ensuring clear requirements before the start of development, when loss aversion is at its lowest, correlated to 97% higher project success. The freedom of software engineers to discuss and address problems correlates with 87% higher success rates. The findings support the development of software development methodologies with a greater focus on human factors in preventing failure.
comment: Peer-reviewed citation: Ali, J. (2025). "So am I Dr. Frankenstein? Or were you a monster the whole time?": Mitigating software project failure with loss-aversion-aware development methodologies. Computer Science & Information Technology (CS & IT), 15(6), 1--9. Link: https://aircconline.com/csit/papers/vol15/csit150601.pdf
zh_title: “我还是弗兰肯斯坦博士吗？还是你从一开始就是个怪物？”：用损失厌恶感驱动的开发方法来减轻软件项目失败
translation: 案例研究表明，软件灾难通过人为掩盖问题而非解决问题，从技术问题演变成灾难。实证研究发现，软件工程师讨论和解决问题的心理安全感是提高项目成功的基石。然而，未能这样做可能归因于损失厌恶等心理因素。我们对英国和美国600名软件工程师的项目成功经验进行了大规模研究。实证评估发现，在损失厌恶感最低时确保需求清晰等方法，使项目成功率提高了97%。软件工程师讨论和解决问题的自由度与87%的成功率相关。这些发现支持开发更关注人为因素以防止失败的软件开发方法。
tldr: 软件项目失败通常源于掩盖问题而非解决问题，这与心理因素如损失厌恶感有关。研究表明，在损失厌恶感最低时确保需求清晰（成功率提高97%）以及允许工程师自由讨论问题（成功率提高87%）可以显著提高项目成功率。因此，应开发更关注人为因素的软件开发方法。
