We couple CODA with principal component analysis on the climate factors as a means of dimension reduction, and fit generalised additive models to better reflect the non-linear relationships between the dimension-reduced principal scores and mortality by cause. The results of our analysis indicate climate-related factors have varying impacts by cause and ages within each cause, with more pronounced increases in the proportions of deaths from hypertensive heart disease as temperature and sea level extremes increase. Scenario analysis also indicates that an increase in temperature high extremes, sea level, and rainfall, in conjunction with a decrease in low temperature extremes, lead to offsetting impacts on the proportion of deaths between climate-related causes, but less offsetting by age within causes. Furthermore, the impacts on the proportions of death are more pronounced for ages between 55 and 95, reinforcing the observation that climate-related risks have a greater impact on older (and potentially more vulnerable) subgroups of the population. For life insurers specifically, these results are consistent with the natural hedge that arises between annuity and protection products, in light of increasing climate risk.

title: Inferring Cooperativity From Pooled Measurements
authors: Robin Requadt, Housen Li
abstract: In many modern experiments, latent interactions drive multicomponent stochastic systems, yet the data are available only as pooled measurements that obscure these dependencies. Whether such interactions can be identified and inferred from aggregate signals remains largely unexplored. Motivated by multi-channel electrophysiological recordings, we address this problem by introducing sum-dependent Markov chains, a class of finite-state continuous-time multivariate Markov processes whose transition rates encode interactions through the aggregate state. Under natural structural conditions, we establish identifiability of the latent dynamic parameters from the aggregate process. We define a cooperativity index that distinguishes positive cooperativity, negative cooperativity and independence, and construct its consistent estimators. For discretely and noisily observed pooled data, we develop likelihood-based inference through a hidden Markov model, address the associated embedding problem, and prove consistency and asymptotic normality. We further propose a stepdown test for cooperativity with asymptotic size control and power guarantees. Simulations and real-data analyses, demonstrate the scope and effectiveness of the methodology.

title: Impact of interim analyses on Bayesian and frequentist operating characteristics of Bayesian clinical trials
authors: Clément R Massonnaud, Lucas Manns, Cédric Laouénan, André Gillibert
abstract: While Bayesian methods are increasingly used in clinical research, confusion persists as to whether Bayesian designs are affected by repeated interim analyses, and how such effects should be evaluated. We aimed to clarify this question by evaluating both frequentist and Bayesian operating characteristics of group-sequential trials. We conducted simulation studies with normally distributed outcomes, examining designs with repeated analyses, with and without futility stopping rules and multiplicity adjustments. We show that repeated interim analyses alter both frequentist and Bayesian operating characteristics in group-sequential trials, regardless of the inferential framework adopted. Without proper adjustment for multiplicity, the Type I error rate increases with the number of analyses. Bayesian operating characteristics such as the risk of erroneous conclusions and the informative value of an efficacy conclusion are meaningful alternatives to classical frequentist metrics, but they are sensitive to prior divergence between stakeholders, and this sensitivity grows with the number of analyses. Even under full prior agreement, the informative value of an efficacy conclusion is reduced. While it is possible to control frequentist operating characteristics of Bayesian trials with appropriate methods, it is not possible to guarantee such control for Bayesian operating characteristics because they are prior-dependent and different stakeholders may adopt different priors. Contrary to claims that Bayesian inference is immune to multiplicity, our results show that Bayesian clinical trials are no less affected by repeated analyses than frequentist ones, regardless of the framework used to evaluate them.

title: A Bayesian Joint Model for Multiple Point Processes with Application to Presence-Only Data
authors: Laura C. M. Teixeira, Dani Gamerman, Vinicius Peripato, Carolina Levis
abstract: Joint modeling of multiple point processes is relevant in applications where relationships among processes are of interest, such as in ecological and archaeological studies. Statistical inference becomes particularly challenging when multiple processes are analyzed jointly and the observed data correspond to presence-only patterns, which are subject to preferential sampling and partial observability. This paper proposes a Bayesian joint model for multiple point processes, with application to the presence-only setting. The dependence between processes is explicitly incorporated into the probabilistic specification of the model using Bayesian networks. Direct use of the likelihood leads to intractable likelihood functions. Latent data processes are then introduced so that the augmented likelihood function becomes tractable and can be exactly evaluated. This formulation also enables direct inference on the number and the spatial distribution of unobserved occurrences of any of the point patterns. Inference is carried out using Markov chain Monte Carlo with blocked Gibbs sampling. Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed inferential scheme is able to recover the true model parameters. The proposed model is applied to real presence-only data of archaeological sites and tree species from Amazonia, as part of the study of the effect that pre-Columbian Indigenous presence might have on the occurrences of relevant tree species. The results are consistent with the findings reported in the literature. They also illustrate how the proposed model enables inference on the existence and on the magnitude of the relation between processes, in addition to their association with environmental covariates.

title: Enhancing comorbidity network inference with risk-enriched health trajectories embedding
authors: Nicole Fontana, Alessia Mapelli, Emanuele Di Angelantonio, Francesca Ieva
abstract: Multimorbidity poses a growing challenge for individual health, reducing quality of life and increasing treatment burden, resulting in a multiplicative impact on healthcare system management and fragmented care trajectories. Comorbidity networks could provide crucial insight into characterising multimorbidity and disease relationships. However, existing approaches to comorbidity network construction face critical limitations: they overlook temporal information by relying on cross-sectional statistics, produce biased association estimates by ignoring confounding due to shared risk factors, and fail to distinguish between direct and indirect disease associations, thereby yielding fully connected networks. To address these limitations, we develop a methodological framework for population-level disease network inference that uses individual health trajectories to learn disease associations, capturing semantic similarity and temporal co-occurrence. Sparse network estimation is achieved via Gaussian Graphical Models with Lasso regularisation, informed by prior clinical knowledge on shared risk factors derived from a dedicated confounding evaluation step. Applied to UK Biobank data comprising 24 cardiometabolic diseases and 76 risk factors, the resulting network revealed clinically meaningful disease patterns. Topological analysis identifies key pathological hubs, reveals potential actionable targets for multimorbidity management, and identifies four distinct disease communities that align with the established cardiometabolic taxonomy. Building on this community structure, we derive community-based patient representations that capture disease progression dynamics. Clustering these representations reveals four progression phenotypes with significantly different long-term survival trajectories, highlighting the potential of the framework for risk stratification and personalised care.

title: Parameter estimation and application in two types of uncertain single-index models
authors: Fuguo Wang, Zhiming Li
abstract: Uncertain data often arises in complex environments because of frequency instability and subjective judgment. This paper establishes two types of uncertain single-index models to capture the inherent properties of such data. Based on the semiparametric least-squares principle, the Nadaraya-Watson kernel and B-spline methods are used to estimate the unknown coefficients in various scenarios with both crisp and imprecise explanatory variables. Residual analysis and hypothesis testing under uncertainty assess the fit of the proposed models. Furthermore, simulation studies verify the models' validity, and a real-data application demonstrates their effectiveness in practical settings.

title: Disentangling Causal Mechanisms in Conjoint Experiments Using Mediation
authors: Michaël Aklin, Max Goplerud, Nicole E. Pashley, Jenna Salzman
abstract: Conjoint experiments provide an attractive way to assess the role of multiple attributes simultaneously on decision-making. However, the randomization of multiple attributes prevents understanding the causal mechanisms that, critically, depend on the relationship between attributes -- e.g., how one attribute affects the respondent's belief as to another attribute. This is because conjoint experiments recover controlled effects whereas a substantively important estimand may be the total or indirect effect of one attribute. Unfortunately, existing experimental designs for conjoint experiments cannot estimate these effects. We provide an alternative framework that requires one additional, simple experiment to learn the relationship between attributes among respondents alongside the standard assumptions for causal mediation. Estimation of the relevant effects can be done in a doubly robust fashion using machine learning methods. We illustrate this by conducting a pre-registered experiment on candidate choice and disentangle the effect of different attributes by understanding their mediation through the candidate's party.

title: Understanding the Hamiltonian Monte Carlo through its Physics Fundamentals and Examples
authors: Mario Molina, Abraham Granados, Jorge GonzálezCázares, Isaías Bañales
abstract: The Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) algorithm is a powerful Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) method that uses Hamiltonian dynamics to generate samples from a target distribution. To fully exploit its potential, we must understand how Hamiltonian dynamics work and why they can be used in a MCMC algorithm. This work elucidates the Monte Carlo Hamiltonian, providing comprehensive explanations of the underlying physical concepts. It is intended for readers with a solid foundation in mathematics who may lack familiarity with specific physical concepts, such as those related to Hamiltonian dynamics. Additionally, we provide Python code for the HMC algorithm, examples and comparisons with the Random Walk Metropolis-Hastings (RWMH) algorithm, alongside an exploration of modern variants such as the No-U-Turn Sampler (NUTS), the Dual Averaging (DA) scheme and the repelling-attracting HMC (raHMC), to highlight HMC's strengths and weaknesses when applied to Bayesian Inference.

title: Minimum Density Power Divergence Estimation for the Gamma Distribution with Applications to Robust Rainfall Modeling
authors: Arnab Hazra
abstract: Statistical modeling of rainfall amounts is of considerable importance in meteorology, hydrology, and agriculture. The gamma distribution remains one of the most popular choices for modeling rainfall data due to its flexibility and ability to capture the skewness of rainfall observations. Rainfall datasets often contain atypical observations due to measurement errors and extreme weather events, making maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) highly sensitive to contamination. In this paper, we develop a robust estimation framework for the two-parameter gamma distribution based on the minimum density power divergence estimator (MDPDE). Explicit estimating equations are derived, and several theoretical properties of the proposed estimators are established. In particular, closed-form expressions for the asymptotic covariance matrix are obtained, and robustness is investigated through influence function analysis and asymptotic relative efficiency. The finite-sample performance of the estimators is examined through simulation studies under both pure and contaminated gamma models. The proposed methodology is further implemented to analyze detrended areally weighted monsoon rainfall data from the 36 meteorological subdivisions of India for the period 1951--2014. The results demonstrate that the MDPDE provides a useful compromise between robustness and efficiency, yielding more stable inference than MLE in the presence of outliers while maintaining high efficiency for uncontaminated data.

title: Cash-invariant hull representation of divergence preferences
authors: Aleš Černý, Johannes Ruf, Martin Schweizer
abstract: Uniformly weighted divergence preferences (UWDP) introduced in Maccheroni et al. (2006) are an important class of risk-averse preferences that contain as a special case the monotone mean--variance utility. UWDP are characterised by the lowest expected value of an act in $L^\infty$ under an adversarially chosen probability measure combined with the divergence of this measure. Our main result provides an alternative, computationally friendlier formula, which establishes in full generality that UWDP are the translation-invariant hull of state-independent expected utility over $L^0$. Some consequences of the new representation are studied.

title: Financial Epiplexity: A Theory of Learnable Market Structure under Bounded Computation
authors: Miquel Noguer i Alonso
abstract: Financial markets are hard to predict, not because price moves are purely random, but because structure is strategic, capacity-constrained, and computationally difficult. Classical information theory measures uncertainty, dependence, and directed flow through entropy, KL divergence, NMI, and transfer entropy. This paper extends that foundation to ask: how much detected structure can a bounded investor learn and reuse? We introduce financial epiplexity: a time-bounded MDL measure of learnable market structure relative to a filtration, representation, model class, and budget. The alpha-relevant object is not raw complexity, but target-specific net compression gain beyond a benchmark, penalizing the model for its description length. This framing aligns with the P-Q wedge: risk-neutral martingality closes arbitrage under a pricing measure, while epiplexity concerns real-world learnability. We prove equal entropy need not imply equal epiplexity, derive finite-sample thresholds for useful regimes, and formalize representation dependence and compute nonmonotonicity. Using the Kelly-Cover-Barron-Cover correspondence, we bound cumulative excess log-growth, Sharpe ratios, sustainable ICs, and breadth by structural bits per period, treating leverage and survival as capacity constraints. The dynamic theory models alpha decay as the migration of private bits into the market budget, crowding as mutual compressibility, and capacity as bit leakage. Finally, the strategic layer explores budget choice, signal congestion, endogenous computational depth, and Red Queen compute competition.

title: Unified and Simple Sample Size Calculations for Individual or Cluster Randomized Trials with Skewed or Ordinal Outcomes
authors: Shengxin Tu, Chun Li, Caroline De Schacht, Carolyn M. Audet, Aminu Taura Abdullahi, Edwin Trevathan, Bryan E. Shepherd
abstract: Sample size calculations can be challenging with skewed continuous outcomes in randomized controlled trials (RCTs). Standard t-test-based calculations may require data transformation, which may be difficult before data collection. Calculations based on individual and clustered Wilcoxon rank-sum tests have been proposed as alternatives, but these calculations for clustered data assume no ties in continuous outcomes, and clustered Wilcoxon rank-sum tests perform poorly with heterogeneous cluster sizes. Recent work has shown that continuous outcomes can be robustly analyzed using ordinal cumulative probability models. Analogously, sample size calculations for ordinal outcomes can be a robust design strategy for continuous outcomes. We show that Whitehead sample size calculations for independent ordinal outcomes can naturally extend to continuous outcomes. We extend these calculations to cluster RCTs using a design effect incorporating rank intraclass correlation coefficients. Therefore, we provide a unifying, simple approach for designing individual and cluster RCTs for continuous or ordinal outcomes that makes minimal assumptions on the distribution of the still-to-be-collected outcome. We conduct simulations to evaluate our approach performance and illustrate its application in multiple RCTs: an individual RCT with skewed continuous outcomes, a cluster RCT with skewed continuous outcomes, and a non-inferiority cluster RCT with an irregularly distributed count outcome.

title: A Limit Order Market with Uncertain Informed Trading Participation
authors: Umut Çetin, Mingwei Lin
abstract: We study a one period limit order market with informed traders, noise traders, and competitive liquidity suppliers, in which the number of informed traders is random. Liquidity suppliers know the distribution of the informed trader count, but not its realization, and therefore face uncertainty about both the presence and the intensity of informed trading. We characterize equilibrium by a fixed point integral equation for the marginal cost function and establish existence of equilibrium for bounded asset values. We then analyse large order asymptotics. For bounded asset values with power law endpoint behaviour, equilibrium price impact follows a power law whose exponent is determined jointly by the asset value tail and the full distribution of the informed trader count. In particular, this exponent is not determined by the expected number of informed traders alone. In the light endpoint regime, price impact is instead logarithmic. Finally, we solve the fixed point numerically across several asset value and informed trader count distributions. The numerical results are consistent with the theoretical asymptotics in the cases covered by the theory and provide comparative statics beyond them.

title: Exact conditional simulation of Point processes: Application to pathwise market impact estimation
authors: Joseph Leclère, Youssef Ouazzani Chahdi, Mathieu Rosenbaum, Grégoire Szymanski
abstract: Market impact is defined as the difference between the observed price trajectory under a given execution strategy and the counterfactual trajectory that would have prevailed without it. Since this counterfactual is unobservable, estimating market impact requires simulating alternative paths under the same realized market randomness. We address this by studying the conditional simulation of point processes under perturbed intensities. Given an observed counting process whose intensity is determined by its own history, we characterize the conditional law of the latent Poisson random measure in a thinning representation. This yields an exact, event-driven algorithm that reconstructs counterfactual paths on a common randomness source, enabling rigorous pathwise market impact estimation for aggressive, passive, and mixed strategies.

title: Reaction-boundary variance and adjoint-consistent local-volatility projection
authors: Chris Angstmann, Tim Gebbie
abstract: We derive an operational-time variance kernel for a latent-order-book reaction boundary and use it to separate three objects usually collapsed in calendar-time volatility models: a structural boundary cumulant, a clock projection, and a pricing-measure choice. The reaction boundary is the zero of a bid--ask imbalance field. For a locally linear book, signed order-flow perturbations displace this zero through a damped Abel response kernel, so the variance of boundary increments is obtained as a finite-scale Green-function cumulant rather than introduced as a primitive diffusion coefficient. For long-memory forcing with exponent $0<γ<1$, the operational variance has a closed asymptotic form involving effective signed-forcing intensity, liquidity slope, resilience, memory, and operational coarse-graining scale. A deterministic activity clock gives the benchmark local-volatility projection. More general, non-unique clocks generate candidate calendar-time pricing systems. We argue that such projections are admissible only when the induced forward density operator and backward valuation operator remain adjoint on the same state space. Adjoint consistency is therefore a reality constraint on operational-to-calendar time projection: it disciplines non-unique time and identifies where incompleteness enters.
comment: Submitted to FMF; 13 pages, 6 Figures, 1 Table; Code reproducibility see: https://github.com/timgebbie/reaction-boundary-vol-surface-reproducibility

title: Order Splitting and Liquidity Replenishment Are Jointly Necessary for the Square-Root Law of Market Impact:
authors: Yang Zhou, Jianwen Chen, Ruipeng Wei
abstract: Three quantitative predictions have been advanced for the square-root law (SRL) of market impact, $I/σ_D = c\,(Q/V_D)^δ$ with $δ\approx 0.5$: GGPS ($δ=β-1$), FGLW ($δ=α-1$), and LOB walking ($δ=1/(1+γ)$). Using a minimal limit-order-book model populated by heterogeneous interacting agents and calibrated against the Tokyo Stock Exchange benchmark ($\langleδ\rangle = 0.489$~\citep{satoStrictUniversalitySquareRoot2025}), we test all three on identical simulated data and find that none matches the per-stock measured $δ$: GGPS and FGLW over-predict by factors of two and four respectively, while LOB walking under-predicts. The model reproduces $\langleδ\rangle = 0.539\pm 0.048$ across 2000 independently parameterised stocks. To identify which mechanisms are causally responsible, we perform counterfactual ablation by selectively suppressing each component. Removing order splitting collapses $δ$ from $0.549$ to $0.324$; removing liquidity replenishment by market makers drops it to $0.386$; perturbations that leave both intact (momentum trading, price limits, splitting rule, background liquidity) move $δ$ by less than $10\%$. Order splitting and liquidity replenishment are thus jointly identified as the necessary mechanisms for the SRL within this model, with the simulated SRL depending on neither the metaorder size tail nor the visible book shape in isolation.

title: Passive Market Impact: A Point Process Approach
authors: Youssef Ouazzani Chahdi, Mathieu Rosenbaum, Grégoire Szymanski
abstract: While the market impact of aggressive orders has been extensively studied, the impact of passive orders, those executed through limit orders, remains less understood. The goal of this paper is to investigate passive market impact by developing a microstructure model connecting liquidity dynamics and price moves. A key innovation of our approach is to replace the traditional assumption of constant information content for each trade by a function that depends on the available volume in the limit order book. Within this framework, we explore scaling limits and analyze the market impact of passive metaorders. Additionally, we derive useful approximations for the shape of market impact curves, leading to closed-form formulas that can be easily applied in practice.

title: A probabilistic approach to continuous differentiability of optimal stopping boundaries
authors: Tiziano De Angelis, Damien Lamberton
abstract: We obtain the first probabilistic proof of continuous differentiability of time-dependent optimal boundaries in optimal stopping problems. The underlying stochastic dynamics is a one-dimensional, time-inhomogeneous diffusion. The gain function is also time-inhomogeneous and not necessarily smooth. Moreover, we include time-and-state-dependent discount rate and the time-horizon can be either finite or infinite. Our arguments of proof are of a local nature that allows us to obtain the result under more general conditions than those used in the PDE literature. As a byproduct of our main result we also obtain the first probabilistic proof of the link between the value function of an optimal stopping problem and the solution of the Stefan's problem.
comment: 43 pages; final version accepted for publication

title: Safeguarding LLM Agents from Misalignment through Provenance Analysis
authors: Yining She, Yiliang Liang, Eunsuk Kang
abstract: As LLM agents gain increasing access to powerful tools, ensuring that their actions are aligned with the user's intent becomes critical. When an agent's proposed tool invocation deviates from the user's intent -- a phenomenon called misalignment -- it may lead to harmful consequences that are difficult to undo. Existing runtime guardrails rely on an LLM-as-a-judge paradigm that lacks a systematic framework for reasoning about alignment, often producing judgments that are inconsistent or difficult to audit. Motivated by provenance analysis, we propose a provenance-based conceptual framework that formalizes misalignment detection as determining whether a proposed tool call is supported by traceable evidence in the agent's context. Building on this framework, we propose ProvenanceGuard, a multi-stage pipeline that analyzes the agent's action for three types of misalignment before the selected tool is executed and only allows the action to take place when it is considered aligned with the user's input query. We evaluated our proposed approach on two different benchmarks, Agent-SafetyBench and WorkBench, across 10 backbone LLMs. Compared to the LLM-as-a-judge baseline, ProvenanceGuard reduces error rate on misaligned traces from 42.9% to 1.8% on Agent-SafetyBench and from 32.1% to 17.3% on WorkBench, while reducing intervention burden on task-successful traces from 30.5% to 12.8% and introducing no statistically significant increase in unnecessary interventions on aligned traces. These results demonstrate that structured, provenance-based reasoning provides an effective and practical foundation for safeguarding LLM agents from misalignment.
zh_title: 通过溯源分析保护LLM代理免受错位影响
translation: 随着LLM代理获得越来越多的强大工具访问权限，确保其行动与用户意图保持一致变得至关重要。当代理提议的工具调用偏离用户意图——一种被称为错位的现象——时，可能导致难以挽回的有害后果。现有的运行时防护措施依赖于“LLM作为判断者”的范式，缺乏一个系统性的对齐推理框架，常常产生不一致或难以审计的判断。受溯源分析的启发，我们提出了一个基于溯源的概念框架，将错位检测形式化为确定一个提议的工具调用是否由代理上下文中可追溯的证据支持。在此框架基础上，我们提出了ProvenanceGuard，一个多阶段管道，用于在选定的工具执行前分析代理行动的三种错位类型，并仅在行动被认为与用户输入查询对齐时才允许其发生。我们在两个不同的基准测试（Agent-SafetyBench和WorkBench）上，对10个骨干LLM评估了我们提出的方法。与“LLM作为判断者”的基线相比，ProvenanceGuard在Agent-SafetyBench上将错位轨迹的错误率从42.9%降低到1.8%，在WorkBench上从32.1%降低到17.3%，同时将任务成功轨迹上的干预负担从30.5%降低到12.8%，并且在对齐轨迹上没有统计学上显著增加不必要的干预。这些结果表明，结构化的、基于溯源的推理为保护LLM代理免受错位影响提供了一个有效且实用的基础。
tldr: 本文提出ProvenanceGuard，一个基于溯源分析的多阶段管道，用于在LLM代理执行工具调用前检测并防止与用户意图的错位，显著降低了错误率并减轻了干预负担。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于引入了溯源分析来系统性地解决LLM代理的错位问题，提供了一个比传统“LLM作为判断者”方法更具可审计性和一致性的框架。ProvenanceGuard通过多阶段管道，在工具执行前进行细致的错位类型分析，有效地提升了代理的安全性。其在降低错误率和干预负担方面的实验结果令人印象深刻，为未来LLM代理的安全性和可靠性研究奠定了基础。
motivation: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）代理获得强大的工具访问权限，确保其行动与用户意图保持一致变得至关重要。当代理的工具调用偏离用户意图（即错位）时，可能导致难以撤销的有害后果。现有的运行时防护措施依赖于“LLM作为判断者”的范式，缺乏系统性的对齐推理框架，导致判断不一致或难以审计。
method: 本文提出了一个基于溯源的概念框架，将错位检测形式化为确定提议的工具调用是否由代理上下文中可追溯的证据支持。在此框架基础上，提出了ProvenanceGuard，一个多阶段管道，用于在选定的工具执行前分析代理行动的三种错位类型，并仅在行动被认为与用户输入查询对齐时才允许其发生。
results: ProvenanceGuard在Agent-SafetyBench上将错位轨迹的错误率从42.9%降低到1.8%，在WorkBench上从32.1%降低到17.3%。同时，将任务成功轨迹上的干预负担从30.5%降低到12.8%，并且在对齐轨迹上没有统计学上显著增加不必要的干预。
conclusion: 结构化的、基于溯源的推理为保护LLM代理免受错位影响提供了一个有效且实用的基础。

title: Kara: Efficient Reasoning LLM Serving via Sliding-Window KV Cache Compression
authors: Shen Han, Yuyang Wu
abstract: Reasoning language models often generate long chain-of-thought (CoT), which accumulates a massive KV cache during the decoding phase and incurs high decoding latency and limited throughput. To address these issues, KV cache compression has emerged as a promising technique for reducing memory overhead by selectively removing unimportant KV pairs while preserving useful ones for subsequent decoding. Nevertheless, we identify two key limitations in existing KV cache compression methods: 1) their threshold-triggered compression policy may provide limited throughput improvement or even reduce throughput, and may fully eliminate KV pairs from certain blocks of the sequence, potentially worsening information loss. 2) they typically retain either isolated KV pairs or fixed-size chunks with rigid boundaries, failing to preserve important flexible-sized chunks at arbitrary token positions. To overcome these limitations, we propose Kara, a sliding-window KV cache compression method that performs decoding-time compression by operating only on the recently generated context. Kara leverages bidirectional attention to score and select informative KV pairs in the window. To enable flexible preservation of important semantic information, we design a Token2Chunk module to expand a subset of selected KV pairs into chunks. Furthermore, we adapt Kara to PagedAttention and develop KvLLM, an inference framework built upon vLLM, which reduces KV cache memory usage and effectively improves output throughput. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent performance improvements of proposed Kara and KvLLM.
zh_title: Kara：通过滑动窗口KV缓存压缩实现高效推理LLM服务
translation: 推理语言模型通常会生成长链式思考（CoT），这在解码阶段会积累大量的KV缓存，导致高解码延迟和有限的吞吐量。为了解决这些问题，KV缓存压缩已成为一种很有前景的技术，通过选择性地移除不重要的KV对同时保留有用的KV对以进行后续解码来减少内存开销。然而，我们发现现有KV缓存压缩方法存在两个主要局限性：1) 它们的阈值触发压缩策略可能提供有限的吞吐量改进，甚至降低吞吐量，并且可能完全消除序列中某些块的KV对，从而可能恶化信息丢失。2) 它们通常保留孤立的KV对或具有固定边界的固定大小块，未能保留任意token位置处重要的灵活大小块。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了Kara，一种滑动窗口KV缓存压缩方法，通过仅在最近生成的上下文上操作来执行解码时压缩。Kara利用双向注意力对窗口中的信息丰富的KV对进行评分和选择。为了灵活保留重要的语义信息，我们设计了一个Token2Chunk模块，将选定的KV对子集扩展为块。此外，我们将Kara适配到PagedAttention并开发了KvLLM，一个基于vLLM构建的推理框架，它减少了KV缓存内存使用并有效提高了输出吞吐量。广泛的实验证明了所提出的Kara和KvLLM持续的性能改进。
tldr: Kara是一种滑动窗口KV缓存压缩方法，通过在最近生成的上下文上操作，并利用双向注意力选择信息丰富的KV对，然后通过Token2Chunk模块扩展为块，从而有效减少LLM推理时的KV缓存内存使用并提高输出吞吐量。
ai_comments: Kara的创新之处在于其滑动窗口压缩策略和Token2Chunk模块，能够更灵活、更有效地管理KV缓存。通过在最近生成的上下文上操作并保留语义块，它解决了现有方法在信息丢失和吞吐量提升方面的不足。KvLLM作为基于vLLM的框架，展示了其在实际应用中的潜力，对提高LLM服务效率具有重要意义。
motivation: 推理语言模型在解码阶段会积累大量KV缓存，导致高解码延迟和有限的吞吐量。现有KV缓存压缩方法存在局限性：1) 阈值触发的压缩策略可能吞吐量提升有限或降低，并可能导致信息丢失；2) 它们通常保留孤立的KV对或固定大小的块，未能灵活保留重要信息。
method: Kara提出了一种滑动窗口KV缓存压缩方法，仅在最近生成的上下文中进行解码时压缩。它利用双向注意力对窗口中的信息丰富的KV对进行评分和选择。为了灵活保留重要语义信息，设计了一个Token2Chunk模块将选定的KV对子集扩展为块。此外，Kara适配了PagedAttention，并开发了基于vLLM的推理框架KvLLM。
results: Kara和KvLLM在实验中展示了持续的性能改进，减少了KV缓存内存使用并有效提高了输出吞吐量。
conclusion: Kara通过其创新的滑动窗口压缩方法和Token2Chunk模块，有效解决了推理LLM服务中KV缓存内存和吞吐量瓶颈，实现了显著的性能提升。

title: TokenScope: Token-Level Explainability and Interpretability for Code-Oriented Tasks in Large Language Models
authors: Amirreza Esmaeili, Fatemeh Fard
abstract: Understanding how Large Language Models (LLMs) make token-level decisions during code generation remains a major challenge for both researchers and practitioners. While recent tools provide insights into model internals or generation outcomes, they often lack decoding-time signals, fine-grained uncertainty measures, and interactive mechanisms for exploring alternative generation paths. We present TokenScope, an interactive interpretability and analysis tool for decoder-based LLMs that exposes token-level metrics, attention patterns, and structural information during generation. TokenScope supports interactive token replacement, counterfactual branching, and code-aware aggregation via abstract syntax trees. By unifying decoding-time signals with structural program analysis, TokenScope enables systematic investigation of LLM behaviour during code generation.
zh_title: TokenScope：大语言模型代码导向任务的Token级可解释性与可解读性
translation: 理解大型语言模型（LLM）在代码生成过程中如何做出Token级别的决策，对于研究人员和从业者来说仍然是一个重大挑战。虽然最近的工具提供了对模型内部或生成结果的洞察，但它们往往缺乏解码时的信号、细粒度的不确定性度量以及用于探索替代生成路径的交互机制。我们提出了TokenScope，这是一个针对基于解码器的LLM的交互式可解释性与分析工具，它在生成过程中展示了Token级别的指标、注意力模式和结构信息。TokenScope支持交互式Token替换、反事实分支以及通过抽象语法树（AST）进行的代码感知聚合。通过将解码时信号与结构化程序分析相结合，TokenScope能够对LLM在代码生成过程中的行为进行系统性的调查。
tldr: TokenScope是一个针对大语言模型的交互式分析工具，它通过结合解码时信号（如Token指标、注意力）与程序结构分析（如抽象语法树），支持反事实分支和Token替换，从而实现对代码生成过程中Token级决策的系统性解释。
ai_comments: 该工作针对大语言模型在代码生成任务中的可解释性痛点，创新性地将解码时的动态信号（如Token级指标、注意力模式）与静态的程序结构分析（如AST抽象语法树）相结合。其引入的交互式Token替换和反事实分支功能，为研究人员和开发者深入探索模型决策路径提供了新颖且实用的手段。不过，摘要中未给出具体的应用案例或用户实验来量化评估该工具在实际代码调试和模型分析中的效率提升。
motivation: 理解大语言模型（LLM）在代码生成过程中如何做出Token级别的决策是一个重大挑战。现有工具虽然能提供模型内部或生成结果的一些洞察，但通常缺乏解码时信号、细粒度的不确定性度量以及探索替代生成路径的交互式机制。
method: 提出了一种名为TokenScope的交互式可解释性与分析工具，适用于基于解码器（decoder-based）的LLM。它在模型生成过程中显式展示Token级指标、注意力模式和结构信息，并支持交互式Token替换、反事实分支（counterfactual branching）以及基于抽象语法树（AST）的代码感知聚合。
results: 成功开发了TokenScope工具，该工具通过结合解码时信号与结构化程序分析，使用户能够对大语言模型在代码生成期间的行为进行系统性、多维度的交互分析和探索。
conclusion: TokenScope通过将解码时信号与结构化程序分析相统一，为系统性调查和理解LLM在代码生成过程中的Token级行为提供了一种强大且交互式的解决方案。

title: SPARCLE: SPeaker-aware Aligned Representations via Contrastive Language Embeddings
authors: Priyam Mazumdar, Yurii Halychanskyi, Steven Guo, Mark Hasegawa-Johnson, Volodymyr Kindratenko
abstract:
Recent advances in speech synthesis have shifted from phoneme representations to direct grapheme modeling. While phonemes address the one-to-many mapping between text and acoustics, they rely on grapheme-to-phoneme (G2P) systems that fail to capture speaker-specific acoustic variation. Prior work demonstrates that grapheme-based models outperform phoneme-based systems at scale, but not in low-resource settings.
  In this paper, we propose SPARCLE, a speaker-aware grapheme representation model that enriches characters with their precise acoustic realizations. SPARCLE is trained with a contrastive objective to align graphemes with corresponding Wav2Vec2 acoustic representations while conditioned on speaker identity. The resulting model serves as a replacement to G2P systems for downstream text-to-speech (TTS) tasks. We demonstrate that SPARCLE improves generation quality, reducing word error rates by half in extreme low-resource settings compared to standard grapheme-based models.
zh_title: SPARCLE：通过对比语言嵌入实现的说话人感知对齐表示
translation:
最近语音合成的进展已从音素表示转向直接的字素建模。虽然音素解决了文本与声学之间的一对多映射问题，但它们依赖于字素到音素（G2P）系统，而这些系统未能捕捉说话人特定的声学变异。先前的研究表明，基于字素的模型在大规模设置中优于基于音素的系统，但在低资源设置中则不然。
在本文中，我们提出了 SPARCLE，一个说话人感知的字素表示模型，它通过精确的声学实现来丰富字符。SPARCLE 通过对比目标进行训练，在以说话人身份为条件的同时，将字素与相应的 Wav2Vec2 声学表示对齐。由此产生的模型可作为下游文本到语音（TTS）任务中 G2P 系统的替代品。我们证明 SPARCLE 提高了生成质量，与标准基于字素的模型相比，在极端低资源设置下将词错误率降低了一半。
tldr: SPARCLE 提出了一种说话人感知的字素表示模型，通过对比学习将字素与声学表示对齐，并在低资源环境下将文本到语音（TTS）的错误率降低一半。
ai_comments: SPARCLE 的创新之处在于通过对比学习和说话人身份条件化，成功地将字素与说话人特有的声学信息结合，从而在低资源环境下显著提升语音合成质量。这对于减少对G2P系统的依赖，并在资源受限的语言中推广高质量语音合成具有重要意义。
motivation: 语音合成中的音素表示依赖 G2P 系统，无法捕捉说话人特有的声学变异；字素模型在大规模设置中表现优异，但在低资源设置中效果不佳。需要一种新的方法来解决这些问题并提高低资源环境下的语音合成质量。
method: 提出 SPARCLE 模型，一个说话人感知的字素表示模型，通过对比目标进行训练，在以说话人身份为条件的同时，将字素与 Wav2Vec2 声学表示对齐。该模型旨在替代下游文本到语音（TTS）任务中的 G2P 系统。
results: SPARCLE 提高了生成质量，与标准字素模型相比，在极端低资源设置下将词错误率降低了一半。
conclusion: SPARCLE 成功地提供了一种说话人感知的字素表示，显著改善了低资源环境下语音合成的质量，并可作为 G2P 系统的有效替代。

title: Breaking Safety at the Token Boundary: How BPE Tokenization Creates Exploitable Gaps in LLM Alignment
authors: Tung-Ling Li, Hongliang Liu, Yuhao Wu
abstract: Character-level perturbations bypass safety alignment in modern LLMs despite leaving prompts human-readable. We identify and test a central structural mechanism: BPE tokenization fragments safety-critical words into sub-word pieces, and the three public alignment datasets we surveyed contain no intentionally fragmented inputs. The mechanism is a chain, tested end-to-end on five model families (Qwen-3-4B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Gemma-3-4B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B). An optimization targeting safety-token fragmentation flips the first-token refusal trigger on 80-100% of refused HarmBench prompts, with 48% of those flips producing genuinely harmful outputs (per-model 29-65%; gap-vs-behavior ROC-AUC 0.66-0.98, pooled 0.84). Activation patching localizes the disrupted signal to the last ${\sim}30\%$ of layers; an alignment-data scan finds zero fragmented prompts among 30,000 examples (positive-control recall $\geq 99\%$ at attack-relevant intensities); and targeted-mutation experiments isolate safety words as the disruption locus. On the defense side, a 68-cell grid (55 trained checkpoints) shows that no DPO configuration achieves seed- and pool-stable ASR closure on the three families with closed pool-size confounds. SFT trained on fragmented prompts closes ASR on 3/5 families but only via global collapse that raises refusal on benign prompts as well, indicating the missing distribution is necessary but not sufficient under the LoRA-16 recipe we tested. To distinguish selective repair from global collapse, we introduce Conv-Benign, a candidate paired diagnostic. All ASR claims are 3-judge-calibrated (cell rankings stable across judges; absolute levels $\pm$18pp; see App.~B.13).
zh_title: 突破令牌边界的安全：BPE分词如何在大语言模型对齐中制造可利用的漏洞
translation: 尽管提示对人类可读，字符级扰动仍能绕过现代LLM的安全对齐。我们识别并测试了一个核心的结构性机制：BPE分词将安全关键词汇碎片化为子词片段，而我们调查的三个公共对齐数据集中不不包含有意碎片化的输入。该机制是一个链条，在五个模型家族（Qwen-3-4B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Gemma-3-4B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B）上进行了端到端测试。针对安全令牌碎片化的优化在80-100%被拒绝的HarmBench提示上翻转了首个令牌拒绝触发器，其中48%的翻转产生了真正有害的输出（各模型29-65%；差距与行为ROC-AUC 0.66-0.98，汇总0.84）。激活补丁将受损信号定位到最后约30%的层；对齐数据扫描在30,000个样本中未发现碎片化提示（在攻击相关强度下，正向控制召回率≥99%）；目标突变实验将安全词汇隔离为干扰源。在防御方面，一个68个单元格的网格（55个训练检查点）显示，在三个具有封闭池大小混淆的家族上，没有DPO配置能够实现种子和池稳定的ASR闭合。在碎片化提示上训练的SFT在3/5的家族上实现了ASR闭合，但仅通过全局崩溃，同时提高了对良性提示的拒绝率，这表明在所测试的LoRA-16方案下，缺失的分布是必要但不充分的。为了区分选择性修复和全局崩溃，我们引入了Conv-Benign，一个候选的配对诊断工具。所有ASR声明均经过3位裁判校准（单元格排名在裁判间稳定；绝对水平±18pp；参见附录B.13）。
tldr: BPE分词会将安全关键词汇碎片化为子词片段，从而在大语言模型（LLM）的安全对齐中制造可利用的漏洞，使得字符级扰动能够绕过安全机制并生成有害输出。
ai_comments: 该论文通过识别并系统分析与BPE分词相关的LLM安全对齐中的一个基本结构性漏洞，做出了重要贡献。其端到端测试、对干扰源的定位以及对防御局限性的探讨，凸显了当前对齐实践中的一个关键盲点。现有对齐数据集中缺乏碎片化输入的发现尤其具有洞察力，暗示了系统性的疏忽。引入Conv-Benign作为诊断工具也很有价值。
motivation: 尽管提示词对人类可读，但字符级扰动能够绕过现代LLM的安全对齐。本文旨在识别并测试一个核心的结构性机制：BPE分词如何将安全关键词汇碎片化，从而在大语言模型对齐中制造可利用的漏洞。
method: 研究人员识别了BPE分词作为将安全关键词汇碎片化的机制。他们调查了三个公开的对齐数据集，发现其中不包含有意碎片化的输入。该机制在五个模型家族（Qwen-3-4B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Gemma-3-4B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B）上进行了端到端测试。他们使用了一种针对安全令牌碎片化的优化方法，并利用激活补丁（activation patching）将受损信号定位到最后约30%的层。对齐数据扫描分析了30,000个样本，目标突变实验（targeted-mutation experiments）分离了安全词作为干扰源。在防御方面，他们使用68个单元格网格（55个训练检查点）评估了DPO配置和在碎片化提示上训练的SFT，并引入了Conv-Benign作为候选配对诊断工具。所有的攻击成功率（ASR）声明都经过了3位裁判校准。
results: BPE分词会将安全关键词汇碎片化为子词片段，并且所调查的三个公共对齐数据集中不包含有意碎片化的输入。针对安全令牌碎片化的优化在80-100%被拒绝的HarmBench提示上翻转了首个令牌拒绝触发器，其中48%的翻转产生了真正有害的输出（各模型29-65%；差距与行为ROC-AUC 0.66-0.98，汇总0.84）。激活补丁将受损信号定位到最后约30%的层。对齐数据扫描在30,000个样本中未发现碎片化提示。目标突变实验将安全词汇隔离为干扰源。在三个具有封闭池大小混淆的家族上，没有DPO配置能够实现种子和池稳定的ASR闭合。在碎片化提示上训练的SFT在3/5的家族上实现了ASR闭合，但仅通过全局崩溃，同时提高了对良性提示的拒绝率。这表明在所测试的LoRA-16方案下，缺失的分布是必要但不充分的。
conclusion: BPE分词通过将安全关键词汇碎片化，在大语言模型（LLM）安全对齐中制造了可利用的漏洞。现有对齐数据集未能解决这一问题，并且使用标准微调方法（如SFT）来修复此漏洞，往往会导致全局崩溃，即模型对良性提示的拒绝率也随之升高。这表明，虽然包含碎片化提示的分布是有效防御的必要条件，但在当前的方法下，它并非充分条件。

title: Prompt Framing Distorts Count-Based Evaluation of LLM Error Detection: Evidence from Numeric Anchoring
authors: Dekun Yang
abstract: Count-based F1 is widely used as a proxy for LLM error-detection quality, but this paper shows that it can rise dramatically without a corresponding improvement in span localization, a gap termed F1 Inflation. The paper introduces ErrorBench, a controlled stress-test protocol for prompt-induced count distortion. ErrorBench evaluates six contemporary LLMs under five prompt conditions over 4,290 responses from 143 CoNLL-2014 passages. Under CoNLL-2014 M2-style scoring, anchored prompts produce up to 0.79 points of F1 Inflation, and up to 0.96 under strict matching. A 100-passage replication using the official ERRANT 3.0.0 pipeline and multi-reference scoring reproduces the pattern: averaged over six models, the Blind-to-Anchored prompt shift raises Count-F1 by +0.21 while raising multi-reference ERRANT F0.5 by only +0.04. The study finds larger count responses in highly instruction-compliant GPT/Claude systems and smaller responses in the Gemini family under this stress-test protocol. The findings suggest that LLM proofreading and document-review evaluations should avoid pre-populated error counts and should report span-aware metrics alongside count-based metrics.
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables. Preprint under review
zh_title: 提示框架扭曲了基于计数的LLM错误检测评估：来自数字锚定的证据
translation: 基于计数的F1分数被广泛用作LLM错误检测质量的代理指标，但本文表明，在没有相应改进跨度定位的情况下，F1分数会急剧上升，这种差距被称为F1通胀。本文介绍了ErrorBench，一个用于提示引起的计数失真的受控压力测试协议。ErrorBench在五种提示条件下评估了六个当代LLM，使用了来自143个CoNLL-2014段落的4,290个响应。在CoNLL-2014 M2风格评分下，锚定提示产生了高达0.79点的F1通胀，在严格匹配下高达0.96点。使用官方ERRANT 3.0.0管道和多参考评分对100个段落进行复制，重现了这种模式：在六个模型上平均，从盲到锚定提示的转变使基于计数的F1分数提高了+0.21，而多参考ERRANT F0.5仅提高了+0.04。研究发现，在高度符合指令的GPT/Claude系统中，计数响应更大，而在Gemini家族中，在这种压力测试协议下，响应更小。研究结果表明，LLM校对和文档审查评估应避免预先填充的错误计数，并应报告跨度感知指标以及基于计数的指标。
tldr: 提示框架，特别是数字锚定，会夸大LLM错误检测中基于计数的F1分数，而没有相应地改善实际的跨度定位，从而导致误导性的评估。
ai_comments: 这篇论文揭示了当前LLM错误检测评估中一个关键的方法论缺陷，即提示框架对基于计数的指标造成的扭曲。引入“F1通胀”和ErrorBench协议为理解和缓解这一问题提供了一个有价值的框架。其发现对于开发更健壮、更可靠的LLM校对和文档审查等任务的评估实践至关重要，强调了对跨度感知指标的需求。研究中对不同模型家族（GPT/Claude与Gemini）在压力测试下响应差异的区分也增加了研究的深度。
motivation: 本文旨在揭示，广泛用于评估LLM错误检测质量的基于计数的F1分数，在没有相应改进跨度定位的情况下，会因提示框架（特别是数字锚定）而急剧上升，这种差距被称为“F1通胀”。
method: 本文引入了ErrorBench，一个用于提示引起的计数失真的受控压力测试协议。该协议在五种提示条件下评估了六个当代LLM，使用了来自143个CoNLL-2014段落的4,290个响应。评估采用了CoNLL-2014 M2风格评分，并通过使用官方ERRANT 3.0.0管道和多参考评分对100个段落进行复制来验证发现。
results: 在M2风格评分下，锚定提示产生了高达0.79点的F1通胀，在严格匹配下高达0.96点。复制实验表明，从盲到锚定提示的转变使基于计数的F1分数提高了+0.21，而多参考ERRANT F0.5仅提高了+0.04。在压力测试协议下，高度符合指令的GPT/Claude系统显示出更大的计数响应，而Gemini家族则显示出更小的响应。
conclusion: LLM校对和文档审查评估应避免预先填充的错误计数，并应在报告基于计数的指标的同时报告跨度感知指标。

title: ExPerT: Personalizing LLM Responses to Users' Domain Expertise via Query-Wise Semantic and Keystroke Behavioral Cues
authors: Yeji Park, Jiwon Tark, Taesik Gong
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used by end users, yet existing personalization methods relying on static profiles or text-only signals fail to capture query-specific expertise variation. We present ExPerT, a query-wise personalization framework that adapts LLM responses to users' query domain expertise by combining semantic and behavioral cues. ExPerT consists of two key components: (i) a semantic-behavioral expertise inference module that jointly interprets query text and keystroke dynamics via in-context LLM prompting, and (ii) an expertise-conditioned response generation that adapts the level of detail, terminology, and conceptual complexity. Our user study with 40 participants and 1270 queries demonstrated that ExPerT reduced expertise inference error by 65.7% compared to the strongest baseline (MAE = 0.398 vs. 1.162) and improved response satisfaction by 17.52% (from 3.71 to 4.36) on a 5-point Likert scale.
zh_title: ExPerT：通过查询级语义和按键行为线索个性化LLM对用户领域专业知识的响应
translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）正被终端用户越来越多地使用，但现有依赖静态配置文件或纯文本信号的个性化方法未能捕捉到查询特定的专业知识差异。我们提出了ExPerT，一个查询级个性化框架，通过结合语义和行为线索，根据用户的查询领域专业知识调整LLM响应。ExPerT包含两个关键组件：(i) 一个语义-行为专业知识推断模块，通过上下文LLM提示共同解释查询文本和按键动态；(ii) 一个专业知识条件响应生成模块，用于调整详细程度、术语和概念复杂性。我们对40名参与者和1270个查询进行的用户研究表明，与最强基线相比，ExPerT将专业知识推断错误率降低了65.7%（平均绝对误差从1.162降至0.398），并将响应满意度提高了17.52%（从3.71提高到4.36，基于5点李克特量表）。
tldr: ExPerT是一个查询级个性化框架，它结合语义和按键行为线索，根据用户的查询领域专业知识调整大型语言模型（LLM）的响应，显著提高了专业知识推断的准确性和用户满意度。
ai_comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于其首次提出了将用户在查询过程中的按键行为动态作为一种新的信号，与查询语义相结合来推断用户在特定领域内的专业知识水平。这种查询级的个性化方法比传统的静态用户画像或纯文本分析更为精细和动态，能够更好地适应用户即时需求，从而显著提升LLM响应的相关性和用户满意度。该方法为未来LLM的个性化发展提供了新的思路。
motivation: 现有依赖静态配置文件或纯文本信号的LLM个性化方法无法捕捉查询特定的专业知识差异，导致LLM响应未能充分适应用户的特定领域专业知识。
method: ExPerT框架包含两个关键组件：(i) 一个语义-行为专业知识推断模块，通过上下文LLM提示共同解释查询文本和按键动态；(ii) 一个专业知识条件响应生成模块，根据专业知识水平调整详细程度、术语和概念复杂性。它通过结合语义和行为线索来适应用户的查询领域专业知识。
results: 用户研究表明，ExPerT将专业知识推断错误率比最强基线降低了65.7%（平均绝对误差从1.162降至0.398），并将响应满意度提高了17.52%（从3.71提高到4.36，基于5点李克特量表）。
conclusion: ExPerT通过结合查询级语义和按键行为线索，有效地实现了LLM响应对用户领域专业知识的个性化，显著提高了专业知识推断的准确性和用户满意度。

title: Mapping Text to Multiplex Graph: Prompt Compression as Lévy Walk-Guided Graph Pruning
authors: Yaxin Gao, Yao Lu, Jinhong Deng, Jiaqi Nie, Zhe Tang, Jian Zhang, Zhaowei Zhu, Shanqing Yu, Qi Xuan, Joey Tianyi Zhou
abstract: Existing prompt compression methods treat text as flat token sequences, failing to capture the distributed nature of important information, which is often spread across multiple locations and connected through both local syntactic dependencies and global semantic relations. Such relational structure is naturally represented as a graph, where tokens or sentences become nodes and their dependencies become edges. To this end, we propose RAGP, which formulates prompt compression as Redundancy-Aware Graph Pruning on a multiplex graph that jointly models fine-grained attention-based dependencies and coarse-grained semantic relations. To efficiently identify non-redundant nodes in this heterogeneous structure (dense local subgraphs and sparse global connections), we employ Levy walks whose heavy-tailed step distribution naturally balances local exploitation with global exploration. Experiments on LongBench show that RAGP achieves an average score of 49.3 under a 4x compression ratio, outperforming existing LLM-based compression methods, such as LongLLMLingua, which attains 48.8 at a 3x compression ratio. Besides, RAGP also surpasses state-of-the-art vision-based text compression paradigms on multiple tasks. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RAGP-B0CB.
zh_title: 将文本映射到多重图：以Lévy游走引导的图剪枝进行提示压缩
translation: 现有提示压缩方法将文本视为扁平的 token 序列，未能捕获重要信息的分布式特性，这些信息通常分散在多个位置，并通过局部句法依赖和全局语义关系连接。这种关系结构自然地表示为图，其中 token 或句子成为节点，它们的依赖关系成为边。为此，我们提出了 RAGP，它将提示压缩公式化为多重图上的冗余感知图剪枝，该多重图共同建模细粒度基于注意力的依赖和粗粒度语义关系。为了有效地识别这种异构结构（密集的局部子图和稀疏的全局连接）中的非冗余节点，我们采用 Lévy 游走，其重尾步长分布自然地平衡了局部利用和全局探索。在 LongBench 上的实验表明，RAGP 在 4 倍压缩比下取得了 49.3 的平均分数，优于现有基于 LLM 的压缩方法，例如 LongLLMLingua，后者在 3 倍压缩比下达到了 48.8。此外，RAGP 还在多项任务上超越了最先进的基于视觉的文本压缩范式。代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/RAGP-B0CB 获取。
tldr: RAGP提出了一种将提示压缩视为多重图剪枝的新方法，通过Lévy游走有效识别非冗余节点，在LongBench上表现优于现有LLM和视觉压缩方法。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将提示压缩视为多重图上的图剪枝问题，有效地建模了文本中多样化的关系结构。利用Lévy游走在异构图结构中进行高效探索也是一个显著的贡献。这种方法为处理文本冗余提供了一种比传统序列方法更精细的方式。
motivation: 现有提示压缩方法将文本视为扁平的 token 序列，未能捕获重要信息的分布式特性，这些信息通常分散在多个位置，并通过局部句法依赖和全局语义关系连接。
method: 提出RAGP（冗余感知图剪枝），将提示压缩公式化为在多重图上进行图剪枝。该多重图共同建模细粒度基于注意力的依赖和粗粒度语义关系。为有效识别异构结构中的非冗余节点，采用Lévy游走，其重尾步长分布平衡了局部利用和全局探索。
results: RAGP在LongBench上以4倍压缩比取得了49.3的平均分数，优于现有LLM压缩方法（如LongLLMLingua在3倍压缩比下为48.8）。此外，RAGP还在多项任务上超越了最先进的基于视觉的文本压缩范式。
conclusion: RAGP通过将文本映射到多重图并利用Lévy游走进行图剪枝，有效解决了现有提示压缩方法的局限性，实现了卓越的性能。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation to Support Railways Engineering Tasks: A Case Study
authors: Andrea Gerardo Russo, Federico Ruggeri, Ivan Tomarchio, Davide Bombini, Nicolò Donati, Gianmarco Pappacoda, Paolo Torroni, Giuseppe-Emiliano La Cara
abstract: The growing number and complexity of technical regulations represent an important challenge for all professionals in regulated industries. This paper describes a case study, from design to deployment, of building a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system for the consultation of complex technical regulations in the railway domain. Although developed for the railway sector, this testimony of an industrial experience is of particular value for technical domains where regulatory compliance and accurate information retrieval from complex documentation are essential requirements. It also constitutes a human-centered approach for implementing LLM-powered technical documentation consultation across various regulated industries, balancing technological capabilities with domain expertise.
zh_title: 检索增强生成支持铁路工程任务：一个案例研究
translation: 日益增长且复杂的技术法规对所有受监管行业的专业人士构成了重要挑战。本文描述了一个在铁路领域为复杂技术法规咨询构建检索增强生成系统的案例研究，从设计到部署。尽管是为铁路部门开发的，但这种工业经验的证明对于那些法规遵从性和从复杂文档中准确检索信息是基本要求的技术领域具有特殊价值。它也构成了一种以人为本的方法，用于在各种受监管行业中实施由LLM驱动的技术文档咨询，平衡了技术能力与领域专业知识。
tldr: 本文介绍了一个在铁路领域为复杂技术法规咨询构建检索增强生成系统的案例研究，强调其对需要法规遵从性和准确信息检索的行业的价值。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新在于将检索增强生成技术应用于铁路工程任务的法规咨询，提供了一个具体的工业案例。其重要性在于解决了受监管行业中日益复杂的法规查阅难题，并提出了一种平衡技术与领域专业知识的人机协作方法。这对于推动LLM在工业应用中的落地具有参考价值。
motivation: 日益增长且复杂的技术法规对受监管行业的专业人士构成了重大挑战，尤其是在铁路领域，需要有效的法规咨询和信息检索。
method: 构建了一个检索增强生成（RAG）系统，用于铁路领域复杂技术法规的咨询，并对其从设计到部署进行了案例研究。
results: 成功构建了一个RAG系统，并在铁路领域进行了部署。该系统为需要法规遵从性和从复杂文档中准确检索信息的其他技术领域提供了宝贵的工业经验，并展示了一种以人为中心的方法来实现LLM驱动的技术文档咨询。
conclusion: 所开发的RAG系统提供了一种以人为中心的方法，用于在各种受监管行业中实施LLM驱动的技术文档咨询，平衡了技术能力与领域专业知识，对于需要法规遵从性和精确信息检索的领域具有重要价值。

title: STRUCTSURVEY: Structured Agentic Retrieval for Automated Survey Paper Generation
authors: Paolo Pedinotti, Enrico Santus
abstract: The rapid growth of scientific publications makes it increasingly difficult to track and synthesize research progress. While Large Language Models (LLMs) can support automated survey generation, existing methods retrieve unstructured data and require models to infer conceptual, methodological, and taxonomic relations from raw text at generation time. We introduce STRUCTSURVEY, a hierarchical multi-agent framework that shifts structural reasoning from generation to retrieval by dynamically constructing graph-based representations of entities, relations, and topical taxonomies. We evaluate STRUCTSURVEY on a new reference-grounded benchmark of ACL survey papers for reproducible long-form scientific summarization. Compared with embedding-only retrieval baselines, STRUCTSURVEY improves ROUGE-1 recall by +2.9 and ROUGE-2 recall by +1.0 on average, without reducing precision. It also improves LLM-as-a-Judge ratings for logical structure, depth, and synthesis, showing that explicit structural retrieval yields surveys closer to human-written organization and reasoning.
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, appendices, SurgeLLM, RAG4Reports, ACL
zh_title: STRUCTSURVEY：用于自动化综述论文生成的结构化智能体检索
translation: 科学出版物的快速增长使得跟踪和综合研究进展变得越来越困难。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）可以支持自动化综述生成，但现有方法检索非结构化数据，并要求模型在生成时从原始文本中推断概念、方法和分类关系。我们引入了STRUCTSURVEY，一个分层多智能体框架，通过动态构建实体、关系和主题分类的图基表示，将结构化推理从生成转移到检索。我们在一个新的基于ACL综述论文的参考基准上评估了STRUCTSURVEY，用于可重现的长篇科学摘要。与仅嵌入检索基线相比，STRUCTSURVEY的ROUGE-1召回率平均提高+2.9，ROUGE-2召回率平均提高+1.0，且未降低精确度。它还提高了LLM-as-a-Judge对逻辑结构、深度和综合性的评分，表明明确的结构化检索能够生成更接近人类编写组织和推理的综述论文。
tldr: STRUCTSURVEY是一个多智能体框架，通过构建图基表示将结构化推理从生成转移到检索，从而改进自动化综述论文生成。
ai_comments: STRUCTSURVEY的创新之处在于将结构化推理从生成时转移到检索时，通过构建图基表示来提供更丰富的结构信息。这解决了现有LLM方法在处理非结构化数据时的局限性，并显著提高了自动化综述的质量，使其更接近人类撰写的水平，在自动化科学文献综述领域具有重要意义。
motivation: 科学出版物快速增长，难以跟踪和综合研究进展。现有的大语言模型（LLMs）自动化综述生成方法检索非结构化数据，并要求模型在生成时从原始文本中推断概念、方法和分类关系。
method: 引入STRUCTSURVEY，一个分层多智能体框架，通过动态构建实体、关系和主题分类的图基表示，将结构化推理从生成转移到检索。它在一个新的基于ACL综述论文的参考基准上进行评估。
results: 与仅嵌入检索基线相比，STRUCTSURVEY的ROUGE-1召回率平均提高+2.9，ROUGE-2召回率平均提高+1.0，且未降低精确度。它还提高了LLM-as-a-Judge对逻辑结构、深度和综合性的评分。
conclusion: 明确的结构化检索能够生成更接近人类编写组织和推理的综述论文。

title: Office Comprehension Benchmark
authors: Firoz Shaik, Mateus Picanço Lima Gomes, Tanvir Aumi, Jingci Wang, Milos Milunovic, Filip Basara, Ivana Jovanovic, Vishwas Suryanarayanan, Neha Nandan Kenkare, Weiyao Xie, Zhipeng Han, Zheng Zhang, Waleed Shahid, Jay Rathi, Russell Scherer, Thong Q. Nguyen, Michael Bentley, Tamara Stankovic, Rasika Chakravarthy, Vishal Chowdhary
abstract: We introduce Office Comprehension Bench (OCB), the first public benchmark to jointly evaluate LLM systems on Word, Excel, and PowerPoint comprehension over native file formats (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) and their variants. OCB consists of two tracks. File Fidelity Q&A tests structural and visual perception of office artifacts - tables, charts, embedded images, formulas, and app-specific elements such as headers, speaker notes, and named ranges. Domain Q&A tests expert-level reasoning grounded in real-world industry documents across 12 professional domains, with queries requiring multi-step analysis and synthesis across documents. Each reference answer is decomposed into atomic, binary-gradable claims, and an ensemble of LLM judges scores responses against each claim independently. Even the strongest frontier system in its default reasoning mode reaches only about 59.3% on Domain Q&A; increasing thinking depth within a tier does not move performance materially, while moving to a higher product tier yields modest gains. We release the dataset, evaluation tooling, judge prompt, and a public leaderboard.
zh_title: 办公文档理解基准测试
translation: 我们介绍了Office Comprehension Bench (OCB)，这是首个联合评估LLM系统对Word、Excel和PowerPoint原生文件格式（.docx, .xlsx, .pptx）及其变体理解能力的公开基准。OCB包含两个赛道。文件保真度问答测试对办公文档结构和视觉元素的感知，包括表格、图表、嵌入图像、公式以及特定应用元素如页眉、演讲者备注和命名区域。领域问答测试跨越12个专业领域、基于真实世界文档的专家级推理能力，要求模型进行多步骤分析和跨文档综合。每个参考答案被分解为原子化的、可二元评分的声明，并由一组LLM裁判针对每个声明独立进行评分。即使是最强大的前沿系统在默认推理模式下，在领域问答赛道上也仅达到约59.3%的准确率；增加推理深度并不能显著提升性能，而转向更高一级的产品版本仅能带来适度的收益。我们发布了数据集、评估工具、裁判提示词及公开排行榜。
tldr: OCB是首个针对Word、Excel和PPT原生格式的LLM办公理解基准，揭示了当前AI在处理复杂办公文档时仍面临巨大挑战。
ai_comments: 该基准测试填补了办公文档理解领域的空白，特别是针对原生格式的深度解析。其创新性在于将答案分解为原子化声明进行评估，增强了评估的客观性。局限性在于目前的模型在复杂领域任务上表现仍有待提升。
motivation: 当前缺乏评估LLM在Word、Excel和PowerPoint等原生办公文档格式中进行深度理解和推理能力的基准测试。
method: 构建了包含文件保真度（File Fidelity）和领域问答（Domain Q&A）两个赛道的基准测试；采用将参考答案分解为原子声明的方法，并利用LLM裁判集合对响应进行独立评分。
results: 即使是最强大的前沿模型，在领域问答赛道上的得分也仅为59.3%左右；增加推理深度对提升性能效果有限，提升模型产品等级仅带来微小收益。
conclusion: OCB为评估LLM在实际办公文档处理任务中的能力提供了标准化的衡量工具，揭示了当前最先进模型在办公领域任务中仍存在显著的性能瓶颈。

title: Folding an e-graph in pure egglog
authors: Zeng Ren, Maddy Bowers
abstract: Folding over a recursive data structure (also known as "catamorphism") is an essential operation in functional programming. It allows one to declaratively define a recursive computation by focusing on how solutions of subproblems are combined into the solution of the parent problem. Folding in the context of e-graphs can have several benefits. Not only do we get memoization for free, but also computation is drastically reduced since the subproblems are defined over e-classes as opposed to concrete sub-terms. This short report presents our initial attempt at defining and implementing catamorphism, a general notion of a fold, in pure egglog. We discuss a reusable implementation trick to stage the inference rules so that there is no re-propagation of updated values.
translation: 对递归数据结构进行折叠（也称为“态射”或catamorphism）是函数式编程中的一项基本操作。它允许人们通过关注如何将子问题的解组合成父问题的解，来声明式地定义递归计算。在e-graph的背景下进行折叠有几个好处。我们不仅可以免费获得备忘录，而且由于子问题是在等价类而不是具体子项上定义的，计算量也大大减少。这份简短的报告介绍了我们在pure egglog中定义和实现catamorphism（一种通用的折叠概念）的初步尝试。我们讨论了一种可重用的实现技巧，用于对推理规则进行分阶段处理，从而不会重新传播更新的值。
tldr: 本文介绍了一种在egglog中实现e-graph折叠（catamorphism）的方法，通过分阶段推理规则优化性能，实现了高效的递归计算。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将函数式编程中的“折叠”（catamorphism）概念引入到e-graph（一种高效的程序表示结构）中，并利用egglog实现了这一过程。通过利用e-graph的等价类特性，该方法能够自动获得备忘录（memoization）效果并显著减少计算量。此外，作者提出了一种通过分阶段推理规则来避免重复计算的技巧，这对提升egglog程序的性能具有实际意义。
motivation: 在函数式编程中，折叠（catamorphism）是定义递归计算的核心操作。将其应用于e-graph不仅可以免费获得备忘录功能，还能通过在等价类而非具体子项上定义子问题，从而大幅降低计算复杂度。
method: 在pure egglog中定义和实现catamorphism（折叠），并采用一种可重用的实现技巧来对推理规则进行分阶段处理，从而避免已更新值的重复传播。
results: 论文成功在pure egglog中定义并实现了catamorphism，并验证了通过分阶段推理规则消除重复传播的性能优化技巧。
conclusion: 论文展示了在pure egglog中实现catamorphism的可行性，并提供了一种通过分阶段推理规则优化性能的有效技巧，为在e-graph上进行复杂递归计算提供了新的思路。

title: A Practice Auditing Framework for Large Language Model Use: Collective Empiricism, Pseudo-Rational Cognition, and Governance of AI-Generated Content
authors: Yang Zhao, Yingshuo Li, Zeyu Zhang
abstract: Large language models are increasingly used for knowledge acquisition, code generation, academic writing, and agent-based automation. In these settings, users may obtain highly structured answers, plans, and judgments without sufficient domain practice. This paper proposes a practice auditing framework for LLM use and AI-generated content governance. It introduces collective empiricism to describe how LLMs compress and reorganize large-scale human experience into outputs that appear empirical and rational, and pseudo-rational cognition to describe how users may mistake AI-generated structured expression for their own rational understanding. The paper analyzes AI subjectivity illusion, subjectivity structures in input materials, template loops in AI-AI conversations, statistical misjudgment in AIGC detection, and memory pollution when generated content enters future contexts, long-term memory, retrieval spaces, or agent skill systems. To reduce these risks, the paper proposes an auditing process based on requirement definition, problem-boundary identification, evidence-source auditing, practical validation, reverse questioning, logging, version management, rollback, and renewed cognition. The framework does not reject AI productivity; it argues that LLM outputs should be returned to verifiable, reproducible, and intervenable processes of practice. The paper provides a conceptual and auditable framework for cognitive risks in LLM interaction, AI-generated content governance, long-term memory systems, and human-AI interaction.
zh_title: 大型语言模型使用实践审计框架：集体经验主义、伪理性认知与AI生成内容治理
translation: 大型语言模型正越来越多地用于知识获取、代码生成、学术写作和基于代理的自动化。在这些场景中，用户可能在缺乏足够领域实践的情况下获得高度结构化的答案、计划和判断。本文提出了一个用于LLM使用和AI生成内容治理的实践审计框架。它引入了“集体经验主义”来描述LLM如何将大规模人类经验压缩并重组为看似经验性和理性的输出，并引入了“伪理性认知”来描述用户可能误将AI生成的结构化表达视为自己理性理解的现象。本文分析了AI主体性错觉、输入材料中的主体性结构、AI-AI对话中的模板循环、AIGC检测中的统计误判，以及当生成内容进入未来上下文、长期记忆、检索空间或代理技能系统时产生的记忆污染。为了降低这些风险，本文提出了一个基于需求定义、问题边界识别、证据源审计、实践验证、反向提问、日志记录、版本管理、回滚和认知更新的审计流程。该框架并不排斥AI生产力，而是主张LLM的输出应回归到可验证、可重复和可干预的实践过程中。本文为LLM交互、AI生成内容治理、长期记忆系统和人机交互中的认知风险提供了一个概念性和可审计的框架。
tldr: 本文提出了一个实践审计框架，通过验证和干预手段，解决人类因过度依赖大模型而产生的伪理性认知及相关系统性风险。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地提出了“集体经验主义”和“伪理性认知”等概念，深入探讨了人机交互中的认知风险。其重要性在于为AI生成内容的治理提供了一套可操作的审计框架，强调了将AI产出重新纳入人类实践验证过程的必要性，这对于解决AI带来的幻觉和认知偏差问题具有显著的现实意义。
motivation: 针对用户在缺乏领域实践的情况下过度依赖LLM生成内容，导致产生“伪理性认知”以及一系列认知和系统风险，需要建立一套有效的审计框架来治理AI生成内容。
method: 提出了一种包含需求定义、问题边界识别、证据源审计、实践验证、反向提问、日志记录、版本管理、回滚和认知更新的实践审计流程。
results: 构建了一个涵盖认知风险、AI生成内容治理、长期记忆系统及人机交互的审计框架，明确了如何通过实践验证来降低AI使用风险。
conclusion: 该框架主张不应盲目排斥AI生产力，而应通过将LLM输出纳入可验证、可重复和可干预的实践流程，有效管理AI生成内容带来的认知风险。

title: Measure Once, Model Everywhere: Model-Based Per-Request Resource Consumption for HTTP
authors: Geerd-Dietger Hoffmann, Verena Majuntke
abstract: Recent proposals for HTTP-based sustainability disclosure focus on \textbf{what} environmental information should be transmitted at the protocol boundary, for example through response headers, but leave open the practical question of \textbf{how} such per-request values can be generated in realistic deployments. This paper addresses that implementation gap. We present a model-based approach for estimating resource consumption and $CO_2e$ per HTTP request without requiring fine-grained production power telemetry. The approach benchmarks endpoints offline under controlled conditions, derives compact endpoint-specific energy models from observable request features, and evaluates these models online at the HTTP server boundary. We implement this mechanism as an nginx extension that loads a JSON model registry and emits per-request metadata for energy, grid intensity, embodied emissions, and total request-level impact. We show that heterogeneous request classes can be represented with constant, linear, and piecewise models, and that the same approach extends to endpoints whose dominant cost driver is only visible at the application layer through inputs such as token counts. Our evaluation indicates that the approach is operationally feasible and introduces only low runtime overhead.
comment: Paper in Proceedings of LIMITS 2026: 12th Workshop on Computing within Limits, 2026-06-23-25, Online
zh_title: 一次测量，处处建模：基于模型的HTTP请求级资源消耗
translation: 最近关于基于HTTP的可持续性披露提案侧重于“什么”环境信息应在协议边界传输，例如通过响应头，但对于在实际部署中“如何”生成这些请求级值这一实际问题却未解决。本文解决了这一实施差距。我们提出了一种基于模型的方法，用于估算每个HTTP请求的资源消耗和$CO_2e$，而无需精细的生产功耗遥测数据。该方法在受控条件下离线对端点进行基准测试，从可观察的请求特征中导出紧凑的端点特定能耗模型，并在HTTP服务器边界在线评估这些模型。我们将此机制实现为Nginx扩展，该扩展加载JSON模型注册表并为能耗、电网强度、隐含排放和总请求级影响发出请求级元数据。我们表明，异构请求类别可以用常数、线性、分段模型表示，并且相同的方法也适用于其主要成本驱动因素仅通过令牌计数等输入在应用层可见的端点。我们的评估表明，该方法在操作上可行，并且只引入了低运行时开销。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于模型的方法，用于估算HTTP请求的资源消耗和$CO_2e$，无需精细的生产环境功耗遥测数据，并以Nginx扩展形式实现，具有低运行时开销。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一种实用的、基于模型的方法来解决HTTP请求级资源消耗估算的难题，特别是不依赖于昂贵的精细生产功耗遥测数据。通过Nginx扩展的实现，展示了其在现有基础设施中的集成潜力，且低运行时开销使其具有较高的实际应用价值。这对于推动HTTP可持续性披露的实际落地具有重要意义。
motivation: 当前HTTP可持续性披露提案关注“什么”环境信息应传输，但未解决“如何”在实际部署中生成这些请求级值的问题。
method: 提出一种模型化方法，离线在受控条件下对端点进行基准测试，从可观察的请求特征中导出紧凑的端点特定能耗模型，并在HTTP服务器边界在线评估这些模型。通过Nginx扩展实现，该扩展加载JSON模型注册表并为能耗、电网强度、隐含排放和总请求级影响发出元数据。
results: 异构请求类别可以用常数、线性、分段模型表示；该方法可扩展到主要成本驱动因素仅在应用层可见的端点（如令牌计数）；该方法在操作上可行，并引入了低运行时开销。
conclusion: 该基于模型的方法为HTTP请求级资源和$CO_2e$估算提供了一个操作可行且高效的解决方案，有效填补了现有可持续性披露提案的实施空白。

title: Structuring the Space of Sociotechnical Alignment
authors: Esra Dönmez, Agnieszka Falenska
abstract:
Sociotechnical alignment concerns the social desirability of AI behavior and is thus inherently normative, not merely technical. While NLP research increasingly addresses its technical aspects, it often leaves underspecified what such "social desirability" entails. We argue that this reflects a fundamental gap: the absence of a systematic way to specify how sociotechnical alignment defines, justifies, and evaluates socially desirable AI behavior.
  To address this gap, we introduce a human-centered framework for specifying sociotechnical alignment. We draw on social-scientific accounts of sociobehavioral desirability to ground the basis for behavioral desirability judgments and use this framework to analyze how alignment is specified in practice. Our systematic literature review identifies recurring patterns: normative concepts grounding desirability judgments are often unspecified or conflated with alignment targets for (desired) system behavior, target populations are underdefined, and design choices are rarely theoretically justified. These findings point to a lack of conceptual specificity that limits cumulative progress. We therefore offer recommendations that link social-scientific frameworks to alignment design choices, supporting more conceptually precise approaches to sociotechnical alignment.
zh_title: 构建社会技术对齐的空间架构
translation: 社会技术对齐关乎AI行为的社会期望，因此本质上是规范性的，而非仅仅是技术性的。虽然自然语言处理（NLP）研究日益关注其技术方面，但往往未能明确界定何为“社会期望”。我们认为这反映了一个根本性的差距：缺乏一种系统性的方法来明确社会技术对齐如何定义、论证和评估AI的社会期望行为。为了解决这一差距，我们引入了一个以人为中心的社会技术对齐规范框架。我们借鉴社会科学中关于社会行为期望的论述，为行为期望的判断奠定基础，并利用该框架分析实践中如何进行对齐。我们的系统性文献综述识别出了一些反复出现的模式：用于支撑期望判断的规范性概念往往未被明确，或与期望的系统行为对齐目标混淆；目标群体定义不足；设计选择很少有理论依据。这些发现指出概念精确性的缺乏限制了研究的累积性进展。因此，我们提出了将社会科学框架与对齐设计选择相结合的建议，以支持更具概念精确性的社会技术对齐方法。
tldr: AI对齐不仅是技术问题，更关乎社会价值。本文揭示了当前对齐研究中缺乏规范性定义的现状，并引入社会科学框架以指导更严谨的AI对齐设计。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将社会科学理论引入AI对齐领域，指出了当前AI对齐研究中缺乏规范性定义的根本问题。其重要性在于为AI伦理和技术实践之间搭建了桥梁，有助于提升AI系统的社会责任感和透明度。局限性在于该框架目前主要侧重于概念规范，尚未提供具体的、可自动化的技术实现方案。
motivation: 当前NLP和AI对齐研究虽然关注技术实现，但往往忽视了“社会期望（social desirability）”这一核心概念的规范性本质，导致对齐定义模糊、缺乏理论支撑，进而限制了该领域研究的累积性进展。
method: 通过系统性文献综述（Systematic Literature Review），结合社会科学中关于社会行为期望的理论，构建了一个以人为中心的社会技术对齐规范框架，并以此评估当前AI对齐实践中的设计模式。
results: 研究发现，目前的AI对齐实践普遍存在规范性概念界定不清、目标群体定义模糊、设计决策缺乏理论依据等问题，这些问题阻碍了AI对齐研究的系统性发展。
conclusion: AI对齐不仅是技术问题，更是深刻的规范性问题。研究者必须在设计阶段明确社会期望的理论基础，通过引入社会科学框架，才能实现更具解释力与社会责任感的AI系统。

title: LLMs as Teaching Assistants for Mathematics Exam Grading: Reliability, and Practical Usability
authors: Aastha Sapkota, M. G. Sarwar Murshed
abstract: Open-ended mathematics exams are valuable because they assess reasoning, proof construction, algorithmic thinking, and communication of intermediate steps. They are also difficult to grade at scale because instructors must apply partial-credit rubrics consistently while giving feedback that helps students repair misconceptions. This paper evaluates six contemporary large language model (LLM) configurations, Gemini 3.1 Pro Extended, Gemini 3.5 Flash, ChatGPT 5.5 Pro Extended, ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking, Claude Pro Opus 4.7, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, as grading assistants for an undergraduate discrete mathematics examination. The study compares two grading policies. The BASELINE policy uses a stricter rubric-following prompt that emphasizes explicit evidence and complete justification. The LIBERAL policy was added after preliminary grading showed that the baseline condition sometimes applied harsh point deductions and failed to recognize valid partial reasoning. Agreement with human grading is measured at both the question and exam-total levels using mean absolute error, root mean squared error, normalized root mean squared error, Pearson correlation, and exact agreement. The results show that liberal partial-credit prompting reduces average question-level error for every evaluated model family. ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking (LIBERAL) has the lowest average question-level MAE (1.87) and RMSE (2.53), while Gemini 3.1 Pro Extended (LIBERAL) has the lowest total-score MAE (8.00) and RMSE (10.66). However, the strongest total-score Pearson correlation occurs under Gemini 3.1 Pro Extended (BASELINE) at 0.58, showing that point calibration and rank preservation remain distinct goals. We also report practical usability observations.
zh_title: 大语言模型作为数学考试评分助教：可靠性与实用性分析
translation: 开放式数学考试因能评估推理、证明构建、算法思维及中间步骤的沟通而具有重要价值。然而，由于教师必须在保持评分标准一致的同时提供有助于纠正学生误解的反馈，使得大规模评分变得困难。本文评估了六种现代大语言模型（LLM）配置——Gemini 3.1 Pro Extended、Gemini 3.5 Flash、ChatGPT 5.5 Pro Extended、ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking、Claude Pro Opus 4.7 和 Claude Sonnet 4.6——作为本科离散数学考试的评分助手。研究对比了两种评分策略。BASELINE 策略使用更严格的遵循评分标准的提示词，强调明确的证据和完整的论证。LIBERAL 策略是在初步评分显示基线条件有时扣分过严且未能识别有效的局部推理后增加的。研究通过平均绝对误差、均方根误差、标准化均方根误差、皮尔逊相关系数和精确一致性，在题目和考试总分层面衡量了模型与人工评分的一致性。结果表明，宽松的局部给分提示词减少了每个评估模型系列的平均题目级误差。ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking (LIBERAL) 具有最低的平均题目级 MAE (1.87) 和 RMSE (2.53)，而 Gemini 3.1 Pro Extended (LIBERAL) 具有最低的总分 MAE (8.00) 和 RMSE (10.66)。然而，最强的总分皮尔逊相关系数出现在 Gemini 3.1 Pro Extended (BASELINE) 下，为 0.58，表明分数校准和排名保留仍然是不同的目标。我们还报告了实际可用性方面的观察。
tldr: 研究发现，通过调整提示词策略（如使用宽松评分），大语言模型可以辅助数学考试评分，但在实现高精度评分和保持学生排名一致性方面仍面临权衡。
ai_comments: 该研究探索了利用LLM进行大规模数学考试评分的潜力，揭示了提示词策略（严格与宽松）对评分准确性的显著影响。研究亮点在于明确了模型在“评分校准”与“排名保留”两个目标之间存在权衡，为自动化教学评估提供了重要的实证参考，但仍需进一步研究如何提高模型在复杂推理任务中的鲁棒性。
motivation: 开放式数学考试难以大规模评分，因为教师需要一致地应用部分给分标准并提供有效的反馈，作者旨在探讨LLM是否能作为有效的教学评分助手。
method: 研究评估了六种不同的LLM配置在本科离散数学考试中的评分表现，对比了“基线（BASELINE）”和“宽松（LIBERAL）”两种评分提示策略，并使用平均绝对误差（MAE）、均方根误差（RMSE）、皮尔逊相关系数等指标与人工评分进行比较。
results: 宽松的提示词策略降低了所有模型在题目层面的平均误差；ChatGPT 5.5 Thinking (LIBERAL) 在题目级误差表现最优，Gemini 3.1 Pro Extended (LIBERAL) 在总分误差上表现最优，而Gemini 3.1 Pro Extended (BASELINE) 在总分皮尔逊相关性上表现最强。
conclusion: LLM在数学考试评分中展现出一定的潜力，但评分策略的选择对结果影响巨大。宽松的提示词策略通常能降低误差，但模型在整体分数校准和学生排名表现上仍有局限。

title: Collaborative Disagreement Resolution for Scalable Oversight
authors: Yuyang Jiang, Chacha Chen, Teng Wu, Liwen Sun, Han Liu, Shi Feng, Chenhao Tan
abstract: Debate, where AI agents argue opposing positions, has emerged as a key approach to scalable oversight. However, debate faces a fundamental tension: models are incentivized to be persuasive to the judge, which may not always align with epistemic honesty. In this work, we propose an alternative paradigm: disagreement resolution, which reframes the interaction mechanism from adversarial debate to collaborative truth seeking. Drawing on principles from human mediation and conflict resolution, where mediators facilitate dialogue to help disputing parties reach consensus rather than adjudicating between them, we design an automated pipeline that adapts these strategies to AI oversight. Unlike standard debate where models argue for fixed positions, our pipeline directs models to collaboratively identify points of disagreement, examine the evidence for conflicting claims, and converge toward consensus or isolate the specific ''crux'' of their disagreement. We find that Disagreement Resolution consistently helps non-expert models identify the truth, achieving 62.1% judging accuracy compared to 49.2% for standard debate. Our results provide encouraging empirical evidence for rethinking the scalable oversight protocol from adversarial persuasion to collaborative truth-seeking.
comment: 27 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to ICML 2026. Codebase link: https://github.com/ChicagoHAI/collaborative-dr.git
zh_title: 用于可扩展监督的协作式分歧解决机制
translation: 辩论作为AI智能体通过争论对立立场来协助监督，已成为可扩展监督的关键方法。然而，辩论面临一个根本性的矛盾：模型倾向于为了说服裁判而争论，这并不总是与认识论上的诚实相一致。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种替代范式：分歧解决，它将交互机制从对抗性辩论重新定义为协作式寻真。借鉴人类调解和冲突解决的原则（即调解人促进对话以帮助争论方达成共识，而不是在他们之间进行裁决），我们设计了一个将这些策略应用于AI监督的自动化流水线。与标准辩论中模型为固定立场争论不同，我们的流水线引导模型协同识别分歧点，检查冲突主张的证据，并趋向于共识或隔离分歧的特定“关键点”。我们发现，分歧解决持续帮助非专家模型识别真相，其判断准确率为62.1%，而标准辩论为49.2%。我们的结果为将可扩展监督协议从对抗性说服重新思考为协作性寻真提供了令人鼓舞的经验证据。
tldr: 将AI监督从对抗性辩论转变为协作式分歧解决，显著提升了模型识别真理的准确率。
ai_comments: 该研究非常有见地，通过从对抗性“辩论”转向协作式“冲突解决”，有效缓解了AI模型为了说服力而牺牲诚实性的风险。这种模仿人类调解的机制为AI对齐和可扩展监督提供了一个更稳健的范式。
motivation: 现有的基于辩论的AI监督方法存在模型过度追求说服力而忽略认识论诚实性的根本矛盾，因此需要一种更倾向于协作寻真的新范式。
method: 设计了一个自动化流水线，借鉴人类调解和冲突解决原则，引导AI模型识别分歧点、审查冲突证据，并致力于达成共识或明确分歧核心，而非单纯进行对抗性辩论。
results: 在实验中，协作式冲突解决机制使非专家模型的判断准确率达到62.1%，显著优于标准辩论方法的49.2%。
conclusion: 通过将AI监督从对抗性辩论转向协作式冲突解决，可以显著提高非专家模型识别真理的能力，为AI的可扩展监督提供了一种更有效且诚实的方法。

title: The Benchmark Ceiling: Human Judgment, Evaluation Scarcity, and the Political Economy of AI Capability Measurement
authors: Mark Esposito, Liu Zhang, Ali Ansari
abstract: Benchmarks are the primary instruments through which AI capability is measured, compared, and governed. This paper argues that the validity of frontier AI benchmarks is a function of the quality of human judgment embedded in their construction, and that this quality is structurally scarce in ways that standard scaling narratives obscure. As foundation models approach ceiling performance on existing evaluation suites, discriminating signal concentrates in the hardest benchmark items, precisely those requiring elite expert judgment to design. We term this the benchmark ceiling problem: the progressive exhaustion of evaluation signal as models saturate the easy majority of items while the difficult tail, authored by a thin stratum of highly expert evaluators, remains the only source of genuine discrimination. The paper develops this argument in three steps. First, we present a formal model of benchmark signal depreciation. Benchmark scores are public signals of latent model quality, but their precision depends endogenously on benchmark validity. As frontier capability rises and as contamination or strategic optimization increases, fixed benchmarks depreciate as measurement instruments. The model shows that valid signal concentrates in hard-tail items, that the replacement cost of such items rises convexly with frontier capability, and that private benchmark producers underinvest in validity relative to the social optimum. Second, drawing on platform data from micro1 covering over one thousand credentialed professionals, we document the scarcity premium associated with high-judgment, low-codifiability evaluation labor. Third, we develop the political economy and governance implications.
zh_title: 基准测试上限：人类判断、评估稀缺性与AI能力测量的政治经济学
translation: 基准测试是衡量、比较和治理AI能力的主要工具。本文认为，前沿AI基准测试的有效性取决于其中嵌入的人类判断质量，而这种质量在结构上是稀缺的，这与标准的扩展叙事相悖。随着基础模型在现有评估套件上的性能接近上限，判别信号集中在最难的基准项目上，而这些项目恰恰需要顶尖专家判断来设计。我们将其称为“基准测试上限”问题：随着模型饱和了简单的大多数项目，而由极少数高水平评估人员编写的困难尾部成为唯一真正的区分来源，评估信号逐渐枯竭。本文分三步展开论述：首先，我们提出了基准测试信号贬值的形式化模型。基准测试分数是潜在模型质量的公共信号，但其精确度内生地取决于基准测试的有效性。随着前沿能力的提升以及污染或战略性优化的增加，固定的基准测试作为测量工具在不断贬值。模型显示，有效信号集中在困难的尾部项目，此类项目的替换成本随前沿能力呈凸函数上升，且私人基准测试生产者在有效性方面的投入低于社会最优水平。其次，利用micro1平台涵盖一千多名资深专业人士的数据，我们记录了与高判断力、低可编码性评估劳动相关的稀缺性溢价。第三，我们探讨了政治经济学和治理方面的含义。
tldr: 随着AI性能逼近现有测试的极限，高质量评测数据的获取变得极其困难，导致基准测试逐渐失去区分能力。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入“基准测试上限”这一概念，深刻揭示了当前AI评测体系的结构性危机。其创新之处在于将AI评测问题从单纯的技术领域提升到政治经济学层面，强调了高质量专家判断的稀缺性及其在模型评价中的核心作用。这对当前依赖自动化基准测试的AI产业具有重要的警示意义。
motivation: 现有基准测试在评估前沿AI模型时面临有效性下降的问题，传统的扩展叙事忽略了高质量人类判断在基准构建中的结构性稀缺性，导致模型在简单任务上饱和，而真正区分能力的难点任务严重依赖稀缺的专家资源。
method: 1. 构建基准测试信号贬值的形式化模型；2. 利用micro1平台超过一千名专业人士的数据，分析高判断力、低可编码性评测劳动的稀缺性溢价；3. 探讨相关政治经济学与治理含义。
results: 研究发现，随着模型能力增强，基准测试的有效信号不断向“高难度尾部”集中，且获取此类评测数据的成本呈凸函数增长。市场化的评测机构由于成本过高，在基准测试的有效性投入上远低于社会最优水平。
conclusion: 随着AI模型能力的提升，现有的基准测试正面临严重的“信号贬值”。高质量的评测依赖于稀缺的专家判断，而目前的市场机制导致了对这种有效评测手段的投入不足，需要新的治理范式来应对这一挑战。

title: Beyond Detection: Redesigning Assessment and Governande of Generative AI at the Universidad Politécnica de Madrid (UPM)
authors: Jessica Díaz, Sonia Linio, Fernando Pescador, Daniel Martin-Fabiani
abstract: Universities have responded to generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in noticeably different ways, both internationally and within Spain. So far, the dominant reaction has been defensive, this is, most institutions frame the debate around AI detection, plagiarism, academic integrity and a presumed drop in student effort, prioritizing basic training for academic staff over students. Other group of pioneering universities is doing the opposite, pursuing deeper adoption, and assuming that any policy built on prevention or sanction will not hold. This paper sides with that second view. Obsessing about detection is a dead end, since generated text is increasingly hard to distinguish from human writing, and detectors still misfire too often to be trusted. What universities need instead is a coordinated effort to set clear, course-by-course rules for GenAI use, redesign assessment toward authentic and interdisciplinary assessment that fosters critical thinking and learner autonomy, and build a serious AI-literacy programme that treats students as critical co-creators rather than passive users. The challenge, though, is not only pedagogical. Adoption at university scale also raises organisational, technical, operational, legal and economic questions that have to be solved together. In this context, the Universidad Politécnica de Madrid (UPM) is developing a strategic and sustainable AI policy and adoption framework structured around six dimensions, in which AI functions as an enabler of student autonomy and pedagogical innovation rather than as a threat to be policed.
zh_title: 超越检测：马德里理工大学（UPM）生成式人工智能的评估与治理重构
translation: 世界各地的大学对生成式人工智能（GenAI）的反应截然不同。到目前为止，主流的反应是防御性的，即大多数机构将辩论的重点放在人工智能检测、剽窃、学术诚信以及学生努力程度下降的假设上，且优先考虑教师培训而非学生培训。另一部分先驱大学则采取了相反的做法，追求更深入的采纳，并认为任何基于预防或制裁的政策都无法持久。本文支持第二种观点。沉迷于检测是死胡同，因为生成式文本越来越难以与人类写作区分开来，而且检测器的误报率太高，不可信。大学真正需要的是协调一致的努力，为GenAI的使用制定明确的课程规则，将评估重新设计为能够培养批判性思维和学习者自主性的真实且跨学科的评估，并建立一个认真的AI素养计划，将学生视为批判性的共同创造者，而非被动的使用者。然而，挑战不仅在于教学法。大学规模的采纳还提出了必须共同解决的组织、技术、操作、法律和经济问题。在此背景下，马德里理工大学（UPM）正在围绕六个维度制定战略性和可持续的AI政策和采纳框架，其中AI的功能是作为学生自主性和教学创新的推动者，而不是需要监管的威胁。
tldr: 高校应放弃徒劳的AI检测，转而通过重构教学评估和构建综合性治理框架，将生成式AI转化为促进学生自主学习和教学创新的工具。
ai_comments: 该论文具有重要的实践意义，它挑战了高等教育界普遍存在的“防御性”AI治理模式。其创新之处在于提出了一种将AI视为教育赋能工具而非监管对象的系统性治理框架，强调了制度重构对教学改革的必要性，为其他高校提供了可参考的治理蓝图。
motivation: 针对目前多数高校过度关注AI检测与学术诚信防范的局限性，作者旨在提出一种更具建设性的视角，即如何将生成式AI作为促进教学创新和学生自主学习的工具，而非仅视为需要防范的威胁。
method: 通过分析当前学术界对生成式AI的两种应对路径（防御性与采纳性），结合马德里理工大学（UPM）的实践，提出了一套包含组织、技术、操作、法律和经济等六个维度的战略性AI采纳与治理框架。
results: 确立了以学生自主性与教学创新为核心的AI治理路径，证明了通过结构化的六维度框架，高校可以实现从“预防性监管”向“战略性采纳”的转型，从而有效应对生成式AI带来的挑战。
conclusion: 对于高校而言，单纯依赖检测工具是死胡同。必须通过多维度的战略框架，将AI整合进教学体系，重点在于重塑评价方式、提升AI素养，并解决组织、法律与技术层面的综合性挑战。

title: Three Futures for the Diagnostic Radiologist: A Structured Disagreement About What AI Actually Changes
authors: Jan Beger, Amine Korchi, Christoph A. Agten
abstract: Rationale. The diagnostic radiologist's role in 2035 will not look like it does today. Imaging AI is already changing how worklists are organized, how reports are generated, and which cases require a radiologist's attention. What remains genuinely contested is not whether the role changes but how. Approach. Three subject-matter experts (two radiologists and one health tech professional with more than 20 years of experience in medical imaging IT) independently authored 2035 job descriptions for the diagnostic radiologist using a shared template. Each author wrote from a distinct vantage point: one optimistic, one framed as a trade-off view incorporating workforce economics, and one structured around professional stratification. The three versions were published openly and subjected to a structured comparison across seven dimensions. Key findings. The three versions agree on direction but disagree on magnitude. All three describe a radiologist whose routine workload is AI-managed, who carries accountability for AI output, and who spends more time on complex cases and clinical collaboration than today's radiologist does. They diverge on headcount, career security, and whether the profession expands broadly, concentrates into a smaller well-compensated group, or stratifies into sharply differentiated tiers. Conclusion. AI won't eliminate the diagnostic radiologist. Whether it expands, concentrates, or stratifies the profession depends on choices health systems haven't made yet. The clinical argument for optimism is real. So is the economic argument for caution. Both can be true simultaneously. Keywords: radiology workforce; artificial intelligence; diagnostic radiology; job redesign; medical imaging IT; AI governance
zh_title: 诊断放射科医生的三种未来：关于人工智能实际改变了什么的结构性分歧
translation: 基本原理。诊断放射科医生在2035年的角色将与今天不同。影像AI已经改变了工作列表的组织方式、报告的生成方式以及哪些病例需要放射科医生的关注。真正有争议的不是角色是否会改变，而是如何改变。方法。三位主题专家（两名放射科医生和一名在医学影像IT领域拥有20多年经验的健康技术专业人士）使用共享模板独立撰写了2035年诊断放射科医生的职位描述。每位作者从不同的视角撰写：一个乐观的，一个以劳动力经济学为框架的权衡观点，一个围绕专业分层构建的。这三个版本被公开出版，并从七个维度进行了结构化比较。主要发现。这三个版本在方向上一致，但在程度上存在分歧。所有三个版本都描述了放射科医生的日常工作由AI管理，对AI输出负责，并且比今天的放射科医生花费更多时间处理复杂病例和临床协作。它们在人员数量、职业安全以及该专业是广泛扩展、集中为一小部分高薪群体，还是分层为明显不同的等级上存在分歧。结论。AI不会消除诊断放射科医生。它是否会扩展、集中或分层该专业取决于医疗系统尚未做出的选择。乐观的临床论点是真实的。谨慎的经济论点也是如此。两者可以同时存在。关键词：放射科劳动力；人工智能；诊断放射学；工作重新设计；医学影像IT；AI治理
tldr: 人工智能不会消除诊断放射科医生，但会改变其角色。三位专家对2035年的放射科医生角色进行了预测，发现他们在方向上一致，但在具体影响（如人数、职业安全、专业分层）上存在分歧。专业未来取决于医疗系统的决策。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过邀请多方专家对未来进行预测，并进行结构化比较，提供了一个关于AI对放射科影响的全面且平衡的视角。其创新之处在于没有试图给出单一答案，而是呈现了未来发展的多种可能性，并明确指出这些可能性取决于现有决策。这对于理解AI在医疗领域带来的复杂性和不确定性非常重要，尤其强调了人类决策在技术变革中的关键作用。
motivation: 诊断放射科医生的角色在2035年将与现在不同，影像AI正在改变工作方式。本文旨在探讨AI将如何改变这一角色，因为这仍存在争议。
method: 三位主题专家（两名放射科医生和一名在医学影像IT领域拥有20多年经验的健康技术专业人士）使用共享模板独立撰写了2035年诊断放射科医生的职位描述。每位作者从不同视角（乐观、权衡、专业分层）撰写。然后对这三个版本进行了公开出版，并从七个维度进行了结构化比较。
results: 三个版本在方向上一致，但在程度上存在分歧。所有版本都描述了放射科医生的日常工作由AI管理，对AI输出负责，并比现在花费更多时间处理复杂病例和临床协作。它们在人员数量、职业安全以及专业是广泛扩展、集中为一小部分高薪群体，还是分层为明显不同的等级上存在分歧。
conclusion: AI不会消除诊断放射科医生。该专业是扩展、集中还是分层，取决于医疗系统尚未做出的选择。乐观的临床论点和谨慎的经济论点都是真实的，且可以同时存在。

title: How Indian Dermatologists are Utilizing Artificial Intelligence for Clinical Practice and Workflow Management: A Nationwide Survey with a Special Focus on atopic dermatitis
authors: Dipayan Sengupta, Saumya Panda, Sandipan Dhar, Dipankar De, Deepika Pandhi, Narayanan B
abstract:
Background: Dermatology AI has mainly focused on image-based diagnosis, while chronic disease workflows have received less attention. We surveyed Indian dermatologists to map routine clinical challenges, with a focus on atopic dermatitis (AD), and assess current AI use.
  Methods: A nationwide cross-sectional survey commissioned by the Society for Eczema Studies included 377 practicing Indian dermatologists. The survey assessed clinical challenges, AD workflow barriers, AI use, adoption barriers, and ethical concerns. Analyses used descriptive statistics, chi-square tests, false discovery rate correction, and multivariable logistic regression.
  Results: Patient adherence (61.3%) and treatment planning in difficult or refractory cases (57.0%) were reported more often than diagnostic uncertainty (48.0%). In AD care, severity scoring was reported as a challenge by 47.7% and had the lowest satisfaction among measured workflow areas. Current AI use was reported by 49.9%, most often involving general large language models for literature synthesis, documentation, and academic tasks rather than specialized image analysis. Barriers differed by experience: dermatologists with more than 20 years of practice more often cited lack of training, while those with 5 years or less more often cited lack of clinical utility after trying AI tools. AI users were more likely than non-users to report concern about patient self-misdiagnosis and anxiety, which remained significant after adjustment for experience and academic affiliation.
