Prior research has largely focused on output quality and productivity gains, with limited attention paid to developers' well-being and interaction experiences. This paper presents a developer-centered empirical mixed-methods study to investigate how professional developers engage with Generative AI (GenAI) in their natural work environment. Controlled data collection sessions are combined with natural work periods. Results show that developers are generally satisfied with GenAI, particularly for monotonous, repetitive, and structured tasks, and report perceived efficiency and productivity gains. Copilot interaction type preferences differ by task type and complexity: While both in-code suggestions and chat-based prompting independently improve task efficiency and reduce perceived workload, combining these interaction types within a single task diminishes benefits. We propose a rule-of-thumb for selecting an interaction type based on task characteristics. During development-heavy tasks, results indicate that perceived cognitive load arises from AI interaction, while perceived productivity depends on AI output quality. Participation in this study positively influenced developers' awareness and intentional use of GenAI tools. These findings demonstrate the value of real-world, mixed-methods study designs to understand GenAI tools and developers' experiences with them.

title: Guiding Human Validation of LLM-Generated Code via Verifiable Literate Programming
authors: Ziqi Yuan, Wenhao Lu, Hao Wu, Dunhong Jin, Chuan Wu
abstract:
Vibe coding democratizes software development by allowing users to generate code via natural-language (NL) interaction with large language models (LLMs). However, the code is reliable only when it faithfully implements the user's intent, which is difficult and labor-intensive for users to validate. Existing validation methods either rely on LLM-assisted automated testing, which suffers from prompt ambiguity and model fallibility, or involve users only in partial software artifacts such as prompts and test cases, which may overlook corner cases and program details. Motivated by a bug study of LLM-generated code, we find that detailed human feedback is essential, as failures often stem from underspecified requirements or subtle semantic deviations.
  This paper presents verifiable literate programming (VLP), a human-in-the-loop framework designed to make the review/validation process of LLM-generated code accessible to users at all programming levels. At its core, VLP proposes unambiguous NL-based documentation as a readable intermediate layer between prompts and code. The documentation demonstrates concrete program semantics and enables users to provide feedback on potential intent-code mismatches. It supports human-involved, end-to-end repair and validation via three techniques: (i) an NL-style literate language with unambiguous syntax and mostly deterministic code-to-documentation translation, (ii) LLM-based fine-grained mismatch detection that uses trace links between prompts and documentation to focus users' review effort on suspicious documentation lines, and (iii) a verification module that leverages user-validated documentation to derive API-usage checks and formal properties, which are then verified against the generated code using model checking. Our evaluation shows that VLP improves code pass@1 from 28.7%-73.2% to 65.4%-93.5% with reasonable user effort.
zh_title: 通过可验证文学编程引导人类对LLM生成代码的验证
translation: “Vibe coding”（随性编程）通过允许用户通过自然语言（NL）与大语言模型（LLM）交互来生成代码，使软件开发民主化。然而，只有当代码忠实地实现了用户意图时，它才是可靠的，而这对用户来说验证起来既困难又费力。现有的验证方法要么依赖于LLM辅助的自动化测试（受提示词歧义和模型错误的影响），要么只涉及用户参与部分软件工件（如提示词和测试用例），这可能会忽略边界情况和程序细节。受到LLM生成代码缺陷研究的启发，我们发现详细的人类反馈至关重要，因为失败通常源于需求未明确或细微的语义偏差。本文提出了可验证文学编程（VLP），这是一个旨在使各编程水平的用户都能进行LLM生成代码审查/验证过程的人机协作框架。VLP的核心是提出基于自然语言的明确文档，作为提示词和代码之间的可读中间层。该文档展示了具体的程序语义，并使用户能够对潜在的意图-代码不匹配提供反馈。它通过三种技术支持人工参与的端到端修复和验证：(i) 一种具有明确语法和大部分确定性代码到文档转换的NL风格文学语言；(ii) 基于LLM的细粒度不匹配检测，利用提示词和文档之间的追踪链接，将用户的审查精力集中在可疑的文档行上；(iii) 一个验证模块，利用用户验证过的文档导出API使用检查和形式化属性，然后使用模型检查对生成的代码进行验证。我们的评估表明，VLP在合理的投入下，将代码的pass@1准确率从28.7%-73.2%提高到65.4%-93.5%。
tldr: VLP框架通过引入文档中间层和形式化验证，解决了LLM代码生成中难以验证意图与代码是否匹配的问题，大幅提升了代码生成质量。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将“文学编程”（Literate Programming）理念引入LLM代码生成领域，通过引入文档作为中间层，有效解决了意图与代码不匹配的验证难题。其方法不仅提升了代码质量，还通过形式化验证增强了结果的可信度，是人机协作编程领域的重要进展。
motivation: LLM生成的代码难以验证，现有的自动化测试或部分人工参与方法存在局限性，导致难以发现潜在的语义偏差和边界情况，因此需要一种能让用户有效参与验证的机制。
method: 提出了一种名为VLP的框架，包含三个核心技术：(1) 支持确定性转换的NL风格文学编程语言；(2) 基于提示词与文档追踪的细粒度不匹配检测；(3) 利用用户验证后的文档，通过模型检查进行API检查和形式化属性验证。
results: 实验结果表明，VLP将代码的pass@1准确率从28.7%-73.2%大幅提升至65.4%-93.5%，且用户投入的验证工作量在合理范围内。
conclusion: 通过引入可验证的文学编程（VLP）框架，该研究有效改善了LLM生成代码的验证难题，显著提升了代码的正确率，并降低了用户的验证负担。

title: HNSW with Accuracy Guarantees Using Graph Spanners -- A Technical Report
authors: Minghao Li, Raghav Mittal, Sanjivni Rana, Suraj Shetiya, Gautam Das, Nick Koudas
abstract: Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) graphs serve as the industry standard due to their logarithmic complexity and strong empirical performance. However, HNSW relies on greedy graph traversal, a heuristic that provides no theoretical guarantees of correctness. In this paper, we propose a novel "Certify-then-Rectify" framework that bridges the gap between the speed of heuristic search and the rigor of exact retrieval. Rather than discarding HNSW, our approach first employs a distribution-free statistical certifier to dynamically evaluate the quality of a standard HNSW search with minimal overhead. If certification indicates that the retrieved neighbors are of low quality, the framework safely escalates to a rigorous exact recovery algorithm. To make this exact recovery computationally feasible, we reinterpret the HNSW graph as a geometric spanner and utilize Extreme Value Theory to stochastically estimate its maximum empirical stretch factor. This allows us to mathematically bound the maximum distance of true nearest neighbors. Extensive evaluations on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our tiered framework delivers the average-case speed of HNSW while ensuring the worst-case correctness of exact search and outperforming other applicable approaches.

title: SkillFuzz: Fuzzing Skill Composition for Implicit Intents Discovery in Open Skill Marketplaces
authors: Jinwei Hu, Yi Dong, Youcheng Sun, Xiaowei Huang
abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents increasingly automate software engineering tasks through reusable skills, natural-language instruction documents that guide planning and execution. Open skill marketplaces enable users to assemble agents by co-activating community-contributed skills, but marketplace operators typically audit skills in isolation. As a result, individually benign skills may interact to redirect an agent toward unintended objectives, which we term implicit intents. Detecting such intents is challenging because the effect emerges only through skill composition, execution environments are often unavailable at admission time, and the space of possible co-activations grows exponentially with marketplace size. In this paper, we formulate implicit-intent discovery as a fuzzing problem over skill compositions, where skill compositions are the unit under test, planning artifacts expose agent intent before execution, and deviations from a skill-free baseline serve as a differential oracle. Based on this formulation, we propose skillfuzz, the first execution-free testing approach that extracts structured skill contracts and uses contract-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search to prioritize potentially conflicting compositions. Across representative skill-marketplace workloads, skillfuzz discovers over 1,000 distinct implicit intents under a fixed query budget, confirms more than 80% of the highest-risk flagged compositions during execution-time validation, and identifies substantially more high-severity implicit intents than alternative search strategies while exploring only a fraction of the pairwise interaction space they require.

title: Self-Gating Attention for Efficient Time Series Forecasting
authors: Dezheng Wang, Tong Chen, Wei Yuan, Congyan Chen, Shihua Li, Hongzhi Yin
abstract: Transformer architectures have shown strong potential in time series forecasting, where multi-head self-attention is widely used to capture temporal dependencies across historical timestamps. However, standard self-attention has quadratic time and memory complexity with respect to the look-back length. This cost may limit its use in resource-constrained or high-throughput forecasting systems, where fast and memory-efficient inference is important. Through qualitative and quantitative analyses, we observe that self-attention maps in time series forecasting often contain redundant patterns across different timestamps. This phenomenon can be related to the repeated temporal patterns and relatively stable temporal correlations in many real-world time series. Motivated by this observation, we propose Self-Gating Attention (SGA), a plug-and-play attention mechanism that represents the attention score with a shared learnable matrix and an input-dependent residual component. The shared matrix captures common attention patterns, while the residual component captures input-dependent variations. In this way, SGA avoids the query and key projections used in standard attention score computation, leading to linear time and score-matrix memory complexity with respect to the look-back length. We integrate SGA into several forecasting backbones and compare it with standard self-attention and lightweight attention variants on nine publicly available real-world datasets covering electricity, finance, weather, medical monitoring, human activity, and climate records. The results show that SGA improves inference efficiency on public benchmarks while maintaining competitive forecasting performance against state-of-the-art attention mechanisms. These benchmark results provide deployment-oriented evidence.
zh_title: 面向高效时间序列预测的自门控注意力机制
translation: Transformer 架构在时间序列预测中表现出了强大的潜力，其中多头自注意力机制被广泛用于捕获历史时间戳之间的时序依赖关系。然而，标准自注意力机制在回溯长度方面具有二次方的时间和内存复杂度。这种成本可能会限制其在资源受限或高吞吐量预测系统中的使用，而在这些系统中，快速且内存高效的推理至关重要。通过定性和定量分析，我们观察到时间序列预测中的注意力图在不同时间戳之间通常包含冗余模式。这种现象与许多现实世界时间序列中重复的时序模式和相对稳定的时序相关性有关。基于这一观察，我们提出了自门控注意力（SGA），这是一种即插即用的注意力机制，它用一个共享的可学习矩阵和一个输入相关的残差分量来表示注意力分数。共享矩阵捕获通用的注意力模式，而残差分量捕获输入相关的变化。通过这种方式，SGA 避免了标准注意力分数计算中使用的查询和键投影，使得时间复杂度和分数矩阵内存复杂度相对于回溯长度呈线性关系。我们将 SGA 集成到多个预测骨干网络中，并在涵盖电力、金融、天气、医疗监测、人类活动和气候记录的九个公开真实数据集上将其与标准自注意力及轻量级注意力变体进行了比较。结果表明，SGA 在提高公共基准测试推理效率的同时，保持了与最先进注意力机制相当的预测性能。这些基准测试结果为面向部署的应用提供了证据。
tldr: 针对 Transformer 在时间序列预测中计算开销大的问题，提出了一种线性复杂度的 Self-Gating Attention (SGA) 机制，显著提升了推理效率且不损失预测精度。
ai_comments: 该论文通过观察时间序列注意力图中的冗余模式，提出了一种创新的高效注意力机制。其核心亮点在于将注意力分解为共享矩阵和输入相关残差，成功将计算复杂度从二次方降低到线性，为资源受限场景下的时间序列预测提供了极具实用价值的解决方案，兼顾了效率与性能。
motivation: 标准 Transformer 中的多头自注意力机制在时间序列预测中具有二次方的时间和内存复杂度，难以在资源受限或高吞吐量的系统中应用。研究发现时间序列的注意力映射中存在大量冗余模式，因此需要一种更高效的替代方案。
method: 提出 Self-Gating Attention (SGA) 机制，利用一个共享的可学习矩阵捕捉通用注意力模式，配合输入相关的残差分量来处理特定变化，从而避免了传统注意力机制中昂贵的查询（Query）和键（Key）投影计算。
results: SGA 实现了线性时间复杂度和线性内存复杂度，在九个不同领域的真实世界数据集上，相比标准注意力机制，在显著提升推理效率的同时，保持了与现有先进方法相当的预测性能。
conclusion: Self-Gating Attention (SGA) 是一种高效的注意力机制，通过减少计算冗余，在保持预测性能的同时显著降低了时间序列预测的计算和内存开销。

title: A PDE-Based Framework for Generative Modeling Beyond Classical Score-Based Diffusion
authors: Horacio Tettamanti, Michael Herty
abstract: We introduce an alternative generative framework based on a nonlinear modification of the classical Ornstein--Uhlenbeck dynamics. The proposed dynamics admits both a microscopic description through an interacting particle system and, in the mean-field limit, a macroscopic formulation given by a nonlinear Fokker--Planck equation with a superlinear drift term. We show that, for suitable choices of the model parameters and sufficiently large initial mass, the forward dynamics exhibits condensation phenomena by proving the loss of $L^2$ regularity of the solution in finite time. Building upon this formulation, we derive a stabilized reverse-time partial differential equation that reconstructs the initial distribution from the asymptotic state of the forward dynamics, thereby extending the generative paradigm beyond the classical score-based framework. Furthermore, we introduce numerical discretizations of both the forward and reverse processes that accurately capture the asymptotic behavior of the continuous model while successfully reconstructing the initial distribution. Numerical experiments in one and two spatial dimensions validate the proposed methodology and illustrate its application to density filtering through successive iterations of the generative process.

title: SelectTSL: Prompt-Guided Selective Target Sound Localization in Complex Scenarios
authors: Ziyang Jiang, Yu Chen, Zexu Pan, Xinyuan Qian, Bowen Xing, Ivor W. Tsang, Xu-Cheng Yin, Haizhou Li
abstract: Humans can selectively attend to a target sound and estimate its direction in complex scenarios, whereas such selective localization remains challenging for current deep learning-based systems. Sound source localization (SSL) has achieved remarkable success with deep learning, yet most methods localize all active sources without selectivity. Conversely, target sound extraction (TSE) extracts sources using multimodal prompts but typically fails to preserve the multichannel spatial information required for accurate localization. To bridge this gap, we formulate the task of prompt-guided selective target sound localization and propose SelectTSL, an end-to-end architecture that localizes only the user-specified target in multi-source acoustic scenes. Specifically, we design a target-aware selective localization strategy that employs a Prompt-Guided Selective Attention Module (PGSA) to generate prompt-informed embeddings. These embeddings guide an inter-channel phase difference (IPD) enhancer to refine raw phase cues, fusing with target magnitudes to jointly estimate direction of arrival (DoA) and target-source cardinality, i.e., the number of target sound sources. This coupled design effectively focuses on the user-specified target spatial cues for selective localization and also handles time-varying numbers of target sources. Extensive experiments on both synthetic data and real-world recordings demonstrate that our proposed method consistently outperforms other baselines and exhibits robust generalization to real acoustic environments.
zh_title: SelectTSL：复杂场景下提示引导的选择性目标声源定位
translation: 人类能够在复杂场景中选择性地关注目标声音并估计其方向，然而这种选择性定位对当前的深度学习系统来说仍然具有挑战性。声源定位（SSL）在深度学习方面取得了显著成功，但大多数方法会定位所有活动声源，而缺乏选择性。相反，目标声源提取（TSE）使用多模态提示提取声源，但通常无法保留准确定位所需的通道间空间信息。为了弥补这一差距，我们制定了提示引导的选择性目标声源定位任务，并提出了SelectTSL，这是一种在多源声学场景中仅定位用户指定目标的端到端架构。具体而言，我们设计了一种目标感知选择性定位策略，采用提示引导的选择性注意力模块（PGSA）来生成提示信息嵌入。这些嵌入引导通道间相位差（IPD）增强器来细化原始相位线索，并与目标幅度融合，以联合估计到达方向（DoA）和目标源基数（即目标声源的数量）。这种耦合设计有效地聚焦于用户指定的目标空间线索以进行选择性定位，并处理时变的目标源数量。在合成数据和真实录音上的广泛实验表明，我们提出的方法始终优于其他基准，并对真实声学环境表现出稳健的泛化能力。
tldr: SelectTSL通过提示引导机制，实现了在复杂多源环境中对特定目标声源的精准选择性定位。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将目标声源提取（TSE）与声源定位（SSL）的优势结合，提出了一种能够根据提示信息在复杂多源场景中精确定位特定目标的新范式。其核心贡献在于通过PGSA模块引导相位信息增强，有效解决了传统方法无法在多源干扰下进行选择性定位的难题。
motivation: 现有的声源定位方法无法在多源场景下进行选择性定位，而目标声源提取方法又往往丢失了定位所需的空间信息，因此需要一种能结合两者优势的新型架构。
method: 提出SelectTSL架构，核心包括提示引导选择性注意力模块（PGSA）和通道间相位差（IPD）增强器。通过将提示引导的嵌入与相位信息融合，联合估计到达方向（DoA）和目标源数量。
results: 在合成数据和真实录音上的实验表明，SelectTSL在定位性能上显著优于现有基准方法，并展现出对真实复杂声学环境的鲁棒泛化能力。
conclusion: SelectTSL通过集成提示引导的选择性注意力机制与相位增强策略，成功实现了在复杂声学场景中对特定目标的高精度选择性定位，且具有良好的泛化能力。

title: Cloak and Detonate: Scanner Evasion and Dynamic Detection of Agent Skill Malware
authors: Zimo Ji, Congying Xu, Zongjie Li, Yudong Gao, Xin Wei, Shuai Wang, Shing-Chi Cheung
abstract:
LLM coding agents increasingly rely on third-party agent skills from public marketplaces, which execute with the agent's privileges and create a software supply-chain attack surface: a malicious skill can steal credentials, exfiltrate source code, or install backdoors. Existing defenses use static skill scanners based on pattern matching or LLM-as-judge analysis, but it remains unclear whether they withstand adaptive evasions that preserve malicious behavior while changing payload appearance.
  This paper first presents an adversarial study of existing skill scanners through SkillCloak, a payload-preserving evasion framework that keeps the attack semantics intact while transforming their visible form. SkillCloak uses two complementary strategies: Structural Obfuscation, which rewrites visible payload indicators into semantically equivalent forms, and Self-Extracting Skill (SFS) Packing, which hides malicious components from the install-time view and restores them during agent execution. Across eight scanners and 1,613 in-the-wild malicious skills, SFS Packing bypasses every scanner at over 90%, while Structural Obfuscation bypasses over 80% on most static scanners and reaches 96% on a hybrid scanner, showing that appearance-based auditing is insufficient.
  Motivated by this finding, we propose SkillDetonate, a behavior-centric runtime auditor that executes skills in a sandbox and detects malicious effects through OS-boundary information-flow evidence rather than install-time appearance. SkillDetonate combines on-demand closure lift, which observes instructions materialized during execution, with marker-based taint analysis, which tracks sensitive-data flows across the agent context, files, processes, and network operations. The results show that SkillDetonate detects 97% of attacks at a 2% false-positive rate and sustains 87% detection on real-world malicious skills.

title: GAP-GDRNet: Geometry-Aware Monocular Visual Pose Sensing on a Single-Target Synthetic Spacecraft Dataset
authors: Yonglong Zhang, Yang Liu
abstract: Monocular relative pose sensing is a central perception problem in non-cooperative rendezvous and on-orbit servicing. In spacecraft images, however, weak surface texture, thin appendages, illumination changes, and partial occlusion often leave only sparse and unstable geometric evidence. This article presents GAP-GDRNet, a geometry-aware attention-enhanced framework for monocular RGB-based 6D pose sensing. The method follows the geometry-guided direct regression paradigm of GDR-Net and modifies two points in the pipeline: an attention-based feature refinement (AFR) module is placed before dense geometric prediction, and a patch-level geometric self-attention (PGSA) module is inserted into Patch-PnP. AFR reinforces global spacecraft structure together with local weak-texture cues; PGSA then relates downsampled geometric patches before final pose regression. A Blender-based annotation process supplies target masks, visible-region masks, dense model-coordinate maps, camera intrinsics, and 6D pose labels for supervised training.
zh_title: GAP-GDRNet：面向单目标合成航天器数据集的几何感知单目视觉姿态感知方法
translation: 单目相对姿态感知是非合作航天器交会对接和在轨服务中的核心感知问题。然而，在航天器图像中，脆弱的表面纹理、细小的附件、光照变化以及部分遮挡往往只留下稀疏且不稳定的几何证据。本文提出了GAP-GDRNet，这是一个用于基于单目RGB的6D姿态感知的几何感知注意力增强框架。该方法遵循GDR-Net的几何引导直接回归范式，并修改了流程中的两点：在密集几何预测之前放置了一个基于注意力的特征细化（AFR）模块，并在Patch-PnP中插入了一个补丁级几何自注意力（PGSA）模块。AFR将全局航天器结构与局部弱纹理线索相结合进行强化；随后PGSA在最终姿态回归之前关联下采样的几何补丁。基于Blender的标注过程为监督训练提供了目标掩码、可见区域掩码、密集模型坐标图、相机内参和6D姿态标签。
tldr: GAP-GDRNet通过引入注意力机制，解决了单目视觉航天器姿态估计中因纹理弱、光照变幻导致的几何特征缺失问题。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入注意力机制改进了传统的几何引导直接回归（GDR-Net）框架，特别针对航天器图像中常见的弱纹理和光照变化问题，具有较强的针对性和工程应用价值。其局限性在于依赖合成数据集，可能在真实空间环境下的泛化能力有待进一步验证。
motivation: 在非合作航天器交会对接和在轨服务中，单目RGB图像常面临弱纹理、细小部件、光照剧变及遮挡问题，导致几何信息稀疏且不稳定，难以实现精准的6D姿态感知。
method: 提出GAP-GDRNet框架，在GDR-Net基础上引入两个模块：1. 注意力特征细化（AFR）模块，用于增强全局结构与局部弱纹理特征；2. 补丁级几何自注意力（PGSA）模块，用于在Patch-PnP阶段关联几何补丁。利用基于Blender的合成数据集进行监督训练。
results: 该方法成功在合成航天器数据集上实现了高效的6D姿态估计，通过注意力机制有效地整合了局部和全局几何信息，解决了特征稀疏带来的感知难题。
conclusion: GAP-GDRNet通过集成注意力机制优化了特征提取与几何回归过程，有效提升了单目视觉航天器6D姿态估计的鲁棒性。

title: Sobolev stability of the $L^2$-projection on hybrid meshes
authors: Lars Diening, Viktoria Lingert, Tabea Tscherpel
abstract: We establish $L^p$- and $W^{1,p}$-stability of the $L^2$-projection onto mapped Lagrange finite elements on hybrid meshes consisting of triangles and convex quadrilaterals arising from adaptive mesh refinement. If $K$ is the (tensor product) degree of polynomials of the discretisation, then we show, in particular, $W^{1,2}$-stability for all $K\geq 2$ for the Q-RG and Q-RB refinements. This extends results by Ali, Funken, and Schmidt (2022) which hold for the range $2 \leq K \leq 9$ for initial meshes consisting of parallelograms. Our proof relies on an extension of the technique by Diening, Storn and Tscherpel (2021) to general convex quadrilaterals.
zh_title: 混合网格上L2投影的Sobolev稳定性
translation: 我们建立了在由自适应网格细化产生的、由三角形和凸四边形组成的混合网格上，到映射拉格朗日有限元空间的$L^2$-投影的$L^p$-和$W^{1,p}$-稳定性。如果$K$是离散化多项式的（张量积）次数，我们特别证明了对于Q-RG和Q-RB细化，所有$K \geq 2$的情况下的$W^{1,2}$-稳定性。这扩展了Ali、Funken和Schmidt（2022）的结果，该结果适用于初始网格由平行四边形组成且次数范围为$2 \leq K \leq 9$的情况。我们的证明依赖于将Diening、Storn和Tscherpel（2021）的技术推广到一般凸四边形。
tldr: 本文证明了在自适应产生的混合网格上，$L^2$-投影对于多项式次数$K \geq 2$具有$W^{1,2}$-稳定性。
ai_comments: 本文通过将Diening等人的技术推广到一般的凸四边形，成功将L2投影的Sobolev稳定性分析范围从特定的平行四边形网格扩展到了更通用的自适应混合网格，具有重要的理论意义。
motivation: 现有的稳定性结果局限于特定的多项式次数范围以及初始平行四边形网格，需要将其推广到更广泛的混合网格和多项式次数。
method: 通过扩展Diening、Storn和Tscherpel（2021）提出的技术，将其应用于一般凸四边形，从而证明了在自适应网格细化下的稳定性。
results: 证明了在自适应网格细化产生的由三角形和凸四边形组成的混合网格上，$L^2$-投影具有$L^p$-和$W^{1,p}$-稳定性，特别是对于$K \geq 2$的Q-RG和Q-RB细化，$W^{1,2}$-稳定性成立。
conclusion: 研究表明，对于$K \geq 2$的多项式次数，在Q-RG和Q-RB细化产生的混合网格上，L2投影具有$W^{1,2}$-稳定性。

title: The Weight Distribution of the Third-Order Reed-Muller Code of Length 2048
authors: Kirill Khoruzhii, Patrick Gelß, Sebastian Pokutta
abstract: We compute the weight distribution of the third-order Reed--Muller code RM(3,11) of length 2048. The weight enumerator is assembled from the coset weight enumerators of f+RM(2,10), evaluated for representatives of all 3691560 nonzero GL(10,2)-orbits of Boolean cubic forms in ten variables. The computation rests on a structural theorem: a nondegenerate Boolean cubic form admits a nondegenerate hyperplane restriction, except for a single orbit in each odd dimension. The same pass determines the second-order nonlinearity of every cubic form: the relative covering radius of RM(2,10) in RM(3,10) is 408, attained on 179 orbits. This raises the best known lower bound on the covering radius of RM(2,10) from 400 to 408. A complementary heuristic search shows that the relative covering radius of RM(6,10) in RM(7,10) is at most 32, improving the previous bound of 50.
zh_title: 长度为2048的三阶Reed-Muller码的重量分布
translation: 我们计算了长度为2048的三阶Reed-Muller码RM(3,11)的重量分布。重量枚举器是通过f+RM(2,10)的陪集重量枚举器组装而成的，这些枚举器针对十变量布尔三次型的所有3691560个非零GL(10,2)-轨道代表元进行了评估。该计算基于一个结构定理：除了每个奇数维度中的单个轨道外，非退化布尔三次型都承认非退化超平面限制。同样的计算过程确定了每个三次型的二阶非线性度：RM(2,10)在RM(3,10)中的相对覆盖半径为408，在179个轨道上达到。这使得RM(2,10)覆盖半径的最佳已知下界从400提高到408。一项补充启发式搜索表明，RM(6,10)在RM(7,10)中的相对覆盖半径最多为32，改进了之前50的界限。
tldr: 研究计算了RM(3,11)的重量分布，并改进了RM(2,10)的覆盖半径下界及RM(6,10)的相对覆盖半径上界。
ai_comments: 该研究成功解决了Reed-Muller码领域的一个长期难题，通过利用布尔三次型的GL(10,2)-轨道结构定理，有效地计算出了RM(3,11)的重量分布。其创新点在于不仅给出了重量分布，还改进了RM(2,10)覆盖半径的下界，展示了计算代数与编码理论结合的强大威力。
motivation: 计算长度为2048的三阶Reed-Muller码RM(3,11)的重量分布，并探索相关码的覆盖半径。
method: 通过对十变量布尔三次型的3691560个非零GL(10,2)-轨道进行代表元评估，利用coset重量枚举器组装出RM(3,11)的重量枚举器，并应用关于非退化布尔三次型超平面限制的结构定理。
results: 确定了RM(3,11)的重量分布；将RM(2,10)的覆盖半径下界从400提高到408；将RM(6,10)在RM(7,10)中的相对覆盖半径上界从50改进为32。
conclusion: 成功计算了长度为2048的三阶Reed-Muller码RM(3,11)的完整重量分布，并更新了相关覆盖半径的界限。

title: Data Comics for Education: Evaluating Effectiveness, Benefits, and the Ethics of AI-Assisted Creation
authors: Zirui Shan, Vanessa Echeverria, Yuheng Li, Yi-Shan Tsai, Roberto Martinez-Maldonado
abstract: In today's data-driven world, students often struggle with interpreting visualisations due to limited visualisation literacy. Data comics have emerged as a promising medium to enhance engagement and understanding, but their educational value has seen little empirical examination, partly due to the effort required to create them. Recent advances in Generative AI (GenAI) offer a scalable solution to this challenge. We conducted a within-subjects study with 60 university students, comparing conventional visualisations with data comics, created with assistance from GenAI tools, across information retrieval and comprehension tasks. Students consistently performed better with data comics, particularly in insight comprehension tasks, independent of prior visualisation literacy. Students also commented data comics as more engaging and easier to understand, though concerns were raised about GenAI-driven misinformation and ownership. Our findings highlight the potential of data comics as a potentially effective tool for data communication in education, while underscoring the need to address ethical concerns related to AI-assisted creation.
zh_title: 教育数据漫画：评估有效性、益处及AI辅助创作的伦理问题
translation: 在当今数据驱动的世界中，由于可视化素养有限，学生往往难以解读可视化内容。数据漫画作为一种增强参与度和理解力的媒介脱颖而出，但由于制作难度大，其教育价值缺乏实证研究。生成式人工智能（GenAI）的最新进展为这一挑战提供了可扩展的解决方案。我们对60名大学生进行了一项组内研究，比较了传统可视化与在GenAI工具辅助下创作的数据漫画在信息检索和理解任务中的表现。结果显示，无论学生原有的可视化素养如何，数据漫画在信息理解任务中均表现更好。学生认为数据漫画更具吸引力且更易理解，但也对GenAI可能导致的错误信息和版权问题提出了担忧。我们的研究结果凸显了数据漫画作为教育中有效数据传播工具的潜力，同时也强调了解决与AI辅助创作相关的伦理问题的必要性。
tldr: 研究表明，利用生成式AI创作的数据漫画能显著提高学生的学习理解能力和参与度，但同时也引发了对AI版权与信息真实性的伦理担忧。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将数据漫画与生成式AI相结合，探索了教育领域的可视化辅助手段。研究不仅验证了数据漫画的有效性，还前瞻性地指出了AI生成内容所带来的伦理挑战，为教育技术的发展提供了重要参考。
motivation: 学生普遍缺乏可视化素养，难以解读数据可视化；同时，传统数据漫画制作成本高昂，研究旨在探讨AI辅助创作的数据漫画在教育中的有效性及潜在伦理问题。
method: 进行了一项针对60名大学生的组内对照研究，比较了传统可视化与AI辅助创作的数据漫画在信息检索和理解任务中的效果。
results: 研究发现学生在使用数据漫画时表现更好，尤其是在深入理解任务方面，且该效果不受学生原有可视化素养水平的影响；学生普遍认为数据漫画更具吸引力且更易理解，但也对AI可能产生的虚假信息和版权问题表示担忧。
conclusion: 数据漫画是教育领域中一种有效的可视化传播工具，能显著提升学生的理解与参与度，但AI辅助创作带来的错误信息和版权伦理问题需引起重视。

title: Deterministic Polynomial-time Exact-root Computation for Sparse Polynomials with Bounded Total Degree
authors: Qiao-Long Huang, Yichuan Cao, Ruichen Qiu, Xiao-Shan Gao
abstract:
We study the problem of deterministically computing the exact root of a sparse polynomial in the multivariate setting. Let $f \in \F[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ be a nonzero polynomial that is an exact $e$-th power, say $f = g^e$. Suppose $f$ is $s$-sparse, has an individual degree of at most $d$, and a total degree of $D = \tdeg(f)$. We prove a sparsity bound on the base polynomial $g$: \[ \|g\|_0 \le s^{D(2d+2)/e + 1}. \] Based on this bound, we develop a deterministic algorithm that computes the base $g$. %
In contrast to the general deterministic factorization algorithm of Bhargava, Saraf, and Volkovich \cite{BhargavaSarafVolkovich2020}, which achieves only a quasi-polynomial dependence on the input parameters, our algorithm is \emph{polynomial-time} in the setting where the total degree $D$ is bounded. Specifically, the overall complexity is \[ \mathrm{poly}\left(s^{O(Dd)}, n, d, D\right) + s\cdot R(e), \] %
where $R(e)$ denotes the cost of constructing a single $e$-th root of a scalar in the base field $\F$, and, when $\operatorname{char}(\F)\mid e$, the cost of computing a single Frobenius root of a scalar. %
This term is field-dependent, and over finite fields, $\mathbb{Q}$, or number fields with a suitable representation, it is absorbed into the polynomial complexity bound. %
Within the bounded total-degree regime, this yields a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm for exact-root computation.
zh_title: 针对总度数有界的稀疏多项式的确定性多项式时间精确根计算
translation: 我们研究了多元设置下稀疏多项式的精确根确定性计算问题。设 $f \in \F[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$ 是一个非零多项式，且是精确的 $e$ 次幂，即 $f = g^e$。假设 $f$ 是 $s$-稀疏的，单变量度数最多为 $d$，总度数为 $D = \tdeg(f)$。我们证明了基多项式 $g$ 的稀疏度界限：$\|g\|_0 \le s^{D(2d+2)/e + 1}$。基于此界限，我们开发了一种计算基 $g$ 的确定性算法。与 Bhargava、Saraf 和 Volkovich 的一般确定性分解算法（仅在输入参数上达到拟多项式依赖）相比，我们的算法在总度数 $D$ 有界的设置下是多项式时间的。具体而言，总体复杂度为 $\mathrm{poly}\left(s^{O(Dd)}, n, d, D\right) + s\cdot R(e)$，其中 $R(e)$ 表示在基域 $\F$ 中构造标量的单个 $e$ 次根的成本，当 $\operatorname{char}(\F)\mid e$ 时，还包括计算标量的单个 Frobenius 根的成本。该项与域有关，在有限域、$\mathbb{Q}$ 或具有合适表示的数域上，它被吸收到多项式复杂度界限中。在总度数有界的范围内，这产生了一种用于精确根计算的确定性多项式时间算法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种在总度数有界条件下，确定性求解稀疏多项式精确根的多项式时间算法，解决了此前算法仅能达到拟多项式时间的局限。
ai_comments: 该研究通过建立稀疏多项式的基多项式稀疏度界限，成功将精确根计算问题从拟多项式时间改进为多项式时间，这对稀疏多项式理论具有重要意义。局限在于该算法仅在总度数（total degree）有界的条件下表现为多项式时间复杂度。
motivation: 现有的确定性多项式分解算法（如 Bhargava 等人的工作）在计算稀疏多项式的根时仅能达到拟多项式时间复杂度，作者旨在寻找在总度数有界条件下的确定性多项式时间解法。
method: 首先推导了基多项式 $g$ 的稀疏度上界 $\|g\|_0 \le s^{D(2d+2)/e + 1}$，并基于此界限开发了一种确定性算法，将计算过程转化为多项式时间操作。
results: 提出了一种在总度数 $D$ 有界时，计算稀疏多项式精确根的确定性多项式时间算法，其复杂度为 $\mathrm{poly}(s^{O(Dd)}, n, d, D) + s \cdot R(e)$。
conclusion: 本文证明了在总度数有界的限制下，稀疏多项式的精确根计算可以在确定性多项式时间内完成，克服了以往算法的复杂度瓶颈。

title: World Wide Models: Literary Tools for Cultural AI
authors: Nina Begus
abstract: LLMs stage a new form of cultural encounter that is massive, automated, and monolingual. Literary disciplines have always negotiated cultural struggles with comparative reading of literature, narratological and poetic analysis, critical theory, world literature, and translation. These tools have now become indispensable for building culturally literate AI. The essay develops a layered framework toward more nuanced textual models and pluralistic interpretations of AI, emphasizing the natural intersections of literature and AI development, connecting current debates in critical theory with structural monolingualism, and suggesting a new application of world literature approaches to address global AI textuality through macrostructure, circulation, and untranslatability.
zh_title: 世界模型：文化AI的文学工具
translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）开启了一种规模巨大、自动化且单一语言的文化接触新形式。文学学科一直通过文学比较阅读、叙事学与诗学分析、批判理论、世界文学及翻译来协调文化冲突。这些工具现在对于构建具有文化素养的AI变得不可或缺。本文提出了一个分层框架，旨在实现更细致的文本模型和对AI的多元化解读，强调了文学与AI发展之间的天然交集，将当前批判理论中的争论与结构性单语问题联系起来，并建议应用世界文学方法，通过宏观结构、传播和不可译性来处理全球AI文本性。
tldr: 本文主张利用文学分析工具（如世界文学、批判理论）来解决大语言模型中存在的单语化和文化局限，以构建更具包容性的文化AI。
ai_comments: 该论文具有高度的跨学科创新性，将传统文学研究方法论引入AI开发领域，为解决当前大模型“结构性单语”和文化偏见问题提供了独特的理论视角。其局限性在于主要侧重于理论框架构建，缺乏具体的实验验证或工程实现细节。
motivation: 针对大语言模型（LLMs）在大规模、自动化和单语化特征下引发的文化冲突与单一文化视角问题，旨在通过文学学科的工具提升AI的文化素养与多元解读能力。
method: 提出一种分层框架，将比较文学、叙事学、诗学分析、批判理论及世界文学方法论应用于AI文本分析，重点关注宏观结构、传播机制和不可译性。
results: 构建了一个旨在实现更细致文本模型和多元化AI解读的分层框架，成功将文学理论与AI开发中的结构性单语问题及全球文本性挑战联系起来。
conclusion: 该研究强调了文学批评工具在提升AI文化素养方面的重要性，主张通过世界文学的视角来构建更具多元性和包容性的AI文本模型。

title: Learning Spectral and Polarimetric Clues for One-to-Multimodal Novel View Synthesis
authors: Federico Lincetto, Gianluca Agresti, Mattia Rossi, Piergiorgio Sartor, Pietro Zanuttigh
abstract: Neural rendering techniques allow for accurate reconstruction of the geometry and color appearance of 3D scenes. Some methods have extended their use to additional imaging modalities, such as multispectral, infrared, or polarimetric data. However, all of these approaches require expensive sensors and calibrated setups to capture new multimodal frames for each new scene. We propose Spectral and Polarimetric Implicit Learned Representation (SPoILeR), a novel method to obtain multi-view consistent renderings of unconventional modalities for scenes where either only RGB frames or very few of the additional modalities are available. Thanks to a multimodal pre-training phase, the model learns the mutual correlation between different modalities. This step allows predicting accurate renderings of unconventional modalities during a fine-tuning phase supervised only by RGB images. Experimental results show that the approach can accurately render infrared, polarimetric, and multispectral frames for scenes where no input sample captured by these types of sensors is provided.

title: Understanding Agent-Based Patching of Compiler Missed Optimizations
authors: Batu Guan, Zirui Wang, Shaohua Li
abstract: Compiler missed optimizations refer to cases in which compilers failed to optimize certain code. It takes many compiler developers' efforts to implement or patch such missed optimizations. In this paper, we present a systematic study of how well agents patch compiler missed optimizations. We identify a significant challenge that patching a missed optimization requires more than just fixing the reported case, and instead requires generalizing to similar cases. We construct a benchmark of real-world LLVM missed optimization issues and compare agent-generated patches with patches from developers in terms of optimization scope. Our results show that coding agents often optimize the given examples, but many generated patches either cover only part of the developer-intended scope or partially overlap with it; in some cases, they further generalize beyond the reference patch. We further introduce historical-knowledge augmentation techniques that leverage prior LLVM optimization pull requests through retrieval and distillation, showing that they improve developer-aligned generalization and yield practical benefits when applied to real-world IR.
zh_title: 理解基于智能体的编译器漏优补丁生成
translation: 编译器漏优是指编译器未能对特定代码进行优化的情况。修复这些问题需要编译器开发人员付出大量努力。在本文中，我们系统地研究了智能体在修复编译器漏优问题上的表现。我们发现了一个重大挑战，即修复漏优问题不仅仅是修复报告的特定案例，还需要推广到相似的案例。我们构建了一个真实世界LLVM漏优问题的基准测试，并从优化范围的角度比较了智能体生成的补丁与开发者补丁。结果表明，代码智能体通常能优化给定的示例，但许多生成的补丁要么仅覆盖开发者预期范围的一部分，要么仅与之部分重叠；在某些情况下，它们甚至超出了参考补丁的泛化范围。我们进一步引入了历史知识增强技术，通过检索和蒸馏利用以往的LLVM优化Pull Request，证明了这些技术可以改善与开发者对齐的泛化能力，并在应用于实际IR时产生实际效益。
tldr: 本文研究了AI智能体在修复编译器漏优问题时的局限性，发现其缺乏泛化能力，并通过引入历史知识增强技术提升了补丁质量。
ai_comments: 该研究揭示了AI智能体在编译器优化补丁生成中的局限性，即缺乏泛化能力。通过引入历史知识增强技术，该论文为提升自动修复工具的实际应用价值提供了重要思路，是编译器自动化领域的一项重要实证研究。
motivation: 编译器漏优问题修复耗时费力，现有的代码智能体在修复此类问题时，往往难以像人类开发者那样实现对相似案例的有效泛化。
method: 构建包含真实世界LLVM漏优问题的基准测试集；对比智能体生成的补丁与开发者补丁在优化范围上的差异；提出基于检索和蒸馏的历史知识增强技术（historical-knowledge augmentation techniques）。
results: 实验发现智能体生成的补丁多局限于特定示例，难以达到开发者预期的泛化覆盖范围；引入历史知识增强技术后，能够显著提升补丁的泛化质量，并在实际IR代码中展现出实用价值。
conclusion: 研究表明，智能体在处理编译器优化问题时往往表现出“过拟合”具体案例的倾向，而通过引入历史知识增强技术，可以有效提升智能体生成补丁的泛化能力，使其更符合开发者的预期。

title: Hardware-Enforced Semantic Coordination for Safety-Critical Real-Time Autonomous Systems
authors: Uwe M. Borghoff, Paolo Bottoni, Remo Pareschi
abstract:
Recent advances in agentic AI are producing increasingly complex autonomous systems that integrate large language models, world models, optimization engines, specialized neural architectures, autonomous platforms, and human operators. While much current research focuses on improving reasoning capabilities, safety-critical real-time deployment also requires bounded and verifiable coordination among heterogeneous components operating concurrently under uncertainty. Software-mediated coordination presents fundamental limitations in domains where bounded latency, deterministic coordination, and enforceable safety guarantees are essential.
  Hence, we propose a hardware-enforced semantic coordination architecture in which selected coordination semantics are implemented directly at the hardware level via field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs). The approach builds on the Topic-Based Communication Space Petri Net (TB-CSPN) framework, which separates semantic reasoning from interaction management.
  In this approach, selected TB-CSPN coordination mechanisms are mapped onto FPGA primitives, creating a hardware-native semantic coordination layer. Focus is not on acceleration, but on enforcing temporal synchronization, semantic gating, authorization constraints, and bounded coordination behavior directly in hardware. Semantic reasoning remains adaptive and software-driven, while embedded coordination semantics become deterministic.

title: DRIFTLENS: Measuring Memory-Induced Reasoning Drift in Personalized Language Models
authors: Xi Fang, Weijie Xu, Yingqiang Ge, Yuhui Xu, Stephanie Eckman, Chandan K. Reddy
abstract: Personalization changes what a model says to a user; we show that it can also change the reasoning trajectory used to justify the response. Modern LLMs personalize interactions by storing user attributes, preferences, and prior context, then injecting this information into future prompts. We study whether such memory reshapes reasoning on open-ended questions where no single ground-truth answer exists. To quantify this effect, we introduce DRIFTLENS, a ground-truth-free framework that maps each expressed reasoning step to a value category and measures divergence between a question's no-memory trajectory and its trajectory under injected user-attribute memory. We first validate that DRIFTLENS distinguishes content-free pragmatic noise from substantive reasoning changes. Across four LLMs and 10 user-attribute categories, including age, occupation, and disability, user-attribute memory induces medium-to-large reasoning drift above each model's pragmatic-noise floor, even when final answers remain fluent, on-topic, and plausible. We then evaluate GRPO- and DPO-based post-training methods for reducing drift. Both reduce drift, but neither uniformly dominates; effects on downstream capability, helpfulness, and instruction following are model-and reward-dependent. These results suggest that memory-induced reasoning drift is a measurable and only partly mitigated failure mode of personalized language models.
zh_title: DRIFTLENS：衡量个性化语言模型中记忆诱发的推理漂移
translation: 个性化改变了模型对用户所说的话；我们证明它还可以改变用于证明该响应合理性的推理轨迹。现代大语言模型通过存储用户属性、偏好和先验上下文，然后将这些信息注入到后续提示中来实现个性化。我们研究了这种记忆是否会重塑开放式问题上的推理，即那些没有单一标准答案的问题。为了量化这种效应，我们引入了DRIFTLENS，这是一个无需标准答案的框架，它将每个表达的推理步骤映射到一个价值类别，并测量一个问题的无记忆轨迹与注入用户属性记忆后的轨迹之间的差异。我们首先验证了DRIFTLENS能够区分无内容的语用噪声与实质性的推理变化。在四个大语言模型和十个用户属性类别（包括年龄、职业和残疾）中，用户属性记忆在每个模型的语用噪声基准之上引发了中等到显著的推理漂移，即使最终答案仍然流畅、切题且合理。然后，我们评估了基于GRPO和DPO的后训练方法以减少这种漂移。两者都能减少漂移，但没有哪种方法占绝对优势；对下游能力、有用性和指令遵循的影响取决于模型和奖励。这些结果表明，记忆诱发的推理漂移是个性化语言模型中一个可测量且仅被部分缓解的失效模式。
tldr: 个性化记忆会改变LLM的推理逻辑，即便答案看起来没问题。本文提出的DRIFTLENS揭示并量化了这一“推理漂移”现象。
ai_comments: 该研究揭示了大型语言模型个性化记忆带来的一个隐蔽但重要的风险：即使最终答案看起来合理，推理过程也可能发生显著偏移。DRIFTLENS框架为量化这种“推理漂移”提供了有效工具，对提升个性化模型的透明度和一致性具有重要意义。局限性在于其减轻措施（GRPO/DPO）的效果在不同模型和任务间表现不一致，且该研究主要关注非事实性开放问题。
motivation: 现有研究表明个性化不仅改变模型输出的内容，还可能改变模型用于论证答案的推理轨迹。作者旨在量化这种由用户属性记忆引发的“推理漂移”现象。
method: 提出了DRIFTLENS框架，通过将推理步骤映射到价值类别，测量无记忆状态与注入用户属性记忆状态下的轨迹差异；并评估了基于GRPO和DPO的后训练方法在减轻推理漂移方面的效果。
results: 研究发现，用户属性记忆在四种模型和十类属性中诱发了中等到显著的推理漂移，且即便在最终答案合理的情况下依然存在。GRPO和DPO方法能减轻漂移，但效果不一致，且对模型下游能力的影响具有模型和奖励依赖性。
conclusion: 记忆驱动的推理漂移是个性化语言模型中一个可测量且难以完全消除的失效模式，需要更深入的研究来平衡个性化与推理的一致性。

title: VisionAId: An Offline-First Multimodal Android Assistant for People with Visual Impairment, Featuring Personalized Object Retrieval
authors: Cristian-Gabriel Florea, Stelian Spînu
abstract: Over 285 million people worldwide live with a visual impairment, for whom everyday tasks such as avoiding obstacles, locating personal belongings, recognizing familiar faces, or handling cash remain persistent obstacles to personal autonomy. Existing assistive applications are typically limited to recognizing predefined categories, depend heavily on cloud connectivity, or require dedicated hardware. We present VisionAId, an Android application that turns a commodity smartphone into a real-time visual assistant. The system integrates six on-device deep learning models (metric monocular depth estimation, instance segmentation, visual and facial embeddings, face detection, and a custom banknote detector) running entirely through ONNX Runtime, with an optional cloud large language model (Google Gemini Flash) used only for narrative scene description and automatic object labeling. A distinctive contribution is a few-shot pipeline for personal objects: the user photographs an object from several angles, and the system later locates that specific instance in the environment, guiding the user toward it with augmented-reality markers, spatial audio, and distance-proportional haptics. All feedback is multimodal (Romanian speech synthesis, voice commands, vibration). On a reference device (Samsung Galaxy S21 Ultra), INT8 quantization reduces depth latency from ~1200 ms to ~491 ms, the custom banknote detector reaches an mAP@50 of 0.986, and metric depth is calibrated to below 1 cm of error within 3 m.
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Project repository available at: github.com
zh_title: VisionAId：一款面向视障人士、支持个性化物体检索的离线优先多模态 Android 辅助系统
translation: 全球有超过 2.85 亿视障人士，日常任务如避障、寻找个人物品、识别人脸或处理现金仍是他们实现个人自主的长期障碍。现有的辅助应用通常局限于识别预定义类别，严重依赖云端连接，或需要专用硬件。我们推出了 VisionAId，这是一款将普通智能手机转化为实时视觉助手的 Android 应用。该系统集成了六个端侧深度学习模型（度量单目深度估计、实例分割、视觉与面部嵌入、人脸检测以及自定义钞票检测器），完全通过 ONNX Runtime 运行，仅在叙述性场景描述和自动物体标记时可选使用云端大语言模型（Google Gemini Flash）。该研究的一个显著贡献是针对个人物品的少样本学习管道：用户从多个角度拍摄物体，系统随后可在环境中定位该特定实例，通过增强现实标记、空间音频和距离比例触觉反馈引导用户找到它。所有反馈均为多模态（罗马尼亚语语音合成、语音命令、振动）。在参考设备（三星 Galaxy S21 Ultra）上，INT8 量化将深度估计延迟从约 1200 毫秒降低至 491 毫秒，自定义钞票检测器的 mAP@50 达到 0.986，且 3 米内的度量深度误差校准在 1 厘米以下。
tldr: VisionAId 是一款无需联网、基于手机的视障辅助应用，通过本地 AI 模型实现实时物体检索与环境感知，并通过声音和震动提供多模态引导。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于成功将复杂的计算机视觉模型（如深度估计、实例分割等）在移动端离线运行，并通过少样本学习（few-shot）实现了个性化物体检索，极大地提升了视障人士在隐私和网络环境受限情况下的自主性。其局限性在于对硬件性能有一定要求，且复杂场景下的鲁棒性仍需进一步验证。
motivation: 现有的视障辅助应用多依赖云端连接、硬件受限或仅能识别预定义类别，无法满足视障人士在离线环境下对个人化、实时性辅助的需求。
method: 开发了一款基于 Android 的应用，集成了六个本地运行的 ONNX Runtime 深度学习模型，并采用 INT8 量化技术进行性能优化；设计了一个少样本学习管道用于个性化物品检索，并通过 AR 标记、空间音频和触觉反馈提供多模态引导。
results: 在三星 Galaxy S21 Ultra 上，INT8 量化使深度估计延迟显著降低；自定义钞票检测器 mAP@50 达到 0.986；3 米内深度测量误差小于 1 厘米。
conclusion: VisionAId 证明了通过轻量化模型和高效推理框架，可以在普通智能手机上实现高性能的视障辅助功能，为离线、个性化的视觉辅助技术提供了有效方案。

title: Representation Distribution Matching for One-Step Visual Generation
authors: Lan Feng, Wuyang Li, Eloi Zablocki, Matthieu Cord, Alexandre Alahi
abstract: We elucidate the design space of Representation Distribution Matching (RDM), our name for the paradigm that trains a one-step image generator by matching generated and reference feature distributions under frozen pretrained encoders. We identify two design axes, how the distributions are compared and the representations they are compared in, and controlled studies along them yield three findings. First, the classical MMD, which could not train convincing generators a decade ago, becomes a strong and scalable objective once estimated right. Second, the generated batch is then the operative variable, with an optimum above 2048, far beyond customary batch sizes. Third, any single representation can be gamed, driven below the real score while images stay visibly fake, so we match against a balanced battery of encoders and evaluate with SW_r14, a Sliced-Wasserstein distance over 14 encoders that is independent of the training loss and resists gaming. Combining the preferred choices yields improved RDM (iRDM): it sets the one-step state of the art on ImageNet at SW_r14 1.30, corroborated by PickScore, a human-preference proxy our objective never optimizes, which prefers it over the prior best one-step generator on 71.2% of matched samples. The same recipe post-trains the four-step FLUX.2 [klein] into a one-step generator, surpassing the four-step version on GenEval, 0.826 to 0.794, and on PickScore, 22.76 to 22.58, in 90 H200 GPU-hours. Project page: https://alan-lanfeng.github.io/rdm/.
zh_title: 用于单步视觉生成的表征分布匹配
translation: 我们阐述了表征分布匹配（RDM）的设计空间，这是我们为一种通过在冻结的预训练编码器下匹配生成特征分布和参考特征分布来训练单步图像生成器的范式所起的名称。我们确定了两个设计轴：如何比较分布以及在哪些表征中进行比较，并沿着这些轴进行了受控研究，得出了三个发现。首先，十年前无法训练出令人信服的生成器的经典MMD，一旦估计正确，就成为了一种强大且可扩展的目标函数。其次，生成的批次大小是关键变量，其最优值在2048以上，远超通常的批次大小。第三，任何单一表征都可能被“游戏化”，即在图像看起来仍然虚假的情况下将分数降低到真实分数以下，因此我们针对一组平衡的编码器进行匹配，并使用SW_r14进行评估，这是一种跨越14个编码器的切片Wasserstein距离，它独立于训练损失且能够抵抗游戏化。结合这些优选方案产生了改进的RDM（iRDM）：它在ImageNet上以1.30的SW_r14设定了单步图像生成的最先进水平，并得到了PickScore的证实，PickScore是我们目标函数从未优化过的人类偏好代理，它在71.2%的匹配样本中更倾向于它，而不是之前的最佳单步生成器。同样的配方将四步FLUX.2后训练为单步生成器，在GenEval上以0.826对0.794，在PickScore上以22.76对22.58超过了四步版本，且仅用了90个H200 GPU小时。项目页面：https://alan-lanfeng.github.io/rdm/。
tldr: 通过改进表征分布匹配策略，本文实现了性能超越现有最强单步生成模型的效果，并能高效将多步扩散模型转化为单步生成器。
ai_comments: 该研究通过系统性地探索“表征分布匹配（RDM）”的设计空间，成功将单步图像生成的效果提升到了新的高度。其核心贡献在于证明了通过正确的估计方法，经典的MMD目标函数依然强劲，并提出了对抗“游戏化（gaming）”单个表征的有效策略。该方法在ImageNet上的表现非常出色，且具有良好的通用性，能够将多步生成模型高效转化为单步生成模型，具有很高的实用价值和学术意义。
motivation: 旨在解决单步图像生成中如何有效匹配生成分布与真实分布的问题，并克服传统方法中存在的训练不稳定、单一表征易被欺骗以及生成质量不足的挑战。
method: 通过冻结预训练编码器，将生成图像与真实图像的特征分布进行匹配。核心改进包括：1. 采用正确估计的MMD作为训练目标；2. 使用超大批处理规模（>2048）；3. 引入包含14个编码器的评估指标SW_r14以防止模型“游戏化”；4. 采用多编码器组合进行训练。
results: iRDM在ImageNet上达到了1.30的SW_r14分数，在人类偏好指标（PickScore）上以71.2%的胜率优于现有最佳单步生成器。此外，该方法能将四步FLUX.2模型转化为性能更优的单步模型，且训练效率极高。
conclusion: 本文提出的改进型RDM（iRDM）通过优化分布匹配策略、增大批处理规模以及采用多编码器评估体系，在单步图像生成任务中达到了最先进（SOTA）水平，并证明了该方法在加速现有扩散模型方面的潜力。

title: Generalized Rank Weight and Extended Generalized Poset Weight Defined For Codes Over Rings: A Galois Connection Approach
authors: Yang Xu, Haibin Kan, Guangyue Han
abstract: In this paper, we study generalized rank weights (GRWs) and extended generalized poset weight (EGPWs) of codes over rings via a Galois connection approach. First, we show that various coding-theoretic properties related to generalized weights, including security drops of a code employed in wire-tap channel of type II, connections between generalized weights of a Gabidulin code and its associated Delsarte code, (generalized) Singleton bound, MDS discrepancy of a code, characterizations of MDS, near MDS, $i$-MDS, MRD, near MRD, $i$-MRD, (dually) quasi-MRD codes as well as evasive property of subspaces, can be reformulated in terms of Galois connections. Next, we study GRWs and rank profiles defined for modules over principal ideal rings, especially those over chain rings. Generalizing GRWs defined for vector spaces over fields, we establish a singleton bound and a Wei-type duality theorem, characterize MRD, near MRD and dually quasi-MRD codes and determine their GRWs; moreover, we characterize $i$-MRD codes and establish a scattered bound for $(h,h)$-evasive codes over chain rings, generalizing counterpart result established for vector space over finite fields. Finally, we propose and study EGPWs and extended poset profiles defined for modules with a composition series, which in fact form a Galois connection. Generalizing EGPWs defined for modules over finite Galois rings, we establish a Wei-type duality theorem for modules over arbitrary quasi-Frobenius rings, which unifies the two Wei-type duality theorems derived in both \cite{32} and \cite{33}.
zh_title: 环上码的广义秩权重与扩展广义偏序权重：一种伽罗瓦连接方法
translation: 在本文中，我们通过伽罗瓦连接方法研究了环上码的广义秩权重（GRW）和扩展广义偏序权重（EGPW）。首先，我们证明了与广义权重相关的多种编码理论属性（包括II型窃听信道中码的安全下降、Gabidulin码与其关联Delsarte码之间的联系、（广义）Singleton界、码的MDS差异、MDS/近MDS/$i$-MDS/MRD/近MRD/$i$-MRD/（对偶）拟MRD码的刻画，以及子空间的逃逸性质）都可以用伽罗瓦连接来重新表述。其次，我们研究了定义在主理想环（特别是链环）上模的GRW和秩轮廓。通过推广有限域上向量空间的GRW，我们建立了Singleton界和Wei型对偶定理，刻画了MRD、近MRD和对偶拟MRD码并确定了它们的GRW；此外，我们刻画了$i$-MRD码并建立了链环上$(h,h)$-逃逸码的散乱界，推广了有限域向量空间的对应结果。最后，我们提出并研究了定义在具有合成列的模上的EGPW和扩展偏序轮廓，它们实际上形成了一个伽罗瓦连接。通过推广有限伽罗瓦环上模的EGPW，我们为任意拟弗罗贝尼乌斯环上的模建立了Wei型对偶定理，统一了文献[32]和[33]中导出的两个Wei型对偶定理。
tldr: 本文利用伽罗瓦连接框架，成功将广义秩权重和偏序权重理论从有限域推广至更一般的环上，并统一了多种编码属性的对偶性和界限。
ai_comments: 该论文通过伽罗瓦连接这一统一框架，系统性地重构并推广了编码理论中关于广义秩权重和偏序权重的核心结论。其创新之处在于将多种复杂的编码属性（如MDS、MRD性质及对偶性）纳入统一的数学结构中，并成功将结论从有限域推广至主理想环和拟弗罗贝尼乌斯环，具有很高的理论统一价值。
motivation: 为了统一和推广编码理论中关于广义权重（如GRW和EGPW）的各种属性，并将其从有限域上的向量空间扩展到更一般的环（如主理想环、链环和拟弗罗贝尼乌斯环）上。
method: 利用伽罗瓦连接（Galois connection）方法，研究环上的码的广义权重，包括主理想环上的模以及具有合成列的模。
results: 重构了多种编码属性的伽罗瓦连接表示；在链环上建立了GRW的Singleton界和Wei型对偶定理，并刻画了多种MRD码；在拟弗罗贝尼乌斯环上建立了EGPW的统一Wei型对偶定理。
conclusion: 论文成功利用伽罗瓦连接框架统一了多种广义权重理论，并将其推广至更广泛的环结构上，建立了新的对偶定理和界限，显著扩展了代数编码理论的应用范围。

title: Generative Autonomous Grid Control: Integrating Decision Transformers with a Two-Stage Safety Stack
authors: Mohamed Shamseldein
abstract: The displacement of synchronous generation by inverter-based resources is accelerating power system frequency dynamics beyond the response capability of conventional automatic generation control. This paper presents Autonomous Grid Generation Control with Decision Transformers, a framework coupling an offline-trained Decision Transformer with a twostage symbolic safety stack for secondary frequency control. The Decision Transformer learns a conditional dispatch policy from offline supervisory control and data acquisition records via sequence modeling, eliminating online exploration risks. A Constraint Verification Unit provides sub-ten-millisecond algebraic screening using real-time power transfer distribution factors, while an aggregate digital twin performs swing-equation-based dynamic stability certification. Validated on the Northeast Power Coordinating Council 140-bus system under low-inertia conditions, the proposed controller reduces the area control error integral by over 99% relative to tuned automatic generation control, maintains a 59.4 Hz frequency nadir, and achieves inference latency of approximately 10 ms, well within real-time constraints. Comparative evaluation against a linear quadratic regulator baseline and structural analysis against conservative Q-learning demonstrate the advantages of the sequence-modeling formulation. Small-signal eigenvalue analysis characterizes the dominant 1.87 Hz electromechanical mode and confirms that the safety stack maintains stable operation across operating points. By falling back to tuned automatic generation control whenever proposals are rejected, the safety stack bounds worst-case performance to industry-standard levels in simulation.

title: Know Your Source: A Public Knowledge Store for Media Background Checks
authors: Benjamin Nichols, Michael Schlichtkrull, Nedjma Ousidhoum
abstract: LLM-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is increasingly used for automated fact-checking (AFC) and related tasks. By grounding LLM outputs in retrieved evidence, RAG-based systems provide transparent justifications while allowing external information to be updated independently of the underlying model. However, existing approaches often assume retrieved evidence is reliable, although real-world information may be conflicting, outdated, and can originate from unreliable or biased sources. Recent work on *source-critical reasoning* addresses this challenge through media background checks (MBCs) (Schlichtkrull, 2024), which assess the credibility of evidence sources to support downstream fact verification. However, generating MBCs relies on costly proprietary search APIs, limiting reproducibility. To mitigate this issue, we introduce MEDIAREF, a publicly available knowledge store of web-sourced documents that enables reproducible, low-cost evaluation of MBC generation across 200 media sources. We describe a reproducible methodology for constructing and updating the collection, assess widely used LLMs on the MBC generation task, and demonstrate that MEDIAREF supports higher-quality MBC generation through both automatic and qualitative evaluation.
zh_title: 了解你的来源：用于媒体背景调查的公共知识存储库
translation: 基于大模型的检索增强生成（RAG）越来越多地用于自动事实核查（AFC）及相关任务。通过将大模型输出建立在检索到的证据基础上，基于RAG的系统提供了透明的依据，同时允许外部信息独立于底层模型进行更新。然而，现有方法通常假设检索到的证据是可靠的，尽管现实世界的信息可能是冲突的、过时的，并且可能源自不可靠或有偏见的来源。最近关于“来源批判性推理”的工作通过媒体背景调查（MBC）解决了这一挑战，该调查评估证据来源的可信度以支持下游的事实验证。然而，生成MBC依赖于昂贵的专有搜索API，限制了可复现性。为了缓解这个问题，我们引入了MEDIAREF，这是一个公开可用的网络源文档知识库，支持跨200个媒体来源的MBC生成的低成本、可复现评估。我们描述了一种用于构建和更新该集合的可复现方法，评估了广泛使用的大模型在MBC生成任务上的表现，并证明了MEDIAREF通过自动和定性评估支持更高质量的MBC生成。
tldr: 为解决事实核查中媒体来源评估成本高、难复现的问题，作者提出了MEDIAREF知识库，通过提供可复现的媒体背景调查数据来提升大模型的事实核查能力。
ai_comments: 该论文针对RAG系统在事实核查中面临的“来源可靠性”挑战，创新性地提出了MEDIAREF知识库，解决了依赖昂贵API进行媒体背景调查（MBC）的瓶颈，显著提升了研究的复现性和评估效率。
motivation: 现有的RAG事实核查系统往往忽视了证据来源的可靠性，而现有的媒体背景调查（MBC）方法依赖昂贵的专有搜索API，导致研究难以复现且成本高昂。
method: 构建了一个包含200个媒体来源的公共知识库（MEDIAREF），并定义了一套可复现的构建与更新方法，通过在不同LLM上进行MBC生成任务的自动化和定性评估来验证其有效性。
results: 实验表明，使用MEDIAREF可以支持更高质量的MBC生成，并为研究者提供了一个低成本、可复现的评估框架。
conclusion: MEDIAREF通过提供一个公共、可复现的媒体背景调查知识库，为提升大模型在事实核查中的来源批判能力提供了有效支撑，验证了其在低成本评估中的实用价值。

title: Steerability via constraints: a substrate for scalable oversight of coding agents
authors: Thomas Winninger
abstract: Coding agents are capable; human oversight is the bottleneck. Unconstrained agents introduce security risks, erode codebase scalability, and make human review increasingly costly. We argue that the same methods used for decades to manage large human engineering teams: access control, network policies, strict coding conventions enforced by tooling; transfer directly to coding agents, and are cheaper (in token) than recent agentic scaffolding. We sketch a start-to-end system on this principle, and report a controlled experiment in scalable oversight: a small reviewer (Gemma 4 e4b) inspects a Python codebase containing 11 inserted backdoors. Recall rises from 54.5% (unconstrained, no tools) to 90.9% (constrained substrate plus a ~200-LoC `docs` CLI), with substrate and tools contributing independently. We choose Python deliberately: substrate-level oversight gains are largest where the language gives the fewest guarantees by default; the principles extend to languages like Rust.
comment: Accepted to the Deep Learning for Code Workshop at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea, 2026
zh_title: 通过约束实现可控性：一种用于编码智能体可扩展监督的基底架构
translation: 编码智能体能力强大，人类监督是其瓶颈。无约束的智能体引入了安全风险，侵蚀了代码库的可扩展性，并使得人工审查的成本越来越高。我们认为，几十年来用于管理大型人类工程团队的方法——访问控制、网络策略、通过工具强制执行的严格编码规范——可以直接迁移到编码智能体上，并且比最近的智能体脚手架（在Token消耗方面）更便宜。我们基于这一原则勾勒了一个端到端的系统，并报告了一项关于可扩展监督的受控实验：一个小型审查员（Gemma 4 e4b）检查一个包含11个植入后门的Python代码库。召回率从54.5%（无约束，无工具）上升到90.9%（约束基底加上约200行代码的docs CLI），其中基底和工具独立地做出了贡献。我们特意选择了Python：在语言默认不提供保证的情况下，基底层面的监督收益最大；这些原则也可以扩展到Rust等语言。
tldr: 本文提出利用传统的软件工程约束（如访问控制和工具规范）作为“基底”来限制编码智能体，不仅降低了监督成本，还将代码后门的检测召回率从54.5%大幅提升至90.9%。
ai_comments: 这篇论文提出了一个非常务实且具有启发性的观点：与其通过复杂的智能体框架来试图“控制”大模型，不如利用成熟的软件工程实践（如访问控制、网络策略和工具强制约束）来构建一个受限的“基底”。这种方法不仅在技术上更具可扩展性，而且在成本效益上更优。实验结果有力支持了该方法的有效性，为解决AI编码助手安全性和可控性问题提供了一个低成本、高效率的路径。
motivation: 当前编码智能体能力强大，但缺乏有效的人类监督机制。无约束的智能体存在安全风险、代码库可扩展性差以及人工审查成本高昂等问题。作者试图探讨如何将传统的软件工程管理方法迁移到AI智能体监督中，以实现更具可扩展性和成本效益的监督方案。
method: 提出了一种基于基底约束（Substrate-level constraints）的方法，通过引入访问控制、网络策略、强制性编码规范以及轻量级工具（如~200行代码的docs CLI）来限制智能体的行为，并使用Gemma 4 e4b模型进行受控实验以验证其在检测代码后门方面的效果。
results: 实验表明，在无约束条件下，后门检测召回率为54.5%；而在引入基底约束和docs CLI工具后，召回率提升至90.9%。结果证明基底约束和辅助工具对提升监督效果具有独立的积极贡献。
conclusion: 通过在基底层面实施强制性约束和工具辅助，可以显著提升对编码智能体的监督能力，即使是较小的模型（如Gemma 4 e4b）也能在受限环境下实现高效的代码审查和安全防御。

title: Bringing Agentic Search to Earth Observation Data Discovery
authors: Minghan Yu, Youran Sun, Chugang Yi, Yixin Wen, Haizhao Yang
abstract: NASA and its data centers hold thousands of geoscience datasets and tools like Worldview, Giovanni, the Science Discovery Engine, and Harmony. Finding the right one is hard even for domain experts. We present an agentic search system, deployed as a public service for the geoscience community, that takes a natural-language research query and returns the matching datasets and tools. We demonstrate that, in the era of large language models, the latent value of knowledge graphs (KGs) can be substantially amplified through agentic search. From the NASA Earth Observation Knowledge Graph (NASA EO-KG) we derive NASA-EO-Bench, an open benchmark of 47k query-dataset pairs (21k task-based queries). A neural scorer fine-tuned on NASA-EO-Bench beats cosine and BM25 baselines. Further combining it with BM25 via score fusion raises both Recall@10 (R@10) and MRR by over 5x. On top of this supervised pipeline, we add a zero-shot agentic reranking stage that, without any additional training, lifts MRR by 28% on a stratified N=200 subset, showing that LLM reasoning is complementary to supervised retrieval.
zh_title: 将代理式搜索引入地球观测数据发现领域
translation: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）及其数据中心拥有数以千计的地球科学数据集以及如Worldview、Giovanni、科学发现引擎（Science Discovery Engine）和Harmony等工具。即便对于领域专家而言，找到合适的数据集也十分困难。我们提出了一种代理式搜索系统，作为面向地球科学界的公共服务进行部署，该系统接收自然语言研究查询并返回匹配的数据集和工具。我们展示了在大语言模型时代，知识图谱（KGs）的潜在价值可以通过代理式搜索得到显著放大。基于NASA地球观测知识图谱（NASA EO-KG），我们衍生出了NASA-EO-Bench，这是一个包含4.7万个查询-数据集对（其中2.1万个为基于任务的查询）的开放基准测试集。一个在NASA-EO-Bench上微调的神经评分器击败了余弦相似度和BM25基线。进一步将其与BM25进行分数融合，使Recall@10 (R@10) 和 MRR 均提升了5倍以上。在此监督式流水线之上，我们增加了一个零样本代理式重排序阶段，在无需额外训练的情况下，使分层N=200子集上的MRR提升了28%，这表明LLM推理与监督式检索是互补的。
tldr: 本文提出一种结合知识图谱与大语言模型的代理式搜索系统，通过神经检索与LLM重排序的组合，大幅提升了NASA地球科学数据发现的准确性与效率。
ai_comments: 该研究创新性地将代理式搜索（Agentic Search）应用于地球科学领域，成功将知识图谱（KG）与大语言模型（LLM）相结合。其最大的贡献在于构建了大规模基准测试集 NASA-EO-Bench，并证明了LLM的推理能力能够有效补充传统的监督式检索，为解决海量科学数据发现难的问题提供了切实可行的解决方案。
motivation: NASA拥有海量的地球科学数据集和工具，但即便是领域专家在查找特定数据时也面临巨大困难，亟需一种更高效、易用的自然语言检索方案。
method: 构建了包含47k个查询-数据集对的基准测试集 NASA-EO-Bench；开发了一个经过微调的神经评分器；采用分数融合技术结合神经评分与BM25；并在监督式流水线上增加了一个零样本（zero-shot）代理式重排序阶段。
results: 神经评分器在NASA-EO-Bench上优于基线；结合BM25进行分数融合后，Recall@10和MRR提升了5倍以上；代理式重排序进一步将MRR提升了28%。
conclusion: 该研究证明了代理式搜索系统在地球观测数据发现中的有效性，通过结合监督式检索与LLM代理重排序，显著提升了检索系统的性能。

title: HULAT2 at MER-TRANS 2026: Governed Multi-Agent Simplification for Spanish Easy-to-Read Generation
authors: Lourdes Moreno, Paloma Martínez, Marco Antonio Sanchez-Escudero, Miguel Domínguez-Gómez
abstract: This paper describes the participation of HULAT2-UC3M in the Spanish track of MER-TRANS 2026, a shared task on multilingual Easy-to-Read translation. Three fully automatic Spanish runs were submitted. RUN1 and RUN2 used a LangGraph-based multi-agent workflow combining Gemini 2.5 Flash and RigoChat-7B-v2, parallel generation strategies, internal quality signals, Event-Condition-Action routing, controlled editing and traceable decisions. RUN1 used the base workflow, while RUN2 activated an additional lexical-support layer based on a glossary and lexical resources. RUN3 was a RigoChat-based generate-evaluate-regenerate baseline with prompt engineering and LoRA-based adaptation. The official leaderboard reports BLEU-Orig, BLEU-Gold, SARI and BERTScore. During development, additional internal signals were also inspected, including semantic fidelity, readability, lexical simplicity, syntactic clarity and factual consistency. According to official SARI, RUN1 was the best HULAT2 run, with 44.0543 points, followed by RUN2 with 43.1049 and RUN3 with 38.5136. These results indicate that, in this task setting, signal-guided multi-agent routing outperformed the linear regeneration baseline. They also show that adding lexical support did not automatically improve reference-based scores. Further segment-level and document-level analysis are required to assess readability, factual consistency and user-oriented adequacy.
zh_title: HULAT2在MER-TRANS 2026：面向西班牙语易读文本生成的受控多智能体简化方案
translation: 本文介绍了HULAT2-UC3M团队在MER-TRANS 2026多语言易读翻译共享任务中西班牙语赛道的参赛情况。团队提交了三个全自动运行版本。RUN1和RUN2使用了基于LangGraph的多智能体工作流，结合了Gemini 2.5 Flash和RigoChat-7B-v2，采用了并行生成策略、内部质量信号、事件-条件-动作（ECA）路由、受控编辑和可追溯决策。RUN1使用基础工作流，RUN2在RUN1基础上增加了一个基于词汇表和词汇资源的词汇支持层。RUN3是一个基于RigoChat的生成-评估-重生成基线，使用了提示工程和基于LoRA的适配。官方排行榜报告了BLEU-Orig、BLEU-Gold、SARI和BERTScore。在开发过程中，团队还检查了其他内部信号，包括语义忠实度、可读性、词汇简洁性、句法清晰度和事实一致性。根据官方SARI得分，RUN1是HULAT2表现最好的版本（44.0543分），其次是RUN2（43.1049分）和RUN3（38.5136分）。这些结果表明，在此任务设置中，信号引导的多智能体路由优于线性重生成基线。同时显示，增加词汇支持并未自动提高基于参考的指标分数。未来需要进行更深入的片段级和文档级分析，以评估可读性、事实一致性和面向用户的适切性。
tldr: 通过LangGraph构建的多智能体系统在西班牙语易读文本生成任务中表现优异，优于传统的线性重生成基线。
ai_comments: 该研究展示了多智能体工作流（Multi-Agent Workflow）在文本简化任务中的应用潜力。创新点在于通过LangGraph引入受控编辑和可追溯决策。局限性在于引入外部词汇支持层并未直接提升基于参考的指标，提示在复杂的自然语言生成任务中，自动化增强策略的效果存在不确定性。
motivation: 参与MER-TRANS 2026共享任务，旨在探索如何通过自动化多智能体框架提升西班牙语文本的易读性生成质量。
method: 提交了三个运行版本：RUN1采用LangGraph多智能体工作流（Gemini 2.5 Flash + RigoChat-7B-v2），包含并行生成、内部质量信号和ECA路由；RUN2在RUN1基础上增加了词汇支持层；RUN3作为基线，采用基于RigoChat的生成-评估-重生成策略及LoRA微调。
results: RUN1表现最优（SARI得分44.0543），多智能体路由策略显著优于线性重生成基线，且词汇支持层未显著提升参考指标分数。
conclusion: 基于信号引导的多智能体路由方法在西班牙语易读文本生成任务中优于线性重生成基线，但词汇支持层的效果仍需进一步深入评估。

title: Transformer Geometry Observatory TGO-II: Representational Similarity Observatory
authors: Kaustubh Kapil, Kishor P. Upla
abstract: While Vision Transformers have achieved remarkable success across computer vision and language applications, the geometric evolution of their internal representations throughout training remains insufficiently understood. Existing analyses primarily focus on attention mechanisms and downstream performance, leaving the evolution of representation geometry largely unexplored. In this work, we present Transformer Geometry Observatory-II (TGO-II), a representation geometry analysis framework designed to investigate how Transformer representations evolve during supervised training. TGO-II analyzes Vision Transformer (ViT-Small/16) representations using Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA), Singular Vector Canonical Correlation Analysis (SVCCA), Two-Nearest Neighbor Intrinsic Dimensionality (TwoNN-ID), and token covariance analysis. Our experiments reveal three key observations. First, both CKA and SVCCA progressively decrease throughout training, indicating increasing representational specialization across Transformer layers. Second, intrinsic dimensionality consistently increases before stabilizing, suggesting progressive expansion of the representation manifold into a larger set of locally accessible degrees of freedom. Third, token covariance and coupling analyses demonstrate that strong token interaction structure persists throughout training, challenging the hypothesis that increasing representational complexity arises primarily from progressive token independence. These findings suggest that representation complexity and layer specialization emerge simultaneously during training. Manifold expansion appears to occur without token decoupling. Together, these observations motivate a new hypothesis in which Vision Transformers increase representational complexity through progressively richer transformations while preserving strong token interaction structure during learning.
zh_title: Transformer几何观测站 TGO-II：表征相似性观测站
translation: 尽管视觉Transformer在计算机视觉和语言应用中取得了显著成功，但其内部表征在训练过程中的几何演化仍未得到充分理解。现有的分析主要集中在注意力机制和下游性能上，而表征几何的演化在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这项工作中，我们提出了Transformer几何观测站-II（TGO-II），这是一个旨在研究Transformer表征在监督训练期间如何演化的表征几何分析框架。TGO-II使用中心核对齐（CKA）、奇异向量典型相关分析（SVCCA）、双最近邻内在维度（TwoNN-ID）和token协方差分析来分析视觉Transformer（ViT-Small/16）的表征。我们的实验揭示了三个关键观察结果。首先，CKA和SVCCA在训练过程中逐渐下降，表明Transformer各层之间的表征专门化程度不断提高。其次，内在维度在稳定前持续增加，表明表征流形向更大的局部可访问自由度集合扩展。第三，token协方差和耦合分析表明，强大的token交互结构在整个训练过程中持续存在，这挑战了表征复杂性的增加主要源于token独立性增加的假设。这些发现表明，表征复杂性和层专门化在训练过程中同时出现。流形扩展似乎在没有token解耦的情况下发生。总之，这些观察结果激发了一个新的假设，即视觉Transformer通过越来越丰富的变换来增加表征复杂性，同时在学习过程中保持强大的token交互结构。
tldr: TGO-II框架揭示了Vision Transformers在训练中通过协同提升表征专门化与复杂性来进化，且其强token交互结构在整个学习过程中得以保持。
ai_comments: 该研究填补了对Vision Transformer内部表征几何演化理解的空白。其创新之处在于将多种指标（CKA, SVCCA, TwoNN-ID等）综合应用于训练全过程，揭示了表征复杂性与层专门化协同演化的机制，挑战了关于token独立性增加的传统假设，为理解深度学习模型的学习动态提供了重要视角。
motivation: 尽管Vision Transformers在视觉和语言任务中表现卓越，但其内部表征在训练过程中的几何演化机制尚不明确，现有研究多关注注意力机制或下游任务表现，缺乏对表征几何演化的系统性探索。
method: 提出了TGO-II框架，利用Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA)、Singular Vector Canonical Correlation Analysis (SVCCA)、Two-Nearest Neighbor Intrinsic Dimensionality (TwoNN-ID)以及token协方差分析，对ViT-Small/16模型在监督训练过程中的内部表征进行定量分析。
results: 1. CKA和SVCCA值随训练下降，表明层间表征专门化程度提高；2. 内在维度先增加后稳定，表明表征流形向更高自由度扩展；3. 强token交互结构在训练中持续存在，反驳了表征复杂性源于token独立性增加的观点。
conclusion: Vision Transformers通过在保持强token交互结构的同时，实现表征流形的逐步扩展和层级专门化，从而在训练过程中提升表征复杂性。

title: DecompRL: Solving Harder Problems by Learning Modular Code Generation
authors: Juliette Decugis, Fabian Gloeckle, Francis Bach, Taco Cohen, Gabriel Synnaeve
abstract: How can Large Language Models (LLMs) solve problems they currently cannot? Repeated sampling scales test-time compute but GPU cost grows linearly with attempts, while reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards improves single-attempt accuracy at the expense of sample diversity. Both strategies ultimately fail when the base policy has near-zero probability of producing a correct solution: no amount of sampling or gradient signal can overcome a search space that is simply too large. We take a different approach: rather than sampling harder, we make the task easier by decomposing problems into smaller, independently solvable sub-functions whose implementations can be recombined. Since off-the-shelf models are not trained for this modular generation, we introduce DecompRL, an RL algorithm that explicitly learns to decompose and implement hierarchical code structures. Recombining $k$ implementations of $n$ modules yields up to $k^{n}$ candidate solutions, shifting the bottleneck from GPU inference to cheap CPU evaluation and cutting GPU token cost by $\sim$50$\times$. On LiveCodeBench and CodeContests (Qwen~2.5~7B, Code World Model~32B), DecompRL outperforms standard and diversity-optimized RL baselines beyond $10^5$ tokens per problem, solving problems that standard generation cannot reach.

title: From Ham-Sandwich to Centerpoints: Semialgebraic Algorithms for Cutting Polytopal Measures
authors: Marie-Charlotte Brandenburg, Jesús A. De Loera, Chiara Meroni
abstract: We design exact algorithms for the ham-sandwich and centerpoint theorems for polytopal measures. Our key observation is that the cap-volume function of such a measure, i.e., the volume cut off by a halfspace, is piecewise rational on a natural decomposition of the space of oriented hyperplanes. This lets us recast prescribed-proportion cutting problems as semialgebraic feasibility problems. For fixed ambient dimension, this yields polynomial-time algorithms to decide the existence of cuts, describe the full solution set, and sample or enumerate solutions. We extend this framework to the center transversal theorem, showing that spaces of deep affine flats are semialgebraic, which holds for centerpoints. We further show that the set of centerpoints of a convex polytope coincides with its floating body at level $1/(d+1)$, a useful semialgebraic description.

title: Ultra-Low-Cost Hybrid Beamforming: A New Static-Connection Architecture with Sparse Phase-Shifter Sharing
authors: Honghao Wang, Qingqing Wu, Yifei Wu, Yuxuan Chen, Wen Chen, Derrick Wing Kwan Ng
abstract: Hybrid beamforming is a promising solution for high-frequency multi-antenna wireless systems, but its implementation is constrained by the cost and complexity of analog phase-shifter (PS) networks. Although sub-connected architectures simplify the analog network, their conventional realization still requires a dedicated PS for each antenna, causing considerable layout area, wiring, calibration, and control overheads. To address this issue, this paper proposes a novel static-connection architecture with sparse PSs for ultra-low-cost sub-connected hybrid beamforming, where antennas within each sub-array share a PS through an optimized fixed PS-to-antenna connection matrix. The proposed architecture preserves static connections while enabling dynamic beam control via adaptive PS phase-shift adjustments and digital precoding. For the single-radio-frequency (RF)-chain scenario, the sparse-PS connection design is transformed into an antenna-grouping problem, with analytically characterized structural properties and an efficient algorithm. For the multi-RF-chain scenario, we develop a quality-of-service (QoS)-majorization-minimization (MM) algorithm to handle the mixed discrete-continuous optimization problem. Numerical results demonstrate that the proposed architecture reduces the PS count while preserving most beamforming capability of the traditional full-PS sub-connected architecture. In particular, the proposed design achieves PS-count reductions of 37.5% and 62.5% in single-RF-chain and multi-RF-chain systems, respectively, while avoiding deep-null and grating-lobe degradations associated with deterministic connection schemes. These results provide engineering insights into static sparse-PS sharing: the key to hardware-efficient hybrid beamforming is not merely reducing the PS count, but also preserving essential analog-domain degrees of freedom through optimized PS connection topologies.
zh_title: 超低成本混合波束赋形：一种具有稀疏移相器共享的新型静态连接架构
translation: 混合波束赋形是高频多天线无线系统的一种有前景的解决方案，但其实现受到模拟移相器（PS）网络成本和复杂性的限制。尽管子连接架构简化了模拟网络，但其传统实现仍要求每个天线配备专用PS，导致相当大的布局面积、布线、校准和控制开销。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了一种用于超低成本子连接混合波束赋形的新型静态连接架构，其中每个子阵列内的天线通过优化的固定PS到天线连接矩阵共享一个PS。所提出的架构在保留静态连接的同时，通过自适应PS相位调整和数字预编码实现动态波束控制。对于单射频（RF）链场景，稀疏PS连接设计被转化为天线分组问题，并具有解析表征的结构特性和高效算法。对于多RF链场景，我们开发了一种服务质量（QoS）-Majorization-Minimization（MM）算法来处理混合离散-连续优化问题。数值结果表明，所提出的架构在保留传统全PS子连接架构大部分波束赋形能力的同时，减少了PS数量。特别是，该设计在单RF链和多RF链系统中分别实现了37.5%和62.5%的PS数量减少，同时避免了与确定性连接方案相关的深零点和栅瓣劣化。这些结果为静态稀疏PS共享提供了工程见解：硬件高效混合波束赋形的关键不仅在于减少PS数量，还在于通过优化的PS连接拓扑保留必要的模拟域自由度。
tldr: 通过创新的稀疏移相器共享架构，在大幅减少硬件成本的同时，保持了高频多天线系统的波束赋形性能。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种极具工程价值的硬件架构优化方案。其创新点在于通过优化的固定连接矩阵实现了移相器（PS）的共享，从而在大幅降低硬件成本的同时，通过数字预编码和剩余的模拟自由度保持了良好的波束赋形性能。这为高频大规模天线阵列的低成本设计提供了重要思路。
motivation: 传统的混合波束赋形架构中，即便采用子连接结构，每个天线仍需专用的移相器，导致高昂的布局面积、布线、校准和控制开销。亟需一种能进一步降低成本且保持波束赋形性能的架构。
method: 提出了一种静态连接架构，通过优化的固定PS到天线连接矩阵让天线共享移相器。针对单RF链场景，将其转化为天线分组问题并通过高效算法求解；针对多RF链场景，开发了基于QoS的Majorization-Minimization (MM) 算法来解决混合离散连续优化问题。
results: 在单RF链系统和多RF链系统中，移相器数量分别减少了37.5%和62.5%，且有效避免了传统确定性连接方案中常见的深零点和栅瓣劣化问题，保持了大部分的波束赋形能力。
conclusion: 研究证明，通过优化的静态稀疏PS共享架构，可以在显著减少移相器数量的同时，保持高频无线系统波束赋形的性能，是实现低成本硬件架构的有效途径。

title: Fast Multi-dimensional Refusal Subspaces via RFM-AGOP
authors: Thomas Winninger
abstract: Steering and monitoring activations in Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for both safety and interpretability. Early work assumed behaviours are encoded along single linear directions, but recent findings suggest complex behaviours, such as the refusal to answer harmful queries, live in multi-dimensional subspaces. However, existing methods for extracting these subspaces are computationally expensive, which becomes prohibitive on reasoning models who produce long reasoning traces. By adapting the Recursive Feature Machine (RFM) algorithm -- which can be computed efficiently -- with a probe-informed initialization, we are able to identify the multi-dimensional refusal subspace in seconds, on reasoning (Qwen 3) and non-reasoning (Qwen 2.5) models. While RFM allows for faster subspace identification, it also showed better performances on the ablation task than its alternatives. More work is planned to better understand the relations between subspaces found by different methods. If confirmed, RFM could be a cheap and scalable complement to existing subspace-extraction methods in LLMs.
comment: Accepted to the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea, 2026

title: WattGPU: Predicting Inference Power and Latency on Unseen GPUs and LLMs
authors: Mauricio Fadel Argerich, Jonathan Fürst, Marta Patiño-Martínez
abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) inference workloads are a rapidly growing contributor to data center energy consumption. Optimizing these deployments requires matching specific LLMs to the most efficient GPUs, but operators currently lack the tools to do so without exhaustively profiling each combination. While some predictive models exist, they still require profiling data and struggle to generalize to hardware unseen during training. To address this, we introduce \textit{WattGPU}, featuring two predictive models for mean GPU power draw and Inter-Token Latency (ITL). Our approach leverages only publicly available LLM metadata and GPU specifications, eliminating the need for hardware access or profiling while enabling generalization to unseen NVIDIA server-grade GPUs and LLMs. We evaluate our models using rigorous leave-one-GPU-out and leave-one-LLM-out cross-validation on a dataset of 42 open-source LLMs (0.1B--27B parameters) and 8 GPUs under both offline and server scenarios. The mean power draw model achieves a median absolute percentage error of $\leq3.4\%$ for offline and $\leq13.5\%$ for server scenarios on unseen GPUs, while the latency model achieves $\leq8.5\%$ in server mode, both maintaining strong GPU ranking correlations for server scenarios (Kendall $τ\geq0.76$). Compared to standard physically grounded baselines -- Load-Scaled Thermal Design Power (TDP) for power draw and roofline for latency -- our models reduce median absolute percentage error by approximately 4$\times$ on unseen LLM-GPU combinations for server scenarios or approximately 2$\times$ for completely unseen GPUs. WattGPU's data and code are publicly available at https://github.com/maufadel/wattgpu.
comment: Accepted at 1st Workshop on Sustainability and Resource-Efficiency of Artificial Intelligence @ IJCAI 2026
zh_title: WattGPU：预测未见GPU和LLM上的推理功耗与延迟
translation: 大语言模型（LLM）推理工作负载正迅速成为数据中心能源消耗的主要增长点。优化这些部署需要将特定的LLM与最高效的GPU相匹配，但目前操作人员缺乏无需对每种组合进行详尽分析就能实现这一目标的工具。虽然存在一些预测模型，但它们仍需要分析数据，且难以泛化到训练期间未见的硬件上。为了解决这个问题，我们推出了WattGPU，它包含两个分别用于预测平均GPU功耗和Token间延迟（ITL）的预测模型。我们的方法仅利用公开的LLM元数据和GPU规格，无需硬件访问或性能分析，同时实现了对未见的NVIDIA服务器级GPU和LLM的泛化。我们使用留一GPU法和留一LLM法交叉验证，在包含42个开源LLM（0.1B--27B参数）和8个GPU的离线及服务器场景数据集上评估了我们的模型。平均功耗模型在未见GPU上的离线场景中值绝对百分比误差≤3.4%，服务器场景≤13.5%；延迟模型在服务器模式下误差≤8.5%，两者在服务器场景下均保持了较强的GPU排序相关性（Kendall τ≥0.76）。与标准的物理基础基准（功耗的负载缩放热设计功耗TDP和延迟的Roofline模型）相比，我们的模型在服务器场景下未见LLM-GPU组合上的中值绝对百分比误差降低了约4倍，在完全未见的GPU上降低了约2倍。WattGPU的数据和代码已在https://github.com/maufadel/wattgpu公开。
tldr: WattGPU是一种无需实机性能分析的预测工具，仅凭公开的规格参数即可高精度预测LLM在不同GPU上的功耗与延迟，帮助优化数据中心部署。
ai_comments: 该研究通过利用公开的元数据和规格参数，而非依赖昂贵的实机性能分析，成功解决了在未见过的硬件和模型组合上预测能耗与延迟的难题。其核心创新在于实现了跨硬件和模型的泛化能力，为数据中心优化LLM部署提供了高效的辅助决策工具。
motivation: 当前数据中心LLM推理能耗增长迅速，但为每种LLM与GPU组合进行详尽性能分析极其耗时。现有的预测模型往往缺乏对未见硬件的泛化能力，且依赖于难以获取的性能数据。
method: 构建了两个独立的预测模型，分别针对平均GPU功耗和Token间延迟（ITL）。该方法仅依赖公开的LLM元数据和GPU规格参数，无需进行硬件实测或性能分析，并通过留一法（leave-one-out）交叉验证进行评估。
results: 在未见过的GPU和LLM组合上，WattGPU的平均功耗模型中值绝对百分比误差在离线场景下≤3.4%，服务器场景下≤13.5%；延迟模型在服务器模式下误差≤8.5%，且在排序相关性上表现优异（Kendall τ≥0.76），性能显著优于传统基准。
conclusion: WattGPU通过仅使用公开元数据即实现了对未见GPU和LLM的高精度能耗与延迟预测，显著优于传统的物理基准方法，为大规模LLM部署的能效优化提供了有效方案。

title: FlintKV: A Fast Durable Storage Engine for Modern Databases
authors: Sergey Egorov, Gregory Chockler, Brijesh Dongol, Dan O'Keeffe, Sadegh Keshavarzi
abstract: Byte-addressable non-volatile memory (NVM) offers an opportunity to rethink storage engine architectures. While recent NVM key-value stores achieve high throughput for ingestion and point lookups, they omit or under-specify the support for the richer interface guarantees required by modern databases. Production key-value engines (e.g., RocksDB) provide point-in-time snapshots, consistent iterators, and atomic batches-features essential for implementing transactions and concurrency control. We present FlintKV, an NVM-optimized skiplist-based storage engine that natively supports the full API of production key-value stores. FlintKV supports both atomic batch writes and snapshot-consistent iteration efficiently while guaranteeing durable linearizability. FlintKV can be deployed standalone or its durable skiplist can be integrated into existing NVM stores to enhance their capabilities. Central to FlintKV is a novel flat-combining based concurrency control algorithm that leverages multi-versioning and carefully co-designed persistence mechanisms to ensure high performance and scalability. Our empirical evaluation shows that FlintKV can achieve up to a 75% improvement in end-to-end throughput over prior work.
zh_title: FlintKV：一种用于现代数据库的快速持久化存储引擎
translation: 字节寻址的非易失性内存（NVM）为重构存储引擎架构提供了契机。尽管近期的NVM键值存储在数据摄入和点查询方面实现了高吞吐量，但它们忽略或未充分说明对现代数据库所需更丰富接口保证的支持。生产级键值引擎（如RocksDB）提供的即时快照、一致性迭代器和原子批处理功能，对于实现事务和并发控制至关重要。我们提出了FlintKV，一种基于跳表的NVM优化存储引擎，它原生支持生产级键值存储的完整API。FlintKV能高效地支持原子批处理写入和快照一致性迭代，同时保证了持久化的线性一致性。FlintKV既可以作为独立引擎部署，其持久化跳表也可以集成到现有的NVM存储中以增强其功能。FlintKV的核心是一种新型的基于扁平组合（flat-combining）的并发控制算法，它利用多版本控制和精心协同设计的持久化机制来确保高性能和可扩展性。实证评估表明，与之前的工作相比，FlintKV的端到端吞吐量最高可提升75%。
tldr: FlintKV是一款针对NVM优化的存储引擎，通过创新的并发控制机制，在支持生产级数据库完整功能的同时，实现了比现有方案高出75%的吞吐量。
ai_comments: FlintKV的创新之处在于将生产级数据库所需的关键特性（如快照、原子批处理）与NVM的高性能结合起来。它通过创新的扁平组合（flat-combining）并发控制算法解决了NVM存储引擎在复杂接口支持与高性能之间的平衡问题，具有很高的实用价值和学术意义。
motivation: 现有的NVM键值存储虽然在吞吐量方面表现优异，但往往缺乏现代数据库所需的关键功能（如快照、一致性迭代、原子批处理），该研究旨在填补这一空白。
method: FlintKV基于跳表结构，采用了一种新型的基于扁平组合（flat-combining）的并发控制算法，并结合多版本控制和协同设计的持久化机制，以支持原子批处理写入和快照一致性迭代。
results: 实验评估表明，FlintKV在端到端吞吐量上比现有工作提升了高达75%。
conclusion: FlintKV通过结合扁平组合并发控制和针对NVM优化的持久化机制，成功为现代数据库提供了一个既具备高性能又支持完整生产级API的存储引擎。

title: Show Me Examples: Inferring Visual Concepts from Image Sets
authors: Nick Stracke, Kolja Bauer, Stefan Andreas Baumann, Miguel Angel Bautista, Josh Susskind, Björn Ommer
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can follow complex textual instructions, yet they struggle to reason from purely visual context. In particular, current models fail to infer shared concepts from sets of example images and apply them to new inputs. We introduce Visual Concept Inference from Sets (VICIS), a task that evaluates this capability. Given a small context set of images sharing a concept and a query image, the model must generate new images that preserve the context-defined concept while remaining consistent with the query. We show that state-of-the-art VLMs perform poorly on this task, often ignoring the visual context or defaulting to biased generations. To address this gap, we propose a training framework and architecture that learn to infer visual concepts from image sets and extract concept-specific embeddings from queries. Experiments on synthetic data and large-scale ImageNet/WordNet data show that our model generates more accurate and diverse outputs and generalizes to unseen concepts and modalities such as sketches.
zh_title: 展示示例：从图像集中推断视觉概念
translation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）能够遵循复杂的文本指令，但它们难以从纯视觉上下文中进行推理。特别是，现有模型无法从一组示例图像中推断出共享概念并将其应用到新的输入中。我们引入了“从集合中进行视觉概念推理”（VICIS）任务，用于评估这种能力。给定一组共享某个概念的小型上下文图像集和一张查询图像，模型必须生成既保留上下文定义概念又与查询图像保持一致的新图像。我们证明了最先进的VLM在执行该任务时表现不佳，往往忽略视觉上下文或默认生成有偏见的结果。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了一个训练框架和架构，学习从图像集中推断视觉概念并从查询中提取特定概念的嵌入。在合成数据和大规模ImageNet/WordNet数据上的实验表明，我们的模型生成了更准确、更多样的输出，并能泛化到未见过的概念和素描等模态。
tldr: 本文提出了VICIS任务及模型框架，使视觉语言模型能够从图像集合中推理并应用视觉概念，解决了当前模型在纯视觉推理上的局限。
ai_comments: 该论文指出了当前视觉语言模型（VLM）在处理基于视觉上下文推理方面的不足，并提出了一个新颖的任务（VICIS）和相应的训练框架。其创新点在于将视觉概念推理从文本转向了纯图像集，这对实现更通用的视觉智能具有重要意义。局限性在于该任务在复杂现实场景下的鲁棒性仍有待进一步验证。
motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型虽然擅长处理文本指令，但在纯视觉上下文的推理方面存在不足，特别是难以从图像集中推断出共享概念并将其应用到新输入中。
method: 提出了VICIS（Visual Concept Inference from Sets）任务，并设计了一个能够从图像集中学习视觉概念、从查询中提取特定概念嵌入的训练框架与架构。
results: 实验表明，该模型在合成数据及ImageNet/WordNet数据集上均能生成更准确、更多样的图像，并展现出对未见概念及素描等模态的良好泛化能力。
conclusion: 通过引入VICIS任务及相应的训练框架，该研究成功提升了模型从图像集推理视觉概念的能力，并在准确性和泛化性上优于现有的先进模型。

title: ACID: Action Consistency via Inverse Dynamics for Planning with World Models
authors: Gawon Seo, Dongwon Kim, Suha Kwak
abstract: Decision-time planning with action-conditioned world models has become a popular paradigm for embodied control. However, the standard planning cost judges a candidate solely by how close its predicted terminal state lies to the goal, leaving the realizability of the intermediate transitions unchecked -- a predicted trajectory can look convincing while the environment rollout drifts away from it. In this paper, we propose ACID, a decision-time planning framework that introduces cycle action consistency: the action inferred backward from a predicted transition by an inverse dynamics model should recover the one that was conditioned on. We fold this per-step residual into the planning cost via a scale-invariant adaptive weight. Across four action-conditioned world models and six tasks spanning rigid and deformable manipulation, articulated control, and visual navigation, ACID consistently improves planning and matches the baseline's accuracy with substantially less planning compute.
zh_title: ACID：通过逆动力学实现动作一致性，用于基于世界模型的规划
translation: 基于动作条件的世界模型决策规划已成为具身控制的一种流行范式。然而，标准的规划代价仅根据预测的终端状态与目标的接近程度来判断候选方案，而忽略了中间过渡过程的可实现性——一条预测轨迹看起来可能令人信服，但实际环境运行中却会偏离。在本文中，我们提出了 ACID，这是一个决策规划框架，引入了循环动作一致性：通过逆动力学模型从预测转移中反向推断出的动作，应能恢复出用于条件化的原始动作。我们将这一逐步残差通过尺度不变的自适应权重纳入规划代价中。在四种基于动作条件的世界模型和六个涵盖刚体和柔性操纵、关节控制以及视觉导航的任务中，ACID 一致性地改进了规划，并以更少的规划计算量达到了基准线的准确度。
tldr: ACID 通过引入逆动力学检查来约束世界模型的轨迹预测，不仅提高了控制任务的准确性，还显著降低了规划所需的计算量。
ai_comments: 该论文通过引入逆动力学模型来约束动作的一致性，从而解决了世界模型在规划中产生的“漂移”问题。其创新点在于将动作一致性作为规划代价的一部分，不仅提高了任务成功率，还显著降低了计算开销，具有很强的实用价值。
motivation: 现有的世界模型规划方法仅关注最终状态与目标的距离，忽略了中间过渡过程的真实性，导致实际环境运行中出现漂移。
method: 提出 ACID 框架，通过逆动力学模型推断预测转移中的动作，并将其与原始动作进行对比，计算循环一致性损失，将其作为规划代价的一部分，并使用尺度不变的自适应权重进行调节。
results: 在四种世界模型和六种涵盖刚体/柔性操纵、关节控制及视觉导航的任务中，ACID 显著提升了规划效果，并在大幅减少计算资源的情况下达到了基准线的精度。
conclusion: ACID 框架通过引入循环动作一致性约束，有效提升了世界模型在复杂控制任务中的规划质量和计算效率。

title: Object-centric LeJEPA
authors: Jakob Geusen, Ender Konukoglu
abstract: Image encoders trained with LeJEPA can deliver strong features for downstream tasks, but, like other image-level self-supervised methods, typically require large training datasets. Aligning representations at the level of objects rather than whole scenes promises greater data efficiency, but doing this in a completely self-supervised way, effectively jointly partitioning a scene and representing its objects, is unstable: the two are locked in a cyclic dependency, partitioning requires meaningful representations, while meaningful representations require consistent partitioning. We sidestep this instability by taking object masks as given during training, using cheap, off-the-shelf SAM proposals. We extend LeJEPA - whose distributional anti-collapse objective ports naturally from whole images to variable-sized sets of objects - to align object-centric representations rather than whole images.
